Upon this Bushair ibn Ka'b said: Verily we find in certain books or books of (wisdom) that it is God-inspired peace of mind or sobriety for the sake of Allah and there is also a weakness in it. Imran was so much enraged that his eyes became red and he said: I am narrating to you the hadith of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and you are contradicting it. He (the narrator) said: Imran reported the hadith, He (the narrator) said: Bushair repeated, (the same thing). Imran was enraged. He (the narrator) said: We asserted: Verily Bushair is one amongst us. Abu Nujaid! There is nothing wrong, with him (Bushair)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَعَامَةَ الْعَدَوِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حُجَيْرَ بْنَ الرَّبِيعِ الْعَدَوِيَّ، يَقُولُ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alnnadru, haddathanaa aabuw na'aamaaa al'adawiyyu, qaala sami'tu hujayra bna alrrabiy'i al'adawiyya, yaquwlu 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwa hadiythi hammaadi bni zaydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ishaq b. Ibrahim narrates this hadith of the Prophet on the authority of Imran b. Husain, like the one narrated by Hammad b. Zaid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا السَّوَّارِ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عِمْرَانَ بْنَ حُصَيْنٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بُشَيْرُ بْنُ كَعْبٍ إِنَّهُ مَكْتُوبٌ فِي الْحِكْمَةِ أَنَّ مِنْهُ وَقَارًا وَمِنْهُ سَكِينَةً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عِمْرَانُ أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتُحَدِّثُنِي عَنْ صُحُفِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa alssawwaari, yuhaddithu aannahu sami'a 'imraana bna husaynin, yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ alhayaa'u laa yaatiy iilaaa bikhayrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala bushayru bnu ka'bin iinnahu maktuwbun fiy alhikmaai aanna minhu waqaarana waminhu sakiynaaan ‏.‏ faqaala 'imraanu auhaddithuka 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm watuhaddithuniy 'an suhufika ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Imran b. Husain that the Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) said:Modesty brings forth nothing but goodness. Bushair b. Ka'b said: It is recorded in the books of wisdom, there lies sobriety in it and calmness of mind in it, Imran said: I am narrating to you the tradition of the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) and you talk of your books
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قُلْ لِي فِي الإِسْلاَمِ قَوْلاً لاَ أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ أَحَدًا بَعْدَكَ - وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ غَيْرَكَ - قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُلْ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ فَاسْتَقِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an jariyrin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kulluhum 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sufyaana bni 'abdi alllahi althhaqafiyyi, qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi qul liy fiy aliislaami qawlaan laa aasaalu 'anhu aahadana ba'daka - wafiy hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa ghayraka - qaala ‏ "‏ qul amantu bialllahi faastaqim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Sufyan b. 'Abdulla al-Thaqafi that he said:I asked the Messenger of Allah to tell me about Islam a thing which might dispense with the necessity of my asking anybody after you. In the hadith of Abu Usama the (words) are: other than you. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: Say I affirm my faith in Allah and then remain steadfast to it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ وَتَقْرَأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, aanna rajulaan, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau aliislaami khayrun qaala ‏ "‏ tut'imu altta'aama wataqraau alssalaama 'alaa man 'arafta waman lam ta'rif ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. 'Amr that a man asked the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) which of the merits (is superior) in Islam. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked:That you provide food and extend greetings to one whom you know or do not know
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ خَيْرٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni sarhin almisriyyu aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an 'amriw bni alhaarithi, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'amriw bni al'aasi, yaquwlu iinna rajulaan saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau almuslimiyna khayrun qaala ‏ "‏ man salima almuslimuwna min lisaanihi wayadihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Amr b. al-As is reported to have said:Verily a person asked the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) who amongst the Muslims was better. Upon this (the Holy Prophet) remarked: From whose hand and tongue the Muslims are safe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي عَاصِمٍ، - قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy 'aasimin, - qaala 'abdun aanbaaanaa aabuw 'aasimin, - 'ani abni jurayjin, aannahu sami'a aabaa alzzubayri, yaquwlu sami'tu jaabirana, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ almuslimu man salima almuslimuwna min lisaanihi wayadihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that he heard the (Holy Prophet) say:A Muslim is he from whose hand and tongue the Muslims are safe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأُمَوِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الإِسْلاَمِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy sa'iydu bnu yahyaa bni sa'iydin alaumawiyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw burdaaa bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy burdaaa bni aabiy muwsaa, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaaau aliislaami aafdalu qaala ‏ "‏ man salima almuslimuwna min lisaanihi wayadihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Musa Ash'ari:I asked the Messenger of Allah which (attribute) of Islam is more excellent. Upon this he remarked: One in which the Muslims are safe, protected from the tongue and hand of (other Muslims)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بُرَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ أَفْضَلُ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi iibraahiymu bnu sa'iydin aljawhariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaala haddathaniy buraydu bnu 'abdi alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau almuslimiyna aafdalu fadhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibrahim b. Sa'id al-Jauhari has narrated this hadith with the same words in addition to these. The Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) was asked as to who amongst the Muslims is better, and the rest of the hadith was narrated like this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، - قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ وَجَدَ بِهِنَّ حَلاَوَةَ الإِيمَانِ مَنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا سِوَاهُمَا وَأَنْ يُحِبَّ الْمَرْءَ لاَ يُحِبُّهُ إِلاَّ لِلَّهِ وَأَنْ يَكْرَهَ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي الْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَنْقَذَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ كَمَا يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُقْذَفَ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu yahyaa bni aabiy 'umara, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, jamiy'ana 'ani althhaqafiyyi, - qaala abnu aabiy 'umara haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ thalaathun man kunna fiyhi wajada bihinna halaawaaa aliiymaani man kaana alllahu warasuwluhu aahabba iilayhi mimmaa siwaahumaa waaan yuhibba almar'a laa yuhibbuhu iilaaa lillahi waaan yakraha aan ya'uwda fiy alkufri ba'da aan aanqadhahu alllahu minhu kamaa yakrahu aan yuqdhafa fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Anas that the Prophet of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him ) said:There are three qualities for which anyone who is characterised by them will relish the sweetness of faith: he to whom Allah and His Messenger are dearer than all else; he who loves a man for Allah's sake alone; and he who has as great an abhorrence of returning to unbelief after Allah has rescued him from it as he has of being cast into Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ وَجَدَ طَعْمَ الإِيمَانِ مَنْ كَانَ يُحِبُّ الْمَرْءَ لاَ يُحِبُّهُ إِلاَّ لِلَّهِ وَمَنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا سِوَاهُمَا وَمَنْ كَانَ أَنْ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ فِي الْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَنْقَذَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aanasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ thalaathun man kunna fiyhi wajada ta'ma aliiymaani man kaana yuhibbu almar'a laa yuhibbuhu iilaaa lillahi waman kaana alllahu warasuwluhu aahabba iilayhi mimmaa siwaahumaa waman kaana aan yulqaa fiy alnnaari aahabba iilayhi min aan yarji'a fiy alkufri ba'da aan aanqadhahu alllahu minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:There are three qualities for which any one who is characterised by them will relish the savour of faith: that he loves man and he does not love him but for Allah's sake alone; he is to whom Allah and His Messenger are dearer than all else; he who prefers to be thrown into fire than to return to unbelief after Allah has rescued him out of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مِنْ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ يَهُودِيًّا أَوْ نَصْرَانِيًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aanbaaanaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, aanbaaanaa hammaadun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythihim ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ min aan yarji'a yahuwdiyyana aaw nasraaniyyana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A similar hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas (with another chain of transmitters) with the exception of these words:that he again becomes a Jew or a Christian
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ عَبْدٌ - وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ الرَّجُلُ - حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, h wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yuuminu 'abdun - wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alwaarithi alrrajulu - hattaa aakuwna aahabba iilayhi min aahlihi wamaalihi waalnnaasi aajma'iyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:No bondsman believes, and, in the hadith narrated by Abdul Warith, no person believes, till I am dearer to him than the members of his household, his wealth and the whole of mankind
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ وَلَدِهِ وَوَالِدِهِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yuuminu aahadukum hattaa aakuwna aahabba iilayhi min waladihi wawaalidihi waalnnaasi aajma'iyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah said:None of you is a believer until I am dearer to him than his child, his father, and the whole of mankind
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ - أَوْ قَالَ لِجَارِهِ - مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yuuminu aahadukum hattaa yuhibba laakhiyhi - aaw qaala lijaarihi - maa yuhibbu linafsihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:"None amongst you believes (truly) until he loves for his brother" - or he said "for his neighbour" - "that which he loves for himself
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ عَبْدٌ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِجَارِهِ - أَوْ قَالَ لأَخِيهِ - مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an husaynin almu'allimi, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laa yuuminu 'abdun hattaa yuhibba lijaarihi - aaw qaala laakhiyhi - maa yuhibbu linafsihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that the Prophet (may peace blessings be upon him) observed:By Him in whose Hand is my life, no, bondsman (truly) believes till he likes for his neighbour, or he (the Holy Prophet) said: for his brother, whatever he likes for himself
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ لاَ يَأْمَنُ جَارُهُ بَوَائِقَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, jamiy'ana 'an iismaa'iyla bni ja'farin, - qaala abnu aayyuwba haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - qaala aakhbaraniy al'alaa'u, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulu aljannaaa man laa yaamanu jaaruhu bawaaiiqahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessing be upon him) observed:He will not enter Paradise whose neighbour is not secure from his wrongful conduct
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ جَارَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aanbaaanaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyaqul khayrana aaw liyasmut waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyukrim jaarahu waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyukrim dayfahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should either utter good words or better keep silence; and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should treat his neighbour with kindness and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should show hospitality to his guest
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يُؤْذِي جَارَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَسْكُتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falaa yuudhiy jaarahu waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyukrim dayfahu waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyaqul khayrana aaw liyaskut ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:He who believes in Allah and the Last Day does not harm is neighbour, and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day shows hospitality to his guest and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day speaks good or remains silent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي حَصِينٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلْيُحْسِنْ إِلَى جَارِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi aabiy hasiynin ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ falyuhsin iilaa jaarihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Another hadith similar to one narrated (above) by Abu Husain is also reported by Abu Huraira with the exception of these words:He (the Prophet) said: He should do good to the neighbour
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، - عَنْ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، يُخْبِرُ عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُحْسِنْ إِلَى جَارِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَسْكُتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala abnu numayrin haddathanaa sufyaanu, - 'an 'amrinw, aannahu sami'a naafi'a bna jubayrin, yukhbiru 'an aabiy shurayhin alkhuzaa'iyyi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyuhsin iilaa jaarihi waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyukrim dayfahu waman kaana yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri falyaqul khayrana aaw liyaskut ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Shuraih al-Khuzai' that the Prophet (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) observed:He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should do good to his neighbour and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should show hospitality to the guest and he who believes in Allah and the Last Day should either speak good or better remain silent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، - وَهَذَا حَدِيثُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ بَدَأَ بِالْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ مَرْوَانُ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ الصَّلاَةُ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ قَدْ تُرِكَ مَا هُنَالِكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ أَمَّا هَذَا فَقَدْ قَضَى مَا عَلَيْهِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمْ مُنْكَرًا فَلْيُغَيِّرْهُ بِيَدِهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِلِسَانِهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِقَلْبِهِ وَذَلِكَ أَضْعَفُ الإِيمَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, kilaahumaa 'an qaysi bni muslimin, 'an taariqi bni shihaabin, - wahadhaa hadiythu aabiy bakrin - qaala aawwalu man badaaa bialkhutbaai yawma al'iydi qabla alssalaaai marwaanu faqaama iilayhi rajulun faqaala alssalaaau qabla alkhutbaai ‏.‏ faqaala qad turika maa hunaalika ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw sa'iydin aammaa hadhaa faqad qadaa maa 'alayhi sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man raaaa minkum munkarana falyughayyirhu biyadihi faiin lam yastati' fabilisaanihi faiin lam yastati' fabiqalbihi wadhalika aad'afu aliiymaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Tariq b. Shihab:It was Marwan who initiated (the practice) of delivering khutbah (address) before the prayer on the 'Id day. A man stood up and said: Prayer should precede khutbah. He (Marwan) remarked, This (practice) has been done away with. Upon this Abu Sa'id remarked: This man has performed (his duty) laid on him. I heard the Messenger of Allah as saying: He who amongst you sees something abominable should modify it with the help of his hand; and if he has not strength enough to do it, then he should do it with his tongue, and if he has not strength enough to do it, (even) then he should (abhor it) from his heart, and that is the least of faith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، وَعَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، فِي قِصَّةِ مَرْوَانَ وَحَدِيثِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ وَسُفْيَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iismaa'iyla bni rajaa'in, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, wa'an qaysi bni muslimin, 'an taariqi bni shihaabin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, fiy qissaai marwaana wahadiythi aabiy sa'iydin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi shu'baaa wasufyaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith of the Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) has been reported by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri in connection with the story of Marwan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَبْدٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْمِسْوَرِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ فِي أُمَّةٍ قَبْلِي إِلاَّ كَانَ لَهُ مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ حَوَارِيُّونَ وَأَصْحَابٌ يَأْخُذُونَ بِسُنَّتِهِ وَيَقْتَدُونَ بِأَمْرِهِ ثُمَّ إِنَّهَا تَخْلُفُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خُلُوفٌ يَقُولُونَ مَا لاَ يَفْعَلُونَ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا لاَ يُؤْمَرُونَ فَمَنْ جَاهَدَهُمْ بِيَدِهِ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَمَنْ جَاهَدَهُمْ بِلِسَانِهِ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَمَنْ جَاهَدَهُمْ بِقَلْبِهِ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَلَيْسَ وَرَاءَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ حَبَّةُ خَرْدَلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو رَافِعٍ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ فَأَنْكَرَهُ عَلَىَّ فَقَدِمَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ فَنَزَلَ بِقَنَاةَ فَاسْتَتْبَعَنِي إِلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ يَعُودُهُ فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا جَلَسْنَا سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ عَنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ فَحَدَّثَنِيهِ كَمَا حَدَّثْتُهُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ صَالِحٌ وَقَدْ تُحُدِّثَ بِنَحْوِ ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waaabuw bakri bnu alnnadri wa'abdu bnu humaydin - waalllafzu li'abdin - qaaluwa haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'ani alhaarithi, 'an ja'fari bni 'abdi alllahi bni alhakami, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni almiswari, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa min nabiyyin ba'athahu alllahu fiy aummaain qabliy iilaaa kaana lahu min aummatihi hawaariyyuwna waaashaabun yaakhudhuwna bisunnatihi wayaqtaduwna biaamrihi thumma iinnahaa takhlufu min ba'dihim khuluwfun yaquwluwna maa laa yaf'aluwna wayaf'aluwna maa laa yuumaruwna faman jaahadahum biyadihi fahuwa muuminun waman jaahadahum bilisaanihi fahuwa muuminun waman jaahadahum biqalbihi fahuwa muuminun walaysa waraa'a dhalika mina aliiymaani habbaau khardalin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw raafi'in fahaddathtuhu 'abda alllahi bna 'umara faaankarahu 'alaaaa faqadima abnu mas'uwdin fanazala biqanaaaa faastatba'aniy iilayhi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara ya'uwduhu faantalaqtu ma'ahu falammaa jalasnaa saaaltu abna mas'uwdin 'an hadhaa alhadiythi fahaddathaniyhi kamaa haddathtuhu abna 'umara ‏.‏ qaala saalihun waqad tuhudditha binahwi dhalika 'an aabiy raafi'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:Never a Prophet had been sent before me by Allah towards his nation who had not among his people (his) disciples and companions who followed his ways and obeyed his command. Then there came after them their successors who said whatever they did not practise, and practised whatever they were not commanded to do. He who strove against them with his hand was a believer: he who strove against them with his tongue was a believer, and he who strove against them with his heart was a believer and beyond that there is no faith even to the extent of a mustard seed. Abu Rafi' said: I narrated this hadith to 'Abdullah b. 'Umar; he contradicted me. There happened to come 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud who stayed at Qanat, and 'Abdullah b 'Umar wanted me to accompany him for visiting him (as 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud was ailing), so I went along with him and as we sat (before him) I asked Ibn Mas'ud about this hadith. He narrated it in the same way as I narrated it to Ibn 'Umar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ الْفُضَيْلِ الْخَطْمِيُّ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا كَانَ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ كَانَ لَهُ حَوَارِيُّونَ يَهْتَدُونَ بِهَدْيِهِ وَيَسْتَنُّونَ بِسُنَّتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ صَالِحٍ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قُدُومَ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَاجْتِمَاعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مَعَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa bni muhammadin, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, qaala aakhbaraniy alhaarithu bnu alfudayli alkhatmiyyu, 'an ja'fari bni 'abdi alllahi bni alhakami, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni almiswari bni makhramaaa, 'an aabiy raafi'in, mawlaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa kaana min nabiyyin iilaaa waqad kaana lahu hawaariyyuwna yahtaduwna bihadyihi wayastannuwna bisunnatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ mithla hadiythi saalihin walam yadhkur quduwma abni mas'uwdin waajtimaa'a abni 'umara ma'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith has been transmitted by another chain of narrators on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud who observed:Never was there one among the prophets who had had not disciples who followed his direction and followed his ways. The remaining part of the hadith is like that as narrated by Salih but the arrival of Ibn Mas'ud and the meeting of Ibn 'Umar with him is not mentioned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَيْسًا، يَرْوِي عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ أَشَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ نَحْوَ الْيَمَنِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ إِنَّ الإِيمَانَ هَا هُنَا وَإِنَّ الْقَسْوَةَ وَغِلَظَ الْقُلُوبِ فِي الْفَدَّادِينَ عِنْدَ أُصُولِ أَذْنَابِ الإِبِلِ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنَا الشَّيْطَانِ فِي رَبِيعَةَ وَمُضَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, kulluhum 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an iismaa'iyla, qaala sami'tu qaysana, yarwiy 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, qaala aashaara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi nahwa alyamani faqaala ‏ "‏ aalaa iinna aliiymaana haa hunaa waiinna alqaswaaa waghilaza alquluwbi fiy alfaddaadiyna 'inda ausuwli aadhnaabi aliibili haythu yatlu'u qarnaa alshhaytaani fiy rabiy'aaa wamudara ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) pointed towards Yemen with his hand and said:Verily Iman is towards this side, and harshness and callousness of the hearts is found amongst the rude owners of the camels who drive them behind their tails (to the direction) where emerge the two horns of Satan, they are the tribes of Rabi'a and Mudar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ جَاءَ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ هُمْ أَرَقُّ أَفْئِدَةً الإِيمَانُ يَمَانٍ وَالْفِقْهُ يَمَانٍ وَالْحِكْمَةُ يَمَانِيَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, aanbaaanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, haddathanaa muhammadun, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ jaa'a aahlu alyamani hum aaraqqu aafiidaaan aliiymaanu yamaanin waalfiqhu yamaanin waalhikmaau yamaaniyaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah observed:There have come the people of Yemen; they are tender of hearts, the belief is that of the Yemenites, the understanding (of the faith) is that of the Yemenites and sagacity is that of the Yemenites
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْرَقُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu yuwsufa alaazraqu, kilaahumaa 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported the same hadith which is transmitted to us by another chain of transmitters, e. g. Muhammad b. al-Muthanna, Ishaq b. Yusuf Azraq, Ibn 'Aun, etc
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَتَاكُمْ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ هُمْ أَضْعَفُ قُلُوبًا وَأَرَقُّ أَفْئِدَةً الْفِقْهُ يَمَانٍ وَالْحِكْمَةُ يَمَانِيَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wahasanun alhulwaaniyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani alaa'raji, qaala qaala aabuw hurayraaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aataakum aahlu alyamani hum aad'afu quluwbana waaaraqqu aafiidaaan alfiqhu yamaanin waalhikmaau yamaaniyaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed: There came to you the people from Yemen; they are tender of hearts and mild of feelings, the understanding is Yemenite, the sagacity is Yemenite
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ رَأْسُ الْكُفْرِ نَحْوَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْفَخْرُ وَالْخُيَلاَءُ فِي أَهْلِ الْخَيْلِ وَالإِبِلِ الْفَدَّادِينَ أَهْلِ الْوَبَرِ وَالسَّكِينَةُ فِي أَهْلِ الْغَنَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ raasu alkufri nahwa almashriqi waalfakhru waalkhuyalaa'u fiy aahli alkhayli waaliibili alfaddaadiyna aahli alwabari waalssakiynaau fiy aahli alghanami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) remarked:The summit of unbelief is towards the East and the pride and conceitedness is found among the owners of horses and camels who are rude and uncivil, people of the tents, and tranquillity is found among those who rear goats and sheep
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الإِيمَانُ يَمَانٍ وَالْكُفْرُ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالسَّكِينَةُ فِي أَهْلِ الْغَنَمِ وَالْفَخْرُ وَالرِّيَاءُ فِي الْفَدَّادِينَ أَهْلِ الْخَيْلِ وَالْوَبَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin 'an iismaa'iyla bni ja'farin, - qaala abnu aayyuwba haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - qaala aakhbaraniy al'alaa'u, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aliiymaanu yamaanin waalkufru qibala almashriqi waalssakiynaau fiy aahli alghanami waalfakhru waalrriyaa'u fiy alfaddaadiyna aahli alkhayli waalwabari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:The belief is among the Yemenites, and the unbelief is towards the East, and tranquillity is among those who rear goats and sheep, and pride and simulation is among the uncivil and rude owners of horses and camels
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْفَخْرُ وَالْخُيَلاَءُ فِي الْفَدَّادِينَ أَهْلِ الْوَبَرِ وَالسَّكِينَةُ فِي أَهْلِ الْغَنَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alfakhru waalkhuyalaa'u fiy alfaddaadiyna aahli alwabari waalssakiynaau fiy aahli alghanami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira:I heard the Messenger of Allah saying this: Pride and conceitedness is found among the uncivil owners of the camels and tranquillity is found among the owners of sheep and goats
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ ‏ "‏ الإِيمَانُ يَمَانٍ وَالْحِكْمَةُ يَمَانِيَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu wazaada ‏ "‏ aliiymaanu yamaanin waalhikmaau yamaaniyaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of authorities with the addition:The belief is among the Yemenites, the sagacity is that of the Yemenites
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ جَاءَ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ هُمْ أَرَقُّ أَفْئِدَةً وَأَضْعَفُ قُلُوبًا الإِيمَانُ يَمَانٍ وَالْحِكْمَةُ يَمَانِيَةٌ السَّكِينَةُ فِي أَهْلِ الْغَنَمِ وَالْفَخْرُ وَالْخُيَلاَءُ فِي الْفَدَّادِينَ أَهْلِ الْوَبَرِ قِبَلَ مَطْلِعِ الشَّمْسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, 'an shu'aybin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ jaa'a aahlu alyamani hum aaraqqu aafiidaaan waaad'afu quluwbana aliiymaanu yamaanin waalhikmaau yamaaniyaaun alssakiynaau fiy aahli alghanami waalfakhru waalkhuyalaa'u fiy alfaddaadiyna aahli alwabari qibala matli'i alshhamsi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira said:I heard the Prophet (may peace and blessings be upon him) saying: There came the people of Yemen, they are tender of feelings and meek of hearts. The belief is that of the Yemenites, the sagacity is that of the Yemenites, the tranquillity is among the owners of goats and sheep, and pride and conceitedness is among the uncivil owners of the camels, the people of the tents in the direction of sunrise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَتَاكُمْ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ هُمْ أَلْيَنُ قُلُوبًا وَأَرَقُّ أَفْئِدَةً الإِيمَانُ يَمَانٍ وَالْحِكْمَةُ يَمَانِيَةٌ رَأْسُ الْكُفْرِ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aataakum aahlu alyamani hum aalyanu quluwbana waaaraqqu aafiidaaan aliiymaanu yamaanin waalhikmaau yamaaniyaaun raasu alkufri qibala almashriqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reporter on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:There came the people of Yemen who are soft of hearts, tender in feelings: the belief is that of the Yemenites, the sagacity is that of the Yemenites and the summit of unbelief is towards the East
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏ "‏ رَأْسُ الْكُفْرِ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur ‏ "‏ raasu alkufri qibala almashriqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qutaiba b. Sa'id and Zubair b. Harb say:Jarir narrated this on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of narrators (as mentioned above)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ وَزَادَ ‏ "‏ وَالْفَخْرُ وَالْخُيَلاَءُ فِي أَصْحَابِ الإِبِلِ وَالسَّكِينَةُ وَالْوَقَارُ فِي أَصْحَابِ الشَّاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathaniy bishru bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithla hadiythi jariyrin wazaada ‏ "‏ waalfakhru waalkhuyalaa'u fiy aashaabi aliibili waalssakiynaau waalwaqaaru fiy aashaabi alshhaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shu'ba narrated the hadith as reported by Jarir with the same chain of narrators with this addition:Pride and conceitedness is among the owners of the camels and tranquillity and sobriety is found amongst the owners of sheep
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ غِلَظُ الْقُلُوبِ وَالْجَفَاءُ فِي الْمَشْرِقِ وَالإِيمَانُ فِي أَهْلِ الْحِجَازِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu alhaarithi almakhzuwmiyyu, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ghilazu alquluwbi waaljafaa'u fiy almashriqi waaliiymaanu fiy aahli alhijaazi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and, blessings be upon him) observed:The callousness of heart and sternness is in the East and faith is among the people of the Hijaz
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا ‏.‏ أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى شَىْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُمْ أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, wawakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tadkhuluwna aljannaaa hattaa tuuminuwa walaa tuuminuwa hattaa tahaabbuwa ‏.‏ aawalaa aadullukum 'alaa shaa'in iidhaa fa'altumuwhu tahaababtum aafshuwa alssalaama baynakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessing be upon him) observed: You shall not enter Paradise so long as you do not affirm belief (in all those things which are the articles of faith) and you will not believe as long as you do not love one another. Should I not direct you to a thing which, if you do, will foster love amongst you: (i. e.) give currency to (the practice of paying salutation to one another by saying) as-salamu alaikum
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، أَنْبَأَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ تَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ وَوَكِيعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, aanbaaanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laa tadkhuluwna aljannaaa hattaa tuuminuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa wawakiy'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zuhair b. Harb said:Jarir reported on the authority of A'mash with this chain of transmitters that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: By him in Whose hand is my life, you shall not enter Paradise unless you believe. The rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Abd Mu'awiya and Waki
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِسُهَيْلٍ إِنَّ عَمْرًا حَدَّثَنَا عَنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِيكَ، قَالَ وَرَجَوْتُ أَنْ يُسْقِطَ، عَنِّي رَجُلاً قَالَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنَ الَّذِي سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ أَبِي كَانَ صَدِيقًا لَهُ بِالشَّامِ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ ‏"‏ قُلْنَا لِمَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin almakkiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala qultu lisuhaylin iinna 'amrana haddathanaa 'ani alqa'qaa'i, 'an aabiyka, qaala warajawtu aan yusqita, 'anniy rajulaan qaala faqaala sami'tuhu mina alladhiy sami'ahu minhu aabiy kaana sadiyqana lahu bialshhaami thumma haddathanaa sufyaanu 'an suhaylin 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda 'an tamiymin alddaariyyi aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ alddiynu alnnasiyhaau ‏"‏ qulnaa liman qaala ‏"‏ lillahi walikitaabihi walirasuwlihi walaaiimmaai almuslimiyna wa'aammatihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Tamim ad-Dari that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:"The Religion is sincerity." We said, "To whom?" He said "To Allah, to His Book, To His Messenger, and to the leaders of the Muslims and their masses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi, 'an tamiymin alddaariyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Hatim and others narrate the same hadith of the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) on the authority of Tamim ad-Dari
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ - حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، سَمِعَهُ وَهُوَ، يُحَدِّثُ أَبَا صَالِحٍ عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaama, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa rawhun, - wahuwa abnu alqaasimi - haddathanaa suhaylun, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda, sami'ahu wahuwa, yuhaddithu aabaa saalihin 'an tamiymin alddaariyyi, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umayya b. Bistam narrates the same hadith of the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) on the authority of Tamim ad-Dari
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ بَايَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى إِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ وَالنُّصْحِ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an qaysin, 'an jariyrin, qaala baaya'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa iiqaami alssalaaai waiiytaa'i alzzakaaai waalnnushi likulli muslimin ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir that he observed I gave pledge of allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) on the observance of prayer, payment of Zakat, and sincerity and well-wishing for every Muslim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلاَقَةَ، سَمِعَ جَرِيرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ بَايَعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى النُّصْحِ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, numayrin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an ziyaadi bni 'ilaaqaaa, sami'a jariyra bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu baaya'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alnnushi likulli muslimin ‏.‏
verses.translation: (Sufyan narrated on the authority of Ziyad b. 'Ilaqa that he heard Jarir b. 'Abdullah saying:I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah may peace and blessings be upon him) on sincerity and well-wishing for every Muslim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَيَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ بَايَعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى السَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ فَلَقَّنَنِي ‏ "‏ فِيمَا اسْتَطَعْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَالنُّصْحِ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَعْقُوبُ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa surayju bnu yuwnusa, waya'quwbu alddawraqiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an sayyaarin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jariyrin, qaala baaya'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alssam'i waalttaa'aai falaqqananiy ‏ "‏ fiymaa astata'ta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waalnnushi likulli muslimin ‏.‏ qaala ya'quwbu fiy riwaayatihi qaala haddathanaa sayyaarun ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir that he observed:I owed allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) on hearing ( is commands) and obeying (them) and the Prophet) instructed me (to act) as lay in my power, and sincerity and goodwill for every Muslim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولاَنِ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَزْنِي الزَّانِي حِينَ يَزْنِي وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَلاَ يَسْرِقُ السَّارِقُ حِينَ يَسْرِقُ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَلاَ يَشْرَبُ الْخَمْرَ حِينَ يَشْرَبُهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ كَانَ يُحَدِّثُهُمْ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ وَكَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يُلْحِقُ مَعَهُنَّ ‏"‏ وَلاَ يَنْتَهِبُ نُهْبَةً ذَاتَ شَرَفٍ يَرْفَعُ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ فِيهَا أَبْصَارَهُمْ حِينَ يَنْتَهِبُهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'imraana alttujiybiyyu, aanbaaanaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala sami'tu aabaa salamaaa bna 'abdi alrrahmani, wasa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yaquwlaani qaala aabuw hurayraaa iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa yazniy alzzaaniy hiyna yazniy wahuwa muuminun walaa yasriqu alssaariqu hiyna yasriqu wahuwa muuminun walaa yashrabu alkhamra hiyna yashrabuhaa wahuwa muuminun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin faaakhbaraniy 'abdu almaliki bnu aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alrrahmani aanna aabaa bakrin kaana yuhaddithuhum hauulaa'i 'an aabiy hurayraaa thumma yaquwlu wakaana aabuw hurayraaa yulhiqu ma'ahunna ‏"‏ walaa yantahibu nuhbaaan dhaata sharafin yarfa'u alnnaasu iilayhi fiyhaa aabsaarahum hiyna yantahibuhaa wahuwa muuminun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah observed:The fornicator who fornicates is not a believer so long as he commits it and no thief who steals is a believer as long as he commits theft, and no drunkard who drinks wine is a believer as long as he drinks it. 'Abdul-Malik b. Abi Bakr' narrated this on the authority of Abu Bakr b. Abdur-Rahman b. Harith and then said: Abu Huraira made this addition: No plunderer who plunders a valuable thing that attracts the attention of people is a believer so long as he commits this act
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزْنِي الزَّانِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِهِ يَذْكُرُ مَعَ ذِكْرِ النُّهْبَةِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ذَاتَ شَرَفٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ هَذَا إِلاَّ النُّهْبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi bni sa'din, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, qaala qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy aabuw bakri bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhaarithi bni hishaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yazniy alzzaaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha bimithlihi yadhkuru ma'a dhikri alnnuhbaai walam yadhkur dhaata sharafin ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi aabiy bakrin hadhaa iilaaa alnnuhbaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdul-Malik b. Shu'aib narrated this hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira that he observed:The Messenger of Allah said that a fornicator does not fornicate, and then narrated the hadith like this, and he also made mention of plundering too, but did not mention of a thin having value. Ibn Shihab said: Sa'id b. al-Musayyib and Abu Salama narrated this hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira a hadith like that of Abu Bakr with the exception of (the mention) of plundering
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ وَأَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عُقَيْلٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَذَكَرَ النُّهْبَةَ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ذَاتَ شَرَفٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, qaala aakhbaraniy 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'ani abni almusayyabi, waaabiy, salamaaa waaabiy bakri bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhaarithi bni hishaamin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi 'uqaylin 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aabiy hurayraaa wadhakara alnnuhbaaa walam yaqul dhaata sharafin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Mihran narrates this hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira and made mention of plundering but did not talk of (a thing) having value
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُطَّلِبِ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، مَوْلَى مَيْمُونَةَ وَحُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu almuttalibi, 'an safwaana bni sulaymin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, mawlaa maymuwnaaa wahumaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imam Muslim has reported this hadith by Hasan b. 'Ali al-Halwani and other traditions
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ غَيْرَ أَنَّ الْعَلاَءَ وَصَفْوَانَ بْنَ سُلَيْمٍ لَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏"‏ يَرْفَعُ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ فِيهَا أَبْصَارَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ هَمَّامٍ ‏"‏ يَرْفَعُ إِلَيْهِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُوَ حِينَ يَنْتَهِبُهَا مُؤْمِنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ يَغُلُّ أَحَدُكُمْ حِينَ يَغُلُّ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَإِيَّاكُمْ إِيَّاكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'ani al'alaa'i bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kullu hauulaa'i bimithli hadiythi alzzuhriyyi ghayra aanna al'alaa'a wasafwaana bna sulaymin laysa fiy hadiythihimaa ‏"‏ yarfa'u alnnaasu iilayhi fiyhaa aabsaarahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi hammaamin ‏"‏ yarfa'u iilayhi almuuminuwna aa'yunahum fiyhaa wahuwa hiyna yantahibuhaa muuminun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wazaada ‏"‏ walaa yaghullu aahadukum hiyna yaghullu wahuwa muuminun faiiyyaakum iiyyaakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Qutaiba b. Sa'id who reported on the authority of Abu Huraira the hadith like that narrated from Zuhri with this exception that in the hadith narrated by 'Ala ' and Safwan b. Sulaim there is no mention of:People raise there eyes towards him, and in the hadith narrated by Hammam: The believers raise their eyes towards him, and such like words, so long as he plunders (is not) a believer, and these words were added: And no exploiter who makes an exploitation is a believer as long as he exploits It; therefore avoid and shun (these evils)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزْنِي الزَّانِي حِينَ يَزْنِي وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَلاَ يَسْرِقُ حِينَ يَسْرِقُ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَلاَ يَشْرَبُ الْخَمْرَ حِينَ يَشْرَبُهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَالتَّوْبَةُ مَعْرُوضَةٌ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, 'an dhakwaana, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yazniy alzzaaniy hiyna yazniy wahuwa muuminun walaa yasriqu hiyna yasriqu wahuwa muuminun walaa yashrabu alkhamra hiyna yashrabuhaa wahuwa muuminun waalttawbaau ma'ruwdaaun ba'du ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira:A fornicator who fornicates is not a believer as long as he commits fornication, and no one who steals is a believer as long as he commits theft, and no one who drinks wine is a believer as long as he drinks it, and repentance may be accepted after that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رَفَعَهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزْنِي الزَّانِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an dhakwaana, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, rafa'ahu qaala ‏ "‏ laa yazniy alzzaaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi shu'baaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Rafi', Abdur-Razzaq, Sufyan, A'mash narrated this hadith like one narrated by Shu'ba, on the authority of Abu Huraira tracing, it (right to the Holy Prophet)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرْبَعٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ كَانَ مُنَافِقًا خَالِصًا وَمَنْ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَلَّةٌ مِنْهُنَّ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَلَّةٌ مِنْ نِفَاقٍ حَتَّى يَدَعَهَا إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ وَإِذَا عَاهَدَ غَدَرَ وَإِذَا وَعَدَ أَخْلَفَ وَإِذَا خَاصَمَ فَجَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَةٌ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aarba'un man kunna fiyhi kaana munaafiqana khaalisana waman kaanat fiyhi khallaaun minhunna kaanat fiyhi khallaaun min nifaaqin hattaa yada'ahaa iidhaa haddatha kadhaba waiidhaa 'aahada ghadara waiidhaa wa'ada aakhlafa waiidhaa khaasama fajara ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi sufyaana ‏"‏ waiin kaanat fiyhi khaslaaun minhunna kaanat fiyhi khaslaaun mina alnnifaaqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. 'Amr that the Prophet observed:"There are four characteristics, whoever has them all is a pure hypocrite, and whoever has one of its characteristics, he has one of the characteristics of hypocrisy, until he gives it up: When he speaks he lies, when he makes a covenant he betrays it, when he makes a promise he breaks it, and when he disputes he resorts to obscene speech." In the narration of Sufyan (one of the narrators) it is: "And if he has one of them, he has one of the characteristics of hypocrisy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سُهَيْلٍ، نَافِعُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَبِي عَامِرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ آيَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ ثَلاَثٌ إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ وَإِذَا وَعَدَ أَخْلَفَ وَإِذَا ائْتُمِنَ خَانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw suhaylin, naafi'u bnu maaliki bni aabiy 'aamirin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ayaau almunaafiqi thalaathun iidhaa haddatha kadhaba waiidhaa wa'ada aakhlafa waiidhaa aitumina khaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said:Three are the signs of a hypocrite: when he spoke he told a lie, when he made a promise he acted treacherously against it, when he was trusted he betrayed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ، مَوْلَى الْحُرَقَةِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مِنْ عَلاَمَاتِ الْمُنَافِقِ ثَلاَثَةٌ إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ وَإِذَا وَعَدَ أَخْلَفَ وَإِذَا ائْتُمِنَ خَانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy al'alaa'u bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni ya'quwba, mawlaa alhuraqaai 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ min 'alaamaati almunaafiqi thalaathaaun iidhaa haddatha kadhaba waiidhaa wa'ada aakhlafa waiidhaa aitumina khaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:There are three characteristics of a hypocrite: when he spoke he told a lie, when he made promise he acted treacherously, and when he was trusted he betrayed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ أَبُو زُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، يُحَدِّثُ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ آيَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ ثَلاَثٌ وَإِنْ صَامَ وَصَلَّى وَزَعَمَ أَنَّهُ مُسْلِمٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu muhammadi bni qaysin aabuw zukayrin, qaala sami'tu al'alaa'a bna 'abdi alrrahmani, yuhaddithu bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ ayaau almunaafiqi thalaathun waiin saama wasallaa waza'ama aannahu muslimun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. Mukarram al-'Ami reported that he heard 'Ala' b. 'Abdur-Rahman narrating this hadith with this chain of transmitters and he said:Three are the signs of a hypocrite, even if he observed fast and prayed and asserted that he was a Muslim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو نَصْرٍ التَّمَّارُ، وَعَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ ذَكَرَ فِيهِ ‏ "‏ وَإِنْ صَامَ وَصَلَّى وَزَعَمَ أَنَّهُ مُسْلِمٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw nasrin alttammaaru, wa'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an daawuda bni aabiy hindin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi yahyaa bni muhammadin 'ani al'alaa'i dhakara fiyhi ‏ "‏ waiin saama wasallaa waza'ama aannahu muslimun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) made observations like them embodied in the hadith narrated by Yahya b. Muhammad on the authority of 'Ala', and added to it:even if he observed fast and prayed and asserted that he was a Muslim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَفَّرَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِهَا أَحَدُهُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, wa'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa kaffara alrrajulu aakhaahu faqad baa'a bihaa aahaduhumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:When a man calls his brother an unbeliever, it returns (at least) to one of them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا امْرِئٍ قَالَ لأَخِيهِ يَا كَافِرُ ‏.‏ فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِهَا أَحَدُهُمَا إِنْ كَانَ كَمَا قَالَ وَإِلاَّ رَجَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, jamiy'ana 'an iismaa'iyla bni ja'farin, qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, aannahu sami'a abna 'umara, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aayyumaa amriiin qaala laakhiyhi yaa kaafiru ‏.‏ faqad baa'a bihaa aahaduhumaa iin kaana kamaa qaala waiilaaa raja'at 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said:Any person who called his brother: "O unbeliever" (has in fact done an act by which this unbelief) would return to one of them. If it were so, as he asserted (then the unbelief of man was confirmed but if it was not true), then it returned to him (to the man who labeled it on his brother Muslim)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَعْمَرَ، أَنَّ أَبَا الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ مِنْ رَجُلٍ ادَّعَى لِغَيْرِ أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ كَفَرَ وَمَنِ ادَّعَى مَا لَيْسَ لَهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا وَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَنْ دَعَا رَجُلاً بِالْكُفْرِ أَوْ قَالَ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ كَذَلِكَ إِلاَّ حَارَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa husaynun almu'allimu, 'ani abni buraydaaa, 'an yahyaa bni ya'mara, aanna aabaa alaaswadi, haddathahu 'an aabiy dharrin, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laysa min rajulin adda'aa lighayri aabiyhi wahuwa ya'lamuhu iilaaa kafara wamani adda'aa maa laysa lahu falaysa minnaa walyatabawwaa maq'adahu mina alnnaari waman da'aa rajulaan bialkufri aaw qaala 'aduwwa alllahi ‏.‏ walaysa kadhalika iilaaa haara 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Dharr that he heard the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) saying:No person who claimed knowingly anyone else as his father besides (his own) committed nothing but infidelity, and he who made a claim of anything, which (in fact) did not belong to him, is not amongst us; he should make his abode in Fire, and he who labeled anyone with unbelief or called him the enemy of Allah, and he was in fact not so, it rebounded on him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَرْغَبُوا عَنْ آبَائِكُمْ فَمَنْ رَغِبَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ فَهُوَ كُفْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'an 'iraaki bni maalikin, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa targhabuwa 'an abaaiikum faman raghiba 'an aabiyhi fahuwa kufrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:Do not detest your fathers; he who detested his father committed infidelity
