verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ لَمَّا ادُّعِيَ زِيَادٌ لَقِيتُ أَبَا بَكْرَةَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ مَا هَذَا الَّذِي صَنَعْتُمْ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعَ أُذُنَاىَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنِ ادَّعَى أَبًا فِي الإِسْلاَمِ غَيْرَ أَبِيهِ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ غَيْرُ أَبِيهِ فَالْجَنَّةُ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرَةَ وَأَنَا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa hushaymu bnu bashiyrin, aakhbaranaa khaalidun, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, qaala lammaa addu'iya ziyaadun laqiytu aabaa bakraaa faqultu lahu maa hadhaa alladhiy sana'tum iinniy sami'tu sa'da bna aabiy waqqaasin yaquwlu sami'a audhunaaaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yaquwlu ‏ "‏ mani adda'aa aabana fiy aliislaami ghayra aabiyhi ya'lamu aannahu ghayru aabiyhi faaljannaau 'alayhi haraamun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakraaa waaanaa sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas:Both of my ears heard the Messenger of Allah saying this: He who claimed the fatherhood of anyone else besides his real father knowingly (committed a great sin) ;Paradise is forbidden to him. Abu Bakra asserted that he too heard it from the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، وَأَبِي، بَكْرَةَ كِلاَهُمَا يَقُولُ سَمِعَتْهُ أُذُنَاىَ، وَوَعَاهُ، قَلْبِي مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ غَيْرُ أَبِيهِ فَالْجَنَّةُ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu zakariyyaa'a bni aabiy zaaiidaaa, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'an 'aasimin, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an sa'din, waaabiy, bakraaa kilaahumaa yaquwlu sami'athu audhunaaaa, wawa'aahu, qalbiy muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ mani adda'aa iilaa ghayri aabiyhi wahuwa ya'lamu aannahu ghayru aabiyhi faaljannaau 'alayhi haraamun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd and Abu Bakra each one of them said:My ears heard and my hearing preserved it that Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) observed: He who claimed for another one his fatherhood besides his own father knowingly that he was not his father-to him Paradise is forbidden
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، وَعَوْنُ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ سِبَابُ الْمُسْلِمِ فُسُوقٌ وَقِتَالُهُ كُفْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ زُبَيْدٌ فَقُلْتُ لأَبِي وَائِلٍ أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ قَوْلُ زُبَيْدٍ لأَبِي وَائِلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakkaari bni alrrayyaani, wa'awnu bnu salaaamin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu talhaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, kulluhum 'an zubaydin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ sibaabu almuslimi fusuwqun waqitaaluhu kufrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala zubaydun faqultu laabiy waaiilin aanta sami'tahu min 'abdi alllahi yarwiyhi 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi shu'baaa qawlu zubaydin laabiy waaiilin ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:Abusing a Muslim is an outrage and fighting against him is unbelief. Zubaid said: I asked Abu Wa'il: Did you hear it from Abdullah narrating if from the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him)? He replied: Yes. But there is mention of the talk between Zubaid and Abu Wa'il in the hadith narrated by Shu'ba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu almuthannaa, 'an muhammadi bni ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an mansuwrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakr b. Abu Shaiba narrated a hadith like this from the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) on the authority of Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُدْرِكٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ جَدِّهِ، جَرِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏"‏ اسْتَنْصِتِ النَّاسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin jamiy'ana 'an muhammadi bni ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'aliyyi bni mudrikin, sami'a aabaa zur'aaa, yuhaddithu 'an jaddihi, jariyrin qaala qaala liya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏"‏ astansiti alnnaasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ laa tarji'uwa ba'diy kuffaarana yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir b. 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) asked him on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage to make the people silent and then said:Do not return to unbelief after me by striking the necks of one another
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an waaqidi bni muhammadin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mu'adh narrated from the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) a hadith like this on the authority on Ibn Umar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏ "‏ وَيْحَكُمْ - أَوْ قَالَ وَيْلَكُمْ - لاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw bakri bnu khalaaadin albaahiliyyu qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an waaqidi bni muhammadi bni zaydin, aannahu sami'a aabaahu, yuhaddithu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏ "‏ wayhakum - aaw qaala waylakum - laa tarji'uwa ba'diy kuffaarana yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Umar that the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage Woe unto you distress unto you! Don't turn back as unbelievers after me by striking the necks of one another
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ وَاقِدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, qaala haddathaniy 'umaru bnu muhammadin, aanna aabaahu, haddathahu 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi shu'baaa 'an waaqidin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Harmala b. Yahya, Abdullah b. Wahb, Umar b. Muhammad, Ibn Umar narrated like the hadith reported by Shu'ba on the authority of Waqid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اثْنَتَانِ فِي النَّاسِ هُمَا بِهِمْ كُفْرٌ الطَّعْنُ فِي النَّسَبِ وَالنِّيَاحَةُ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy wamuhammadu bnu 'ubaydin, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ athnataani fiy alnnaasi humaa bihim kufrun altta'nu fiy alnnasabi waalnniyaahaau 'alaa almayyiti ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:Two (things) are found among men which are tantamount to unbelief: slandering one's lineage and lamentation on the dead
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ أَبَقَ مِنْ مَوَالِيهِ فَقَدْ كَفَرَ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَنْصُورٌ قَدْ وَاللَّهِ رُوِيَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَكِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُرْوَى عَنِّي هَا هُنَا بِالْبَصْرَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - 'an mansuwri bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jariyrin, aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aayyumaa 'abdin aabaqa min mawaaliyhi faqad kafara hattaa yarji'a iilayhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala mansuwrun qad waalllahi ruwiya 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm walakinniy aakrahu aan yurwaa 'anniy haa hunaa bialbasraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir that he heard (the Holy Prophet) saying, The slave who fled from his master committed an act of infidelity as long as he would not return to him. Mansur observed:By God, this hadith was narrated from the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him), but I do not like that this should be narrated on my authority here in Basra
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ أَبَقَ فَقَدْ بَرِئَتْ مِنْهُ الذِّمَّةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, 'an daawuda, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jariyrin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aayyumaa 'abdin aabaqa faqad bariiat minhu aldhhimmaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jarir that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:The slave who fled from his master, responsibility with regard to him was absolved
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَبَقَ الْعَبْدُ لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلاَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mughiyraaa, 'ani alshha'biyyi, qaala kaana jariyru bnu 'abdi alllahi yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aabaqa al'abdu lam tuqbal lahu salaaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jarir b. Abdullah reported it from the Holy Prophet:When the slave runs away from his master, his prayer is not accepted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي إِثْرِ السَّمَاءِ كَانَتْ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرُونَ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ أَصْبَحَ مِنْ عِبَادِي مُؤْمِنٌ بِي وَكَافِرٌ فَأَمَّا مَنْ قَالَ مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ ‏.‏ فَذَلِكَ مُؤْمِنٌ بِي وَكَافِرٌ بِالْكَوْكَبِ وَأَمَّا مَنْ قَالَ مُطِرْنَا بِنَوْءِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ فَذَلِكَ كَافِرٌ بِي مُؤْمِنٌ بِالْكَوْكَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an zaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alssubhi bialhudaybiyaai fiy iithri alssamaa'i kaanat mina alllayli falammaa ansarafa aaqbala 'alaa alnnaasi faqaala ‏"‏ hal tadruwna maadhaa qaala rabbukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qaala aasbaha min 'ibaadiy muuminun biy wakaafirun faaammaa man qaala mutirnaa bifadli alllahi warahmatihi ‏.‏ fadhalika muuminun biy wakaafirun bialkawkabi waaammaa man qaala mutirnaa binaw'i kadhaa wakadhaa ‏.‏ fadhalika kaafirun biy muuminun bialkawkabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani:The Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) led the morning prayer at Hudaybiya. There were some marks of the rainfall during the night. At the conclusion of prayer he turned towards people and observed: Do you know what your Lord has said? They replied: Allah and His Messenger know best. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: He (Allah) said: Some of My bondsmen entered the morning as My believers and some as unbelievers. He who said: We have had a rainfall due to the Blessing and Mercy of Allah, he is My believer and a disbeliever of stars, and who said: We have had a rainfall due to the rising of such and such (star) disbelieved Me and affirmed his faith in the stars
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، قَالَ الْمُرَادِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلَمْ تَرَوْا إِلَى مَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالَ مَا أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَى عِبَادِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ إِلاَّ أَصْبَحَ فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ بِهَا كَافِرِينَ ‏.‏ يَقُولُونَ الْكَوَاكِبُ وَبِالْكَوَاكِبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, wa'amruw bnu sawwaadin al'aamiriyyu, wamuhammadu bnu salamaaa almuraadiyyu, qaala almuraadiyyu haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalam tarawa iilaa maa qaala rabbukum qaala maa aan'amtu 'alaa 'ibaadiy min ni'maain iilaaa aasbaha fariyqun minhum bihaa kaafiriyna ‏.‏ yaquwluwna alkawaakibu wabialkawaakibi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said:Don't you know what your Lord said? He observed: I have never endowed My bondsmen with a favor, but a section amongst them disbelieved it and said: Stars, it was due to the stars
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ أَبَا يُونُسَ، مَوْلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِنْ بَرَكَةٍ إِلاَّ أَصْبَحَ فَرِيقٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ بِهَا كَافِرِينَ يُنْزِلُ اللَّهُ الْغَيْثَ فَيَقُولُونَ الْكَوْكَبُ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ الْمُرَادِيِّ ‏"‏ بِكَوْكَبِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu salamaaa almuraadiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an 'amriw bni alhaarithi, h wahaddathaniy 'amruw bnu sawwaadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, aanna aabaa yuwnusa, mawlaa aabiy hurayraaa haddathahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ maa aanzala alllahu mina alssamaa'i min barakaain iilaaa aasbaha fariyqun mina alnnaasi bihaa kaafiriyna yunzilu alllahu alghaytha fayaquwluwna alkawkabu kadhaa wakadhaa ‏"‏ wafiy hadiythi almuraadiyyi ‏"‏ bikawkabi kadhaa wakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessing be upon him) observed:Allah does not shower His blessings from the heaven that in the morning a group of men disbelieve it (to be a blessing from Allah). Allah sends down rain, but they (the disbelievers) say: Such and such star (is responsible for that)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُمَيْلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مُطِرَ النَّاسُ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَصْبَحَ مِنَ النَّاسِ شَاكِرٌ وَمِنْهُمْ كَافِرٌ قَالُوا هَذِهِ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لَقَدْ صَدَقَ نَوْءُ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَاقِعِ النُّجُومِ‏}‏ حَتَّى بَلَغَ ‏{‏ وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ‏{‏}
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abbaasu bnu 'abdi al'aziymi al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa alnnadru bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau, - wahuwa abnu 'ammaarin - haddathanaa aabuw zumaylin, qaala haddathaniy abnu 'abbaasin, qaala mutira alnnaasu 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aasbaha mina alnnaasi shaakirun waminhum kaafirun qaaluwa hadhihi rahmaau alllahi ‏.‏ waqaala ba'duhum laqad sadaqa naw'u kadhaa wakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fanazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ falaa auqsimu bimawaaqi'i alnnujuwmi‏}‏ hattaa balagha ‏{‏ wataj'aluwna rizqakum aannakum tukadhhibuwna‏{‏}
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that there was (once) a downpour during the life of the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him Upon this the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed:Some people entered the morning with gratitude and some with ingratitude (to Allah). Those who entered with gratitude said: This is the blessing of Allah, and those who entered with ingratitude said: Such and such asterism was right. It was upon this that the verse was revealed: I swear by the setting of the stars to the end and make your provision that you should disbelieve it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ آيَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ بُغْضُ الأَنْصَارِ وَآيَةُ الْمُؤْمِنِ حُبُّ الأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni jabrin, qaala sami'tu aanasana, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ayaau almunaafiqi bughdu alaansaari waayaau almuumini hubbu alaansaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings Be upon him) observed:The sign of a hypocrite is the hatred against the Ansar and the sign of a believer is the love for the Ansar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ حُبُّ الأَنْصَارِ آيَةُ الإِيمَانِ وَبُغْضُهُمْ آيَةُ النِّفَاقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ hubbu alaansaari ayaau aliiymaani wabughduhum ayaau alnnifaaqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) said:The love of the Ansar is the sign of faith and hatred against them is the sign of dissemblance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الأَنْصَارِ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُحِبُّهُمْ إِلاَّ مُؤْمِنٌ وَلاَ يُبْغِضُهُمْ إِلاَّ مُنَافِقٌ مَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ أَحَبَّهُ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ أَبْغَضَهُمْ أَبْغَضَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ قُلْتُ لِعَدِيٍّ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنَ الْبَرَاءِ قَالَ إِيَّاىَ حَدَّثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, qaala haddathaniy mu'aadhu bnu mu'aadhin, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala fiy alaansaari ‏ "‏ laa yuhibbuhum iilaaa muuminun walaa yubghiduhum iilaaa munaafiqun man aahabbahum aahabbahu alllahu waman aabghadahum aabghadahu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau qultu li'adiyyin sami'tahu mina albaraa'i qaala iiyyaaaa haddatha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara reported from the Messenger (may peace and blessing be upon him) that he remarked with regard to the Ansar:"None but the believer loves them, none but the hypocrite hates them. He who loves them loves Allah and he who hates them hates Allah." I (the narrator) said: Did you hear this hadith from al-Bara'? He said: He narrated it to me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُبْغِضُ الأَنْصَارَ رَجُلٌ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yubghidu alaansaara rajulun yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) said:A person who believes in Allah and the Last Day never nurses a grudge against the Ansar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يُبْغِضُ الأَنْصَارَ رَجُلٌ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu muhammadi bni aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yubghidu alaansaara rajulun yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri that the Messenger of Allah observed:The person who believes in Allah and the Last Day never nurses a grudge against the Ansar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ وَالَّذِي فَلَقَ الْحَبَّةَ وَبَرَأَ النَّسَمَةَ إِنَّهُ لَعَهْدُ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَىَّ أَنْ لاَ يُحِبَّنِي إِلاَّ مُؤْمِنٌ وَلاَ يُبْغِضَنِي إِلاَّ مُنَافِقٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, 'an zirrin, qaala qaala 'aliyyun waalladhiy falaqa alhabbaaa wabaraaa alnnasamaaa iinnahu la'ahdu alnnabiyyi alaummiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaaa aan laa yuhibbaniy iilaaa muuminun walaa yubghidaniy iilaaa munaafiqun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zirr reported:'Ali observed: By Him Who split up the seed and created something living, the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) gave me a promise that no one but a believer would love me, and none but a hypocrite would nurse grudge against me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ النِّسَاءِ تَصَدَّقْنَ وَأَكْثِرْنَ الاِسْتِغْفَارَ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُكُنَّ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ جَزْلَةٌ وَمَا لَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تُكْثِرْنَ اللَّعْنَ وَتَكْفُرْنَ الْعَشِيرَ وَمَا رَأَيْتُ مِنْ نَاقِصَاتِ عَقْلٍ وَدِينٍ أَغْلَبَ لِذِي لُبٍّ مِنْكُنَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا نُقْصَانُ الْعَقْلِ وَالدِّينِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا نُقْصَانُ الْعَقْلِ فَشَهَادَةُ امْرَأَتَيْنِ تَعْدِلُ شَهَادَةَ رَجُلٍ فَهَذَا نُقْصَانُ الْعَقْلِ وَتَمْكُثُ اللَّيَالِيَ مَا تُصَلِّي وَتُفْطِرُ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَهَذَا نُقْصَانُ الدِّينِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri almisriyyu, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni alhaadi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ yaa ma'shara alnnisaa'i tasaddaqna waaakthirna alaistighfaara faiinniy raaaytukunna aakthara aahli alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalati amraaaaun minhunna jazlaaun wamaa lanaa yaa rasuwla alllahi aakthara aahli alnnaari ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ tukthirna allla'na watakfurna al'ashiyra wamaa raaaytu min naaqisaati 'aqlin wadiynin aaghlaba lidhiy lubbin minkunna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi wamaa nuqsaanu al'aqli waalddiyni qaala ‏"‏ aammaa nuqsaanu al'aqli fashahaadaau amraaatayni ta'dilu shahaadaaa rajulin fahadhaa nuqsaanu al'aqli watamkuthu alllayaaliya maa tusalliy watuftiru fiy ramadaana fahadhaa nuqsaanu alddiyni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Umar that the Messenger of Allah observed:O womenfolk, you should give charity and ask much forgiveness for I saw you in bulk amongst the dwellers of Hell. A wise lady among them said: Why is it, Messenger of Allah, that our folk is in bulk in Hell? Upon this the Prophet observed: You curse too much and are ungrateful to your spouses. I have seen none lacking in common sense and failing in religion but (at the same time) robbing the wisdom of the wise, besides you. Upon this the woman remarked: What is wrong with our common sense and with religion? He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Your lack of common sense (can be well judged from the fact) that the evidence of two women is equal to one man, that is a proof of the lack of common sense, and you spend some nights (and days) in which you do not offer prayer and in the month of Ramadan (during the days) you do not observe fast, that is a failing in religion
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ مُضَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an bakri bni mudara, 'ani abni alhaadi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Tahir with this chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy zaydu bnu aaslama, 'an 'iyaadi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h
verses.translation: A hadith like this as narrated by Ibn 'Umar has also been transmitted by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَرَأَ ابْنُ آدَمَ السَّجْدَةَ فَسَجَدَ اعْتَزَلَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَبْكِي يَقُولُ يَا وَيْلَهُ - وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ يَا وَيْلِي - أُمِرَ ابْنُ آدَمَ بِالسُّجُودِ فَسَجَدَ فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ وَأُمِرْتُ بِالسُّجُودِ فَأَبَيْتُ فَلِيَ النَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa qaraaa abnu adama alssajdaaa fasajada a'tazala alshhaytaanu yabkiy yaquwlu yaa waylahu - wafiy riwaayaai aabiy kuraybin yaa wayliy - aumira abnu adama bialssujuwdi fasajada falahu aljannaau waaumirtu bialssujuwdi faaabaytu faliya alnnaaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that when, the son of Adam recites the Ayat of Sajdah (prostration) and then falls down in prostration, the Satan goes into seclusion and weeps and says:Alas, and in the narration of Abu Kuraib the words are: Woe unto me, the son of Adam was commanded to prostrate, and he prostrated and Paradise was entitled to him and I was commanded to prostrate, but I refused and am doomed to Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَعَصَيْتُ فَلِيَ النَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ fa'asaytu faliya alnnaaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'mash narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters, with this change of words that he (the Satan) said:I disobeyed and I am doomed to Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلِ وَبَيْنَ الشِّرْكِ وَالْكُفْرِ تَرْكَ الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, kilaahumaa 'an jariyrin, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, qaala sami'tu jaabirana, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna bayna alrrajuli wabayna alshhirki waalkufri tarka alssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that he heard the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) saying. Verily between man and between polytheism and unbelief is the negligence of prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلِ وَبَيْنَ الشِّرْكِ وَالْكُفْرِ تَرْكُ الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa alddahhaaku bnu makhladin, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ bayna alrrajuli wabayna alshhirki waalkufri tarku alssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Zubair that he heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying. I heard the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings be upon him) observing this:Between man and polytheism and unbelief is the abandonment of salat
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِيمَانٌ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَاذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَاذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ حَجٌّ مَبْرُورٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِيمَانٌ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa mansuwru bnu aabiy muzaahimin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu ja'fari bni ziyaadin, aakhbaranaa iibraahiymu, - ya'niy abna sa'din - 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau alaa'maali aafdalu qaala ‏"‏ iiymaanun bialllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma maadhaa qaala ‏"‏ aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma maadhaa qaala ‏"‏ hajjun mabruwrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai muhammadi bni ja'farin qaala ‏"‏ iiymaanun bialllahi warasuwlihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah was asked about the best of deeds. He observed: Belief in Allah. He (the inquirer) said: What next? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Jihad (struggle to the utmost) in the cause of Allah. He (the inquirer) again said: What next? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Pilgrimage accepted into the grace of the Lord. In the. tradition narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. Ja'far (the words are) that he (the Holy Prophet) said: Belief in Allah and His Messenger. Muhammad b. Rafi and 'Abd b. Humaid, 'Abdur-Razzaq and Ma'mar and Zuhri have narrated a hadith like this on the authority of the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُرَاوِحٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الإِيمَانُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَىُّ الرِّقَابِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْفَسُهَا عِنْدَ أَهْلِهَا وَأَكْثَرُهَا ثَمَنًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ أَفْعَلْ قَالَ ‏"‏ تُعِينُ صَانِعًا أَوْ تَصْنَعُ لأَخْرَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ ضَعُفْتُ عَنْ بَعْضِ الْعَمَلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَكُفُّ شَرَّكَ عَنِ النَّاسِ فَإِنَّهَا صَدَقَةٌ مِنْكَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, h wahaddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy muraawihin alllaythiyyi, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaaau alaa'maali aafdalu qaala ‏"‏ aliiymaanu bialllahi waaljihaadu fiy sabiylihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu aaaau alrriqaabi aafdalu qaala ‏"‏ aanfasuhaa 'inda aahlihaa waaaktharuhaa thamanana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu faiin lam aaf'al qaala ‏"‏ tu'iynu saani'ana aaw tasna'u laakhraqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta iin da'uftu 'an ba'di al'amali qaala ‏"‏ takuffu sharraka 'ani alnnaasi faiinnahaa sadaqaaun minka 'alaa nafsika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported:I said: Messenger of Allah, which of the deeds is the best? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Belief in Allah and Jihad in His cause. I again asked: Who is the slave whose emancipation is the best? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: One who is valuable for his master and whose price is high. I said: If I can't afford to do it? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Help an artisan or make anything for the unskilled (labourer). I (Abu Dharr) said: Messenger of Allah, you see that I am helpless in doing some of these deeds. He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Desist from doing mischief to the people. That is the charity of your person on your behalf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، مَوْلَى عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُرَاوِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَتُعِينُ الصَّانِعَ أَوْ تَصْنَعُ لأَخْرَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an habiybin, mawlaa 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an aabiy muraawihin, 'an aabiy dharrin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ fatu'iynu alssaani'a aaw tasna'u laakhraqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Abu Rafi' narrated the hadith on the authority of Abu Dharr with a slight difference
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ الْعَيْزَارِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الْعَمَلِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الصَّلاَةُ لِوَقْتِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَمَا تَرَكْتُ أَسْتَزِيدُهُ إِلاَّ إِرْعَاءً عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'ani alwaliydi bni al'ayzaari, 'an sa'di bni iiyaasin aabiy 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau al'amali aafdalu qaala ‏"‏ alssalaaau liwaqtihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ birru alwaalidayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ famaa taraktu aastaziyduhu iilaaa iir'aa'an 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that he observed. I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) which deed was the best. He (the Holy Prophet) replied:Prayer at its appointed hour. I (again) said: Then what? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Kindness to the parents. I (again) said: Then what? He replied: Earnest endeavour (Jihad) in the cause of Allah. And I would have not ceased asking more questions but out of regard (for his feelings)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ الْفَزَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يَعْفُورٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ الْعَيْزَارِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَى مَوَاقِيتِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَاذَا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَاذَا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'umara almakkiyyu, haddathanaa marwaanu alfazaariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw ya'fuwrin, 'ani alwaliydi bni al'ayzaari, 'an aabiy 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, qaala qultu yaa nabiyya alllahi aaaau alaa'maali aaqrabu iilaa aljannaai qaala ‏"‏ alssalaaau 'alaa mawaaqiytihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu wamaadhaa yaa nabiyya alllahi qaala ‏"‏ birru alwaalidayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu wamaadhaa yaa nabiyya alllahi qaala ‏"‏ aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported:I said: Messenger of Allah, which of the deeds (takes one) nearer to Paradise? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Prayer at its proper time, I said: What next, Messenger of Allah? He replied: Kindness to the parents. I said: What next? He replied: Jihad in the cause of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ الْعَيْزَارِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيَّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي صَاحِبُ، هَذِهِ الدَّارِ - وَأَشَارَ إِلَى دَارِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ - قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَى وَقْتِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ بِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بِهِنَّ وَلَوِ اسْتَزَدْتُهُ لَزَادَنِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alwaliydi bni al'ayzaari, aannahu sami'a aabaa 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyya, qaala haddathaniy saahibu, hadhihi alddaari - waaashaara iilaa daari 'abdi alllahi - qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau alaa'maali aahabbu iilaa alllahi qaala ‏"‏ alssalaaau 'alaa waqtihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ thumma birru alwaalidayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ thumma aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ qaala haddathaniy bihinna walawi astazadtuhu lazaadaniy ‏.‏
verses.translation: It was heard from Abu 'Amr Shaibani that, pointing towards the house of Abdullah, he said:The owner of this house told me that he asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Which of the deeds are liked by Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Prayer at its proper time. I (again) said: What next? He replied: Then goodness to the parents. I (again) said: What then? He replied: Then Jihad in the cause of Allah. He ('Abdullah) said: This is what I was told (by the Holy Prophet). Had I questioned further, he would have made additions for me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ وَأَشَارَ إِلَى دَارِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَمَا سَمَّاهُ لَنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏ wazaada waaashaara iilaa daari 'abdi alllahi wamaa sammaahu lanaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Muhammad b. Bashshar, Muhammad b. Ja'far Shu'ba with this chain of narrators, with the addition that he pointed towards the house of 'Abdullah, but he did not mention his name for us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَفْضَلُ الأَعْمَالِ - أَوِ الْعَمَلِ - الصَّلاَةُ لِوَقْتِهَا وَبِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alhasani bni 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an aabiy 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aafdalu alaa'maali - aawi al'amali - alssalaaau liwaqtihaa wabirru alwaalidayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah observed:The best of' the deeds or deed is the (observance of) prayer at its proper time and kindness to the parents
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الذَّنْبِ أَعْظَمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِلَّهِ نِدًّا وَهُوَ خَلَقَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَعَظِيمٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَلَدَكَ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يَطْعَمَ مَعَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَنْ تُزَانِيَ حَلِيلَةَ جَارِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa jariyrun, waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'amriw bni shurahbiyla, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau aldhhanbi aa'zamu 'inda alllahi qaala ‏"‏ aan taj'ala lillahi niddana wahuwa khalaqaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu lahu iinna dhalika la'aziymun ‏.‏ qaala qultu thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ thumma aan taqtula waladaka makhaafaaa aan yat'ama ma'aka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ thumma aan tuzaaniya haliylaaa jaarika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported:I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Which sin is the gravest in the eye of Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you associate a partner with Allah (despite the fact) that He has created you. He (the reporter) said: I told him (the, Holy Prophet): Verily it is indeed grave. He (the reporter) said: I asked him what the next (gravest sin) was. He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you kill your child out of fear that he shall join you in food. He (the reporter) said: I asked (him) what the next (gravest sin) was. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Then (the next gravest sin) is that you commit adultery with the wife of your neighbour
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الذَّنْبِ أَكْبَرُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَدْعُوَ لِلَّهِ نِدًّا وَهُوَ خَلَقَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَلَدَكَ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يَطْعَمَ مَعَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَىٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تُزَانِيَ حَلِيلَةَ جَارِكَ ‏"‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ تَصْدِيقَهَا ‏{‏ وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ وَلاَ يَزْنُونَ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an jariyrin, qaala 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'amriw bni shurahbiyla, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi qaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi aaaau aldhhanbi aakbaru 'inda alllahi qaala ‏"‏ aan tad'uwa lillahi niddana wahuwa khalaqaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ aan taqtula waladaka makhaafaaa aan yat'ama ma'aka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma aaaaun qaala ‏"‏ aan tuzaaniya haliylaaa jaarika ‏"‏ faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla tasdiyqahaa ‏{‏ waalladhiyna laa yad'uwna ma'a alllahi iilahana akhara walaa yaqtuluwna alnnafsa allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi walaa yaznuwna waman yaf'al dhalika yalqa aathaamana‏}‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that a man said:Messenger of Allah, which offence is the most grievous in the eye of Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you associate a partner with Allah (despite the fact) that He created you. He (the man) said: What next? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you kill your child out of fear that he would join you in food. He (the inquirer) said (again): What next? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you commit adultery with the wife of your neighbour. And the Almighty and Exalted Lord testified it (with this verse): All those who call not unto another god along with Allah, and slay not any soul which Allah has forbidden, except in the cause of justice, nor commit fornication, and he who does this shall meet a requital of sin (xxv)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَكْبَرِ الْكَبَائِرِ - ثَلاَثًا - الإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَشَهَادَةُ الزُّورِ أَوْ قَوْلُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَّكِئًا فَجَلَسَ فَمَازَالَ يُكَرِّرُهَا حَتَّى قُلْنَا لَيْتَهُ سَكَتَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu muhammadi bni bukayri bni muhammadin alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an sa'iydin aljurayriyyi, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabiy bakraaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kunnaa 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aalaa aunabbiiukum biaakbari alkabaaiiri - thalaathana - aliishraaku bialllahi wa'uquwqu alwaalidayni washahaadaau alzzuwri aaw qawlu alzzuwri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm muttakiiana fajalasa famaazaala yukarriruhaa hattaa qulnaa laytahu sakata ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdur-Rahman b. Abu Bakra that his father said:We were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he observed: Should I not inform you about the most grievous of the grave sins? (The Holy Prophet) repeated it three times, and then said: Associating anyone with Allah, disobedience to parents, false testimony or false utterance. The Prophet was reclining, then he sat up, and he repeated it so many times that we wished that he should become silent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْكَبَائِرِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الشِّرْكُ بِاللَّهِ وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ وَقَوْلُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu aabiy bakrin, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alkabaaiiri qaala ‏ "‏ alshhirku bialllahi wa'uquwqu alwaalidayni waqatlu alnnafsi waqawlu alzzuwri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) about the major sins. He (the Holy Prophet) observed:Associating anyone with Allah, disobedience to parents, killing a person and false utterance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ ذَكَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْكَبَائِرَ - أَوْ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْكَبَائِرِ - فَقَالَ ‏"‏ الشِّرْكُ بِاللَّهِ وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَكْبَرِ الْكَبَائِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَوْلُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ شَهَادَةُ الزُّورِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَكْبَرُ ظَنِّي أَنَّهُ شَهَادَةُ الزُّورِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu alwaliydi bni 'abdi alhamiydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu aabiy bakrin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, qaala dhakara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alkabaaiira - aaw suiila 'ani alkabaaiiri - faqaala ‏"‏ alshhirku bialllahi waqatlu alnnafsi wa'uquwqu alwaalidayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ aalaa aunabbiiukum biaakbari alkabaaiiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qawlu alzzuwri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ shahaadaau alzzuwri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau waaakbaru zanniy aannahu shahaadaau alzzuwri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah b. Abu Bakr said:I heard Anas b. Malik saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) talked about the major sins, or he was asked about the major sins. Upon this he observed: Associating anyone with Allah, killing of a person, disobedience to parents. He (the Prophet further) said: Should I not inform you about the gravest of the major sins, and (in this connection) observed: False utterance or false testimony. Shu'ba said. It was most probably" false testimony
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اجْتَنِبُوا السَّبْعَ الْمُوبِقَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا هُنَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الشِّرْكُ بِاللَّهِ وَالسِّحْرُ وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَكْلُ مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ وَأَكْلُ الرِّبَا وَالتَّوَلِّي يَوْمَ الزَّحْفِ وَقَذْفُ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْغَافِلاَتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an thawri bni zaydin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ ajtanibuwa alssab'a almuwbiqaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi wamaa hunna qaala ‏"‏ alshhirku bialllahi waalssihru waqatlu alnnafsi allatiy harrama alllahu iilaaa bialhaqqi waaaklu maali alyatiymi waaaklu alrribaa waalttawalliy yawma alzzahfi waqadhfu almuhsanaati alghaafilaati almuuminaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:Avoid the seven noxious things. It was said (by the hearers): What are they, Messenger of Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Associating anything with Allah, magic, killing of one whom God has declared inviolate without a just cause, consuming the property of an orphan, and consuming of usury, turning back when the army advances, and slandering chaste women who are believers, but unwary
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مِنَ الْكَبَائِرِ شَتْمُ الرَّجُلِ وَالِدَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ يَشْتِمُ الرَّجُلُ وَالِدَيْهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ يَسُبُّ أَبَا الرَّجُلِ فَيَسُبُّ أَبَاهُ وَيَسُبُّ أُمَّهُ فَيَسُبُّ أُمَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'ani abni alhaadi, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni al'aasi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ mina alkabaaiiri shatmu alrrajuli waalidayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi hal yashtimu alrrajulu waalidayhi qaala ‏"‏ na'am yasubbu aabaa alrrajuli fayasubbu aabaahu wayasubbu aummahu fayasubbu aummahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:Abusing one's parents is one of the major sins. They (the hearers) said: Messenger of Allah, does a man abuse his parents too? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: Yes, one abuses the father of another man, who in turn abuses his father. One abuses his mother and he in turn abuses his (the former's) mother
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin jamiy'ana 'an muhammadi bni ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has also been transmitted on the authority of Sa'd b. Ibrahim with this chain of narrators
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَمَّادٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، - أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ، عَنْ فُضَيْلٍ الْفُقَيْمِيِّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يَكُونَ ثَوْبُهُ حَسَنًا وَنَعْلُهُ حَسَنَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ الْكِبْرُ بَطَرُ الْحَقِّ وَغَمْطُ النَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, waiibraahiymu bnu diynaarin, jamiy'ana 'an yahyaa bni hammaadin, - qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathaniy yahyaa bnu hammaadin, - aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an aabaana bni taghliba, 'an fudaylin alfuqaymiyyi, 'an iibraahiyma alnnakha'iyyi, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa yadkhulu aljannaaa man kaana fiy qalbihi mithqaalu dharraain min kibrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala rajulun iinna alrrajula yuhibbu aan yakuwna thawbuhu hasanana wana'luhu hasanaaan ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha jamiylun yuhibbu aljamaala alkibru bataru alhaqqi waghamtu alnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It Is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), observed:He who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of pride shall not enter Paradise. A person (amongst his hearers) said: Verily a person loves that his dress should be fine, and his shoes should be fine. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: Verily, Allah is Graceful and He loves Grace. Pride is disdaining the truth (out of self-conceit) and contempt for the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ، - قَالَ مِنْجَابٌ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ النَّارَ أَحَدٌ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةِ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ وَلاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ أَحَدٌ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةِ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ كِبْرِيَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, wasuwaydu bnu sa'iydin, kilaahumaa 'an 'aliyyi bni mushirin, - qaala minjaabun aakhbaranaa abnu mushirin, - 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulu alnnaara aahadun fiy qalbihi mithqaalu habbaai khardalin min iiymaanin walaa yadkhulu aljannaaa aahadun fiy qalbihi mithqaalu habbaai khardalin min kibriyaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:None shall enter the Fire (of Hell) who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of Iman and none shall enter Paradise who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of pride
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ، عَنْ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabaana bni taghliba, 'an fudaylin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulu aljannaaa man kaana fiy qalbihi mithqaalu dharraain min kibrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:He who has in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of pride shall not enter Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ وَكِيعٌ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ مَاتَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ النَّارَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقُلْتُ أَنَا وَمَنْ مَاتَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy wawakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala wakiy'un qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala abnu numayrin sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man maata yushriku bialllahi shayiana dakhala alnnaara ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqultu aanaa waman maata laa yushriku bialllahi shayiana dakhala aljannaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that Waki told (him) that the Messenger of Allah had observed and Ibn Numair asserted:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: He who dies associating anything with Allah would enter the Fire (of Hell). 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud said: I say that he who died without associating anything with Allah entered Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الْمُوجِبَتَانِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ مَاتَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَنْ مَاتَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ النَّارَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi maa almuwjibataani faqaala ‏ "‏ man maata laa yushriku bialllahi shayiana dakhala aljannaaa waman maata yushriku bialllahi shayiana dakhala alnnaara ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that a man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said:Messenger of Allah, what are the two things quite unavoidable? He replied: He who dies without associating anyone with Allah would (necessarily) enter Paradise and he who dies associating anything with Allah would enter the (Fire of) Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو أَيُّوبَ الْغَيْلاَنِيُّ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَنْ لَقِيَهُ يُشْرِكُ بِهِ دَخَلَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw aayyuwba alghaylaaniyyu, sulaymaanu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa qurraau, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, haddathanaa jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man laqiya alllaha laa yushriku bihi shayiana dakhala aljannaaa waman laqiyahu yushriku bihi dakhala alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw aayyuwba qaala aabuw alzzubayri 'an jaabirin ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: He who met Allah without associating anything with Allah entered Paradise and he who met Him associating (anything) with Him entered Fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ هِشَامٍ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa mu'aadhun, - wahuwa abnu hishaamin - qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith has been narrated by Ishaq b. Mansur on the authority of Jabir with another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ الأَحْدَبِ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَانِي جِبْرِيلُ - عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - فَبَشَّرَنِي أَنَّهُ مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an waasilin alaahdabi, 'ani alma'ruwri bni suwaydin, qaala sami'tu aabaa dharrin, yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ aataaniy jibriylu - 'alayhi alssalaamu - fabashharaniy aannahu man maata min aummatika laa yushriku bialllahi shayiana dakhala aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu waiin zanaa waiin saraqa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waiin zanaa waiin saraqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: I heard Abu Dharr narrating it from the Apostle (ﷺ) that he observed:Gabriel came to me and gave me the tidings: Verily he who died amongst your Ummah without associating anything with Allah would enter Paradise. I (the narrator) said: Even if he committed adultery and theft. He (the Holy Prophet) said: (Yes), even if he committed adultery and theft
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ خِرَاشٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنِي حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، أَنَّ يَحْيَى بْنَ يَعْمَرَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا الأَسْوَدِ الدِّيلِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا ذَرٍّ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ نَائِمٌ عَلَيْهِ ثَوْبٌ أَبْيَضُ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ نَائِمٌ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ وَقَدِ اسْتَيْقَظَ فَجَلَسْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ مَاتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ ‏"‏ عَلَى رَغْمِ أَنْفِ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ‏"‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ وَإِنْ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waaahmadu bnu khiraashin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathaniy husaynun almu'allimu, 'ani abni buraydaaa, aanna yahyaa bna ya'mara, haddathahu aanna aabaa alaaswadi alddiyliyya haddathahu aanna aabaa dharrin haddathahu qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa naaiimun 'alayhi thawbun aabyadu thumma aataytuhu faiidhaa huwa naaiimun thumma aataytuhu waqadi astayqaza fajalastu iilayhi faqaala ‏"‏ maa min 'abdin qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu thumma maata 'alaa dhalika iilaaa dakhala aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu waiin zanaa waiin saraqa qaala ‏"‏ waiin zanaa waiin saraqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu waiin zanaa waiin saraqa qaala ‏"‏ waiin zanaa waiin saraqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thalaathana thumma qaala fiy alrraabi'aai ‏"‏ 'alaa raghmi aanfi aabiy dharrin ‏"‏ qaala fakharaja aabuw dharrin wahuwa yaquwlu waiin raghima aanfu aabiy dharrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported,:I came to the Apostle (may peace be upon him ) and he was asleep with a white mantle over him. I again came, he was still asleep, I came again and he had awakened. I sat by his side and (the Holy Prophet) observed: There is none among the bondsmen who affirmed his faith in La illaha ill-Allah there is no God but Allah) and died in this state and did not enter Paradise. I (Abu Dharr) said: Even if he committed adultery and theft? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: (Yes) even though he committed adultery and theft. I (again said): Even if he committed adultery and theft? He replied: (Yes) even though he committed adultery and theft. (Th Holy Prophet repeated it three times) and said for the fourth time: In defiance of Abu Dharr. Abu Dharr then went out and he repeated (these words): In defiance of Abu Dharr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ مُتَقَارِبٌ - أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَدِيِّ بْنِ الْخِيَارِ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَادِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَقِيتُ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ فَقَاتَلَنِي فَضَرَبَ إِحْدَى يَدَىَّ بِالسَّيْفِ فَقَطَعَهَا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ لاَذَ مِنِّي بِشَجَرَةٍ فَقَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ لِلَّهِ ‏.‏ أَفَأَقْتُلُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَعْدَ أَنْ قَالَهَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَقْتُلْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ قَدْ قَطَعَ يَدِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ذَلِكَ بَعْدَ أَنْ قَطَعَهَا أَفَأَقْتُلُهُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَقْتُلْهُ فَإِنْ قَتَلْتَهُ فَإِنَّهُ بِمَنْزِلَتِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقْتُلَهُ وَإِنَّكَ بِمَنْزِلَتِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ كَلِمَتَهُ الَّتِي قَالَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, - waalllafzu mutaqaaribun - aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'adiyyi bni alkhiyaari, 'ani almiqdaadi bni alaaswadi, aannahu aakhbarahu aannahu, qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta iin laqiytu rajulaan mina alkuffaari faqaatalaniy fadaraba iihdaa yadaaaa bialssayfi faqata'ahaa ‏.‏ thumma laadha minniy bishajaraain faqaala aaslamtu lillahi ‏.‏ aafaaaqtuluhu yaa rasuwla alllahi ba'da aan qaalahaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taqtulhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnahu qad qata'a yadiy thumma qaala dhalika ba'da aan qata'ahaa aafaaaqtuluhu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taqtulhu faiin qataltahu faiinnahu bimanzilatika qabla aan taqtulahu waiinnaka bimanzilatihi qabla aan yaquwla kalimatahu allatiy qaala ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Miqdad b. Aswad that he said. Messenger of Allah, you just see (here is a point):If I encountered a person amongst the infidels (in the battlefield) and he attacked me and struck me and cut off one of my hands with the sword. Then he (in order to protect himself from me) took shelter of a tree and said: I become Muslim for Allah's sake. Messenger of Allah, can I kill him after he had uttered this? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not kill him. I (the narrator) said: Messenger of Allah, he cut off my hand and uttered this after amputating it; should I then kill him? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Don't kill him, for I you kill him, verily he would be in a position where you had been before killing him and verily you would be in a position where he had been before uttering (kalima)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُوسَى الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَمَّا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ وَابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ فَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا قَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ لِلَّهِ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ اللَّيْثُ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا مَعْمَرٌ فَفِي حَدِيثِهِ فَلَمَّا أَهْوَيْتُ لأَقْتُلَهُ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaala aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu muwsaa alaansaariyyu, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, jamiy'ana 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aammaa alaawzaa'iyyu waabnu jurayjin fafiy hadiythihimaa qaala aaslamtu lillahi ‏.‏ kamaa qaala alllaythu fiy hadiythihi ‏.‏ waaammaa ma'marun fafiy hadiythihi falammaa aahwaytu laaqtulahu qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith has been transmitted by the same chain of narrators. The hadith transmitted by Auza'i and Ibn Juraij contains these words:I embraced Islam for Allah's sake. and in the hadith narrated by Ma'mar the words are: I knelt down to kill him, that he said; There is no god but Allah
