verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، ثُمَّ الْجُنْدَعِيُّ أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ عَدِيِّ بْنِ الْخِيَارِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ الْمِقْدَادَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ الْكِنْدِيَّ - وَكَانَ حَلِيفًا لِبَنِي زُهْرَةَ وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَقِيتُ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda alllaythiyyu, thumma aljunda'iyyu aanna 'ubayda, alllahi bna 'adiyyi bni alkhiyaari aakhbarahu aanna almiqdaada bna 'amriw bni alaaswadi alkindiyya - wakaana haliyfana libaniy zuhraaa wakaana mimman shahida badrana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - aannahu qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta iin laqiytu rajulaan mina alkuffaari thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi alllaythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated by Miqdad, and he was an ally of B. Zuhra and was of those who participated in the Battle of Badr along with the Messenger of Allah, that he said:Messenger of Allah, here is a point: If I happened to encounter a person amongst the infidels (in the battle). Then he narrated a hadith similar to the one transmitted by Laith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي ظِبْيَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، وَهَذَا، حَدِيثُ ابْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَرِيَّةٍ فَصَبَّحْنَا الْحُرَقَاتِ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ فَأَدْرَكْتُ رَجُلاً فَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ فَطَعَنْتُهُ فَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَذَكَرْتُهُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَقَتَلْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا قَالَهَا خَوْفًا مِنَ السِّلاَحِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَلاَ شَقَقْتَ عَنْ قَلْبِهِ حَتَّى تَعْلَمَ أَقَالَهَا أَمْ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَمَازَالَ يُكَرِّرُهَا عَلَىَّ حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنِّي أَسْلَمْتُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ وَأَنَا وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَقْتُلُ مُسْلِمًا حَتَّى يَقْتُلَهُ ذُو الْبُطَيْنِ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي أُسَامَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ أَلَمْ يَقُلِ اللَّهُ ‏{‏ وَقَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّى لاَ تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ الدِّينُ كُلُّهُ لِلَّهِ‏}‏ فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ قَدْ قَاتَلْنَا حَتَّى لاَ تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَأَنْتَ وَأَصْحَابُكَ تُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تُقَاتِلُوا حَتَّى تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy zibyaana, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, wahadhaa, hadiythu abni aabiy shaybaaa qaala ba'athanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy sariyyaain fasabbahnaa alhuraqaati min juhaynaaa faaadraktu rajulaan faqaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ fata'antuhu fawaqa'a fiy nafsiy min dhalika fadhakartuhu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaqaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waqataltahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnamaa qaalahaa khawfana mina alssilaahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aafalaa shaqaqta 'an qalbihi hattaa ta'lama aaqaalahaa aam laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ famaazaala yukarriruhaa 'alaaaa hattaa tamannaytu aanniy aaslamtu yawmaiidhin ‏.‏ qaala faqaala sa'dun waaanaa waalllahi laa aaqtulu muslimana hattaa yaqtulahu dhuw albutayni ‏.‏ ya'niy ausaamaaa qaala qaala rajulun aalam yaquli alllahu ‏{‏ waqaatiluwhum hattaa laa takuwna fitnaaun wayakuwna alddiynu kulluhu lillahi‏}‏ faqaala sa'dun qad qaatalnaa hattaa laa takuwna fitnaaun waaanta waaashaabuka turiyduwna aan tuqaatiluwa hattaa takuwna fitnaaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Usama b. Zaid that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent us in a raiding party. We raided Huraqat of Juhaina in the morning. I caught hold of a man and he said:There is no god but Allah, I attacked him with a spear. It once occurred to me and I talked about it to the Apostle (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Did he profess" There is no god but Allah," and even then you killed him? I said: Messenger of Allah, he made a profession of it out of the fear of the weapon. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Did you tear his heart in order to find out whether it had professed or not? And he went on repeating it to me till I wished I had embraced Islam that day. Sa'd said: By Allah, I would never kill any Muslim so long as a person with a heavy belly, i. e., Usama, would not kill. Upon this a person remarked: Did Allah not say this: And fight them until there is no more mischief and religion is wholly for Allah? Sa'd said: We fought so that there should be no mischief, but you and your companions wish to fight so that there should be mischief
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ظِبْيَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْحُرَقَةِ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ فَصَبَّحْنَا الْقَوْمَ فَهَزَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَحِقْتُ أَنَا وَرَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ رَجُلاً مِنْهُمْ فَلَمَّا غَشَيْنَاهُ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ فَكَفَّ عَنْهُ الأَنْصَارِيُّ وَطَعَنْتُهُ بِرُمْحِي حَتَّى قَتَلْتُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا بَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ يَا أُسَامَةُ أَقَتَلْتَهُ بَعْدَ مَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا كَانَ مُتَعَوِّذًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَقَتَلْتَهُ بَعْدَ مَا قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَازَالَ يُكَرِّرُهَا عَلَىَّ حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ أَسْلَمْتُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa husaynun, haddathanaa aabuw zibyaana, qaala sami'tu ausaamaaa bna zaydi bni haarithaaa, yuhaddithu qaala ba'athanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa alhuraqaai min juhaynaaa fasabbahnaa alqawma fahazamnaahum walahiqtu aanaa warajulun mina alaansaari rajulaan minhum falammaa ghashaynaahu qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ fakaffa 'anhu alaansaariyyu wata'antuhu birumhiy hattaa qataltuhu ‏.‏ qaala falammaa qadimnaa balagha dhalika alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala liy ‏"‏ yaa ausaamaau aaqataltahu ba'da maa qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnamaa kaana muta'awwidhana ‏.‏ qaala faqaala ‏"‏ aaqataltahu ba'da maa qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famaazaala yukarriruhaa 'alaaaa hattaa tamannaytu aanniy lam aakun aaslamtu qabla dhalika alyawmi ‏.‏
verses.translation: (It is narrated on the authority of Usama b. Zaid:The Messenger of Allah may peace be upon him) sent us to Huraqat, a tribe of Juhaina. We attacked that tribe early in the morning and defeated them and I and a man from the Ansar caught hold of a person (of the defeated tribe). When we overcame him, he said: There is no god but Allah. At that moment the Ansari spared him, but I attacked him with my spear and killed him. The news had already reached the Apostle (peace be upon him), so when we came back he (the Apostle) said to me: Usama, did you kill him after he had made the profession: There is no god but Allah? I said. Messenger of Allah, he did it only as a shelter. The Prophet observed: Did you kill him after he had made the profession that there is no god but Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) went on repeating this to me till I wished I had not embraced Islam before that day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خِرَاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، أَنَّ خَالِدًا الأَثْبَجَ ابْنَ أَخِي، صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مُحْرِزٍ حَدَّثَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مُحْرِزٍ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَ أَنَّ جُنْدَبَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيَّ بَعَثَ إِلَى عَسْعَسِ بْنِ سَلاَمَةَ زَمَنَ فِتْنَةِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَ اجْمَعْ لِي نَفَرًا مِنْ إِخْوَانِكَ حَتَّى أُحَدِّثَهُمْ ‏.‏ فَبَعَثَ رَسُولاً إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَمَّا اجْتَمَعُوا جَاءَ جُنْدَبٌ وَعَلَيْهِ بُرْنُسٌ أَصْفَرُ فَقَالَ تَحَدَّثُوا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَحَدَّثُونَ بِهِ ‏.‏ حَتَّى دَارَ الْحَدِيثُ فَلَمَّا دَارَ الْحَدِيثُ إِلَيْهِ حَسَرَ الْبُرْنُسَ عَنْ رَأْسِهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَتَيْتُكُمْ وَلاَ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخْبِرَكُمْ عَنْ نَبِيِّكُمْ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ بَعْثًا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلَى قَوْمٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَإِنَّهُمُ الْتَقَوْا فَكَانَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِذَا شَاءَ أَنْ يَقْصِدَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ قَصَدَ لَهُ فَقَتَلَهُ وَإِنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ قَصَدَ غَفْلَتَهُ قَالَ وَكُنَّا نُحَدَّثُ أَنَّهُ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ فَلَمَّا رَفَعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّيْفَ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ فَقَتَلَهُ فَجَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ فَأَخْبَرَهُ حَتَّى أَخْبَرَهُ خَبَرَ الرَّجُلِ كَيْفَ صَنَعَ فَدَعَاهُ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لِمَ قَتَلْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهَ أَوْجَعَ فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَقَتَلَ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا - وَسَمَّى لَهُ نَفَرًا - وَإِنِّي حَمَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا رَأَى السَّيْفَ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَقَتَلْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَكَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ بِلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِذَا جَاءَتْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَكَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ بِلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِذَا جَاءَتْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلَ لاَ يَزِيدُهُ عَلَى أَنْ يَقُولَ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ بِلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِذَا جَاءَتْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu alhasani bni khiraashin, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aasimin, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, aanna khaalidana alaathbaja abna aakhiy, safwaana bni muhrizin haddatha 'an safwaana bni muhrizin, aannahu haddatha aanna jundaba bna 'abdi alllahi albajaliyya ba'atha iilaa 'as'asi bni salaamaaa zamana fitnaai abni alzzubayri faqaala ajma' liy nafarana min iikhwaanika hattaa auhaddithahum ‏.‏ faba'atha rasuwlaan iilayhim falammaa ajtama'uwa jaa'a jundabun wa'alayhi burnusun aasfaru faqaala tahaddathuwa bimaa kuntum tahaddathuwna bihi ‏.‏ hattaa daara alhadiythu falammaa daara alhadiythu iilayhi hasara alburnusa 'an raasihi faqaala iinniy aataytukum walaa auriydu aan aukhbirakum 'an nabiyyikum iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha ba'thana mina almuslimiyna iilaa qawmin mina almushrikiyna waiinnahumu altaqawa fakaana rajulun mina almushrikiyna iidhaa shaa'a aan yaqsida iilaa rajulin mina almuslimiyna qasada lahu faqatalahu waiinna rajulaan mina almuslimiyna qasada ghaflatahu qaala wakunnaa nuhaddathu aannahu ausaamaau bnu zaydin falammaa rafa'a 'alayhi alssayfa qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ faqatalahu fajaa'a albashiyru iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu faaakhbarahu hattaa aakhbarahu khabara alrrajuli kayfa sana'a fada'aahu fasaaalahu faqaala ‏"‏ lima qataltahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllaha aawja'a fiy almuslimiyna waqatala fulaanana wafulaanana - wasammaa lahu nafarana - waiinniy hamaltu 'alayhi falammaa raaaa alssayfa qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaqataltahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fakayfa tasna'u bilaa iilaha iilaaa alllahu iidhaa jaa'at yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi astaghfir liy ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wakayfa tasna'u bilaa iilaha iilaaa alllahu iidhaa jaa'at yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faja'ala laa yaziyduhu 'alaa aan yaquwla ‏"‏ kayfa tasna'u bilaa iilaha iilaaa alllahu iidhaa jaa'at yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated by Safwan b. Muhriz that Jundab b. 'Abdullah al-Bajali during the stormy days of Ibn Zubair sent a message to 'As'as b. Salama:Gather some men of your family so that I should talk to them. He ('As'as) sent a messenger to them (to the members of his family). When they had assembled, Jundab came there with a yellow hooded cloak on him, He said: Talk what you were busy in talking. The talk went on by turns, till there came his (Jundab's) turn. He took off the hooded cloak from his head and said: I have come to you with no other intention but to narrate to you a hadith of your Apostle: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a squad of the Muslims to a tribe of the polytheists. Both the armies confronted one another. There was a man among the army of polytheists who (was so dashing that), whenever he intended to kill a man from among the Muslims, he killed him. Amongst the Muslims too was a man looking forward to (an opportunity of) his (the polytheist's) unmindfulness. He (the narrator) said: We talked that he was Usama b, Zaid. When he raised his sword, he (the soldier of the polytheists) uttered:" There is no god but Allah," but he (Usama b. Zaid) killed him. When the messenger of the glad tidings came to the Apostle (ﷺ) he asked him (about the events of the battle) and he informed him about the man (Usama) and what he had done He (the Prophet of Allah) called for him and asked him why he had killed him. He (Usama) said: Messenger of Allah, he struck the Muslims and killed such and such of them. And he even named some of them. (He continued): I attacked him and when he saw the sword he said: There is no god but Allah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Did you kill him? He (Usama) replied in the affirmative. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: What would you do with:" There is no god but Allah," when he would come (before you) on the Day of Judgment? He (Usama) said: Messenger of Allah, beg pardon for me (from your Lord). He (the Holy Prophet) said: What would you do with:" There is no god but Allah" when he would come (before you) on the Day of Judgment? He (the Holy Prophet) added nothing to it but kept saying: What would you do with:" There is no god but Allah," when he would come (before you) on the Day of Judgment?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا السِّلاَحَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, waabnu, numayrin kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in 'ani abni 'umara aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man hamala 'alaynaa alssilaaha falaysa minnaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Umar who narrates from the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) who said:He who took up arms against us is not of us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُصْعَبٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْمِقْدَامِ - حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَلَّ عَلَيْنَا السَّيْفَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa mus'abun, - wahuwa abnu almiqdaami - haddathanaa 'ikrimaau bnu 'ammaarin, 'an iiyaasi bni salamaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man salla 'alaynaa alssayfa falaysa minnaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Iyas b. Salama narrated from his father that the Apostle (ﷺ) observed:He who draws the sword against us is not of us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَرَّادٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا السِّلاَحَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'abdu alllahi bnu barraadin alaash'ariyyu, waaabuw kuraybin qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man hamala 'alaynaa alssilaaha falaysa minnaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Musa Ash'ari:He who took up arms against us is not of us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا السِّلاَحَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا وَمَنْ غَشَّنَا فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyyu h wahaddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, muhammadu bnu hayyaana haddathanaa abnu aabiy haazimin, kilaahumaa 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man hamala 'alaynaa alssilaaha falaysa minnaa waman ghashhanaa falaysa minnaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:He who took up arms against us is not of us and he who acted dishonestly towards us is not of us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ عَلَى صُبْرَةِ طَعَامٍ فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِيهَا فَنَالَتْ أَصَابِعُهُ بَلَلاً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا هَذَا يَا صَاحِبَ الطَّعَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَصَابَتْهُ السَّمَاءُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَلاَ جَعَلْتَهُ فَوْقَ الطَّعَامِ كَىْ يَرَاهُ النَّاسُ مَنْ غَشَّ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin jamiy'ana 'an iismaa'iyla bni ja'farin, - qaala abnu aayyuwba haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - qaala aakhbaraniy al'alaa'u, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, ‏.‏ aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marra 'alaa subraai ta'aamin faaadkhala yadahu fiyhaa fanaalat aasaabi'uhu balalaan faqaala ‏"‏ maa hadhaa yaa saahiba altta'aami ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aasaabathu alssamaa'u yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aafalaa ja'altahu fawqa altta'aami kaa yaraahu alnnaasu man ghashha falaysa minniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a heap of eatables (corn). He thrust his hand in that (heap) and his fingers were moistened. He said to the owner of that heap of eatables (corn):What is this? He replied: Messenger of Allah, these have been drenched by rainfall. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: Why did you not place this (the drenched part of the heap) over other eatables so that the people could see it? He who deceives is not of me (is not my follower)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ ضَرَبَ الْخُدُودَ أَوْ شَقَّ الْجُيُوبَ أَوْ دَعَا بِدَعْوَى الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ هَذَا حَدِيثُ يَحْيَى وَأَمَّا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالاَ ‏"‏ وَشَقَّ وَدَعَا ‏"‏ بِغَيْرِ أَلِفٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, wawakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy jamiy'ana, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laysa minnaa man daraba alkhuduwda aaw shaqqa aljuyuwba aaw da'aa bida'waa aljaahiliyyaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ hadhaa hadiythu yahyaa waaammaa abnu numayrin waaabuw bakrin faqaalaa ‏"‏ washaqqa wada'aa ‏"‏ bighayri aalifin ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Prophet observed:He is not one of us (one among the Ummah of Islam) who beat the cheeks or tore the front opening of the shirt or uttered the slogans of (the days of) Jahiliya (ignorance). Ibn Numair and Abu Bakr said (instead of the word" au" (or) it is" wa" [and] the words are) and tore and uttered (the slogans) of Jahiliya without" alif
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالاَ ‏ "‏ وَشَقَّ وَدَعَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, jamiy'ana 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaalaa ‏ "‏ washaqqa wada'aa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of narrators and the transmitters said:He tore and called
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْقَنْطَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُخَيْمِرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ وَجِعَ أَبُو مُوسَى وَجَعًا فَغُشِيَ عَلَيْهِ وَرَأْسُهُ فِي حَجْرِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ فَصَاحَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهَا شَيْئًا فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ أَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا بَرِئَ مِنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَرِئَ مِنَ الصَّالِقَةِ وَالْحَالِقَةِ وَالشَّاقَّةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu muwsaa alqantariyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hamzaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda bni jaabirin, aanna alqaasima bna mukhaymiraaa, haddathahu qaala haddathaniy aabuw burdaaa bnu aabiy muwsaa, qaala waji'a aabuw muwsaa waja'ana faghushiya 'alayhi waraasuhu fiy hajri amraaaain min aahlihi fasaahati amraaaaun min aahlihi falam yastati' aan yarudda 'alayhaa shayiana falammaa aafaaqa qaala aanaa bariy'un mimmaa bariia minhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bariia mina alssaaliqaai waalhaaliqaai waalshhaaqqaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Burda b. Abu Musa that Abu Musa was afflicted with grave pain and he became unconscious and his head was in the lap of a lady of his household. One of the women of his household walled. He (Abu Musa) was unable (because of weakness) to say anything to her. But when he was a bit recovered he said:I have no concern with one with whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has no concern, Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has no concern with that woman who wails loudly, shaves her hair and tears (her garment in grief)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا صَخْرَةَ، يَذْكُرُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، وَأَبِي، بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى قَالاَ أُغْمِيَ عَلَى أَبِي مُوسَى وَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ أُمُّ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ تَصِيحُ بِرَنَّةٍ ‏.‏ قَالاَ ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ قَالَ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمِي - وَكَانَ يُحَدِّثُهَا - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّنْ حَلَقَ وَسَلَقَ وَخَرَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa ja'faru bnu 'awnin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'umaysin, qaala sami'tu aabaa sakhraaa, yadhkuru 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, waaabiy, burdaaa bni aabiy muwsaa qaalaa aughmiya 'alaa aabiy muwsaa waaaqbalati amraaatuhu aummu 'abdi alllahi tasiyhu birannaain ‏.‏ qaalaa thumma aafaaqa qaala aalam ta'lamiy - wakaana yuhaddithuhaa - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aanaa bariy'un mimman halaqa wasalaqa wakharaqa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Burda that Abu Musa fell unconscious and his wife Umm Abdullah came there and wailed loudly. When he felt relief he said:Don't you know? -and narrated to her: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I have no concern with one who shaved her hair, lamented loudly and tore (her clothes in grief)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُطِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ عِيَاضٍ الأَشْعَرِيِّ، عَنِ امْرَأَةِ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي هِنْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مُحْرِزٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ عِيَاضٍ الأَشْعَرِيِّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ مِنَّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏"‏ بَرِيءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu mutiy'in, hadaathanaa hushaymun, 'an husaynin, 'an 'iyaadin alaash'ariyii, 'ani amraaaai aabiy muwsaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahadaathaniyhi hajaaaju bnu alshaaa'iri, hadaathanaa 'abdu alsaamadi, qaala hadaathaniy aabiy, hadaathanaa daawudu, - ya'niy abna aabiy hindin - hadaathanaa 'aasimun, 'an safwaana bni muhrizin, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahadaathaniy alhasanu bnu 'aliyinn alhulwaaniyuu, hadaathanaa 'abdu alsaamadi, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an rib'iyii bni hiraashin, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏ ghayra aanaa fiy hadiythi 'iyaadin alaash'ariyii qaala ‏"‏ laysa minaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yaqul ‏"‏ bariy'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Musa with this change only:That (the Holy Prophet) did not say that he had no concern but said: He is not one of us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيٌّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مَيْمُونٍ - حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلٌ الأَحْدَبُ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، يَنِمُّ الْحَدِيثَ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ نَمَّامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, wa'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a aldduba'iyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa mahdiyyun, - wahuwa abnu maymuwnin - haddathanaa waasilun alaahdabu, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an hudhayfaaa, aannahu balaghahu aanna rajulaan, yanimmu alhadiytha faqaala hudhayfaau sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulu aljannaaa nammaamun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported from Hudhaifa that news reached him (the Holy Prophet) that a certain man carried tales. Upon this Hudhaifa remarked:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: The tale-bearer shall not enter Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَجُلٌ يَنْقُلُ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى الأَمِيرِ فَكُنَّا جُلُوسًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ الْقَوْمُ هَذَا مِمَّنْ يَنْقُلُ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى الأَمِيرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَ حَتَّى جَلَسَ إِلَيْنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَتَّاتٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an hammaami bni alhaarithi, qaala kaana rajulun yanqulu alhadiytha iilaa alaamiyri fakunnaa juluwsana fiy almasjidi faqaala alqawmu hadhaa mimman yanqulu alhadiytha iilaa alaamiyri ‏.‏ qaala fajaa'a hattaa jalasa iilaynaa ‏.‏ faqaala hudhayfaau sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulu aljannaaa qattaatun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Hammam b, al-Harith that a man used to carry tales to the governor. We were sitting in the mosque. the people said:He is one who carries tales to the governor. He (the narrator) said: Then he came and sat with us. Thereupon Hudhaifa remarked: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: The beater of false tales would never enter heaven
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا مَعَ حُذَيْفَةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ حَتَّى جَلَسَ إِلَيْنَا فَقِيلَ لِحُذَيْفَةَ إِنَّ هَذَا يَرْفَعُ إِلَى السُّلْطَانِ أَشْيَاءَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ - إِرَادَةَ أَنْ يُسْمِعَهُ - سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَتَّاتٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, wawakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa abnu mushirin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an hammaami bni alhaarithi, qaala kunnaa juluwsana ma'a hudhayfaaa fiy almasjidi fajaa'a rajulun hattaa jalasa iilaynaa faqiyla lihudhayfaaa iinna hadhaa yarfa'u iilaa alssultaani aashyaa'a ‏.‏ faqaala hudhayfaau - iiraadaaa aan yusmi'ahu - sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulu aljannaaa qattaatun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Hammam b. al-Harith:We were sitting with Hudhaifa in the mosque. A man came and sat along with us. It was said to Hudhaifa that he was the man who carried tales to the ruler. Hudhaifa remarked with the intention of conveying to him: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: The tale-bearer will not enter Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُدْرِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ خَرَشَةَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ ثَلاَثَةٌ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ‏"‏ قَالَ فَقَرَأَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ خَابُوا وَخَسِرُوا مَنْ هُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْمُسْبِلُ وَالْمَنَّانُ وَالْمُنَفِّقُ سِلْعَتَهُ بِالْحَلِفِ الْكَاذِبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaaluwa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an 'aliyyi bni mudrikin, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an kharashaaa bni alhurri, 'an aabiy dharrin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ thalaathaaun laa yukallimuhumu alllahu yawma alqiyaamaai walaa yanzuru iilayhim walaa yuzakkiyhim walahum 'adhaabun aaliymun ‏"‏ qaala faqaraaahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaatha miraarin ‏.‏ qaala aabuw dharrin khaabuwa wakhasiruwa man hum yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ almusbilu waalmannaanu waalmunaffiqu sil'atahu bialhalifi alkaadhibi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated o the authority of Abu Dharr that the Messenger of Allah (may ace he upon him) observed:Three are the (persons) with whom Allah would neither speak on the Day of Resurrection, nor would look at them nor would absolve the and there is a painful chastisement for them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) repeated it three times. Abu Dharr remarked: They failed and they lost; who are these persons, Messenger of Allah? Upon this he (the Holy) Prophet) observed: They are: the dragger of lower garment, the recounter of obligation the seller of goods by false oath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ خَرَشَةَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثَةٌ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الْمَنَّانُ الَّذِي لاَ يُعْطِي شَيْئًا إِلاَّ مَنَّهُ وَالْمُنَفِّقُ سِلْعَتَهُ بِالْحَلِفِ الْفَاجِرِ وَالْمُسْبِلُ إِزَارَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu khalaaadin albaahiliyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu alaa'mashu, 'an sulaymaana bni mushirin, 'an kharashaaa bni alhurri, 'an aabiy dharrin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ thalaathaaun laa yukallimuhumu alllahu yawma alqiyaamaai almannaanu alladhiy laa yu'tiy shayiana iilaaa mannahu waalmunaffiqu sil'atahu bialhalifi alfaajiri waalmusbilu iizaarahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr who narrates that the Prophet (ﷺ) observed:Three are the persons with whom Allah would not speak on the Day of Resurrection: the bestower of gift who does not give anything but by laying obligation on him, the seller of goods who sells them by taking false oath and one who hangs low his lower garment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثَةٌ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi bishru bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - 'an shu'baaa, qaala sami'tu sulaymaana, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ thalaathaaun laa yukallimuhumu alllahu walaa yanzuru iilayhim walaa yuzakkiyhim walahum 'adhaabun aaliymun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bishr b. Khalid has narrated this hadith on the authority of Sulaiman with the same chain of transmitters with this addition:Allah shall neither speak nor look at nor absolve then, and there is a tormenting punishment for them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثَةٌ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلاَ يُزَكِّيهِمْ - قَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ وَلاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ - وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ شَيْخٌ زَانٍ وَمَلِكٌ كَذَّابٌ وَعَائِلٌ مُسْتَكْبِرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ thalaathaaun laa yukallimuhumu alllahu yawma alqiyaamaai walaa yuzakkiyhim - qaala aabuw mu'aawiyaaa walaa yanzuru iilayhim - walahum 'adhaabun aaliymun shaykhun zaanin wamalikun kadhhaabun wa'aaiilun mustakbirun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:Three (are the persons) with whom Allah would neither speak, nor would He absolve them on the Day of Resurrection. Abu Mu'awiya added: He would not look at them and there is grievous torment for them: the aged adulterer, the liar king and the proud destitute
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، - وَهَذَا حَدِيثُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثٌ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ رَجُلٌ عَلَى فَضْلِ مَاءٍ بِالْفَلاَةِ يَمْنَعُهُ مِنِ ابْنِ السَّبِيلِ وَرَجُلٌ بَايَعَ رَجُلاً بِسِلْعَةٍ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَحَلَفَ لَهُ بِاللَّهِ لأَخَذَهَا بِكَذَا وَكَذَا فَصَدَّقَهُ وَهُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ وَرَجُلٌ بَايَعَ إِمَامًا لاَ يُبَايِعُهُ إِلاَّ لِدُنْيَا فَإِنْ أَعْطَاهُ مِنْهَا وَفَى وَإِنْ لَمْ يُعْطِهِ مِنْهَا لَمْ يَفِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, - wahadhaa hadiythu aabiy bakrin - qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ thalaathun laa yukallimuhumu alllahu yawma alqiyaamaai walaa yanzuru iilayhim walaa yuzakkiyhim walahum 'adhaabun aaliymun rajulun 'alaa fadli maa'in bialfalaaai yamna'uhu mini abni alssabiyli warajulun baaya'a rajulaan bisil'aain ba'da al'asri fahalafa lahu bialllahi laakhadhahaa bikadhaa wakadhaa fasaddaqahu wahuwa 'alaa ghayri dhalika warajulun baaya'a iimaamana laa yubaayi'uhu iilaaa lidunyaa faiin aa'taahu minhaa wafaa waiin lam yu'tihi minhaa lam yafi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira narrated on the authority of Abu Bakr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Three are the persons with whom Allah would neither speak on the Day of Resurrection, nor would He look towards them, nor would purify them (from sins), and there would be a tormenting chastisement for them: a person who in the waterless desert has more water (than his need) and he refuses to give it to the traveller and a person who sold a commodity to another person in the afternoon and took an oath of Allah that he had bought it at such and such price and he (the buyer) accepted it to be true though it was not a fact, and a person who pledged allegiance to the Imam but for the sake of the world (material gains). And if the Imam bestowed on him (something) out of that (worldly riches) he stood by his allegiance and if he did not give him, he did not fulfil the allegiance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏ "‏ وَرَجُلٌ سَاوَمَ رَجُلاً بِسِلْعَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abtharun, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi jariyrin ‏ "‏ warajulun saawama rajulaan bisil'aain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith has been transmitted by another chain of transmitters with the exception of these words:He offered for sale a commodity to another person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، - قَالَ أُرَاهُ مَرْفُوعًا - قَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثَةٌ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ رَجُلٌ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ بَعْدَ صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ عَلَى مَالِ مُسْلِمٍ فَاقْتَطَعَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَبَاقِي حَدِيثِهِ نَحْوُ حَدِيثِ الأَعْمَشِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, - qaala auraahu marfuw'ana - qaala ‏ "‏ thalaathaaun laa yukallimuhumu alllahu walaa yanzuru iilayhim walahum 'adhaabun aaliymun rajulun halafa 'alaa yamiynin ba'da salaaai al'asri 'alaa maali muslimin faaqtata'ahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wabaaqiy hadiythihi nahwu hadiythi alaa'mashi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that he (the Messenger of Allah) observed:Three are the persons with whom Allah would neither speak (on the Day of Resurrection) nor would He look at them, and there would be a painful chastisement for them, a person who took an oath on the goods of a Muslim in the afternoon and then broke it. The rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by A'mash
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنَ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِحَدِيدَةٍ فَحَدِيدَتُهُ فِي يَدِهِ يَتَوَجَّأُ بِهَا فِي بَطْنِهِ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا مُخَلَّدًا فِيهَا أَبَدًا وَمَنْ شَرِبَ سَمًّا فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ فَهُوَ يَتَحَسَّاهُ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا مُخَلَّدًا فِيهَا أَبَدًا وَمَنْ تَرَدَّى مِنْ جَبَلٍ فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ فَهُوَ يَتَرَدَّى فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا مُخَلَّدًا فِيهَا أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mana qatala nafsahu bihadiydaain fahadiydatuhu fiy yadihi yatawajjaau bihaa fiy batnihi fiy naari jahannama khaalidana mukhalladana fiyhaa aabadana waman shariba sammana faqatala nafsahu fahuwa yatahassaahu fiy naari jahannama khaalidana mukhalladana fiyhaa aabadana waman taraddaa min jabalin faqatala nafsahu fahuwa yataraddaa fiy naari jahannama khaalidana mukhalladana fiyhaa aabadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:He who killed himself with steel (weapon) would be the eternal denizen of the Fire of Hell and he would have that weapon in his hand and would be thrusting that in his stomach for ever and ever, he who drank poison and killed himself would sip that in the Fire of Hell where he is doomed for ever and ever; and he who killed himself by falling from (the top of) a mountain would constantly fall in the Fire of Hell and would live there for ever and ever
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ذَكْوَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, haddathanaa 'abtharun, h wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau, kulluhum bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai shu'baaa 'an sulaymaana qaala sami'tu dhakwaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سَلاَّمِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلاَّمٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا قِلاَبَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ثَابِتَ بْنَ الضَّحَّاكِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَايَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ بِمِلَّةٍ غَيْرِ الإِسْلاَمِ كَاذِبًا فَهُوَ كَمَا قَالَ وَمَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِشَىْءٍ عُذِّبَ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَيْسَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ نَذْرٌ فِي شَىْءٍ لاَ يَمْلِكُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa mu'aawiyaau bnu salaaami bni aabiy salaaamin alddimashqiyyu, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, aanna aabaa qilaabaaa, aakhbarahu aanna thaabita bna alddahhaaki aakhbarahu aannahu, baaya'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tahta alshhajaraai waaanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man halafa 'alaa yamiynin bimillaain ghayri aliislaami kaadhibana fahuwa kamaa qaala waman qatala nafsahu bishaa'in 'udhhiba bihi yawma alqiyaamaai walaysa 'alaa rajulin nadhrun fiy shaa'in laa yamlikuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thabit b. Dahhak reported that he pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) under the Tree, and verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:He who took an oath of a religion other than Islam, in the state of being a liar, would became so, as he professed. He who killed himself with a thing would be tormented on the Day of Resurrection with that very thing. One is not obliged to offer votive offering of a thing which is not in his possession
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ هِشَامٍ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ الضَّحَّاكِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ نَذْرٌ فِيمَا لاَ يَمْلِكُ وَلَعْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَقَتْلِهِ وَمَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِشَىْءٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا عُذِّبَ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَنِ ادَّعَى دَعْوَى كَاذِبَةً لِيَتَكَثَّرَ بِهَا لَمْ يَزِدْهُ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ قِلَّةً وَمَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينِ صَبْرٍ فَاجِرَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - wahuwa abnu hishaamin - qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, qaala haddathaniy aabuw qilaabaaa, 'an thaabiti bni alddahhaaki, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laysa 'alaa rajulin nadhrun fiymaa laa yamliku wala'nu almuumini kaqatlihi waman qatala nafsahu bishaa'in fiy alddunyaa 'udhhiba bihi yawma alqiyaamaai wamani adda'aa da'waa kaadhibaaan liyatakathhara bihaa lam yazidhu alllahu iilaaa qillaaan waman halafa 'alaa yamiyni sabrin faajiraain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Thabit b. al-Dahhak that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observes:None is obliged to give votive offering (of a thing) which is not in his possession and the cursing of a believer is tantamount to killing him, and he who killed himself with a thing in this world would be tormented with that (very thing) on the Day of Resurrection, and he who made a false claim to increase (his wealth), Allah would make no addition but that of paucity, and he who perjured would earn the wrath of God
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَعَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ الضَّحَّاكِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، ح
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, wa'abdu alwaarithi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, kulluhum 'an 'abdi alssamadi bni 'abdi alwaarithi, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an thaabiti bni alddahhaaki alaansaariyyi, h
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Thabit b. Dahhak that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:He who took deliberately a false oath on a religion other than Islam would become that which he had professed. And he who killed himself with anything Allah would torment him with that in the Fire of Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، - قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ شَهِدْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُنَيْنًا فَقَالَ لِرَجُلٍ مِمَّنْ يُدْعَى بِالإِسْلاَمِ ‏"‏ هَذَا مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ فَلَمَّا حَضَرْنَا الْقِتَالَ قَاتَلَ الرَّجُلُ قِتَالاً شَدِيدًا فَأَصَابَتْهُ جِرَاحَةٌ فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي قُلْتَ لَهُ آنِفًا ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهُ قَاتَلَ الْيَوْمَ قِتَالاً شَدِيدًا وَقَدْ مَاتَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِلَى النَّارِ ‏"‏ فَكَادَ بَعْضُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ أَنْ يَرْتَابَ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ إِذْ قِيلَ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَمُتْ وَلَكِنَّ بِهِ جِرَاحًا شَدِيدًا فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ لَمْ يَصْبِرْ عَلَى الْجِرَاحِ فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ فَأُخْبِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشْهَدُ أَنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِلاَلاً فَنَادَى فِي النَّاسِ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلاَّ ن��فْسٌ مُسْلِمَةٌ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُؤَيِّدُ هَذَا الدِّينَ بِالرَّجُلِ الْفَاجِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, - qaala abnu raafi'in haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, - aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'ani abni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala shahidnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hunaynana faqaala lirajulin mimman yud'aa bialiislaami ‏"‏ hadhaa min aahli alnnaari ‏"‏ falammaa hadarnaa alqitaala qaatala alrrajulu qitaalaan shadiydana faaasaabathu jiraahaaun faqiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi alrrajulu alladhiy qulta lahu anifana ‏"‏ iinnahu min aahli alnnaari ‏"‏ faiinnahu qaatala alyawma qitaalaan shadiydana waqad maata ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iilaa alnnaari ‏"‏ fakaada ba'du almuslimiyna aan yartaaba fabaynamaa hum 'alaa dhalika iidh qiyla iinnahu lam yamut walakinna bihi jiraahana shadiydana falammaa kaana mina alllayli lam yasbir 'alaa aljiraahi faqatala nafsahu faaukhbira alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhalika faqaala ‏"‏ alllahu aakbaru aashhadu aanniy 'abdu alllahi warasuwluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aamara bilaalaan fanaadaa fiy alnnaasi ‏"‏ iinnahu laa yadkhulu aljannaaa iilaaa n��fsun muslimaaun waiinna alllaha yuuayyidu hadhaa alddiyna bialrrajuli alfaajiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira:We participated in the Battle of Hunain along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) said about a man who claimed to be a Muslim that he was one of the denizens of the Fire (of Hell). When we were in the thick of the battle that man fought desperately and was wounded. It was said: Messenger of Allah, the person whom you at first called as the denizen of Fire fought desperately and died. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: He was doomed to the Fire (of Hell). Some men were on the verge of doubt (about his fate) when it was said that he was not dead but fatally wounded. When it was night he could not stand the (pain of his) wound and killed himself. The Apostle (ﷺ) was informed of that. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Allah is Great, I bear testimony to the fact that I am the servant of Allah and His messenger. He then commanded Bilal to announce to the people that none but a Muslim would enter Paradise. Verily Allah helps this faith even by a sinful person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ - حَىٌّ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْتَقَى هُوَ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ فَاقْتَتَلُوا ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا مَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى عَسْكَرِهِ وَمَالَ الآخَرُونَ إِلَى عَسْكَرِهِمْ وَفِي أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ لاَ يَدَعُ لَهُمْ شَاذَّةً إِلاَّ اتَّبَعَهَا يَضْرِبُهَا بِسَيْفِهِ فَقَالُوا مَا أَجْزَأَ مِنَّا الْيَوْمَ أَحَدٌ كَمَا أَجْزَأَ فُلاَنٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَنَا صَاحِبُهُ أَبَدًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ مَعَهُ كُلَّمَا وَقَفَ وَقَفَ مَعَهُ وَإِذَا أَسْرَعَ أَسْرَعَ مَعَهُ - قَالَ - فَجُرِحَ الرَّجُلُ جُرْحًا شَدِيدًا فَاسْتَعْجَلَ الْمَوْتَ فَوَضَعَ نَصْلَ سَيْفِهِ بِالأَرْضِ وَذُبَابَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيْهِ ثُمَّ تَحَامَلَ عَلَى سَيْفِهِ فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ فَخَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي ذَكَرْتَ آنِفًا أَنَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَأَعْظَمَ النَّاسُ ذَلِكَ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا لَكُمْ بِهِ فَخَرَجْتُ فِي طَلَبِهِ حَتَّى جُرِحَ جُرْحًا شَدِيدًا فَاسْتَعْجَلَ الْمَوْتَ فَوَضَعَ نَصْلَ سَيْفِهِ بِالأَرْضِ وَذُبَابَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيْهِ ثُمَّ تَحَامَلَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ وَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ وَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyyu - haaaun mina al'arabi - 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm altaqaa huwa waalmushrikuwna faaqtataluwa ‏.‏ falammaa maala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa 'askarihi wamaala alakharuwna iilaa 'askarihim wafiy aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun laa yada'u lahum shaadhhaaan iilaaa attaba'ahaa yadribuhaa bisayfihi faqaaluwa maa aajzaaa minnaa alyawma aahadun kamaa aajzaaa fulaanun ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aamaa iinnahu min aahli alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi aanaa saahibuhu aabadana ‏.‏ qaala fakharaja ma'ahu kullamaa waqafa waqafa ma'ahu waiidhaa aasra'a aasra'a ma'ahu - qaala - fajuriha alrrajulu jurhana shadiydana faasta'jala almawta fawada'a nasla sayfihi bialaardi wadhubaabahu bayna thadyayhi thumma tahaamala 'alaa sayfihi faqatala nafsahu fakharaja alrrajulu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aashhadu aannaka rasuwlu alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alrrajulu alladhiy dhakarta anifana aannahu min aahli alnnaari faaa'zama alnnaasu dhalika faqultu aanaa lakum bihi fakharajtu fiy talabihi hattaa juriha jurhana shadiydana faasta'jala almawta fawada'a nasla sayfihi bialaardi wadhubaabahu bayna thadyayhi thumma tahaamala 'alayhi faqatala nafsahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda dhalika ‏"‏ iinna alrrajula laya'malu 'amala aahli aljannaai fiymaa yabduw lilnnaasi wahuwa min aahli alnnaari waiinna alrrajula laya'malu 'amala aahli alnnaari fiymaa yabduw lilnnaasi wahuwa min aahli aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi that there was an encounter between the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the polytheists, and they fought (against one another). At the conclusion of the battle the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bent his steps towards his army and they (the enemies) bent their steps towards their army. And there was a person (his name was Quzman and he was one of the hypocrites) among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) who did not spare a detached (fighter of the enemy) but pursued and killed him with the sword. They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said:None served us better today than this man Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: Verily he is one of the denizens of Fire. One of the people (Muslims) said: I will constantly shadow him. Then this man went out along with him. He halted whenever he halted, and ran along with him whenever he ran. He (the narrator) said: The man was seriously injured. He (could not stand the pain) and hastened his own death. He placed the blade of the sword on the ground with the tip between his chest and then pressed himself against the sword and killed himself. Then the man (following him) went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: I bear testimony that verily thou art the Messenger of Allah, He (the Holy Prophet) said: What is the matter? He replied: The person about whom you just mentioned that he was one among the denizens of Fire and the people were surprised (at this) and I said to them that I would bring (the news about him) and consequently I went out in search of him till I (found him ) to be very seriously injured. He hastened his death. He placed the blade of the sword upon the ground and its tip between his chest and then pressed himself against that and killed himself. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: A person performs the deeds which to the people appear to be the deeds befitting the dweller of Paradise, but he is in fact one of the denizens of Hell. And verily a person does an act which in the eyes of public is one which is done by the denizens of Hell, but the person is one among the dwellers of Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، - وَهُوَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ - حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ رَجُلاً مِمَّنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ خَرَجَتْ بِهِ قَرْحَةٌ فَلَمَّا آذَتْهُ انْتَزَعَ سَهْمًا مِنْ كِنَانَتِهِ فَنَكَأَهَا فَلَمْ يَرْقَإِ الدَّمُ حَتَّى مَاتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَدْ حَرَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ مَدَّ يَدَهُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ إِي وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ حَدَّثَنِي بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ جُنْدَبٌ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa alzzubayriyyu, - wahuwa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri - haddathanaa shaybaanu, qaala sami'tu alhasana, yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna rajulaan mimman kaana qablakum kharajat bihi qarhaaun falammaa adhathu antaza'a sahmana min kinaanatihi fanakaaahaa falam yarqaii alddamu hattaa maata ‏.‏ qaala rabbukum qad harramtu 'alayhi aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma madda yadahu iilaa almasjidi faqaala iiy waalllahi laqad haddathaniy bihadhaa alhadiythi jundabun 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hadhaa almasjidi ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Hasan:A person belonging to the people of the past suffered from a boil, when it pained him, he drew out an arrow from the quiver and pierced it. And the bleeding did not stop till he died. Your Lord said: I forbade his entrance into Paradise. Then he (Hasan) stretched his hand towards the mosque and said: By God, Jundab transmitted this hadith to me from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in this very mosque
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنَا جُنْدَبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيُّ، فِي هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ فَمَا نَسِينَا وَمَا نَخْشَى أَنْ يَكُونَ جُنْدَبٌ كَذَبَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَرَجَ بِرَجُلٍ فِيمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ خُرَاجٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa aabiy qaala, sami'tu alhasana, yaquwlu haddathanaa jundabu bnu 'abdi alllahi albajaliyyu, fiy hadhaa almasjidi famaa nasiynaa wamaa nakhshaa aan yakuwna jundabun kadhaba 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kharaja birajulin fiyman kaana qablakum khuraajun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Hasan:Jundab b. 'Abdullah al-Bajali narrated this hadith in this mosque which we can neither forget and at the same time we have no apprehension that Jundab could attribute a lie to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) observed: A person belonging to the people of the past suffered from a boil, and then the rest of the hadith was narrated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سِمَاكٌ الْحَنَفِيُّ أَبُو زُمَيْلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ خَيْبَرَ أَقْبَلَ نَفَرٌ مِنْ صَحَابَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا فُلاَنٌ شَهِيدٌ فُلاَنٌ شَهِيدٌ حَتَّى مَرُّوا عَلَى رَجُلٍ فَقَالُوا فُلاَنٌ شَهِيدٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَلاَّ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ فِي النَّارِ فِي بُرْدَةٍ غَلَّهَا أَوْ عَبَاءَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ اذْهَبْ فَنَادِ فِي النَّاسِ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلاَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجْتُ فَنَادَيْتُ ‏"‏ أَلاَ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلاَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa haashimu bnu alqaasimi, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau bnu 'ammaarin, qaala haddathaniy simaakun alhanafiyyu aabuw zumaylin, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abbaasin, qaala haddathaniy 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi, qaala lammaa kaana yawmu khaybara aaqbala nafarun min sahaabaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa fulaanun shahiydun fulaanun shahiydun hattaa marruwa 'alaa rajulin faqaaluwa fulaanun shahiydun ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kalaaa iinniy raaaytuhu fiy alnnaari fiy burdaain ghallahaa aaw 'abaa'aain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa abna alkhattaabi adhhab fanaadi fiy alnnaasi iinnahu laa yadkhulu aljannaaa iilaaa almuuminuwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakharajtu fanaadaytu ‏"‏ aalaa iinnahu laa yadkhulu aljannaaa iilaaa almuuminuwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Umar b. Khattab that when it was the day of Khaibar a party of Companions of the Apostle (ﷺ) came there and said:So and so is a martyr, till they happened to pass by a man and said: So and so is a martyr. Upon this the Messenger of Allah remarked: Nay, not so verily I have seen him in the Fire for the garment or cloak that he had stolen from the booty, Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Umar son of Khattab, go and announce to the people that none but the believers shall enter Paradise. He ('Umar b. Khattab) narrated: I went out and proclaimed: Verily none but the believers would enter Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الدُّؤَلِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ مُطِيعٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَهَذَا حَدِيثُهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى خَيْبَرَ فَفَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا فَلَمْ نَغْنَمْ ذَهَبًا وَلاَ وَرِقًا غَنِمْنَا الْمَتَاعَ وَالطَّعَامَ وَالثِّيَابَ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقْنَا إِلَى الْوَادِي وَمَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَبْدٌ لَهُ وَهَبَهُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ جُذَامٍ يُدْعَى رِفَاعَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ مِنْ بَنِي الضُّبَيْبِ فَلَمَّا نَزَلْنَا الْوَادِيَ قَامَ عَبْدُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحُلُّ رَحْلَهُ فَرُمِيَ بِسَهْمٍ فَكَانَ فِيهِ حَتْفُهُ فَقُلْنَا هَنِيئًا لَهُ الشَّهَادَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَلاَّ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ الشَّمْلَةَ لَتَلْتَهِبُ عَلَيْهِ نَارًا أَخَذَهَا مِنَ الْغَنَائِمِ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ لَمْ تُصِبْهَا الْمَقَاسِمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفَزِعَ النَّاسُ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ بِشِرَاكٍ أَوْ شِرَاكَيْنِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَصَبْتُ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ شِرَاكٌ مِنْ نَارٍ أَوْ شِرَاكَانِ مِنْ نَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an thawri bni zaydin aldduualiyyi, 'an saalimin aabiy alghaythi, mawlaa abni mutiy'in 'an aabiy hurayraaa, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, - wahadhaa hadiythuhu - haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - 'an thawrin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kharajnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa khaybara fafataha alllahu 'alaynaa falam naghnam dhahabana walaa wariqana ghanimnaa almataa'a waaltta'aama waalthhiyaaba thumma antalaqnaa iilaa alwaadiy wama'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'abdun lahu wahabahu lahu rajulun min judhaamin yud'aa rifaa'aaa bna zaydin min baniy alddubaybi falammaa nazalnaa alwaadiya qaama 'abdu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yahullu rahlahu farumiya bisahmin fakaana fiyhi hatfuhu faqulnaa haniyiana lahu alshhahaadaau yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kalaaa waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi iinna alshhamlaaa lataltahibu 'alayhi naarana aakhadhahaa mina alghanaaiimi yawma khaybara lam tusibhaa almaqaasimu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fafazi'a alnnaasu ‏.‏ fajaa'a rajulun bishiraakin aaw shiraakayni ‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aasabtu yawma khaybara ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ shiraakun min naarin aaw shiraakaani min naarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira:We went to Khaibar along with the Apostle (ﷺ) and Allah granted us victory. We plundered neither gold nor silver but laid our hands on goods, corn and clothes, and then bent our stops to a valley; along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) there was a slave who was presented to him by one Rifa'a b. Zaid of the family of Judham, a tribe of Dubayb. When we got down into the valley the slave of the Messenger of Allah stood up and began to unpack the saddle-bag and was suddenly struck by a (stray) arrow which proved fatal. We said: There is a greeting for him, Messenger of Allah, as he is a martyr. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: Nay, not so. By Him in Whose hand is the life of Muhammad, the small garment which he stole from the booty on the day of Khaibar but which did not (legitimately) fall to his lot is burning like the Fire (of Hell) on him. The people were greatly perturbed (on hearing this). A person came there with a lace or two laces and said: Messenger of Allah, I found (them) on the day of Khaibar. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: This is a lace of fire or two laces of fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ الطُّفَيْلَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو الدَّوْسِيَّ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ لَكَ فِي حِصْنٍ حَصِينٍ وَمَنَعَةٍ - قَالَ حِصْنٌ كَانَ لِدَوْسٍ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ - فَأَبَى ذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلَّذِي ذَخَرَ اللَّهُ لِلأَنْصَارِ فَلَمَّا هَاجَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ الطُّفَيْلُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو وَهَاجَرَ مَعَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ فَاجْتَوَوُا الْمَدِينَةَ فَمَرِضَ فَجَزِعَ فَأَخَذَ مَشَاقِصَ لَهُ فَقَطَعَ بِهَا بَرَاجِمَهُ فَشَخَبَتْ يَدَاهُ حَتَّى مَاتَ فَرَآهُ الطُّفَيْلُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو فِي مَنَامِهِ فَرَآهُ وَهَيْئَتُهُ حَسَنَةٌ وَرَآهُ مُغَطِّيًا يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا صَنَعَ بِكَ رَبُّكَ فَقَالَ غَفَرَ لِي بِهِجْرَتِي إِلَى نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَا لِي أَرَاكَ مُغَطِّيًا يَدَيْكَ قَالَ قِيلَ لِي لَنْ نُصْلِحَ مِنْكَ مَا أَفْسَدْتَ ‏.‏ فَقَصَّهَا الطُّفَيْلُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ وَلِيَدَيْهِ فَاغْفِرْ ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an sulaymaana, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, - haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an hajjaajin alssawwaafi, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna alttufayla bna 'amrinw alddawsiyya, aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi hal laka fiy hisnin hasiynin wamana'aain - qaala hisnun kaana lidawsin fiy aljaahiliyyaai - faaabaa dhalika alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lilladhiy dhakhara alllahu lilaansaari falammaa haajara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa almadiynaai haajara iilayhi alttufaylu bnu 'amrinw wahaajara ma'ahu rajulun min qawmihi faajtawawua almadiynaaa famarida fajazi'a faaakhadha mashaaqisa lahu faqata'a bihaa baraajimahu fashakhabat yadaahu hattaa maata faraahu alttufaylu bnu 'amrinw fiy manaamihi faraahu wahayiatuhu hasanaaun waraahu mughattiyana yadayhi faqaala lahu maa sana'a bika rabbuka faqaala ghafara liy bihijratiy iilaa nabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala maa liy aaraaka mughattiyana yadayka qaala qiyla liy lan nusliha minka maa aafsadta ‏.‏ faqassahaa alttufaylu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma waliyadayhi faaghfir ‏"‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir that Tufail son of Amr al-Dausi came to the Apostle (ﷺ) and said:Do you need strong, fortified protection? The tribe of Daus had a fort in the pre-Islamic days. The Apostle (ﷺ) declined this offer, since it (the privilege of protecting the Holy Prophet) had already been reserved for the Ansar. When the Apostle (ﷺ) migrated to Medina, Tufail son of Amr also migrated to that place, and there also migrated along with him a man of his tribe. But the climate of Medina did not suit him, and he fell sick. He felt very uneasy. So he took hold of an iron head of an arrow and cut his finger-joints. The blood streamed forth from his hands, till he died. Tufail son of Amr saw him in a dream. His state was good and he saw him with his hands wrapped. He (Tufail) said to him: What treatment did your Allah accord to you? He replied. Allah granted me pardon for my migration to the Apostle (ﷺ): He (Tufail) again said: What is this that I see you wrapping up your hands? He replied: I was told (by Allah): We would not set right anything of yours which you damaged yourself. Tufail narrated this (dream) to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Upon this he prayed: O Allah I grant pardon even to his hands
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَأَبُو عَلْقَمَةَ الْفَرْوِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ رِيحًا مِنَ الْيَمَنِ أَلْيَنَ مِنَ الْحَرِيرِ فَلاَ تَدَعُ أَحَدًا فِي قَلْبِهِ - قَالَ أَبُو عَلْقَمَةَ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ - مِنْ إِيمَانٍ إِلاَّ قَبَضَتْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdaaa alddabbiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, waaabuw 'alqamaaa alfarwiyyu qaalaa haddathanaa safwaanu bnu sulaymin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni salmaana, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha yab'athu riyhana mina alyamani aalyana mina alhariyri falaa tada'u aahadana fiy qalbihi - qaala aabuw 'alqamaaa mithqaalu habbaain waqaala 'abdu al'aziyzi mithqaalu dharraain - min iiymaanin iilaaa qabadathu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Verily Allah would make a wind to blow from the side of the Yemen more delicate than silk and would spare none but cause him to die who, in the words of Abu 'Alqama, has faith equal to the weight of a grain; while Abdul-'Aziz said: having faith equal to the weight of a dust particle
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَادِرُوا بِالأَعْمَالِ فِتَنًا كَقِطَعِ اللَّيْلِ الْمُظْلِمِ يُصْبِحُ الرَّجُلُ مُؤْمِنًا وَيُمْسِي كَافِرًا أَوْ يُمْسِي مُؤْمِنًا وَيُصْبِحُ كَافِرًا يَبِيعُ دِينَهُ بِعَرَضٍ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin jamiy'ana 'an iismaa'iyla bni ja'farin, - qaala abnu aayyuwba haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - qaala aakhbaraniy al'alaa'u, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ baadiruwa bialaa'maali fitanana kaqita'i alllayli almuzlimi yusbihu alrrajulu muuminana wayumsiy kaafirana aaw yumsiy muuminana wayusbihu kaafirana yabiy'u diynahu bi'aradin mina alddunyaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:Be prompt in doing good deeds (before you are overtaken) by turbulence which would be like a part of the dark night. During (that stormy period) a man would be a Muslim in the morning and an unbeliever in the evening or he would be a believer in the evening and an unbeliever in the morning, and would sell his faith for worldly goods
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ جَلَسَ ثَابِتُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَقَالَ أَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏.‏ وَاحْتَبَسَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَعْدَ بْنَ مُعَاذٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا عَمْرٍو مَا شَأْنُ ثَابِتٍ أَشْتَكَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعْدٌ إِنَّهُ لَجَارِي وَمَا عَلِمْتُ لَهُ بِشَكْوَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَاهُ سَعْدٌ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ثَابِتٌ أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ أَنِّي مِنْ أَرْفَعِكُمْ صَوْتًا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ سَعْدٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَلْ هُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qaala lammaa nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa laa tarfa'uwa aaswaatakum fawqa sawti alnnabiyyi‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai jalasa thaabitu bnu qaysin fiy baytihi waqaala aanaa min aahli alnnaari ‏.‏ waahtabasa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm sa'da bna mu'aadhin faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa 'amrinw maa shaanu thaabitin aashtakaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sa'dun iinnahu lajaariy wamaa 'alimtu lahu bishakwaa ‏.‏ qaala faaataahu sa'dun fadhakara lahu qawla rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala thaabitun aunzilat hadhihi alayaau walaqad 'alimtum aanniy min aarfa'ikum sawtana 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaanaa min aahli alnnaari ‏.‏ fadhakara dhalika sa'dun lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bal huwa min aahli aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that when this verse:" O ye who believe I raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout loud unto him in discourse, as ye shout loud unto one another, lest your deeds should become null and void, while you perceive not" (xlix. 2-5), was revealed. Thabit b. Qais confined himself in his house and said: I am one of the denizens of Fire, and he deliberately avoided coming to the Apostle (ﷺ). The Apostle (ﷺ) asked Sa'd b, Mu'adh about him and said, Abu Amr, how is Thabit? Has he fallen sick? Sa'd said: He is my neighbour, but I do not know of his illness. Sa'd came to him (Thabit), and conveyed to him the message of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Upon this Thabit said: This verse was revealed, and you are well aware of the fact that, amongst all of you, mine is the voice louder than that of the Messenger of Allah, and so I am one amongst the denizens of Fire, Sa'd Informed the Prophet about it. Upon this the Messenger of Allah observed: (Nay, not so) but he (Thabit) is one of the dwellers of Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قَطَنُ بْنُ نُسَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ ثَابِتُ بْنُ قَيْسِ بْنِ شَمَّاسٍ خَطِيبَ الأَنْصَارِ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ذِكْرُ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ ‏.‏
