verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنْ وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلاَنِ يَخْتَصِمَانِ فِي أَرْضٍ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا إِنَّ هَذَا انْتَزَى عَلَى أَرْضِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ - وَهُوَ امْرُؤُ الْقَيْسِ بْنُ عَابِسٍ الْكِنْدِيُّ وَخَصْمُهُ رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ عِبْدَانَ - قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيِّنَتُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَيْسَ لِي بَيِّنَةٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَمِينُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِذًا يَذْهَبُ بِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ لَكَ إِلاَّ ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَامَ لِيَحْلِفَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنِ اقْتَطَعَ أَرْضًا ظَالِمًا لَقِيَ اللَّهَ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ غَضْبَانُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ عَيْدَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy alwaliydi, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'abdi almaliki, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an 'alqamaaa bni waaiilin, 'an waaiili bni hujrin, qaala kuntu 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataahu rajulaani yakhtasimaani fiy aardin faqaala aahaduhumaa iinna hadhaa antazaa 'alaa aardiy yaa rasuwla alllahi fiy aljaahiliyyaai - wahuwa amruuu alqaysi bnu 'aabisin alkindiyyu wakhasmuhu rabiy'aau bnu 'ibdaana - qaala ‏"‏ bayyinatuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laysa liy bayyinaaun ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yamiynuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala iidhana yadhhabu bihaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laysa laka iilaaa dhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala falammaa qaama liyahlifa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ mani aqtata'a aardana zaalimana laqiya alllaha wahuwa 'alayhi ghadbaanu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala iishaaqu fiy riwaayatihi rabiy'aau bnu 'aydaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Wa'il reported it on the authority of his father Hujr:I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that two men came there disputing over a piece of land. One of them said: Messenger of Allah, this man appropriated my land without justification in the days of ignorance. The (claimant) was Imru'l-Qais b. 'Abis al-Kindi and his opponent was Rabi'a b. 'Iban He (the Holy Prophet) said (to the claimant): Have you evidence (to substantiate your claim)? He replied: I have no evidence. Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) remarked: Then his (that is of the defendant) is the oath. He (the claimant) said: In this case he (the defendant) would appropriate this (the property). He (the Holy Prophet) said: There is than no other way left for you but this. He (the narrator) said: When he (the defendant) stood up to take oath, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who appropriated the land wrongfully would meet Allah in a state that He would be angry with him. Ishaq in his narration mentions Rabi'a b. 'Aidan (instead of Rabi'a b. 'Ibdan)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَخْلَدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَخْذَ مَالِي قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ تُعْطِهِ مَالَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ قَاتَلَنِي قَالَ ‏"‏ قَاتِلْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ قَتَلَنِي قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَنْتَ شَهِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ قَتَلْتُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna makhladin - haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, 'ani al'alaa'i bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta iin jaa'a rajulun yuriydu aakhdha maaliy qaala ‏"‏ falaa tu'tihi maalaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aaraaayta iin qaatalaniy qaala ‏"‏ qaatilhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aaraaayta iin qatalaniy qaala ‏"‏ faaanta shahiydun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aaraaayta iin qataltuhu qaala ‏"‏ huwa fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, what do you think if a man comes to me in order to appropriate my possession? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Don't surrender your possession to him. He (the inquirer) said: If he fights me? He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: Then fight (with him). He (the inquirer) again said: What do you think if I am killed? He (the Holy Prophet) observed: You would be a martyr. He (the inquirer) said: What do you think of him (Messenger of Allah) If I kill him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: he would be in the Fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ الأَحْوَلُ، أَنَّ ثَابِتًا، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، لَمَّا كَانَ بَيْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَبَيْنَ عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ مَا كَانَ تَيَسَّرُوا لِلْقِتَالِ فَرَكِبَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْعَاصِ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فَوَعَظَهُ خَالِدٌ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, - waaalfaazuhum mutaqaaribaaun - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy sulaymaanu alaahwalu, aanna thaabitana, mawlaa 'umara bni 'abdi alrrahmani aakhbarahu aannahu, lammaa kaana bayna 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw wabayna 'anbasaaa bni aabiy sufyaana maa kaana tayassaruwa lilqitaali farakiba khaalidu bnu al'aasi iilaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw fawa'azahu khaalidun faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amrinw aamaa 'alimta aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man qutila duwna maalihi fahuwa shahiydun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Thabit, that when 'Abdullah b. 'Amr and 'Anbasa b. Abi Sufyan were about to fight against each other, Khalid b. 'As rode to 'Abdullah b. 'Amr and persuaded him (not to do so). Upon this Abdullah b. 'Amr said:Are you not aware that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had observed:" He who died in protecting his property is a martyr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, h wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, kilaahumaa 'ani abni jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Muhammad b. Hatim, Muhammad b. Bakr, Ahmad b. 'Uthman Naufali, Abu 'Asim, Ibn Juraij
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَشْهَبِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ عَادَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ مَعْقِلَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ الْمُزَنِيَّ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَعْقِلٌ إِنِّي مُحَدِّثُكَ حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَوْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ لِي حَيَاةً مَا حَدَّثْتُكَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَسْتَرْعِيهِ اللَّهُ رَعِيَّةً يَمُوتُ يَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَهُوَ غَاشٌّ لِرَعِيَّتِهِ إِلاَّ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa aabuw alaashhabi, 'ani alhasani, qaala 'aada 'ubaydu alllahi bnu ziyaadin ma'qila bna yasaarin almuzaniyya fiy maradihi alladhiy maata fiyhi ‏.‏ qaala ma'qilun iinniy muhaddithuka hadiythana sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm law 'alimtu aanna liy hayaaaan maa haddathtuka iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ maa min 'abdin yastar'iyhi alllahu ra'iyyaaan yamuwtu yawma yamuwtu wahuwa ghaashhun lira'iyyatihi iilaaa harrama alllahu 'alayhi aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hasan reported:'Ubaidullah b. Ziyad paid a visit to Ma'qil b. Yasar Muzani in his illness of which he (later on) died. (At this juncture) Ma'qil said: I am going to narrate to you a hadith which I have heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and which I would not have transmitted if I knew that I would survive. Verily I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: There is none amongst the bondsmen who was entrusted with the affairs of his subjects and he died in such a state that he was dishonest in his dealings with those over whom he ruled that the Paradise is not forbidden for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ دَخَلَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَلَى مَعْقِلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَهُوَ وَجِعٌ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي مُحَدِّثُكَ حَدِيثًا لَمْ أَكُنْ حَدَّثْتُكَهُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَسْتَرْعِي اللَّهُ عَبْدًا رَعِيَّةً يَمُوتُ حِينَ يَمُوتُ وَهُوَ غَاشٌّ لَهَا إِلاَّ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلاَّ كُنْتَ حَدَّثْتَنِي هَذَا قَبْلَ الْيَوْمِ قَالَ مَا حَدَّثْتُكَ أَوْ لَمْ أَكُنْ لأُحَدِّثَكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alhasani, qaala dakhala 'ubaydu alllahi bnu ziyaadin 'alaa ma'qili bni yasaarin wahuwa waji'un fasaaalahu faqaala iinniy muhaddithuka hadiythana lam aakun haddathtukahu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yastar'iy alllahu 'abdana ra'iyyaaan yamuwtu hiyna yamuwtu wahuwa ghaashhun lahaa iilaaa harrama alllahu 'alayhi aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aalaaa kunta haddathtaniy hadhaa qabla alyawmi qaala maa haddathtuka aaw lam aakun lauhaddithaka ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hasan reported:Ubaidullah b. Ziyad went to see Ma'qil b. Yasir and he was ailing. He ('Ubaidullah) inquired (about his health) to which he (Ma'qil) replied: I am narrating to you a hadith which I avoided narrating to you (before). Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Allah does not entrust to his bondsman the responsibility of managing the affairs of his subjects and he dies as a dishonest (ruler) but Paradise is forbidden by Allah for such a (ruler). He (Ibn Ziyad) said: Why did you not narrate it to me before this day? He replied: I (in fact) did not narrate it to you as it was not (fit) for me to narrate that to you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ، - يَعْنِي الْجُعْفِيَّ - عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ كُنَّا عِنْدَ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ نَعُودُهُ فَجَاءَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَعْقِلٌ إِنِّي سَأُحَدِّثُكَ حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa husaynun, - ya'niy alju'fiyya - 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an hishaamin, qaala qaala alhasanu kunnaa 'inda ma'qili bni yasaarin na'uwduhu fajaa'a 'ubaydu alllahi bnu ziyaadin faqaala lahu ma'qilun iinniy saauhaddithuka hadiythana sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma dhakara bima'naa hadiythihimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hasan reported:We were with Ma'qil b. Yasar inquiring about his health that Ubaidullah b. Ziyad came there. Ma'qil said to him: Verily I am going to narrate to you a hadith which I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Then he narrated the hadith like those two (mentioned above)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زِيَادٍ، عَادَ مَعْقِلَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ فِي مَرَضِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَعْقِلٌ إِنِّي مُحَدِّثُكَ بِحَدِيثٍ لَوْلاَ أَنِّي فِي الْمَوْتِ لَمْ أُحَدِّثْكَ بِهِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ أَمِيرٍ يَلِي أَمْرَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ثُمَّ لاَ يَجْهَدُ لَهُمْ وَيَنْصَحُ إِلاَّ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ مَعَهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy almaliyhi, aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna ziyaadin, 'aada ma'qila bna yasaarin fiy maradihi faqaala lahu ma'qilun iinniy muhaddithuka bihadiythin lawlaa aanniy fiy almawti lam auhaddithka bihi sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ maa min aamiyrin yaliy aamra almuslimiyna thumma laa yajhadu lahum wayansahu iilaaa lam yadkhul ma'ahumu aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Malih that Ubaidullah b. Ziyad visited Ma'qil b. Yasar in his illness. Ma'qil said to him:I am narrating to you a hadith which I would have never narrated to you had I not been in death-bed. I heard Allah's apostle (ﷺ) say: A ruler who has been entrusted with the affairs of the Muslims but he makes no endeavors ( for the material and moral uplift) and does not sincerely mean (their welfare) would not enter Paradise along with them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدِيثَيْنِ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَهُمَا وَأَنَا أَنْتَظِرُ الآخَرَ حَدَّثَنَا ‏"‏ أَنَّ الأَمَانَةَ نَزَلَتْ فِي جِذْرِ قُلُوبِ الرِّجَالِ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ فَعَلِمُوا مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ وَعَلِمُوا مِنَ السُّنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ رَفْعِ الأَمَانَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَنَامُ الرَّجُلُ النَّوْمَةَ فَتُقْبَضُ الأَمَانَةُ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ فَيَظَلُّ أَثَرُهَا مِثْلَ الْوَكْتِ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ النَّوْمَةَ فَتُقْبَضُ الأَمَانَةُ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ فَيَظَلُّ أَثَرُهَا مِثْلَ الْمَجْلِ كَجَمْرٍ دَحْرَجْتَهُ عَلَى رِجْلِكَ فَنَفِطَ فَتَرَاهُ مُنْتَبِرًا وَلَيْسَ فِيهِ شَىْءٌ - ثُمَّ أَخَذَ حَصًى فَدَحْرَجَهُ عَلَى رِجْلِهِ - فَيُصْبِحُ النَّاسُ يَتَبَايَعُونَ لاَ يَكَادُ أَحَدٌ يُؤَدِّي الأَمَانَةَ حَتَّى يُقَالَ إِنَّ فِي بَنِي فُلاَنٍ رَجُلاً أَمِينًا ‏.‏ حَتَّى يُقَالَ لِلرَّجُلِ مَا أَجْلَدَهُ مَا أَظْرَفَهُ مَا أَعْقَلَهُ وَمَا فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَقَدْ أَتَى عَلَىَّ زَمَانٌ وَمَا أُبَالِي أَيَّكُمْ بَايَعْتُ لَئِنْ كَانَ مُسْلِمًا لَيَرُدَّنَّهُ عَلَىَّ دِينُهُ وَلَئِنْ كَانَ نَصْرَانِيًّا أَوْ يَهُودِيًّا لَيَرُدَّنَّهُ عَلَىَّ سَاعِيهِ وَأَمَّا الْيَوْمَ فَمَا كُنْتُ لأُبَايِعَ مِنْكُمْ إِلاَّ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, wawakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala haddathanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadiythayni qad raaaytu aahadahumaa waaanaa aantaziru alakhara haddathanaa ‏"‏ aanna alaamaanaaa nazalat fiy jidhri quluwbi alrrijaali thumma nazala alquranu fa'alimuwa mina alqurani wa'alimuwa mina alssunnaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma haddathanaa 'an raf'i alaamaanaai qaala ‏"‏ yanaamu alrrajulu alnnawmaaa fatuqbadu alaamaanaau min qalbihi fayazallu aatharuhaa mithla alwakti thumma yanaamu alnnawmaaa fatuqbadu alaamaanaau min qalbihi fayazallu aatharuhaa mithla almajli kajamrin dahrajtahu 'alaa rijlika fanafita fataraahu muntabirana walaysa fiyhi shaa'un - thumma aakhadha hasana fadahrajahu 'alaa rijlihi - fayusbihu alnnaasu yatabaaya'uwna laa yakaadu aahadun yuuaddiy alaamaanaaa hattaa yuqaala iinna fiy baniy fulaanin rajulaan aamiynana ‏.‏ hattaa yuqaala lilrrajuli maa aajladahu maa aazrafahu maa aa'qalahu wamaa fiy qalbihi mithqaalu habbaain min khardalin min iiymaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaqad aataa 'alaaaa zamaanun wamaa aubaaliy aayyakum baaya'tu laiin kaana muslimana layaruddannahu 'alaaaa diynuhu walaiin kaana nasraaniyyana aaw yahuwdiyyana layaruddannahu 'alaaaa saa'iyhi waaammaa alyawma famaa kuntu laubaayi'a minkum iilaaa fulaanana wafulaanana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) narrated to us two ahadith. I have seen one (crystallized into reality), and I am waiting for the other. He told us: Trustworthiness descended in the innermost (root) of the hearts of people. Then the Qur'an was revealed and they learnt from the Qur'an and they learnt from the Sunnah. Then he (the Holy Prophet) told us about the removal of trustworthiness. He said: The man would have a wink of sleep and trustworthiness would be taken away from his heart leaving the impression of a faint mark. He would again sleep and trustworthiness would be taken away from his heart leaving an impression of a blister, as if you rolled down an ember on your foot and it was vesicled. He would see a swelling having nothing in it. He (the Holy Prophet) then took up a pebble and rolled it down over his foot and (said): The people would enter into transactions amongst one another and hardly a person would be left who would return (things) entrusted to him. (And there would be so much paucity of honest persons) till it would be said: There in such a such tribe is a trustworthy man. And they would also say about a person: How prudent he is, how broad-minded he is and how intelligent he is, whereas in his heart there would not be faith even to the weight of a mustard seed. I have passed through a time in which I did not care with whom amongst you I entered into a transaction, for if he were a Muslim his faith would compel him to discharge his obligations to me and it he were a Christian or a Jew, the ruler would compel him to discharge his obligations to me. But today I would not enter into a transaction with you except so and so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَوَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy wawakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, jamiy'ana 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by another chain of transmitters:Ibn Numair, Waki', Ishaq b. Ibrahim, 'Isa b. Yunus on the authority of A'mash
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ، - يَعْنِي سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ حَيَّانَ - عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ طَارِقٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ أَيُّكُمْ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَذْكُرُ الْفِتَنَ فَقَالَ قَوْمٌ نَحْنُ سَمِعْنَاهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْنُونَ فِتْنَةَ الرَّجُلِ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَجَارِهِ قَالُوا أَجَلْ ‏.‏ قَالَ تِلْكَ تُكَفِّرُهَا الصَّلاَةُ وَالصِّيَامُ وَالصَّدَقَةُ وَلَكِنْ أَيُّكُمْ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَذْكُرُ الْفِتَنَ الَّتِي تَمُوجُ مَوْجَ الْبَحْرِ قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ فَأَسْكَتَ الْقَوْمُ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنْتَ لِلَّهِ أَبُوكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تُعْرَضُ الْفِتَنُ عَلَى الْقُلُوبِ كَالْحَصِيرِ عُودًا عُودًا فَأَىُّ قَلْبٍ أُشْرِبَهَا نُكِتَ فِيهِ نُكْتَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ وَأَىُّ قَلْبٍ أَنْكَرَهَا نُكِتَ فِيهِ نُكْتَةٌ بَيْضَاءُ حَتَّى تَصِيرَ عَلَى قَلْبَيْنِ عَلَى أَبْيَضَ مِثْلِ الصَّفَا فَلاَ تَضُرُّهُ فِتْنَةٌ مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَوَاتُ وَالأَرْضُ وَالآخَرُ أَسْوَدُ مُرْبَادًّا كَالْكُوزِ مُجَخِّيًا لاَ يَعْرِفُ مَعْرُوفًا وَلاَ يُنْكِرُ مُنْكَرًا إِلاَّ مَا أُشْرِبَ مِنْ هَوَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ وَحَدَّثْتُهُ أَنَّ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهَا بَابًا مُغْلَقًا يُوشِكُ أَنْ يُكْسَرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ أَكَسْرًا لاَ أَبَا لَكَ فَلَوْ أَنَّهُ فُتِحَ لَعَلَّهُ كَانَ يُعَادُ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ بَلْ يُكْسَرُ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثْتُهُ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ الْبَابَ رَجُلٌ يُقْتَلُ أَوْ يَمُوتُ ‏.‏ حَدِيثًا لَيْسَ بِالأَغَالِيطِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو خَالِدٍ فَقُلْتُ لِسَعْدٍ يَا أَبَا مَالِكٍ مَا أَسْوَدُ مُرْبَادًّا قَالَ شِدَّةُ الْبَيَاضِ فِي سَوَادٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَمَا الْكُوزُ مُجَخِّيًا قَالَ مَنْكُوسًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin, - ya'niy sulaymaana bna hayyaana - 'an sa'di bni taariqin, 'an rib'iyyin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala kunnaa 'inda 'umara faqaala aayyukum sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadhkuru alfitana faqaala qawmun nahnu sami'naahu ‏.‏ faqaala la'allakum ta'nuwna fitnaaa alrrajuli fiy aahlihi wajaarihi qaaluwa aajal ‏.‏ qaala tilka tukaffiruhaa alssalaaau waalssiyaamu waalssadaqaau walakin aayyukum sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yadhkuru alfitana allatiy tamuwju mawja albahri qaala hudhayfaau faaaskata alqawmu faqultu aanaa ‏.‏ qaala aanta lillahi aabuwka ‏.‏ qaala hudhayfaau sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ tu'radu alfitanu 'alaa alquluwbi kaalhasiyri 'uwdana 'uwdana faaaaau qalbin aushribahaa nukita fiyhi nuktaaun sawdaa'u waaaaau qalbin aankarahaa nukita fiyhi nuktaaun baydaa'u hattaa tasiyra 'alaa qalbayni 'alaa aabyada mithli alssafaa falaa tadurruhu fitnaaun maa daamati alssamawaatu waalaardu waalakharu aaswadu murbaaddana kaalkuwzi mujakhhiyana laa ya'rifu ma'ruwfana walaa yunkiru munkarana iilaaa maa aushriba min hawaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala hudhayfaau wahaddathtuhu aanna baynaka wabaynahaa baabana mughlaqana yuwshiku aan yuksara ‏.‏ qaala 'umaru aakasrana laa aabaa laka falaw aannahu futiha la'allahu kaana yu'aadu ‏.‏ qultu laa bal yuksaru ‏.‏ wahaddathtuhu aanna dhalika albaaba rajulun yuqtalu aaw yamuwtu ‏.‏ hadiythana laysa bialaaghaaliyti ‏.‏ qaala aabuw khaalidin faqultu lisa'din yaa aabaa maalikin maa aaswadu murbaaddana qaala shiddaau albayaadi fiy sawaadin ‏.‏ qaala qultu famaa alkuwzu mujakhhiyana qaala mankuwsana ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Hudhaifa:We were sitting in the company of Umar and he said: Who amongst you has heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) talking about the turmoil? Some people said: It is we who heard it. Upon this be remarked: Perhaps by turmoil you presume the unrest of man in regard to his household or neighbour, they replied: Yes. He ('Umar) observed: Such (an unrest) would be done away with by prayer, fasting and charity. But who amongst you has heard from the Apostle (ﷺ) describing that turmoil which would come like the wave of the ocean. Hudhaifa said: The people hushed into silence, I replied: It is I. He ('Umar) said: Ye, well, your father was also very pious. Hudhaifa said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may peace be, upon him ) observing: Temptations will be presented to men's hearts as reed mat is woven stick by stick and any heart which is impregnated by them will have a black mark put into it, but any heart which rejects them will have a white mark put in it. The result is that there will become two types of hearts: one white like a white stone which will not be harmed by any turmoil or temptation, so long as the heavens and the earth endure; and the other black and dust-coloured like a vessel which is upset, not recognizing what is good or rejecting what is abominable, but being impregnated with passion. Hudhaifa said: I narrated to him ('Umar): There is between you and that (turmoil) a closed door, but there is every likelihood of its being broken. 'Umar said: Would it be broken? You have, been rendered fatherless. Had it been opened, it would have been perhaps closed also. I said: No, it would be broken, and I narrated to him: Verily that door implies a person who would be killed or die. There is no mistake in this hadith. Abu Khalid narrated: I said to Sa'd, O Abu Malik, what do you mean by the term" Aswad Murbadda"? He replied: High degree of whiteness in blackness. I said: What is meant by" Alkoozu Mujakhiyyan"? He replied: A vessel turned upside down
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ الْفَزَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمَ حُذَيْفَةُ مِنْ عِنْدِ عُمَرَ جَلَسَ فَحَدَّثَنَا فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَمْسِ لَمَّا جَلَسْتُ إِلَيْهِ سَأَلَ أَصْحَابَهُ أَيُّكُمْ يَحْفَظُ قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْفِتَنِ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ تَفْسِيرَ أَبِي مَالِكٍ لِقَوْلِهِ ‏ "‏ مُرْبَادًّا مُجَخِّيًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa marwaanu alfazaariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw maalikin alaashja'iyyu, 'an rib'iyyin, qaala lammaa qadima hudhayfaau min 'indi 'umara jalasa fahaddathanaa faqaala iinna aamiyra almuuminiyna aamsi lammaa jalastu iilayhi saaala aashaabahu aayyukum yahfazu qawla rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alfitani wasaaqa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythi aabiy khaalidin walam yadhkur tafsiyra aabiy maalikin liqawlihi ‏ "‏ murbaaddana mujakhhiyana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Rib'i (b. Hirash). When Hudhaifa came from 'Umar he sat down to narrate to us and said:Verily yesterday when I was sitting with the Commander of the believers he asked his companions: When amongst you retains in his memory the utterance of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with regard to the turmoil? -and he cited the hadith like the hadith narrated on the authority of Abu Khalid, but he did not mention the exposition of his words (Murbaddan) and (Mujakhiyyan)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، وَعُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، قَالَ مَنْ يُحَدِّثُنَا أَوْ قَالَ أَيُّكُمْ يُحَدِّثُنَا - وَفِيهِمْ حُذَيْفَةُ - مَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْفِتْنَةِ قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ أَنَا ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ كَنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ حَدَّثْتُهُ حَدِيثًا لَيْسَ بِالأَغَالِيطِ وَقَالَ يَعْنِي أَنَّهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wa'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, wa'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, qaaluwa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, 'an nu'aymi bni aabiy hindin, 'an rib'iyyi bni hiraashin, 'an hudhayfaaa, aanna 'umara, qaala man yuhaddithunaa aaw qaala aayyukum yuhaddithunaa - wafiyhim hudhayfaau - maa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alfitnaai qaala hudhayfaau aanaa ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha kanahwi hadiythi aabiy maalikin 'an rib'iyyin waqaala fiy alhadiythi qaala hudhayfaau haddathtuhu hadiythana laysa bialaaghaaliyti waqaala ya'niy aannahu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is transmitted by Rib'i b. Hirash. who narrated it on the authority of Hudhaifa that verily 'Umar said:Who would narrate to us or who amongst you would narrate to us (and Hudhaifa was one amongst them) what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said about the turmoil? Hudhaifa said: I will, and recited the hadith like that transmitted by Abu Malik on the authority of Rib'i and he observed in connection with this hadith that Hudhaifa remarked: I am narrating to you a hadith and it has no mistake, and said: That it is transmitted from he Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مَرْوَانَ الْفَزَارِيِّ، قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ كَيْسَانَ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بَدَأَ الإِسْلاَمُ غَرِيبًا وَسَيَعُودُ كَمَا بَدَأَ غَرِيبًا فَطُوبَى لِلْغُرَبَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'an marwaana alfazaariyyi, qaala abnu 'abbaadin haddathanaa marwaanu, 'an yaziyda, - ya'niy abna kaysaana - 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ badaaa aliislaamu ghariybana wasaya'uwdu kamaa badaaa ghariybana fatuwbaa lilghurabaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Islam initiated as something strange, and it would revert to its (old position) of being strange. so good tidings for the stranger
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ الأَعْرَجُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعُمَرِيُّ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الإِسْلاَمَ بَدَأَ غَرِيبًا وَسَيَعُودُ غَرِيبًا كَمَا بَدَأَ وَهُوَ يَأْرِزُ بَيْنَ الْمَسْجِدَيْنِ كَمَا تَأْرِزُ الْحَيَّةُ فِي جُحْرِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, waalfadlu bnu sahlin alaa'raju, qaalaa haddathanaa shabaabaau bnu sawwaarin, haddathanaa 'aasimun, - wahuwa abnu muhammadin al'umariyyu - 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aliislaama badaaa ghariybana wasaya'uwdu ghariybana kamaa badaaa wahuwa yaarizu bayna almasjidayni kamaa taarizu alhayyaau fiy juhrihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:Verily Islam started as something strange and it would again revert (to its old position) of being strange just as it started, and it would recede between the two mosques just as the serpent crawls back into its hole
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الإِيمَانَ لَيَأْرِزُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ كَمَا تَأْرِزُ الْحَيَّةُ إِلَى جُحْرِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an khubaybi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aliiymaana layaarizu iilaa almadiynaai kamaa taarizu alhayyaau iilaa juhrihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Verily the faith would recede to Medina just as the serpent crawls back into its hole
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى لاَ يُقَالَ فِي الأَرْضِ اللَّهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa hammaadun, aakhbaranaa thaabitun, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa laa yuqaala fiy alaardi alllahu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"The Hour (Resurrection) will not occur until 'Allah, Allah' is not said on earth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau 'alaa aahadin yaquwlu alllahu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"The Hour (Resurrection) will not occur as long as anyone says: 'Allah, Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْصُوا لِي كَمْ يَلْفِظُ الإِسْلاَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَخَافُ عَلَيْنَا وَنَحْنُ مَا بَيْنَ السِّتِّمِائَةِ إِلَى السَّبْعِمِائَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ لاَ تَدْرُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ أَنْ تُبْتَلَوْا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَابْتُلِينَا حَتَّى جَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ مِنَّا لاَ يُصَلِّي إِلاَّ سِرًّا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy kuraybin - qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aahsuwa liy kam yalfizu aliislaama ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aatakhaafu 'alaynaa wanahnu maa bayna alssittimiaiaai iilaa alssab'imiaiaai qaala ‏"‏ iinnakum laa tadruwna la'allakum aan tubtalawa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faabtuliynaa hattaa ja'ala alrrajulu minnaa laa yusalliy iilaaa sirrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported:We were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he said. Count for me those who profess al-Islam. We said: Messenger of Allah, do you entertain any fear concerning us and we are (at this time) between six hundred and seven hundred (in strength). He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: You don't perceive; you may be put to some trial, He (the narrator) said: We actually suffered trial so much so that some of our men were constrained to offer their prayers in concealment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَسْمًا فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَعْطِ فُلاَنًا فَإِنَّهُ مُؤْمِنٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمٌ ‏"‏ أَقُولُهَا ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ وَيُرَدِّدُهَا عَلَىَّ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمٌ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لأُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ وَغَيْرُهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْهُ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يَكُبَّهُ اللَّهُ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qasama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qasmana faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aa'ti fulaanana faiinnahu muuminun ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaw muslimun ‏"‏ aaquwluhaa thalaathana ‏.‏ wayuraddiduhaa 'alaaaa thalaathana ‏"‏ aaw muslimun ‏"‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinniy lau'tiy alrrajula waghayruhu aahabbu iilaaaa minhu makhaafaaa aan yakubbahu alllahu fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd narrated it on the authority of his father (Abi Waqqas) that he observed:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) distributed shares (of booty among his Companions). I said: Messenger of Allah! Give it to so and so, for verily he is a believer. Upon this the Messenger of Allah remarked: Or a Muslim. I (the narrator) repeated it (the word" believer" ) thrice and he (the Holy Prophet) turned his back upon me (and substituted the word)" Muslim," and then observed: I bestow it (this share) to a man out of apprehension lest Allah should throw him prostrate into the fire (of Hell) whereas in fact the other man is dearer to me than he
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَعْدٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَى رَهْطًا وَسَعْدٌ جَالِسٌ فِيهِمْ قَالَ سَعْدٌ فَتَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ يُعْطِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْجَبُهُمْ إِلَىَّ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكَ عَنْ فُلاَنٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَاهُ مُؤْمِنًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَكَتُّ قَلِيلاً ثُمَّ غَلَبَنِي مَا أَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكَ عَنْ فُلاَنٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَاهُ مُؤْمِنًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَكَتُّ قَلِيلاً ثُمَّ غَلَبَنِي مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكَ عَنْ فُلاَنٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَاهُ مُؤْمِنًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمًا ‏.‏ إِنِّي لأُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ وَغَيْرُهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْهُ خَشْيَةَ أَنْ يُكَبَّ فِي النَّارِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa abnu aakhiy abni shihaabin, 'an 'ammihi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'aamiru bnu sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an aabiyhi, sa'din aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'taa rahtana wasa'dun jaalisun fiyhim qaala sa'dun fataraka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm minhum man lam yu'tihi wahuwa aa'jabuhum iilaaaa faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi maa laka 'an fulaanin fawaalllahi iinniy laaraahu muuminana ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaw muslimana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fasakattu qaliylaan thumma ghalabaniy maa aa'lamu minhu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi maa laka 'an fulaanin fawaalllahi iinniy laaraahu muuminana faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaw muslimana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fasakattu qaliylaan thumma ghalabaniy maa 'alimtu minhu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi maa laka 'an fulaanin fawaalllahi iinniy laaraahu muuminana ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaw muslimana ‏.‏ iinniy lau'tiy alrrajula waghayruhu aahabbu iilaaaa minhu khashyaaa aan yukabba fiy alnnaari 'alaa wajhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Sa'd that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bestowed upon a group of persons (things), and Sa'd was sitting amongst them. Sa'd said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ignored some of them. And he who was ignored seemed to be more deserving in my eyes (as compared with others). I (Sa'd) said: Messenger of Allah I why is it that you did not give to such and such (man)? Verily I see him a believer. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Or a Muslim? I kept quiet for some time but I was again impelled (to express) what I knew about him. I said: Messenger of Allah why is it that you did not give it to such and such? Verily, by Allah, see him a believer. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: (Nay, not a believer) but a Muslim. He (Sa'd) said: I again kept quite for some time but what I knew about him again impelled me (to express my opinion) and I said: Why is it that you did not give (the share) to so and so: By Allah, verily I see him a believer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked; (Nay, not so) but a Muslim. Verily (at times) I give (a share) to a certain man apprehending that he may not be thrown prostrate in the Fire, whereas the other man (who is not given) is dearer to me (as compared with him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَعْدٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَهْطًا وَأَنَا جَالِسٌ فِيهِمْ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَمِّهِ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَارَرْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ مَا لَكَ عَنْ فُلاَنٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'aamiru bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, sa'din aannahu qaala aa'taa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rahtana waaanaa jaalisun fiyhim ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni aakhiy abni shihaabin 'an 'ammihi ‏.‏ wazaada faqumtu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaarartuhu faqultu maa laka 'an fulaanin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) bestowed upon a group of persons (booty) and I was sitting with them. The remaining part of the hadith is the same as mentioned (above) with the additionI stood up and went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and whispered to him: Why did you omit such and such a man?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، يُحَدِّثُ هَذَا فَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ فَضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ بَيْنَ عُنُقِي وَكَتِفِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقِتَالاً أَىْ سَعْدُ إِنِّي لأُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alhasanu alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'an iismaa'iyla bni muhammadin, qaala sami'tu muhammada bna sa'din, yuhaddithu hadhaa faqaala fiy hadiythihi fadaraba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi bayna 'unuqiy wakatifiy thumma qaala ‏ "‏ aaqitaalaan aaa sa'du iinniy lau'tiy alrrajula ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muhammad b Sa'd and these words (are also there):The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave a stroke on my neck or between my two shoulders and said: Sa'd, do you fight with me simply because I gave (a share) to a man?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ نَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِالشَّكِّ مِنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ قَالَ ‏{‏ رَبِّ أَرِنِي كَيْفَ تُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى قَالَ أَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِنْ قَالَ بَلَى وَلَكِنْ لِيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِي‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ لُوطًا لَقَدْ كَانَ يَأْوِي إِلَى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ وَلَوْ لَبِثْتُ فِي السِّجْنِ طُولَ لَبْثِ يُوسُفَ لأَجَبْتُ الدَّاعِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, wasa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ nahnu aahaqqu bialshhakki min iibraahiyma sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh qaala ‏{‏ rabbi aariniy kayfa tuhyiy almawtaa qaala aawalam tuumin qaala balaa walakin liyatmaiinna qalbiy‏}‏ qaala ‏"‏ wayarhamu alllahu luwtana laqad kaana yaawiy iilaa ruknin shadiydin walaw labithtu fiy alssijni tuwla labthi yuwsufa laajabtu alddaa'iya ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:We have more claim to doubt than Ibrahim (ﷺ) when he said: My Lord! Show me how Thou wilt quicken the dead. He said: Believeth thou not? He said: Yes! But that my heart may rest at ease. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: May Lord take mercy on Lot, that he wanted a strong support, and had I stayed (in the prison) as long as Yusuf stayed, I would have responded to him who invited me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِ، إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ الضُّبَعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبَا، عُبَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏ "‏ وَلَكِنْ لِيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ حَتَّى جَازَهَا ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُوَيْسٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، كَرِوَايَةِ مَالِكٍ بِإِسْنَادِهِ وَقَالَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ حَتَّى أَنْجَزَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy bihi, iin shaa'a alllahu 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a aldduba'iyyu haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an maalikin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aanna sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, waaabaa, 'ubaydin aakhbaraahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa 'ani alzzuhriyyi wafiy hadiythi maalikin ‏ "‏ walakin liyatmaiinna qalbiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma qaraaa hadhihi alayaaa hattaa jaazahaa ‏.‏ haddathanaahu 'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala haddathaniy ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabuw auwaysin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, kariwaayaai maalikin biiisnaadihi waqaala thumma qaraaa hadhihi alayaaa hattaa aanjazahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Muhammad narrated the same hadith on the authority of Abu Huraira and in the transmission by Malik the words are that he (the Holy Prophet) recited the verse:" but that my heart may rest at ease" and completed it. This hadith has also been narrated by Abd b. Humaid Ya'qub, i. e. son of Ibrahim b. Sa'd, Abu Uwais, Zuhri, like the one narrated by Malik with the same chain of transmission and said: He recited this verse till he completed it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلاَّ قَدْ أُعْطِيَ مِنَ الآيَاتِ مَا مِثْلُهُ آمَنَ عَلَيْهِ الْبَشَرُ وَإِنَّمَا كَانَ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُ وَحْيًا أَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَىَّ فَأَرْجُو أَنْ أَكُونَ أَكْثَرَهُمْ تَابِعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa mina alaanbiyaa'i min nabiyyin iilaaa qad au'tiya mina alayaati maa mithluhu amana 'alayhi albasharu waiinnamaa kaana alladhiy auwtiytu wahyana aawhaa alllahu iilaaaa faaarjuw aan aakuwna aaktharahum taabi'ana yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:There has never been a Prophet amongst the prophets who was not bestowed with a sign amongst the signs which were bestowed (on the earlier prophets). Human beings believed in it and verily I have been conferred upon revelation (the Holy Qur'an) which Allah revealed to me. I hope that I will have the greatest following on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ أَبَا يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لاَ يَسْمَعُ بِي أَحَدٌ مِنْ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ يَهُودِيٌّ وَلاَ نَصْرَانِيٌّ ثُمَّ يَمُوتُ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنْ بِالَّذِي أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ إِلاَّ كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala waaakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna aabaa yuwnusa, haddathahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi laa yasma'u biy aahadun min hadhihi alaummaai yahuwdiyyun walaa nasraaniyyun thumma yamuwtu walam yuumin bialladhiy aursiltu bihi iilaaa kaana min aashaabi alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:By Him in Whose hand is the life of Muhammad, he who amongst the community of Jews or Christians hears about me, but does not affirm his belief in that with which I have been sent and dies in this state (of disbelief), he shall be but one of the denizens of Hell-Fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَهْلِ خُرَاسَانَ سَأَلَ الشَّعْبِيَّ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَمْرٍو إِنَّ مَنْ قِبَلَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ خُرَاسَانَ يَقُولُونَ فِي الرَّجُلِ إِذَا أَعْتَقَ أَمَتَهُ ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا فَهُوَ كَالرَّاكِبِ بَدَنَتَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثَةٌ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُمْ مَرَّتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ آمَنَ بِنَبِيِّهِ وَأَدْرَكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَآمَنَ بِهِ وَاتَّبَعَهُ وَصَدَّقَهُ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ وَعَبْدٌ مَمْلُوكٌ أَدَّى حَقَّ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَحَقَّ سَيِّدِهِ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ وَرَجُلٌ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَمَةٌ فَغَذَاهَا فَأَحْسَنَ غِذَاءَهَا ثُمَّ أَدَّبَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ أَدَبَهَا ثُمَّ أَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ لِلْخُرَاسَانِيِّ خُذْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ بِغَيْرِ شَىْءٍ ‏.‏ فَقَدْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ يَرْحَلُ فِيمَا دُونَ هَذَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an saalihi bni saalihin alhamdaaniyyi, 'ani alshha'biyyi, qaala raaaytu rajulaan min aahli khuraasaana saaala alshha'biyya faqaala yaa aabaa 'amrinw iinna man qibalanaa min aahli khuraasaana yaquwluwna fiy alrrajuli iidhaa aa'taqa aamatahu thumma tazawwajahaa fahuwa kaalrraakibi badanatahu ‏.‏ faqaala alshha'biyyu haddathaniy aabuw burdaaa bnu aabiy muwsaa 'an aabiyhi aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ thalaathaaun yuutawna aajrahum marratayni rajulun min aahli alkitaabi amana binabiyyihi waaadraka alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faamana bihi waattaba'ahu wasaddaqahu falahu aajraani wa'abdun mamluwkun aaddaa haqqa alllahi ta'aalaa wahaqqa sayyidihi falahu aajraani warajulun kaanat lahu aamaaun faghadhaahaa faaahsana ghidhaa'ahaa thumma aaddabahaa faaahsana aadabahaa thumma aa'taqahaa watazawwajahaa falahu aajraani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala alshha'biyyu lilkhuraasaaniyyi khudh hadhaa alhadiytha bighayri shaa'in ‏.‏ faqad kaana alrrajulu yarhalu fiymaa duwna hadhaa iilaa almadiynaai ‏.‏ wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, kulluhum 'an saalihi bni saalihin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Sha'bi that one among the citizens of Khurasan asked him:0 Abu! some of the people amongst us who belong to Khurasan say that a person who freed his bondswoman and then married her is like one who rode over a sacrificial animal. Sha'bi said: Abu Burda b. Abi Musa narrated it to me on the authority of his father that verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There are three (classes of persons) who would be given a double reward. One who is amongst the People of the Book and believed in his apostle and (lived) to see the time of Apostle Muhammad (ﷺ) and affirmed his faith in him and followed him and attested his truth, for him is the double reward; and the slave of the master who discharges all those obligations that he owes to Allah and discharges his duties that he owes to his master, for him there is a double reward. And a man who had a bondswoman and fed her and fed her well, then taught her good manners, and did that well and later on granted her freedom and married her, for him is the double reward. Then Sha'bi said: Accept this hadith without (giving) anything. Formerly a man was (obliged) to travel to Medina even for a smaller hadith than this. This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters like Abu Bakr b. Abi Shaiba, 'Abda b. Sulaiman Ibn Abi 'Umar Sufyan, 'Ubaidullah b. Mu'adh, Shu'ba; all of them heard it from Salih b. Salih
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَيُوشِكَنَّ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ فِيكُمُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَكَمًا مُقْسِطًا فَيَكْسِرَ الصَّلِيبَ وَيَقْتُلَ الْخِنْزِيرَ وَيَضَعَ الْجِزْيَةَ وَيَفِيضَ الْمَالُ حَتَّى لاَ يَقْبَلَهُ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani abni almusayyabi, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi layuwshikanna aan yanzila fiykumu abnu maryama sla allh 'lyh wslm hakamana muqsitana fayaksira alssaliyba wayaqtula alkhinziyra wayada'a aljizyaaa wayafiyda almaalu hattaa laa yaqbalahu aahadun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:By Him in Whose hand is my life, the son of Mary (ﷺ) will soon descend among you as a just judge. He will break crosses, kill swine and abolish Jizya and the wealth will pour forth to such an extent that no one will accept it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏"‏ إِمَامًا مُقْسِطًا وَحَكَمًا عَدْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ يُونُسَ ‏"‏ حَكَمًا عَادِلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏"‏ إِمَامًا مُقْسِطًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ صَالِحٍ ‏"‏ حَكَمًا مُقْسِطًا ‏"‏ كَمَا قَالَ اللَّيْثُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِ مِنَ الزِّيَادَةِ ‏"‏ وَحَتَّى تَكُونَ السَّجْدَةُ الْوَاحِدَةُ خَيْرًا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏ وَإِنْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ إِلاَّ لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهِ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ‏}‏ الآيَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathaniyhi harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala haddathaniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an ya'quwba bni iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy riwaayaai abni 'uyaynaaa ‏"‏ iimaamana muqsitana wahakamana 'adlaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai yuwnusa ‏"‏ hakamana 'aadilaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur ‏"‏ iimaamana muqsitana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi saalihin ‏"‏ hakamana muqsitana ‏"‏ kamaa qaala alllaythu ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihi mina alzziyaadaai ‏"‏ wahattaa takuwna alssajdaau alwaahidaau khayrana mina alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma yaquwlu aabuw hurayraaa aqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏ waiin min aahli alkitaabi iilaaa layuuminanna bihi qabla mawtihi‏}‏ alayaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith is transmitted from Zuhri with the same chain of transmission. But in the tradition narrated by Ibn 'Uyaina the words are:" impartial leader and just judge" and in the tradition narrated by Yunus: the" judge judging with justice" and" impartial leader" are not mentioned. And in the hadith narrated by Salih like the one transmitted by Laith the words are:" impartial judge". And in the hadith transmitted by Ziyad the words are:" Till one sajda is better than the worldand what it contains. Then Abu Huraira used to say," recite" if you like: Not one of the People of the Book will fail to believe in him before his death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ مِينَاءَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ لَيَنْزِلَنَّ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ حَكَمًا عَادِلاً فَلَيَكْسِرَنَّ الصَّلِيبَ وَلَيَقْتُلَنَّ الْخِنْزِيرَ وَلَيَضَعَنَّ الْجِزْيَةَ وَلَتُتْرَكَنَّ الْقِلاَصُ فَلاَ يُسْعَى عَلَيْهَا وَلَتَذْهَبَنَّ الشَّحْنَاءُ وَالتَّبَاغُضُ وَالتَّحَاسُدُ وَلَيَدْعُوَنَّ إِلَى الْمَالِ فَلاَ يَقْبَلُهُ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an 'ataa'i bni miynaa'a, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalllahi layanzilanna abnu maryama hakamana 'aadilaan falayaksiranna alssaliyba walayaqtulanna alkhinziyra walayada'anna aljizyaaa walatutrakanna alqilaasu falaa yus'aa 'alayhaa walatadhhabanna alshhahnaa'u waalttabaaghudu waalttahaasudu walayad'uwanna iilaa almaali falaa yaqbaluhu aahadun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger or Allah (ﷺ) observed:I swear by Allah that the son of Mary will certainly descend as a just judge and he would definitely break the cross, and kill swine and abolish Jizya and would leave the young she-camel and no one would endeavour to (collect Zakat on it). Spite, mutual hatred and jealousy against one another will certainly disappear and when he summons people to accept wealth, not even one would do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ إِذَا نَزَلَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ فِيكُمْ وَإِمَامُكُمْ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, mawlaa aabiy qataadaaa alaansaariyyi aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kayfa aantum iidhaa nazala abnu maryama fiykum waiimaamukum minkum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:What will be your state when the son of Mary descends amongst you and there will be an Imam amongst you?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ إِذَا نَزَلَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ فِيكُمْ وَأَمَّكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa abnu aakhiy abni shihaabin, 'an 'ammihi, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, mawlaa aabiy qataadaaa alaansaariyyi aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kayfa aantum iidhaa nazala abnu maryama fiykum waaammakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying:What would you do when the son of Mary would descend and lead you?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ إِذَا نَزَلَ فِيكُمُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ فَأَمَّكُمْ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ إِنَّ الأَوْزَاعِيَّ حَدَّثَنَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏"‏ وَإِمَامُكُمْ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ تَدْرِي مَا أَمَّكُمْ مِنْكُمْ قُلْتُ تُخْبِرُنِي ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَمَّكُمْ بِكِتَابِ رَبِّكُمْ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى وَسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathaniy alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an naafi'in, mawlaa aabiy qataadaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ kayfa aantum iidhaa nazala fiykumu abnu maryama faaammakum minkum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu laibni aabiy dhiibin iinna alaawzaa'iyya haddathanaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an naafi'in 'an aabiy hurayraaa ‏"‏ waiimaamukum minkum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy dhiibin tadriy maa aammakum minkum qultu tukhbiruniy ‏.‏ qaala faaammakum bikitaabi rabbikum tabaaraka wata'aalaa wasunnaai nabiyyikum sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:What would you do when the son of Mary would descend amongst you and would lead you as one amongst you? Ibn Abi Dhi'b on the authority of Abu Huraira narrated: Your leader amongst you. Ibn Abi Dhi'b said: Do you know what the words:" He would lead as one amongst you" mean? I said: Explain these to me. He said: He would lead you according to the Book of your: Lord (hallowed be He and most exalted) and the Sunnah of your Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي يُقَاتِلُونَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ ظَاهِرِينَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ - قَالَ - فَيَنْزِلُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَقُولُ أَمِيرُهُمْ تَعَالَ صَلِّ لَنَا ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لاَ ‏.‏ إِنَّ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ أُمَرَاءُ ‏.‏ تَكْرِمَةَ اللَّهِ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu shujaa'in, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, qaaluwa haddathanaa hajjaajun, - wahuwa abnu muhammadin - 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tazaalu taaiifaaun min aummatiy yuqaatiluwna 'alaa alhaqqi zaahiriyna iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai - qaala - fayanzilu 'iysaa abnu maryama sla allh 'lyh wslm fayaquwlu aamiyruhum ta'aala salli lanaa ‏.‏ fayaquwlu laa ‏.‏ iinna ba'dakum 'alaa ba'din aumaraa'u ‏.‏ takrimaaa alllahi hadhihi alaummaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A section of my people will not cease fighting for the Truth and will prevail till the Day of Resurrection. He said: Jesus son of Mary would then descend and their (Muslims') commander would invite him to come and lead them in prayer, but he would say: No, some amongst you are commanders over some (amongst you). This is the honour from Allah for this Ummah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا فَإِذَا طَلَعَتْ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا آمَنَ النَّاسُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لاَ يَنْفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِي إِيمَانِهَا خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa tatlu'a alshhamsu min maghribihaa faiidhaa tala'at min maghribihaa amana alnnaasu kulluhum aajma'uwna fayawmaiidhin laa yanfa'u nafsana iiymaanuhaa lam takun amanat min qablu aaw kasabat fiy iiymaanihaa khayrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:The (Last) Hour shall not came till the sun rises from the place of its setting And on the day when it rises from the place of its setting even if all the people together affirmed their faith, it would not be of any avail to one who did not believe previously and derived no good out of his belief
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin waaabuw kuraybin qaaluwa hadaathanaa abnu fudaylin, h wahadaathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, hadaathanaa jariyrun, kilaahumaa 'an 'umaaraaa bni alqa'qaa'i, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahadaathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, hadaathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyinn, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an 'abdi allaahi bni dhakwaana, 'an 'abdi alraahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu raafi'in, hadaathanaa 'abdu alraazaaaqi, hadaathanaa ma'marun, 'an hamaaami bni munabiihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi al'alaa'i 'an aabiyhi 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters, Abu Bakr b. Abi Shaiba, Ibn Numair, Abu Kuraib, Ibn Fudail. This hadith has also been narrated through several other chains on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْرَقُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ غَزْوَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثٌ إِذَا خَرَجْنَ لاَ يَنْفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِي إِيمَانِهَا خَيْرًا طُلُوعُ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا وَالدَّجَّالُ وَدَابَّةُ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu yuwsufa alaazraqu, jamiy'ana 'an fudayli bni ghazwaana, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ thalaathun iidhaa kharajna laa yanfa'u nafsana iiymaanuhaa lam takun amanat min qablu aaw kasabat fiy iiymaanihaa khayrana tuluw'u alshhamsi min maghribihaa waalddajjaalu wadaabbaau alaardi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:When three things appear faith will not benefit one who has not previously believed or has derived no good from his faith: the rising of the sun in its place of setting, the Dajjal, and the beast of the earth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ التَّيْمِيِّ، - سَمِعَهُ فِيمَا، أَعْلَمُ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمًا ‏"‏ أَتَدْرُونَ أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ هَذِهِ الشَّمْسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ تَجْرِي حَتَّى تَنْتَهِيَ إِلَى مُسْتَقَرِّهَا تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ فَتَخِرُّ سَاجِدَةً وَلاَ تَزَالُ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُقَالَ لَهَا ارْتَفِعِي ارْجِعِي مِنْ حَيْثُ جِئْتِ فَتَرْجِعُ فَتُصْبِحُ طَالِعَةً مِنْ مَطْلِعِهَا ثُمَّ تَجْرِي حَتَّى تَنْتَهِيَ إِلَى مُسْتَقَرِّهَا تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ فَتَخِرُّ سَاجِدَةً وَلاَ تَزَالُ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُقَالَ لَهَا ارْتَفِعِي ارْجِعِي مِنْ حَيْثُ جِئْتِ فَتَرْجِعُ فَتُصْبِحُ طَالِعَةً مِنْ مَطْلِعِهَا ثُمَّ تَجْرِي لاَ يَسْتَنْكِرُ النَّاسُ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا حَتَّى تَنْتَهِيَ إِلَى مُسْتَقَرِّهَا ذَاكَ تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ فَيُقَالُ لَهَا ارْتَفِعِي أَصْبِحِي طَالِعَةً مِنْ مَغْرِبِكِ فَتُصْبِحُ طَالِعَةً مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَدْرُونَ مَتَى ذَاكُمْ ذَاكَ حِينَ لاَ يَنْفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِي إِيمَانِهَا خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, - qaala abnu aayyuwba haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, - haddathanaa yuwnusu, 'an iibraahiyma bni yaziyda alttaymiyyi, - sami'ahu fiymaa, aa'lamu - 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy dharrin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala yawmana ‏"‏ aatadruwna aayna tadhhabu hadhihi alshhamsu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinna hadhihi tajriy hattaa tantahiya iilaa mustaqarrihaa tahta al'arshi fatakhirru saajidaaan walaa tazaalu kadhalika hattaa yuqaala lahaa artafi'iy arji'iy min haythu jiiti fatarji'u fatusbihu taali'aaan min matli'ihaa thumma tajriy hattaa tantahiya iilaa mustaqarrihaa tahta al'arshi fatakhirru saajidaaan walaa tazaalu kadhalika hattaa yuqaala lahaa artafi'iy arji'iy min haythu jiiti fatarji'u fatusbihu taali'aaan min matli'ihaa thumma tajriy laa yastankiru alnnaasu minhaa shayiana hattaa tantahiya iilaa mustaqarrihaa dhaaka tahta al'arshi fayuqaalu lahaa artafi'iy aasbihiy taali'aaan min maghribiki fatusbihu taali'aaan min maghribihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aatadruwna mataa dhaakum dhaaka hiyna laa yanfa'u nafsana iiymaanuhaa lam takun amanat min qablu aaw kasabat fiy iiymaanihaa khayrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one day said:Do you know where the sun goes? They replied: Allah and His Apostle know best. He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Verily it (the sun) glides till it reaches its resting place under the Throne. Then it falls prostrate and remains there until it is asked: Rise up and go to the place whence you came, and it goes back and continues emerging out from its rising place and then glides till it reaches its place of rest under the Throne and falls prostrate and remains in that state until it is asked: Rise up and return to the place whence you came, and it returns and emerges out from it rising place and the it glides (in such a normal way) that the people do not discern anything ( unusual in it) till it reaches its resting place under the Throne. Then it would be said to it: Rise up and emerge out from the place of your setting, and it will rise from the place of its setting. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. Do you know when it would happen? It would happen at the time when faith will not benefit one who has not previously believed or has derived no good from the faith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ - عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمًا ‏ "‏ أَتَدْرُونَ أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ هَذِهِ الشَّمْسُ ‏"‏ بِمِثْلِ مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alhamiydi bnu bayaanin alwaasitiyyu, aakhbaranaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alllahi - 'an yuwnusa, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy dharrin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala yawmana ‏ "‏ aatadruwna aayna tadhhabu hadhihi alshhamsu ‏"‏ bimithli ma'naa hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Dharr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one day said:Do you know where the sun goes? The remaining part of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسٌ فَلَمَّا غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ هَلْ تَدْرِي أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهَا تَذْهَبُ فَتَسْتَأْذِنُ فِي السُّجُودِ فَيُؤْذَنُ لَهَا وَكَأَنَّهَا قَدْ قِيلَ لَهَا ارْجِعِي مِنْ حَيْثُ جِئْتِ فَتَطْلُعُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ فِي قِرَاءَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَذَلِكَ مُسْتَقَرٌّ لَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy kuraybin - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala dakhaltu almasjida warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaalisun falammaa ghaabati alshhamsu qaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa dharrin hal tadriy aayna tadhhabu hadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinnahaa tadhhabu fatastaadhinu fiy alssujuwdi fayuudhanu lahaa wakaaannahaa qad qiyla lahaa arji'iy min haythu jiiti fatatlu'u min maghribihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma qaraaa fiy qiraa'aai 'abdi alllahi wadhalika mustaqarrun lahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported:I entered the mosque and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting there. When the sun disappeared (from the sight) he said: O Abu Dharr! Do you know where it goes? He (the narrator) said: Allah and His Apostle know best. He (the Holy Prophet) said. Verily it goes and begs permission, for prostration (to Allah) and the permission is granted to it. Once it would be said: Return to the place whence you came, and then it would rise from its setting place. Then he, after the recitation of 'Abdullah recited it: And that is its appointed term
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا - وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَهَا‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُسْتَقَرُّهَا تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alaashajju, haddathanaa - wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an qawli alllahi ta'aalaa ‏{‏ waalshhamsu tajriy limustaqarrin lahaa‏}‏ qaala ‏"‏ mustaqarruhaa tahta al'arshi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported:I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the (implication of the) words of Allah, the Exalted: The sun glides to its appointed resting place. He replied: Its appointed resting place is under the Throne
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ أَوَّلُ مَا بُدِئَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْوَحْىِ الرُّؤْيَا الصَّادِقَةَ فِي النَّوْمِ فَكَانَ لاَ يَرَى رُؤْيَا إِلاَّ جَاءَتْ مِثْلَ فَلَقِ الصُّبْحِ ثُمَّ حُبِّبَ إِلَيْهِ الْخَلاَءُ فَكَانَ يَخْلُو بِغَارِ حِرَاءٍ يَتَحَنَّثُ فِيهِ -
