verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي الْقَطَّانَ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ، كَلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، بِهَذَا مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa khaalidun ya'niy abna alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy alqattaana - kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, jamiy'ana 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, - ya'niy abna 'uthmaana - h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy ausaamaau, kallu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, mithla hadiythi alllaythi 'an naafi'in, ‏.‏ qaala aabuw iishaaqa haddathanaa alhasanu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, bihadhaa mithla hadiythi alllaythi 'an naafi'in, ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has been narrated through more; than one chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي الْقَطَّانَ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ، كَلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، بِهَذَا مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa khaalidun ya'niy abna alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy alqattaana - kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, jamiy'ana 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, - ya'niy abna 'uthmaana - h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy ausaamaau, kallu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, mithla hadiythi alllaythi 'an naafi'in, ‏.‏ qaala aabuw iishaaqa haddathanaa alhasanu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, bihadhaa mithla hadiythi alllaythi 'an naafi'in, ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has been narrated through more; than one chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَطَاعَنِي فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ وَمَنْ يَعْصِنِي فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ الأَمِيرَ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَنِي وَمَنْ يَعْصِ الأَمِيرَ فَقَدْ عَصَانِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُر " وَمَنْ يَعْصِ الأَمِيرَ فَقَدْ عَصَانِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa almughiyraau bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alhizaamiyyu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man aataa'aniy faqad aataa'a alllaha waman ya'siniy faqad 'asaa alllaha waman yuti'i alaamiyra faqad aataa'aniy waman ya'si alaamiyra faqad 'asaaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur " waman ya'si alaamiyra faqad 'asaaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Holy prophet (ﷺ) said:Whoso obeys me obeys God, and whoso disobeys me disobeys God. Whoso obeys the commander (appointed by me) obeys me, and whoso disobeys the commander disobeys me. The same tradition transmitted by different persons omits the portion: And whose disobeys the commander disobeys me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُسَيْدِ بْنِ حُضَيْرٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ خَلاَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ خَلاَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau bnu alhajjaaji, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yuhaddithu 'an ausaydi bni hudayrin, aanna rajulaan, mina alaansaari khalaa birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yaqul khalaa birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has been narrated on the same authority through a different chain of transmitters. Another version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Shu'ba does not include the words:" He took the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) aside
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُسَيْدِ بْنِ حُضَيْرٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ خَلاَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ خَلاَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏

verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ طَارِقٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ كَانَ أَبِي مِمَّنْ بَايَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ الشَّجَرَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقْنَا فِي قَابِلٍ حَاجِّينَ فَخَفِيَ عَلَيْنَا مَكَانُهَا فَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَبَيَّنَتْ لَكُمْ فَأَنْتُمْ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، قَالَ وَقَرَأْتُهُ عَلَى نَصْرِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الشَّجَرَةِ قَالَ فَنَسُوهَا مِنَ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu haamidu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an taariqin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, qaala kaana aabiy mimman baaya'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda alshhajaraai ‏.‏ qaala faantalaqnaa fiy qaabilin haajjiyna fakhafiya 'alaynaa makaanuhaa faiin kaanat tabayyanat lakum faaantum aa'lamu ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa aabuw aahmada, qaala waqaraatuhu 'alaa nasri bni 'aliyyin 'an aabiy aahmada, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an taariqi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiyhi, aannahum kaanuwa 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alshhajaraai qaala fanasuwhaa mina al'aami almuqbili
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Musayyab who said:My father was one of those who swore fealty to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) near the tree. When we passed that way next year intending to perform the Hajj, the place of the tree was hidden to us. If you could point out clearly, you would (certainly) be knowing better. It has also been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Musayyib who learnt from his father that they were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the year of the Tree (i. e. in the year of the fealty of God's pleasure sworn under the tree at Hudaibiya), but next year they forgot the spot of the tree
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ طَارِقٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ كَانَ أَبِي مِمَّنْ بَايَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ الشَّجَرَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقْنَا فِي قَابِلٍ حَاجِّينَ فَخَفِيَ عَلَيْنَا مَكَانُهَا فَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَبَيَّنَتْ لَكُمْ فَأَنْتُمْ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، قَالَ وَقَرَأْتُهُ عَلَى نَصْرِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الشَّجَرَةِ قَالَ فَنَسُوهَا مِنَ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ

Musayyib who learnt from his father that they were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the year of the Tree (i. e. in the year of the fealty of God's pleasure sworn under the tree at Hudaibiya), but next year they forgot the spot of the tree
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، مَوْلَى الْمَهْرِيِّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَعَثَ بَعْثًا ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُوسَى - عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alssamadi, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alwaarithi - qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, haddathanaa alhusaynu, 'an yahyaa, haddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin, mawlaa almahriyyi haddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu, aanna rasuwla alllahi ba'atha ba'thana ‏.‏ bima'naahu ‏.‏ wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, - ya'niy abna muwsaa - 'an shaybaana, 'an yahyaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above tradition has also been narrated through two different chains of transmitters on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri and Yahya, respectively
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، مَوْلَى الْمَهْرِيِّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَعَثَ بَعْثًا ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُوسَى - عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alssamadi, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alwaarithi - qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, haddathanaa alhusaynu, 'an yahyaa, haddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin, mawlaa almahriyyi haddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu, aanna rasuwla alllahi ba'atha ba'thana ‏.‏ bima'naahu ‏.‏ wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, - ya'niy abna muwsaa - 'an shaybaana, 'an yahyaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above tradition has also been narrated through two different chains of transmitters on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri and Yahya, respectively
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above tradition has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَطْرُقَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلاً يَتَخَوَّنُهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسُ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an muhaaribin, 'an jaabirin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yatruqa alrrajulu aahlahu laylaan yatakhawwanuhum aaw yaltamisu 'atharaatihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated (through a different chain of tranmitten) on the authority of Jabir who said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that a man should come to his family like (an unexpected) night visitor doubting their fidelity and spying into their lapses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ لاَ أَدْرِي هَذَا فِي الْحَدِيثِ أَمْ لاَ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي أَنْ يَتَخَوَّنَهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسَ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala 'abdu alrrahmani qaala sufyaanu laa aadriy hadhaa fiy alhadiythi aam laa ‏.‏ ya'niy aan yatakhawwanahum aaw yaltamisa 'atharaatihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has been reported through anothee chain. 'Abdurahman, one of the sub-narrators, said "I do not know if it in the hadith or not", meaning (the words) "doubting their fidelity and spying into their lapses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالاَ، جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكَرَاهَةِ الطُّرُوقِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ يَتَخَوَّنُهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسُ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy qaalaa, jamiy'ana haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhaaribin, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bikaraahaai altturuwqi walam yadhkur yatakhawwanuhum aaw yaltamisu 'atharaatihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Jabir (but through a different chain of transmitters) mentions the undesirability of coining to one's house like a night visitor, but does not contain the words:" Doubting their fidelity or spying into their lapses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُسْهِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْدِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏ "‏ أَصْلِحْ هَذَا اللَّحْمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَصْلَحْتُهُ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ حَمْزَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw mushirin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hamzaaa, haddathaniy alzzubaydiyyu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayri bni nufayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an thawbaana, mawlaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏ "‏ aaslih hadhaa alllahma ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaaslahtuhu falam yazal yaakulu minhu hattaa balagha almadiynaaa ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu almubaaraki, haddathanaa yahyaa, bnu hamzaaa bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yaqul fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me on the occasion of Hajjat-al-Wada' (the Farewell Pilgrimage): Make the flesh usable. So I made it usable (for him) and he ate it constantly until he reached Medina. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yabya b. Hamza with the same chain of transmitters, but he did not say: On the occasion of Hajjat-al-Wada
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُسْهِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْدِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏ "‏ أَصْلِحْ هَذَا اللَّحْمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَصْلَحْتُهُ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ حَمْزَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw mushirin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hamzaaa, haddathaniy alzzubaydiyyu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayri bni nufayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an thawbaana, mawlaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏ "‏ aaslih hadhaa alllahma ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaaslahtuhu falam yazal yaakulu minhu hattaa balagha almadiynaaa ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu almubaaraki, haddathanaa yahyaa, bnu hamzaaa bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yaqul fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me on the occasion of Hajjat-al-Wada' (the Farewell Pilgrimage): Make the flesh usable. So I made it usable (for him) and he ate it constantly until he reached Medina. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yabya b. Hamza with the same chain of transmitters, but he did not say: On the occasion of Hajjat-al-Wada
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ وَسَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْجَرِّ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالنَّقِيرِ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا لَمْ يَجِدْ شَيْئًا يُنْتَبَذُ لَهُ فِيهِ نُبِذَ لَهُ فِي تَوْرٍ مِنْ حِجَارَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aabuw alzzubayri wasami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani aljarri waalmuzaffati waalnnaqiyri ‏.‏ wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa lam yajid shayiana yuntabadhu lahu fiyhi nubidha lahu fiy tawrin min hijaaraain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in green pitcher, in varnished jar, in hollow stump, and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not find anything to prepare Nabidh in that (i. e. waterskin), it was prepared for him in a big bowl made of stone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ ضِرَارِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ضِرَارُ بْنُ مُرَّةَ، أَبُو سِنَانٍ عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنِ النَّبِيذِ إِلاَّ فِي سِقَاءٍ فَاشْرَبُوا فِي الأَسْقِيَةِ كُلِّهَا وَلاَ تَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, qaala aabuw bakrin 'an aabiy sinaanin, waqaala abnu almuthannaa, 'an diraari bni murraaa, 'an muhaaribin, 'ani abni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, haddathanaa diraaru bnu murraaa, aabuw sinaanin 'an muhaaribi bni dithaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ nahaytukum 'ani alnnabiydhi iilaaa fiy siqaa'in faashrabuwa fiy alaasqiyaai kullihaa walaa tashrabuwa muskirana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Buraida, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I had forbidden you from the preparation of Nabidh except in a waterskin. But now you may drink in all vessels, but do not drink what is intoxicant
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ضَحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ، مَرْثَدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنِ الظُّرُوفِ وَإِنَّ الظُّرُوفَ - أَوْ ظَرْفًا - لاَ يُحِلُّ شَيْئًا وَلاَ يُحَرِّمُهُ وَكُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa dahhaaku bnu makhladin, 'an sufyaana, 'an 'alqamaaa bni, marthadin 'ani abni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ nahaytukum 'ani alzzuruwfi waiinna alzzuruwfa - aaw zarfana - laa yuhillu shayiana walaa yuharrimuhu wakullu muskirin haraamun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Buraida, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I had forbidden you (from the preparation of Nabidh) and drinking it in certain vessels, (but now you may do so if you like) for it is not vessels or a vessel that makes a thing lawful or unlawful. It is every intoxicant that is unlawful

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْح��اقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ، بْنِ يَسَارٍ أَبِي الْحُبَابِ مَوْلَى بَنِي النَّجَّارِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ تَمَاثِيلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ هَذَا يُخْبِرُنِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ تَمَاثِيلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَهَلْ سَمِعْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَتْ لاَ وَلَكِنْ سَأُحَدِّثُكُمْ مَا رَأَيْتُهُ فَعَلَ رَأَيْتُهُ خَرَجَ فِي غَزَاتِهِ فَأَخَذْتُ نَمَطًا فَسَتَرْتُهُ عَلَى الْبَابِ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ فَرَأَى النَّمَطَ عَرَفْتُ الْكَرَاهِيَةَ فِي وَجْهِهِ فَجَذَبَهُ حَتَّى هَتَكَهُ أَوْ قَطَعَهُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا أَنْ نَكْسُوَ الْحِجَارَةَ وَالطِّينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ وِسَادَتَيْنِ وَحَشَوْتُهُمَا لِيفًا فَلَمْ يَعِبْ ذَلِكَ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iish��aqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an sa'iydi, bni yasaarin aabiy alhubaabi mawlaa baniy alnnajjaari 'an zaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, 'an aabiy talhaaa alaansaariyyi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa tadkhulu almalaaiikaau baytana fiyhi kalbun walaa tamaathiylu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaataytu 'aaiishaaa faqultu iinna hadhaa yukhbiruniy aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa tadkhulu almalaaiikaau baytana fiyhi kalbun walaa tamaathiylu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fahal sami'ti rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhakara dhalika faqaalat laa walakin saauhaddithukum maa raaaytuhu fa'ala raaaytuhu kharaja fiy ghazaatihi faaakhadhtu namatana fasatartuhu 'alaa albaabi falammaa qadima faraaaa alnnamata 'araftu alkaraahiyaaa fiy wajhihi fajadhabahu hattaa hatakahu aaw qata'ahu waqaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha lam yaamurnaa aan naksuwa alhijaaraaa waalttiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqata'naa minhu wisaadatayni wahashawtuhumaa liyfana falam ya'ib dhalika 'alaaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Talha Ansari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture or portraits. I came to 'A'isha and said to her: This is a news that I have received that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had said: Angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture or a dog, (and further added) whether she had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) making a mention of it. She said: No (I did not hear this myself), but I narrate to you what I saw him doing. I bear testimony to the fact that he (the Holy Prophet) set out for an expedition. I took a carpet and screened the door with it. When he (the Holy Prophet) came back he saw that carpet and I perceived signs of disapproval on his face. He pulled it until it was torn or it was cut (into pieces) and he said: God has not commanded us to clothe stones and clay. We cut it (the curtain) and prepared two pillowa out of it by stuffing them with the fibre of date-palms and he (the Holy Prophet) did not find fault with it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ عَزْرَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ لَنَا سِتْرٌ فِيهِ تِمْثَالُ طَائِرٍ وَكَانَ الدَّاخِلُ إِذَا دَخَلَ اسْتَقْبَلَهُ فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ حَوِّلِي هَذَا فَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَخَلْتُ فَرَأَيْتُهُ ذَكَرْتُ الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَكَانَتْ لَنَا قَطِيفَةٌ كُنَّا نَقُولُ عَلَمُهَا حَرِيرٌ فَكُنَّا نَلْبَسُهَا ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، وَعَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَزَادَ فِيهِ - يُرِيدُ عَبْدَ الأَعْلَى - فَلَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَطْعِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an daawuda, 'an 'azraaa, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an sa'di bni hishaamin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana lanaa sitrun fiyhi timthaalu taaiirin wakaana alddaakhilu iidhaa dakhala astaqbalahu faqaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ hawwiliy hadhaa faiinniy kullamaa dakhaltu faraaaytuhu dhakartu alddunyaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat wakaanat lanaa qatiyfaaun kunnaa naquwlu 'alamuhaa hariyrun fakunnaa nalbasuhaa ‏.‏ haddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, wa'abdu alaa'laa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala abnu almuthannaa wazaada fiyhi - yuriydu 'abda alaa'laa - falam yaamurnaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biqat'ihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:We had a curtain with us which had portraits of birds upon it. Whenever a visitor came, he found them in front of him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Change them, for whenever I enter the room) I see them and it brings to my mind (the pleasures) of worldly life. She said: We had with us a sheet which had silk badges upon it and we used to wear it. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Muthanna but with this addition: 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not command us to tear that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ مَسْرُوقٍ فِي بَيْتٍ فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ مَرْيَمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ هَذَا تَمَاثِيلُ كِسْرَى ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لاَ هَذَا تَمَاثِيلُ مَرْيَمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ أَمَا إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَشَدُّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الْمُصَوِّرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى نَصْرِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ أُصَوِّرُ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرَ فَأَفْتِنِي فِيهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ادْنُ مِنِّي ‏.‏ فَدَنَا مِنْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ادْنُ مِنِّي ‏.‏ فَدَنَا حَتَّى وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ قَالَ أُنَبِّئُكَ بِمَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ كُلُّ مُصَوِّرٍ فِي النَّارِ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ صُورَةٍ صَوَّرَهَا نَفْسًا فَتُعَذِّبُهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ لاَ بُدَّ فَاعِلاً فَاصْنَعِ الشَّجَرَ وَمَا لاَ نَفْسَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathanaa mansuwrun, 'an muslimi bni subayhin, qaala kuntu ma'a masruwqin fiy baytin fiyhi tamaathiylu maryama ‏.‏ faqaala masruwqun hadhaa tamaathiylu kisraa ‏.‏ faqultu laa hadhaa tamaathiylu maryama ‏.‏ faqaala masruwqun aamaa iinniy sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aashaddu alnnaasi 'adhaabana yawma alqiyaamaai almusawwiruwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala muslimun qaraatu 'alaa nasri bni 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyi 'an 'abdi alaa'laa bni 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy iishaaqa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy alhasani, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa abni 'abbaasin faqaala iinniy rajulun ausawwiru hadhihi alssuwara faaaftiniy fiyhaa ‏.‏ faqaala lahu adnu minniy ‏.‏ fadanaa minhu thumma qaala adnu minniy ‏.‏ fadanaa hattaa wada'a yadahu 'alaa raasihi qaala aunabbiiuka bimaa sami'tu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ kullu musawwirin fiy alnnaari yaj'alu lahu bikulli suwraain sawwarahaa nafsana fatu'adhhibuhu fiy jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala iin kunta laa budda faa'ilaan faasna'i alshhajara wamaa laa nafsa lahu ‏.‏ faaaqarra bihi nasru bnu 'aliyyin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muslim b. Subaih reported:I was with Masriuq in the house which had the portrayals of Mary (hadrat Maryan). Thereupon Masriuq said: These are portraits of Kisra. I said: No, these are of Mary. Masruq said: I heard Abdullah b, Mas'ud as saying Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: The most grievously tormented people on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures. (Muslim said): I read this before Nasr b. 'Ali at-Jahdami and he read it before other narrators, the last one being Ibn Sa'id b Abl at Hasan that a person came to Ibn 'Abbas and said: I am the person who paints pictures; give me a religious verdict about them. He (Ibn 'Abbas) said to him: Come near me (still further). He came near him so much so that he placed his hand upon his head and said: I am going to narrate to yor what I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I heard him say: All the painters who make pictures would be in the fire of Hell. The soul will be breathed in every picture prepared by him and it shall punish him in the Hell, and he (Ibn 'Abbas) said: If you have to do it at all, then paint the pictures of trees and lifeless things; and Nasr b. 'Ali confirmed it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ مَسْرُوقٍ فِي بَيْتٍ فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ مَرْيَمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ هَذَا تَمَاثِيلُ كِسْرَى ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لاَ هَذَا تَمَاثِيلُ مَرْيَمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ أَمَا إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَشَدُّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الْمُصَوِّرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى نَصْرِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ أُصَوِّرُ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرَ فَأَفْتِنِي فِيهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ادْنُ مِنِّي ‏.‏ فَدَنَا مِنْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ادْنُ مِنِّي ‏.‏ فَدَنَا حَتَّى وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ قَالَ أُنَبِّئُكَ بِمَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ كُلُّ مُصَوِّرٍ فِي النَّارِ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ صُورَةٍ صَوَّرَهَا نَفْسًا فَتُعَذِّبُهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ لاَ بُدَّ فَاعِلاً فَاصْنَعِ الشَّجَرَ وَمَا لاَ نَفْسَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathanaa mansuwrun, 'an muslimi bni subayhin, qaala kuntu ma'a masruwqin fiy baytin fiyhi tamaathiylu maryama ‏.‏ faqaala masruwqun hadhaa tamaathiylu kisraa ‏.‏ faqultu laa hadhaa tamaathiylu maryama ‏.‏ faqaala masruwqun aamaa iinniy sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aashaddu alnnaasi 'adhaabana yawma alqiyaamaai almusawwiruwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala muslimun qaraatu 'alaa nasri bni 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyi 'an 'abdi alaa'laa bni 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy iishaaqa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy alhasani, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa abni 'abbaasin faqaala iinniy rajulun ausawwiru hadhihi alssuwara faaaftiniy fiyhaa ‏.‏ faqaala lahu adnu minniy ‏.‏ fadanaa minhu thumma qaala adnu minniy ‏.‏ fadanaa hattaa wada'a yadahu 'alaa raasihi qaala aunabbiiuka bimaa sami'tu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ kullu musawwirin fiy alnnaari yaj'alu lahu bikulli suwraain sawwarahaa nafsana fatu'adhhibuhu fiy jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala iin kunta laa budda faa'ilaan faasna'i alshhajara wamaa laa nafsa lahu ‏.‏ faaaqarra bihi nasru bnu 'aliyyin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muslim b. Subaih reported:I was with Masriuq in the house which had the portrayals of Mary (hadrat Maryan). Thereupon Masriuq said: These are portraits of Kisra. I said: No, these are of Mary. Masruq said: I heard Abdullah b, Mas'ud as saying Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: The most grievously tormented people on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures. (Muslim said): I read this before Nasr b. 'Ali at-Jahdami and he read it before other narrators, the last one being Ibn Sa'id b Abl at Hasan that a person came to Ibn 'Abbas and said: I am the person who paints pictures; give me a religious verdict about them. He (Ibn 'Abbas) said to him: Come near me (still further). He came near him so much so that he placed his hand upon his head and said: I am going to narrate to yor what I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I heard him say: All the painters who make pictures would be in the fire of Hell. The soul will be breathed in every picture prepared by him and it shall punish him in the Hell, and he (Ibn 'Abbas) said: If you have to do it at all, then paint the pictures of trees and lifeless things; and Nasr b. 'Ali confirmed it

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ، زَيْدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِرْبَدًا وَهُوَ يَسِمُ غَنَمًا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ فِي آذَانِهَا ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، وَيَحْيَى، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, haddathaniy hishaamu bnu, zaydin qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu dakhalnaa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mirbadana wahuwa yasimu ghanamana ‏.‏ qaala aahsibuhu qaala fiy adhaanihaa ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, wayahyaa, wa'abdu alrrahmani, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:We went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was in the fold and he was cauterising the animals of the flock and I think (he was cauterising them) on their ears. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ يَنَّاقَ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ زَوَّجَتِ ابْنَةً لَهَا فَاشْتَكَتْ فَتَسَاقَطَ شَعْرُهَا فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ زَوْجَهَا يُرِيدُهَا أَفَأَصِلُ شَعَرَهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لُعِنَ الْوَاصِلاَتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لُعِنَ الْمُوصِلاَتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa zaydu bnu alhubaabi, 'an iibraahiyma bni naafi'in, aakhbaraniy alhasanu bnu muslimi bni yannaaqa, 'an safiyyaaa binti shaybaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna amraaaaan, mina alaansaari zawwajati abnaaan lahaa faashtakat fatasaaqata sha'ruhaa faaatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat iinna zawjahaa yuriyduhaa aafaaasilu sha'arahaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ lu'ina alwaasilaatu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an iibraahiyma bni naafi'in, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏"‏ lu'ina almuwsilaatu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that a woman from the Ansar married her daughter who had lost her hair because of illness. She came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said:Her husband wants that false hair should be aaded to her head. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The woman who adds false hair has been cursed. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Nafi' with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَعَنَ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ وَالْوَاشِمَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ، جُوَيْرِيَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu, bnu almuthannaa - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm la'ana alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa waalwaashimaaa waalmustawshimaaa ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni baziy'in, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa sakhru bnu, juwayriyaaa 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursing the woman who added false hair and the woman who asked for tattoos. This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abdullah through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَعَنَ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ وَالْوَاشِمَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ، جُوَيْرِيَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu, bnu almuthannaa - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm la'ana alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa waalwaashimaaa waalmustawshimaaa ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni baziy'in, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa sakhru bnu, juwayriyaaa 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursing the woman who added false hair and the woman who asked for tattoos. This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abdullah through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَةً يَفْرَعُ النَّاسَ جِسْمُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيَتَعَشَّى ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala wakaanati amraaaaan yafra'u alnnaasa jismuhaa ‏.‏ qaala waiinnahu layata'ashhaa ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, and the words are:She (Sauda) was a woman who looked to be significant amongst the people (so far as the bulk of her) body was concerned. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَةً يَفْرَعُ النَّاسَ جِسْمُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيَتَعَشَّى ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala wakaanati amraaaaan yafra'u alnnaasa jismuhaa ‏.‏ qaala waiinnahu layata'ashhaa ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, and the words are:She (Sauda) was a woman who looked to be significant amongst the people (so far as the bulk of her) body was concerned. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ، أُخْتِ عُكَّاشَةَ بْنِ مِحْصَنٍ قَالَتْ دَخَلْتُ بِابْنٍ لِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ فَبَالَ عَلَيْهِ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَرَشَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ بِابْنٍ لِي قَدْ أَعْلَقْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ عَلاَمَهْ تَدْغَرْنَ أَوْلاَدَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعِلاَقِ عَلَيْكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ مِنْهَا ذَاتُ الْجَنْبِ يُسْعَطُ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ وَيُلَدُّ مِنْ ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin waabnu aabiy 'umara - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa sufyaanu, bnu 'uyaynaaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aummi qaysin binti mihsanin, aukhti 'ukkaashaaa bni mihsanin qaalat dakhaltu biabnin liy 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yaakuli altta'aama fabaala 'alayhi fada'aa bimaa'in farashhahu ‏.‏ qaalat wadakhaltu 'alayhi biabnin liy qad aa'laqtu 'alayhi mina al'udhraai faqaala ‏ "‏ 'alaamah tadgharna aawlaadakunna bihadhaa al'ilaaqi 'alaykunna bihadhaa al'uwdi alhindiyyi faiinna fiyhi sab'aaa aashfiyaain minhaa dhaatu aljanbi yus'atu mina al'udhraai wayuladdu min dhaati aljanbi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, the sister of 'Ukasha b. Mihsan said:I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with my son who had not, by that time, been weaned and he urinated over his (clothes). He ordered water to be brought and sprinkled (it) over them. She (further) said: I visited him (Allah's Apostle) along with my son and I had squeezed the swelling in the uvula, whereupon he said: Why do you afflict your children by compressing like this? Use this Indian aloeswood, for it contains seven types of remedies, one among them being a remedy for pleurisy. It is applied through the nose for a swelling of the uvula and poured into the side of the mouth for pleurisy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتَ مِحْصَنٍ، - وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرَاتِ الأُوَلِ اللاَّتِي بَايَعْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ أُخْتُ عُكَّاشَةَ بْنِ مِحْصَنٍ أَحَدِ بَنِي أَسَدِ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لَهَا لَمْ يَبْلُغْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الطَّعَامَ وَقَدْ أَعْلَقَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ - قَالَ يُونُسُ أَعْلَقَتْ غَمَزَتْ فَهِيَ تَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ بِهِ عُذْرَةٌ - قَالَتْ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ عَلاَمَهْ تَدْغَرْنَ أَوْلاَدَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الإِعْلاَقِ عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ - يَعْنِي بِهِ الْكُسْتَ - فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ مِنْهَا ذَاتُ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ وَأَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّ ابْنَهَا ذَاكَ بَالَ فِي حَجْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَاءٍ فَنَضَحَهُ عَلَى بَوْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْهُ غَسْلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, aanna abna shihaabin, aakhbarahu qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna aumma qaysin binta mihsanin, - wakaanat mina almuhaajiraati alauwali allaaatiy baaya'na rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya aukhtu 'ukkaashaaa bni mihsanin aahadi baniy aasadi bni khuzaymaaa - qaala aakhbaratniy aannahaa aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biabnin lahaa lam yablugh aan yaakula altta'aama waqad aa'laqat 'alayhi mina al'udhraai - qaala yuwnusu aa'laqat ghamazat fahiya takhaafu aan yakuwna bihi 'udhraaun - qaalat - faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ 'alaamah tadgharna aawlaadakunna bihadhaa alii'laaqi 'alaykum bihadhaa al'uwdi alhindiyyi - ya'niy bihi alkusta - faiinna fiyhi sab'aaa aashfiyaain minhaa dhaatu aljanbi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi waaakhbaratniy aanna abnahaa dhaaka baala fiy hajri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fada'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimaa'in fanadahahu 'alaa bawlihi walam yaghsilhu ghaslaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, was one of the earlier female emigrants who had pledged allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She was the sister of Ukasha b. Mihsan, one of the posterity of Asad b. Khuzaima. She reported that she came to Allah's messenger (ﷺ) along with her son who had not attained the age of weaning and she had compressed the swelling of his uvula. (Yunus said:She compressed the uvula because she was afraid that there might be swelling of uvula.) Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Why do you afflict your children by compressing in this way? You should use Indian aloeswood, for it has seven remedies in it, one of them being the remedy for pleurisy. Ubaidullah reported that she had told that that was the child who had urinated in the lap of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called for water and sprinkled it on his urine, but he did not wash it well
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَاجِبُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُ بِقَتْلِ الْكِلاَبِ يَقُولُ ‏\"‏ اقْتُلُوا الْحَيَّاتِ وَالْكِلاَبَ وَاقْتُلُوا ذَا الطُّفْيَتَيْنِ وَالأَبْتَرَ فَإِنَّهُمَا يَلْتَمِسَانِ الْبَصَرَ وَيَسْتَسْقِطَانِ الْحَبَالَى ‏\"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَنُرَى ذَلِكَ مِنْ سُمَّيْهِمَا وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَالِمٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ فَلَبِثْتُ لاَ أَتْرُكُ حَيَّةً أَرَاهَا إِلاَّ قَتَلْتُهَا فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أُطَارِدُ حَيَّةً يَوْمًا مِنْ ذَوَاتِ الْبُيُوتِ مَرَّ بِي زَيْدُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ أَوْ أَبُو لُبَابَةَ وَأَنَا أُطَارِدُهَا فَقَالَ مَهْلاً يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ بِقَتْلِهِنَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ نَهَى عَنْ ذَوَاتِ الْبُيُوتِ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ، حُمَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ صَالِحًا، قَالَ حَتَّى رَآنِي أَبُو لُبَابَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُنْذِرِ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالاَ إِنَّهُ قَدْ نَهَى عَنْ ذَوَاتِ الْبُيُوتِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ ‏\"‏ اقْتُلُوا الْحَيَّاتِ ‏\"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏\"‏ ذَا الطُّفْيَتَيْنِ وَالأَبْتَرَ ‏\"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haajibu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu harbin, 'ani alzzubaydiyyi, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamuru biqatli alkilaabi yaquwlu ‏\"‏ aqtuluwa alhayyaati waalkilaaba waaqtuluwa dhaa alttufyatayni waalaabtara faiinnahumaa yaltamisaani albasara wayastasqitaani alhabaalaa ‏\"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alzzuhriyyu wanuraa dhalika min summayhimaa waalllahu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala saalimun qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara falabithtu laa aatruku hayyaaan aaraahaa iilaaa qataltuhaa fabaynaa aanaa autaaridu hayyaaan yawmana min dhawaati albuyuwti marra biy zaydu bnu alkhattaabi aaw aabuw lubaabaaa waaanaa autaariduhaa faqaala mahlaan yaa 'abda alllahi ‏.‏ faqultu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara biqatlihinna ‏.‏ qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad nahaa 'an dhawaati albuyuwti ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu, humaydin aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aanna saalihana, qaala hattaa raaniy aabuw lubaabaaa bnu 'abdi almundhiri wazaydu bnu alkhattaabi faqaalaa iinnahu qad nahaa 'an dhawaati albuyuwti ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi yuwnusa ‏\"‏ aqtuluwa alhayyaati ‏\"‏ ‏.‏ walam yaqul ‏\"‏ dhaa alttufyatayni waalaabtara ‏\"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanding the killing of dogs and the killing of the striped and the short-tailed snakes, for both of them affect the eyesight adversely and cause miscarriage. Zuhri said: We thought of their poison (the pernicious effects of these two). Allah, however, knows best. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar said: I did not spare any snake. I rather killed everyone that I saw. One day as I was pursuing a snake from amongst the snakes of the house, Zaid b. Khattab or Abu Lubaba happened to pass by me and found me pursuing it. He said: 'Abdullah, wait. I said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded (us) to kill them, whereupon he said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the killing of the snakes of the houses. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَدِفْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ مَعَكَ مِنْ شِعْرِ أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ أَبِي الصَّلْتِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ هِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَنْشَدْتُهُ بَيْتًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَنْشَدْتُهُ بَيْتًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ حَتَّى أَنْشَدْتُهُ مِائَةَ بَيْتٍ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ، أَوْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ عَنِ الشَّرِيدِ، قَالَ أَرْدَفَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَلْفَهُ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, kilaahumaa 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala abnu aabiy 'umara haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an iibraahiyma bni maysaraaa, 'an 'amriw bni alshhariydi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala radiftu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana faqaala ‏"‏ hal ma'aka min shi'ri aumayyaaa bni aabiy alssalti shayiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu na'am qaala ‏"‏ hiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaanshadtuhu baytana faqaala ‏"‏ hiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aanshadtuhu baytana faqaala ‏"‏ hiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ hattaa aanshadtuhu miaiaaa baytin ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, waaahmadu bnu 'abdaaa, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, 'an iibraahiyma, bni maysaraaa 'an 'amriw bni alshhariydi, aaw ya'quwba bni 'aasimin 'ani alshhariydi, qaala aardafaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khalfahu ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. Sharid reported his father as saying:One day when I rode behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he said (to me): Do you remember any poetry of Umayya b. Abu Salt. I said: Yes. He said: Then go on. I recited a couplet, and he said: Go on. Then I again recited a couplet and he said: Go on. I recited one hundred couplets (of his poetry). This hadith has been reported on the authority of Sharid through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

He said: Then go on. I recited a couplet, and he said: Go on. Then I again recited a couplet and he said: Go on. I recited one hundred couplets (of his poetry). This hadith has been reported on the authority of Sharid through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ مُسَيْلِمَةُ الْكَذَّابُ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ إِنْ جَعَلَ لِي مُحَمَّدٌ الأَمْرَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ تَبِعْتُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَدِمَهَا فِي بَشَرٍ كَثِيرٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ فَأَقْبَلَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَهُ ثَابِتُ بْنُ قَيْسِ بْنِ شَمَّاسٍ وَفِي يَدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِطْعَةُ جَرِيدَةٍ حَتَّى وَقَفَ عَلَى مُسَيْلِمَةَ فِي أَصْحَابِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ سَأَلْتَنِي هَذِهِ الْقِطْعَةَ مَا أَعْطَيْتُكَهَا وَلَنْ أَتَعَدَّى أَمْرَ اللَّهِ فِيكَ وَلَئِنْ أَدْبَرْتَ لَيَعْقِرَنَّكَ اللَّهُ وَإِنِّي لأُرَاكَ الَّذِي أُرِيتُ فِيكَ مَا أُرِيتُ وَهَذَا ثَابِتٌ يُجِيبُكَ عَنِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ عَنْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلْتُ عَنْ قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ أَرَى الَّذِي أُرِيتُ فِيكَ مَا أُرِيتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُ فِي يَدَىَّ سِوَارَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَأَهَمَّنِي شَأْنُهُمَا فَأُوحِيَ إِلَىَّ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِ انْفُخْهُمَا فَنَفَخْتُهُمَا فَطَارَا فَأَوَّلْتُهُمَا كَذَّابَيْنِ يَخْرُجَانِ مِنْ بَعْدِي فَكَانَ أَحَدُهُمَا الْعَنْسِيَّ صَاحِبَ صَنْعَاءَ وَالآخَرُ مُسَيْلِمَةَ صَاحِبَ الْيَمَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu sahlin alttamiymiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'an 'abdi alllahi, bni aabiy husaynin haddathanaa naafi'u bnu jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qadima musaylimaau alkadhhaabu 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa faja'ala yaquwlu iin ja'ala liy muhammadun alaamra min ba'dihi tabi'tuhu ‏.‏ faqadimahaa fiy basharin kathiyrin min qawmihi faaaqbala iilayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wama'ahu thaabitu bnu qaysi bni shammaasin wafiy yadi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qit'aau jariydaain hattaa waqafa 'alaa musaylimaaa fiy aashaabihi qaala ‏"‏ law saaaltaniy hadhihi alqit'aaa maa aa'taytukahaa walan aata'addaa aamra alllahi fiyka walaiin aadbarta laya'qirannaka alllahu waiinniy lauraaka alladhiy auriytu fiyka maa auriytu wahadhaa thaabitun yujiybuka 'anniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma ansarafa 'anhu ‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'abbaasin fasaaaltu 'an qawli alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnaka aaraa alladhiy auriytu fiyka maa auriytu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaakhbaraniy aabuw hurayraaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ baynaa aanaa naaiimun raaaytu fiy yadaaaa siwaarayni min dhahabin faaahammaniy shaanuhumaa faauwhiya iilaaaa fiy almanaami aani anfukhhumaa fanafakhtuhumaa fataaraa faaawwaltuhumaa kadhhaabayni yakhrujaani min ba'diy fakaana aahaduhumaa al'ansiyya saahiba san'aa'a waalakharu musaylimaaa saahiba alyamaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn `Abbas reported that Musailima al-Kadhdhab (the greater liar) (who claimed prophethood after the death of the Holy Prophet) came during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to Medina and said:If Muhammad assigns his caliphate to me after him I would follow him, and there came along with him a large body of persons of his tribe, and there came to him Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) along with Thabit b. Qais b. Shammas and the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) had a piece of wood in his hand until he came in front of Musailima in the company of his companions and said: If you were to ask even this (wood), I would never give it to you. I am not going to do anything against the will of God in your case, and if you turn away (from what I say) Allah will destroy you. And I find you in the same state which I was shown (in the dream) and here is Thabit and he would answer you on my behalf. He (the Holy Prophet) then went back. Ibn `Abbas said: I asked the (meaning of the) words of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): "You are the same what I was made to see about you in my dream." and Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: While I was sleeping I saw in my hands two gold bangles. This had a disturbing effect upon me and I was given a suggestion in the sleep that I should blow over them, so I blew over them and they were no more. And I interpreted these (two bangles) as the two great liars who would appear after me and the one amongst them was Al-`Anasi the inhabitant of San`a' and the other one Musailima the inhabitant of Yamama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَهْلاً، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَنَا فَرَطُكُمْ، عَلَى الْحَوْضِ مَنْ وَرَدَ شَرِبَ وَمَنْ شَرِبَ لَمْ يَظْمَأْ أَبَدًا وَلَيَرِدَنَّ عَلَىَّ أَقْوَامٌ أَعْرِفُهُمْ وَيَعْرِفُونِي ثُمَّ يُحَالُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ فَسَمِعَ النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ وَأَنَا أُحَدِّثُهُمْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ فَقَالَ هَكَذَا سَمِعْتَ سَهْلاً يَقُولُ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ، عَلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ لَسَمِعْتُهُ يَزِيدُ فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمْ مِنِّي ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا عَمِلُوا بَعْدَكَ ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ سُحْقًا سُحْقًا لِمَنْ بَدَّلَ بَعْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'an aabiy haazimin, qaala sami'tu sahlaan, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ aanaa faratukum, 'alaa alhawdi man warada shariba waman shariba lam yazmaa aabadana walayaridanna 'alaaaa aaqwaamun aa'rifuhum waya'rifuwniy thumma yuhaalu bayniy wabaynahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw haazimin fasami'a alnnu'maanu bnu aabiy 'ayyaashin waaanaa auhaddithuhum hadhaa alhadiytha faqaala hakadhaa sami'ta sahlaan yaquwlu qaala faqultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala waaanaa aashhadu, 'alaa aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi lasami'tuhu yaziydu fayaquwlu ‏"‏ iinnahum minniy ‏.‏ fayuqaalu iinnaka laa tadriy maa 'amiluwa ba'daka ‏.‏ faaaquwlu suhqana suhqana liman baddala ba'diy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl (b. Sa'd) reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: I shall go to the Cistern before you and he who comes would drink and he who drinks would never feel thirsty, and there would come to me people whom I would know and who would know me. Then there would be intervention between me and them. Abu Hazim said that Nu'man b. Abu 'Ayyash heard it and I narrated to them this hadith, and said: Is it this that you heard Sahl saying? He said: Yes, and I bear witness to the fact that I heard it from Abu Sa'id Khudri also, but he made this addition that he (the Holy Prophet) would say: They are my followers, and it would be said to him: You do not know what they did after you and I will say to them: Woe to him who changes (his religion) after me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الضَّبِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْجُمَحِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ حَوْضِي مَسِيرَةُ شَهْرٍ وَزَوَايَاهُ سَوَاءٌ وَمَاؤُهُ أَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْوَرِقِ وَرِيحُهُ أَطْيَبُ مِنَ الْمِسْكِ وَكِيزَانُهُ كَنُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ فَمَنْ شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلاَ يَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي عَلَى الْحَوْضِ حَتَّى أَنْظُرَ مَنْ يَرِدُ عَلَىَّ مِنْكُمْ وَسَيُؤْخَذُ أُنَاسٌ دُونِي فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ مِنِّي وَمِنْ أُمَّتِي ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ أَمَا شَعَرْتَ مَا عَمِلُوا بَعْدَكَ وَاللَّهِ مَا بَرِحُوا بَعْدَكَ يَرْجِعُونَ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ نَرْجِعَ عَلَى أَعْقَابِنَا أَوْ أَنْ نُفْتَنَ عَنْ دِينِنَا
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa daawudu bnu 'amrinw alddabbiyyu, haddathanaa naafi'u bnu 'umara aljumahiyyu, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amriw bni al'aasi qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hawdiy masiyraau shahrin wazawaayaahu sawaa'un wamaauuhu aabyadu mina alwariqi wariyhuhu aatyabu mina almiski wakiyzaanuhu kanujuwmi alssamaa'i faman shariba minhu falaa yazmaau ba'dahu aabadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala waqaalat aasmaa'u bintu aabiy bakrin qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinniy 'alaa alhawdi hattaa aanzura man yaridu 'alaaaa minkum wasayuukhadhu aunaasun duwniy faaaquwlu yaa rabbi minniy wamin aummatiy ‏.‏ fayuqaalu aamaa sha'arta maa 'amiluwa ba'daka waalllahi maa barihuwa ba'daka yarji'uwna 'alaa aa'qaabihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakaana abnu aabiy mulaykaaa yaquwlu alllahumma iinnaa na'uwdhu bika aan narji'a 'alaa aa'qaabinaa aaw aan nuftana 'an diyninaa
verses.translation: Abdullah b. `Amr al-`As, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:My Cistern (is as wide and broad that it requires) a month's journey (to go round it) all, and its sides are equal and its water is whiter than silver, and its odour is more fragrant than the fragrance of musk, and its jugs (placed around it) are like stars in the sky; and he who would drink from it would never feel thirsty after that. Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I would be on the Cistern so that I would be seeing those who would be coming to me from you, but some people would be detained (before reaching me). I would say: My Lord, they are my followers and belong to my Ummah, and it would be said to me: Do you know what they did after you? By Allah, they did not do good after you, and they turned back upon their heels. He (the narrator) said: lbn Abu Mulaika used to say (in supplication): O Allah, I seek refuge with Thee that we should turn back upon our heels or put to any trial about our religion
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الْيَعْمَرِيِّ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لَبِعُقْرِ حَوْضِي أَذُودُ النَّاسَ لأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ أَضْرِبُ بِعَصَاىَ حَتَّى يَرْفَضَّ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسُئِلَ عَنْ عَرْضِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ مَقَامِي إِلَى عَمَّانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسُئِلَ عَنْ شَرَابِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ اللَّبَنِ وَأَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ يَغُتُّ فِيهِ مِيزَابَانِ يَمُدَّانِهِ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ أَحَدُهُمَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَالآخَرُ مِنْ وَرِقٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِإِسْنَادِ هِشَامٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ عُقْرِ الْحَوْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waaalfaazuhum mutaqaaribaaun - qaaluwa haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - wahuwa abnu hishaamin - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an ma'daana bni aabiy talhaaa alya'mariyyi, 'an thawbaana, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinniy labi'uqri hawdiy aadhuwdu alnnaasa laahli alyamani aadribu bi'asaaaa hattaa yarfadda 'alayhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasuiila 'an 'ardihi faqaala ‏"‏ min maqaamiy iilaa 'ammaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasuiila 'an sharaabihi faqaala ‏"‏ aashaddu bayaadana mina alllabani waaahlaa mina al'asali yaghuttu fiyhi miyzaabaani yamuddaanihi mina aljannaai aahaduhumaa min dhahabin waalakharu min wariqin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, biiisnaadi hishaamin ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ aanaa yawma alqiyaamaai 'inda 'uqri alhawdi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:I would be pushing back from my Cistern the crowd of people. I would strike away from it (the Cistern) with my staff the people of Yemen until the water (of the Haud) would spout forth upon them. He was asked about its breadth. He said: From this place of mine to 'Amman, and he was asked about the drink and he said: It is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey. There would spout into it two streamlets having their sources in Paradise. the one is from gold and the other is from silver. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters and the words are:" I would be on the Day of Resurrection near the bank of the Cistern
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الْيَعْمَرِيِّ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لَبِعُقْرِ حَوْضِي أَذُودُ النَّاسَ لأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ أَضْرِبُ بِعَصَاىَ حَتَّى يَرْفَضَّ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسُئِلَ عَنْ عَرْضِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ مَقَامِي إِلَى عَمَّانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسُئِلَ عَنْ شَرَابِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ اللَّبَنِ وَأَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ يَغُتُّ فِيهِ مِيزَابَانِ يَمُدَّانِهِ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ أَحَدُهُمَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَالآخَرُ مِنْ وَرِقٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِإِسْنَادِ هِشَامٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ عُقْرِ الْحَوْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waaalfaazuhum mutaqaaribaaun - qaaluwa haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - wahuwa abnu hishaamin - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an ma'daana bni aabiy talhaaa alya'mariyyi, 'an thawbaana, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinniy labi'uqri hawdiy aadhuwdu alnnaasa laahli alyamani aadribu bi'asaaaa hattaa yarfadda 'alayhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasuiila 'an 'ardihi faqaala ‏"‏ min maqaamiy iilaa 'ammaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasuiila 'an sharaabihi faqaala ‏"‏ aashaddu bayaadana mina alllabani waaahlaa mina al'asali yaghuttu fiyhi miyzaabaani yamuddaanihi mina aljannaai aahaduhumaa min dhahabin waalakharu min wariqin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, biiisnaadi hishaamin ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ aanaa yawma alqiyaamaai 'inda 'uqri alhawdi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:I would be pushing back from my Cistern the crowd of people. I would strike away from it (the Cistern) with my staff the people of Yemen until the water (of the Haud) would spout forth upon them. He was asked about its breadth. He said: From this place of mine to 'Amman, and he was asked about the drink and he said: It is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey. There would spout into it two streamlets having their sources in Paradise. the one is from gold and the other is from silver. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters and the words are:" I would be on the Day of Resurrection near the bank of the Cistern

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، زَيْدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ - قَالَ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ قَالَ أَنَسٌ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَحْسَنِ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا فَأَرْسَلَنِي يَوْمًا لِحَاجَةٍ فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَذْهَبُ ‏.‏ وَفِي نَفْسِي أَنْ أَذْهَبَ لِمَا أَمَرَنِي بِهِ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجْتُ حَتَّى أَمُرَّ عَلَى صِبْيَانٍ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي السُّوقِ فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ قَبَضَ بِقَفَاىَ مِنْ وَرَائِي - قَالَ - فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أُنَيْسُ أَذَهَبْتَ حَيْثُ أَمَرْتُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ أَنَا أَذْهَبُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ خَدَمْتُهُ تِسْعَ سِنِينَ مَا عَلِمْتُهُ قَالَ لِشَىْءٍ صَنَعْتُهُ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا أَوْ لِشَىْءٍ تَرَكْتُهُ هَلاَّ فَعَلْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ma'nin alrraqaashiyyu, zaydu bnu yaziyda aakhbaranaa 'umaru bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau, - wahuwa abnu 'ammaarin - qaala qaala iishaaqu qaala aanasun kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aahsani alnnaasi khuluqana faaarsalaniy yawmana lihaajaain faqultu waalllahi laa aadhhabu ‏.‏ wafiy nafsiy aan aadhhaba limaa aamaraniy bihi nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakharajtu hattaa aamurra 'alaa sibyaanin wahum yal'abuwna fiy alssuwqi faiidhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad qabada biqafaaaa min waraaiiy - qaala - fanazartu iilayhi wahuwa yadhaku faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa aunaysu aadhahabta haythu aamartuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu na'am aanaa aadhhabu yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala aanasun waalllahi laqad khadamtuhu tis'a siniyna maa 'alimtuhu qaala lishaa'in sana'tuhu lima fa'alta kadhaa wakadhaa aaw lishaa'in taraktuhu halaaa fa'alta kadhaa wakadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had the best disposition amongst people. He sent me on an errand one day, and I said:By Allah, I would not go. I had, however, this idea in my mind that I would do as Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had commanded me to do. I went out until I happened to come across children who had been playing in the street. In the meanwhile, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came there and he caught me by the back of my neck from behind me. As I looked towards him I found him smiling and he said: Unais, did you go where I commanded you to go? I said: Allah's Messenger, yes, I am going. Anas further said: I served him for nine years but I know not that he ever said to me about a thing which I had done why I did that, or about a thing I had left as to why I had not done that

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبَّادُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ، بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَأَلَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَرْجِعَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ جِئْتُ فَلَمْ أَجِدْكَ قَالَ أَبِي كَأَنَّهَا تَعْنِي الْمَوْتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدِينِي فَأْتِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، جُبَيْرَ بْنَ مُطْعِمٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَلَّمَتْهُ فِي شَىْءٍ فَأَمَرَهَا بِأَمْرٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ مُوسَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abbaadu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an muhammadi bni jubayri, bni mut'imin 'an aabiyhi, aanna amraaaaan, saaalat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shayiana faaamarahaa aan tarji'a iilayhi faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta iin jiitu falam aajidka qaala aabiy kaaannahaa ta'niy almawta ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ faiin lam tajidiyniy faatiy aabaa bakrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an aabiyhi, aakhbaraniy muhammadu bnu jubayri bni mut'imin, aanna aabaahu, jubayra bna mut'imin aakhbarahu aanna amraaaaan aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakallamathu fiy shaa'in faaamarahaa biaamrin ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi 'abbaadi bni muwsaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Jubair b. Mut'im reported on the authority of his father that a woman asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about something but lit, told her to come to him on some other occasion, whereupon she said:What in your opinion (should I do) if I come to you but do not find you, and it seemed as if she meant that he might die. Thereupon he said: If you do not find me, then come to Abu Bakr. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jubair b. Mut'im through another chain of transmitters (and the words are) that a woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and discussed with him something and he gave a command as we find in the above-mentioned narration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
