verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيُّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ تَخَلَّفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَخَلَّفْتُ مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا قَضَى حَاجَتَهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَعَكَ مَاءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِمَطْهَرَةٍ فَغَسَلَ كَفَّيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ يَحْسِرُ عَنْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ فَضَاقَ كُمُّ الْجُبَّةِ فَأَخْرَجَ يَدَهُ مِنْ تَحْتِ الْجُبَّةِ وَأَلْقَى الْجُبَّةَ عَلَى مَنْكِبَيْهِ وَغَسَلَ ذِرَاعَيْهِ وَمَسَحَ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ وَعَلَى الْعِمَامَةِ وَعَلَى خُفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ وَرَكِبْتُ فَانْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ وَقَدْ قَامُوا فِي الصَّلاَةِ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ وَقَدْ رَكَعَ بِهِمْ رَكْعَةً فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَهَبَ يَتَأَخَّرُ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقُمْتُ فَرَكَعْنَا الرَّكْعَةَ الَّتِي سَبَقَتْنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni baziy'in, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa humaydun alttawiylu, haddathanaa bakru bnu 'abdi alllahi almuzaniyyu, 'an 'urwaaa bni almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala takhallafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm watakhallaftu ma'ahu falammaa qadaa haajatahu qaala ‏ "‏ aama'aka maa'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaataytuhu bimatharaain faghasala kaffayhi wawajhahu thumma dhahaba yahsiru 'an dhiraa'ayhi fadaaqa kummu aljubbaai faaakhraja yadahu min tahti aljubbaai waaalqaa aljubbaaa 'alaa mankibayhi waghasala dhiraa'ayhi wamasaha binaasiyatihi wa'alaa al'imaamaai wa'alaa khuffayhi thumma rakiba warakibtu faantahaynaa iilaa alqawmi waqad qaamuwa fiy alssalaaai yusalliy bihim 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin waqad raka'a bihim rak'aaan falammaa aahassa bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhahaba yataaakhharu faaawmaaa iilayhi fasallaa bihim falammaa sallama qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waqumtu faraka'naa alrrak'aaa allatiy sabaqatnaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Urwa b. al Mughira b. Shu'ba reported it on the authority of his father that he said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) lagged behind (in a journey) and I also lagged behind along with him. After having relieved himself he said: Have you any water with you? I brought to him a jar of water; he washed his palms, and face, and when he tried to get his forearms out (he could not) for the sleeve of the gown was tight. He, therefore, brought them out from under the gown and, throwing it over his shoulders, he washed his forearm. He then wiped his forelock and his turban and his socks. He then mounted and I also mounted (the ride) and came to the people. They had begun the prayer with 'Abd ar-Rabmin b. 'Anf leading them and had completed a rak'a. When he perceived the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he began to retire. He (the Holy Prophet) signed to him to continue and offered prayer along with them. Then when he had pronounced the salutation, the Apostle (ﷺ) got up and I also got up with him, and we offered the rak'a which had been finished before we came
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَسَحَ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ وَمُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ وَعَلَى عِمَامَتِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aumayyaau bnu bistaama, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa haddathanaa almu'tamiru, 'an aabiyhi, qaala haddathaniy bakru bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni almughiyraai, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm masaha 'alaa alkhuffayni wamuqaddami raasihi wa'alaa 'imaamatihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Mughira narrated it from his father:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) wiped over his socks and over his forehead and over his turban
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, 'an aabiyhi, 'an bakrin, 'ani alhasani, 'ani abni almughiyraai, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Ibn Mughira on the authority of his father by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانِ، قَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ بَكْرٌ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ مِنِ ابْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَوَضَّأَ فَمَسَحَ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ وَعَلَى الْعِمَامَةِ وَعَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, jamiy'ana 'an yahyaa alqattaani, qaala abnu haatimin haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani alttaymiyyi, 'an bakri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alhasani, 'ani abni almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala bakrun waqad sami'tu mini abni almughiyraai, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm tawaddaaa famasaha binaasiyatihi wa'alaa al'imaamaai wa'alaa alkhuffayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bakr reported that he had heard from the son of Mughira that verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed ablution and wiped over his forehead and wiped over his turban and over his socks
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْمُلاَئِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُخَيْمِرَةَ، عَنْ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ هَانِئٍ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ أَسْأَلُهَا عَنِ الْمَسْحِ، عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ فَقَالَتْ عَلَيْكَ بِابْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَسَلْهُ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُسَافِرُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَسَأَلْنَاهُ فَقَالَ جَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَلَيَالِيَهُنَّ لِلْمُسَافِرِ وَيَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةً لِلْمُقِيمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ سُفْيَانُ إِذَا ذَكَرَ عَمْرًا أَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa althhawriyyu, 'an 'amriw bni qaysin almulaaiiyyi, 'ani alhakami bni 'utaybaaa, 'ani alqaasimi bni mukhaymiraaa, 'an shurayhi bni haaniiin, qaala aataytu 'aaiishaaa aasaaluhaa 'ani almashi, 'alaa alkhuffayni faqaalat 'alayka biabni aabiy taalibin fasalhu faiinnahu kaana yusaafiru ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fasaaalnaahu faqaala ja'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaathaaa aayyaamin walayaaliyahunna lilmusaafiri wayawmana walaylaaan lilmuqiymi ‏.‏ qaala wakaana sufyaanu iidhaa dhakara 'amrana aathnaa 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shuraih b. Hani said:I came to 'A'isha to ask her about wiping over the socks. She said: You better ask ('Ali) son of Abu Talib for he used to travel with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We asked him and he said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stipulated (the upper limit) of three days and three nights for a traveller and one day and one night for the resident
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa zakariyyaa'u bnu 'adiyyin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'amrinw, 'an zaydi bni aabiy aunaysaaa, 'ani alhakami, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Ubaidullah b. 'Amr and Zaid b. Abu Unaisa with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُخَيْمِرَةَ، عَنْ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ هَانِئٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ الْمَسْحِ، عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ فَقَالَتِ ائْتِ عَلِيًّا فَإِنَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِذَلِكَ مِنِّي فَأَتَيْتُ عَلِيًّا فَذَكَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'ani alhakami, 'ani alqaasimi bni mukhaymiraaa, 'an shurayhi bni haaniiin, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa 'ani almashi, 'alaa alkhuffayni faqaalati aiti 'aliyyana faiinnahu aa'lamu bidhalika minniy faaataytu 'aliyyana fadhakara 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shuraib b. Hani reported:I asked 'A'isha about wiping over the shoes. She said: You better go to 'Ali, for he knows more about this than I. I, therefore, came to 'Ali and he narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) like this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى الصَّلَوَاتِ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ بِوُضُوءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَمَسَحَ عَلَى خُفَّيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ لَقَدْ صَنَعْتَ الْيَوْمَ شَيْئًا لَمْ تَكُنْ تَصْنَعُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ عَمْدًا صَنَعْتُهُ يَا عُمَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'alqamaaa bni marthadin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy 'alqamaau bnu marthadin, 'an sulaymaana bni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa alssalawaati yawma alfathi biwuduw'in waahidin wamasaha 'alaa khuffayhi faqaala lahu 'umaru laqad sana'ta alyawma shayiana lam takun tasna'uhu ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ 'amdana sana'tuhu yaa 'umaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sulaiman b. Buraida narrated it from his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered prayers with one ablution on the day of the Conquest (of Mecca) and wiped over the socks. 'Umar said to him:You have today done something that you have not been accustomed to before. He (the Holy Prophet) said: 0 'Umar, I have done that on purpose
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، وَحَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ فَلاَ يَغْمِسْ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ حَتَّى يَغْسِلَهَا ثَلاَثًا فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي أَيْنَ بَاتَتْ يَدُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, wahaamidu bnu 'umara albakraawiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, 'an khaalidin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaqiyqin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa astayqaza aahadukum min nawmihi falaa yaghmis yadahu fiy aliinaa'i hattaa yaghsilahaa thalaathana faiinnahu laa yadriy aayna baatat yaduhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira said:When anyone amongst you wakes up from sleep, he must not put his hand in the utensil till he has washed it three times, for he does not know where his hand was during the night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ، وَأَبِي، صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ قَالَ يَرْفَعُهُ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy raziynin, waaabiy, saalihin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, fiy hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi wakiy'in qaala yarfa'uhu bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is transmitted from Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, h wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'ani abni almusayyabi, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zahri and Ibn Musayyab have both transmitted a hadith like this from Abu Huraira who narrated it from the Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُفْرِغْ عَلَى يَدِهِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْخِلَ يَدَهُ فِي إِنَائِهِ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي فِيمَ بَاتَتْ يَدُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, qaala haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu aakhbarahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa astayqaza aahadukum falyufrigh 'alaa yadihi thalaatha marraatin qabla aan yudkhila yadahu fiy iinaaiihi faiinnahu laa yadriy fiyma baatat yaduhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you wakes up from sleep, he should wash his hands three times before putting it in the utensil, for he does not know where his hand was during the night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَخْلَدٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَابْنُ، رَافِعٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادٌ، أَنَّ ثَابِتًا، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، فِي رِوَايَتِهِمْ جَمِيعًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ كُلُّهُمْ يَقُولُ حَتَّى يَغْسِلَهَا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ وَاحِدٌ مِنْهُمْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ إِلاَّ مَا قَدَّمْنَا مِنْ رِوَايَةِ جَابِرٍ وَابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ وَأَبِي صَالِحٍ وَأَبِي رَزِينٍ فَإِنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ ذِكْرَ الثَّلاَثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahadaathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, hadaathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy alhizaamiyaa - 'an aabiy alziinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, h wahadaathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyinn, hadaathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an hishaamin, 'an muhamaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, h wahadaathaniy aabuw kuraybin, hadaathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna makhladin - 'an muhamaadi bni ja'farin, 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, h wahadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu raafi'in, hadaathanaa 'abdu alraazaaaqi, hadaathanaa ma'marun, 'an hamaaami bni munabiihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, h wahadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu haatimin, hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu bakrin, h wahadaathanaa alhulwaaniyuu, waabnu, raafi'in qaalaa hadaathanaa 'abdu alraazaaaqi, qaalaa jamiy'ana aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy ziyaadun, aanaa thaabitana, mawlaa 'abdi alraahmani bni zaydin aakhbarahu aanaahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, fiy riwaayatihim jamiy'ana 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa alhadiythi kuluuhum yaquwlu hataaa yaghsilahaa ‏.‏ walam yaqul waahidun minhum thalaathana ‏.‏ iilaaa maa qadaamnaa min riwaayaai jaabirin waabni almusayaabi waaabiy salamaaa wa'abdi allaahi bni shaqiyqin waaabiy saalihin waaabiy raziynin faiinaa fiy hadiythihim dhikra althaalaathi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted through other chains of transmitters on the authority of Abu Huraira in which it is reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a mention of washing the hand, and did not instruct to wash it three times. But the hadith narrated from Jabir and Ibn Musayyab. Abu Salama, and Abdullah b. Shaqiq, Abu Salih, Abla Razin, there is a mention of" three times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ، وَأَبِي، صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيُرِقْهُ ثُمَّ لْيَغْسِلْهُ سَبْعَ مِرَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, aakhbaranaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy raziynin, waaabiy, saalihin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa walagha alkalbu fiy iinaa'i aahadikum falyuriqhu thumma lyaghsilhu sab'a miraarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to have said:When a dog licks a utensil belonging to any one of you, (the thing contained in it) should be thrown away and then (the utensil) should be washed seven times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ فَلْيُرِقْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu zakariyyaa'a, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu walam yaqul falyuriqhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by another chain of transmitters in which there is no mention of" throwing away
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا شَرِبَ الْكَلْبُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَغْسِلْهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa shariba alkalbu fiy iinaa'i aahadikum falyaghsilhu sab'a marraatin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When a dog drinks out of a vessel belonging to any one of you, he must wash it seven times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ طُهُورُ إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا وَلَغَ فِيهِ الْكَلْبُ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ أُولاَهُنَّ بِالتُّرَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an hishaami bni hassaanin, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tuhuwru iinaa'i aahadikum iidhaa walagha fiyhi alkalbu aan yaghsilahu sab'a marraatin auwlaahunna bialtturaabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The purification of the utensil belonging to any one of you, after it is licked by a dog, lies in washing it seven times, using sand for the first time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ طُهُورُ إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِيهِ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an muhammadin, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tuhuwru iinaa'i aahadikum iidhaa walagha alkalbu fiyhi aan yaghsilahu sab'a marraatin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:Of the a hadith narrated by Abu Huraira from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), one is this: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The purification of the utensil belonging to one amongst you, after it is licked by a dog, lies in washing it seven times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، سَمِعَ مُطَرِّفَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُغَفَّلِ، قَالَ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَتْلِ الْكِلاَبِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُهُمْ وَبَالُ الْكِلاَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَخَّصَ فِي كَلْبِ الصَّيْدِ وَكَلْبِ الْغَنَمِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِي الإِنَاءِ فَاغْسِلُوهُ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ وَعَفِّرُوهُ الثَّامِنَةَ فِي التُّرَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, sami'a mutarrifa bna 'abdi alllahi, yuhaddithu 'ani abni almughaffali, qaala aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biqatli alkilaabi thumma qaala ‏"‏ maa baaluhum wabaalu alkilaabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma rakhhasa fiy kalbi alssaydi wakalbi alghanami waqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa walagha alkalbu fiy aliinaa'i faaghsiluwhu sab'a marraatin wa'affiruwhu althhaaminaaa fiy altturaabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Mughaffal reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered killing of the dogs, and then said: What about them, i. e. about other dogs? and then granted concession (to keep) the dog for hunting and the dog for (the security) of the herd, and said: When the dog licks the utensil, wash it seven times, and rub it with earth the eighth time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي رِوَايَةِ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ مِنَ الزِّيَادَةِ وَرَخَّصَ فِي كَلْبِ الْغَنَمِ وَالصَّيْدِ وَالزَّرْعِ وَلَيْسَ ذَكَرَ الزَّرْعَ فِي الرِّوَايَةِ غَيْرُ يَحْيَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun ya'niy abna alhaarithi, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bimithlihi ghayra aanna fiy riwaayaai yahyaa bni sa'iydin mina alzziyaadaai warakhhasa fiy kalbi alghanami waalssaydi waalzzar'i walaysa dhakara alzzar'a fiy alrriwaayaai ghayru yahyaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated from Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters except for the fact that in the hadith transmitted by Yahya those words are:" He (the Holy Prophet) gave concession in the case of the dog for looking after the herd, for hunting and for watching the cultivated land," and there is no mention of this addition (i. e. concession in case of watching the cultivated lands) except in the hadith transmitted by Yahya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُبَالَ فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa aan yubaala fiy almaa'i alrraakidi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade to urinate in stagnant water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ ثُمَّ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an hishaamin, 'ani abni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yabuwlanna aahadukum fiy almaa'i alddaaiimi thumma yaghtasilu minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: None amongst you should urinate in standing water, and then wash in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبُلْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ الَّذِي لاَ يَجْرِي ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an muhammadin, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tabul fiy almaa'i alddaaiimi alladhiy laa yajriy thumma taghtasilu minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih said:Of the ahadith narrated to us by Abfi Huraira from Muhammad the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one is this: The Messenger or Allah (ﷺ) said: You should not urinate in standing water, that is not flowing, then wash in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، - قَالَ هَارُونُ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، - أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، أَنَّ أَبَا السَّائِبِ، مَوْلَى هِشَامِ بْنِ زُهْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَغْتَسِلُ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ يَتَنَاوَلُهُ تَنَاوُلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaabuw alttaahiri, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, jamiy'ana 'ani abni wahbin, - qaala haaruwnu haddathanaa abnu wahbin, - aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an bukayri bni alaashajji, aanna aabaa alssaaiibi, mawlaa hishaami bni zuhraaa haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yaghtasilu aahadukum fiy almaa'i alddaaiimi wahuwa junubun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala kayfa yaf'alu yaa aabaa hurayraaa qaala yatanaawaluhu tanaawulaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying:None of you must wash in standing water when he is in a state of Junub. And Abu Huraira was asked how it was to be done; he said: It was to be taken out in handfuls
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، بَالَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ دَعُوهُ وَلاَ تُزْرِمُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ دَعَا بِدَلْوٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَصَبَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hammaadun, - wahuwa abnu zaydin - 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, aanna aa'raabiyyana, baala fiy almasjidi faqaama iilayhi ba'du alqawmi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ da'uwhu walaa tuzrimuwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala falammaa faragha da'aa bidalwin min maa'in fasabbahu 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:A Bedouin urinated in the mosque. Some of the persons stood up (to reprimand him or to check him from doing so), but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leave him alone; don't interrupt him. He (the narrator) said: And when he had finished, he called for a bucket of water and poured it over
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الدَّرَاوَرْدِيِّ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، - عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَذْكُرُ أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، قَامَ إِلَى نَاحِيَةٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَبَالَ فِيهَا فَصَاحَ بِهِ النَّاسُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ دَعُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَنُوبٍ فَصُبَّ عَلَى بَوْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin alqattaanu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin alaansaariyyi, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, jamiy'ana 'ani alddaraawardiyyi, - qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin almadaniyyu, - 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yadhkuru aanna aa'raabiyyana, qaama iilaa naahiyaain fiy almasjidi fabaala fiyhaa fasaaha bihi alnnaasu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ da'uwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa faragha aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhanuwbin fasubba 'alaa bawlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik narrated that a desert Arab (Bedouin) stood in a corner of the mosque and urinated there. The people (the Companions of the Prophet who were present there) shouted, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Leave him alone. When he had finished, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered that a bucket (of water) should be brought and poured over it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، - وَهُوَ عَمُّ إِسْحَاقَ - قَالَ بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَامَ يَبُولُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَهْ مَهْ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُزْرِمُوهُ دَعُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَتَرَكُوهُ حَتَّى بَالَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعَاهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْمَسَاجِدَ لاَ تَصْلُحُ لِشَىْءٍ مِنْ هَذَا الْبَوْلِ وَلاَ الْقَذَرِ إِنَّمَا هِيَ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَالصَّلاَةِ وَقِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَمَرَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْقَوْمِ فَجَاءَ بِدَلْوٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَشَنَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu yuwnusa alhanafiyyu, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau bnu 'ammaarin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu aabiy talhaaa, haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin, - wahuwa 'ammu iishaaqa - qaala baynamaa nahnu fiy almasjidi ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh jaa'a aa'raabiyyun faqaama yabuwlu fiy almasjidi faqaala aashaabu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mah mah ‏.‏ qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tuzrimuwhu da'uwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fatarakuwhu hattaa baala ‏.‏ thumma iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm da'aahu faqaala lahu ‏"‏ iinna hadhihi almasaajida laa tasluhu lishaa'in min hadhaa albawli walaa alqadhari iinnamaa hiya lidhikri alllahi 'azza wajalla waalssalaaai waqiraa'aai alqurani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala faaamara rajulaan mina alqawmi fajaa'a bidalwin min maa'in fashannahu 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:While we were in the mosque with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), a desert Arab came and stood up and began to urinate in the mosque. The Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Stop, stop, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Don't interrupt him; leave him alone. They left him alone, and when he finished urinating, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called him and said to him: These mosques are not the places meant for urine and filth, but are only for the remembrance of Allah, prayer and the recitation of the Qur'an, or Allah's Messenger said something like that. He (the narrator) said that he (the Holy Prophet) then gave orders to one of the people who brought a bucket of water and poured It over
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُؤْتَى بِالصِّبْيَانِ فَيُبَرِّكُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيُحَنِّكُهُمْ فَأُتِيَ بِصَبِيٍّ فَبَالَ عَلَيْهِ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَأَتْبَعَهُ بَوْلَهُ وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yuutaa bialssibyaani fayubarriku 'alayhim wayuhannikuhum faautiya bisabiyyin fabaala 'alayhi fada'aa bimaa'in faaatba'ahu bawlahu walam yaghsilhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ) said:Babies were brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he blessed them, and after having chewed (something, e. g. dates or any other sweet thing) he rubbed there with their soft palates. A baby was brought to him and he passed water over him (over his garment), so he asked water to be brought and sprinkled it, but he did not wash it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِصَبِيٍّ يَرْضَعُ فَبَالَ فِي حِجْرِهِ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَصَبَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bisabiyyin yarda'u fabaala fiy hijrihi fada'aa bimaa'in fasabbahu 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:A suckling babe was brought to the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) and he urinated in his tap. He (the Holy Prophet) sent for water and poured it over
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithla hadiythi abni numayrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham narrated the hadith like one transmitted by Ibn Numair (the above mentioned one) with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ، أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لَهَا لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ فَوَضَعَتْهُ فِي حِجْرِهِ فَبَالَ - قَالَ - فَلَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَى أَنْ نَضَحَ بِالْمَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aummi qaysin binti mihsanin, aannahaa aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biabnin lahaa lam yaakuli altta'aama fawada'athu fiy hijrihi fabaala - qaala - falam yazid 'alaa aan nadaha bialmaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Qais daughter of Mihsan reported that she came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with her child. who was not yet weaned, and she placed him in his lap; and he urinated in his (Holy Prophet's) lap. He (the Holy Prophet) did nothing more than spraying water over it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَرَشَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala fada'aa bimaa'in farashhahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has also been narrated from al-Zuhri with the same chain of narrators. (but for the words):" He (the Holy Prophet) sent for water and sprinkled it over
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ أَمَّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتَ مِحْصَنٍ، - وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرَاتِ الأُوَلِ اللاَّتِي بَايَعْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ أُخْتُ عُكَّاشَةَ بْنِ مِحْصَنٍ أَحَدُ بَنِي أَسَدِ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لَهَا لَمْ يَبْلُغْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الطَّعَامَ - قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ - أَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّ ابْنَهَا ذَاكَ بَالَ فِي حِجْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَاءٍ فَنَضَحَهُ عَلَى ثَوْبِهِ وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْهُ غَسْلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, aanna abna shihaabin, aakhbarahu qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna aamma qaysin binta mihsanin, - wakaanat mina almuhaajiraati alauwali allaaatiy baaya'na rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya aukhtu 'ukkaashaaa bni mihsanin aahadu baniy aasadi bni khuzaymaaa - qaala aakhbaratniy aannahaa aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biabnin lahaa lam yablugh aan yaakula altta'aama - qaala 'ubaydu alllahi - aakhbaratniy aanna abnahaa dhaaka baala fiy hijri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fada'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimaa'in fanadahahu 'alaa thawbihi walam yaghsilhu ghaslaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah b. Abdullah b. 'Utba b. Mas'ud said:Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, was among the earliest female emigrants who took the oath of allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and she was the sister of 'Ukkasha b. Mihsan, one amongst the sons of Asad b. Khuzaima. He (the narrator) said: She (Umm Qais) told me that she came to the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) with her son and he had not attained the age of eating food. He (the narrator, 'Ubaidullah), said: She told me that her son passed urine in the lap of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent for water and sprayed it over his garment (over that part which was contaminated with the urine of the child) and he did not wash it thoroughly
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَالأَسْوَدِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، نَزَلَ بِعَائِشَةَ فَأَصْبَحَ يَغْسِلُ ثَوْبَهُ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِنَّمَا كَانَ يُجْزِئُكَ إِنْ رَأَيْتَهُ أَنْ تَغْسِلَ مَكَانَهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَرَ نَضَحْتَ حَوْلَهُ وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي أَفْرُكُهُ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرْكًا فَيُصَلِّي فِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an khaalidin, 'an aabiy ma'sharin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, waalaaswadi, aanna rajulaan, nazala bi'aaiishaaa faaasbaha yaghsilu thawbahu faqaalat 'aaiishaau iinnamaa kaana yujziiuka iin raaaytahu aan taghsila makaanahu faiin lam tara nadahta hawlahu walaqad raaaytuniy aafrukuhu min thawbi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm farkana fayusalliy fiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Alqama and Aswad reported:A person stayed in the house of A'isha and in the morning began to wash his garment. A'isha said: In case you saw it (i. e. drop of semen), it would have served the purpose (of purifying the garment) if you had simply washed that spot; and in case you did not see it, it would have been enough to sprinkle water around it, for when I saw that on the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I simply scraped it off and he offered prayer, while putting that on
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، وَهَمَّامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي الْمَنِيِّ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَفْرُكُهُ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, wahammaamin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy almaniyyi qaalat kuntu aafrukuhu min thawbi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Aawad and Hammam reported A'isha as saying:I used to scrape off the (drop of) semen from the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مَهْدِيِّ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ الأَحْدَبِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، وَمُغِيرَةَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي حَتِّ الْمَنِيِّ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - 'an hishaami bni hassaana, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy ma'sharin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an mughiyraaa, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an mahdiyyi bni maymuwnin, 'an waasilin alaahdabi, h wahaddathaniy abnu haatimin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an mansuwrin, wamughiyraaa, kullu hauulaa'i 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy hatti almaniyyi min thawbi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwa hadiythi khaalidin 'an aabiy ma'sharin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qutaiba b. Sa'id, Ishaq b. Ibrahim, Ibn Abi 'Aruba, Abu Ma'shar, Abu Bakr b. Abu Shaiba, Mansur and Mughira have all transmitted from Ibrahim, who transmitted it on the authority of A'isha's narration pertaining to the scraping off of the (drop) of semen from the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) like the hadith of Khalid on the authority of Abu Ma'shar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an hammaamin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam narrated the hadith from A'isha like the (above-mentioned) traditions
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ عَنِ الْمَنِيِّ، يُصِيبُ ثَوْبَ الرَّجُلِ أَيَغْسِلُهُ أَمْ يَغْسِلُ الثَّوْبَ فَقَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَغْسِلُ الْمَنِيَّ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فِي ذَلِكَ الثَّوْبِ وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَثَرِ الْغَسْلِ فِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, 'an 'amriw bni maymuwnin, qaala saaaltu sulaymaana bna yasaarin 'ani almaniyyi, yusiybu thawba alrrajuli aayaghsiluhu aam yaghsilu althhawba faqaala aakhbaratniy 'aaiishaau aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaghsilu almaniyya thumma yakhruju iilaa alssalaaai fiy dhalika althhawbi waaanaa aanzuru iilaa aathari alghasli fiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. Maimun said:I asked Sulaiman b. Yasar whether the semen that gets on to the garment of a person should be washed or not. He replied: A'isha told me: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) washed the semen, and then went out for prayer in that very garment and I saw the mark of washing on it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، وَابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَمَّا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ فَحَدِيثُهُ كَمَا قَالَ ابْنُ بِشْرٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَغْسِلُ الْمَنِيَّ وَأَمَّا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ وَعَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ فَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُهُ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, aakhbaranaa abnu almubaaraki, waabnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, kulluhum 'an 'amriw bni maymuwnin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aammaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa fahadiythuhu kamaa qaala abnu bishrin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaghsilu almaniyya waaammaa abnu almubaaraki wa'abdu alwaahidi fafiy hadiythihimaa qaalat kuntu aaghsiluhu min thawbi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Kuraib, Ibn al-Mubarak, Ibn Abu Za'ida all of them narrated from Amr b. Maimun with the same chain of transmitters. Ibn Abu Za'ida narrated as was transmitted from Ibn Bishr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) washed semen, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Mabarak and Abdul Wahid the words are:" She (A'isha) reported: I used to wash it from the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ جَوَّاسٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ شَبِيبِ بْنِ غَرْقَدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ نَازِلاً عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَاحْتَلَمْتُ فِي ثَوْبَىَّ فَغَمَسْتُهُمَا فِي الْمَاءِ فَرَأَتْنِي جَارِيَةٌ لِعَائِشَةَ فَأَخْبَرَتْهَا فَبَعَثَتْ إِلَىَّ عَائِشَةُ فَقَالَتْ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا صَنَعْتَ بِثَوْبَيْكَ قَالَ قُلْتُ رَأَيْتُ مَا يَرَى النَّائِمُ فِي مَنَامِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ هَلْ رَأَيْتَ فِيهِمَا شَيْئًا ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَوْ رَأَيْتَ شَيْئًا غَسَلْتَهُ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي وَإِنِّي لأَحُكُّهُ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَابِسًا بِظُفُرِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu jawwaasin alhanafiyyu aabuw 'aasimin, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an shabiybi bni gharqadaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shihaabin alkhawlaaniyyi, qaala kuntu naazilaan 'alaa 'aaiishaaa faahtalamtu fiy thawbaaaa faghamastuhumaa fiy almaa'i faraaatniy jaariyaaun li'aaiishaaa faaakhbarathaa faba'athat iilaaaa 'aaiishaau faqaalat maa hamalaka 'alaa maa sana'ta bithawbayka qaala qultu raaaytu maa yaraa alnnaaiimu fiy manaamihi ‏.‏ qaalat hal raaayta fiyhimaa shayiana ‏.‏ qultu laa ‏.‏ qaalat falaw raaayta shayiana ghasaltahu laqad raaaytuniy waiinniy laahukkuhu min thawbi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaabisana bizufuriy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Shihab al-Khaulani reported:I stayed in the house of 'A'isha and had a wet dream (and perceived its effect on my garment), so (in the morning) I dipped both (the clothes) in water. This (act of mine) was watched by a maid-servant of A'isha and she informed her. She (Hadrat A'isha) sent me a message: Whatprompted you to act like this with your clothes? He (the narrator) said: I told that I saw in a dream what a sleeper sees. She said: Did you find (any mark of the fluid) on your clothes? I said: No. She said: Had you found anything you should have washed it. Incase I found that (semen) on the garment of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dried up, I scraped it off with my nails
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي فَاطِمَةُ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِحْدَانَا يُصِيبُ ثَوْبَهَا مِنْ دَمِ الْحَيْضَةِ كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ بِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَحُتُّهُ ثُمَّ تَقْرُصُهُ بِالْمَاءِ ثُمَّ تَنْضَحُهُ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, qaala haddathatniy faatimaau, 'an aasmaa'a, qaalat jaa'ati amraaaaun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat iihdaanaa yusiybu thawbahaa min dami alhaydaai kayfa tasna'u bihi qaala ‏ "‏ tahuttuhu thumma taqrusuhu bialmaa'i thumma tandahuhu thumma tusalliy fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asma (daughter of Abu Bakr) reported:A woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: What should one do if the blood of menses smears the garment of one amongst us? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: She should scrape it, then rub it with water, then pour water over it and then offer prayer in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، وَمَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yahyaa bnu 'abdi alllahi bni saalimin, wamaaliku bnu aanasin, wa'amruw bnu alhaarithi, kulluhum 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithla hadiythi yahyaa bni sa'iydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition is narrated by Abu Kuraib, Ibn Numair, Abu Tahir, Ibn Wahb, Yahya b. 'Abdullah b. Salim, Malik b. Anas, 'Amr b. Harith on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa, with the same chain of transmitters like one transmitted by Yahya b. Sa'id like the above-mentioned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى قَبْرَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَكَانَ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ وَأَمَّا الآخَرُ فَكَانَ لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَعَا بِعَسِيبٍ رَطْبٍ فَشَقَّهُ بِاثْنَيْنِ ثُمَّ غَرَسَ عَلَى هَذَا وَاحِدًا وَعَلَى هَذَا وَاحِدًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يُخَفَّفَ عَنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَيْبَسَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, waaabuw kuraybin muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala sami'tu mujaahidana, yuhaddithu 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala marra rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa qabrayni faqaala ‏"‏ aamaa iinnahumaa layu'adhhabaani wamaa yu'adhhabaani fiy kabiyrin aammaa aahaduhumaa fakaana yamshiy bialnnamiymaai waaammaa alakharu fakaana laa yastatiru min bawlihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fada'aa bi'asiybin ratbin fashaqqahu biathnayni thumma gharasa 'alaa hadhaa waahidana wa'alaa hadhaa waahidana thumma qaala ‏"‏ la'allahu aan yukhaffafa 'anhumaa maa lam yaybasaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by two graves and said: They (their occupants) are being tormented, but they are not tormented for a grievous sin. One of them carried tales and the other did not keep himself safe from being defiled by urine. He then called for a fresh twig and split it into two parts, and planted them on each grave and then said: Perhaps, their punishment way be mitigated as long as these twigs remain fresh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِيهِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَكَانَ الآخَرُ لاَ يَسْتَنْزِهُ عَنِ الْبَوْلِ أَوْ مِنَ الْبَوْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniyhi aahmadu bnu yuwsufa alaazdiyyu, haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, 'an sulaymaana alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ wakaana alakharu laa yastanzihu 'ani albawli aaw mina albawli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is transmitted from A'mash by Abmad b. Yusuf al-Azdi, Mu'alla b. Asad, Abd al-Wahid, Sulaiman with the same chain of transmitters but for the words:" The other did not keep himself safe from being defiled by urine
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ إِحْدَانَا إِذَا كَانَتْ حَائِضًا أَمَرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَأْتَزِرُ بِإِزَارٍ ثُمَّ يُبَاشِرُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana iihdaanaa iidhaa kaanat haaiidana aamarahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fataataziru biiizaarin thumma yubaashiruhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When anyone amongst us (amongst the wives of the Holy Prophet) menstruated, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked her to tie a waist-wrapper over her (body) and then embraced her
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ إِحْدَانَا إِذَا كَانَتْ حَائِضًا أَمَرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تَأْتَزِرَ فِي فَوْرِ حَيْضَتِهَا ثُمَّ يُبَاشِرُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَأَيُّكُمْ يَمْلِكُ إِرْبَهُ كَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْلِكُ إِرْبَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, aakhbaranaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alaaswadi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana iihdaanaa iidhaa kaanat haaiidana aamarahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan taatazira fiy fawri haydatihaa thumma yubaashiruhaa ‏.‏ qaalat waaayyukum yamliku iirbahu kamaa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamliku iirbahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When anyone amongst us was menstruating the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked her to tie waist-wrapper daring the time when the menstrual blood profusely flowed and then embraced her; and she ('A'isha) observed: And who amongst you can have control over his desires as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had over his desires
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُبَاشِرُ نِسَاءَهُ فَوْقَ الإِزَارِ وَهُنَّ حُيَّضٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaddaadin, 'an maymuwnaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yubaashiru nisaa'ahu fawqa aliizaari wahunna huyyadun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Maimuna (the wife of the Holy Prophet) reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) contacted and embraced his wives over the waist-wrapper when they were menstruating
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَضْطَجِعُ مَعِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ وَبَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ ثَوْبٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an makhramaaa, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy makhramaau, 'an aabiyhi, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin qaala sami'tu maymuwnaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadtaji'u ma'iy waaanaa haaiidun wabayniy wabaynahu thawbun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Kuraibthe freed slave of Ibn Abbas, reported:I heard it from Maimuna, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to lie with me when I menstruated, and there was a cloth between me and him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَتْهَا قَالَتْ، بَيْنَمَا أَنَا مُضْطَجِعَةٌ، مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ إِذْ حِضْتُ فَانْسَلَلْتُ فَأَخَذْتُ ثِيَابَ حَيْضَتِي فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنُفِسْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَدَعَانِي فَاضْطَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَكَانَتْ هِيَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْتَسِلاَنِ فِي الإِنَاءِ الْوَاحِدِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna zaynaba binta aummi salamaaa, haddathathu aanna aumma salamaaa haddathathaa qaalat, baynamaa aanaa mudtaji'aaun, ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alkhamiylaai iidh hidtu faansalaltu faaakhadhtu thiyaaba haydatiy faqaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanufisti ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu na'am ‏.‏ fada'aaniy faadtaja'tu ma'ahu fiy alkhamiylaai ‏.‏ qaalat wakaanat hiya warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaghtasilaani fiy aliinaa'i alwaahidi mina aljanaabaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama reported:While I was lying with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a bed cover I menstruated, so I slipped away and I took up the clothes (which I wore) in menses. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Have you menstruated? I said: Yes. He called me and I lay down
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اعْتَكَفَ يُدْنِي إِلَىَّ رَأْسَهُ فَأُرَجِّلُهُ وَكَانَ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْبَيْتَ إِلاَّ لِحَاجَةِ الإِنْسَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa a'takafa yudniy iilaaaa raasahu faaurajjiluhu wakaana laa yadkhulu albayta iilaaa lihaajaai aliinsaani ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported from 'A'isha that she observed:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in I'tikaf, he inclined his head towards me and I combedhis hair, and he did not enter the house but for the natural calls (for relieving himself)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، وَعَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ إِنْ كُنْتُ لأَدْخُلُ الْبَيْتَ لِلْحَاجَةِ وَالْمَرِيضُ فِيهِ فَمَا أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ إِلاَّ وَأَنَا مَارَّةٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيُدْخِلُ عَلَىَّ رَأْسَهُ وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَأُرَجِّلُهُ وَكَانَ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْبَيْتَ إِلاَّ لِحَاجَةٍ إِذَا كَانَ مُعْتَكِفًا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ إِذَا كَانُوا مُعْتَكِفِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, qaala aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, wa'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat iin kuntu laadkhulu albayta lilhaajaai waalmariydu fiyhi famaa aasaalu 'anhu iilaaa waaanaa maarraaun waiin kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm layudkhilu 'alaaaa raasahu wahuwa fiy almasjidi faaurajjiluhu wakaana laa yadkhulu albayta iilaaa lihaajaain iidhaa kaana mu'takifana ‏.‏ waqaala abnu rumhin iidhaa kaanuwa mu'takifiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amra daughter of 'Abd al-Rahman reported:'A'isha, wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed: When I was (in I'tikaf), I entered the house for the call of nature, and while passing I inquired after the health of the sick (in the. family), and when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was (in I'tikaf), he put out his head towards me, while he himself was in the mosque, and I combed his hair; and he did not enter the house except for the call of nature so long as he was In I'tikaf; and Ibn Rumh stated: As long as they (the Prophet and his wives) were among the observers of I'tikaf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُخْرِجُ إِلَىَّ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ وَهُوَ مُجَاوِرٌ فَأَغْسِلُهُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni nawfalin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yukhriju iilaaaa raasahu mina almasjidi wahuwa mujaawirun faaaghsiluhu waaanaa haaiidun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Apostle (may peace he upon him), reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) put out from the mosque his head for me as he was in I'tikaf, and I washed it in the state that I was menstruating
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُرْوَةُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُدْنِي إِلَىَّ رَأْسَهُ وَأَنَا فِي حُجْرَتِي فَأُرَجِّلُ رَأْسَهُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an hishaamin, aakhbaranaa 'urwaau, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yudniy iilaaaa raasahu waaanaa fiy hujratiy faaurajjilu raasahu waaanaa haaiidun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Urwa reported it from 'A'isha that she observed:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) inclined his head towards me (from the mosque) while I was in my apartment and I combed it in a state of menstruation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aaghsilu raasa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa haaiidun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Aswad narrated it from 'A'isha that she observed:I used to wash the head of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), while I was in a state of menstruation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نَاوِلِينِي الْخُمْرَةَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي حَائِضٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ حَيْضَتَكِ لَيْسَتْ فِي يَدِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an thaabiti bni 'ubaydin, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ naawiliyniy alkhumraaa mina almasjidi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu iinniy haaiidun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinna haydataki laysat fiy yadiki ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: Get me the mat from the mosque. I said: I am menstruating. Upon this he remarked: Your menstruation is not in your hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، وَابْنِ أَبِي غَنِيَّةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أُنَاوِلَهُ الْخُمْرَةَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي حَائِضٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ تَنَاوَلِيهَا فَإِنَّ الْحَيْضَةَ لَيْسَتْ فِي يَدِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an hajjaajin, waabni aabiy ghaniyyaaa, 'an thaabiti bni 'ubaydin, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat aamaraniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aunaawilahu alkhumraaa mina almasjidi ‏.‏ faqultu iinniy haaiidun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ tanaawaliyhaa faiinna alhaydaaa laysat fiy yadiki ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered me that I should get him the mat from the mosque. I said: I am menstruating. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Do get me that, for menstruation is not in your hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ نَاوِلِينِي الثَّوْبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي حَائِضٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ حَيْضَتَكِ لَيْسَتْ فِي يَدِكِ ‏"‏ فَنَاوَلَتْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw kaamilin wamuhammadu bnu haatimin kulluhum 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa yahyaa, - 'an yaziyda bni kaysaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala baynamaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almasjidi faqaala ‏"‏ yaa 'aaiishaau naawiliyniy althhawba ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat iinniy haaiidun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinna haydataki laysat fiy yadiki ‏"‏ fanaawalathu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:While the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in the mosque, he said: O 'A'isha, get me that garment. She said: I am menstruating. Upon this he remarked: Your menstruation is not in your hand, and she, therefore, got him that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، وَسُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَشْرَبُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، ثُمَّ أُنَاوِلُهُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَضَعُ فَاهُ عَلَى مَوْضِعِ فِيَّ فَيَشْرَبُ وَأَتَعَرَّقُ الْعَرْقَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ ثُمَّ أُنَاوِلُهُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَضَعُ فَاهُ عَلَى مَوْضِعِ فِيَّ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ زُهَيْرٌ فَيَشْرَبُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an mis'arin, wasufyaana, 'ani almiqdaami bni shurayhin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aashrabu waaanaa haaiidun, thumma aunaawiluhu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fayada'u faahu 'alaa mawdi'i fiyya fayashrabu waaata'arraqu al'arqa waaanaa haaiidun thumma aunaawiluhu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fayada'u faahu 'alaa mawdi'i fiyya ‏.‏ walam yadhkur zuhayrun fayashrabu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:I would drink when I was menstruating, then I would hand it (the vessel) to the Apostle (ﷺ) and he would put his mouth where mine had been, and drink, and I would eat flesh from a bone when I was menstruating, then hand it over to the Apostle (ﷺ) and he would put his mouth where mine had been. Zuhair made no mention of (the Holy Prophet's) drinking
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَكِّيُّ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَّكِئُ فِي حِجْرِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ فَيَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa daawudu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani almakkiyyu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aummihi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yattakiiu fiy hijriy waaanaa haaiidun fayaqraau alqurana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would recline in my lap when I was menstruating, and recite the Qur'an
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ، كَانُوا إِذَا حَاضَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فِيهِمْ لَمْ يُؤَاكِلُوهَا وَلَمْ يُجَامِعُوهُنَّ فِي الْبُيُوتِ فَسَأَلَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اصْنَعُوا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ النِّكَاحَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ الْيَهُودَ فَقَالُوا مَا يُرِيدُ هَذَا الرَّجُلُ أَنْ يَدَعَ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا شَيْئًا إِلاَّ خَالَفَنَا فِيهِ فَجَاءَ أُسَيْدُ بْنُ حُضَيْرٍ وَعَبَّادُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ فَقَالاَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الْيَهُودَ تَقُولُ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ فَلاَ نُجَامِعُهُنَّ فَتَغَيَّرَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنْ قَدْ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِمَا فَخَرَجَا فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُمَا هَدِيَّةٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرْسَلَ فِي آثَارِهِمَا فَسَقَاهُمَا فَعَرَفَا أَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ عَلَيْهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasin, aanna alyahuwda, kaanuwa iidhaa haadati almaraaau fiyhim lam yuuaakiluwhaa walam yujaami'uwhunna fiy albuyuwti fasaaala aashaabu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏ wayasaaluwnaka 'ani almahiydi qul huwa aadhana faa'taziluwa alnnisaa'a fiy almahiydi‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ asna'uwa kulla shaa'in iilaaa alnnikaaha ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fabalagha dhalika alyahuwda faqaaluwa maa yuriydu hadhaa alrrajulu aan yada'a min aamrinaa shayiana iilaaa khaalafanaa fiyhi fajaa'a ausaydu bnu hudayrin wa'abbaadu bnu bishrin faqaalaa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna alyahuwda taquwlu kadhaa wakadhaa ‏.‏ falaa nujaami'uhunna fataghayyara wajhu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa zanannaa aan qad wajada 'alayhimaa fakharajaa faastaqbalahumaa hadiyyaaun min labanin iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaarsala fiy athaarihimaa fasaqaahumaa fa'arafaa aan lam yajid 'alayhimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thabit narrated it from Anas:Among the Jews, when a woman menstruated, they did not dine with her, nor did they live with them in their houses; so the Companions of the Apostle (ﷺ) asked The Apostle (ﷺ), and Allah, the Exalted revealed:" And they ask you about menstruation; say it is a pollution, so keep away from woman during menstruation" to the end (Qur'an, ii. 222). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do everything except intercourse. The Jews heard of that and said: This man does not want to leave anything we do without opposing us in it. Usaid b. Hudair and Abbad b. Bishr came and said: Messenger of Allah, the Jews say such and such thing. We should not have, therefore, any contactwith them (as the Jews do). The face of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) underwent such a change that we thought he was angry with them, but when they went out, they happened to receive a gift of milk which was sent to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) called for them and gave them drink, whereby they knew that he was not angry with them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ وَهُشَيْمٌ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُنْذِرِ بْنِ يَعْلَى، - وَيُكْنَى أَبَا يَعْلَى - عَنِ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ رَجُلاً مَذَّاءً وَكُنْتُ أَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ أَسْأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمَكَانِ ابْنَتِهِ فَأَمَرْتُ الْمِقْدَادَ بْنَ الأَسْوَدِ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَغْسِلُ ذَكَرَهُ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa wahushaymun 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an mundhiri bni ya'laa, - wayuknaa aabaa ya'laa - 'ani abni alhanafiyyaai, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala kuntu rajulaan madhhaa'an wakuntu aastahyiy aan aasaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm limakaani abnatihi faaamartu almiqdaada bna alaaswadi fasaaalahu faqaala ‏ "‏ yaghsilu dhakarahu wayatawaddaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
