verses.translation: Ali reported:I was one whose prostatic fluid flowed readily and I was ashamed to ask the Apostle (ﷺ) about it, because of the position of his daughter. I, therefore, asked Miqdad. b. al-Asad and he inquired of him (the Holy Prophet). He (the Holy Prophet) said: He should wash his male organ and perform ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُنْذِرًا، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ اسْتَحْيَيْتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَ، النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمَذْىِ مِنْ أَجْلِ فَاطِمَةَ فَأَمَرْتُ الْمِقْدَادَ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مِنْهُ الْوُضُوءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaraniy sulaymaanu, qaala sami'tu mundhirana, 'an muhammadi bni 'aliyyin, 'an 'aliyyin, aannahu qaala astahyaytu aan aasaala, alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almadhai min aajli faatimaaa faaamartu almiqdaada fasaaalahu faqaala ‏ "‏ minhu alwuduw'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported:I felt shy of asking about prostatic fluid from the Apostle (ﷺ) because of Fatimah. I, therefore, asked al-Miqdad (to ask on my behalf) and he asked. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Ablution is obligatory in such a case
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَرْسَلْنَا الْمِقْدَادَ بْنَ الأَسْوَدِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْمَذْىِ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الإِنْسَانِ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ بِهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَوَضَّأْ وَانْضَحْ فَرْجَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy makhramaau bnu bukayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala 'aliyyu bnu aabiy taalibin aarsalnaa almiqdaada bna alaaswadi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu 'ani almadhai yakhruju mina aliinsaani kayfa yaf'alu bihi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tawaddaa waandah farjaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported it from 'Ali:We sent al-Miqdad b. al-Aswad to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to ask him what must be done about prostatic fluid which flows from (the private part of) a person. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Perform ablution and wash your sexual organ
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَضَى حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ نَامَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama mina alllayli faqadaa haajatahu thumma ghasala wajhahu wayadayhi thumma naama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Apostle (ﷺ) woke up at night; relieved himself, and then washed his face and hands and then again slept
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنَامَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aaraada aan yanaama wahuwa junubun tawaddaaa wuduw'ahu lilssalaaai qabla aan yanaama ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) intended to sleep after having sexual intercourse, he performed ablution as for the prayer before going to sleep
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، وَغُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا كَانَ جُنُبًا فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ أَوْ يَنَامَ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, wawakiy'un, waghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, 'ani alhakami, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa kaana junubana faaaraada aan yaakula aaw yanaama tawaddaaa wuduw'ahu lilssalaaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Whenever the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had sexual intercourse and intended to eat or sleep, he performed the ablution of prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى فِي حَدِيثِهِ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ، سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، يُحَدِّثُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala abnu almuthannaa fiy hadiythihi haddathanaa alhakamu, sami'tu iibraahiyma, yuhaddithu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters. Ibn at-Muthanna said in his narration:AI-Hakam narrated to us who heard from Ibrahim narrating that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا - قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيَرْقُدُ أَحَدُنَا وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin - waalllafzu lahumaa - qaala abnu numayrin haddathanaa aabiy waqaala aabuw bakrin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, - qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara, qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aayarqudu aahadunaa wahuwa junubun qaala ‏ "‏ na'am iidhaa tawaddaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:Umar said: Is one amongst us permitted to sleep in a state of impurity (i. e. after having sexual intercourse)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes, after performing ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، اسْتَفْتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ هَلْ يَنَامُ أَحَدُنَا وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ لِيَتَوَضَّأْ ثُمَّ لْيَنَمْ حَتَّى يَغْتَسِلَ إِذَا شَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara, astaftaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala hal yanaamu aahadunaa wahuwa junubun qaala ‏ "‏ na'am liyatawaddaa thumma lyanam hattaa yaghtasila iidhaa shaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar said:'Umar asked the verdict of the Shari'ah from the Apostle (ﷺ) thus: Is it permissible for any one of us to sleep in a state of impurity? He (the Prophet said: Yes, he must perform ablution and then sleep and take a bath when he desires)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ ذَكَرَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ تُصِيبُهُ جَنَابَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَوَضَّأْ وَاغْسِلْ ذَكَرَكَ ثُمَّ نَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala dhakara 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu tusiybuhu janaabaaun mina alllayli faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tawaddaa waaghsil dhakaraka thumma nam ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:Umar b. al-Khattab said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), that he became Junbi during the night. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Perform ablution, wash your sexual organ and then go to sleep
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ وِتْرِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ كَانَ يَصْنَعُ فِي الْجَنَابَةِ أَكَانَ يَغْتَسِلُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنَامَ أَمْ يَنَامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ قَالَتْ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ قَدْ كَانَ يَفْعَلُ رُبَّمَا اغْتَسَلَ فَنَامَ وَرُبَّمَا تَوَضَّأَ فَنَامَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي الأَمْرِ سَعَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni saalihin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qaysin, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa 'an witri, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara alhadiytha qultu kayfa kaana yasna'u fiy aljanaabaai aakaana yaghtasilu qabla aan yanaama aam yanaamu qabla aan yaghtasila qaalat kullu dhalika qad kaana yaf'alu rubbamaa aghtasala fanaama warubbamaa tawaddaaa fanaama ‏.‏ qultu alhamdu lillahi alladhiy ja'ala fiy alaamri sa'aaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abu'l-Qais reported:I asked 'A'isha about the Witr (prayer) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and made mention of a hadith, then I said: What did he do after having sexual intercourse? Did he take a bath before going to sleep or did he sleep before taking a bath? She said: He did all these. Some- times he took a bath and then slept, and sometimes he performed ablution only and went to sleep. I (the narrator) said: Praise be to Allah Who has made things easy (for human beings)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, h wahaddathaniyhi haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, jamiy'ana 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni saalihin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted with the same chain of transmitters from Mu'awyia b. Salih by Zuhair b. Harb, 'Abd al-Rahman b. Mahdi, Harun b. Sa'id al-'Aili and Ibn Wahb
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَعُودَ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ بَيْنَهُمَا وُضُوءًا وَقَالَ ثُمَّ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُعَاوِدَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, h wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa alfazaariyyu, kulluhum 'an 'aasimin, 'an aabiy almutawakkili, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aataa aahadukum aahlahu thumma aaraada aan ya'uwda falyatawaddaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ zaada aabuw bakrin fiy hadiythihi baynahumaa wuduw'ana waqaala thumma aaraada aan yu'aawida ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you has sexual intercourse with his wife and then he intends to repeat it, he should perform ablution. In the hadith transmitted by Abu Bakr. (the words are):" Between the two (acts) there should be an ablution," or he (the narrator) said:" Then he intended that it should be repeated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي شُعَيْبٍ الْحَرَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْكِينٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بُكَيْرٍ الْحَذَّاءَ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ بِغُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alhasanu bnu aahmada bni aabiy shu'aybin alharraaniyyu, haddathanaa miskiynun, - ya'niy abna bukayrin alhadhhaa'a - 'an shu'baaa, 'an hishaami bni zaydin, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yatuwfu 'alaa nisaaiihi bighuslin waahidin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to have sexual intercourse with his wives with a single bath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، قَالَ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ جَاءَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ - وَهِيَ جَدَّةُ إِسْحَاقَ - إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ لَهُ وَعَائِشَةُ عِنْدَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الْمَرْأَةُ تَرَى مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ فِي الْمَنَامِ فَتَرَى مِنْ نَفْسِهَا مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ فَضَحْتِ النِّسَاءَ تَرِبَتْ يَمِينُكِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِعَائِشَةَ ‏ "‏ بَلْ أَنْتِ فَتَرِبَتْ يَمِينُكِ نَعَمْ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ إِذَا رَأَتْ ذَاكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu yuwnusa alhanafiyyu, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau bnu 'ammaarin, qaala qaala iishaaqu bnu aabiy talhaaa haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala jaa'at aummu sulaymin - wahiya jaddaau iishaaqa - iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat lahu wa'aaiishaau 'indahu yaa rasuwla alllahi almaraaau taraa maa yaraa alrrajulu fiy almanaami fataraa min nafsihaa maa yaraa alrrajulu min nafsihi ‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau yaa aumma sulaymin fadahti alnnisaa'a taribat yamiynuki ‏.‏ faqaala li'aaiishaaa ‏ "‏ bal aanti fataribat yamiynuki na'am faltaghtasil yaa aumma sulaymin iidhaa raaat dhaaki ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:Umm Sulaim who was the grandmother of Ishaq came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the presence of 'A'isha and said to him: Messenger of Allah, in case or woman sees what a man sees in dream and she experiences in dream what a man experiences (i. e. experiences orgasm)? Upon this 'A'isha remarked: O Umm Sulaim, you brought humiliation to women;may your right hand be covered with dust. He (the Holy Prophet) said to 'A'isha: Let your hand be covered with dust, and (addressing Umm Sulaim) said: Well, O Umm Sulaim, she should take a bath if she sees that (i. e. she experiences orgasm in dream)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّاسُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ حَدَّثَتْ أَنَّهَا، سَأَلَتْ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى فِي مَنَامِهَا مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا رَأَتْ ذَلِكِ الْمَرْأَةُ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ وَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَالَتْ وَهَلْ يَكُونُ هَذَا فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نَعَمْ فَمِنْ أَيْنَ يَكُونُ الشَّبَهُ إِنَّ مَاءَ الرَّجُلِ غَلِيظٌ أَبْيَضُ وَمَاءَ الْمَرْأَةِ رَقِيقٌ أَصْفَرُ فَمِنْ أَيِّهِمَا عَلاَ أَوْ سَبَقَ يَكُونُ مِنْهُ الشَّبَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abbaasu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, aanna aanasa bna maalikin, haddathahum aanna aumma sulaymin haddathat aannahaa, saaalat nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almaraaai taraa fiy manaamihaa maa yaraa alrrajulu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa raaat dhaliki almaraaau faltaghtasil ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat aummu sulaymin waastahyaytu min dhalika qaalat wahal yakuwnu hadhaa faqaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ na'am famin aayna yakuwnu alshhabahu iinna maa'a alrrajuli ghaliyzun aabyadu wamaa'a almaraaai raqiyqun aasfaru famin aayyihimaa 'alaa aaw sabaqa yakuwnu minhu alshhabahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Umm Sulaim narrated it that she asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about a woman who sees in a dream what a man sees (sexual dream). The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon bi m) said:In case a woman sees that, she must take a bath. Umm Sulaim said: I was bashful on account of that and said: Does it happen? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes (it does happen), otherwise how can (a child) resemble her? Man's discharge (i. e. sperm) is thick and white and the discharge of woman is thin and yellow; so the resemblance comes from the one whose genes prevail or dominate
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ سَأَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى فِي مَنَامِهَا مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ فِي مَنَامِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَانَ مِنْهَا مَا يَكُونُ مِنَ الرَّجُلِ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa daawudu bnu rushaydin, haddathanaa saalihu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa aabuw maalikin alaashja'iyyu, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala saaalati amraaaaun rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almaraaai taraa fiy manaamihaa maa yaraa alrrajulu fiy manaamihi faqaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa kaana minhaa maa yakuwnu mina alrrajuli faltaghtasil ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:A woman asked the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) about a woman who sees in her dream what a man sees in his dream (sexual dream). He (the Holy Prophet) said: If she experiences what a man experiences, she should take a bath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ فَهَلْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ مِنْ غُسْلٍ إِذَا احْتَلَمَتْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نَعَمْ إِذَا رَأَتِ الْمَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَتَحْتَلِمُ الْمَرْأَةُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكِ فَبِمَ يُشْبِهُهَا وَلَدُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an zaynaba binti aabiy salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat jaa'at aummu sulaymin iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna alllaha laa yastahyiy mina alhaqqi fahal 'alaa almaraaai min ghuslin iidhaa ahtalamat faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ na'am iidhaa raaati almaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat aummu salamaaa yaa rasuwla alllahi watahtalimu almaraaau faqaala ‏"‏ taribat yadaaki fabima yushbihuhaa waladuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama reported:Umm Sulaim went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Apostle of Allah, Allah is not ashamed of the truth. Is bathing necessary for a woman when she has a sexual dream? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes, when she sees the liquid (vaginal secretion). Umm Salama said: Messenger of Allah, does a woman have sexual dream? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Let your hand be covered with dust, in what way does her child resemble her?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ وَزَادَ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ فَضَحْتِ النِّسَاءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, jamiy'ana 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithla ma'naahu wazaada qaalat qultu fadahti alnnisaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith with the same sense (as narrated above) bus been transmitted from Hisham b. 'Urwa with the same chain of narrators but with this addition that she (Umm Salama) said:" You humiliated the women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ أُمَّ بَنِي أَبِي طَلْحَةَ دَخَلَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ هِشَامٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِيهِ قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا أُفٍّ لَكِ أَتَرَى الْمَرْأَةُ ذَلِكِ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aannahu qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathu aanna aumma sulaymin aumma baniy aabiy talhaaa dakhalat 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi hishaamin ghayra aanna fiyhi qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau faqultu lahaa auffin laki aataraa almaraaau dhaliki
verses.translation: A'isha the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ) narrated:Umm Sulaim, the mother of Bani Abu Talha, came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and a hadith (like that) narrated by Hisham was narrated but for these words. A'isha said: I expressed disapproval to her, saying: Does a woman see a sexual dream?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الرَّازِيُّ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالَ سَهْلٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ مُسَافِعِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، قَالَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَلْ تَغْتَسِلُ الْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا احْتَلَمَتْ وَأَبْصَرَتِ الْمَاءَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ لَهَا عَائِشَةُ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكِ وَأُلَّتْ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعِيهَا وَهَلْ يَكُونُ الشَّبَهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ قِبَلِ ذَلِكِ إِذَا عَلاَ مَاؤُهَا مَاءَ الرَّجُلِ أَشْبَهَ الْوَلَدُ أَخْوَالَهُ وَإِذَا عَلاَ مَاءُ الرَّجُلِ مَاءَهَا أَشْبَهَ أَعْمَامَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa alrraaziyyu, wasahlu bnu 'uthmaana, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy kuraybin - qaala sahlun haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an mus'abi bni shaybaaa, 'an musaafi'i bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna amraaaaan, qaalat lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hal taghtasilu almaraaau iidhaa ahtalamat waaabsarati almaa'a faqaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat lahaa 'aaiishaau taribat yadaaki waaullat ‏.‏ qaalat faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ da'iyhaa wahal yakuwnu alshhabahu iilaaa min qibali dhaliki iidhaa 'alaa maauuhaa maa'a alrrajuli aashbaha alwaladu aakhwaalahu waiidhaa 'alaa maa'u alrrajuli maa'ahaa aashbaha aa'maamahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of 'A'isha that a woman came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and inquired:Should a woman wash herself when she sees a sexual dream and sees (the marks) of liquid? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. 'A'isha said to her: May your hand be covered with dust and injured. She narrated: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leave her alone. In what way does the child resemble her but for the fact that when the genes contributed by woman prevail upon those of man, the child resembles the maternal family, and when the genes of man prevail upon those of woman the child resembles the paternal family
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تَوْبَةَ، - وَهُوَ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَلاَّمٍ - عَنْ زَيْدٍ، - يَعْنِي أَخَاهُ - أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَلاَّمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيُّ، أَنَّ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ كُنْتُ قَائِمًا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَ حَبْرٌ مِنْ أَحْبَارِ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ‏.‏ فَدَفَعْتُهُ دَفْعَةً كَادَ يُصْرَعُ مِنْهَا فَقَالَ لِمَ تَدْفَعُنِي فَقُلْتُ أَلاَ تَقُولُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ إِنَّمَا نَدْعُوهُ بِاسْمِهِ الَّذِي سَمَّاهُ بِهِ أَهْلُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اسْمِي مُحَمَّدٌ الَّذِي سَمَّانِي بِهِ أَهْلِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ جِئْتُ أَسْأَلُكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيَنْفَعُكَ شَىْءٌ إِنْ حَدَّثْتُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنَىَّ فَنَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعُودٍ مَعَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ أَيْنَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هُمْ فِي الظُّلْمَةِ دُونَ الْجِسْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَنْ أَوَّلُ النَّاسِ إِجَازَةً قَالَ ‏"‏ فُقَرَاءُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ فَمَا تُحْفَتُهُمْ حِينَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ زِيَادَةُ كَبِدِ النُّونِ ‏"‏ قَالَ فَمَا غِذَاؤُهُمْ عَلَى إِثْرِهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ يُنْحَرُ لَهُمْ ثَوْرُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّذِي كَانَ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا شَرَابُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ عَيْنٍ فِيهَا تُسَمَّى سَلْسَبِيلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ صَدَقْتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَجِئْتُ أَسْأَلُكَ عَنْ شَىْءٍ لاَ يَعْلَمُهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ إِلاَّ نَبِيٌّ أَوْ رَجُلٌ أَوْ رَجُلاَنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَنْفَعُكَ إِنْ حَدَّثْتُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنَىَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ جِئْتُ أَسْأَلُكَ عَنِ الْوَلَدِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَاءُ الرَّجُلِ أَبْيَضُ وَمَاءُ الْمَرْأَةِ أَصْفَرُ فَإِذَا اجْتَمَعَا فَعَلاَ مَنِيُّ الرَّجُلِ مَنِيَّ الْمَرْأَةِ أَذْكَرَا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَإِذَا عَلاَ مَنِيُّ الْمَرْأَةِ مَنِيَّ الرَّجُلِ آنَثَا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ لَقَدْ صَدَقْتَ وَإِنَّكَ لَنَبِيٌّ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَذَهَبَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَقَدْ سَأَلَنِي هَذَا عَنِ الَّذِي سَأَلَنِي عَنْهُ وَمَا لِي عِلْمٌ بِشَىْءٍ مِنْهُ حَتَّى أَتَانِيَ اللَّهُ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa aabuw tawbaaa, - wahuwa alrrabiy'u bnu naafi'in - haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, - ya'niy abna salaaamin - 'an zaydin, - ya'niy aakhaahu - aannahu sami'a aabaa salaaamin, qaala haddathaniy aabuw aasmaa'a alrrahabiyyu, aanna thawbaana, mawlaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm haddathahu qaala kuntu qaaiimana 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajaa'a habrun min aahbaari alyahuwdi faqaala alssalaamu 'alayka yaa muhammadu ‏.‏ fadafa'tuhu daf'aaan kaada yusra'u minhaa faqaala lima tadfa'uniy faqultu aalaa taquwlu yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala alyahuwdiyyu iinnamaa nad'uwhu biasmihi alladhiy sammaahu bihi aahluhu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna asmiy muhammadun alladhiy sammaaniy bihi aahliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala alyahuwdiyyu jiitu aasaaluka ‏.‏ faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayanfa'uka shaa'un iin haddathtuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aasma'u biaudhunaaaa fanakata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'uwdin ma'ahu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ sal ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala alyahuwdiyyu aayna yakuwnu alnnaasu yawma tubaddalu alaardu ghayra alaardi waalssamawaatu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hum fiy alzzulmaai duwna aljisri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faman aawwalu alnnaasi iijaazaaan qaala ‏"‏ fuqaraa'u almuhaajiriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alyahuwdiyyu famaa tuhfatuhum hiyna yadkhuluwna aljannaaa qaala ‏"‏ ziyaadaau kabidi alnnuwni ‏"‏ qaala famaa ghidhaauuhum 'alaa iithrihaa qaala ‏"‏ yunharu lahum thawru aljannaai alladhiy kaana yaakulu min aatraafihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famaa sharaabuhum 'alayhi qaala ‏"‏ min 'aynin fiyhaa tusammaa salsabiylaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sadaqta ‏.‏ qaala wajiitu aasaaluka 'an shaa'in laa ya'lamuhu aahadun min aahli alaardi iilaaa nabiyyun aaw rajulun aaw rajulaani ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yanfa'uka iin haddathtuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aasma'u biaudhunaaaa ‏.‏ qaala jiitu aasaaluka 'ani alwaladi qaala ‏"‏ maa'u alrrajuli aabyadu wamaa'u almaraaai aasfaru faiidhaa ajtama'aa fa'alaa maniyyu alrrajuli maniyya almaraaai aadhkaraa biiidhni alllahi waiidhaa 'alaa maniyyu almaraaai maniyya alrrajuli anathaa biiidhni alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alyahuwdiyyu laqad sadaqta waiinnaka lanabiyyun thumma ansarafa fadhahaba ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laqad saaalaniy hadhaa 'ani alladhiy saaalaniy 'anhu wamaa liy 'ilmun bishaa'in minhu hattaa aataaniya alllahu bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said:While I was standing beside the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one of the rabbis of the Jews came and said: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad. I pushed him backwith a push that he was going to fall. Upon this he said: Why do you push me? I said: Why don't you say: O Messenger of Allah? The Jew said: We call him by the name by which he was named by his family. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: My name is Muhammad with which I was named by my family. The Jew said: I have come to ask you (something). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Should that thing be of any benefit to you, if I tell you that? He (the Jew) said: I will lend my ears to it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew a line with the help of the stick that he had with him and then said: Ask (whatever you like). Thereupon the Jew said: Where would the human beings be on the Daywhen the earth would change into another earth and the heavens too (would change into other heavens)? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: They would be in darkness beside the Bridge. He (the Jew) again said: Who amongst people would be the first to cross (this bridge).? He said: They would be the poor amongst the refugees. The Jew said: What would constitute their breakfast when they would enter Paradise? He (the Holy Prophet) replied: A caul of the fish-liver. He (the Jew) said. What would be their food alter this? He (the Holy Prophet) said: A bullockwhich was fed in the different quarters of Paradise would be slaughtered for them. He (the Jew) said: What would be their drink? He (the Holy Prophet) said: They would be given drink from the fountain which is named" Salsabil". He (the Jew) said: I have come to ask you about a thing which no one amongst the people on the earth knows except an apostle or one or two men besides him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Would it benefit you if I tell you that? He (the Jew) said: I would lend ears to that. He then said: I have come to ask you about the child. He (the Holy Prophet) said: The reproductive substance of man is white and that of woman (i. e. ovum central portion) yellow, and when they have sexual intercourse and the male's substance (chromosomes and genes) prevails upon the female's substance (chromosomes and genes), it is the male child that is created by Allah's Decree, and when the substance of the female prevails upon the substance contributed by the male, a female child is formed by the Decree of Allah. The Jew said: What you have said is true; verily you are an Apostle. He then returned and went away. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He asked me about such and such things of which I have had no knowledge till Allah gave me that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنْتُ قَاعِدًا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ زَائِدَةُ كَبِدِ النُّونِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَذْكَرَ وَآنَثَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَذْكَرَا وَآنَثَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu hassaana, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu salaaamin, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala kuntu qaa'idana 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala zaaiidaau kabidi alnnuwni ‏.‏ waqaala aadhkara waanatha ‏.‏ walam yaqul aadhkaraa waanathaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has been narrated by Mu'awyia b. Salim with the same chain of transmitters except for the words:I was sitting beside the Messenger of Allah" and some other minor alterations
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ يَبْدَأُ فَيَغْسِلُ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُفْرِغُ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ فَيَغْسِلُ فَرْجَهُ ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ الْمَاءَ فَيُدْخِلُ أَصَابِعَهُ فِي أُصُولِ الشَّعْرِ حَتَّى إِذَا رَأَى أَنْ قَدِ اسْتَبْرَأَ حَفَنَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثَ حَفَنَاتٍ ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَى سَائِرِ جَسَدِهِ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aghtasala mina aljanaabaai yabdaau fayaghsilu yadayhi thumma yufrighu biyamiynihi 'alaa shimaalihi fayaghsilu farjahu thumma yatawaddaau wuduw'ahu lilssalaaai thumma yaakhudhu almaa'a fayudkhilu aasaabi'ahu fiy ausuwli alshha'ri hattaa iidhaa raaaa aan qadi astabraaa hafana 'alaa raasihi thalaatha hafanaatin thumma aafaada 'alaa saaiiri jasadihi thumma ghasala rijlayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bathed because of sexual intercourse, he first washed his hands: he then poured water with his right hand on his left hand and washed his private parts. He then performed ablution as is done for prayer'. He then took some water and put his fingers and moved them through the roots of his hair. And when he found that these had been properly mois- tened, then poured three handfuls on his head and then poured water over his body and subsequently washed his feet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ غَسْلُ الرِّجْلَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, kulluhum 'an hishaamin, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi walaysa fiy hadiythihim ghaslu alrrijlayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Abu Kuraib. Ibn Numair and others, all on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but in their narration these words are not there:" washed his feet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَبَدَأَ فَغَسَلَ كَفَّيْهِ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ غَسْلَ الرِّجْلَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aghtasala mina aljanaabaai fabadaaa faghasala kaffayhi thalaathana thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa walam yadhkur ghasla alrrijlayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham narrated it from his father, who narrated it on the authority of 'A'isha that when the Apostle (ﷺ) took a bath because of sexual inter-course, he first washed the palms of his hands three times, and then the whole hadith was transmitted like that based on the authority of Abu Mu'awyia, but no mention is made of the washing of feet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ بَدَأَ فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْخِلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ مِثْلَ وُضُوئِهِ لِلصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa zaaiidaau, 'an hishaamin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aghtasala mina aljanaabaai badaaa faghasala yadayhi qabla aan yudkhila yadahu fiy aliinaa'i thumma tawaddaaa mithla wuduwiihi lilssalaaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Urwa has narrated it on the authority of 'A'isha that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a bath because of sexual intercourse, he first washed his hands before dipping one of them into the basin, and then performed ablu- tion as is done for prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي خَالَتِي، مَيْمُونَةُ قَالَتْ أَدْنَيْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُسْلَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَغَسَلَ كَفَّيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ بِهِ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ وَغَسَلَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِشِمَالِهِ الأَرْضَ فَدَلَكَهَا دَلْكًا شَدِيدًا ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثَ حَفَنَاتٍ مِلْءَ كَفِّهِ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ سَائِرَ جَسَدِهِ ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى عَنْ مَقَامِهِ ذَلِكَ فَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ بِالْمِنْدِيلِ فَرَدَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathaniy 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala haddathatniy khaalatiy, maymuwnaau qaalat aadnaytu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghuslahu mina aljanaabaai faghasala kaffayhi marratayni aaw thalaathana thumma aadkhala yadahu fiy aliinaa'i thumma aafragha bihi 'alaa farjihi waghasalahu bishimaalihi thumma daraba bishimaalihi alaarda fadalakahaa dalkana shadiydana thumma tawaddaaa wuduw'ahu lilssalaaai thumma aafragha 'alaa raasihi thalaatha hafanaatin mil'a kaffihi thumma ghasala saaiira jasadihi thumma tanahhaa 'an maqaamihi dhalika faghasala rijlayhi thumma aataytuhu bialmindiyli faraddahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported it on the authority of Maimuna, his mother's sister, that she said:I placed water near the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to take a bath because of sexual intercourse. He washed the palms of his bands twice or thrice and then put his hand In the basin and poured water over his private parts and washed them with his left hand. He then struck his hand against the earth and rubbed it with force and then performed ablution for the prayer and then poured three handfuls of water on his head and then washed his whole body after which he moved aside from that place and washed his feet, and then I brought a towel (so that he may wipe his body). but he returned it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَالأَشَجُّ وَإِسْحَاقُ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا إِفْرَاغُ ثَلاَثِ حَفَنَاتٍ عَلَى الرَّأْسِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ وَصْفُ الْوُضُوءِ كُلِّهِ يَذْكُرُ الْمَضْمَضَةَ وَالاِسْتِنْشَاقَ فِيهِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ذِكْرُ الْمِنْدِيلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin waalaashajju waiishaaqu kulluhum 'an wakiy'in, h wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythihimaa iifraaghu thalaathi hafanaatin 'alaa alrraasi wafiy hadiythi wakiy'in wasfu alwuduw'i kullihi yadhkuru almadmadaaa waalaistinshaaqa fiyhi walaysa fiy hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa dhikru almindiyli ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters, but in the hadith narrated by Yahya b. Yahya and Abu Kuraib there is no mention of:" Pouring of three handfuls of water on the head." and in the hadith narrated by Waki' all the features of ablution have been recorded: rinsing (of mouth), snuffing of water (in the nostrils) ; and in the hadith transmitted by Abu Mu'awyia, there is no mention of a towel
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِمِنْدِيلٍ فَلَمْ يَمَسَّهُ وَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ بِالْمَاءِ هَكَذَا يَعْنِي يَنْفُضُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an saalimin, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an maymuwnaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya bimindiylin falam yamassahu waja'ala yaquwlu bialmaa'i hakadhaa ya'niy yanfuduhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas narrated It on the authority of Maimuna that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was given a towel, but he did not rub (his body) with it, but he did like this with water, i. e. he shook it off
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ دَعَا بِشَىْءٍ نَحْوَ الْحِلاَبِ فَأَخَذَ بِكَفِّهِ بَدَأَ بِشِقِّ رَأْسِهِ الأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ الأَيْسَرِ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِكَفَّيْهِ فَقَالَ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, haddathaniy aabuw 'aasimin, 'an hanzalaaa bni aabiy sufyaana, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aghtasala mina aljanaabaai da'aa bishaa'in nahwa alhilaabi faaakhadha bikaffihi badaaa bishiqqi raasihi alaaymani thumma alaaysari thumma aakhadha bikaffayhi faqaala bihimaa 'alaa raasihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath because of sexual intercourse, he called for a vessel and took a handful of water from it and first (washed) the right side of his head, then left, and then took a handful (of water) and poured it on his head
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ هُوَ الْفَرَقُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaghtasilu min iinaa'in huwa alfaraqu mina aljanaabaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) washed himself with water from a vessel (measuring seven to eight seers) because of sexual intercourse
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْتَسِلُ فِي الْقَدَحِ وَهُوَ الْفَرَقُ وَكُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَهُوَ فِي الإِنَاءِ الْوَاحِدِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَالْفَرَقُ ثَلاَثَةُ آصُعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaghtasilu fiy alqadahi wahuwa alfaraqu wakuntu aaghtasilu aanaa wahuwa fiy aliinaa'i alwaahidi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi sufyaana min iinaa'in waahidin ‏.‏ qaala qutaybaau qaala sufyaanu waalfaraqu thalaathaau asu'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from the vessel (which contained seven to eight seers, i. e. fifteen to sixteen pounds) of water And I and he (the Holy Prophet) took a bath from the same vessel. And in the hadith narrated by Sufyan the words are:" from one vessel". Qutaiba said: Al-Faraq is three Sa' (a cubic measuring of varying magnitude)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ أَنَا وَأَخُوهَا، مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ فَسَأَلَهَا عَنْ غُسْلِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَدَعَتْ بِإِنَاءٍ قَدْرِ الصَّاعِ فَاغْتَسَلَتْ وَبَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهَا سِتْرٌ وَأَفْرَغَتْ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْخُذْنَ مِنْ رُءُوسِهِنَّ حَتَّى تَكُونَ كَالْوَفْرَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, qaala haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy bakri bni hafsin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa 'aaiishaaa aanaa waaakhuwhaa, mina alrradaa'aai fasaaalahaa 'an ghusli alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm mina aljanaabaai fada'at biiinaa'in qadri alssaa'i faaghtasalat wabaynanaa wabaynahaa sitrun waaafraghat 'alaa raasihaa thalaathana ‏.‏ qaala wakaana aazwaaju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaakhudhna min ru'uwsihinna hattaa takuwna kaalwafraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Salamab. 'Abd al-Rahman reported:I along with the foster brother of 'A'isha went to her and he asked about the bath of the Apostle (ﷺ) because of sexual intercourse. She called for a vessel equal to a Sa' and she took a bath. and there was a curtain between us and her. She poured water on her head thrice and he (Abu Salama) said: The wives of the Apostle (ﷺ) collectedhair on their heads and these lopped up to ears (and did rot go beyond that)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ بَدَأَ بِيَمِينِهِ فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَغَسَلَهَا ثُمَّ صَبَّ الْمَاءَ عَلَى الأَذَى الَّذِي بِهِ بِيَمِينِهِ وَغَسَلَ عَنْهُ بِشِمَالِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ صَبَّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَنَحْنُ جُنُبَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy makhramaau bnu bukayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aghtasala badaaa biyamiynihi fasabba 'alayhaa mina almaa'i faghasalahaa thumma sabba almaa'a 'alaa alaadhaa alladhiy bihi biyamiynihi waghasala 'anhu bishimaalihi hattaa iidhaa faragha min dhalika sabba 'alaa raasihi ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin wanahnu junubaani ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salama b. Abd al-Rahman narrated it on the authority of A'isha that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath, he started from the right hand and poured water over it and washed it, and then poured water on the impurity with the right band and washed it away with the help of the left hand. and after having removed it, he poured water on his head. A'isha said:I and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from the same vessel, after sexual intercourse
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عِرَاكٍ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، - وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ الْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ - أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّهَا، كَانَتْ تَغْتَسِلُ هِيَ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ يَسَعُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَمْدَادٍ أَوْ قَرِيبًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yaziyda, 'an 'iraakin, 'an hafsaaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakrin, - wakaanat tahta almundhiri bni alzzubayri - aanna 'aaiishaaa, aakhbarathaa aannahaa, kaanat taghtasilu hiya waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy iinaa'in waahidin yasa'u thalaathaaa aamdaadin aaw qariybana min dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hafsa, daughter of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr, reported that 'A'isha narrated to her that she and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from the same vessel which contained water equal to three Mudds or thereabout
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ تَخْتَلِفُ أَيْدِينَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, qaala haddathanaa aaflahu bnu humaydin, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa warasuwlu alllahi, sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin takhtalifu aaydiynaa fiyhi mina aljanaabaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:I and the Messenger (ﷺ) took a bath from the same vessel and our hands alternated into it in the state that we had had sexual intercourse
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ - بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ - وَاحِدٍ فَيُبَادِرُنِي حَتَّى أَقُولَ دَعْ لِي دَعْ لِي ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَهُمَا جُنُبَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'an mu'aadhaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa warasuwlu alllahi, sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in - bayniy wabaynahu - waahidin fayubaadiruniy hattaa aaquwla da' liy da' liy ‏.‏ qaalat wahumaa junubaani ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:I and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from one vessel which was placed between me and him and he would get ahead of me, so that I would say: Spare (some water for) me, spare (some water for) me; and she said that they had had sexual intercourse
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي مَيْمُونَةُ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَغْتَسِلُ هِيَ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala qutaybaau haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an aabiy alshha'thaa'i, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala aakhbaratniy maymuwnaau, aannahaa kaanat taghtasilu hiya waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy iinaa'in waahidin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas said:Maimuna (the wife of the Holy Prophet) reported to me that she and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from one vessel
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ أَكْبَرُ عِلْمِي وَالَّذِي يَخْطُرُ عَلَى بَالِي أَنَّ أَبَا الشَّعْثَاءِ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَغْتَسِلُ بِفَضْلِ مَيْمُونَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, qaala aakbaru 'ilmiy waalladhiy yakhturu 'alaa baaliy aanna aabaa alshha'thaa'i aakhbaraniy aanna abna 'abbaasin aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaghtasilu bifadli maymuwnaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath with the water left over by Maimuna
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَتْهَا قَالَتْ، كَانَتْ هِيَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْتَسِلاَنِ فِي الإِنَاءِ الْوَاحِدِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna zaynaba binta aummi salamaaa, haddathathu aanna aumma salamaaa haddathathaa qaalat, kaanat hiya warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaghtasilaani fiy aliinaa'i alwaahidi mina aljanaabaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zainab bint Umm Salama (the wife of the Holy Prophet) reported that Umm Salama and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath from the same vessel
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْتَسِلُ بِخَمْسِ مَكَاكِيكَ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ بِمَكُّوكٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى بِخَمْسِ مَكَاكِيَّ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنَ جَبْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'niy abna mahdiyyin - qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni jabrin, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaghtasilu bikhamsi makaakiyka wayatawaddaau bimakkuwkin ‏.‏ waqaala abnu almuthannaa bikhamsi makaakiyya ‏.‏ waqaala abnu mu'aadhin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi walam yadhkuri abna jabrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) took a bath with five Makkuks of water and performed ablution with one Makkuk. Ibn Muthanna has used the words five Makakiyya, and Ibn Mu'adh narrated it from 'Abdullah b. 'Abdullah and he made no mention of Ibn Jabr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جَبْرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ بِالْمُدِّ وَيَغْتَسِلُ بِالصَّاعِ إِلَى خَمْسَةِ أَمْدَادٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an mis'arin, 'ani abni jabrin, 'an aanasi, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yatawaddaau bialmuddi wayaghtasilu bialssaa'i iilaa khamsaai aamdaadin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas said:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) performed ablution with one Mudd and took bath with a Sa' up to five Mudds
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ الْمُفَضَّلِ، - قَالَ أَبُو كَامِلٍ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَيْحَانَةَ، عَنْ سَفِينَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُغَسِّلُهُ الصَّاعُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ وَيُوَضِّؤُهُ الْمُدُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, wa'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, kilaahumaa 'an bishri bni almufaddali, - qaala aabuw kaamilin haddathanaa bishrun, - haddathanaa aabuw rayhaanaaa, 'an safiynaaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yughassiluhu alssaa'u mina almaa'i mina aljanaabaai wayuwaddiuuhu almuddu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Safina reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath with one Sa` of water because of sexual intercourse and performed ablution with one Mudd
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي رَيْحَانَةَ، عَنْ سَفِينَةَ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ - صَاحِبُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْتَسِلُ بِالصَّاعِ وَيَتَطَهَّرُ بِالْمُدِّ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ حُجْرٍ أَوْ قَالَ وَيُطَهِّرُهُ الْمُدُّ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَقَدْ كَانَ كَبِرَ وَمَا كُنْتُ أَثِقُ بِحَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aabiy rayhaanaaa, 'an safiynaaa, - qaala aabuw bakrin - saahibu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaghtasilu bialssaa'i wayatatahharu bialmuddi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni hujrin aaw qaala wayutahhiruhu almuddu ‏.‏ waqaala waqad kaana kabira wamaa kuntu aathiqu bihadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Safina reported that Abu Bakr, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him), observed:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath with one Sa' of water and performed ablution with one Mudd (of water) ; and in the hadith narrated by Ibn Hujr the words are: One Mudd sufficed for his (Holy Prophet's) ablution. And Ibn Hujr said that (his Shaikh) Isma'il was much advanced in age, and it was because of this that he could not fully rely on him for this tradition
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدٍ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، قَالَ تَمَارَوْا فِي الْغُسْلِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ أَمَّا أَنَا فَإِنِّي أَغْسِلُ رَأْسِي كَذَا وَكَذَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَمَّا أَنَا فَإِنِّي أُفِيضُ عَلَى رَأْسِي ثَلاَثَ أَكُفٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an sulaymaana bni suradin, 'an jubayri bni mut'imin, qaala tamaarawa fiy alghusli 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ba'du alqawmi aammaa aanaa faiinniy aaghsilu raasiy kadhaa wakadhaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aammaa aanaa faiinniy aufiydu 'alaa raasiy thalaatha aakuffin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jubair b. Mut'im reported:The people contended amongst themselves in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with regard to bathing. Some of them said: We wash our heads like this and this. Upon this the Messenger (ﷺ) said: As for me I pour three handfuls of water upon my head
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدٍ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَهُ الْغُسْلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُفْرِغُ عَلَى رَأْسِي ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an sulaymaana bni suradin, 'an jubayri bni mut'imin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu dhukira 'indahu alghuslu mina aljanaabaai faqaala ‏ "‏ aammaa aanaa faaufrighu 'alaa raasiy thalaathana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jubair b. Mut'im reported it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that a mention was made before him about bathing because of sexual intercourse and he said:I pour water over my head thrice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ وَفْدَ، ثَقِيفٍ سَأَلُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا إِنَّ أَرْضَنَا أَرْضٌ بَارِدَةٌ فَكَيْفَ بِالْغُسْلِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُفْرِغُ عَلَى رَأْسِي ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ سَالِمٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ وَقَالَ إِنَّ وَفْدَ ثَقِيفٍ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waiismaa'iylu bnu saalimin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna wafda, thaqiyfin saaaluwa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa iinna aardanaa aardun baaridaaun fakayfa bialghusli faqaala ‏ "‏ aammaa aanaa faaufrighu 'alaa raasiy thalaathana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu saalimin fiy riwaayatihi haddathanaa hushaymun aakhbaranaa aabuw bishrin waqaala iinna wafda thaqiyfin qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:A delegation of the Thaqif said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Our land is cold; what about our bathing then? He (the Holy Prophet) said: I pour water thrice over my head. Ibn Salim in his narration reported:" The delegation of the Thaqif said: Messenger of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي الثَّقَفِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ صَبَّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثَ حَفَنَاتٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ إِنَّ شَعْرِي كَثِيرٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ جَابِرٌ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي كَانَ شَعْرُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْثَرَ مِنْ شَعْرِكَ وَأَطْيَبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - ya'niy althhaqafiyya - haddathanaa ja'farun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aghtasala min janaabaain sabba 'alaa raasihi thalaatha hafanaatin min maa'in ‏.‏ faqaala lahu alhasanu bnu muhammadin iinna sha'riy kathiyrun ‏.‏ qaala jaabirun faqultu lahu yaa abna aakhiy kaana sha'ru rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakthara min sha'rika waaatyaba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a bath because of sexual intercourse, he poured three handfuls of water upon his head. Hasan b. Muhammad said to him (the narrator): My hair is thick. Upon this Jabir observed. I said to him: O son of my brother, the hair of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was thicker than your hair and these were more fine (than yours)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أَشُدُّ ضَفْرَ رَأْسِي فَأَنْقُضُهُ لِغُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِنَّمَا يَكْفِيكِ أَنْ تَحْثِي عَلَى رَأْسِكِ ثَلاَثَ حَثَيَاتٍ ثُمَّ تُفِيضِينَ عَلَيْكِ الْمَاءَ فَتَطْهُرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, kulluhum 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba bni muwsaa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni raafi'in, mawlaa aummi salamaaa 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy amraaaaun aashuddu dafra raasiy faaanquduhu lighusli aljanaabaai qaala ‏ "‏ laa iinnamaa yakfiyki aan tahthiy 'alaa raasiki thalaatha hathayaatin thumma tufiydiyna 'alayki almaa'a fatathuriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama reported:I said: Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who has closely plaited hair on my head; should I undo it for taking a bath, because of sexual intercourse? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No, it is enough for you to throw three handfuls of water on your head and then pour water over yourself, and you shall be purified
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ فَأَنْقُضُهُ لِلْحَيْضَةِ وَالْجَنَابَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaalaa aakhbaranaa althhawriyyu, 'an aayyuwba bni muwsaa, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alrrazzaaqi faaanquduhu lilhaydaai waaljanaabaai faqaala ‏ "‏ laa ‏"‏ thumma dhakara bima'naa hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Amr al-Naqid, Yazid b. Harun, 'Abd b. Humaid, Abd al-Razzaq, Thauri, Ayyub b. Musa, with the same chain of transmitters. In hadith narrated by Abd al-Razzaq there is a mention of the menstruation and of the sexual intercourse. The rest of the hadith has been transmitted like that of Ibn 'Uyaina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَحْمَدُ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُوسَى، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ أَفَأَحُلُّهُ فَأَغْسِلُهُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْحَيْضَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aahmadu alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu 'adiyyin, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - 'an rawhi bni alqaasimi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu bnu muwsaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala aafaaahulluhu faaaghsiluhu mina aljanaabaai ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri alhaydaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by the same chain of transmitters by Ahmad al. Darimi, Zakariya b. 'Adi, Yazid, i. e. ' Ibn Zurai', Rauh b. al-Qasim, Ayyub b. Musa with the same chain of transmitters, and there is a mention of these words:" Should I undo the plait and wash it, because of sexual intercourse?" and there is no mention of menstruation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ بَلَغَ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو يَأْمُرُ النِّسَاءَ إِذَا اغْتَسَلْنَ أَنْ يَنْقُضْنَ رُءُوسَهُنَّ فَقَالَتْ يَا عَجَبًا لاِبْنِ عَمْرٍو هَذَا يَأْمُرُ النِّسَاءَ إِذَا اغْتَسَلْنَ أَنْ يَنْقُضْنَ رُءُوسَهُنَّ أَفَلاَ يَأْمُرُهُنَّ أَنْ يَحْلِقْنَ رُءُوسَهُنَّ لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَلاَ أَزِيدُ عَلَى أَنْ أُفْرِغَ عَلَى رَأْسِي ثَلاَثَ إِفْرَاغَاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an 'ubaydi bni 'umayrin, qaala balagha 'aaiishaaa aanna 'abda, alllahi bna 'amrinw yaamuru alnnisaa'a iidhaa aghtasalna aan yanqudna ru'uwsahunna faqaalat yaa 'ajabana laibni 'amrinw hadhaa yaamuru alnnisaa'a iidhaa aghtasalna aan yanqudna ru'uwsahunna aafalaa yaamuruhunna aan yahliqna ru'uwsahunna laqad kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin walaa aaziydu 'alaa aan aufrigha 'alaa raasiy thalaatha iifraaghaatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaid b. Umair reported:It was conveyed to 'A'isha that 'Abdullah b. 'Amr ordered the women to undo the (plaits) of hair on their heads. She said: How strange it is for Ibn 'Amr that he orders the women to undo the plaits of their head while taking a bath; why does he not order them to shave their beads? I and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took bath from one vessel. I did no more than this that I poured three handfuls of water over my head
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ابْنِ صَفِيَّةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَيْفَ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ حَيْضَتِهَا قَالَ فَذَكَرَتْ أَنَّهُ عَلَّمَهَا كَيْفَ تَغْتَسِلُ ثُمَّ تَأْخُذُ فِرْصَةً مِنْ مِسْكٍ فَتَطَهَّرُ بِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَيْفَ أَتَطَهَّرُ بِهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَطَهَّرِي بِهَا ‏.‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَاسْتَتَرَ - وَأَشَارَ لَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ بِيَدِهِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ - قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَاجْتَذَبْتُهَا إِلَىَّ وَعَرَفْتُ مَا أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ تَتَبَّعِي بِهَا أَثَرَ الدَّمِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ فَقُلْتُ تَتَبَّعِي بِهَا آثَارَ الدَّمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu muhammadin alnnaaqidu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'an mansuwrin abni safiyyaaa, 'an aummihi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat saaalati amraaaaun alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kayfa taghtasilu min haydatihaa qaala fadhakarat aannahu 'allamahaa kayfa taghtasilu thumma taakhudhu firsaaan min miskin fatatahharu bihaa ‏.‏ qaalat kayfa aatatahharu bihaa qaala ‏ "‏ tatahhariy bihaa ‏.‏ subhaana alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waastatara - waaashaara lanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa biyadihi 'alaa wajhihi - qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau waajtadhabtuhaa iilaaaa wa'araftu maa aaraada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu tatabba'iy bihaa aathara alddami ‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy 'umara fiy riwaayatihi faqultu tatabba'iy bihaa athaara alddami ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:A woman asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) how to wash herself after menstruation. She mentioned that he taught her how to take bath and then told her to take a piece of cotton with musk and purify herself. She said: How should I purify myself with that? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Praise be to Allah, purify yourself with it, and covered his face, Sufyan b. 'Uyaina gave a demonstration by covering his face (as the Prophet had done). 'A'isha reported: I dragged her to my side for I had understood what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) intended and, therefore, said: Apply this cotton with musk to the trace of blood. Ibn 'Umar in his hadith (has mentioned the words of 'A'isha thus): Apply it to the marks of blood
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَيْفَ أَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ الطُّهْرِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ خُذِي فِرْصَةً مُمَسَّكَةً فَتَوَضَّئِي بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu sa'iydin alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa habbaanu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa mansuwrun, 'an aummihi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna amraaaaan, saaalati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kayfa aaghtasilu 'inda alttuhri faqaala ‏ "‏ khudhiy firsaaan mumassakaaan fatawaddaiiy bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi sufyaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:A woman asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) how he should wash herself after the menstrual period. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Take a cotton with musk and purity yourself, and the rest of the hadith was narrated like that of Sufyan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ صَفِيَّةَ، تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ، سَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ غُسْلِ الْمَحِيضِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَأْخُذُ إِحْدَاكُنَّ مَاءَهَا وَسِدْرَتَهَا فَتَطَهَّرُ فَتُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ ثُمَّ تَصُبُّ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا فَتَدْلُكُهُ دَلْكًا شَدِيدًا حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ شُئُونَ رَأْسِهَا ثُمَّ تَصُبُّ عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَأْخُذُ فِرْصَةً مُمَسَّكَةً فَتَطَهَّرُ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ وَكَيْفَ تَطَهَّرُ بِهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ تَطَهَّرِينَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ كَأَنَّهَا تُخْفِي ذَلِكَ تَتَبَّعِينَ أَثَرَ الدَّمِ ‏.‏ وَسَأَلَتْهُ عَنْ غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَأْخُذُ مَاءً فَتَطَهَّرُ فَتُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ - أَوْ تُبْلِغُ الطُّهُورَ - ثُمَّ تَصُبُّ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا فَتَدْلُكُهُ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ شُئُونَ رَأْسِهَا ثُمَّ تُفِيضُ عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ نِعْمَ النِّسَاءُ نِسَاءُ الأَنْصَارِ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَمْنَعُهُنَّ الْحَيَاءُ أَنْ يَتَفَقَّهْنَ فِي الدِّينِ ‏.‏
