verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an iibraahiyma bni almuhaajiri, qaala sami'tu safiyyaaa, tuhaddithu 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aasmaa'a, saaalati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an ghusli almahiydi faqaala ‏"‏ taakhudhu iihdaakunna maa'ahaa wasidratahaa fatatahharu fatuhsinu alttuhuwra thumma tasubbu 'alaa raasihaa fatadlukuhu dalkana shadiydana hattaa tablugha shuiuwna raasihaa thumma tasubbu 'alayhaa almaa'a ‏.‏ thumma taakhudhu firsaaan mumassakaaan fatatahharu bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat aasmaa'u wakayfa tatahharu bihaa faqaala ‏"‏ subhaana alllahi tatahhariyna bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau kaaannahaa tukhfiy dhalika tatabba'iyna aathara alddami ‏.‏ wasaaalathu 'an ghusli aljanaabaai faqaala ‏"‏ taakhudhu maa'an fatatahharu fatuhsinu alttuhuwra - aaw tublighu alttuhuwra - thumma tasubbu 'alaa raasihaa fatadlukuhu hattaa tablugha shuiuwna raasihaa thumma tufiydu 'alayhaa almaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau ni'ma alnnisaa'u nisaa'u alaansaari lam yakun yamna'uhunna alhayaa'u aan yatafaqqahna fiy alddiyni ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Asma (daughter of Shakal) asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about washing after menstruation. He said: Everyone amongst you should use water (mixed with the leaves of) the lote-tree and cleanse herself well, and then pour water on her head and rub it vigorously till it reaches the roots of the hair. Then she should pour water on it. Afterwards she should take a piece of cotton smeared with musk and cleanse herself with it. Asma' said: How should she cleanse herself with the help of that? Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) observed: Praise be to Allah, she should cleanse herself. 'A'isha said in a subdued tone that she should apply it to the trace of blood. She (Asma) then further asked about bathing after sexual intercourse. He (the Holy Prophet) said: She should take water and cleanse herself well or complete the ablution and then (pour water) on her head and rub it till it reaches the roots of the hair (of her) head and then pour water on her. 'A'isha said: How good are the women of Ansar (helpers) that their shyness does not prevent them from learning religion
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَقَالَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ تَطَهَّرِي بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَاسْتَتَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu waqaala qaala ‏ "‏ subhaana alllahi tatahhariy bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waastatara ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by 'Ubaidullah b. Mu'adh with the same chain of transmitters (but for the words) that he (the Holy Prophet) said:Cleanse yourself with it, and he covered (his face on account of shyness)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ شَكَلٍ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ تَغْتَسِلُ إِحْدَانَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِيهِ غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa kilaahumaa 'an aabiy alaahwasi, 'an iibraahiyma bni muhaajirin, 'an safiyyaaa binti shaybaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhalat aasmaa'u bintu shakalin 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa taghtasilu iihdaanaa iidhaa tahurat mina alhaydi wasaaqa alhadiytha walam yadhkur fiyhi ghusla aljanaabaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Asma' b. Shakal came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, how one amongst us should take a bath after the menstruation, and the rest of the hadith is the same and there is no mention of bathing because of sexual intercourse
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أُسْتَحَاضُ فَلاَ أَطْهُرُ أَفَأَدَعُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ وَلَيْسَ بِالْحَيْضَةِ فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَدَعِي الصَّلاَةَ وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ وَصَلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat jaa'at faatimaau bintu aabiy hubayshin iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy amraaaaun austahaadu falaa aathuru aafaaada'u alssalaaaa faqaala ‏ "‏ laa iinnamaa dhaliki 'irqun walaysa bialhaydaai faiidhaa aaqbalati alhaydaau fada'iy alssalaaaa waiidhaa aadbarat faaghsiliy 'anki alddama wasalliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Fatimah b. Abu Hubaish came to the Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I am a woman whose blood keeps flowing (even after the menstruation period). I am never purified; should I, therefore, abandon prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Not at all, for that is only a vein, and is not a menstruation, so when menstruation comes, abandon prayer, and when it ends wash the blood from yourself and then pray
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ وَإِسْنَادِهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ قُتَيْبَةَ عَنْ جَرِيرٍ جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي حُبَيْشِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ أَسَدٍ وَهِيَ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَّا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ زِيَادَةُ حَرْفٍ تَرَكْنَا ذِكْرَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, kulluhum 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bimithli hadiythi wakiy'in waiisnaadihi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi qutaybaaa 'an jariyrin jaa'at faatimaau bintu aabiy hubayshi bni 'abdi almuttalibi bni aasadin wahiya amraaaaun minnaa ‏.‏ qaala wafiy hadiythi hammaadi bni zaydin ziyaadaau harfin taraknaa dhikrahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: The hadith narrated by Waki' and with its chain of narrators has been transmitted on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa, but in the hadith narrated by Qutaiba on the authority of Jarir, the words are:" There came Fatimah b. Abu Hubaish, b. 'Abd al-Muttalib b. Asad, and she was a woman amongst us," and in the hadith of Hammid b. Zaid there is an addition of these words:" We abandoned mentioning him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتِ اسْتَفْتَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتُ جَحْشٍ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي أُسْتَحَاضُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ فَاغْتَسِلِي ثُمَّ صَلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ وَلَكِنَّهُ شَىْءٌ فَعَلَتْهُ هِيَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ابْنَةُ جَحْشٍ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalati astaftat aummu habiybaaa bintu jahshin rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat iinniy austahaadu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa dhaliki 'irqun faaghtasiliy thumma salliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakaanat taghtasilu 'inda kulli salaaain ‏.‏ qaala alllaythu bnu sa'din lam yadhkuri abnu shihaabin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara aumma habiybaaa binta jahshin aan taghtasila 'inda kulli salaaain walakinnahu shaa'un fa'alathu hiya ‏.‏ waqaala abnu rumhin fiy riwaayatihi abnaau jahshin walam yadhkur aumma habiybaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Umm Habiba b. Jahsh thus asked for a verdict from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): I am a woman whose blood keeps flowing (after the menstrual period). He (the Holy Prophet) said: That is only a vein, so take a bath and offer prayer; and she took a bath at the time of every prayer. Laith b. Sa'd said: Ibn Shihab made no mention that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had ordered her to take a bath at the time of every prayer, but she did it of her own accord. And in the tradition transmitted by Ibn Rumh there is no mention of Umm Habiba (and there is mention of the daughter of Jahsh only)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَعَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ - خَتَنَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَحْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ - اسْتُحِيضَتْ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ فَاسْتَفْتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ لَيْسَتْ بِالْحَيْضَةِ وَلَكِنَّ هَذَا عِرْقٌ فَاغْتَسِلِي وَصَلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَكَانَتْ تَغْتَسِلُ فِي مِرْكَنٍ فِي حُجْرَةِ أُخْتِهَا زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ حَتَّى تَعْلُوَ حُمْرَةُ الدَّمِ الْمَاءَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِذَلِكَ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ فَقَالَ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ هِنْدًا لَوْ سَمِعَتْ بِهَذِهِ الْفُتْيَا وَاللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَتْ لَتَبْكِي لأَنَّهَا كَانَتْ لاَ تُصَلِّي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu salamaaa almuraadiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an 'amriw bni alhaarithi, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, wa'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna aumma habiybaaa binta jahshin - khatanaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm watahta 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin - astuhiydat sab'a siniyna faastaftat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy dhalika faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna hadhihi laysat bialhaydaai walakinna hadhaa 'irqun faaghtasiliy wasalliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau fakaanat taghtasilu fiy mirkanin fiy hujraai aukhtihaa zaynaba binti jahshin hattaa ta'luwa humraau alddami almaa'a ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin fahaddathtu bidhalika aabaa bakri bna 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhaarithi bni hishaamin faqaala yarhamu alllahu hindana law sami'at bihadhihi alfutyaa waalllahi iin kaanat latabkiy laannahaa kaanat laa tusalliy ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported:Umm Habiba b. Jahsh who was the sister-in-law of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the wife of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf, remained mustahada for seven years, and she, therefore, asked for the verdict of Shari'ah from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: This is not menstruation, but (blood from) a vein: so bathe yourself and offer prayer. 'A'isha said: She took a bath in the wash-tub placed in the apartment of her sister Zainab b. Jahsh, till the redness of the blood came over the water. Ibn Shihab said: I narrated it to Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham about it who observed: May Allah have mercy on Hinda! would that she listened to this verdict. By Lord, she wept for not offering prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عِمْرَانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتُ جَحْشٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَتِ اسْتُحِيضَتْ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ تَعْلُوَ حُمْرَةُ الدَّمِ الْمَاءَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw 'imraana, muhammadu bnu ja'fari bni ziyaadin aakhbaranaa iibraahiymu, - ya'niy abna sa'din - 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat jaa'at aummu habiybaaa bintu jahshin iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaanati astuhiydat sab'a siniyna bimithli hadiythi 'amriw bni alhaarithi iilaa qawlihi ta'luwa humraau alddami almaa'a ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been thus reported by another chain of transmitters:Umm Habiba b. Jahsh came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and she had been a mustahada for seven years, and the rest of the hadith was narrated like that of 'Amr b. al-Harith up to the words:" There came the redness of the blood over water." and nothing was narrated beyond it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ ابْنَةَ جَحْشٍ، كَانَتْ تُسْتَحَاضُ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna abnaaa jahshin, kaanat tustahaadu sab'a siniyna binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: The hadith has been narrated by 'A'isha through another chain of transmitters (in these words):I The daughter of jahsh had been mustabida for seven years," and the rest of the hadith is the same (as mentioned above)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيِبٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ إِنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ سَأَلَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الدَّمِ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رَأَيْتُ مِرْكَنَهَا مَلآنَ دَمًا فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ امْكُثِي قَدْرَ مَا كَانَتْ تَحْبِسُكِ حَيْضَتُكِ ثُمَّ اغْتَسِلِي وَصَلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiyibin, 'an ja'farin, 'an 'iraakin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat iinna aumma habiybaaa saaalat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alddami faqaalat 'aaiishaau raaaytu mirkanahaa malana damana faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ amkuthiy qadra maa kaanat tahbisuki haydatuki thumma aghtasiliy wasalliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: On the authority of 'A'isha:Umm Habiba asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the blood (which flows beyond the period of menstruation). 'A'isha said: I saw her wash-tub full of blood. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Remain away (from prayer) equal (to the length of time) that your menses prevented you. After this (after the period of usual courses) bathe yourself and offer prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ قُرَيْشٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ بَكْرِ بْنِ مُضَرَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ إِنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَحْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ شَكَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الدَّمَ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ امْكُثِي قَدْرَ مَا كَانَتْ تَحْبِسُكِ حَيْضَتُكِ ثُمَّ اغْتَسِلِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muwsaa bnu qurayshin alttamiymiyyu, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu bakri bni mudara, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathaniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an 'iraaki bni maalikin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat iinna aumma habiybaaa binta jahshin allatiy kaanat tahta 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin shakat iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alddama faqaala lahaa ‏ "‏ amkuthiy qadra maa kaanat tahbisuki haydatuki thumma aghtasiliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakaanat taghtasilu 'inda kulli salaaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ), said:Umm Habiba b. Jahsh who was the spouse of Abd al- Rahman b. Auf made a complaint to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about blood (which flows beyond the menstrual period). He said to her: Remain away (from prayer) equal (to the length of time) that your menstruation holds you back. After this, bathe yourself. And she washed herself before every prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرِّشْكِ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ أَتَقْضِي إِحْدَانَا الصَّلاَةَ أَيَّامَ مَحِيضِهَا فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ قَدْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ لاَ تُؤْمَرُ بِقَضَاءٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an mu'aadhaaa, h wahaddathanaa hammaadun, 'an yaziyda alrrishki, 'an mu'aadhaaa, aanna amraaaaan, saaalat 'aaiishaaa faqaalat aataqdiy iihdaanaa alssalaaaa aayyaama mahiydihaa faqaalat 'aaiishaau aaharuwriyyaaun aanti qad kaanat iihdaanaa tahiydu 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma laa tuumaru biqadaa'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mu'adha reported:A woman asked 'A'isha: Should one amongst us complete prayers abandoned during the period of menses? 'A'isha said: Are you a Haruriya? When any one of us during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in her menses (and abandoned prayer) she was not required to complete them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُعَاذَةَ، أَنَّهَا سَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةَ أَتَقْضِي الْحَائِضُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ قَدْ كُنَّ نِسَاءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحِضْنَ أَفَأَمَرَهُنَّ أَنْ يَجْزِينَ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ تَعْنِي يَقْضِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an yaziyda, qaala sami'tu mu'aadhaaa, aannahaa saaalat 'aaiishaaa aataqdiy alhaaiidu alssalaaaa faqaalat 'aaiishaau aaharuwriyyaaun aanti qad kunna nisaa'u rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yahidna aafaaamarahunna aan yajziyna qaala muhammadu bnu ja'farin ta'niy yaqdiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported from Mu'adha that she asked 'A'isha:Should a menstruating woman complete the prayer (abandoned during the menstrual period)? 'A'isha said: Are you a Hurariya? The wives of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) have had their monthly courses, (but) did he order them to make compensation (for the abandoned prayers)? Muhammad b. Ja'far said: (Compensation) denotes their completion
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ فَقُلْتُ مَا بَالُ الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلاَ تَقْضِي الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَتْ أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ قُلْتُ لَسْتُ بِحَرُورِيَّةٍ وَلَكِنِّي أَسْأَلُ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَانَ يُصِيبُنَا ذَلِكَ فَنُؤْمَرُ بِقَضَاءِ الصَّوْمِ وَلاَ نُؤْمَرُ بِقَضَاءِ الصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an 'aasimin, 'an mu'aadhaaa, qaalat saaaltu 'aaiishaaa faqultu maa baalu alhaaiidi taqdiy alssawma walaa taqdiy alssalaaaa faqaalat aaharuwriyyaaun aanti qultu lastu biharuwriyyaain walakinniy aasaalu ‏.‏ qaalat kaana yusiybunaa dhalika fanuumaru biqadaa'i alssawmi walaa nuumaru biqadaa'i alssalaaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mu'adha said:I asked 'A'isha: What is the reason that a menstruating woman completes the fasts (that she abandons during her monthly course). but she does not complete the prayers? She (Hadrat 'A'isha) said: Are you a Haruriya? I said: I am not a Haruriya, but I simply want to inquire. She said: We passed through this (period of menstruation), and we were ordered to complete the fasts, but were not ordered to complete the prayers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، أَنَّ أَبَا مُرَّةَ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، تَقُولُ ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْفَتْحِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ يَغْتَسِلُ ‏.‏ وَفَاطِمَةُ ابْنَتُهُ تَسْتُرُهُ بِثَوْبٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alnnadri, aanna aabaa murraaa, mawlaa aummi haaniiin binti aabiy taalibin aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a aumma haaniiin binta aabiy taalibin, taquwlu dhahabtu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alfathi fawajadtuhu yaghtasilu ‏.‏ wafaatimaau abnatuhu tasturuhu bithawbin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Hani b. Abu Talib reported:I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of the conquest (of Mecca) and found him take a bath. while his daughter Fatimah was holding a curtain around him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا مُرَّةَ، مَوْلَى عَقِيلٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهُ، لَمَّا كَانَ عَامُ الْفَتْحِ أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ بِأَعْلَى مَكَّةَ ‏.‏ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى غُسْلِهِ فَسَتَرَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَاطِمَةُ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ ثَوْبَهُ فَالْتَحَفَ بِهِ ثُمَّ صَلَّى ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ سُبْحَةَ الضُّحَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy hindin, aanna aabaa murraaa, mawlaa 'aqiylin haddathahu aanna aumma haaniiin binta aabiy taalibin haddathathu aannahu, lammaa kaana 'aamu alfathi aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa biaa'laa makkaaa ‏.‏ qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa ghuslihi fasatarat 'alayhi faatimaau thumma aakhadha thawbahu faaltahafa bihi thumma sallaa thamaana raka'aatin subhaaa aldduhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Hani b. Abu Talib reported:It was the day of the conquest (of Mecca) that she went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was staying at a higher part (of that city). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up for his bath. Fatimah held a curtain around him (in order to provide him privacy). He then put on his garments and wrapped himself with that and then offered eight rak'ahs of the forenoon prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فَسَتَرَتْهُ ابْنَتُهُ فَاطِمَةُ بِثَوْبِهِ فَلَمَّا اغْتَسَلَ أَخَذَهُ فَالْتَحَفَ بِهِ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَصَلَّى ثَمَانَ سَجَدَاتٍ وَذَلِكَ ضُحًى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi bni kathiyrin, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy hindin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala fasatarathu abnatuhu faatimaau bithawbihi falammaa aghtasala aakhadhahu faaltahafa bihi thumma qaama fasallaa thamaana sajadaatin wadhalika duhana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Sa'id b. Abu Hind with the same chain of transmitters and said:His (the Holy Prophet's) daughter Fatimah provided him privacy with the help of his cloth, and when he had taken a bath he took it up and wrapped it around him and then stood and offered eight rak'ahs of the forenoon prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى الْقَارِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، قَالَتْ وَضَعْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَاءً وَسَتَرْتُهُ فَاغْتَسَلَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa muwsaa alqaariiu, haddathanaa zaaiidaau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an maymuwnaaa, qaalat wada'tu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa'an wasatartuhu faaghtasala ‏.‏
verses.translation: Maimuna reported:I placed water for the Apostle (ﷺ) and provided privacy for him, and he took a bath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْظُرُ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى عَوْرَةِ الرَّجُلِ وَلاَ الْمَرْأَةُ إِلَى عَوْرَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ وَلاَ يُفْضِي الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ وَلاَ تُفْضِي الْمَرْأَةُ إِلَى الْمَرْأَةِ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa zaydu bnu alhubaabi, 'ani alddahhaaki bni 'uthmaana, qaala aakhbaraniy zaydu bnu aaslama, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yanzuru alrrajulu iilaa 'awraai alrrajuli walaa almaraaau iilaa 'awraai almaraaai walaa yufdiy alrrajulu iilaa alrrajuli fiy thawbin waahidin walaa tufdiy almaraaau iilaa almaraaai fiy althhawbi alwaahidi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman, the son of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, reported from his father:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A man should not see the private parts of another man, and a woman should not see the private parts of another woman, and a man should not lie with another man under one covering, and a woman should not lie with another woman under one covering
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالاَ - مَكَانَ عَوْرَةِ - عُرْيَةِ الرَّجُلِ وَعُرْيَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku bnu 'uthmaana, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaalaa - makaana 'awraai - 'uryaai alrrajuli wa'uryaai almaraaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Abu Fudaik and Dabbik b. 'Uthman with the same chain of transmitters and they observed:Private parts of man are the nakedness (which is concealed)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَانَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ يَغْتَسِلُونَ عُرَاةً يَنْظُرُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى سَوْأَةِ بَعْضٍ وَكَانَ مُوسَى - عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - يَغْتَسِلُ وَحْدَهُ فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا يَمْنَعُ مُوسَى أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ مَعَنَا إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ آدَرُ - قَالَ - فَذَهَبَ مَرَّةً يَغْتَسِلُ فَوَضَعَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى حَجَرٍ فَفَرَّ الْحَجَرُ بِثَوْبِهِ - قَالَ - فَجَمَحَ مُوسَى بِإِثْرِهِ يَقُولُ ثَوْبِي حَجَرُ ثَوْبِي حَجَرُ ‏.‏ حَتَّى نَظَرَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ إِلَى سَوْأَةِ مُوسَى قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا بِمُوسَى مِنْ بَأْسٍ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ الْحَجَرُ حَتَّى نُظِرَ إِلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ ثَوْبَهُ فَطَفِقَ بِالْحَجَرِ ضَرْبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ بِالْحَجَرِ نَدَبٌ سِتَّةٌ أَوْ سَبْعَةٌ ضَرْبُ مُوسَى بِالْحَجَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an muhammadin, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kaanat banuw iisraaiiyla yaghtasiluwna 'uraaaan yanzuru ba'duhum iilaa sawaaai ba'din wakaana muwsaa - 'alayhi alssalaamu - yaghtasilu wahdahu faqaaluwa waalllahi maa yamna'u muwsaa aan yaghtasila ma'anaa iilaaa aannahu adaru - qaala - fadhahaba marraaan yaghtasilu fawada'a thawbahu 'alaa hajarin fafarra alhajaru bithawbihi - qaala - fajamaha muwsaa biiithrihi yaquwlu thawbiy hajaru thawbiy hajaru ‏.‏ hattaa nazarat banuw iisraaiiyla iilaa sawaaai muwsaa qaaluwa waalllahi maa bimuwsaa min baasin ‏.‏ faqaama alhajaru hattaa nuzira iilayhi - qaala - faaakhadha thawbahu fatafiqa bialhajari darbana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa waalllahi iinnahu bialhajari nadabun sittaaun aaw sab'aaun darbu muwsaa bialhajari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amongst the traditions narrated from Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of Abu Huraira, the one is that Banu Isra'il used to take a bath naked, and they looked at the private parts of one another. Moses (peace be upon him), however, took a bath alone (in privacy) ; and they said (tauntingly):By Allah, nothing prohibits Moses to take a bath along with us, but sacrotal hernia. He (Moses) once went for a bath and placed his clothes on a stone and the stone moved on with his clothes. Moses ran after it saying: 0 stone, my clothes,0 stone, my clothes, and Banu Isra'il had the chance to see the private parts of Moses, and said: By Allah, Moses does not suffer from any ailment. The stone then stopped, till Moses had been seen by them, and he then took hold of his clothes and struck the stone. Abu Huraira said: By Allah, there are the marks of six or seven strokes made by Moses on the stone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَاللَّفْظُ، لَهُمَا - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ لَمَّا بُنِيَتِ الْكَعْبَةُ ذَهَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَبَّاسٌ يَنْقُلاَنِ حِجَارَةً فَقَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اجْعَلْ إِزَارَكَ عَلَى عَاتِقِكَ مِنَ الْحِجَارَةِ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَ فَخَرَّ إِلَى الأَرْضِ وَطَمَحَتْ عَيْنَاهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِزَارِي إِزَارِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَشَدَّ عَلَيْهِ إِزَارَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَلَى رَقَبَتِكَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ عَلَى عَاتِقِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, wamuhammadu bnu haatimi bni maymuwnin, jamiy'ana 'an muhammadi bni bakrin, qaala aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, h wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, waalllafzu, lahumaa - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, - aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu lammaa buniyati alka'baau dhahaba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'abbaasun yanqulaani hijaaraaan faqaala al'abbaasu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aj'al iizaaraka 'alaa 'aatiqika mina alhijaaraai ‏.‏ fafa'ala fakharra iilaa alaardi watamahat 'aynaahu iilaa alssamaa'i thumma qaama faqaala ‏ "‏ iizaariy iizaariy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fashadda 'alayhi iizaarahu ‏.‏ qaala abnu raafi'in fiy riwaayatihi 'alaa raqabatika ‏.‏ walam yaqul 'alaa 'aatiqika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:When the Ka'ba was constructed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abbas went and lifted stones. Abbas said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Place your lower garment on your shoulder (so that you may protect yourself from the roughness and hardness of stones). He (the Holy Prophet) did this, but fell down upon the ground in a state of unconciousness and his eyes were turned towards the sky. He then stood up and said: My lower garment, my lower garment; and this wrapper was tied around him. In the hadith transmitted by Ibn Rafi', there is the word:" On his neck" and he did not say:" Upon his shoulder
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَنْقُلُ مَعَهُمُ الْحِجَارَةَ لِلْكَعْبَةِ وَعَلَيْهِ إِزَارُهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْعَبَّاسُ عَمُّهُ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي لَوْ حَلَلْتَ إِزَارَكَ فَجَعَلْتَهُ عَلَى مَنْكِبِكَ دُونَ الْحِجَارَةِ - قَالَ - فَحَلَّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ فَسَقَطَ مَغْشِيًّا عَلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَمَا رُؤِيَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ عُرْيَانًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu diynaarin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yuhaddithu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yanqulu ma'ahumu alhijaaraaa lilka'baai wa'alayhi iizaaruhu faqaala lahu al'abbaasu 'ammuhu yaa abna aakhiy law halalta iizaaraka faja'altahu 'alaa mankibika duwna alhijaaraai - qaala - fahallahu faja'alahu 'alaa mankibihi fasaqata maghshiyyana 'alayhi - qaala - famaa ruuiya ba'da dhalika alyawmi 'uryaanana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was carrying along with them (his people) stones for the Ka'ba and there was a waist wrapper around him. His uncle," Abbas, said to him: 0 son of my brother! if you take off the lower garment and place it on the shoulders underneath the stones, it would be better. He (the Holy Prophet) took it off and placed it on his shoulder and fell down unconscious. He (the narrator) said: Never was he seen naked after that day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمِ بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو أُمَامَةَ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالَ أَقْبَلْتُ بِحَجَرٍ أَحْمِلُهُ ثَقِيلٍ وَعَلَىَّ إِزَارٌ خَفِيفٌ - قَالَ - فَانْحَلَّ إِزَارِي وَمَعِيَ الْحَجَرُ لَمْ أَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ أَضَعَهُ حَتَّى بَلَغْتُ بِهِ إِلَى مَوْضِعِهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ارْجِعْ إِلَى ثَوْبِكَ فَخُذْهُ وَلاَ تَمْشُوا عُرَاةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu yahyaa alaumawiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu hakiymi bni 'abbaadi bni hunayfin alaansaariyyu, aakhbaraniy aabuw aumaamaaa bnu sahli bni hunayfin, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, qaala aaqbaltu bihajarin aahmiluhu thaqiylin wa'alaaaa iizaarun khafiyfun - qaala - faanhalla iizaariy wama'iya alhajaru lam aastati' aan aada'ahu hattaa balaghtu bihi iilaa mawdi'ihi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ arji' iilaa thawbika fakhudhhu walaa tamshuwa 'uraaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Miswar b. Makhrama reported:I was carrying a heavy stone and my lower garment was loose, and it, therefore, slipped off (so soon) that I could not place the stone (on the ground) and carry to its proper place. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Return to your cloth (lower garment), take it (and tie it around your waist) and do not walk naked
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيٌّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مَيْمُونٍ - حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، مَوْلَى الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَرْدَفَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ خَلْفَهُ فَأَسَرَّ إِلَىَّ حَدِيثًا لاَ أُحَدِّثُ بِهِ أَحَدًا مِنَ النَّاسِ وَكَانَ أَحَبَّ مَا اسْتَتَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحَاجَتِهِ هَدَفٌ أَوْ حَائِشُ نَخْلٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَسْمَاءَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ يَعْنِي حَائِطَ نَخْلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, wa'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a aldduba'iyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa mahdiyyun, - wahuwa abnu maymuwnin - haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy ya'quwba, 'ani alhasani bni sa'din, mawlaa alhasani bni 'aliyyin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ja'farin, qaala aardafaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata yawmin khalfahu faaasarra iilaaaa hadiythana laa auhaddithu bihi aahadana mina alnnaasi wakaana aahabba maa astatara bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lihaajatihi hadafun aaw haaiishu nakhlin ‏.‏ qaala abnu aasmaa'a fiy hadiythihi ya'niy haaiita nakhlin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Ja'far reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one day made me mount behind him and he confided to me something secret which I would not disclose to anybody; and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) liked the concealment provided by a lofty place or cluster of dates (while answering the call of nature), Ibn Asma' said in his narration: It implied an enclosure of the date-trees
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي نَمِرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الاِثْنَيْنِ إِلَى قُبَاءٍ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا فِي بَنِي سَالِمٍ وَقَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى بَابِ عِتْبَانَ فَصَرَخَ بِهِ فَخَرَجَ يَجُرُّ إِزَارَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَعْجَلْنَا الرَّجُلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عِتْبَانُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ الرَّجُلَ يُعْجَلُ عَنِ امْرَأَتِهِ وَلَمْ يُمْنِ مَاذَا عَلَيْهِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا الْمَاءُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin - qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'an shariykin, - ya'niy abna aabiy namirin - 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kharajtu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alaithnayni iilaa qubaa'in hattaa iidhaa kunnaa fiy baniy saalimin waqafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa baabi 'itbaana fasarakha bihi fakharaja yajurru iizaarahu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aa'jalnaa alrrajula ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'itbaanu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta alrrajula yu'jalu 'ani amraaatihi walam yumni maadhaa 'alayhi qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa almaa'u mina almaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id al-Khudri narrated it from his father:I went to Quba' with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Monday till we reached (the habitation) of Banu Salim. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood at the door of 'Itban and called him loudly. So he came out dragging his lower garnment. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: We have made this man to make haste 'Itban said: Messenger of Allah, if a man parts with his wife suddenly without seminal emission, what is he required to do (with regard to bath)? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is with the seminal emission that bath becomes obligatory
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا الْمَاءُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathahu aanna aabaa salamaaa bna 'abdi alrrahmani haddathahu 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa almaa'u mina almaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) observed: Bathing is obligatory in case of seminal emission
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْعَلاَءِ بْنُ الشِّخِّيرِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْسَخُ حَدِيثُهُ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا كَمَا يَنْسَخُ الْقُرْآنُ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw al'alaa'i bnu alshhikhhiyri, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yansakhu hadiythuhu ba'duhu ba'dana kamaa yansakhu alquranu ba'duhu ba'dana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu al. 'Ala' b. al-Shikhkhir said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) abrogated some of his commands by others, just as the Qur'an abrogates some part with the other
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ فَخَرَجَ وَرَأْسُهُ يَقْطُرُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّنَا أَعْجَلْنَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أُعْجِلْتَ أَوْ أَقْحَطْتَ فَلاَ غُسْلَ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَيْكَ الْوُضُوءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ ‏"‏ إِذَا أُعْجِلْتَ أَوْ أُقْحِطْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an dhakwaana, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marra 'alaa rajulin mina alaansaari faaarsala iilayhi fakharaja waraasuhu yaqturu faqaala ‏"‏ la'allanaa aa'jalnaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa au'jilta aaw aaqhatta falaa ghusla 'alayka wa'alayka alwuduw'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala abnu bashhaarin ‏"‏ iidhaa au'jilta aaw auqhitta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by (the house) of a man amongst the Ansar, and he sent for him. He came out and water was trickling down from his head. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: Perhaps we put you to haste. He said: Yes. Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: When you made haste or semen is not emitted, bathing is not obligatory for you, but ablution is binding. Ibn Bashshir has narrated it with a minor alteration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُ مِنَ الْمَرْأَةِ ثُمَّ يُكْسِلُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَغْسِلُ مَا أَصَابَهُ مِنَ الْمَرْأَةِ ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ وَيُصَلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy aayyuwba, 'an aubaaai bni ka'bin, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alrrajuli yusiybu mina almaraaai thumma yuksilu faqaala ‏ "‏ yaghsilu maa aasaabahu mina almaraaai thumma yatawaddaau wayusalliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubayy Ibn Ka'b reported:I arked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about a man who has sexual intercourse with his wife, but leaves her before orgasm. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: He should wash the secretion of his wife, and then perform ablution and ofier prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ الْمَلِيِّ، عَنِ الْمَلِيِّ، - يَعْنِي بِقَوْلِهِ الْمَلِيِّ عَنِ الْمَلِيِّ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ، - عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي أَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ لاَ يُنْزِلُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَغْسِلُ ذَكَرَهُ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, haddathaniy aabiy, 'ani almaliyyi, 'ani almaliyyi, - ya'niy biqawlihi almaliyyi 'ani almaliyyi aabuw aayyuwba, - 'an aubaaai bni ka'bin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala fiy alrrajuli yaatiy aahlahu thumma laa yunzilu qaala ‏ "‏ yaghsilu dhakarahu wayatawaddaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubayy ibn Ka'b narrated it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he said:If a person has sexual intercourse with his wife, but does not experience orgasm, he should wash his organ and perform an ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ عَطَاءَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَأَلَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذَا جَامَعَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَلَمْ يُمْنِ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ ‏ "‏ يَتَوَضَّأُ كَمَا يَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاَةِ وَيَغْسِلُ ذَكَرَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, 'ani alhusayni bni dhakwaana, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa, aanna 'ataa'a bna yasaarin, aakhbarahu aanna zayda bna khaalidin aljuhaniyya aakhbarahu aannahu, saaala 'uthmaana bna 'affaana qaala qultu aaraaayta iidhaa jaama'a alrrajulu amraaatahu walam yumni qaala 'uthmaanu ‏ "‏ yatawaddaau kamaa yatawaddaau lilssalaaai wayaghsilu dhakarahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'uthmaanu sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Khalid al-Jubani reported that he askad Uthman b. 'Affan:What is your opinion about the man who has sexual intercourse with his wife, but does not experience orgasm? Uthman said: He should perform ablution as he does for prayer, and wash his organ. 'Uthmin also said: I have heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ، مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, 'ani alhusayni, qaala yahyaa waaakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa, aanna 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri, aakhbarahu aanna aabaa aayyuwba aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a dhalika, min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ayyub reported that he had heard like this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَمَطَرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا جَلَسَ بَيْنَ شُعَبِهَا الأَرْبَعِ ثُمَّ جَهَدَهَا فَقَدْ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْغُسْلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مَطَرٍ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ لَمْ يُنْزِلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ ‏"‏ بَيْنَ أَشْعُبِهَا الأَرْبَعِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu h wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaaluwa haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, wamatarin, 'ani alhasani, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa jalasa bayna shu'abihaa alaarba'i thumma jahadahaa faqad wajaba 'alayhi alghuslu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi matarin ‏"‏ waiin lam yunzil ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala zuhayrun min baynihim ‏"‏ bayna aash'ubihaa alaarba'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: When a man has sexual intercourse, bathing becomes obligatory (both for the male and the female). In the hadith of Matar the words are: Even if there is no orgasm. Zuhair has narrated it with a minor alteration of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ اجْتَهَدَ ‏"‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ لَمْ يُنْزِلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni 'abbaadi bni jabalaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy wahbu bnu jariyrin, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi shu'baaa ‏"‏ thumma ajtahada ‏"‏ walam yaqul ‏"‏ waiin lam yunzil ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Qatida with the same chain of transmitters, but with minor alterations. Here instead of the word - (jahada, (ijtahada) has been used, and the words;" Even if there is no orgasm" have been omitted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، - وَهَذَا حَدِيثُهُ - حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، قَالَ - وَلاَ أَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، - عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ اخْتَلَفَ فِي ذَلِكَ رَهْطٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّونَ لاَ يَجِبُ الْغُسْلُ إِلاَّ مِنَ الدَّفْقِ أَوْ مِنَ الْمَاءِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ بَلْ إِذَا خَالَطَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى فَأَنَا أَشْفِيكُمْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ فَاسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَأُذِنَ لِي فَقُلْتُ لَهَا يَا أُمَّاهْ - أَوْ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ - إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكِ عَنْ شَىْءٍ وَإِنِّي أَسْتَحْيِيكِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ لاَ تَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ تَسْأَلَنِي عَمَّا كُنْتَ سَائِلاً عَنْهُ أُمَّكَ الَّتِي وَلَدَتْكَ فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا أُمُّكَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَمَا يُوجِبُ الْغُسْلَ قَالَتْ عَلَى الْخَبِيرِ سَقَطْتَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا جَلَسَ بَيْنَ شُعَبِهَا الأَرْبَعِ وَمَسَّ الْخِتَانُ الْخِتَانَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, haddathanaa humaydu bnu hilaalin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, - wahadhaa hadiythuhu - haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, qaala - walaa aa'lamuhu iilaaa 'an aabiy burdaaa, - 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala akhtalafa fiy dhalika rahtun mina almuhaajiriyna waalaansaari faqaala alaansaariyyuwna laa yajibu alghuslu iilaaa mina alddafqi aaw mina almaa'i ‏.‏ waqaala almuhaajiruwna bal iidhaa khaalata faqad wajaba alghuslu ‏.‏ qaala qaala aabuw muwsaa faaanaa aashfiykum min dhalika ‏.‏ faqumtu faastaadhantu 'alaa 'aaiishaaa faaudhina liy faqultu lahaa yaa aummaah - aaw yaa aumma almuuminiyna - iinniy auriydu aan aasaalaki 'an shaa'in waiinniy aastahyiyki ‏.‏ faqaalat laa tastahyiy aan tasaalaniy 'ammaa kunta saaiilaan 'anhu aummaka allatiy waladatka faiinnamaa aanaa aummuka ‏.‏ qultu famaa yuwjibu alghusla qaalat 'alaa alkhabiyri saqatta qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa jalasa bayna shu'abihaa alaarba'i wamassa alkhitaanu alkhitaana faqad wajaba alghuslu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported:There cropped up a difference of opinion between a group of Muhajirs (Emigrants and a group of Ansar (Helpers) (and the point of dispute was) that the Ansar said: The bath (because of sexual intercourse) becomes obligatory only-when the semen spurts out or ejaculates. But the Muhajirs said: When a man has sexual intercourse (with the woman), a bath becomes obligatory (no matter whether or not there is seminal emission or ejaculation). Abu Musa said: Well, I satisfy you on this (issue). He (Abu Musa, the narrator) said: I got up (and went) to 'A'isha and sought her permission and it was granted, and I said to her: 0 Mother, or Mother of the Faithful, I want to ask you about a matter on which I feel shy. She said: Don't feel shy of asking me about a thing which you can ask your mother, who gave you birth, for I am too your mother. Upon this I said: What makes a bath obligatory for a person? She replied: You have come across one well informed! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone sits amidst four parts (of the woman) and the circumcised parts touch each other a bath becomes obligatory
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عِيَاضُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ إِنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُجَامِعُ أَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ يُكْسِلُ هَلْ عَلَيْهِمَا الْغُسْلُ وَعَائِشَةُ جَالِسَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ أَنَا وَهَذِهِ ثُمَّ نَغْتَسِلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, wahaaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'iyaadu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aummi kulthuwmin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat iinna rajulaan saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alrrajuli yujaami'u aahlahu thumma yuksilu hal 'alayhimaa alghuslu wa'aaiishaau jaalisaaun ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinniy laaf'alu dhalika aanaa wahadhihi thumma naghtasilu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported. A person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about one who has sexual intercourse with his wife and parts away (without orgasm) whether bathing is obligatory for him. 'A'isha was sitting by him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:I and she (the Mother of the Faithful) do it and then take a bath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، أَنَّ خَارِجَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْوُضُوءُ مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ ‏"‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, qaala qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy 'abdu almaliki bnu aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhaarithi bni hishaamin, aanna khaarijaaa bna zaydin alaansaariyya, aakhbarahu aanna aabaahu zayda bna thaabitin qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alwuduw'u mimmaa massati alnnaaru ‏"‏
verses.translation: Zaid b Thabit reported:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say this: Ablution is obligatory (for one who takes anything) touched by fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ قَارِظٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، وَجَدَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَتَوَضَّأُ عَلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا أَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ أَثْوَارِ أَقِطٍ أَكَلْتُهَا لأَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تَوَضَّئُوا مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna iibraahiyma bni qaarizin, aakhbarahu aannahu, wajada aabaa hurayraaa yatawaddaau 'alaa almasjidi faqaala iinnamaa aatawaddaau min aathwaari aaqitin aakaltuhaa laanniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ tawaddaiuwa mimmaa massati alnnaaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Ibrahim b. Qariz reported that he found Abu Huraira performing ablution in the mosque, who said:I am performing ablution because of having eaten pieces of cheese, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Perform ablution (after eating anything) touched by fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، وَأَنَا أُحَدِّثُهُ، هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنِ الْوُضُوءِ، مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ فَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَوَضَّئُوا مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu khaalidi bni 'amriw bni 'uthmaana, waaanaa auhaddithuhu, hadhaa alhadiytha ‏.‏ aannahu saaala 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri 'ani alwuduw'i, mimmaa massati alnnaaru faqaala 'urwaau sami'tu 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm taquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tawaddaiuwa mimmaa massati alnnaaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Urwa reported on the authority of'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), saying this:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. Perform ablution (after eating) anything touched by fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكَلَ كَتِفَ شَاةٍ ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakala katifa shaaain thumma sallaa walam yatawaddaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took (meat of) goat's shoulder and offered prayer and did not perform ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي وَهْبُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكَلَ عَرْقًا - أَوْ لَحْمًا - ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ وَلَمْ يَمَسَّ مَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, aakhbaraniy wahbu bnu kaysaana, 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, h wahaddathaniy alzzuhriyyu, 'an 'aliyyi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aakala 'arqana - aaw lahmana - thumma sallaa walam yatawaddaa walam yamassa maa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took flesh from the bone or meat, and then offered prayer and did not perform ablution, and (in fact) he did not touch water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحْتَزُّ مِنْ كَتِفٍ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an ja'fari bni 'amriw bni aumayyaaa alddamriyyi, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu raaaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yahtazzu min katifin yaakulu minhaa thumma sallaa walam yatawaddaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ja'far b. Amr b. Umayya al-Damari reported on the authority of his father who said:I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) take slices from goat's shoulder, and then eat them, and then offer prayer without having performed ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحْتَزُّ مِنْ كَتِفِ شَاةٍ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا فَدُعِيَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَقَامَ وَطَرَحَ السِّكِّينَ وَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'iysaa, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an ja'fari bni 'amriw bni aumayyaaa alddamriyyi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yahtazzu min katifi shaaain faaakala minhaa fadu'iya iilaa alssalaaai faqaama wataraha alssikkiyna wasallaa walam yatawaddaa ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin 'an aabiyhi 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ja'far b. 'Amr b. Umayya al-Damari reported on the authority of his father who said:I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) take slices from goat's shoulder and then eat them. He was called for prayer and he got'up, leaving aside the knife, and offered prayer but did not perform ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ عَمْرٌو وَحَدَّثَنِي بُكَيْرُ بْنُ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكَلَ عِنْدَهَا كَتِفًا ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala 'amrunw wahaddathaniy bukayru bnu alaashajji, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'an maymuwnaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aakala 'indahaa katifana thumma sallaa walam yatawaddaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported it on the authority of Maimuana, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took (a piece of goat's) shoulder at her place, and then offered prayer but did not perform ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala 'amrunw haddathaniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an ya'quwba bni alaashajji, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'an maymuwnaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn 'Abbas on the authority of Maimuna. the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ), by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي غَطَفَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ أَشْهَدُ لَكُنْتُ أَشْوِي لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَطْنَ الشَّاةِ ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala 'amrunw haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy hilaalin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy ghatafaana, 'an aabiy raafi'in, qaala aashhadu lakuntu aashwiy lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm batna alshhaaai thumma sallaa walam yatawaddaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Rafi' reported:I testify that I used to roast the liver of the goat for the Messenger of Allah (may peace be tipcn him) and then he offered praver but did not perform ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَرِبَ لَبَنًا ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَتَمَضْمَضَ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لَهُ دَسَمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm shariba labanana thumma da'aa bimaa'in fatamadmada waqaala ‏ "‏ iinna lahu dasamana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:The Apostle (ﷺ) took milk and then called for water and rinsed (his mouth) and said: It contains greasiness
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ عُقَيْلٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'iysaa, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, waaakhbaraniy 'amrunw, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy yuwnusu, kulluhum 'ani abni shihaabin, biiisnaadi 'uqaylin 'ani alzzuhriyyi, mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ ثِيَابَهُ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَأُتِيَ بِهَدِيَّةٍ خُبْزٍ وَلَحْمٍ فَأَكَلَ ثَلاَثَ لُقَمٍ ثُمَّ صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ وَمَا مَسَّ مَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni halhalaaa, 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jama'a 'alayhi thiyaabahu thumma kharaja iilaa alssalaaai faautiya bihadiyyaain khubzin walahmin faaakala thalaatha luqamin thumma sallaa bialnnaasi wamaa massa maa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dressed himself, and then went out for prayer, when he was presented with bread and meat. He took three morsels out of that, and then offered prayer along with other people and did not touch water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ وَفِيهِ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، شَهِدَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَقَالَ صَلَّى وَلَمَ يَقُلْ بِالنَّاسِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi bni kathiyrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni 'ataa'in, qaala kuntu ma'a abni 'abbaasin ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi abni halhalaaa wafiyhi aanna abna 'abbaasin, shahida dhalika mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ waqaala sallaa walama yaqul bialnnaasi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Muhammad b. 'Amr b. Ata' with these words:I was with Ibn 'Abbas, and Ibn 'Abbas saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing like this, and it is also said that the words are: He (the Holy Prophet) offered prayer; and the word" people" is not mentioned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَأَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ لُحُومِ الْغَنَمِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَلاَ تَوَضَّأْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ لُحُومِ الإِبِلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ فَتَوَضَّأْ مِنْ لُحُومِ الإِبِلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُصَلِّي فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُصَلِّي فِي مَبَارِكِ الإِبِلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an 'uthmaana bni 'abdi alllahi bni mawhabin, 'an ja'fari bni aabiy thawrin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, aanna rajulaan, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaatawaddaau min luhuwmi alghanami qaala ‏"‏ iin shiita fatawaddaa waiin shiita falaa tawaddaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aatawaddaau min luhuwmi aliibili qaala ‏"‏ na'am fatawaddaa min luhuwmi aliibili ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ausalliy fiy maraabidi alghanami qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ausalliy fiy mabaariki aliibili qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:A man asked the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) whether he should perform ablution after (eating) mutton. He (the Messenger of Allah) said: Perform ablution it you so desire, and if you do not wish, do not perform it. He (again) asked: Should I perform ablution (after eating) camel's flesh? He said: Yes, perform ablution (after eating) camel's flesh. He (again) said: May I say prayer in the sheepfolds? He (the Messenger of Allah) said: Yes. He (the narrator) again said: May I say prayer where camels lie down? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، وَأَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي كَامِلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa zaaiidaau, 'an simaakin, h wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an shaybaana, 'an 'uthmaana bni 'abdi alllahi bni mawhabin, waaash'atha bni aabiy alshha'thaa'i, kulluhum 'an ja'fari bni aabiy thawrin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi aabiy kaamilin 'an aabiy 'awaanaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is also narrated by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، شُكِيَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّجُلُ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ يَجِدُ الشَّىْءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْصَرِفُ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ صَوْتًا أَوْ يَجِدَ رِيحًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِمَا هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydin, wa'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, shukiya iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alrrajulu yukhayyalu iilayhi aannahu yajidu alshhaa'a fiy alssalaaai qaala ‏ "‏ laa yansarifu hattaa yasma'a sawtana aaw yajida riyhana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin wazuhayru bnu harbin fiy riwaayatihimaa huwa 'abdu alllahi bnu zaydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abbad b. Tamim reported from his uncle that a person made a complaint to the Apostle (ﷺ) that he entertained (doubt) as it something had happened to him breaking his ablution. He (the Holy Prophet) said:He should not return (from prayer) unless he hears a sound or perceives a smell (of passing wind). Abu Bakr and Zuhair b. Harb have pointed out in their narrations that it was 'Abdullah b. Zaid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا وَجَدَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي بَطْنِهِ شَيْئًا فَأَشْكَلَ عَلَيْهِ أَخَرَجَ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ أَمْ لاَ فَلاَ يَخْرُجَنَّ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ صَوْتًا أَوْ يَجِدَ رِيحًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa wajada aahadukum fiy batnihi shayiana faaashkala 'alayhi aakharaja minhu shaa'un aam laa falaa yakhrujanna mina almasjidi hattaa yasma'a sawtana aaw yajida riyhana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If any one of you has pain in his abdomen, but is doubtful whether or not anything has issued from him, be should not leave the mosque unless he hears a sound or perceives a smell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ تُصُدِّقَ عَلَى مَوْلاَةٍ لِمَيْمُونَةَ بِشَاةٍ فَمَاتَتْ فَمَرَّ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلاَّ أَخَذْتُمْ إِهَابَهَا فَدَبَغْتُمُوهُ فَانْتَفَعْتُمْ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا إِنَّهَا مَيْتَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا حَرُمَ أَكْلُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ رضى الله عنها ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu waabnu aabiy 'umara jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala tusuddiqa 'alaa mawlaaain limaymuwnaaa bishaaain famaatat famarra bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ halaaa aakhadhtum iihaabahaa fadabaghtumuwhu faantafa'tum bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa iinnahaa maytaaun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa haruma aakluhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin waabnu aabiy 'umara fiy hadiythihimaa 'an maymuwnaaa rda allh 'nha ‏.‏
verses.translation: The freed slave-girl of Maimuna was given a goat in charity but it died. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by that (carcass). Upon this be said:Why did you not take off its skin? You could put it to use, after tanning it. They (the Companions) said: It was dead.
