Upon, this he (the Messenger of Allah) said: Only its eating is prohibited. Abu bakr and Ibn Umar in their narrations said: It is narrated from Maimuna (may Allah be pleased with her)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَدَ شَاةً مَيْتَةً أُعْطِيَتْهَا مَوْلاَةٌ لِمَيْمُونَةَ مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلاَّ انْتَفَعْتُمْ بِجِلْدِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا إِنَّهَا مَيْتَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا حَرُمَ أَكْلُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wajada shaaaan maytaaan au'tiyathaa mawlaaaun limaymuwnaaa mina alssadaqaai faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ halaaa antafa'tum bijildihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa iinnahaa maytaaun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa haruma aakluhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw a dead goat, which had been given in charity to the freed slave-girl of Maimuna. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Why don't you make use of its skin? They (the Companions around the Holy Prophet) said: It is dead. Upon this he said: It is the eating (of the dead animal) which is prohibited
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِنَحْوِ رِوَايَةِ يُونُسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an ya'quwba bni iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi binahwi riwaayaai yuwnusa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters as transmitted by Yunus
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِشَاةٍ مَطْرُوحَةٍ أُعْطِيَتْهَا مَوْلاَةٌ لِمَيْمُونَةَ مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَّ أَخَذُوا إِهَابَهَا فَدَبَغُوهُ فَانْتَفَعُوا بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, wa'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin alzzuhriyyu, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy 'umara - qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marra bishaaain matruwhaain au'tiyathaa mawlaaaun limaymuwnaaa mina alssadaqaai faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalaaa aakhadhuwa iihaabahaa fadabaghuwhu faantafa'uwa bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a goat thrown (away) which had been in fact given to the freed slave-girl of Maimuna as charity. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (way peace he upon him) said: Why did they not get its skin? They had better tan it and make use of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، مُنْذُ حِينٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ مَيْمُونَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ دَاجِنَةً كَانَتْ لِبَعْضِ نِسَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَاتَتْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَّ أَخَذْتُمْ إِهَابَهَا فَاسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, mundhu hiynin qaala aakhbaraniy abnu 'abbaasin, aanna maymuwnaaa, aakhbarathu aanna daajinaaan kaanat liba'di nisaa'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm famaatat faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalaaa aakhadhtum iihaabahaa faastamta'tum bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn'Abbas reported on the authority of Maimuna that someone amongst the wives of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a domestic animal and it died. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Why did you not take off its skin and make use of that?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِشَاةٍ لِمَوْلاَةٍ لِمَيْمُونَةَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَّ انْتَفَعْتُمْ بِإِهَابِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahiymi bnu sulaymaana, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni aabiy sulaymaana, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm marra bishaaain limawlaaain limaymuwnaaa faqaala ‏ "‏ aalaaa antafa'tum biiihaabihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by (the dead body) of the goat which belonged to the freed slave-girl of Maimuna and said: Why did you not make use of its skin?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ وَعْلَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا دُبِغَ الإِهَابُ فَقَدْ طَهُرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna wa'laaa, aakhbarahu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa dubigha aliihaabu faqad tahura ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abbas said:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: When the skin is tanned it becomes purified
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ يَعْنِي حَدِيثَ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَحْيَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi ya'niy abna muhammadin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an wakiy'in, 'an sufyaana, kulluhum 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni wa'laaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ya'niy hadiytha yahyaa bni yahyaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الْخَيْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ عَلَى ابْنِ وَعْلَةَ السَّبَئِيِّ فَرْوًا فَمَسِسْتُهُ فَقَالَ مَا لَكَ تَمَسُّهُ قَدْ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ قُلْتُ إِنَّا نَكُونُ بِالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَعَنَا الْبَرْبَرُ وَالْمَجُوسُ نُؤْتَى بِالْكَبْشِ قَدْ ذَبَحُوهُ وَنَحْنُ لاَ نَأْكُلُ ذَبَائِحَهُمْ وَيَأْتُونَا بِالسِّقَاءِ يَجْعَلُونَ فِيهِ الْوَدَكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَدْ سَأَلْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ دِبَاغُهُ طَهُورُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa waqaala abnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'amruw bnu alrrabiy'i, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, aanna aabaa alkhayri, haddathahu qaala raaaytu 'alaa abni wa'laaa alssabaiiyyi farwana famasistuhu faqaala maa laka tamassuhu qad saaaltu 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin qultu iinnaa nakuwnu bialmaghribi wama'anaa albarbaru waalmajuwsu nuutaa bialkabshi qad dhabahuwhu wanahnu laa naakulu dhabaaiihahum wayaatuwnaa bialssiqaa'i yaj'aluwna fiyhi alwadaka ‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'abbaasin qad saaalnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ dibaaghuhu tahuwruhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu al-Khair reported:I saw Ibn Wa'la al-Saba'i wear a fur. I touched it. He said: Why do you touch it? I asked Ibn 'Abbas saying: We are the inhabitants of the western regions, and there (live) with us Berbers and Magians. They bring with them rams and slaughter them, but we do not eat (the meat of the animals) slaughtered by them, and they come with skins full of fat. Upon this Ibn 'Abbas said: We asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about this and he said: Its tanning makes it pure
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَعْلَةَ السَّبَئِيُّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ قُلْتُ إِنَّا نَكُونُ بِالْمَغْرِبِ فَيَأْتِينَا الْمَجُوسُ بِالأَسْقِيَةِ فِيهَا الْمَاءُ وَالْوَدَكُ فَقَالَ اشْرَبْ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَرَأْىٌ تَرَاهُ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ دِبَاغُهُ طَهُورُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa 'an 'amriw bni alrrabiy'i, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'an aabiy alkhayri, haddathahu qaala haddathaniy abnu wa'laaa alssabaiiyyu, qaala saaaltu 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin qultu iinnaa nakuwnu bialmaghribi fayaatiynaa almajuwsu bialaasqiyaai fiyhaa almaa'u waalwadaku faqaala ashrab ‏.‏ faqultu aaraaaun taraahu faqaala abnu 'abbaasin sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ dibaaghuhu tahuwruhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Wa'la al-Saba'i reported:I asked 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas saying: We are the inhabitants of the western regions. The Magians come to us with skins full of water and fat. He said: Drink. I said to him: Is it your own opinion? Ibn Abbas said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Tanning purifies it (the skin)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالْبَيْدَاءِ - أَوْ بِذَاتِ الْجَيْشِ - انْقَطَعَ عِقْدٌ لِي فَأَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْتِمَاسِهِ وَأَقَامَ النَّاسُ مَعَهُ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى مَاءٍ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءٌ فَأَتَى النَّاسُ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالُوا أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا صَنَعَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَقَامَتْ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِالنَّاسِ مَعَهُ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى مَاءٍ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءٌ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاضِعٌ رَأْسَهُ عَلَى فَخِذِي قَدْ نَامَ فَقَالَ حَبَسْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسَ وَلَيْسُوا عَلَى مَاءٍ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ مَاءٌ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَعَاتَبَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَقَالَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ وَجَعَلَ يَطْعُنُ بِيَدِهِ فِي خَاصِرَتِي فَلاَ يَمْنَعُنِي مِنَ التَّحَرُّكِ إِلاَّ مَكَانُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى فَخِذِي فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَاءٍ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ آيَةَ التَّيَمُّمِ فَتَيَمَّمُوا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُسَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُضَيْرِ - وَهُوَ أَحَدُ النُّقَبَاءِ - مَا هِيَ بِأَوَّلِ بَرَكَتِكُمْ يَا آلَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَبَعَثْنَا الْبَعِيرَ الَّذِي كُنْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَوَجَدْنَا الْعِقْدَ تَحْتَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di aasfaarihi hattaa iidhaa kunnaa bialbaydaa'i - aaw bidhaati aljayshi - anqata'a 'iqdun liy faaaqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa altimaasihi waaaqaama alnnaasu ma'ahu walaysuwa 'alaa maa'in walaysa ma'ahum maa'un faaataa alnnaasu iilaa aabiy bakrin faqaaluwa aalaa taraa iilaa maa sana'at 'aaiishaau aaqaamat birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wabialnnaasi ma'ahu walaysuwa 'alaa maa'in walaysa ma'ahum maa'un ‏.‏ fajaa'a aabuw bakrin warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waadi'un raasahu 'alaa fakhidhiy qad naama faqaala habasti rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasa walaysuwa 'alaa maa'in walaysa ma'ahum maa'un ‏.‏ qaalat fa'aatabaniy aabuw bakrin waqaala maa shaa'a alllahu aan yaquwla waja'ala yat'unu biyadihi fiy khaasiratiy falaa yamna'uniy mina alttaharruki iilaaa makaanu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa fakhidhiy fanaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa aasbaha 'alaa ghayri maa'in faaanzala alllahu ayaaa alttayammumi fatayammamuwa ‏.‏ faqaala ausaydu bnu alhudayri - wahuwa aahadu alnnuqabaa'i - maa hiya biaawwali barakatikum yaa ala aabiy bakrin ‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau faba'athnaa alba'iyra alladhiy kuntu 'alayhi fawajadnaa al'iqda tahtahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:We went with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on one of his journeys and when we reached the place Baida' or Dhat al-jaish, my necklace was broken (and fell somewhere). The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) along with other people stayed there for searching it. There was neither any water at that place nor was there any water with them (the Companions of the Holy Prophet). Some persons came to my father Abu Bakr and said: Do you see what 'A'isha has done? She has detained the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and persons accompanying him, and there is neither any water here or with them. So Abu Bakr came there and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sleeping with his head on my thigh. He (Abu Bakr) said: You have detained the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and other persons and there is neither water here nor with them. She ('A'isha) said: Abu Bakr scolded me and uttered what Allah wanted him to utter and nudged my hips with his hand. And there was nothing to prevent me from stirring but for the fact that the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was lying upon my thigh. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slept till it was dawn at a waterless place. So Allah revealed the verses pertaining to tayammum and they (the Prophet and his Companions) performed tayammum. Usaid b. al-Hudair who was one of the leaders said: This is not the first of your blessings,0 Family to Abu Bakr. 'A'isha said: We made the came) stand which was my mount and found the necklace under it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، بِشْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا اسْتَعَارَتْ مِنْ أَسْمَاءَ قِلاَدَةً فَهَلَكَتْ فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَاسًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِي طَلَبِهَا فَأَدْرَكَتْهُمُ الصَّلاَةُ فَصَلَّوْا بِغَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ فَلَمَّا أَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَكَوْا ذَلِكَ إِلَيْهِ فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ التَّيَمُّمِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُسَيْدُ بْنُ حُضَيْرٍ جَزَاكِ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا فَوَاللَّهِ مَا نَزَلَ بِكِ أَمْرٌ قَطُّ إِلاَّ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكِ مِنْهُ مَخْرَجًا وَجَعَلَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ فِيهِ بَرَكَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, waabnu, bishrin 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa asta'aarat min aasmaa'a qilaadaaan fahalakat faaarsala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm naasana min aashaabihi fiy talabihaa faaadrakathumu alssalaaau fasallawa bighayri wuduw'in falammaa aatawua alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm shakawa dhalika iilayhi fanazalat ayaau alttayammumi ‏.‏ faqaala ausaydu bnu hudayrin jazaaki alllahu khayrana fawaalllahi maa nazala biki aamrun qattu iilaaa ja'ala alllahu laki minhu makhrajana waja'ala lilmuslimiyna fiyhi barakaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported she had borrowed from Asma' (her sister) a necklace and it was lost. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent men to search for it. As it was the time for prayer, they offered prayer without ablution (as water was not available there). When they came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), they made a complaint about it, and the verses pertaining to tayammum were revealed. Upon this Usaid b. Hadair said (to 'A'isha):May Allah grant you a good reward! Never has been there an occasion when you were beset with difficulty and Allah did not make you come out of that and made it an occasion of blessing for the Muslims
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَبِي مُوسَى فَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً أَجْنَبَ فَلَمْ يَجِدِ الْمَاءَ شَهْرًا كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لاَ يَتَيَمَّمُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ الْمَاءَ شَهْرًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى فَكَيْفَ بِهَذِهِ الآيَةِ فِي سُورَةِ الْمَائِدَةِ ‏{‏ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا‏}‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَوْ رُخِّصَ لَهُمْ فِي هَذِهِ الآيَةِ - لأَوْشَكَ إِذَا بَرَدَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَاءُ أَنْ يَتَيَمَّمُوا بِالصَّعِيدِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ قَوْلَ عَمَّارٍ بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَاجَةٍ فَأَجْنَبْتُ فَلَمْ أَجِدِ الْمَاءَ فَتَمَرَّغْتُ فِي الصَّعِيدِ كَمَا تَمَرَّغُ الدَّابَّةُ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَكْفِيكَ أَنْ تَقُولَ بِيَدَيْكَ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِيَدَيْهِ الأَرْضَ ضَرْبَةً وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ مَسَحَ الشِّمَالَ عَلَى الْيَمِينِ وَظَاهِرَ كَفَّيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَوَلَمْ تَرَ عُمَرَ لَمْ يَقْنَعْ بِقَوْلِ عَمَّارٍ
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waabnu numayrin jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, qaala kuntu jaalisana ma'a 'abdi alllahi waaabiy muwsaa faqaala aabuw muwsaa yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani aaraaayta law aanna rajulaan aajnaba falam yajidi almaa'a shahrana kayfa yasna'u bialssalaaai faqaala 'abdu alllahi laa yatayammamu waiin lam yajidi almaa'a shahrana ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw muwsaa fakayfa bihadhihi alayaai fiy suwraai almaaiidaai ‏{‏ falam tajiduwa maa'an fatayammamuwa sa'iydana tayyibana‏}‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi law rukhhisa lahum fiy hadhihi alayaai - laawshaka iidhaa barada 'alayhimu almaa'u aan yatayammamuwa bialssa'iydi ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw muwsaa li'abdi alllahi aalam tasma' qawla 'ammaarin ba'athaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy haajaain faaajnabtu falam aajidi almaa'a fatamarraghtu fiy alssa'iydi kamaa tamarraghu alddaabbaau thumma aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakartu dhalika lahu faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa kaana yakfiyka aan taquwla biyadayka hakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma daraba biyadayhi alaarda darbaaan waahidaaan thumma masaha alshhimaala 'alaa alyamiyni wazaahira kaffayhi wawajhahu ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi aawalam tara 'umara lam yaqna' biqawli 'ammaarin
verses.translation: Shaqiq reported:I was sitting in the company of Abdullah and Abu Musa when Abu Musa said: 0 'Abd al-Rahman (kunya of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud), what would you like a man to do about the prayer if he experiences a seminal emission or has sexual intercourse but does not find water for a month? 'Abdullah said: He should not perform tayammum even if he does not find water for a month. 'Abdullah said: Then what about the verse in Sura Ma'ida:" If you do not find water, betake yourself to clean dust"? 'Abdullah said: If they were granted concession on the basis of this verse, there is a possibility that they would perform tayammum with dust on finding water very cold for themselves. Abu Musa said to Abdullah: You have not heard the words of 'Ammar: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me on an errand and I had a seminal emission, but could find no water, and rolled myself in dust just as a beast rolls itself. I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then and made a mention of that to him and he (the Holy Prophet) said: It would have been enough for you to do thus. Then he struck the ground with his hands once and wiped his right hand with the help of his left hand and the exterior of his palms and his face. 'Abdullah said: Didn't you see that Umar was not fully satisfied with the words of 'Ammar only?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِقِصَّتِهِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَكْفِيكَ أَنْ تَقُولَ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَضَرَبَ بِيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الأَرْضِ فَنَفَضَ يَدَيْهِ فَمَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ وَكَفَّيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an shaqiyqin, qaala qaala aabuw muwsaa li'abdi alllahi wasaaqa alhadiytha biqissatihi nahwa hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa ghayra aannahu qaala faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa kaana yakfiyka aan taquwla hakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wadaraba biyadayhi iilaa alaardi fanafada yadayhi famasaha wajhahu wakaffayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Shaqiq with the same chain of transmitters but with the alteration of these words:He (the Holy Prophet) struck hands upon the earth, and then shook them and then wiped his face and palm
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانَ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ، عَنْ ذَرٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى عُمَرَ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَجْنَبْتُ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ مَاءً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ تُصَلِّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَمَّارٌ أَمَا تَذْكُرُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ أَنَا وَأَنْتَ فِي سَرِيَّةٍ فَأَجْنَبْنَا فَلَمْ نَجِدْ مَاءً فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ فَلَمْ تُصَلِّ وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَتَمَعَّكْتُ فِي التُّرَابِ وَصَلَّيْتُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَكْفِيكَ أَنْ تَضْرِبَ بِيَدَيْكَ الأَرْضَ ثُمَّ تَنْفُخَ ثُمَّ تَمْسَحَ بِهِمَا وَجْهَكَ وَكَفَّيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَا عَمَّارُ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنْ شِئْتَ لَمْ أُحَدِّثْ بِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَكَمُ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ ذَرٍّ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ عَنْ ذَرٍّ فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ الْحَكَمُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ نُوَلِّيكَ مَا تَوَلَّيْتَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu haashimin al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin alqattaana - 'an shu'baaa, qaala haddathaniy alhakamu, 'an dharrin, 'an sa'iydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabzaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rajulaan, aataa 'umara faqaala iinniy aajnabtu falam aajid maa'an ‏.‏ faqaala laa tusalli ‏.‏ faqaala 'ammaarun aamaa tadhkuru yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna iidh aanaa waaanta fiy sariyyaain faaajnabnaa falam najid maa'an faaammaa aanta falam tusalli waaammaa aanaa fatama''aktu fiy altturaabi wasallaytu ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa kaana yakfiyka aan tadriba biyadayka alaarda thumma tanfukha thumma tamsaha bihimaa wajhaka wakaffayka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru attaqi alllaha yaa 'ammaaru ‏.‏ qaala iin shiita lam auhaddith bihi ‏.‏ qaala alhakamu wahaddathaniyhi abnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabzaa 'an aabiyhi mithla hadiythi dharrin qaala wahaddathaniy salamaau 'an dharrin fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi alladhiy dhakara alhakamu faqaala 'umaru nuwalliyka maa tawallayta ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rabmin b. Abza narrated It on the authority of his father that a man came to 'Umar and said:I am (at times) affected by seminal emission but find no water. He ('Umar) told him not to say prayer. 'Ammar then said. Do you remember,0 Commander of the Faithful, when I and you were in a military detachment and we had had a seminal emission and did not find water (for taking bath) and you did not say prayer, but as for myself I rolled in dust and said prayer, and (when it was mentioned before) the Apostle (ﷺ) said: It was enough for you to strike the ground with your hands and then blow (the dust) and then wipe your face and palms. Umar said: 'Ammar, fear Allah. He said: If you so like, I would not narrate it. A hadith like this has been transmitted with the same chain of transmitters but for the words: 'Umar said: We hold you responsible for what you claim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ذَرًّا، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى، قَالَ قَالَ الْحَكَمُ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنِ ابْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى عُمَرَ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَجْنَبْتُ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ مَاءً ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَزَادَ فِيهِ قَالَ عَمَّارٌ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِنْ شِئْتَ لِمَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَىَّ مِنْ حَقِّكَ لاَ أُحَدِّثُ بِهِ أَحَدًا وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ عَنْ ذَرٍّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, qaala sami'tu dharrana, 'ani abni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabzaa, qaala qaala alhakamu waqad sami'tuhu mini abni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabzaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rajulaan, aataa 'umara faqaala iinniy aajnabtu falam aajid maa'an ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha wazaada fiyhi qaala 'ammaarun yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna iin shiita limaa ja'ala alllahu 'alaaaa min haqqika laa auhaddithu bihi aahadana walam yadhkur haddathaniy salamaau 'an dharrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Abza mnated it on the authority of his father that a man came to Umar and said:I have had a seminal emission but I found no water, and the rest of the hadith is the same but with this addition: 'Amr said: 0 Commander of the Faithful, because of the right given to you by Allah over me, if you desire, I would not narrate this hadith to anyone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ وَرَوَى اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ أَقْبَلْتُ أَنَا وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، مَوْلَى مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا عَلَى أَبِي الْجَهْمِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الصِّمَّةِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ فَقَالَ أَبُو الْجَهْمِ أَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ نَحْوِ بِئْرِ جَمَلٍ فَلَقِيَهُ رَجُلٌ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى أَقْبَلَ عَلَى الْجِدَارِ فَمَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ رَدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala muslimun warawaa alllaythu bnu sa'din, 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni hurmuza, 'an 'umayrin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu aaqbaltu aanaa wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu yasaarin, mawlaa maymuwnaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa dakhalnaa 'alaa aabiy aljahmi bni alhaarithi bni alssimmaai alaansaariyyi faqaala aabuw aljahmi aaqbala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min nahwi biiri jamalin falaqiyahu rajulun fasallama 'alayhi falam yarudda rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alayhi hattaa aaqbala 'alaa aljidaari famasaha wajhahu wayadayhi thumma radda 'alayhi alssalaama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umair, the freed slave of Ibn 'Abbas, reported:I and 'Abd al-Rahmin b. Yasir, the freed slave of Maimuna, the wife of the Apostle (way peace be upon him). came to the house of Abu'l-Jahm b. al-Harith al-Simma Ansari and he said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came from the direction of Bi'r Jamal and a man met him; he saluted him but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made no response, till he (the Holy Prophet) came to the wall, wiped his face and hands and then returned his salutations
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مَرَّ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَبُولُ فَسَلَّمَ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alddahhaaki bni 'uthmaana, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rajulaan, marra warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yabuwlu fasallama falam yarudda 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:A person happened to pass by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when he was making water and saluted him, but he did not respond to his salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ حَدَّثَنَا ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ لَقِيَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَرِيقٍ مِنْ طُرُقِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ فَانْسَلَّ فَذَهَبَ فَاغْتَسَلَ فَتَفَقَّدَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَقِيتَنِي وَأَنَا جُنُبٌ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُجَالِسَكَ حَتَّى أَغْتَسِلَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ لاَ يَنْجُسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - qaala humaydun haddathanaa h, wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an humaydin alttawiyli, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu laqiyahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy tariyqin min turuqi almadiynaai wahuwa junubun faansalla fadhahaba faaghtasala fatafaqqadahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa jaa'ahu qaala ‏"‏ aayna kunta yaa aabaa hurayraaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi laqiytaniy waaanaa junubun fakarihtu aan aujaalisaka hattaa aaghtasila ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ subhaana alllahi iinna almuumina laa yanjusu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that he met the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on one of the paths leading to Medina in a state of (sexual) defilement and he slipped away and took a bath. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) searched for him and when he came, he said to him:0 Abu Huraira, where were you? He said: Messenger of Allah, you met when I was (sexually) defiled and I did not like to sit in your company before taking a bath. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Hallowed be Allah, verily a believer is never defiled
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَقِيَهُ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ فَحَادَ عَنْهُ فَاغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ كُنْتُ جُنُبًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ لاَ يَنْجُسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an mis'arin, 'an waasilin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an hudhayfaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laqiyahu wahuwa junubun fahaada 'anhu faaghtasala thumma jaa'a faqaala kuntu junubana ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ iinna almuslima laa yanjusu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to meet him and he was (sexually) defiled, and he slipped away and took a bath and then came and said: I was (sexually) defiled. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: A Muslim is never defiled
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ الْبَهِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ أَحْيَانِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i waiibraahiymu bnu muwsaa qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an khaalidi bni salamaaa, 'ani albahiyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yadhkuru alllaha 'alaa kulli aahyaanihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha said:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to remember Allah at all moments
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَقَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنَ الْخَلاَءِ فَأُتِيَ بِطَعَامٍ فَذَكَرُوا لَهُ الْوُضُوءَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ فَأَتَوَضَّأَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, waqaala aabuw alrrabiy'i, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an sa'iydi bni alhuwayrithi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja mina alkhalaa'i faautiya bita'aamin fadhakaruwa lahu alwuduw'a faqaala ‏ "‏ auriydu aan ausalliya faaatawaddaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came out of the privy, and he was presented with some food, and the people reminded him about ablution, but he said: Am I to say prayer that I should perform ablution?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ وَأُتِيَ بِطَعَامٍ فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَلاَ تَوَضَّأُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لِمَ أَأُصَلِّي فَأَتَوَضَّأَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, 'an sa'iydi bni alhuwayrithi, sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu kunnaa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajaa'a mina alghaaiiti waautiya bita'aamin faqiyla lahu aalaa tawaddaau faqaala ‏ "‏ lima aaausalliy faaatawaddaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he had come out of the privy. Food was presented to him. It was said to him (by the Companions around him): Wouldn't you perform ablution? Upon this he said: Why, am I to say prayer that I should perform ablution?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الطَّائِفِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ، مَوْلَى آلِ السَّائِبِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ ذَهَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْغَائِطِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ قُدِّمَ لَهُ طَعَامٌ فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلاَ تَوَضَّأُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لِمَ أَلِلصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu muslimin alttaaiifiyyu, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an sa'iydi bni alhuwayrithi, mawlaa ali alssaaiibi aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, qaala dhahaba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa alghaaiiti falammaa jaa'a quddima lahu ta'aamun faqiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi aalaa tawaddaau ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ lima aalilssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the privy and when he came back, he was presented with food. It was said to him; Messenger of Allah, wouldn't you perform ablution. He said: Why, am I to say prayer?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ حُوَيْرِثٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَضَى حَاجَتَهُ مِنَ الْخَلاَءِ فَقُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ فَأَكَلَ وَلَمْ يَمَسَّ مَاءً ‏.‏ قَالَ وَزَادَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّكَ لَمْ تَوَضَّأْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا أَرَدْتُ صَلاَةً فَأَتَوَضَّأَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَعَمَ عَمْرٌو أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مِنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni 'abbaadi bni jabalaaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu huwayrithin, aannahu sami'a abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qadaa haajatahu mina alkhalaa'i faqurriba iilayhi ta'aamun faaakala walam yamassa maa'an ‏.‏ qaala wazaadaniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin 'an sa'iydi bni alhuwayrithi aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qiyla lahu iinnaka lam tawaddaa qaala ‏ "‏ maa aaradtu salaaaan faaatawaddaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waza'ama 'amrunw aannahu sami'a min sa'iydi bni alhuwayrithi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas, reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came out of the privy after relieving himself, and food was brought to him and he took it, and did not touch water. In another narration transmitted by Sa'id b. al-Huwairith it is like this: It was said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) You have not performed ablution. He said: I do not intend to say prayer that I should perform ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَيْضًا أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، - فِي حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا دَخَلَ الْخَلاَءَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ هُشَيْمٍ - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْكَنِيفَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, waqaala, yahyaa aaydana aakhbaranaa hushaymun, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, 'an aanasin, - fiy hadiythi hammaadin kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa dakhala alkhalaa'a wafiy hadiythi hushaymin - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa dakhala alkaniyfa qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina alkhubthi waalkhabaaiithi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the privy, and in the hadith transmitted by Hushaim (the words are): When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) entered the lavatory, be used to say: O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from wicked and noxious things
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ aa'uwdhu bialllahi mina alkhubthi waalkhabaaiithi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is also transmitted by 'Abd al-'Aziz with the same chain of transmitters, and the words are:I seek refuge with Allah from the wicked and noxious things
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَجِيٌّ لِرَجُلٍ - وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ وَنَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنَاجِي الرَّجُلَ - فَمَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى نَامَ الْقَوْمُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, h wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin, qaala auqiymati alssalaaau warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm najiyyun lirajulin - wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alwaarithi wanabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yunaajiy alrrajula - famaa qaama iilaa alssalaaai hattaa naama alqawmu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:(The people) stood up for prayer and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was whispering to a man, and in the narration of 'Abd al-Warith (the words are): The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) was having a private conversation with a man, and did not start the prayer till the people dozed off
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنَاجِي رَجُلاً فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يُنَاجِيهِ حَتَّى نَامَ أَصْحَابُهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, qaala auqiymati alssalaaau waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yunaajiy rajulaan falam yazal yunaajiyhi hattaa naama aashaabuhu thumma jaa'a fasallaa bihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:(The people) stood up for prayer and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was talking in whispers with a man, and he did not discontinue the conversation till his Companions dozed off; he then came and led the prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنَامُونَ ثُمَّ يُصَلُّونَ وَلاَ يَتَوَضَّئُونَ قَالَ قُلْتُ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ إِي وَاللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu kaana aashaabu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanaamuwna thumma yusalluwna walaa yatawaddaiuwna qaala qultu sami'tahu min aanasin qaala iiy waalllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qatida reported:I heard Anas as saying that the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dozed off and then offered prayer and did not perform ablution. He (the narrator) said: I asked him if he had actually heard it from Anas. He said: By Allah. yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أُقِيمَتْ صَلاَةُ الْعِشَاءِ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لِي حَاجَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنَاجِيهِ حَتَّى نَامَ الْقَوْمُ - أَوْ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ - ثُمَّ صَلَّوْا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu sa'iydi bni sakhrin alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa habbaanu, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, aannahu qaala auqiymat salaaau al'ishaa'i faqaala rajulun liy haajaaun ‏.‏ faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yunaajiyhi hattaa naama alqawmu - aaw ba'du alqawmi - thumma sallawa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:(The people) stood up for the night prayer when a man spoke forth: I need to say something. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) entered into secret conversation with him, till the people dozed off or some of the people (dozed off), and then they said the prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ حِينَ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ يَجْتَمِعُونَ فَيَتَحَيَّنُونَ الصَّلَوَاتِ وَلَيْسَ يُنَادِي بِهَا أَحَدٌ فَتَكَلَّمُوا يَوْمًا فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمُ اتَّخِذُوا نَاقُوسًا مِثْلَ نَاقُوسِ النَّصَارَى وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ قَرْنًا مِثْلَ قَرْنِ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَوَلاَ تَبْعَثُونَ رَجُلاً يُنَادِي بِالصَّلاَةِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا بِلاَلُ قُمْ فَنَادِ بِالصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy naafi'un, mawlaa abni 'umara 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aannahu qaala kaana almuslimuwna hiyna qadimuwa almadiynaaa yajtami'uwna fayatahayyanuwna alssalawaati walaysa yunaadiy bihaa aahadun fatakallamuwa yawmana fiy dhalika faqaala ba'duhumu attakhidhuwa naaquwsana mithla naaquwsi alnnasaaraa waqaala ba'duhum qarnana mithla qarni alyahuwdi faqaala 'umaru aawalaa tab'athuwna rajulaan yunaadiy bialssalaaai qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa bilaalu qum fanaadi bialssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:When the Muslims came to Medina, they gathered and sought to know the time of prayer but no one summoned them. One day they discussed the matter, and some of them said: Use something like the bell of the Christians and some of them said: Use horn like that of the Jews. Umar said: Why may not a be appointed who should call (people) to prayer? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: O Bilal, get up and summon (the people) to prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أُمِرَ بِلاَلٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ، الأَذَانَ وَيُوتِرَ الإِقَامَةَ ‏.‏ زَادَ يَحْيَى فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ أَيُّوبَ فَقَالَ إِلاَّ الإِقَامَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, jamiy'ana 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala aumira bilaalun aan yashfa'a, alaadhaana wayuwtira aliiqaamaaa ‏.‏ zaada yahyaa fiy hadiythihi 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa fahaddathtu bihi aayyuwba faqaala iilaaa aliiqaamaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:Bilal was commanded (by the Messenger of Allah) to repeat (the phrases of) Adhan twice and once in Iqama. The narrator said: I made a mention of it before Ayyub who said: Except for saying: Qamat-is-Salat [the time for prayer has come]
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ ذَكَرُوا أَنْ يُعْلِمُوا، وَقْتَ الصَّلاَةِ بِشَىْءٍ يَعْرِفُونَهُ فَذَكَرُوا أَنْ يُنَوِّرُوا نَارًا أَوْ يَضْرِبُوا نَاقُوسًا فَأُمِرَ بِلاَلٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ الأَذَانَ وَيُوتِرَ الإِقَامَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala dhakaruwa aan yu'limuwa, waqta alssalaaai bishaa'in ya'rifuwnahu fadhakaruwa aan yunawwiruwa naarana aaw yadribuwa naaquwsana faaumira bilaalun aan yashfa'a alaadhaana wayuwtira aliiqaamaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:They (the Companions) discussed that they should know the timings of prayer by means of something recognized by all. Some of them said that fire should be lighted or a bell should be rung. But Bilal was ordered to repeat the phrases twice in Adhan, and once in Iqama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ لَمَّا كَثُرَ النَّاسُ ذَكَرُوا أَنْ يُعْلِمُوا ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ الثَّقَفِيِّ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَنْ يُورُوا نَارًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, bihadhaa aliisnaadi lammaa kathura alnnaasu dhakaruwa aan yu'limuwa ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi althhaqafiyyi ghayra aannahu qaala aan yuwruwa naarana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is transmitted by Khalid Hadhdha with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are):When the majority of the people discussed they should know, like the hadith narrated by al-Thaqafi (mentioned above) except for the words:" They (the people) should kindle fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أُمِرَ بِلاَلٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ، الأَذَانَ وَيُوتِرَ الإِقَامَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu sa'iydin, wa'abdu alwahhaabi bnu 'abdi almajiydi, qaalaa haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala aumira bilaalun aan yashfa'a, alaadhaana wayuwtira aliiqaamaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:Bilal was commanded (by the Holy Prophet) to repeat the phrases twice in Adhan, and once in lqama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، مَالِكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَبُو غَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَّمَهُ هَذَا الأَذَانَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ - ثُمَّ يَعُودُ فَيَقُولُ - أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَىَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ - مَرَّتَيْنِ - حَىَّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ - مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ إِسْحَاقُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, maaliku bnu 'abdi alwaahidi waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma qaala aabuw ghassaana haddathanaa mu'aadhun, waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, saahibi alddastawaaiiyyi wahaddathaniy aabiy, 'an 'aamirin alaahwali, 'an makhuwlin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni muhayriyzin, 'an aabiy mahdhuwraaa, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'allamahu hadhaa alaadhaana ‏"‏ alllahu aakbaru alllahu aakbaru aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu aashhadu aanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi aashhadu aanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi - thumma ya'uwdu fayaquwlu - aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu aashhadu aanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi aashhadu aanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi haaaa 'alaa alssalaaai - marratayni - haaaa 'alaa alfalaahi - marratayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ zaada iishaaqu ‏"‏ alllahu aakbaru alllahu aakbaru laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mahdhura said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught him Adhan like this:Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that there is no god but Allah; I testify that Muhammad Is the Messenger of Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and it should be again repeated: I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that there is no god but Allah; I testify that Muhammad Is the Messenger of Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to the prayer (twice). Come to success (twice). Ishaq added: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; there Is no god but Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُؤَذِّنَانِ بِلاَلٌ وَابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ الأَعْمَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala kaana lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm muuadhhinaani bilaalun waabnu aummi maktuwmin alaa'maa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had two Mu'adhdhins, Bilal and 'Abdullah b. Umm Maktum, who (latter) was blind
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, haddathanaa alqaasimu, 'an 'aaiishaaa, mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَخْلَدٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ يُؤَذِّنُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ أَعْمَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna makhladin - 'an muhammadi bni ja'farin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana abnu aummi maktuwmin yuuadhhinu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa aa'maa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Ibn Umm Maktum used to pronounce Adhan at the behest of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (despite the fact) that he was blind
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu salamaaa almuraadiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi, wasa'iydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Hisham
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُغِيرُ إِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ وَكَانَ يَسْتَمِعُ الأَذَانَ فَإِنْ سَمِعَ أَذَانًا أَمْسَكَ وَإِلاَّ أَغَارَ فَسَمِعَ رَجُلاً يَقُولُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خَرَجْتَ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَنَظَرُوا فَإِذَا هُوَ رَاعِي مِعْزًى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - 'an hammaadi bni salamaaa, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yughiyru iidhaa tala'a alfajru wakaana yastami'u alaadhaana faiin sami'a aadhaanana aamsaka waiilaaa aaghaara fasami'a rajulaan yaquwlu alllahu aakbaru alllahu aakbaru ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ 'alaa alfitraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kharajta mina alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fanazaruwa faiidhaa huwa raa'iy mi'zana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to attack the enemy when it was dawn. He would listen to the Adhan; so if he heard an Adhan, he stopped, otherwise made an attack. Once on hearing a man say: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remarked: He is following al-Fitra (al-Islam). Then hearing him say: I testify that there is no god but Allah. there is no god but Allah, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: You have come out of the Fire (of Hell). They looked at him and found that he was a goat herd
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمُ النِّدَاءَ فَقُولُوا مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa sami'tumu alnnidaa'a faquwluwa mithla maa yaquwlu almuuadhhinu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:When you hear the call (to prayer), repeat what the Mu'adhdhin pronounces
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، وَغَيْرِهِمَا، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ فَقُولُوا مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ ثُمَّ صَلُّوا عَلَىَّ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَىَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا ثُمَّ سَلُوا اللَّهَ لِيَ الْوَسِيلَةَ فَإِنَّهَا مَنْزِلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لاَ تَنْبَغِي إِلاَّ لِعَبْدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ وَأَرْجُو أَنْ أَكُونَ أَنَا هُوَ فَمَنْ سَأَلَ لِيَ الْوَسِيلَةَ حَلَّتْ لَهُ الشَّفَاعَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu salamaaa almuraadiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an haywaaa, wasa'iydi bni aabiy aayyuwba, waghayrihimaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni al'aasi, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa sami'tumu almuuadhhina faquwluwa mithla maa yaquwlu thumma salluwa 'alaaaa faiinnahu man sallaa 'alaaaa salaaaan sallaa alllahu 'alayhi bihaa 'ashrana thumma saluwa alllaha liya alwasiylaaa faiinnahaa manzilaaun fiy aljannaai laa tanbaghiy iilaaa li'abdin min 'ibaadi alllahi waaarjuw aan aakuwna aanaa huwa faman saaala liya alwasiylaaa hallat lahu alshhafaa'aau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Amr b. al-As reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When you hear the Mu'adhdhin, repeat what he says, then invoke a blessing on me, for everyone who invokes a blessing on me will receive ten blessings from Allah; then beg from Allah al-Wasila for me, which is a rank in Paradise fitting for only one of Allah's servants, and I hope that I may be that one. If anyone who asks that I be given the Wasila, he will be assured of my intercession
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَهْضَمٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ غَزِيَّةَ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ إِسَافٍ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَحَدُكُمُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ حَىَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ حَىَّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw ja'farin, muhammadu bnu jahdamin althhaqafiyyu haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an 'umaaraaa bni ghaziyyaaa, 'an khubaybi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni iisaafin, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaddihi, 'umara bni alkhattaabi qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa qaala almuuadhhinu alllahu aakbaru alllahu aakbaru ‏.‏ faqaala aahadukumu alllahu aakbaru alllahu aakbaru ‏.‏ thumma qaala aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ qaala aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu thumma qaala aashhadu aanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi ‏.‏ qaala aashhadu aanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi ‏.‏ thumma qaala haaaa 'alaa alssalaaai ‏.‏ qaala laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi ‏.‏ thumma qaala haaaa 'alaa alfalaahi ‏.‏ qaala laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi ‏.‏ thumma qaala alllahu aakbaru alllahu aakbaru ‏.‏ qaala alllahu aakbaru alllahu aakbaru ‏.‏ thumma qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ min qalbihi dakhala aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. al-Khattab reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the Mu'adhdhin says: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and one of you should make this response: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; (and when the Mu'adhdhin) says: I testify that there is no god but Allah, one should respond: I testify that there is no god but Allah, and when he says: I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, one should make a response: I testify that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger. When he (the Mu'adhdhin) says: Come to prayer, one should make a response: There is no might and no power except with Allah. When he (the Mu'adhdhin) says: Come to salvation, one should respond: There is no might and no power except with Allah, and when he (the Mu'adhdhin) says: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, then make a response: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. When he (the Mu'adhdhin) says: There is no god but Allah, and he who makes a re- sponse from the heart: There is no god but Allah, he will enter Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ الْحُكَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْقُرَشِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ الْحُكَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا ‏.‏ غُفِرَ لَهُ ذَنْبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَسْمَعُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قُتَيْبَةُ قَوْلَهُ وَأَنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani alhukaymi bni 'abdi alllahi bni qaysin alqurashiyyi, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani alhukaymi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ man qaala hiyna yasma'u almuuadhhina aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu waaanna muhammadana 'abduhu warasuwluhu radiytu bialllahi rabbana wabimuhammadin rasuwlaan wabialiislaami diynana ‏.‏ ghufira lahu dhanbuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu rumhin fiy riwaayatihi ‏"‏ man qaala hiyna yasma'u almuuadhhina waaanaa aashhadu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur qutaybaau qawlahu waaanaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If anyone says on hearing the Mu'adhdhin: I testify that there is no god but Allah alone. Who has no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger, (and that) I am satisfied with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as Messenger. and with Islam as din (code of life), his sins would be forgiven. In the narration transmitted by Ibn Rumh the words are:" He who said on hearing the Mu'adhdhin and verity I testify." ' Qutaiba has not mentioned his words:" And I
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ إِذَا سَمِعَ النِّدَاءَ بِالصَّلاَةِ ذَهَبَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مَكَانَ الرَّوْحَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّوْحَاءِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ هِيَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ سِتَّةٌ وَثَلاَثُونَ مِيلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alshhaytaana iidhaa sami'a alnnidaa'a bialssalaaai dhahaba hattaa yakuwna makaana alrrawhaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sulaymaanu fasaaaltuhu 'ani alrrawhaa'i ‏.‏ faqaala hiya mina almadiynaai sittaaun wathalaathuwna miylaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sufyan reported it on the authority of Jabir that he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say:When Satan hears the call to prayer, he runs away to a distance like that of Rauha. Sulaimin said: I asked him about Rauha. He replied: It is at a distance of thirty-six miles from Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mu'awiya narrated it on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ إِذَا سَمِعَ النِّدَاءَ بِالصَّلاَةِ أَحَالَ لَهُ ضُرَاطٌ حَتَّى لاَ يَسْمَعَ صَوْتَهُ فَإِذَا سَكَتَ رَجَعَ فَوَسْوَسَ فَإِذَا سَمِعَ الإِقَامَةَ ذَهَبَ حَتَّى لاَ يَسْمَعَ صَوْتَهُ فَإِذَا سَكَتَ رَجَعَ فَوَسْوَسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu liqutaybaaa - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alshhaytaana iidhaa sami'a alnnidaa'a bialssalaaai aahaala lahu duraatun hattaa laa yasma'a sawtahu faiidhaa sakata raja'a fawaswasa faiidhaa sami'a aliiqaamaaa dhahaba hattaa laa yasma'a sawtahu faiidhaa sakata raja'a fawaswasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying:When Satan hears the call to prayer, he turns back and breaks the wind so as not to hear the call being made, but when the call is finished he turns round and distracts (the minds of those who pray), and when he hears the Iqama, he again runs away so as not to hear its voice and when it subsides, he comes back and distracts (the minds of those who stand for prayer)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ وَلَهُ حُصَاصٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alhamiydi bnu bayaanin alwaasitiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alllahi - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aadhhana almuuadhhinu aadbara alshhaytaanu walahu husaasun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the Mu'adhdhin calls to prayer, Satan runs back vehemently
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، قَالَ أَرْسَلَنِي أَبِي إِلَى بَنِي حَارِثَةَ - قَالَ - وَمَعِي غُلاَمٌ لَنَا - أَوْ صَاحِبٌ لَنَا - فَنَادَاهُ مُنَادٍ مِنْ حَائِطٍ بِاسْمِهِ - قَالَ - وَأَشْرَفَ الَّذِي مَعِي عَلَى الْحَائِطِ فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لأَبِي فَقَالَ لَوْ شَعَرْتُ أَنَّكَ تَلْقَى هَذَا لَمْ أُرْسِلْكَ وَلَكِنْ إِذَا سَمِعْتَ صَوْتًا فَنَادِ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ إِذَا نُودِيَ بِالصَّلاَةِ وَلَّى وَلَهُ حُصَاصٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaama, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa rawhun, 'an suhaylin, qaala aarsalaniy aabiy iilaa baniy haarithaaa - qaala - wama'iy ghulaamun lanaa - aaw saahibun lanaa - fanaadaahu munaadin min haaiitin biasmihi - qaala - waaashrafa alladhiy ma'iy 'alaa alhaaiiti falam yara shayiana fadhakartu dhalika laabiy faqaala law sha'artu aannaka talqaa hadhaa lam aursilka walakin iidhaa sami'ta sawtana fanaadi bialssalaaai faiinniy sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa yuhaddithu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alshhaytaana iidhaa nuwdiya bialssalaaai wallaa walahu husaasun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Suhail reported that his father sent him to Banu Haritha along with a boy or a man. Someone called him by his name from an enclosure. He (thenarrator) said:The person with me looked towards the enclosure, but saw nothing. I made a mention of that to my father. He said: If I knew that you would meet such a situation I would have never sent you (there), but (bear in wind) whenever you hear such a call (from the evil spirits) pronounce the Adhan. for I have heard Abu Huraira say that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upbn him) said: Whenever Adhan is proclaimed, Satan runs back vehemently
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلاَةِ أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَهُ ضُرَاطٌ حَتَّى لاَ يَسْمَعَ التَّأْذِينَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ التَّأْذِينُ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى إِذَا ثُوِّبَ بِالصَّلاَةِ أَدْبَرَ حَتَّى إِذَا قُضِيَ التَّثْوِيبُ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى يَخْطِرَ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَنَفْسِهِ يَقُولُ لَهُ اذْكُرْ كَذَا وَاذْكُرْ كَذَا لِمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَذْكُرُ مِنْ قَبْلُ حَتَّى يَظَلَّ الرَّجُلُ مَا يَدْرِي كَمْ صَلَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy alhizaamiyya - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa nuwdiya lilssalaaai aadbara alshhaytaanu lahu duraatun hattaa laa yasma'a alttaadhiyna faiidhaa qudiya alttaadhiynu aaqbala hattaa iidhaa thuwwiba bialssalaaai aadbara hattaa iidhaa qudiya alttathwiybu aaqbala hattaa yakhtira bayna almar'i wanafsihi yaquwlu lahu adhkur kadhaa waadhkur kadhaa limaa lam yakun yadhkuru min qablu hattaa yazalla alrrajulu maa yadriy kam sallaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Apostle (ﷺ) said When the call to prayer is made, Satan runs back and breaks wind so as not to hear the call being made, and when the call is finished. he turns round. When Iqama is proclaimed he turns his back, and when it is finished he turns round to distract a man, saying: Re- member such and such; remember such and such, referring to something the man did not have in his mind, with the result that he does not know how much he has prayed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ حَتَّى يَظَلَّ الرَّجُلُ إِنْ يَدْرِي كَيْفَ صَلَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ hattaa yazalla alrrajulu iin yadriy kayfa sallaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like it has been narrated by Abu Huraira but for these words:" He (the man saying the prayer) does not know how much he has prayed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلاَةَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ وَقَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ وَلاَ يَرْفَعُهُمَا بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, wasa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin waabnu numayrin kulluhum 'an sufyaana bni 'uyaynaaa, - waalllafzu liyahyaa qaala aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aftataha alssalaaaa rafa'a yadayhi hattaa yuhaadhiya mankibayhi waqabla aan yarka'a waiidhaa rafa'a mina alrrukuw'i walaa yarfa'uhumaa bayna alssajdatayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim narrated it on the authority of his father who reported:I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raising his hands apposite the shoulders at the time of beginning the prayer and before bowing down and after coming back to the position after bowing. but he did not raise them between two prostrations
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَامَ لِلصَّلاَةِ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى تَكُونَا حَذْوَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَلاَ يَفْعَلُهُ حِينَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, haddathaniy abnu shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna abna 'umara, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qaama lilssalaaai rafa'a yadayhi hattaa takuwnaa hadhwa mankibayhi thumma kabbara faiidhaa aaraada aan yarka'a fa'ala mithla dhalika waiidhaa rafa'a mina alrrukuw'i fa'ala mithla dhalika walaa yaf'aluhu hiyna yarfa'u raasahu mina alssujuwdi ‏.‏
