verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakkaarin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu zakariyyaa'a, 'ani alaa'mashi, wa'an mis'arin, wa'an maaliki bni mighwalin, kulluhum 'ani alhakami, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ wabaarik 'alaa muhammadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yaquli alllahumma ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by al-Hakam except that he said:" Bless Muhammad (ﷺ)" and he did not say:" O Allah I
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحٌ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيُّ، أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa rawhun, wa'abdu alllahi bnu naafi'in, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala aakhbaranaa rawhun, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'amriw bni sulaymin, aakhbaraniy aabuw humaydin alssaa'idiyyu, aannahum qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa nusalliy 'alayka qaala ‏ "‏ quwluwa alllahumma salli 'alaa muhammadin wa'alaa aazwaajihi wadhurriyyatihi kamaa sallayta 'alaa ali iibraahiyma wabaarik 'alaa muhammadin wa'alaa aazwaajihi wadhurriyyatihi kamaa baarakta 'alaa ali iibraahiyma iinnaka hamiydun majiydun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi reported:They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Apostle of Allah, how should we bless you? He (the Holy Prophet) observed: Say:" O Allah! bless Muhammad, his wives and his offspring as Thou didst bless Ibrahim, and grant favours to Muhammad, and his wives and his offspring as Thou didst grant favours to the family of Ibrahim; Thou art Praiseworthy and Glorious
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَىَّ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man sallaa 'alaaaa waahidaaan sallaa alllahu 'alayhi 'ashrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who blesses me once, Allah would bless him ten times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ الإِمَامُ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ وَافَقَ قَوْلُهُ قَوْلَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an sumaaain, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa qaala aliimaamu sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏.‏ faquwluwa alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu ‏.‏ faiinnahu man waafaqa qawluhu qawla almalaaiikaai ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the Imam says:" Allah listens to him who praises Him." you should say:" O Allah, our Lord for Thee is the praise." for if what anyone says synchronises with what the angels say, his past sins will be forgiven
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ سُمَىٍّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi sumaaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this is narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّهُمَا أَخْبَرَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَمَّنَ الإِمَامُ فَأَمِّنُوا فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ وَافَقَ تَأْمِينُهُ تَأْمِينَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ آمِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, waaabiy, salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani aannahumaa aakhbaraahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa aammana aliimaamu faaamminuwa faiinnahu man waafaqa taamiynuhu taamiyna almalaaiikaai ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ amiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: SayAmin when the Imam says Amin, for it anyone's utterance of Amin synchronises with that of the angels, he will be forgiven his past sins
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy abnu almusayyabi, waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi maalikin walam yadhkur qawla abni shihaabin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira said:I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the hadith like one transmitted by Malik, but he made no mention of the words of Shihab
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ أَبَا يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الصَّلاَةِ آمِينَ ‏.‏ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ فِي السَّمَاءِ آمِينَ ‏.‏ فَوَافَقَ إِحْدَاهُمَا الأُخْرَى غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, haddathaniy abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna aabaa yuwnusa, haddathahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa qaala aahadukum fiy alssalaaai amiyna ‏.‏ waalmalaaiikaau fiy alssamaa'i amiyna ‏.‏ fawaafaqa iihdaahumaa alaukhraa ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you utters Amin in prayer and the angels in the sky also utter Amin, and this (utterance of the one) synchronises with (that of) the other, all his previous sins are pardoned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ آمِينَ ‏.‏ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ فِي السَّمَاءِ آمِينَ ‏.‏ فَوَافَقَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الأُخْرَى غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa alqa'nabiyyu, haddathanaa almughiyraau, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa qaala aahadukum amiyna ‏.‏ waalmalaaiikaau fiy alssamaa'i amiyna ‏.‏ fawaafaqat iihdaahumaa alaukhraa ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Harare reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When anyone amongst you utters Amin and the angels In the heaven also utter Amin and (the Amin) of the one synchronises with (that of) the other, all his previous sins are pardoned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this is transmitted by Ma'mar from Hammam b. Munabbih on the authority of Abu Huraira who reported it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ الْقَارِئُ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ الضَّالِّينَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ آمِينَ ‏.‏ فَوَافَقَ قَوْلُهُ قَوْلَ أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa qaala alqaariiu ghayri almaghduwbi 'alayhim walaa alddaalliyna ‏.‏ faqaala man khalfahu amiyna ‏.‏ fawaafaqa qawluhu qawla aahli alssamaa'i ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the reciter (Imam) utters:" Not of those on whom (is Thine) wrath and not the erring ones," and (the person) behind him utters Amin and his utterance synchronises with that of the dwellers of heavens, all his previous sins would be pardoned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ سَقَطَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ فَرَسٍ فَجُحِشَ شِقُّهُ الأَيْمَنُ فَدَخَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ نَعُودُهُ فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَصَلَّى بِنَا قَاعِدًا فَصَلَّيْنَا وَرَاءَهُ قُعُودًا فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلاَةَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَإِذَا سَجَدَ فَاسْجُدُوا وَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَارْفَعُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا صَلَّى قَاعِدًا فَصَلُّوا قُعُودًا أَجْمَعُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu saqata alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an farasin fajuhisha shiqquhu alaaymanu fadakhalnaa 'alayhi na'uwduhu fahadarati alssalaaau fasallaa binaa qaa'idana fasallaynaa waraa'ahu qu'uwdana falammaa qadaa alssalaaaa qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ju'ila aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi faiidhaa kabbara fakabbiruwa waiidhaa sajada faasjuduwa waiidhaa rafa'a faarfa'uwa waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏.‏ faquwluwa rabbanaa walaka alhamdu ‏.‏ waiidhaa sallaa qaa'idana fasalluwa qu'uwdana aajma'uwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) fell down from a horse and his right side was grazed. We went to him to inquire after his health when the time of prayer came. He led us in prayer in a sitting posture and we said prayer behind him sitting, and when he finished the prayer hesaid: The Imam is appointed only to be followed; so when he recites takbir, you should also recite that; when he prostrates, you should also prostrate; when he rises up, you should also rise up, and when he said" God listens to him who praises Him," you should say:" Our Lord, to Thee be the praise," and when he prays sitting, all of you should pray sitting
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ خَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ فَرَسٍ فَجُحِشَ فَصَلَّى لَنَا قَاعِدًا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kharra rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an farasin fajuhisha fasallaa lanaa qaa'idana ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell down from a horse and he was grazed and he led the prayer for us sitting, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صُرِعَ عَنْ فَرَسٍ فَجُحِشَ شِقُّهُ الأَيْمَنُ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمَا وَزَادَ ‏ "‏ فَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm suri'a 'an farasin fajuhisha shiqquhu alaaymanu binahwi hadiythihimaa wazaada ‏ "‏ faiidhaa sallaa qaaiimana fasalluwa qiyaamana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell down from a horse and his right side was grazed, and the rest of the hadith is the same with the addition of these words:" When he (the Imam) says prayer standing, you should also do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكِبَ فَرَسًا فَصُرِعَ عَنْهُ فَجُحِشَ شِقُّهُ الأَيْمَنُ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَفِيهِ ‏ "‏ إِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa ma'nu bnu 'iysaa, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakiba farasana fasuri'a 'anhu fajuhisha shiqquhu alaaymanu ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihim wafiyhi ‏ "‏ iidhaa sallaa qaaiimana fasalluwa qiyaamana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) rode a horse and fell down from it and his right side was grazed, and the rest of the hadith is the same, and (these words) are found in it:" When he (the Imam) says prayer in an erect posture, you should also say it in an erect posture
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسٌ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَقَطَ مِنْ فَرَسِهِ فَجُحِشَ شِقُّهُ الأَيْمَنُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَلَيْسَ فِيهِ زِيَادَةُ يُونُسَ وَمَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy aanasun, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm saqata min farasihi fajuhisha shiqquhu alaaymanu ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha walaysa fiyhi ziyaadaau yuwnusa wamaalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell down from his horse and his right side was grazed, and the rest of the hadith is the same. In this hadith there are no additions (of words) as transmitted by Yunus and Malik
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتِ اشْتَكَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَعُودُونَهُ فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسًا فَصَلَّوْا بِصَلاَتِهِ قِيَامًا فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَنِ اجْلِسُوا ‏.‏ فَجَلَسُوا فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا وَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَارْفَعُوا وَإِذَا صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalati ashtakaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadakhala 'alayhi naasun min aashaabihi ya'uwduwnahu fasallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaalisana fasallawa bisalaatihi qiyaamana faaashaara iilayhim aani ajlisuwa ‏.‏ fajalasuwa falammaa ansarafa qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ju'ila aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi faiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa waiidhaa rafa'a faarfa'uwa waiidhaa sallaa jaalisana fasalluwa juluwsana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell ill and some of his Companions came to inquire after his health. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer sitting, while (his Companions) said it (behind him) standing. He (the Holy Prophet) directed them by his gesture to sit down, and they sat down (in prayer). After finishing the (prayer) he (the Holy Prophet) said: The Imam is appointed so that he should be followed, so bow down when he bows down, and rise upp when he rises up and say (prayer) sitting when he (the Imam) says (it) sitting
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun ya'niy abna zaydin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy jamiy'ana, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated with the same chain of transmitters by Hisham b. 'Urwa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ اشْتَكَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّيْنَا وَرَاءَهُ وَهُوَ قَاعِدٌ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُسْمِعُ النَّاسَ تَكْبِيرَهُ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْنَا فَرَآنَا قِيَامًا فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْنَا فَقَعَدْنَا فَصَلَّيْنَا بِصَلاَتِهِ قُعُودًا فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كِدْتُمْ آنِفًِا لَتَفْعَلُونَ فِعْلَ فَارِسَ وَالرُّومِ يَقُومُونَ عَلَى مُلُوكِهِمْ وَهُمْ قُعُودٌ فَلاَ تَفْعَلُوا ائْتَمُّوا بِأَئِمَّتِكُمْ إِنْ صَلَّى قَائِمًا فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا وَإِنْ صَلَّى قَاعِدًا فَصَلُّوا قُعُودًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala ashtakaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaynaa waraa'ahu wahuwa qaa'idun waaabuw bakrin yusmi'u alnnaasa takbiyrahu faaltafata iilaynaa faraanaa qiyaamana faaashaara iilaynaa faqa'adnaa fasallaynaa bisalaatihi qu'uwdana falammaa sallama qaala ‏ "‏ iin kidtum anifiana lataf'aluwna fi'la faarisa waalrruwmi yaquwmuwna 'alaa muluwkihim wahum qu'uwdun falaa taf'aluwa aitammuwa biaaiimmatikum iin sallaa qaaiimana fasalluwa qiyaamana waiin sallaa qaa'idana fasalluwa qu'uwdana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was ill and we said prayer behind him and he was sitting. And Abu Bakr was making audible to the people his takbir. As he paid his attention towards us he saw us standing and (directed us to sit down) with a gesture. So we sat down and said our prayer with his prayer in a sitting posture. After uttering salutation he said: You were at this time about to do an act like that of the Persians and the Romans. They stand before their kings while they sit, so don't do that; follow your Imams. If they say prayer standing, you should also do so, and if they say prayer sitting, you should also say prayer sitting
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرُّؤَاسِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ خَلْفَهُ فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَبَّرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لِيُسْمِعَنَا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alrruuaasiyyu, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin khalfahu faiidhaa kabbara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kabbara aabuw bakrin liyusmi'anaa ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi alllaythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the prayer and Abu Bakr was behind him. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the takbir, Abu Bakr also recited (it) in order to make it audible to us. And the rest of the hadith is like one transmitted by Laith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ فَلاَ تَخْتَلِفُوا عَلَيْهِ فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ فَاسْجُدُوا وَإِذَا صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا أَجْمَعُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy alhizaamiyya - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi falaa takhtalifuwa 'alayhi faiidhaa kabbara fakabbiruwa waiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏.‏ faquwluwa alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu ‏.‏ waiidhaa sajada faasjuduwa waiidhaa sallaa jaalisana fasalluwa juluwsana aajma'uwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The Imam is appointed, so that he should be followed, so don't be at variance with him. Recite takbir when he recites it; bow down when he bows down and when he says:" Allah listens to him who praises Him," say:" O Allah, our Lord, to Thee be the Praise." And when he (the Imam) prostrates, you should also prostrate, and when he says prayer sitting, you should all observe prayer sitting
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Hammam b. Munabbih from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ، خَشْرَمٍ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُنَا يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُبَادِرُوا الإِمَامَ إِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ وَلاَ الضَّالِّينَ ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا آمِينَ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu, khashramin qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'allimunaa yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tubaadiruwa aliimaama iidhaa kabbara fakabbiruwa waiidhaa qaala walaa alddaalliyna ‏.‏ faquwluwa amiyna ‏.‏ waiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏.‏ faquwluwa alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while teaching us (the principles of faith), said: Do not try to go ahead of the Imam, recite takbir when he recites it, and when he says: "Nor of those who err" you should say Amin, bow down when he bows down, and when he says: "Allah listens to him who praises Him" say: "O Allah, our Lord, to Thee be the praise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ وَلاَ الضَّالِّينَ ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا آمِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ تَرْفَعُوا قَبْلَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwihi iilaaa qawlahu ‏"‏ walaa alddaalliyna ‏.‏ faquwluwa amiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wazaada ‏"‏ walaa tarfa'uwa qablahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (a hadith) like it, except the words:" Nor of those who err, say Amin" and added:" And don't rise up ahead of him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يَعْلَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَطَاءٍ - سَمِعَ أَبَا عَلْقَمَةَ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا الإِمَامُ جُنَّةٌ فَإِذَا صَلَّى قَاعِدًا فَصَلُّوا قُعُودًا وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا وَافَقَ قَوْلُ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ قَوْلَ أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an ya'laa, - wahuwa abnu 'ataa'in - sami'a aabaa 'alqamaaa, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa aliimaamu junnaaun faiidhaa sallaa qaa'idana fasalluwa qu'uwdana waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏.‏ faquwluwa alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu ‏.‏ faiidhaa waafaqa qawlu aahli alaardi qawla aahli alssamaa'i ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Verily the Imam is a shield, say prayer sitting when he says prayer sitting. And when he says:" Allah listens to him who praises Him," say:" O Allah, our Lord, to Thee be the praise." and when the utterance of the people of the earth synchronises with that of the beings of heaven (angels), all the previous sins would be pardoned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا يُونُسَ، مَوْلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا وَإِذَا صَلَّى قَاعِدًا فَصَلُّوا قُعُودًا أَجْمَعُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an haywaaa, aanna aabaa yuwnusa, mawlaa aabiy hurayraaa haddathahu qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ju'ila aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi faiidhaa kabbara fakabbiruwa waiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏.‏ faquwluwa alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu ‏.‏ waiidhaa sallaa qaaiimana fasalluwa qiyaamana waiidhaa sallaa qaa'idana fasalluwa qu'uwdana aajma'uwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying:The Imam is appointed to be followed. So recite takbir when he recites it, and bow down when he bows down and when he utters:" Allah listens to him who praises Him," say" O Allah, our Lord, for Thee be the praise." And when he prays, standing, you should pray standing. And when he prays sitting, all of you should pray sitting
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا أَلاَ تُحَدِّثِينِي عَنْ مَرَضِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ بَلَى ثَقُلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ وَهُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلْنَا فَاغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ وَهُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلْنَا فَاغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ وَهُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلْنَا فَاغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا لاَ وَهُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَالنَّاسُ عُكُوفٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَنْتَظِرُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِصَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ الآخِرَةِ - قَالَتْ - فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ فَأَتَاهُ الرَّسُولُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَكَانَ رَجُلاً رَقِيقًا يَا عُمَرُ صَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَنْتَ أَحَقُّ بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ تِلْكَ الأَيَّامَ ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَدَ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ خِفَّةً فَخَرَجَ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا الْعَبَّاسُ لِصَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ذَهَبَ لِيَتَأَخَّرَ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ لاَ يَتَأَخَّرَ وَقَالَ لَهُمَا ‏"‏ أَجْلِسَانِي إِلَى جَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَجْلَسَاهُ إِلَى جَنْبِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ بِصَلاَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ يُصَلُّونَ بِصَلاَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَاعِدٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَلاَ أَعْرِضُ عَلَيْكَ مَا حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ عَنْ مَرَضِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ هَاتِ ‏.‏ فَعَرَضْتُ حَدِيثَهَا عَلَيْهِ فَمَا أَنْكَرَ مِنْهُ شِيْئًا غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَسَمَّتْ لَكَ الرَّجُلَ الَّذِي كَانَ مَعَ الْعَبَّاسِ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zaaiidaau, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu aabiy 'aaiishaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa 'aaiishaaa faqultu lahaa aalaa tuhaddithiyniy 'an maradi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat balaa thaqula alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aasallaa alnnaasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa laa wahum yantaziruwnaka yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ da'uwa liy maa'an fiy almikhdabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fafa'alnaa faaghtasala thumma dhahaba liyanuw'a faaughmiya 'alayhi thumma aafaaqa faqaala ‏"‏ aasallaa alnnaasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa laa wahum yantaziruwnaka yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ da'uwa liy maa'an fiy almikhdabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fafa'alnaa faaghtasala thumma dhahaba liyanuw'a faaughmiya 'alayhi thumma aafaaqa faqaala ‏"‏ aasallaa alnnaasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa laa wahum yantaziruwnaka yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ da'uwa liy maa'an fiy almikhdabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fafa'alnaa faaghtasala thumma dhahaba liyanuw'a faaughmiya 'alayhi thumma aafaaqa faqaala ‏"‏ aasallaa alnnaasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqulnaa laa wahum yantaziruwnaka yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaalat waalnnaasu 'ukuwfun fiy almasjidi yantaziruwna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lisalaaai al'ishaa'i alakhiraai - qaalat - faaarsala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa aabiy bakrin aan yusalliya bialnnaasi faaataahu alrrasuwlu faqaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamuruka aan tusalliya bialnnaasi ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin wakaana rajulaan raqiyqana yaa 'umaru salli bialnnaasi ‏.‏ qaala faqaala 'umaru aanta aahaqqu bidhalika ‏.‏ qaalat fasallaa bihim aabuw bakrin tilka alaayyaama thumma iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wajada min nafsihi khiffaaan fakharaja bayna rajulayni aahaduhumaa al'abbaasu lisalaaai alzzuhri waaabuw bakrin yusalliy bialnnaasi falammaa raahu aabuw bakrin dhahaba liyataaakhhara faaawmaaa iilayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan laa yataaakhhara waqaala lahumaa ‏"‏ aajlisaaniy iilaa janbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaajlasaahu iilaa janbi aabiy bakrin wakaana aabuw bakrin yusalliy wahuwa qaaiimun bisalaaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu yusalluwna bisalaaai aabiy bakrin waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaa'idun ‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi fadakhaltu 'alaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin faqultu lahu aalaa aa'ridu 'alayka maa haddathatniy 'aaiishaau 'an maradi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala haati ‏.‏ fa'aradtu hadiythahaa 'alayhi famaa aankara minhu shiyiana ghayra aannahu qaala aasammat laka alrrajula alladhiy kaana ma'a al'abbaasi qultu laa ‏.‏ qaala huwa 'aliyyun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah b. Abdullah reported:I visited 'A'isha and asked her to tell about the illness of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She agreed and said: The Apostle (ﷺ) was seriously ill and he asked whether the people had prayed. We said: No, they are waiting for you, Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Put some water in the tub for me. We did accordingly and he (the Holy Prophet) took a bath;and, when he was about to move with difficulty, he fainted. When he came round, he again said: Have the people said prayer? We said: No, they are waiting for you, Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) again said: Put some water for me in the tub. We did accordingly and he took a bag, but when he was about to move with difficultyhe fainted. When he came round, he asked whether the people had prayed. We said: No, they are waiting for you, Messenger of Allah. He said: Put some water for me in the tub. We did accordingly and he took a bath and he was about to move with difficulty when he fainted. When he came roundhe said: Have the people saidprayer? We said: No, they are waiting for you, Messenger of Allah. She ('A'isha) said: The people were staying in the mosque and waiting for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to lead the last (night) prayer. She ('A'isha) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent (instructions) to Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. When the messenger came, he told him (Abd Bakr): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has ordered you to lead the people in prayer. Abu Bakr who was a man of very tenderly feelings asked Umar to lead the prayer. 'Umar said: You are more entitled to that. Abu Bakr led the prayers during those days. Afterwards the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt some relief and he went out supported by two men, one of them was al-'Abbas, to the noon prayer. Abu Bakr was leading the people in prayer. When Abu Bakr saw him. he began to withdraw, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told him not to withdraw. He told his two (companions) to seat him down beside him (Abu Bakr). They seated him by the side of Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr said the prayer standing while following the prayer of the Apostle (ﷺ) and the people Bald prayer (standing) while following the prayer of Abu Bakr. The Apostle (ﷺ) was seated. Ubaidullah said: I visited 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas, and said: Should I submit to you what 'A'isha had told about the illness of the Apostle (ﷺ)? He said: Go ahead. I submitted to him what had been transmitted by her ('A'isha). He objected to none of it, only asking whether she had named to him the man who accompanied al-'Abbas. I said: No. He said: It was 'Ali
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، قَالَ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ قَالَتْ، أَوَّلُ مَا اشْتَكَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ فَاسْـتَأْذَنَ أَزْوَاجَهُ أَنْ يُمَرَّضَ فِي بَيْتِهَا وَأَذِنَّ لَهُ - قَالَتْ - فَخَرَجَ وَيَدٌ لَهُ عَلَى الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَيَدٌ لَهُ عَلَى رَجُلٍ آخَرَ وَهُوَ يَخُطُّ بِرِجْلَيْهِ فِي الأَرْضِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ أَتَدْرِي مَنِ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي لَمْ تُسَمِّ عَائِشَةُ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, qaala qaala alzzuhriyyu waaakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa, aakhbarathu qaalat, aawwalu maa ashtakaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy bayti maymuwnaaa faastaadhana aazwaajahu aan yumarrada fiy baytihaa waaadhinna lahu - qaalat - fakharaja wayadun lahu 'alaa alfadli bni 'abbaasin wayadun lahu 'alaa rajulin akhara wahuwa yakhuttu birijlayhi fiy alaardi ‏.‏ faqaala 'ubaydu alllahi fahaddathtu bihi abna 'abbaasin faqaala aatadriy mani alrrajulu alladhiy lam tusammi 'aaiishaau huwa 'aliyyun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:It was in the house ofMaimuna that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) first fell ill. He asked permission from his wives to stay in her ('A'isha's) house during his illness. They granted him permission. She ('A'isha) narrated: He (the Holy Prophet) went out (for prayer) with his hand over al-Fadl b. 'Abbas and on the other hand there was another person and (due to weakness) his feet dragged on the earth. 'Ubaidullah said: I narrated this hadith to the son of 'Abbas ('Abdullah b. 'Abbas) and he said: Do you know who the man was whose name 'A'isha did not mention? It was 'Ali
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاشْتَدَّ بِهِ وَجَعُهُ اسْتَأْذَنَ أَزْوَاجَهُ أَنْ يُمَرَّضَ فِي بَيْتِي فَأَذِنَّ لَهُ فَخَرَجَ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ تَخُطُّ رِجْلاَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ بَيْنَ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَبَيْنَ رَجُلٍ آخَرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَأَخْبَرْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بِالَّذِي قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقَالَ لِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَنِ الرَّجُلُ الآخَرُ الَّذِي لَمْ تُسَمِّ عَائِشَةُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat lammaa thaqula rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waashtadda bihi waja'uhu astaadhana aazwaajahu aan yumarrada fiy baytiy faaadhinna lahu fakharaja bayna rajulayni takhuttu rijlaahu fiy alaardi bayna 'abbaasi bni 'abdi almuttalibi wabayna rajulin akhara ‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi faaakhbartu 'abda alllahi bialladhiy qaalat 'aaiishaau faqaala liy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abbaasin hal tadriy mani alrrajulu alakharu alladhiy lam tusammi 'aaiishaau qaala qultu laa ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin huwa 'aliyyun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Apostle (ﷺ), said:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) fell ill and his illness became serious, he asked permission from his wives to stay in my house during his illness. They gave him permission to do so. He stepped out (of'A'isha's apartment for prayer) supported by two persons. (He was so much weak) that his feet dragged on the ground and he was being supported by 'Abbas b. 'Abd al-Muttalib and another person. 'Ubaidullah said: I informed 'Abdullah (b. 'Abbas) about that which 'A'isha had said. 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas said: Do you know the man whose name 'A'isha did not mention? He said: No. Ibn 'Abbas said: It was 'Ali
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ لَقَدْ رَاجَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ذَلِكَ وَمَا حَمَلَنِي عَلَى كَثْرَةِ مُرَاجَعَتِهِ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَقَعْ فِي قَلْبِي أَنْ يُحِبَّ النَّاسُ بَعْدَهُ رَجُلاً قَامَ مَقَامَهُ أَبَدًا وَإِلاَّ أَنِّي كُنْتُ أَرَى أَنَّهُ لَنْ يَقُومَ مَقَامَهُ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ تَشَاءَمَ النَّاسُ بِهِ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ يَعْدِلَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, qaala qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat laqad raaja'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy dhalika wamaa hamalaniy 'alaa kathraai muraaja'atihi iilaaa aannahu lam yaqa' fiy qalbiy aan yuhibba alnnaasu ba'dahu rajulaan qaama maqaamahu aabadana waiilaaa aanniy kuntu aaraa aannahu lan yaquwma maqaamahu aahadun iilaaa tashaa'ama alnnaasu bihi faaaradtu aan ya'dila dhalika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aabiy bakrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said:I tried to dissuade the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from it (i. e. from appointing Abu Bakr as the Imam.) and my insistence upon it was not due to the fact that I entertained any apprehension in my mind that the people would not love the man who would occupy his (Prophet's) place (i. e. who would be appointed as his caliph) and I feared that the people would be superstitious about one who would occupy his place. I, therefore, desired that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) should leave Abu Bakr aside in this matter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَأَخْبَرَنِي حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْتِي قَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ رَقِيقٌ إِذَا قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ لاَ يَمْلِكُ دَمْعَهُ فَلَوْ أَمَرْتَ غَيْرَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا بِي إِلاَّ كَرَاهِيَةُ أَنْ يَتَشَاءَمَ النَّاسُ بِأَوَّلِ مَنْ يَقُومُ فِي مَقَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ فَرَاجَعْتُهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لِيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَإِنَّكُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, - aakhbaranaa ma'marun, qaala alzzuhriyyu waaakhbaraniy hamzaau bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lammaa dakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm baytiy qaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aabaa bakrin rajulun raqiyqun iidhaa qaraaa alqurana laa yamliku dam'ahu falaw aamarta ghayra aabiy bakrin ‏.‏ qaalat waalllahi maa biy iilaaa karaahiyaau aan yatashaa'ama alnnaasu biaawwali man yaquwmu fiy maqaami rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat faraaja'tuhu marratayni aaw thalaathana faqaala ‏"‏ liyusalli bialnnaasi aabuw bakrin faiinnakunna sawaahibu yuwsufa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to my house, he said: Ask Abu Bakr to lead people in prayer. 'A'isha narrated: I said, Messenger of Allah, Abu Bakr is a man of tenderly feelings; as he recites the Qur'an, he cannot help shedding tears: so better command anyone else to lead the prayer. By Allah, there is nothing disturbing in it for me but the idea that the people may not takeevil omen with regard to one who is the first to occupy the place of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I tried to dissuade him (the Holy Prophet) twice or thrice (from appointing my father as an Imam in prayer), but he ordered Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer and said: You women are like those (who had) surrounded Yusuf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَ بِلاَلٌ يُؤْذِنُهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ أَسِيفٌ إِنَّهُ مَتَى يَقُمْ مَقَامَكَ لاَ يُسْمِعِ النَّاسَ فَلَوْ أَمَرْتَ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ لِحَفْصَةَ قُولِي لَهُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ أَسِيفٌ وَإِنَّهُ مَتَى يَقُمْ مَقَامَكَ لاَ يُسْمِعِ النَّاسَ فَلَوْ أَمَرْتَ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكُنَّ لأَنْتُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ ‏.‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَأَمَرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ - قَالَتْ - فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَجَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ نَفْسِهِ خِفَّةً فَقَامَ يُهَادَى بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ وَرِجْلاَهُ تَخُطَّانِ فِي الأَرْضِ - قَالَتْ - فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ سَمِعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حِسَّهُ ذَهَبَ يَتَأَخَّرُ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُمْ مَكَانَكَ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى جَلَسَ عَنْ يَسَارِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَتْ - فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ جَالِسًا وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ قَائِمًا يَقْتَدِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِصَلاَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَيَقْتَدِي النَّاسُ بِصَلاَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, wawakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lammaa thaqula rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'a bilaalun yuudhinuhu bialssalaaai faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aabaa bakrin rajulun aasiyfun iinnahu mataa yaqum maqaamaka laa yusmi'i alnnaasa falaw aamarta 'umara ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu lihafsaaa quwliy lahu iinna aabaa bakrin rajulun aasiyfun waiinnahu mataa yaqum maqaamaka laa yusmi'i alnnaasa falaw aamarta 'umara ‏.‏ faqaalat lahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnakunna laantunna sawaahibu yuwsufa ‏.‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faaamaruwa aabaa bakrin yusalliy bialnnaasi - qaalat - falammaa dakhala fiy alssalaaai wajada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min nafsihi khiffaaan faqaama yuhaadaa bayna rajulayni warijlaahu takhuttaani fiy alaardi - qaalat - falammaa dakhala almasjida sami'a aabuw bakrin hissahu dhahaba yataaakhharu faaawmaaa iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qum makaanaka ‏.‏ fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa jalasa 'an yasaari aabiy bakrin - qaalat - fakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy bialnnaasi jaalisana waaabuw bakrin qaaiimana yaqtadiy aabuw bakrin bisalaaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wayaqtadiy alnnaasu bisalaaai aabiy bakrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was confined to bed, Bilal came to him to summon him to prayer. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Ask Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. She ('A'isha) reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, Abu Bakr is a tenderhearted man, when he would stand at your place (he would be so overwhelmed by feelings) that he would not be able to make the people hear anything (his recitation would not be audible to the followers in prayer). You should better order Umar (to lead the prayer). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Ask Abu Bakr to lead people in prayer. She ('A'isha) said: I asked Hafsa to (convey) my impression to him (the Holy Prophet) that Abu Bakr was a tenderhearted man, so when he would stand at his place, he would not be able to make the people bear anything. He better order Umar. Hafsa conveyed this (message of Hadrat 'A'isha) to him (the Holy Prophet). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (You are behaving) as if you are the females who had gathered around Yusuf. Order Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. She ('A'isha) reported: So Abu Bakr was ordered to lead the people in prayer. As the prayer began, the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) felt some relief; he got up and moved supported by two persons and his feet dragged on earth (due to excessive weakness). 'A'isha reported: As he (the Holy Prophet) entered the mosque. Abu Bakr perceived his (arrival). He was about to withdraw, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) by the gesture (of his hand) told him to keep standing at his place. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came and seated himself on the left side of Abu Bakr. She ('A'isha) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was leading people in prayer sitting. Abu Bakr was following the prayer of the Apostle (ﷺ) in a standing posture and the people were following the prayer of Abu Bakr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا لَمَّا مَرِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَضَهُ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ فَأُتِيَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى أُجْلِسَ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُسْمِعُهُمُ التَّكْبِيرَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عِيسَى فَجَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُسْمِعُ النَّاسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu mushirin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu wafiy hadiythihimaa lammaa marida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maradahu alladhiy tuwuffiya fiyhi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni mushirin faautiya birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa aujlisa iilaa janbihi wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy bialnnaasi waaabuw bakrin yusmi'uhumu alttakbiyra ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'iysaa fajalasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy waaabuw bakrin iilaa janbihi waaabuw bakrin yusmi'u alnnaasa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'mash reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) suffered from illness of which he died, and in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Mus-hir, the words are: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was brought till he was seated by his (Abu Bakr's) side and the Apostle (ﷺ) led the people in prayer and Abu Bakr was making takbir audible to them, and in the hadith transmitted by 'Isa the (words are):" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat and led the people in prayer and Abu Bakr was by his side and he was making (takbir) audible to the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ فِي مَرَضِهِ فَكَانَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ فَوَجَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ نَفْسِهِ خِفَّةً فَخَرَجَ وَإِذَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَؤُمُّ النَّاسَ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ اسْتَأْخَرَ فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىْ كَمَا أَنْتَ فَجَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حِذَاءَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ ‏.‏ فَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِصَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ يُصَلُّونَ بِصَلاَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, 'an hishaamin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waaalfaazuhum mutaqaaribaaun - qaala haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabaa bakrin aan yusalliya bialnnaasi fiy maradihi fakaana yusalliy bihim ‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau fawajada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min nafsihi khiffaaan fakharaja waiidhaa aabuw bakrin yauummu alnnaasa falammaa raahu aabuw bakrin astaakhara faaashaara iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaa kamaa aanta fajalasa rasuwlu alllahi hidhaa'a aabiy bakrin iilaa janbihi ‏.‏ fakaana aabuw bakrin yusalliy bisalaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu yusalluwna bisalaaai aabiy bakrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered Abu Bakr that he should lead people in prayer during his illness, and he led them in prayer. `Urwa said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt relief and went (to the mosque) and Abu Bakr was leading the people in prayer. When Abu Bakr saw him he began to withdraw, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) signaled him to remain where he was. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat opposite to Abu Bakr by his side. Abu Bakr said prayer following the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and the people said prayer following the prayer of Abu Bakr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، كَانَ يُصَلِّي لَهُمْ فِي وَجَعِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الاِثْنَيْنِ - وَهُمْ صُفُوفٌ فِي الصَّلاَةِ - كَشَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِتْرَ الْحُجْرَةِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْنَا وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ كَأَنَّ وَجْهَهُ وَرَقَةُ مُصْحَفٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَاحِكًا - قَالَ - فَبُهِتْنَا وَنَحْنُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ مِنْ فَرَحٍ بِخُرُوجِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَكَصَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ لِيَصِلَ الصَّفَّ وَظَنَّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَارِجٌ لِلصَّلاَةِ فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ أَنْ أَتِمُّوا صَلاَتَكُمْ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرْخَى السِّتْرَ - قَالَ - فَتُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ يَوْمِهِ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wahasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - qaala 'abdun aakhbaraniy waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - wahaddathaniy aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna aabaa bakrin, kaana yusalliy lahum fiy waja'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alladhiy tuwuffiya fiyhi hattaa iidhaa kaana yawmu alaithnayni - wahum sufuwfun fiy alssalaaai - kashafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sitra alhujraai fanazara iilaynaa wahuwa qaaiimun kaaanna wajhahu waraqaau mushafin ‏.‏ thumma tabassama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm daahikana - qaala - fabuhitnaa wanahnu fiy alssalaaai min farahin bikhuruwji rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanakasa aabuw bakrin 'alaa 'aqibayhi liyasila alssaffa wazanna aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaarijun lilssalaaai faaashaara iilayhim rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi aan aatimmuwa salaatakum - qaala - thumma dakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaarkhaa alssitra - qaala - fatuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min yawmihi dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported, Abu Bakr led them in prayer due to the illness of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) of which be died. It was a Monday and they stood in rows for prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew aside the curtain of ('A'isha's) apartment and looked at us while he was standing, and his (Prophet's) face was (as bright) as the paper of the Holy Book. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt happy and smiled. And we were confounded with joy while in prayer due to the arrival (among our midst) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Abu Bakr stepped back upon his heels to say prayer in a row perceiving that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had come out for prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with the help of his hand signed to them to complete their prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went back (to his apartment) and drew the curtain. He (the narrator) said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) breathed his last on that very day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ آخِرُ نَظْرَةٍ نَظَرْتُهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَشَفَ السِّتَارَةَ يَوْمَ الاِثْنَيْنِ بِهَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ وَحَدِيثُ صَالِحٍ أَتَمُّ وَأَشْبَعُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aanasin, qaala akhiru nazraain nazartuhaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kashafa alssitaaraaa yawma alaithnayni bihadhihi alqissaai wahadiythu saalihin aatammu waaashba'u ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The last glance that I have had of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (before his death) was that when he on Monday drew the curtain aside. The hadith transmitted by Salih is perfect and complete
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ الاِثْنَيْنِ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala lammaa kaana yawmu alaithnayni ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمْ يَخْرُجْ إِلَيْنَا نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثًا فَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَذَهَبَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَتَقَدَّمُ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحِجَابِ فَرَفَعَهُ فَلَمَّا وَضَحَ لَنَا وَجْهُ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا نَظَرْنَا مَنْظَرًا قَطُّ كَانَ أَعْجَبَ إِلَيْنَا مِنْ وَجْهِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ وَضَحَ لَنَا - قَالَ - فَأَوْمَأَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ وَأَرْخَى نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْحِجَابَ فَلَمْ نَقْدِرْ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى مَاتَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin, qaala lam yakhruj iilaynaa nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaathana faauqiymati alssalaaau fadhahaba aabuw bakrin yataqaddamu faqaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhijaabi farafa'ahu falammaa wadaha lanaa wajhu nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa nazarnaa manzarana qattu kaana aa'jaba iilaynaa min wajhi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna wadaha lanaa - qaala - faaawmaaa nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi iilaa aabiy bakrin aan yataqaddama waaarkhaa nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alhijaaba falam naqdir 'alayhi hattaa maata ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) did not come to us for three days. When the prayer was about to start. Abu Bakr stepped forward (to lead the prayer), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) lifted the curtain. When the face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) became visible to us, we (found) that no sight was more endearing to us than the face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as it appeared to us. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) with the gesture of his hand directed Abu Bakr to step forward (and lead the prayer). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) then drew the curtain, and we could not see him till he died
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ مَرِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاشْتَدَّ مَرَضُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ رَقِيقٌ مَتَى يَقُمْ مَقَامَكَ لاَ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ فَإِنَّكُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَيَاةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala marida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faashtadda maraduhu faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aabaa bakrin rajulun raqiyqun mataa yaqum maqaamaka laa yastati' aan yusalliya bialnnaasi faqaala ‏"‏ muriy aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi faiinnakunna sawaahibu yuwsufa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fasallaa bihim aabuw bakrin hayaaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) became ill and illness became serious he ordered Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. Upon this 'A'isha said: Messenger of Allah, Abd Bakr is a man of tenderly feelings: when he would stand in your place (he would be so much overwhelmed -by grief that) he would not be able to lead the people in prayer. He (the Holy Prophet) said: You order Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer, and added: You are like the female companions of Yusuf. So Abu Bakr led the prayer (during this period of illness) in the life of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَهَبَ إِلَى بَنِي عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ لِيُصْلِحَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَحَانَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَجَاءَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ أَتُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ فَأُقِيمُ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَلَّى أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَتَخَلَّصَ حَتَّى وَقَفَ فِي الصَّفِّ فَصَفَّقَ النَّاسُ - وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لاَ يَلْتَفِتُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ - فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرَ النَّاسُ التَّصْفِيقَ الْتَفَتَ فَرَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ امْكُثْ مَكَانَكَ فَرَفَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَدَيْهِ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى مَا أَمَرَهُ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْخَرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَتَّى اسْتَوَى فِي الصَّفِّ وَتَقَدَّمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَثْبُتَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَا كَانَ لاِبْنِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا لِي رَأَيْتُكُمْ أَكْثَرْتُمُ التَّصْفِيقَ مَنْ نَابَهُ شَىْءٌ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَلْيُسَبِّحْ فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا سَبَّحَ الْتُفِتَ إِلَيْهِ وَإِنَّمَا التَّصْفِيحُ لِلنِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhahaba iilaa baniy 'amriw bni 'awfin liyusliha baynahum fahaanati alssalaaau fajaa'a almuuadhhinu iilaa aabiy bakrin faqaala aatusalliy bialnnaasi faauqiymu qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala fasallaa aabuw bakrin fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu fiy alssalaaai fatakhallasa hattaa waqafa fiy alssaffi fasaffaqa alnnaasu - wakaana aabuw bakrin laa yaltafitu fiy alssalaaai - falammaa aakthara alnnaasu alttasfiyqa altafata faraaaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaashaara iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aani amkuth makaanaka farafa'a aabuw bakrin yadayhi fahamida alllaha 'azza wajalla 'alaa maa aamarahu bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min dhalika thumma astaakhara aabuw bakrin hattaa astawaa fiy alssaffi wataqaddama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa thumma ansarafa faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa bakrin maa mana'aka aan tathbuta iidh aamartuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin maa kaana laibni aabiy quhaafaaa aan yusalliya bayna yadaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa liy raaaytukum aakthartumu alttasfiyqa man naabahu shaa'un fiy salaatihi falyusabbih faiinnahu iidhaa sabbaha altufita iilayhi waiinnamaa alttasfiyhu lilnnisaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the tribe of Bani Amr b. Auf in order to bring reconciliation amongst (its members), and It was a time of prayer. The Mu'adhdhin came to Abu Bakr and said: Would you lead the prayer in case I recite takbir (tahrima, with which the prayer begins)? He (Abu Bakr) said: Yes. He (the narrator) said: He (Abu Bakr) started (leading) the prayer. The people were engaged in observing prayer when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to come there and made his way (through the people) till he stood in a row. The people began to clap (their hands), but Abu Bakr paid no heed (to it) in prayer. When the people clapped more vigorously, he (Abu Bakr) then paid heed and saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) there. (He was about to withdraw when) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) signed to him to keep standing at his place. Abu Bakr lifted his hands and praised Allah for what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had commanded him and then Abu Bakr withdrew himself till he stood in the midst of the row and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stepped forward and led the prayer. When (the prayer) was over, he (the Holy Prophet) said: 0 Abu Bakr, what prevented you from standing (at that place) as I ordered you to do? Abu Bakr said: It does not become the son of Abu Quhafa to lead prayer before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to the people) around him: What is it that I saw you clapping so vigorously? (Behold) when anything happens in prayer, say: Subha Allah, for when you would utter it, it would attract the attention, while clapping of hands is meant for women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي حَازِمٍ - وَقَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا فَرَفَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَدَيْهِ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَرَجَعَ الْقَهْقَرَى وَرَاءَهُ حَتَّى قَامَ فِي الصَّفِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna aabiy haazimin - waqaala qutaybaau haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyyu - kilaahumaa 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, bimithli hadiythi maalikin ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihimaa farafa'a aabuw bakrin yadayhi fahamida alllaha waraja'a alqahqaraa waraa'ahu hattaa qaama fiy alssaffi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is transmitted by Sahl b. Sa'd in the same way as narrated by Malik, with the exception of these words:" Abu Bakr lifted his hands and praised Allah and retraced his (steps) till he stood in a row
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، قَالَ ذَهَبَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصْلِحُ بَيْنَ بَنِي عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَزَادَ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَقَ الصُّفُوفَ حَتَّى قَامَ عِنْدَ الصَّفِّ الْمُقَدَّمِ ‏.‏ وَفِيهِ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجَعَ الْقَهْقَرَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni baziy'in, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, qaala dhahaba nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuslihu bayna baniy 'amriw bni 'awfin ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihim wazaada fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakharaqa alssufuwfa hattaa qaama 'inda alssaffi almuqaddami ‏.‏ wafiyhi aanna aabaa bakrin raja'a alqahqaraa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) went to Bani Amr b. 'Auf in order to bring about reconciliation amongst them. The rest of the hadith is the same but with (the addition of these words):" The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came and made his way through the rows till he came to the first row and Abu Bakr retraced his steps
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَدِيثِ، عَبَّادِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، غَزَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَبُوكَ - قَالَ الْمُغِيرَةُ - فَتَبَرَّزَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِبَلَ الْغَائِطِ فَحَمَلْتُ مَعَهُ إِدَاوَةً قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَىَّ أَخَذْتُ أُهَرِيقُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ مِنَ الإِدَاوَةِ وَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ يُخْرِجُ جُبَّتَهُ عَنْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ فَضَاقَ كُمَّا جُبَّتِهِ فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْجُبَّةِ حَتَّى أَخْرَجَ ذِرَاعَيْهِ مِنْ أَسْفَلِ الْجُبَّةِ ‏.‏ وَغَسَلَ ذِرَاعَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ عَلَى خُفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ - قَالَ الْمُغِيرَةُ - فَأَقْبَلْتُ مَعَهُ حَتَّى نَجِدُ النَّاسَ قَدْ قَدَّمُوا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ فَصَلَّى لَهُمْ فَأَدْرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِحْدَى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فَصَلَّى مَعَ النَّاسِ الرَّكْعَةَ الآخِرَةَ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُتِمُّ صَلاَتَهُ فَأَفْزَعَ ذَلِكَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَأَكْثَرُوا التَّسْبِيحَ فَلَمَّا قَضَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَتَهُ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْسَنْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَغْبِطُهُمْ أَنْ صَلَّوُا الصَّلاَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wahasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, qaala abnu raafi'in haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, haddathaniy abnu shihaabin, 'an hadiythi, 'abbaadi bni ziyaadin aanna 'urwaaa bna almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, aakhbarahu aanna almughiyraaa bna shu'baaa aakhbarahu aannahu, ghazaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tabuwka - qaala almughiyraau - fatabarraza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qibala alghaaiiti fahamaltu ma'ahu iidaawaaan qabla salaaai alfajri falammaa raja'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaaa aakhadhtu auhariyqu 'alaa yadayhi mina aliidaawaai waghasala yadayhi thalaatha marraatin thumma ghasala wajhahu thumma dhahaba yukhriju jubbatahu 'an dhiraa'ayhi fadaaqa kummaa jubbatihi faaadkhala yadayhi fiy aljubbaai hattaa aakhraja dhiraa'ayhi min aasfali aljubbaai ‏.‏ waghasala dhiraa'ayhi iilaa almirfaqayni thumma tawaddaaa 'alaa khuffayhi thumma aaqbala - qaala almughiyraau - faaaqbaltu ma'ahu hattaa najidu alnnaasa qad qaddamuwa 'abda alrrahmani bna 'awfin fasallaa lahum faaadraka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iihdaa alrrak'atayni fasallaa ma'a alnnaasi alrrak'aaa alakhiraaa falammaa sallama 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yutimmu salaatahu faaafza'a dhalika almuslimiyna faaaktharuwa alttasbiyha falammaa qadaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm salaatahu aaqbala 'alayhim thumma qaala ‏"‏ aahsantum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ qad aasabtum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ yaghbituhum aan sallawua alssalaaaa liwaqtihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that he participated In the expedition of Tabuk along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature before the morning prayer. and I carried along with him a jar (full of water). When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came back to me (after relieving himself). I began to pour water upon his hands out of the jar and he washed his hands three times, then washed his face three times. He then tried to tuck up the sleeves of his cloak upon his forearms but since the sleeves were tight he inserted his hands in the cloak and then brought out his forearms up to the elbow below the cloak, and then wiped over his shoes and then moved on. Mughira said:I also moved along with him till he came to the people and (he found) that they had been saying their prayer under the Imamah of 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) could get one rak ah out of two and said (this) last rak'ah along with the people. When Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf pronounced the salutation, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up to complete the prayer. This made the Muslims terrified and most of them began to recite the glory of the Lord. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished his prayer, he turned towards them and then said: You did well, or said with a sense of joy: You did the right thing that you said prayer at the appointed hour
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَالْحُلْوَانِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ عَبَّادٍ قَالَ الْمُغِيرَةُ فَأَرَدْتُ تَأْخِيرَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ دَعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, waalhulwaaniyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'ani abni jurayjin, haddathaniy abnu shihaabin, 'an iismaa'iyla bni muhammadi bni sa'din, 'an hamzaaa bni almughiyraai, nahwa hadiythi 'abbaadin qaala almughiyraau faaaradtu taakhiyra 'abdi alrrahmani faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ da'hu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Hamza b. Mughira by another chain of trans- mitters (but with the addition of these words):I made up my mind to hold Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf back, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leave him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
