verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ التَّسْبِيحُ لِلرِّجَالِ وَالتَّصْفِيقُ لِلنِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ حَرْمَلَةُ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رِجَالاً مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ يُسَبِّحُونَ وَيُشِيرُونَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani aannahumaa sami'aa aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alttasbiyhu lilrrijaali waalttasfiyqu lilnnisaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ zaada harmalaau fiy riwaayatihi qaala abnu shihaabin waqad raaaytu rijaalaan min aahli al'ilmi yusabbihuwna wayushiyruwna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Glorification of Allah is for men and clapping of hands is meant for women (if something happens in prayer). Harmala added in his narration that Ibn Shihab told him: I saw some of the scholars glorifying Allah and making a gesture
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عِيَاضٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa alfudaylu ya'niy abna 'iyaadin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ وَزَادَ ‏ "‏ فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi wazaada ‏ "‏ fiy alssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is transmitted by Muhammad b. Rafi', Abu'I-Razzaq. Ma'mar, Hammam on the authority of Abu Huraira with the addition of (the word)" prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ كَثِيرٍ - حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا فُلاَنُ أَلاَ تُحْسِنُ صَلاَتَكَ أَلاَ يَنْظُرُ الْمُصَلِّي إِذَا صَلَّى كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي فَإِنَّمَا يُصَلِّي لِنَفْسِهِ إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لأُبْصِرُ مَنْ وَرَائِي كَمَا أُبْصِرُ مَنْ بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi, - ya'niy abna kathiyrin - haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyu, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana thumma ansarafa faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa fulaanu aalaa tuhsinu salaataka aalaa yanzuru almusalliy iidhaa sallaa kayfa yusalliy faiinnamaa yusalliy linafsihi iinniy waalllahi laubsiru man waraaiiy kamaa aubsiru man bayna yadaaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led the prayer. Then turning (towards his Companions) he said: O you man, why don't you say your prayer well? Does the observer of prayer not see how he is performing the prayer, for he performs it for himself? By Allah, I see behind me as I see in front of me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ تَرَوْنَ قِبْلَتِي هَا هُنَا فَوَاللَّهِ مَا يَخْفَى عَلَىَّ رُكُوعُكُمْ وَلاَ سُجُودُكُمْ إِنِّي لأَرَاكُمْ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ hal tarawna qiblatiy haa hunaa fawaalllahi maa yakhfaa 'alaaaa rukuw'ukum walaa sujuwdukum iinniy laaraakum waraa'a zahriy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do you find me seeing towards the Qibla only? By Allah, your bowing and your prostrating are not hidden from my view. Verily I see them behind my back
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقِيمُوا الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَاكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِي - وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ مِنْ بَعْدِ ظَهْرِي - إِذَا رَكَعْتُمْ وَسَجَدْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aaqiymuwa alrrukuw'a waalssujuwda fawaalllahi iinniy laaraakum min ba'diy - warubbamaa qaala min ba'di zahriy - iidhaa raka'tum wasajadtum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Perform bowing and prostration well. By Allah, I see you even if you are behind me, or he said: (I see you) behind my back when you bow or prostrate
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتِمُّوا الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَاكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ ظَهْرِي إِذَا مَا رَكَعْتُمْ وَإِذَا مَا سَجَدْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ ‏"‏ إِذَا رَكَعْتُمْ وَإِذَا سَجَدْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - ya'niy abna hishaamin - haddathaniy aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, kilaahumaa 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aatimmuwa alrrukuw'a waalssujuwda fawaalllahi iinniy laaraakum min ba'di zahriy iidhaa maa raka'tum waiidhaa maa sajadtum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi sa'iydin ‏"‏ iidhaa raka'tum waiidhaa sajadtum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: Complete the bowing and prostration well. By Allah, I see you behind my back as to how you bow and prostrate or when you bow and prostrate
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، وَاللَّفْظُ، لأَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ ابْنُ حُجْرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ بْنِ فُلْفُلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلاَةَ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنِّي إِمَامُكُمْ فَلاَ تَسْبِقُونِي بِالرُّكُوعِ وَلاَ بِالسُّجُودِ وَلاَ بِالْقِيَامِ وَلاَ بِالاِنْصِرَافِ فَإِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ أَمَامِي وَمِنْ خَلْفِي - ثُمَّ قَالَ - وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَوْ رَأَيْتُمْ مَا رَأَيْتُ لَضَحِكْتُمْ قَلِيلاً وَلَبَكَيْتُمْ كَثِيرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا رَأَيْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ رَأَيْتُ الْجَنَّةَ وَالنَّارَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, waalllafzu, laabiy bakrin qaala abnu hujrin aakhbaranaa waqaala aabuw bakrin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani almukhtaari bni fulfulin, 'an aanasin, qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata yawmin falammaa qadaa alssalaaaa aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi faqaala ‏"‏ aayyuhaa alnnaasu iinniy iimaamukum falaa tasbiquwniy bialrrukuw'i walaa bialssujuwdi walaa bialqiyaami walaa bialainsiraafi faiinniy aaraakum aamaamiy wamin khalfiy - thumma qaala - waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi law raaaytum maa raaaytu ladahiktum qaliylaan walabakaytum kathiyrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa wamaa raaayta yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ raaaytu aljannaaa waalnnaara ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one day led us in the prayer. and when he completed the Prayer he turned his face towards us and said: 0 People, I am your Imam, so do not precede me in bowing and prostration and in standing and turning (faces, i. e. In pronouncing salutation), for I see you in front of me and behind me, and then said: By Him in Whose hand Is the life of Muhammad, if you could see what I see, you would have laughed little and wept much more. They said: What did you see, Messenger of Allah? He replied: (I saw) Paradise and Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ فُضَيْلٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏ "‏ وَلاَ بِالاِنْصِرَافِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, 'ani abni fudaylin, jamiy'ana 'ani almukhtaari, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa alhadiythi walaysa fiy hadiythi jariyrin ‏ "‏ walaa bialainsiraafi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Anas with another chain of transmitters, and in the hadith transmitted by Jarir there is no mention of" turning (faces)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، - قَالَ خَلَفٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَمَا يَخْشَى الَّذِي يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ قَبْلَ الإِمَامِ أَنْ يُحَوِّلَ اللَّهُ رَأْسَهُ رَأْسَ حِمَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, kulluhum 'an hammaadin, - qaala khalafun haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, - 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, qaala qaala muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aamaa yakhshaa alladhiy yarfa'u raasahu qabla aliimaami aan yuhawwila alllahu raasahu raasa himaarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Does the man who lifts his head ahead of the Imam (from prostration) not fear that Allah may change his head into the head of an ass?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا يَأْمَنُ الَّذِي يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ قَبْلَ الإِمَامِ أَنْ يُحَوِّلَ اللَّهُ صُورَتَهُ فِي صُورَةِ حِمَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an yuwnusa, 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa yaamanu alladhiy yarfa'u raasahu fiy salaatihi qabla aliimaami aan yuhawwila alllahu suwratahu fiy suwraai himaarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Does the man who lifts his head before the Imam not fear that Allah may change his face into that of an ass?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ الْجُمَحِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ ‏ "‏ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ وَجْهَ حِمَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu salaaamin aljumahiyyu, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu alrrabiy'i bni muslimin, jamiy'ana 'ani alrrabiy'i bni muslimin, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an hammaadi bni salamaaa, kulluhum 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi alrrabiy'i bni muslimin ‏ "‏ aan yaj'ala alllahu wajhahu wajha himaarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters except for the words narrated by Rabi' b. Muslim:" Allah may make his face like the face of an ass
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيَنْتَهِيَنَّ أَقْوَامٌ يَرْفَعُونَ أَبْصَارَهُمْ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ أَوْ لاَ تَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'ani almusayyabi, 'an tamiymi bni tarafaaa, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ layantahiyanna aaqwaamun yarfa'uwna aabsaarahum iilaa alssamaa'i fiy alssalaaai aaw laa tarji'u iilayhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The people who lift their eyes towards the sky in Prayer should avoid it or they would lose their eyesight
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيَنْتَهِيَنَّ أَقْوَامٌ عَنْ رَفْعِهِمْ أَبْصَارَهُمْ عِنْدَ الدُّعَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ أَوْ لَتُخْطَفَنَّ أَبْصَارُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, wa'amruw bnu sawwaadin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy alllaythu bnu sa'din, 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ layantahiyanna aaqwaamun 'an raf'ihim aabsaarahum 'inda alddu'aa'i fiy alssalaaai iilaa alssamaa'i aaw latukhtafanna aabsaaruhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:People should avoid lifting their eyes towards the sky while supplicating in prayer, otherwise their eyes would be snatched away
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لِي أَرَاكُمْ رَافِعِي أَيْدِيكُمْ كَأَنَّهَا أَذْنَابُ خَيْلٍ شُمْسٍ اسْكُنُوا فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا فَرَآنَا حَلَقًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لِي أَرَاكُمْ عِزِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ تَصُفُّونَ كَمَا تَصُفُّ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَكَيْفَ تَصُفُّ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ يُتِمُّونَ الصُّفُوفَ الأُوَلَ وَيَتَرَاصُّونَ فِي الصَّفِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'ani almusayyabi bni raafi'in, 'an tamiymi bni tarafaaa, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala kharaja 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa liy aaraakum raafi'iy aaydiykum kaaannahaa aadhnaabu khaylin shumsin askunuwa fiy alssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma kharaja 'alaynaa faraanaa halaqana faqaala ‏"‏ maa liy aaraakum 'iziyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma kharaja 'alaynaa faqaala ‏"‏ aalaa tasuffuwna kamaa tasuffu almalaaiikaau 'inda rabbihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi wakayfa tasuffu almalaaiikaau 'inda rabbihaa qaala ‏"‏ yutimmuwna alssufuwfa alauwala wayataraassuwna fiy alssaffi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us and said: "How is it that I see you lifting your hands like the tails of headstrong horses? Be calm in prayer." He (the narrator) said: He then again came to us and saw us (sitting) in circles. He said: "How is it that I see you in separate groups?" He (the narrator) said: He again came to us and said: "Why don't you draw yourselves up in rows as angels do in the presence of their Lord?" We said: Messenger of Allah, how do the angels draw themselves up in rows in the presence of their Lord? He (the Holy Prophet) said: "They make the first rows complete and keep close together in the row
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, qaalaa jamiy'ana haddathanaa alaa'mashu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ابْنُ الْقِبْطِيَّةِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا إِذَا صَلَّيْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْنَا السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الْجَانِبَيْنِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ عَلاَمَ تُومِئُونَ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ كَأَنَّهَا أَذْنَابُ خَيْلٍ شُمُسٍ إِنَّمَا يَكْفِي أَحَدَكُمْ أَنْ يَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى فَخِذِهِ ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَى أَخِيهِ مَنْ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ وَشِمَالِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaala haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an mis'arin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an mis'arin, haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi abnu alqibtiyyaai, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala kunnaa iidhaa sallaynaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qulnaa alssalaamu 'alaykum warahmaau alllahi alssalaamu 'alaykum warahmaau alllahi ‏.‏ waaashaara biyadihi iilaa aljaanibayni faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ 'alaama tuwmiiuwna biaaydiykum kaaannahaa aadhnaabu khaylin shumusin iinnamaa yakfiy aahadakum aan yada'a yadahu 'alaa fakhidhihi thumma yusallimu 'alaa aakhiyhi man 'alaa yamiynihi washimaalihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:When we said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we pronounced: Peace be upon you and Mercy of Allah, peace be upon you and Mercy of Allah, and made gesture with the hand on both the sides. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him said: What do you point out with your hands as if they are the tails of headstrong horses? This is enough for you that one should place one's hand on one's thigh and then pronounce salutation upon one's brother on the right side and then on the left)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ فُرَاتٍ، - يَعْنِي الْقَزَّازَ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكُنَّا إِذَا سَلَّمْنَا قُلْنَا بِأَيْدِينَا السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا شَأْنُكُمْ تُشِيرُونَ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ كَأَنَّهَا أَذْنَابُ خَيْلٍ شُمُسٍ إِذَا سَلَّمَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَلْتَفِتْ إِلَى صَاحِبِهِ وَلاَ يُومِئْ بِيَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an furaatin, - ya'niy alqazzaaza - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala sallaytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakunnaa iidhaa sallamnaa qulnaa biaaydiynaa alssalaamu 'alaykum alssalaamu 'alaykum fanazara iilaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ maa shaanukum tushiyruwna biaaydiykum kaaannahaa aadhnaabu khaylin shumusin iidhaa sallama aahadukum falyaltafit iilaa saahibihi walaa yuwmii biyadihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:We said our prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and, while pronouncing salutations, we made gestures with our hands (indicating)" Peace be upon you, peace be upon you." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) looked towards us and said: Why is it that you make gestures with your hands like the tails of headstrong horses? When any one of you pro- nounces salutation (in prayer) he should only turn his face towards his companion and should not make a gesture with his hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ وَوَكِيعٌ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُ مَنَاكِبَنَا فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اسْتَوُوا وَلاَ تَخْتَلِفُوا فَتَخْتَلِفَ قُلُوبُكُمْ لِيَلِنِي مِنْكُمْ أُولُو الأَحْلاَمِ وَالنُّهَى ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ فَأَنْتُمُ الْيَوْمَ أَشَدُّ اخْتِلاَفًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa wawakiy'un 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'umaaraaa bni 'umayrin alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy ma'marin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamsahu manaakibanaa fiy alssalaaai wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ astawuwa walaa takhtalifuwa fatakhtalifa quluwbukum liyaliniy minkum auwluw alaahlaami waalnnuhaa thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw mas'uwdin faaantumu alyawma aashaddu akhtilaafana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mas'ud reported:The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to touch our shoulders in prayer and say: Keep straight, don't be irregular, for there would be dissension in your hearts. Let those of you who are sedate and prudent be near me, then those who are next to them, then those who are next to them. Abu Mas'ud said: Now-a-days there is much dissension amongst you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى يَعْنِي ابْنَ يُونُسَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, h qaala wahaddathanaa abnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa ya'niy abna yuwnusa, h qaala wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Ibn Uyaina with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، وَصَالِحُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ وَرْدَانَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لِيَلِنِي مِنْكُمْ أُولُو الأَحْلاَمِ وَالنُّهَى ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ - ثَلاَثًا - وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهَيْشَاتِ الأَسْوَاقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, wasaalihu bnu haatimi bni wardaana, qaalaa haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathaniy khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, 'an aabiy ma'sharin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ liyaliniy minkum auwluw alaahlaami waalnnuhaa thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum - thalaathana - waiiyyaakum wahayshaati alaaswaaqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Let those who are sedate and prudent be near me, then those who are next to them (saying it tliree tinies), and beware of the tumult of the markets
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ سَوُّوا صُفُوفَكُمْ فَإِنَّ تَسْوِيَةَ الصَّفِّ مِنْ تَمَامِ الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ sawwuwa sufuwfakum faiinna taswiyaaa alssaffi min tamaami alssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Straighten your rows. for the straightening of a row is a part of the perfection of prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ صُهَيْبٍ - عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَتِمُّوا الصُّفُوفَ فَإِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, - wahuwa abnu suhaybin - 'an aanasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aatimmuwa alssufuwfa faiinniy aaraakum khalfa zahriy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Complete the rows, for I can see you behind my back
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقِيمُوا الصَّفَّ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّ إِقَامَةَ الصَّفِّ مِنْ حُسْنِ الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala ‏ "‏ aaqiymuwa alssaffa fiy alssalaaai faiinna iiqaamaaa alssaffi min husni alssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:This is what was transmitted to us by Abu Huraira from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and, while making a mention of a few ahadith, said: (The Messengerof Allah directed us thus): Establish rows in prayer, for the making of a row (straight) is one of the merits of prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ الْغَطَفَانِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَتُسَوُّنَّ صُفُوفَكُمْ أَوْ لَيُخَالِفَنَّ اللَّهُ بَيْنَ وُجُوهِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, qaala sami'tu saalima bna aabiy alja'di alghatafaaniyya, qaala sami'tu alnnu'maana bna bashiyrin, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ latusawwunna sufuwfakum aaw layukhaalifanna alllahu bayna wujuwhikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Straighten your rows, or Allah would create dissension amongst you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسَوِّي صُفُوفَنَا حَتَّى كَأَنَّمَا يُسَوِّي بِهَا الْقِدَاحَ حَتَّى رَأَى أَنَّا قَدْ عَقَلْنَا عَنْهُ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ يَوْمًا فَقَامَ حَتَّى كَادَ يُكَبِّرُ فَرَأَى رَجُلاً بَادِيًا صَدْرُهُ مِنَ الصَّفِّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ لَتُسَوُّنَّ صُفُوفَكُمْ أَوْ لَيُخَالِفَنَّ اللَّهُ بَيْنَ وُجُوهِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an simaaki bni harbin, qaala sami'tu alnnu'maana bna bashiyrin, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusawwiy sufuwfanaa hattaa kaaannamaa yusawwiy bihaa alqidaaha hattaa raaaa aannaa qad 'aqalnaa 'anhu thumma kharaja yawmana faqaama hattaa kaada yukabbiru faraaaa rajulaan baadiyana sadruhu mina alssaffi faqaala ‏ "‏ 'ibaada alllahi latusawwunna sufuwfakum aaw layukhaalifanna alllahu bayna wujuwhikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported:The Messenger of Allah (may peace-be upon him) used to straighten our rows as it lie were straightening an arrow with their help until be saw that we had learnt it from him. One day he came out, stood up (for prayer) and was about to say: Allah is the Greatest, when he saw a man, whose chest was bulging out from the row, so he said: Servants of Allah, you hint straighten your rows or Allah would create dissension amongst you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanu bnu alrrabiy'i, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu 'Awana reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَا فِي النِّدَاءِ وَالصَّفِّ الأَوَّلِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَجِدُوا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَسْتَهِمُوا عَلَيْهِ لاَسْتَهَمُوا وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي التَّهْجِيرِ لاَسْتَبَقُوا إِلَيْهِ وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي الْعَتَمَةِ وَالصُّبْحِ لأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an sumaaain, mawlaa aabiy bakrin 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ law ya'lamu alnnaasu maa fiy alnnidaa'i waalssaffi alaawwali thumma lam yajiduwa iilaaa aan yastahimuwa 'alayhi laastahamuwa walaw ya'lamuwna maa fiy alttahjiyri laastabaquwa iilayhi walaw ya'lamuwna maa fiy al'atamaai waalssubhi laatawhumaa walaw habwana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If the people were to know what excellence is there in the Adhan and in the first row, and they could not (get these opportunities) except by drawing lots, they would have definitely done that. And if they were to know what excellence lies in joining the prayer in the first takbir (prayer), they would have vied with one another. And if they were to know what excellence lies in the night prayer and morning prayer, they would have definitely come even if crawling (on their knees)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَشْهَبِ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ الْعَبْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى فِي أَصْحَابِهِ تَأَخُّرًا فَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏ "‏ تَقَدَّمُوا فَائْتَمُّوا بِي وَلْيَأْتَمَّ بِكُمْ مَنْ بَعْدَكُمْ لاَ يَزَالُ قَوْمٌ يَتَأَخَّرُونَ حَتَّى يُؤَخِّرَهُمُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa aabuw alaashhabi, 'an aabiy nadraaa al'abdiyyi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa fiy aashaabihi taaakhhurana faqaala lahum ‏ "‏ taqaddamuwa faaitammuwa biy walyaatamma bikum man ba'dakum laa yazaalu qawmun yataaakhharuwna hattaa yuuakhhirahumu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw (a tendency ) among his Companions to go to the back, so he said to them: Come forward and follow my lead, and let those who come after you follow your lead. People will continue to keep back till Allah will put them at the back
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْمًا فِي مُؤَخَّرِ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alrraqaashiyyu, haddathanaa bishru bnu mansuwrin, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala raaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qawmana fiy muuakhhari almasjidi ‏.‏ fadhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw people at the end of the mosque, and then the (above-mentioned hadith) was narrated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ أَبُو قَطَنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ خِلاَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ - أَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ - مَا فِي الصَّفِّ الْمُقَدَّمِ لَكَانَتْ قُرْعَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ حَرْبٍ ‏"‏ الصَّفِّ الأَوَّلِ مَا كَانَتْ إِلاَّ قُرْعَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu diynaarin, wamuhammadu bnu harbin alwaasitiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa 'amruw bnu alhaythami aabuw qatanin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an khilaasin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ law ta'lamuwna - aaw ya'lamuwna - maa fiy alssaffi almuqaddami lakaanat qur'aaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala abnu harbin ‏"‏ alssaffi alaawwali maa kaanat iilaaa qur'aaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If you were to know, or if they were to know, what (excellence) lies in the first rows, there would have been drawing of lots (for filling them) ; and Ibn Harb said: For (occupying) the first row there would have been drawing of lots
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ صُفُوفِ الرِّجَالِ أَوَّلُهَا وَشَرُّهَا آخِرُهَا وَخَيْرُ صُفُوفِ النِّسَاءِ آخِرُهَا وَشَرُّهَا أَوَّلُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khayru sufuwfi alrrijaali aawwaluhaa washarruhaa akhiruhaa wakhayru sufuwfi alnnisaa'i akhiruhaa washarruhaa aawwaluhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It was narrated from Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:The best rows for men are the first rows, and the worst ones the last ones, and the best rows for women are the last ones and the worst ones for them are the first ones
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'an suhaylin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Suhail with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الرِّجَالَ عَاقِدِي أُزُرِهِمْ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ مِثْلَ الصِّبْيَانِ مِنْ ضِيقِ الأُزُرِ خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ يَا مَعْشَرَ النِّسَاءِ لاَ تَرْفَعْنَ رُءُوسَكُنَّ حَتَّى يَرْفَعَ الرِّجَالُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala laqad raaaytu alrrijaala 'aaqidiy auzurihim fiy aa'naaqihim mithla alssibyaani min diyqi alauzuri khalfa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala qaaiilun yaa ma'shara alnnisaa'i laa tarfa'na ru'uwsakunna hattaa yarfa'a alrrijaalu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd reported:I saw men having tied (the ends) of their lower garments around their necks, like children, due to shortage of cloth and offering their prayers behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). One of the proclaimers said: O womenfolk, do not lift your heads till men raise (them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، سَمِعَ سَالِمًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْ أَحَدَكُمُ امْرَأَتُهُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَلاَ يَمْنَعْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'ani alzzuhriyyi, sami'a saalimana, yuhaddithu 'an aabiyhi, yablughu bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa astaadhanat aahadakumu amraaatuhu iilaa almasjidi falaa yamna'haa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim narrated it from his father ('Abdullah b. Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:When women ask permission for going to the mosque, do not prevent them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَمْنَعُوا نِسَاءَكُمُ الْمَسَاجِدَ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ بِلاَلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ لَنَمْنَعُهُنَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَسَبَّهُ سَبًّا سَيِّئًا مَا سَمِعْتُهُ سَبَّهُ مِثْلَهُ قَطُّ وَقَالَ أُخْبِرُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَقُولُ وَاللَّهِ لَنَمْنَعُهُنَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tamna'uwa nisaa'akumu almasaajida iidhaa astaadhannakum iilayhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala bilaalu bnu 'abdi alllahi waalllahi lanamna'uhunna ‏.‏ qaala faaaqbala 'alayhi 'abdu alllahi fasabbahu sabbana sayyiiana maa sami'tuhu sabbahu mithlahu qattu waqaala aukhbiruka 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wataquwlu waalllahi lanamna'uhunna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: Don't prevent your women from going to the mosque when they seek your permission. Bilal b. 'Abdullah said: By Allah, we shall certainly prevent them. On this'Abdullah b. Umar turned towards him and reprimanded him to harshly as I had never heard him do before. He ('Abdullah b. Umar) said: I am narrating to you that which comes from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and you (have the audicity) to say: By Allah, we shall certainly prevent them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَابْنُ، إِدْرِيسَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَمْنَعُوا إِمَاءَ اللَّهِ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy waabnu, iidriysa qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tamna'uwa iimaa'a alllahi masaajida alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:'The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not prevent the maid-servants of Allah from going to the mosque
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا حَنْظَلَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَكُمْ نِسَاؤُكُمْ إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ فَأْذَنُوا لَهُنَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa hanzalaau, qaala sami'tu saalimana, yaquwlu sami'tu abna 'umara, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa astaadhanakum nisaauukum iilaa almasaajidi faadhanuwa lahunna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: lbn Umar reported:I heard the Messeinger of Allah (ﷺ) say: When your women seek your permission for going to the mosque, you grant them (permission)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَمْنَعُوا النِّسَاءَ مِنَ الْخُرُوجِ إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ بِاللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنٌ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ لاَ نَدَعُهُنَّ يَخْرُجْنَ فَيَتَّخِذْنَهُ دَغَلاً ‏.‏ قَالَ فَزَبَرَهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَقَالَ أَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَقُولُ لاَ نَدَعُهُنَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tamna'uwa alnnisaa'a mina alkhuruwji iilaa almasaajidi bialllayli ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala abnun li'abdi alllahi bni 'umara laa nada'uhunna yakhrujna fayattakhidhnahu daghalaan ‏.‏ qaala fazabarahu abnu 'umara waqaala aaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wataquwlu laa nada'uhunna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not prevent women from going to the mosque at night. A boy said to 'Abdullah b. Umar: We would never let them go out, that they may not be caught in evil. He (the narrator) said: Ibn Umar reprimanded him and said.. I am saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said this, but you say: We would not allow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَابْنُ، رَافِعٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ائْذَنُوا لِلنِّسَاءِ بِاللَّيْلِ إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنٌ لَهُ يُقَالُ لَهُ وَاقِدٌ إِذًا يَتَّخِذْنَهُ دَغَلاً ‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَرَبَ فِي صَدْرِهِ وَقَالَ أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَقُولُ لاَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu haatimin, waabnu, raafi'in qaalaa haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathaniy warqaa'u, 'an 'amrinw, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aidhanuwa lilnnisaa'i bialllayli iilaa almasaajidi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala abnun lahu yuqaalu lahu waaqidun iidhana yattakhidhnahu daghalaan ‏.‏ qaala fadaraba fiy sadrihi waqaala auhaddithuka 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wataquwlu laa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:Grant permission to women for going to the mosque in the night. His son who was called Waqid said: Then they would make mischief. He (the narrator) said: He thumped his (son's) chest and said: I am narrating to you the hadith of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and you say: No
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ - حَدَّثَنَا كَعْبُ بْنُ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ بِلاَلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَمْنَعُوا النِّسَاءَ حُظُوظَهُنَّ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنُوكُمْ ‏"‏ فَقَالَ بِلاَلٌ وَاللَّهِ لَنَمْنَعُهُنَّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَقُولُ أَنْتَ لَنَمْنَعُهُنَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda almuqriiu, haddathanaa sa'iydun, - ya'niy abna aabiy aayyuwba - haddathanaa ka'bu bnu 'alqamaaa, 'an bilaali bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tamna'uwa alnnisaa'a huzuwzahunna mina almasaajidi iidhaa astaadhanuwkum ‏"‏ faqaala bilaalun waalllahi lanamna'uhunna ‏.‏ faqaala lahu 'abdu alllahi aaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wataquwlu aanta lanamna'uhunna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not deprive women of their share of the mosques, when they seek permission from you. Bilal said: By Allah, we would certainly prevent them. 'Abdullah said: I say that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said it and you say: We would certainly prevent them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ الثَّقَفِيَّةَ، كَانَتْ تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا شَهِدَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ الْعِشَاءَ فَلاَ تَطَيَّبْ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy makhramaau, 'an aabiyhi, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, aanna zaynaba althhaqafiyyaaa, kaanat tuhaddithu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa shahidat iihdaakunna al'ishaa'a falaa tatayyab tilka alllaylaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zainab Thaqafiya reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you (women) participates in the 'Isha' prayer, she should not perfume herself that night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، حَدَّثَنِي بُكَيْرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ، امْرَأَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَتْ قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا شَهِدَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلاَ تَمَسَّ طِيبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin alqattaanu, 'an muhammadi bni 'ajlaana, haddathaniy bukayru bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alaashajji, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, 'an zaynaba, amraaaai 'abdi alllahi qaalat qaala lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa shahidat iihdaakunna almasjida falaa tamassa tiybana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zainab, the wife of Abdullah (b. 'Umar), reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to us: When any one of you comes to the mosque, she should not apply perfume
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُصَيْفَةَ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ أَصَابَتْ بَخُورًا فَلاَ تَشْهَدْ مَعَنَا الْعِشَاءَ الآخِرَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy farwaaa, 'an yaziyda bni khusayfaaa, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aayyumaa amraaaain aasaabat bakhuwrana falaa tashhad ma'anaa al'ishaa'a alakhiraaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Whoever (woman) fumigates herself with perfume should not join us in the 'Isha' prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَقُولُ لَوْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى مَا أَحْدَثَ النِّسَاءُ لَمَنَعَهُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا مُنِعَتْ نِسَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لِعَمْرَةَ أَنِسَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مُنِعْنَ الْمَسْجِدَ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin - 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahaa sami'at 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm taquwlu law aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa maa aahdatha alnnisaa'u lamana'ahunna almasjida kamaa muni'at nisaa'u baniy iisraaiiyla ‏.‏ qaala faqultu li'amraaa aanisaa'u baniy iisraaiiyla muni'na almasjida qaalat na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amra, daughter of Abd al-Rahmin, reported:I heard 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). say: If the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had seen what new things the women have introduced (in their way of life) he would have definitely prevented them from going to the mosque, as the women of BaniIsra'il were prevented
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ يَعْنِي الثَّقَفِيَّ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi ya'niy althhaqafiyya, h qaala wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h qaala wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, h qaala wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kulluhum 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ جَمِيعًا عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ، - قَالَ ابْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، - أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَوَارٍ بِمَكَّةَ فَكَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى بِأَصْحَابِهِ رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ بِالْقُرْآنِ فَإِذَا سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ سَبُّوا الْقُرْآنَ وَمَنْ أَنْزَلَهُ وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِهِ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏ وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ‏}‏ فَيَسْمَعَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ قِرَاءَتَكَ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}‏ عَنْ أَصْحَابِكَ أَسْمِعْهُمُ الْقُرْآنَ وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ ذَلِكَ الْجَهْرَ وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ سَبِيلاً يَقُولُ بَيْنَ الْجَهْرِ وَالْمُخَافَتَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ja'farin, muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu jamiy'ana 'an hushaymin, - qaala abnu alssabbaahi haddathanaa hushaymun, - aakhbaranaa aabuw bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, fiy qawlihi 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ walaa tajhar bisalaatika walaa tukhaafit bihaa‏}‏ qaala nazalat warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mutawaarin bimakkaaa fakaana iidhaa sallaa biaashaabihi rafa'a sawtahu bialqurani faiidhaa sami'a dhalika almushrikuwna sabbuwa alqurana waman aanzalahu waman jaa'a bihi faqaala alllahu ta'aalaa linabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏ walaa tajhar bisalaatika‏}‏ fayasma'a almushrikuwna qiraa'ataka ‏{‏ walaa tukhaafit bihaa‏}‏ 'an aashaabika aasmi'humu alqurana walaa tajhar dhalika aljahra waabtaghi bayna dhalika sabiylaan yaquwlu bayna aljahri waalmukhaafataai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The word of (Allah) Great and Glorious: 'And utter not thy prayer loudly, nor be low in it" (xvii. 110) was revealed as the Messenger of Allah (may peace beupon him) was hiding himself in Mecca. When he led his Companions in prayer he raised his voice (while reciting the) Qur'an. And when the polytheists heard that, they reviled the Qur'an and Him Who revealed it and him who brought it. Upon this Allah, the Exalted, said to His Apostle (ﷺ): Utter not thy prayer so loudly that the polytheists may hear thy recitation and (recite it) not so low that it may be inaudible to your Companions. Make them hear the Qur'an, but do not recite it loudly and seek a (middle) way between these. Recite between loud and low tone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}‏ قَالَتْ أُنْزِلَ هَذَا فِي الدُّعَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu zakariyyaa'a, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, fiy qawlihi 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ walaa tajhar bisalaatika walaa tukhaafit bihaa‏}‏ qaalat aunzila hadhaa fiy alddu'aa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that so far as these words of (Allah) Glorious and High are concerned:" And utter not thy prayer loudly, not be low in it" (xvii. 110) relate to supplication (du'a)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hammaadun ya'niy abna zaydin, h qaala wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, wawakiy'un, h qaala wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, kulluhum 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ جِبْرِيلُ بِالْوَحْىِ كَانَ مِمَّا يُحَرِّكُ بِهِ لِسَانَهُ وَشَفَتَيْهِ فَيَشْتَدُّ عَلَيْهِ فَكَانَ ذَلِكَ يُعْرَفُ مِنْهُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ‏}‏ أَخْذَهُ ‏{‏ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ‏}‏ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا أَنْ نَجْمَعَهُ فِي صَدْرِكَ ‏.‏ وَقُرْآنَهُ فَتَقْرَأُهُ ‏{‏ فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ‏}‏ قَالَ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فَاسْتَمِعْ لَهُ ‏{‏ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ‏}‏ أَنْ نُبَيِّنَهُ بِلِسَانِكَ فَكَانَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ أَطْرَقَ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ قَرَأَهُ كَمَا وَعَدَهُ اللَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma kulluhum 'an jariyrin, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa jariyru bnu 'abdi alhamiydi, - 'an muwsaa bni aabiy 'aaiishaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, fiy qawlihi 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ laa tuharrik bihi lisaanaka‏}‏ qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa nazala 'alayhi jibriylu bialwahai kaana mimmaa yuharriku bihi lisaanahu washafatayhi fayashtaddu 'alayhi fakaana dhalika yu'rafu minhu faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏ laa tuharrik bihi lisaanaka lita'jala bihi‏}‏ aakhdhahu ‏{‏ iinna 'alaynaa jam'ahu waquranahu‏}‏ iinna 'alaynaa aan najma'ahu fiy sadrika ‏.‏ waquranahu fataqraauhu ‏{‏ faiidhaa qaraanaahu faattabi' quranahu‏}‏ qaala aanzalnaahu faastami' lahu ‏{‏ iinna 'alaynaa bayaanahu‏}‏ aan nubayyinahu bilisaanika fakaana iidhaa aataahu jibriylu aatraqa faiidhaa dhahaba qaraaahu kamaa wa'adahu alllahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported with regard to the words of Allah, Great and Glorious:" Move not thy tongue therewith" (Ixxv. 16) that when Gabriel brought revelation to him (the Holy Prophet) he moved his tongue and lips (with a view to committing it to memory instantly). This was something hard for him and it was visible (from his face). Then Allah, the Exalted. revealed this a" Move not thy tongue therewith to make haste (in memorising it). Surely on us rests the collecting of it and the reciting of it" (ixxv. 16), i. e. Verily it rests with Us that We would preserve it in your heart and (enable you) to recite it You would recite it when We would recite it and so follow its recitation, and He (Allah) said:" We revealed it, so listen to it attentively. Verily its exposition rests with Us. i. e. We would make it deliver by your tongue." So when Gabriel came to him (to the Holy Prophet), he kept silence, and when he went away he recited as Allah had promised him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَالِجُ مِنَ التَّنْزِيلِ شِدَّةً كَانَ يُحَرِّكُ شَفَتَيْهِ - فَقَالَ لِيَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَا أُحَرِّكُهُمَا كَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَرِّكُهُمَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَنَا أُحَرِّكُهُمَا كَمَا كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يُحَرِّكُهُمَا ‏.‏ فَحَرَّكَ شَفَتَيْهِ - فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ * إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ‏}‏ قَالَ جَمْعَهُ فِي صَدْرِكَ ثُمَّ تَقْرَأُهُ ‏{‏ فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ‏}‏ قَالَ فَاسْتَمِعْ وَأَنْصِتْ ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا أَنْ تَقْرَأَهُ قَالَ فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ اسْتَمَعَ فَإِذَا انْطَلَقَ جِبْرِيلُ قَرَأَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا أَقْرَأَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an muwsaa bni aabiy 'aaiishaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, fiy qawlihi ‏{‏ laa tuharrik bihi lisaanaka lita'jala bihi‏}‏ qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'aaliju mina alttanziyli shiddaaan kaana yuharriku shafatayhi - faqaala liya abnu 'abbaasin aanaa auharrikuhumaa kamaa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuharrikuhumaa ‏.‏ faqaala sa'iydun aanaa auharrikuhumaa kamaa kaana abnu 'abbaasin yuharrikuhumaa ‏.‏ faharraka shafatayhi - faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏ laa tuharrik bihi lisaanaka lita'jala bihi * iinna 'alaynaa jam'ahu waquranahu‏}‏ qaala jam'ahu fiy sadrika thumma taqraauhu ‏{‏ faiidhaa qaraanaahu faattabi' quranahu‏}‏ qaala faastami' waaansit thumma iinna 'alaynaa aan taqraaahu qaala fakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aataahu jibriylu astama'a faiidhaa antalaqa jibriylu qaraaahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm kamaa aaqraaahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported with regard to the words:" Do not move thy tongue there with to make haste," that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt it hard and he moved his lips. Ibn 'Abbas said to me (Sa'id b. Jubair): I move them just as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) moved them. Then said Sa'id: I move them just as Ibn 'Abbas moved them, and he moved his lips. Allah, the Exalted, revealed this:" Do not move your tongue therewith to make haste. It is with US that its collection rests and its recital" (al-Qur'an, ixxv. 16). He said: Its preservation in your heart and then your recital. So when We recite it, follow its recital. He said: Listen to it, and be silent and then it rests with Us that you recite it. So when Gabriel came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), he listened to him attentively, and when Gabriel went away, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited as he (Gabriel) had recited it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَا قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْجِنِّ وَمَا رَآهُمُ انْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَائِفَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ عَامِدِينَ إِلَى سُوقِ عُكَاظٍ وَقَدْ حِيلَ بَيْنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ وَأُرْسِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّهُبُ فَرَجَعَتِ الشَّيَاطِينُ إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَقَالُوا مَا لَكُمْ قَالُوا حِيلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ وَأُرْسِلَتْ عَلَيْنَا الشُّهُبُ ‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا ذَاكَ إِلاَّ مِنْ شَىْءٍ حَدَثَ فَاضْرِبُوا مَشَارِقَ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا فَانْظُرُوا مَا هَذَا الَّذِي حَالَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقُوا يَضْرِبُونَ مَشَارِقَ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا فَمَرَّ النَّفَرُ الَّذِينَ أَخَذُوا نَحْوَ تِهَامَةَ - وَهُوَ بِنَخْلٍ - عَامِدِينَ إِلَى سُوقِ عُكَاظٍ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي بِأَصْحَابِهِ صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ فَلَمَّا سَمِعُوا الْقُرْآنَ اسْتَمَعُوا لَهُ وَقَالُوا هَذَا الَّذِي حَالَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعُوا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَقَالُوا يَا قَوْمَنَا ‏{‏ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا * يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا‏}‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏ قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala maa qaraaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa aljinni wamaa raahumu antalaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy taaiifaain min aashaabihi 'aamidiyna iilaa suwqi 'ukaazin waqad hiyla bayna alshhayaatiyni wabayna khabari alssamaa'i waaursilat 'alayhimu alshhuhubu faraja'ati alshhayaatiynu iilaa qawmihim faqaaluwa maa lakum qaaluwa hiyla baynanaa wabayna khabari alssamaa'i waaursilat 'alaynaa alshhuhubu ‏.‏ qaaluwa maa dhaaka iilaaa min shaa'in hadatha faadribuwa mashaariqa alaardi wamaghaaribahaa faanzuruwa maa hadhaa alladhiy haala baynanaa wabayna khabari alssamaa'i ‏.‏ faantalaquwa yadribuwna mashaariqa alaardi wamaghaaribahaa famarra alnnafaru alladhiyna aakhadhuwa nahwa tihaamaaa - wahuwa binakhlin - 'aamidiyna iilaa suwqi 'ukaazin wahuwa yusalliy biaashaabihi salaaaa alfajri falammaa sami'uwa alqurana astama'uwa lahu waqaaluwa hadhaa alladhiy haala baynanaa wabayna khabari alssamaa'i ‏.‏ faraja'uwa iilaa qawmihim faqaaluwa yaa qawmanaa ‏{‏ iinnaa sami'naa quranana 'ajabana * yahdiy iilaa alrrushdi faamannaa bihi walan nushrika birabbinaa aahadana‏}‏ faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla 'alaa nabiyyihi muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏ qul auwhiya iilaaaa aannahu astama'a nafarun mina aljinni‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) neither recited the Qur'an to the Jinn nor did he see them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out with some of his Companions with the intention of going to the bazaar of 'Ukaz And there had been (at that time) obstructions between satans and the news from the Heaven, and there were flung flames upon them. So satan went back to their people and they said: What has happened to you? They said: There have been created obstructions between us and the news from the Heaven. And there have been flung upon us flames. They said: It cannot happen but for some (important) event. So traverse the eastern parts of the earth and the western parts and find out why is it that there have been created obstructions between us and the news from the Heaven. So they went forth and traversed the easts of the earth and its wests. Some of them proceeded towards Tihama and that is a nakhl towards the bazaar of 'Ukaz and he (the Holy Prophet) was leading his Companions in the morning prayer. So when they heard the Qur'an. they listened to it attentively and said: It is this which has caused obstruction between us and news from the Heaven. They went back to their people and said: O our people, we have heard a strange Qur'an which directs us to the right path; so we affirm our faith in it and we would never associate anyone with our Lord. And Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed to His Apostle Muhammad (ﷺ):" It has been revealed to me that a party of Jinn listened to it" (Qur'an, lxxii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَلْقَمَةَ هَلْ كَانَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ شَهِدَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةَ الْجِنِّ قَالَ فَقَالَ عَلْقَمَةُ أَنَا سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَقُلْتُ هَلْ شَهِدَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةَ الْجِنِّ قَالَ لاَ وَلَكِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَفَقَدْنَاهُ فَالْتَمَسْنَاهُ فِي الأَوْدِيَةِ وَالشِّعَابِ فَقُلْنَا اسْتُطِيرَ أَوِ اغْتِيلَ - قَالَ - فَبِتْنَا بِشَرِّ لَيْلَةٍ بَاتَ بِهَا قَوْمٌ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحْنَا إِذَا هُوَ جَاءٍ مِنْ قِبَلِ حِرَاءٍ - قَالَ - فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْنَاكَ فَطَلَبْنَاكَ فَلَمْ نَجِدْكَ فَبِتْنَا بِشَرِّ لَيْلَةٍ بَاتَ بِهَا قَوْمٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَانِي دَاعِي الْجِنِّ فَذَهَبْتُ مَعَهُ فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ بِنَا فَأَرَانَا آثَارَهُمْ وَآثَارَ نِيرَانِهِمْ وَسَأَلُوهُ الزَّادَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَكُمْ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ ذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ يَقَعُ فِي أَيْدِيكُمْ أَوْفَرَ مَا يَكُونُ لَحْمًا وَكُلُّ بَعَرَةٍ عَلَفٌ لِدَوَابِّكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَلاَ تَسْتَنْجُوا بِهِمَا فَإِنَّهُمَا طَعَامُ إِخْوَانِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an daawuda, 'an 'aamirin, qaala saaaltu 'alqamaaa hal kaana abnu mas'uwdin shahida ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laylaaa aljinni qaala faqaala 'alqamaau aanaa saaaltu abna mas'uwdin faqultu hal shahida aahadun minkum ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laylaaa aljinni qaala laa walakinnaa kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata laylaain fafaqadnaahu faaltamasnaahu fiy alaawdiyaai waalshhi'aabi faqulnaa astutiyra aawi aghtiyla - qaala - fabitnaa bisharri laylaain baata bihaa qawmun falammaa aasbahnaa iidhaa huwa jaa'in min qibali hiraa'in - qaala - faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi faqadnaaka fatalabnaaka falam najidka fabitnaa bisharri laylaain baata bihaa qawmun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aataaniy daa'iy aljinni fadhahabtu ma'ahu faqaraatu 'alayhimu alqurana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faantalaqa binaa faaaraanaa athaarahum waathaara niyraanihim wasaaaluwhu alzzaada faqaala ‏"‏ lakum kullu 'azmin dhukira asmu alllahi 'alayhi yaqa'u fiy aaydiykum aawfara maa yakuwnu lahmana wakullu ba'araain 'alafun lidawaabbikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ falaa tastanjuwa bihimaa faiinnahumaa ta'aamu iikhwaanikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Dawud reported from 'Amir who said:I asked 'Alqama if Ibn Mas'ud was present with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the night of the Jinn (the night when the Prophet met them). He (Ibn Mas'uad) said: No, but we were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) one night and we missed him. We searched for him in the valleys and the hills and said. He has either been taken away (by jinn) or has been secretly killed. He (the narrator) said. We spent the worst night which people could ever spend. When it was dawn we saw him coming from the side of Hiri'. He (the narrator) reported. We said: Messenger of Allah, we missed you and searched for you, but we could not find you and we spent the worst night which people could ever spend. He (the Holy Prophet) said: There came to me an inviter on behalf of the Jinn and I went along with him and recited to them the Qur'an. He (the narrator) said: He then went along with us and showed us their traces and traces of their embers. They (the Jinn) asked him (the Holy Prophet) about their provision and he said: Every bone on which the name of Allah is recited is your provision. The time it will fall in your hand it would be covered with flesh, and the dung of (the camels) is fodder for your animals. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Don't perform istinja with these (things) for these are the food of your brothers (Jinn)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ وَآثَارَ نِيرَانِهِمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ وَسَأَلُوهُ الزَّادَ وَكَانُوا مِنْ جِنِّ الْجَزِيرَةِ ‏.‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ مِنْ قَوْلِ الشَّعْبِيِّ مُفَصَّلاً مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an daawuda, bihadhaa aliisnaadi iilaa qawlihi waathaara niyraanihim ‏.‏ qaala alshha'biyyu wasaaaluwhu alzzaada wakaanuwa min jinni aljaziyraai ‏.‏ iilaa akhiri alhadiythi min qawli alshha'biyyi mufassalaan min hadiythi 'abdi alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported by Dawud with the same chain of transmitters up to the word (s):" The traces of their embers." Sha'bi said: They (the Jinn) asked about their provision, and they were the Jinn of al-jazira, up to the end of the hadith, and the words of Sha'bi have been directly transmitted from the hadith of Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى قَوْلِهِ وَآثَارَ نِيرَانِهِمْ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'an daawuda, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa qawlihi waathaara niyraanihim ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah from the Apostle (ﷺ) up to the words:" The traces of the embers," but he made no mention of what followed afterward
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَمْ أَكُنْ لَيْلَةَ الْجِنِّ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَوَدِدْتُ أَنِّي كُنْتُ مَعَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an khaalidin, 'an aabiy ma'sharin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala lam aakun laylaaa aljinni ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wawadidtu aanniy kuntu ma'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) said:I was not with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but I wish I were with him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْجَرْمِيُّ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ مَعْنٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، سَأَلْتُ مَسْرُوقًا مَنْ آذَنَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْجِنِّ لَيْلَةَ اسْتَمَعُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُوكَ - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ - أَنَّهُ آذَنَتْهُ بِهِمْ شَجَرَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu muhammadin aljarmiyyu, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an mis'arin, 'an ma'nin, qaala sami'tu aabiy qaala, saaaltu masruwqana man adhana alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm bialjinni laylaaa astama'uwa alqurana faqaala haddathaniy aabuwka - ya'niy abna mas'uwdin - aannahu adhanathu bihim shajaraaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ma'n reported.. I heard it from my father who said:I asked Masruq who informed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the night when they heard the Qur'an. He said: Your father, Ibn Mas'ud, narrated it to me that a tree informed him about that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، - يَعْنِي الصَّوَّافَ - عَنْ يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي بِنَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَسُورَتَيْنِ وَيُسْمِعُنَا الآيَةَ أَحْيَانًا وَكَانَ يُطَوِّلُ الرَّكْعَةَ الأُولَى مِنَ الظُّهْرِ وَيُقَصِّرُ الثَّانِيَةَ وَكَذَلِكَ فِي الصُّبْحِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani alhajjaaji, - ya'niy alssawwaafa - 'an yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu aabiy kathiyrin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, waaabiy, salamaaa 'an aabiy qataadaaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy binaa fayaqraau fiy alzzuhri waal'asri fiy alrrak'atayni alauwlayayni bifaatihaai alkitaabi wasuwratayni wayusmi'unaa alayaaa aahyaanana wakaana yutawwilu alrrak'aaa alauwlaa mina alzzuhri wayuqassiru althhaaniyaaa wakadhalika fiy alssubhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in prayer and recited in the first two rak'ahs of the noon and afternoon prayers Surat al-Fitiha and two (other) surahs. And he would sometimes recite loud enough for us the verses. He would prolong the first rak'ah more than the second. And he acted similarly in the morning prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
