verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ، وَأَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَسُورَةٍ وَيُسْمِعُنَا الآيَةَ أَحْيَانًا وَيَقْرَأُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُخْرَيَيْنِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hammaamun, waaabaanu bnu yaziyda, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy alrrak'atayni alauwlayayni mina alzzuhri waal'asri bifaatihaai alkitaabi wasuwraain wayusmi'unaa alayaaa aahyaanana wayaqraau fiy alrrak'atayni alaukhrayayni bifaatihaai alkitaabi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada reported it on the authority of his father:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would recite in the first two rak'ahs of the noon and afternoon prayers the opening chapter of the Book and another surah. He would sometimes recite loud enough to make audible to us the verse and would recite in the last two rak'ahs Surat al-Faitiha (only)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، - عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَحْزِرُ قِيَامَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ فَحَزَرْنَا قِيَامَهُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ قَدْرَ قِرَاءَةِ الم تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةِ وَحَزَرْنَا قِيَامَهُ فِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ قَدْرَ النِّصْفِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَحَزَرْنَا قِيَامَهُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَصْرِ عَلَى قَدْرِ قِيَامِهِ فِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ وَفِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَصْرِ عَلَى النِّصْفِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ الم تَنْزِيلُ وَقَالَ قَدْرَ ثَلاَثِينَ آيَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa jamiy'ana 'an hushaymin, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa hushaymun, - 'an mansuwrin, 'ani alwaliydi bni muslimin, 'an aabiy alssiddiyqi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala kunnaa nahziru qiyaama rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alzzuhri waal'asri fahazarnaa qiyaamahu fiy alrrak'atayni alauwlayayni mina alzzuhri qadra qiraa'aai alm tanziylu alssajdaai wahazarnaa qiyaamahu fiy alaukhrayayni qadra alnnisfi min dhalika wahazarnaa qiyaamahu fiy alrrak'atayni alauwlayayni mina al'asri 'alaa qadri qiyaamihi fiy alaukhrayayni mina alzzuhri wafiy alaukhrayayni mina al'asri 'alaa alnnisfi min dhalika ‏.‏ walam yadhkur aabuw bakrin fiy riwaayatihi alm tanziylu waqaala qadra thalaathiyna ayaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:We used to estimate how long Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood in the noon and afternoon prayers, and we estimated hat he stood in the first two rak'ahs of the noon prayer as long as it takes to recite Alif Lam Mim, Tanzil, i. e. as-Sajda. We estimated that he stood half that time in the last two rak'ahs; that he stood in the first two of the afternoon as long as he did in the last two at noon; and in the last two of the afternoon prayer about half that time. Abu Bakr in his narration has made no mention of Alif Lam Mim, Tanzil, but said: As long as it takes to recite thirty verses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ النَّاجِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي صَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ قَدْرَ ثَلاَثِينَ آيَةً وَفِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ قَدْرَ خَمْسَ عَشَرَةَ آيَةً أَوْ قَالَ نِصْفَ ذَلِكَ وَفِي الْعَصْرِ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ قَدْرَ قِرَاءَةِ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ آيَةً وَفِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ قَدْرَ نِصْفِ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an mansuwrin, 'ani alwaliydi aabiy bishrin, 'an aabiy alssiddiyqi alnnaajiyyi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy salaaai alzzuhri fiy alrrak'atayni alauwlayayni fiy kulli rak'aain qadra thalaathiyna ayaaan wafiy alaukhrayayni qadra khamsa 'asharaaa ayaaan aaw qaala nisfa dhalika wafiy al'asri fiy alrrak'atayni alauwlayayni fiy kulli rak'aain qadra qiraa'aai khamsa 'ashraaa ayaaan wafiy alaukhrayayni qadra nisfi dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in every rak'ah of the first two rak'ahs of the noon prayer about thirty verses and in the last two about fifteen verses or half (of the first rak'ah) and in every rak'ah of the 'Asr prayer of the first two rak'ahs about fifteen verses and in the last two verses half (of the first ones)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْكُوفَةِ، شَكَوْا سَعْدًا إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَذَكَرُوا مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ عُمَرُ فَقَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ مَا عَابُوهُ بِهِ مِنْ أَمْرِ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي لأُصَلِّي بِهِمْ صَلاَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أَخْرِمُ عَنْهَا إِنِّي لأَرْكُدُ بِهِمْ فِي الأُولَيَيْنِ وَأَحْذِفُ فِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ذَاكَ الظَّنُّ بِكَ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, aanna aahla alkuwfaai, shakawa sa'dana iilaa 'umara bni alkhattaabi fadhakaruwa min salaatihi faaarsala iilayhi 'umaru faqadima 'alayhi fadhakara lahu maa 'aabuwhu bihi min aamri alssalaaai faqaala iinniy lausalliy bihim salaaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa aakhrimu 'anhaa iinniy laarkudu bihim fiy alauwlayayni waaahdhifu fiy alaukhrayayni ‏.‏ faqaala dhaaka alzzannu bika aabaa iishaaqa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:The people of Kufa complained to Umar b. Khattab about Sa'd and they made a mention of his prayer. 'Umar sent for him. He came to him. He ('Umar) told him that the people had found fault with his prayer. He said: I lead them in prayer in accorance with the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I make no decrease in it. I make them stand for a longer time in the first two (rak'ahs) and shorten it in the last two. Upon this 'Umar remarked: This is what I deemed of thee, O Abu Ishaq
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an jariyrin, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith his been narrated by 'Abu al-Malik with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ عُمَرُ لِسَعْدٍ قَدْ شَكَوْكَ فِي كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّى فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمَّا أَنَا فَأَمُدُّ فِي الأُولَيَيْنِ وَأَحْذِفُ فِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ وَمَا آلُو مَا اقْتَدَيْتُ بِهِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ذَاكَ الظَّنُّ بِكَ ‏.‏ أَوْ ذَاكَ ظَنِّي بِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy 'awnin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna samuraaa, qaala 'umaru lisa'din qad shakawka fiy kulli shaa'in hattaa fiy alssalaaai ‏.‏ qaala aammaa aanaa faaamuddu fiy alauwlayayni waaahdhifu fiy alaukhrayayni wamaa aluw maa aqtadaytu bihi min salaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala dhaaka alzzannu bika ‏.‏ aaw dhaaka zanniy bika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:'Umar said to Sa'd: They complain against you in every matter, even in prayer. He (Sa'd) said: I prolong (standing) in the first two (rak'ahs) and shorten it in the last two, and I make no negligence in following the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He ('Umar) remarked: This is what is expected of you, or, that is what I deemed of you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، وَأَبِي، عَوْنٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِمْ وَزَادَ فَقَالَ تُعَلِّمُنِي الأَعْرَابُ بِالصَّلاَةِ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu bishrin, 'an mis'arin, 'an 'abdi almaliki, waaabiy, 'awnin 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, bima'naa hadiythihim wazaada faqaala tu'allimuniy alaa'raabu bialssalaaai
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Jabir b. Samura but with the addition of these words:" (Sa'd said): These bedouins presume to teach me prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُسْلِمٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ - عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ قَزْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ لَقَدْ كَانَتْ صَلاَةُ الظُّهْرِ تُقَامُ فَيَذْهَبُ الذَّاهِبُ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ فَيَقْضِي حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى مِمَّا يُطَوِّلُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa daawudu bnu rushaydin, haddathanaa alwaliydu, - ya'niy abna muslimin - 'an sa'iydin, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi al'aziyzi - 'an 'atiyyaaa bni qaysin, 'an qaz'aaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala laqad kaanat salaaau alzzuhri tuqaamu fayadhhabu aldhhaahibu iilaa albaqiy'i fayaqdiy haajatahu thumma yatawaddaau thumma yaatiy warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alrrak'aai alauwlaa mimmaa yutawwiluhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The noon prayer would start and one would go to al-Baqi' and after having relieved himself he would perform ablution and then come, while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would be in the first rak'ah, because he would prolong it so much
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي قَزْعَةُ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ وَهُوَ مَكْثُورٌ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا تَفَرَّقَ النَّاسُ عَنْهُ قُلْتُ إِنِّي لاَ أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَّا يَسْأَلُكَ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْهُ - قُلْتُ - أَسْأَلُكَ عَنْ صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَا لَكَ فِي ذَاكَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ ‏.‏ فَأَعَادَهَا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ كَانَتْ صَلاَةُ الظُّهْرِ تُقَامُ فَيَنْطَلِقُ أَحَدُنَا إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ فَيَقْضِي حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي أَهْلَهُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni saalihin, 'an rabiy'aaa, qaala haddathaniy qaz'aau, qaala aataytu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya wahuwa makthuwrun 'alayhi falammaa tafarraqa alnnaasu 'anhu qultu iinniy laa aasaaluka 'ammaa yasaaluka hauulaa'i 'anhu - qultu - aasaaluka 'an salaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala maa laka fiy dhaaka min khayrin ‏.‏ faaa'aadahaa 'alayhi faqaala kaanat salaaau alzzuhri tuqaamu fayantaliqu aahadunaa iilaa albaqiy'i fayaqdiy haajatahu thumma yaatiy aahlahu fayatawaddaau thumma yarji'u iilaa almasjidi warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alrrak'aai alauwlaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qaz'a reported:I came to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and he was surrounded by people. When the people departed from him I said: I am not going to ask you what these people have been asking you. I want to ask you about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (Abu Sa'id) said: There is no good for you in this. He (Qaz'a), however, repeated (his demand). He then said: The noon prayer would start and one of us would go to Baqi' and, having relieved himself, would come to his home, then perform ablution and go to the mosque, and (he would find) The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the first rak'ah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ الْعَابِدِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، قَالَ صَلَّى لَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصُّبْحَ بِمَكَّةَ فَاسْتَفْتَحَ سُورَةَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَتَّى جَاءَ ذِكْرُ مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ أَوْ ذِكْرُ عِيسَى - مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ يَشُكُّ أَوِ اخْتَلَفُوا عَلَيْهِ - أَخَذَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَعْلَةٌ فَرَكَعَ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ السَّائِبِ حَاضِرٌ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ فَحَذَفَ فَرَكَعَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلِ ابْنِ الْعَاصِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, 'ani abni jurayjin, h qaala wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, - wataqaarabaa fiy alllafzi - haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala sami'tu muhammada bna 'abbaadi bni ja'farin, yaquwlu aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu sufyaana, wa'abdu alllahi bnu 'amriw bni al'aasi, wa'abdu alllahi bnu almusayyabi al'aabidiyyu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaaiibi, qaala sallaa lanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alssubha bimakkaaa faastaftaha suwraaa almuuminiyna hattaa jaa'a dhikru muwsaa wahaaruwna aaw dhikru 'iysaa - muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin yashukku aawi akhtalafuwa 'alayhi - aakhadhati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sa'laaun faraka'a wa'abdu alllahi bnu alssaaiibi haadirun dhalika ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alrrazzaaqi fahadhafa faraka'a ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihi wa'abdu alllahi bnu 'amrinw ‏.‏ walam yaquli abni al'aasi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Sa'id reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) led us in the morning prayer in Mecca and began Sarat al-Mu'minin (xxiii ) but when he came to the mention of Moses and Aaron (verse. 45) or to the mention of Jesus (verse 50), a cough got the better of him, and he bowed. 'Abdullah b. Sa'ib was present there, and in the hadith narrated by Abd al-Razzaq (the words are): He cut short (the recitation) and bowed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ سَرِيعٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْفَجْرِ ‏{‏ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, h qaala wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy aabuw kuraybin, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa abnu bishrin, 'an mis'arin, qaala haddathaniy alwaliydu bnu sariy'in, 'an 'amriw bni huraythin, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alfajri ‏{‏ waalllayli iidhaa 'as'asa‏}‏
verses.translation: Amr b. Huwairith reported:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recite in the morning prayer" Wa'l-lail-i-idhd 'As'asa" (ixxxi)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلاَقَةَ، عَنْ قُطْبَةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ وَصَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏ ق وَالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيدِ‏}‏ حَتَّى قَرَأَ ‏{‏ وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ‏}‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلْتُ أُرَدِّدُهَا وَلاَ أَدْرِي مَا قَالَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, fudaylu bnu husaynin haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an ziyaadi bni 'ilaaqaaa, 'an qutbaaa bni maalikin, qaala sallaytu wasallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaraaa ‏{‏ q waalqurani almajiydi‏}‏ hattaa qaraaa ‏{‏ waalnnakhla baasiqaatin‏}‏ qaala faja'altu auraddiduhaa walaa aadriy maa qaala ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qutba b. Malik reported:I said prayer and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led it and he recited" Qaf. (I.). By the Glorious Qur'an," till he recited" and the tall palm trees" (l. 10). I wanted to repeat it but I could not follow its significance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، وَابْنُ، عُيَيْنَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلاَقَةَ، عَنْ قُطْبَةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْفَجْرِ ‏{‏ وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa shariykun, waabnu, 'uyaynaaa h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an ziyaadi bni 'ilaaqaaa, 'an qutbaaa bni maalikin, sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alfajri ‏{‏ waalnnakhla baasiqaatin lahaa tal'un nadiydun‏}‏
verses.translation: Qutba b. Malik reported that he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting in the morning prayer this:" And the tall palm trees having flower spikes piled one above another" (Al-Qur'an 50:)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلاَقَةَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصُّبْحَ فَقَرَأَ فِي أَوَّلِ رَكْعَةٍ ‏{‏ وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ‏}‏ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ ‏{‏ ق‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an ziyaadi bni 'ilaaqaaa, 'an 'ammihi, aannahu sallaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alssubha faqaraaa fiy aawwali rak'aain ‏{‏ waalnnakhla baasiqaatin lahaa tal'un nadiydun‏}‏ warubbamaa qaala ‏{‏ q‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ziyad b. 'Ilaqa reported it on the authority of his uncle that he said the morning prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he recited in the first rak'ah:"And the tall palm trees having flower spikes piled one above another (l. 10) or perhaps Surah Qaf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سِمَاكُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الْفَجْرِ بِـ ‏{‏ ق وَالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيدِ‏}‏ وَكَانَ صَلاَتُهُ بَعْدُ تَخْفِيفًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaaiidaaa, haddathanaa simaaku bnu harbin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy alfajri bi ‏{‏ q waalqurani almajiydi‏}‏ wakaana salaatuhu ba'du takhfiyfana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the morning prayer" Qaf. By the Glorious Quran." and his prayer afterward shortened
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ عَنْ صَلاَةِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ كَانَ يُخَفِّفُ الصَّلاَةَ وَلاَ يُصَلِّي صَلاَةَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَنْبَأَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الْفَجْرِ بـ ‏{‏ ق وَالْقُرْآنِ‏}‏ وَنَحْوِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an simaakin, qaala saaaltu jaabira bna samuraaa 'an salaaai alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala kaana yukhaffifu alssalaaaa walaa yusalliy salaaaa hauulaa'i ‏.‏ qaala waaanbaaaniy aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy alfajri b ‏{‏ q waalqurani‏}‏ wanahwihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Simak asked Jabir b. Samura about the prayer of the Apostle (ﷺ). He said:He (the Holy Prophet) shortened the prayer and he did not pray like these people then, and he informed me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite" Qaf. By the (Glorious) Qur'an," and a passage of similar length
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ بِـ ‏{‏ اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى‏}‏ وَفِي الْعَصْرِ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ وَفِي الصُّبْحِ أَطْوَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaakin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alzzuhri bi ‏{‏ alllayli iidhaa yaghshaa‏}‏ wafiy al'asri nahwa dhalika wafiy alssubhi aatwala min dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the noon prayer:" By the night when it envelopes" (xcii.), and in the afternoon like this, but he prolonged the morning prayer as compared to that (noon and afternoon prayers)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ بِـ ‏{‏ سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعْلَى‏}‏ وَفِي الصُّبْحِ بِأَطْوَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda alttayaalisiyyu, 'an shu'baaa, 'an simaakin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, ‏.‏ aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy alzzuhri bi ‏{‏ sabbihi asma rabbika alaa'laa‏}‏ wafiy alssubhi biaatwala min dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the noon prayer:" Glorify the name of thy Most High Lord in the morning prayer longer than this" (lxxxvii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي صَلاَةِ الْغَدَاةِ مِنَ السِّتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِائَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, 'ani alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy alminhaali, 'an aabiy barzaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy salaaai alghadaaai mina alssittiyna iilaa almiaiaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Barza reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the morning prayer from sixty to one hundred verses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْفَجْرِ مَا بَيْنَ السِّتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِائَةِ آيَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an aabiy alminhaali, 'an aabiy barzaaa alaaslamiyyi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alfajri maa bayna alssittiyna iilaa almiaiaai ayaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Barza Aslami reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite from sixty to one hundred verses in the morning prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ إِنَّ أُمَّ الْفَضْلِ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ سَمِعَتْهُ وَهُوَ، يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏ وَالْمُرْسَلاَتِ عُرْفًا‏}‏ فَقَالَتْ يَا بُنَىَّ لَقَدْ ذَكَّرْتَنِي بِقِرَاءَتِكَ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ إِنَّهَا لآخِرُ مَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ بِهَا فِي الْمَغْرِبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala iinna aumma alfadli binta alhaarithi sami'athu wahuwa, yaqraau ‏{‏ waalmursalaati 'urfana‏}‏ faqaalat yaa bunaaaa laqad dhakkartaniy biqiraa'atika hadhihi alssuwraaa iinnahaa lakhiru maa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau bihaa fiy almaghribi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:Umm al-Fadl daughter of al-Harith heard him reciting:" By those sent forth to spread goodness" (lxxvii.). (Upon this) she remarked: O my son, you reminded me by the recitation of this surah (the fact) that it was the last surah that I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he recited it in the evening prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ صَالِحٍ ثُمَّ مَا صَلَّى بَعْدُ حَتَّى قَبَضَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, h qaala wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h qaala wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h qaala wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wazaada fiy hadiythi saalihin thumma maa sallaa ba'du hattaa qabadahu alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition:" And he did not lead the player after this till his death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ بِالطُّورِ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an muhammadi bni jubayri bni mut'imin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau bialttuwri fiy almaghribi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jubair b. Mut'im reported:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting Surat al-Tur (Mountain) (lii) in the evening prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, h qaala wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h qaala wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَصَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ الآخِرَةَ فَقَرَأَ فِي إِحْدَى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ‏{‏ وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyin, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana fiy safarin fasallaa al'ishaa'a alakhiraaa faqaraaa fiy iihdaa alrrak'atayni ‏{‏ waalttiyni waalzzaytuwni‏}‏
verses.translation: Adi reported:I heard al-Bara' narrating it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that while in a journey he said the night prayer and recited in one of the two rak'ahs:" By the Fig and the Olive" (Su'rah xcv)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِشَاءَ فَقَرَأَ بِالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin - 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, aannahu qaala sallaytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'ishaa'a faqaraaa bialttiyni waalzzaytuwni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that he said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he recited:" By the Fig and the Olive
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَرَأَ فِي الْعِشَاءِ بِالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ ‏.‏ فَمَا سَمِعْتُ أَحَدًا أَحْسَنَ صَوْتًا مِنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa mis'arun, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaraaa fiy al'ishaa'i bialttiyni waalzzaytuwni ‏.‏ famaa sami'tu aahadana aahsana sawtana minhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting in the night prayer:" By the Fig and the Olive," and I have never heard anyone with a sweeter voice than he
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ مُعَاذٌ يُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ يَأْتِي فَيَؤُمُّ قَوْمَهُ فَصَلَّى لَيْلَةً مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ أَتَى قَوْمَهُ فَأَمَّهُمْ فَافْتَتَحَ بِسُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فَانْحَرَفَ رَجُلٌ فَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَحْدَهُ وَانْصَرَفَ فَقَالُوا لَهُ أَنَافَقْتَ يَا فُلاَنُ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ وَلآتِيَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلأُخْبِرَنَّهُ ‏.‏ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا أَصْحَابُ نَوَاضِحَ نَعْمَلُ بِالنَّهَارِ وَإِنَّ مُعَاذًا صَلَّى مَعَكَ الْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ أَتَى فَافْتَتَحَ بِسُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مُعَاذٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ أَفَتَّانٌ أَنْتَ اقْرَأْ بِكَذَا وَاقْرَأْ بِكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَقُلْتُ لِعَمْرٍو إِنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ جَابِرٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا ‏.‏ وَالضُّحَى ‏.‏ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى ‏.‏ وَسَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَمْرٌو نَحْوَ هَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabirin, qaala kaana mu'aadhun yusalliy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma yaatiy fayauummu qawmahu fasallaa laylaaan ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'ishaa'a thumma aataa qawmahu faaammahum faaftataha bisuwraai albaqaraai faanharafa rajulun fasallama thumma sallaa wahdahu waansarafa faqaaluwa lahu aanaafaqta yaa fulaanu qaala laa waalllahi walatiyanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaukhbirannahu ‏.‏ faaataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa aashaabu nawaadiha na'malu bialnnahaari waiinna mu'aadhana sallaa ma'aka al'ishaa'a thumma aataa faaftataha bisuwraai albaqaraai ‏.‏ faaaqbala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa mu'aadhin faqaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu aafattaanun aanta aqraa bikadhaa waaqraa bikadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu faqultu li'amrinw iinna aabaa alzzubayri haddathanaa 'an jaabirin aannahu qaala ‏"‏ aqraa waalshhamsi waduhaahaa ‏.‏ waaldduhaa ‏.‏ waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa ‏.‏ wasabbihi asma rabbika alaa'laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'amrunw nahwa hadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Mu'adh b. Jabal used to pray with the Apostle (ﷺ), then came and led his people in prayer. One night he said the night prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He then came to his people and led them in prayer beginning with Surat al-Baqara. A man turned aside, pronounced the taslim (salutation for concluding the prayer), then prayed alone and departed. The people said to him:Have you become a hypocrite, so and so? He said: I swear by Allah that I have not, but I will certainly go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and will inform (him) about this. He then came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, we look after camels used for watering and work by day. Mu'adh said the night prayer with you. He then came and began with Surat al-Baqara. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then turned to Mu'adh and said: Are you there to (put the people) to trial? Recite such and recite such (and such a surah). It is transmitted on the authority of Jabir, as told by Sufyan, that he (the Holy Prophet) had said: "By the sun and its morning brightness" (Surah xci), "By brightness" (Surah xciii), "By the night when it spreads" (Surah xcii), and "Glorify the name of thy most high Lord" (Surah lxxxii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ صَلَّى مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ لأَصْحَابِهِ الْعِشَاءَ فَطَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَانْصَرَفَ رَجُلٌ مِنَّا فَصَلَّى فَأُخْبِرَ مُعَاذٌ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ مُنَافِقٌ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلَ دَخَلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ مَا قَالَ مُعَاذٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَتُرِيدُ أَنْ تَكُونَ فَتَّانًا يَا مُعَاذُ إِذَا أَمَمْتَ النَّاسَ فَاقْرَأْ بِالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا ‏.‏ وَسَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعْلَى ‏.‏ وَاقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ ‏.‏ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h qaala wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aannahu qaala sallaa mu'aadhu bnu jabalin alaansaariyyu laashaabihi al'ishaa'a fatawwala 'alayhim faansarafa rajulun minnaa fasallaa faaukhbira mu'aadhun 'anhu faqaala iinnahu munaafiqun ‏.‏ falammaa balagha dhalika alrrajula dakhala 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu maa qaala mu'aadhun faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aaturiydu aan takuwna fattaanana yaa mu'aadhu iidhaa aamamta alnnaasa faaqraa bialshhamsi waduhaahaa ‏.‏ wasabbihi asma rabbika alaa'laa ‏.‏ waaqraa biasmi rabbika ‏.‏ waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:'Mu'adh b. Jabal al-Ansari led his companions in the night prayer and prolonged it for them. A person amongst us said prayer (after having separated himself from the congregation). Mu'adh was informed of this, and he remarked that he was a hypocrite. When it (the remark) was conveyed to the man, he went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and informed him of what Mu'adh had said. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Mu'adh, do you want to become a person putting (people) to trial? When you lead people in prayer, recite:" By the Sun and its morning brightness" (Surat ash-Shams)," Glorify the name of thy most high Lord" (Surat al-A`la) and" Read in the name of Lord" (Surat al-`Alaq), and" By the night when it spreads" (Surat al-Lail)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ، كَانَ يُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِشَاءَ الآخِرَةَ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ تِلْكَ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna mu'aadha bna jabalin, kaana yusalliy ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'ishaa'a alakhiraaa thumma yarji'u iilaa qawmihi fayusalliy bihim tilka alssalaaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:Mu'adh b. Jabal said the night prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and then returned to his people and then led them in this prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، قَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ مُعَاذٌ يُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مَسْجِدَ قَوْمِهِ فَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, qaala aabuw alrrabiy'i haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kaana mu'aadhun yusalliy ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'ishaa'a thumma yaatiy masjida qawmihi fayusalliy bihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:Mu'adh said the night prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He then came to the mosque of his people and led them in prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي لأَتَأَخَّرُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ مِنْ أَجْلِ فُلاَنٍ مِمَّا يُطِيلُ بِنَا ‏.‏ فَمَا رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَضِبَ فِي مَوْعِظَةٍ قَطُّ أَشَدَّ مِمَّا غَضِبَ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ مِنْكُمْ مُنَفِّرِينَ فَأَيُّكُمْ أَمَّ النَّاسَ فَلْيُوجِزْ فَإِنَّ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ الْكَبِيرَ وَالضَّعِيفَ وَذَا الْحَاجَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an qaysin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin alaansaariyyi, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinniy laataaakhharu 'an salaaai alssubhi min aajli fulaanin mimmaa yutiylu binaa ‏.‏ famaa raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ghadiba fiy maw'izaain qattu aashadda mimmaa ghadiba yawmaiidhin faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu iinna minkum munaffiriyna faaayyukum aamma alnnaasa falyuwjiz faiinna min waraaiihi alkabiyra waaldda'iyfa wadhaa alhaajaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mas'ud al-Ainsari reported:A person came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: I keep away from the morning prayer on account of such and such (a man), because; he keeps us so long. I never saw God's Messenger (ﷺ) more angry when giving an exhortation than he was that day. He said: 0 people, some of you are scaring people away. So whoever of you leads the people in prayer he must be brief, for behind him are the weak, the aged, and the people who have (argent) business to attend
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، وَوَكِيعٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ هُشَيْمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hushaymun, wawakiy'un, h qaala wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kulluhum 'an iismaa'iyla, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bimithli hadiythi hushaymin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith like one narrated by Hashalm has been narrated from Isma'il with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيُّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَمَّ أَحَدُكُمُ النَّاسَ فَلْيُخَفِّفْ فَإِنَّ فِيهِمُ الصَّغِيرَ وَالْكَبِيرَ وَالضَّعِيفَ وَالْمَرِيضَ فَإِذَا صَلَّى وَحْدَهُ فَلْيُصَلِّ كَيْفَ شَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani alhizaamiyyu - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aamma aahadukumu alnnaasa falyukhaffif faiinna fiyhimu alssaghiyra waalkabiyra waaldda'iyfa waalmariyda faiidhaa sallaa wahdahu falyusalli kayfa shaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you leads the people in prayer, he should be brief for among them are the young and the aged, the weak and the sick. But when one of you prays by himself, he may (prolong) as he likes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا مَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ لِلنَّاسِ فَلْيُخَفِّفِ الصَّلاَةَ فَإِنَّ فِيهِمُ الْكَبِيرَ وَفِيهِمُ الضَّعِيفَ وَإِذَا قَامَ وَحْدَهُ فَلْيُطِلْ صَلاَتَهُ مَا شَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an muhammadin, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa maa qaama aahadukum lilnnaasi falyukhaffifi alssalaaaa faiinna fiyhimu alkabiyra wafiyhimu aldda'iyfa waiidhaa qaama wahdahu falyutil salaatahu maa shaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:This is what Abu Huraira transmitted to us from Muhammad the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he narrated (some) ahadith out of (these narrations and one of them is this): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you stands to lead people In prayer, he should shorten it, for amongst them are the aged, and amongst them are the weak, but when he prays by himself, he may prolong his prayer as he likes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا صَلَّى أَحَدُكُمْ لِلنَّاسِ فَلْيُخَفِّفْ فَإِنَّ فِي النَّاسِ الضَّعِيفَ وَالسَّقِيمَ وَذَا الْحَاجَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa sallaa aahadukum lilnnaasi falyukhaffif faiinna fiy alnnaasi aldda'iyfa waalssaqiyma wadhaa alhaajaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you leads people in prayer, he must shorten it for among them are the weak, the infirm and those who have business to attend
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - بَدَلَ السَّقِيمِ - الْكَبِيرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathaniy alllaythu bnu sa'din, haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala - badala alssaqiymi - alkabiyra ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported that he had heard Abu Huraira say that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said like it, but he substituted" the aged" for 'the infirm
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي الْعَاصِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ أُمَّ قَوْمَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَجِدُ فِي نَفْسِي شَيْئًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ادْنُهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَلَّسَنِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ وَضَعَ كَفَّهُ فِي صَدْرِي بَيْنَ ثَدْيَىَّ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَحَوَّلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَوَضَعَهَا فِي ظَهْرِي بَيْنَ كَتِفَىَّ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أُمَّ قَوْمَكَ فَمَنْ أَمَّ قَوْمًا فَلْيُخَفِّفْ فَإِنَّ فِيهِمُ الْكَبِيرَ وَإِنَّ فِيهِمُ الْمَرِيضَ وَإِنَّ فِيهِمُ الضَّعِيفَ وَإِنَّ فِيهِمْ ذَا الْحَاجَةِ وَإِذَا صَلَّى أَحَدُكُمْ وَحْدَهُ فَلْيُصَلِّ كَيْفَ شَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'uthmaana, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu talhaaa, haddathaniy 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy al'aasi althhaqafiyyu, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahu ‏"‏ aumma qawmaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy aajidu fiy nafsiy shayiana ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adnuh ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fajallasaniy bayna yadayhi thumma wada'a kaffahu fiy sadriy bayna thadyaaaa thumma qaala ‏"‏ tahawwal ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fawada'ahaa fiy zahriy bayna katifaaaa thumma qaala ‏"‏ aumma qawmaka faman aamma qawmana falyukhaffif faiinna fiyhimu alkabiyra waiinna fiyhimu almariyda waiinna fiyhimu aldda'iyfa waiinna fiyhim dhaa alhaajaai waiidhaa sallaa aahadukum wahdahu falyusalli kayfa shaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uthman b. Abu'l-'As at-Thaqafi reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Lead your people in prayer. I said: Messenger of Allah. I perceive something (disturbing) in my soul. He (the Holy Prophet) asked me to draw near him and making me sit down in front of him he placed his hand on my breast between my nipples. and then, telling me to turn round, he placed it on my back between my shoulders. He then said: Act as an Imam for your people. He who acts as Imam of the people, he must be brief, for among them are the aged, among them are the sick, among them are the weak, and among them are the people who have business to attend. But when any of you prays alone, he may pray as he likes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي الْعَاصِ، قَالَ آخِرُ مَا عَهِدَ إِلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَمَمْتَ قَوْمًا فَأَخِفَّ بِهِمُ الصَّلاَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, qaala haddatha 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy al'aasi, qaala akhiru maa 'ahida iilaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aamamta qawmana faaakhiffa bihimu alssalaaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uthman b. Abu'l-'As reported:The last thing which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) instructed me was: When you lead the people in prayer, be brief
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُوجِزُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَيُتِمُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yuwjizu fiy alssalaaai wayutimmu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to be brief and perfect in prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ مِنْ أَخَفِّ النَّاسِ صَلاَةً فِي تَمَامٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala, qutaybaau haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana min aakhaffi alnnaasi salaaaan fiy tamaamin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was among those whose prayers was brief and perfect
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ مَا صَلَّيْتُ وَرَاءَ إِمَامٍ قَطُّ أَخَفَّ صَلاَةً وَلاَ أَتَمَّ صَلاَةً مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - 'an shariyki bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy namirin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qaala maa sallaytu waraa'a iimaamin qattu aakhaffa salaaaan walaa aatamma salaaaan min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:I never prayed behind an Imam who was more brief and more perfect in prayer than the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْمَعُ بُكَاءَ الصَّبِيِّ مَعَ أُمِّهِ وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَيَقْرَأُ بِالسُّورَةِ الْخَفِيفَةِ أَوْ بِالسُّورَةِ الْقَصِيرَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa ja'faru bnu sulaymaana, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasin, qaala aanasun kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasma'u bukaa'a alssabiyyi ma'a aummihi wahuwa fiy alssalaaai fayaqraau bialssuwraai alkhafiyfaai aaw bialssuwraai alqasiyraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would listen to the crying of a lad in the company of his mother, in prayer, and he would recite a short surah or a small surah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَدْخُلُ الصَّلاَةَ أُرِيدُ إِطَالَتَهَا فَأَسْمَعُ بُكَاءَ الصَّبِيِّ فَأُخَفِّفُ مِنْ شِدَّةِ وَجْدِ أُمِّهِ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu minhaalin alddariyru, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinniy laadkhulu alssalaaaa auriydu iitaalatahaa faaasma'u bukaa'a alssabiyyi faaukhaffifu min shiddaai wajdi aummihi bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) having said:When I begin the prayer I Intend to make it long, but I hear a boy cry. ing; I then shorten it because of his mother's feelings
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، - قَالَ حَامِدٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، - عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ رَمَقْتُ الصَّلاَةَ مَعَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدْتُ قِيَامَهُ فَرَكْعَتَهُ فَاعْتِدَالَهُ بَعْدَ رُكُوعِهِ فَسَجْدَتَهُ فَجَلْسَتَهُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ فَسَجْدَتَهُ فَجَلْسَتَهُ مَا بَيْنَ التَّسْلِيمِ وَالاِنْصِرَافِ قَرِيبًا مِنَ السَّوَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haamidu bnu 'umara albakraawiyyu, waaabuw kaamilin fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu kilaahumaa 'an aabiy 'awaanaaa, - qaala haamidun haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, - 'an hilaali bni aabiy humaydin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, qaala ramaqtu alssalaaaa ma'a muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm fawajadtu qiyaamahu farak'atahu faa'tidaalahu ba'da rukuw'ihi fasajdatahu fajalsatahu bayna alssajdatayni fasajdatahu fajalsatahu maa bayna alttasliymi waalainsiraafi qariybana mina alssawaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported:I noticed the prayer of Muhammad (ﷺ) and saw his Qiyam (standing), his bowing, and then going back to the standing posture after bowing, his prostration, his sitting between the two prostrations, and his prostration and sitting between salutation and going away, all these were nearly equal to one another
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ غَلَبَ عَلَى الْكُوفَةِ رَجُلٌ - قَدْ سَمَّاهُ - زَمَنَ ابْنِ الأَشْعَثِ فَأَمَرَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ فَكَانَ يُصَلِّي فَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَامَ قَدْرَ مَا أَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَكَمُ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ يَقُولُ كَانَتْ صَلاَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرُكُوعُهُ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ وَسُجُودُهُ وَمَا بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ قَرِيبًا مِنَ السَّوَاءِ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فَذَكَرْتُهُ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ فَقَالَ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى فَلَمْ تَكُنْ صَلاَتُهُ هَكَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, qaala ghalaba 'alaa alkuwfaai rajulun - qad sammaahu - zamana abni alaash'athi faaamara aabaa 'ubaydaaa bna 'abdi alllahi aan yusalliya bialnnaasi fakaana yusalliy faiidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i qaama qadra maa aaquwlu alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu mil'a alssamawaati wamil'a alaardi wamil'a maa shiita min shaa'in ba'du aahla althhanaa'i waalmajdi laa maani'a limaa aa'tayta walaa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta walaa yanfa'u dhaa aljaddi minka aljaddu ‏.‏ qaala alhakamu fadhakartu dhalika li'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa faqaala sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin yaquwlu kaanat salaaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm warukuw'uhu waiidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i wasujuwduhu wamaa bayna alssajdatayni qariybana mina alssawaa'i ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau fadhakartuhu li'amriw bni murraaa faqaala qad raaaytu abna aabiy laylaa falam takun salaatuhu hakadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hakam reported:There dominated in Kufa a man whose name was men- tioned as Zaman b. al-Ash'ath, who ordered Abu 'Ubaidah b. 'Abdullah to lead people in prayer and he accordingly used to lead them. Whenever he raised his head after bowing, he stood up equal to the time that I can recite (this supplication): O Allah! our Lord! unto Thee be the praise which would fill the heavens and the earth, and that which will please Thee besides them I Worthy art Thou of all praise and glory. None can prevent that which Thou bestowest, and none can bestow that whichthou preventest. And the greatness of the great will not avail him against Thee. Hakam (the narrator) said: I made a mention of that to Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Laila who reported: I heard al-Bara' b. 'Azib say that the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his bowing, and when he lifted his head from bowing, and his prostration, and between the two prostrations (all these acts) were nearly proportionate. I made a mention of that to 'Ar b. Murrah and he said: I saw Ibn Abi Laili (saying the prayer), but his prayer was not like this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، أَنَّ مَطَرَ بْنَ نَاجِيَةَ، لَمَّا ظَهَرَ عَلَى الْكُوفَةِ أَمَرَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ، بِالنَّاسِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, aanna matara bna naajiyaaa, lammaa zahara 'alaa alkuwfaai aamara aabaa 'ubaydaaa aan yusalliya, bialnnaasi ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hakam reported:When Matar b. Najiya dominated Kufa he ordered Abu Ubaida to lead people in prayer, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ إِنِّي لاَ آلُو أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ بِكُمْ كَمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي بِنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ أَنَسٌ يَصْنَعُ شَيْئًا لاَ أَرَاكُمْ تَصْنَعُونَهُ كَانَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ انْتَصَبَ قَائِمًا حَتَّى يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُ قَدْ نَسِيَ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السَّجْدَةِ مَكَثَ حَتَّى يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُ قَدْ نَسِيَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala iinniy laa aluw aan ausalliya bikum kamaa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy binaa ‏.‏ qaala fakaana aanasun yasna'u shayiana laa aaraakum tasna'uwnahu kaana iidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i antasaba qaaiimana hattaa yaquwla alqaaiilu qad nasiya ‏.‏ waiidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alssajdaai makatha hattaa yaquwla alqaaiilu qad nasiya ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thabit reported it on the authority of Anas:While leading you in prayer I do not shorten anything in the prayer. I pray as I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) leading us. He (Thabit) said: Anas used to do that which I do not see you doing; when he lifted his head from bowing he stood up (so long) that one would say: He has forgotten (to baw down in prostration). And when he lifted his head from prostration, he stayed in that position, till someone would say: He has forgotten (to bow down in prostration for the second sajda)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ مَا صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ أَحَدٍ أَوْجَزَ صَلاَةً مِنْ صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي تَمَامٍ كَانَتْ صَلاَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَقَارِبَةً وَكَانَتْ صَلاَةُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ مُتَقَارِبَةً فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ مَدَّ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَامَ حَتَّى نَقُولَ قَدْ أَوْهَمَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُ وَيَقْعُدُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ حَتَّى نَقُولَ قَدْ أَوْهَمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa hammaadun, aakhbaranaa thaabitun, 'an aanasin, qaala maa sallaytu khalfa aahadin aawjaza salaaaan min salaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy tamaamin kaanat salaaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mutaqaaribaaan wakaanat salaaau aabiy bakrin mutaqaaribaaan falammaa kaana 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi madda fiy salaaai alfajri wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qaala ‏ "‏ sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaama hattaa naquwla qad aawhama ‏.‏ thumma yasjudu wayaq'udu bayna alssajdatayni hattaa naquwla qad aawhama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thabit reported it on the authority of Anas:I have never said such a light and perfect prayer as I said behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The prayer of the Messenger. of Allah (ﷺ) was well balanced. And so too was the prayer of Abu Bakr well balanced. When it was the time of 'Umar b. al-Khattab he prolonged the morning prayer. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah listened to him who praised Him, he stood erect till we said: He has forgotten. He then prostrated and sat between two prostration till we said: He has forgotten
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ، وَهُوَ غَيْرُ كَذُوبٍ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ لَمْ أَرَ أَحَدًا يَحْنِي ظَهْرَهُ حَتَّى يَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَبْهَتَهُ عَلَى الأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَخِرُّ مَنْ وَرَاءَهُ سُجَّدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, h qaala wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni yaziyda, qaala haddathaniy albaraa'u, wahuwa ghayru kadhuwbin aannahum kaanuwa yusalluwna khalfa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i lam aara aahadana yahniy zahrahu hattaa yada'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jabhatahu 'alaa alaardi thumma yakhirru man waraa'ahu sujjadana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' (b. 'Azib), and he was no liar (but a truthful Companion of the Holy Prophet), reported:They used to say prayer behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I never saw anyone bending his back at the time when he (the Holy Prophet) raised his head, till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) placed his forehead on the ground. They then fell in prostration after him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ، - وَهُوَ غَيْرُ كَذُوبٍ - قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَحْنِ أَحَدٌ مِنَّا ظَهْرَهُ حَتَّى يَقَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاجِدًا ثُمَّ نَقَعُ سُجُودًا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu khalaaadin albaahiliyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathaniy aabuw iishaaqa, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, haddathaniy albaraa'u, - wahuwa ghayru kadhuwbin - qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qaala ‏ "‏ sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ lam yahni aahadun minnaa zahrahu hattaa yaqa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saajidana thumma naqa'u sujuwdana ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported, and he was no liar:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah listened to him who praised Him, none of us bent his back till he (the Holy Prophet) prostrated; we then, afterwards, went down in prostration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَهْمٍ الأَنْطَاكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ حَدَّثَنَا الْبَرَاءُ، أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا رَكَعَ رَكَعُوا وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لَمْ نَزَلْ قِيَامًا حَتَّى نَرَاهُ قَدْ وَضَعَ وَجْهَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ ثُمَّ نَتَّبِعُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni sahmin alaantaakiyyu, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muhammadin aabuw iishaaqa alfazaariyyu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an muhaaribi bni dithaarin, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna yaziyda, yaquwlu 'alaa alminbari haddathanaa albaraa'u, aannahum kaanuwa yusalluwna ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiidhaa raka'a raka'uwa waiidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i faqaala ‏ "‏ sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ lam nazal qiyaamana hattaa naraahu qad wada'a wajhahu fiy alaardi thumma nattabi'uhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported:They (the Companions) said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and they bowed when he (the Holy Prophet) bowed. and when he raised his head after bowing, he pronounced:" Allah listened to him who praised Him," and we kept standing till we saw him placing his face on the ground and then we followed him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانٌ، وَغَيْرُهُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَحْنُو أَحَدٌ مِنَّا ظَهْرَهُ حَتَّى نَرَاهُ قَدْ سَجَدَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْكُوفِيُّونَ أَبَانٌ وَغَيْرُهُ قَالَ حَتَّى نَرَاهُ يَسْجُدُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa aabaanun, waghayruhu, 'ani alhakami, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yahnuw aahadun minnaa zahrahu hattaa naraahu qad sajada ‏.‏ faqaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu qaala haddathanaa alkuwfiyyuwna aabaanun waghayruhu qaala hattaa naraahu yasjudu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported:When we were (in prayer) with the Messenger of Allah Allah (ﷺ) none of us benfft his back till we saw he prostrated. Zuhair and others reported:" till we saw him prostrating
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحْرِزُ بْنُ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ خَلِيفَةَ الأَشْجَعِيُّ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ سَرِيعٍ، مَوْلَى آلِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْفَجْرَ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏ فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ * الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ‏}‏ وَكَانَ لاَ يَحْنِي رَجُلٌ مِنَّا ظَهْرَهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَتِمَّ سَاجِدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhrizu bnu 'awni bni aabiy 'awnin, haddathanaa khalafu bnu khaliyfaaa alaashja'iyyu aabuw aahmada, 'ani alwaliydi bni sariy'in, mawlaa ali 'amriw bni huraythin 'an 'amriw bni huraythin, qaala sallaytu khalfa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alfajra fasami'tuhu yaqraau ‏{‏ falaa auqsimu bialkhunnasi * aljawaari alkunnasi‏}‏ wakaana laa yahniy rajulun minnaa zahrahu hattaa yastatimma saajidana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. Huraith reported:I said the dawn prayer behind the Apostle of (ﷺ) and heard him reciting: 'Nay. I call to witness the stars, running their courses and setting" (al-Qur'an, lxxxi. 15-16) and Done of us bent his back till he completed prostration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَفَعَ ظَهْرَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, wawakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'ubaydi bni alhasani, 'ani abni aabiy aawfaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa rafa'a zahrahu mina alrrukuw'i qaala ‏ "‏ sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu mil'a alssamawaati wamil'a alaardi wamil'a maa shiita min shaa'in ba'du ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: (Abdullah b ) Ibn Abi Aufa reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his back from the rukd' he pronounced: Allah listened to him who praised Him. O Allah! our Lord! unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْعُو بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'ubaydi bni alhasani, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yad'uw bihadhaa alddu'aa'i ‏ "‏ alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu mil'a alssamawaati wamil'a alaardi wamil'a maa shiita min shaa'in ba'du ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Aufa reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite this supplication: O Allah! our Lord, unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَجْزَأَةَ بْنِ زَاهِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَاءِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَالْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْنِي مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْوَسَخِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an majzaaaaa bni zaahirin, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa, yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma laka alhamdu mil'a alssamaa'i wamil'a alaardi wamil'a maa shiita min shaa'in ba'du alllahumma tahhirniy bialthhalji waalbaradi waalmaa'i albaaridi alllahumma tahhirniy mina aldhhunuwbi waalkhataayaa kamaa yunaqqaa althhawbu alaabyadu mina alwasakhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abu Aufa reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite (this supplication):O Allah! our Lord, unto Thee be praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and fill that which will please Thee besides (them). O Allah! purify me with snow, (water of) hail and with cold water; O Allah. cleanse me from the sins and errors just as a white garment is cleansed from dirt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فِي رِوَايَةِ مُعَاذٍ ‏"‏ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّرَنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ يَزِيدَ ‏"‏ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, qaala wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi fiy riwaayaai mu'aadhin ‏"‏ kamaa yunaqqaa althhawbu alaabyadu mina alddarani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai yaziyda ‏"‏ mina alddanasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith with the same chain of transmitters has been narrated by Shu'ba, and in the narration of Mu'adh the words are:" just as the white garment is cleansed from filth," and in the narration of Yazid:" from dirt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ قَزْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa marwaanu bnu muhammadin alddimashqiyyu, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an 'atiyyaaa bni qaysin, 'an qaz'aaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i qaala ‏ "‏ rabbanaa laka alhamdu mil'a alssamawaati waalaardi wamil'a maa shiita min shaa'in ba'du aahla althhanaa'i waalmajdi aahaqqu maa qaala al'abdu wakullunaa laka 'abdun alllahumma laa maani'a limaa aa'tayta walaa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta walaa yanfa'u dhaa aljaddi minka aljaddu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his head after bowing, he said: O Allah! our Lord, to Thee be the praise that would fill all the heavens and the earth, and all that it pleases Thee besides (them). O, thou art worthy of praise and glory, most worthy of what a servant says, and we all are Thy servants, no one can withhold what Thou givest or give what Thou withholdest, and riches cannot avail a wealthy person against Thee
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hushaymu bnu bashiyrin, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, 'an qaysi bni sa'din, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma rabbanaa laka alhamdu mil'a alssamawaati wamil'a alaardi wamaa baynahumaa wamil'a maa shiita min shaa'in ba'du aahla althhanaa'i waalmajdi laa maani'a limaa aa'tayta walaa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta walaa yanfa'u dhaa aljaddi minka aljaddu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his head after bowing, he said: Allah! our Lord, to Thee be the praise that would fill the heavens and the earth and that which is between them, and that which will please Thee besides (them). Worthy art Thou of all praise and glory. No one can withhold what Thou givest, or give what Thou withholdest. And the greatness O! the great availeth not against Thee
