verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏ "‏ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa hafsun, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, haddathanaa qaysu bnu sa'din, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa qawlihi ‏ "‏ wamil'a maa shiita min shaa'in ba'du ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the words:" And that would fill that which will please Thee besides (them)!" and he did not mention the subsequent (portion of supplication)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ سُحَيْمٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَشَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم السِّتَارَةَ وَالنَّاسُ صُفُوفٌ خَلْفَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْ مُبَشِّرَاتِ النُّبُوَّةِ إِلاَّ الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ يَرَاهَا الْمُسْلِمُ أَوْ تُرَى لَهُ أَلاَ وَإِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ رَاكِعًا أَوْ سَاجِدًا فَأَمَّا الرُّكُوعُ فَعَظِّمُوا فِيهِ الرَّبَّ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَأَمَّا السُّجُودُ فَاجْتَهِدُوا فِي الدُّعَاءِ فَقَمِنٌ أَنْ يُسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, aakhbaraniy sulaymaanu bnu suhaymin, 'an iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alllahi bni ma'badin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kashafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alssitaaraaa waalnnaasu sufuwfun khalfa aabiy bakrin faqaala ‏ "‏ aayyuhaa alnnaasu iinnahu lam yabqa min mubashhiraati alnnubuwwaai iilaaa alrruuyaa alssaalihaau yaraahaa almuslimu aaw turaa lahu aalaa waiinniy nuhiytu aan aaqraaa alqurana raaki'ana aaw saajidana faaammaa alrrukuw'u fa'azzimuwa fiyhi alrrabba 'azza wajalla waaammaa alssujuwdu faajtahiduwa fiy alddu'aa'i faqaminun aan yustajaaba lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew aside the curtain (of his apartment) and (he saw) people in rows (saying prayer) behind Aba Bakr. And he said: Nothing remains of the glad tidings of apostlehood, except good visions which a Muslim sees or someone is made to see for him. And see that I have been forbidden to recite the Qur'an in the state of bowing and prostration. So far as Ruk'u is concerned, extol in it the Great and Glorious Lord, and while prostrating yourselves be earnest in supplication, for it is fitting that your supplications should be answered
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ سُحَيْمٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَشَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم السِّتْرَ وَرَأْسُهُ مَعْصُوبٌ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْ مُبَشِّرَاتِ النُّبُوَّةِ إِلاَّ الرُّؤْيَا يَرَاهَا الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ أَوْ تُرَى لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an sulaymaana, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, aakhbaraniy sulaymaanu bnu suhaymin, 'an iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alllahi bni ma'badi bni 'abbaasin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, qaala kashafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alssitra waraasuhu ma'suwbun fiy maradihi alladhiy maata fiyhi faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma hal ballaghtu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thalaatha marraatin ‏"‏ iinnahu lam yabqa min mubashhiraati alnnubuwwaai iilaaa alrruuyaa yaraahaa al'abdu alssaalihu aaw turaa lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi sufyaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew aside the curtain and his head was bandaged on account of illness in which he died. He said: O Allah, have I not delivered (Thy Message)? (He repeated it) three times. Nothing has been left out of the glad tidings of apostlebood, but good vision. which a pious servant (of Allah) sees or someone else is made to see for him. He then narrated like the hadith transmitted by Sufyan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ نَهَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَقْرَأَ رَاكِعًا أَوْ سَاجِدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, aanna aabaahu, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin, qaala nahaaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aaqraaa raaki'ana aaw saajidana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Abi Talib reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade me to recite (the Qur'an) in a state of bowing and prostration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ كَثِيرٍ - حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، يَقُولُ نَهَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ قِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ وَأَنَا رَاكِعٌ أَوْ سَاجِدٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi, - ya'niy abna kathiyrin - haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin, yaquwlu nahaaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an qiraa'aai alqurani waaanaa raaki'un aaw saajidun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Abi Talib reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade to recite the Qur'an, while I am in the state of bowing and prostration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ نَهَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ وَلاَ أَقُولُ نَهَاكُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, aakhbaraniy zaydu bnu aaslama, 'an iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin, aannahu qaala nahaaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alqiraa'aai fiy alrrukuw'i waalssujuwdi walaa aaquwlu nahaakum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Abi Talib reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade me from the recitation (of the Qur'an) in bowing and prostration and I do not say that he forbade you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ نَهَانِي حِبِّي صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَقْرَأَ رَاكِعًا أَوْ سَاجِدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu, qaalaa aakhbaranaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu, haddathanaa daawudu bnu qaysin, haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala nahaaniy hibbiy sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aaqraaa raaki'ana aaw saajidana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported:My loved one (the Holy Prophet) forbade me that I should recite (the Qur'an) in a state of bowing and prostration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، - إِلاَّ الضَّحَّاكَ وَابْنَ عَجْلاَنَ فَإِنَّهُمَا زَادَا عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلُّهُمْ قَالُوا نَهَانِي عَنْ قِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ وَأَنَا رَاكِعٌ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرُوا فِي رِوَايَتِهِمُ النَّهْىَ عَنْهَا فِي السُّجُودِ كَمَا ذَكَرَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ وَالْوَلِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ وَدَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, h wahaddathaniy 'iysaa bnu hammaadin almisriyyu, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, h qaala wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, haddathanaa alddahhaaku bnu 'uthmaana, h qaala wahaddathanaa almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'ani abni 'ajlaana, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin, h qaala wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - aakhbaraniy muhammadun, wahuwa abnu 'amrinw h qaala wahaddathaniy hannaadu bnu alssariyyi, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an muhammadi bni iishaaqa, kullu hauulaa'i 'an iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aliyyin, - iilaaa alddahhaaka waabna 'ajlaana faiinnahumaa zaadaa 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an 'aliyyin, - 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kulluhum qaaluwa nahaaniy 'an qiraa'aai alqurani waaanaa raaki'un walam yadhkuruwa fiy riwaayatihimu alnnahaa 'anhaa fiy alssujuwdi kamaa dhakara alzzuhriyyu wazaydu bnu aaslama waalwaliydu bnu kathiyrin wadaawudu bnu qaysin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by some other narrators, Ibn 'Abbas and others, and they all reported that 'Ali said:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) forbade me to recite the Qur'an while I am in a state of bowing and prostration, and in their narration (there is a mention of) forbiddance from that (recital) in the state of prostration as it has been transmitted by Zuhri, Zaid b. Aslam, al-Wahid b. Kathir, and Dawud b. Qais
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ حَاتِمِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي السُّجُودِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau, 'an haatimi bni iismaa'iyla, 'an ja'fari bni muhammadin, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, 'an 'aliyyin, walam yadhkur fiy alssujuwdi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is transmitted on the authority of 'Ali, but he made no mention of" while in prostration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ، وَأَنَا رَاكِعٌ، ‏.‏ لاَ يَذْكُرُ فِي الإِسْنَادِ عَلِيًّا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy bakri bni hafsin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aannahu qaala nuhiytu aan aaqraaa, waaanaa raaki'un, ‏.‏ laa yadhkuru fiy aliisnaadi 'aliyyana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:I was forbidden to recite (the Qur'an) while I was bowing, and there is no mention of 'Ali in the chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ غَزِيَّةَ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، ذَكْوَانَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, wa'amruw bnu sawwaadin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an 'amriw bni alhaarithi, 'an 'umaaraaa bni ghaziyyaaa, 'an sumaaain, mawlaa aabiy bakrin aannahu sami'a aabaa saalihin, dhakwaana yuhaddithu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aaqrabu maa yakuwnu al'abdu min rabbihi wahuwa saajidun faaakthiruwa alddu'aa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The nearest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is prostrating himself, so make supplication (in this state)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ غَزِيَّةَ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِهِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلاَنِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, wayuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, 'an 'umaaraaa bni ghaziyyaaa, 'an sumaaain, mawlaa aabiy bakrin 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu fiy sujuwdihi ‏ "‏ alllahumma aghfir liy dhanbiy kullahu diqqahu wajillahu waaawwalahu waakhirahu wa'alaaniyatahu wasirrahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say while prostrating himself: O Lord, forgive me all my sins, small and great, first and last, open and secret
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُكْثِرُ أَنْ يَقُولَ فِي رُكُوعِهِ وَسُجُودِهِ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَتَأَوَّلُ الْقُرْآنَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yukthiru aan yaquwla fiy rukuw'ihi wasujuwdihi ‏ "‏ subhaanaka alllahumma rabbanaa wabihamdika alllahumma aghfir liy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ yataaawwalu alqurana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him') often said while bowing and prostrating himself:" Glory be to Thee, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to Thee, O Allah, forgive me," thus complying with the (command in) the Qur'an
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُكْثِرُ أَنْ يَقُولَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمُوتَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَاتُ الَّتِي أَرَاكَ أَحْدَثْتَهَا تَقُولُهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ جُعِلَتْ لِي عَلاَمَةٌ فِي أُمَّتِي إِذَا رَأَيْتُهَا قُلْتُهَا ‏{‏ إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلَى آخِرِ السُّورَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an muslimin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yukthiru aan yaquwla qabla aan yamuwta ‏"‏ subhaanaka wabihamdika aastaghfiruka waaatuwbu iilayka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi maa hadhihi alkalimaatu allatiy aaraaka aahdathtahaa taquwluhaa qaala ‏"‏ ju'ilat liy 'alaamaaun fiy aummatiy iidhaa raaaytuhaa qultuhaa ‏{‏ iidhaa jaa'a nasru alllahi waalfathu‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaa akhiri alssuwraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) before his death recited often:Hallowed be Thou, and with Thy praise, I seek forgiveness from Thee and return to Thee. She reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, what are these words that I find you reciting? He said: There has been made a sign for me in my Ummah; when I saw that, I uttered them (these words of glorification for Allah), and the sign is:" When Allah's help and victory..... to the end of the surah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُفَضَّلٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُنْذُ نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ ‏{‏ إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}‏ يُصَلِّي صَلاَةً إِلاَّ دَعَا أَوْ قَالَ فِيهَا ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَكَ رَبِّي وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa mufaddalun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an muslimi bni subayhin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat maa raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm mundhu nazala 'alayhi ‏{‏ iidhaa jaa'a nasru alllahi waalfathu‏}‏ yusalliy salaaaan iilaaa da'aa aaw qaala fiyhaa ‏"‏ subhaanaka rabbiy wabihamdika alllahumma aghfir liy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Never did I, see the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after the revelation (of these verses):" When Allah's help and victory came." observin- his prayer without making (this supplication) or he said in it (supplication): Hallowed be Thee, my Lord, and with Thy praise, O Allah, forgive me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُكْثِرُ مِنْ قَوْلِ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَاكَ تُكْثِرُ مِنْ قَوْلِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ خَبَّرَنِي رَبِّي أَنِّي سَأَرَى عَلاَمَةً فِي أُمَّتِي فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُهَا أَكْثَرْتُ مِنْ قَوْلِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهَا ‏{‏ إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}‏ فَتْحُ مَكَّةَ ‏{‏ وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا * فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa daawudu, 'an 'aamirin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yukthiru min qawli ‏"‏ subhaana alllahi wabihamdihi aastaghfiru alllaha waaatuwbu iilayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaka tukthiru min qawli subhaana alllahi wabihamdihi aastaghfiru alllaha waaatuwbu iilayhi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ khabbaraniy rabbiy aanniy saaaraa 'alaamaaan fiy aummatiy faiidhaa raaaytuhaa aakthartu min qawli subhaana alllahi wabihamdihi aastaghfiru alllaha waaatuwbu iilayhi ‏.‏ faqad raaaytuhaa ‏{‏ iidhaa jaa'a nasru alllahi waalfathu‏}‏ fathu makkaaa ‏{‏ waraaayta alnnaasa yadkhuluwna fiy diyni alllahi aafwaajana * fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waastaghfirhu iinnahu kaana tawwaabana‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited often these words: Hallowed be Allah and with His praise, I seek the forgiveness of Allah and return to Him. She said: I asked: Messenger of Allah, I see that you often repeat the saying" subhan allahi bihamdihi astag firullahi watubuilaih" whereupon he said: My Lord informed me that I would soon see a sign in my Ummah, so when I see it I often recite (these) words: Hallowed be Allah and with His Praise, I seek forgiveness of Allah and return to Him. Indeed I saw it (when this verse) was revealed:" When Allah's help and victory came, it marked the victory of Mecca, and you see people entering into Allah's religion in troops, celebrate the praise of Thy Lord and ask His forgiveness. Surely He is ever returning to Mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ كَيْفَ تَقُولُ أَنْتَ فِي الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ أَمَّا سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ فَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتِ افْتَقَدْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ ذَهَبَ إِلَى بَعْضِ نِسَائِهِ فَتَحَسَّسْتُ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ فَإِذَا هُوَ رَاكِعٌ أَوْ سَاجِدٌ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي إِنِّي لَفِي شَأْنٍ وَإِنَّكَ لَفِي آخَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala qultu li'ataa'in kayfa taquwlu aanta fiy alrrukuw'i qaala aammaa subhaanaka wabihamdika laa iilaha iilaaa aanta faaakhbaraniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa 'an 'aaiishaaa qaalati aftaqadtu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata laylaain fazanantu aannahu dhahaba iilaa ba'di nisaaiihi fatahassastu thumma raja'tu faiidhaa huwa raaki'un aaw saajidun yaquwlu ‏ "‏ subhaanaka wabihamdika laa iilaha iilaaa aanta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu biaabiy aanta waaummiy iinniy lafiy shaanin waiinnaka lafiy akhara ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Juraij reported:I asked 'Ata': What do you recite when you are in a state of bowing (in prayer)? He said:" Hallowed be Thou, and with Thy praise, there is no god but Thou." Son of Abd Mulaika narrated to me on the anthority of 'A'isha (who reported): I missed one night the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (from his bed). I thought that he might have gone to one of his other wives. I searched for him and then came back and (found him) in a state of bowing, or prostration, saying: Hallowed be Thou and with Thy praise; there is no god but Thou. I said: With my father mayest thou be ransomed and with my mother. I was thinking of (another) affair, whereas you are (occupied) in another one
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ فَقَدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً مِنَ الْفِرَاشِ فَالْتَمَسْتُهُ فَوَقَعَتْ يَدِي عَلَى بَطْنِ قَدَمَيْهِ وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَهُمَا مَنْصُوبَتَانِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an muhammadi bni yahyaa bni habbaana, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat faqadtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laylaaan mina alfiraashi faaltamastuhu fawaqa'at yadiy 'alaa batni qadamayhi wahuwa fiy almasjidi wahumaa mansuwbataani wahuwa yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma aa'uwdhu biridaaka min sakhatika wabimu'aafaatika min 'uquwbatika waaa'uwdhu bika minka laa auhsiy thanaa'an 'alayka aanta kamaa aathnayta 'alaa nafsika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:One night I missed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from the bed, and when I sought him my hand touched the soles of his feet while he was in the state of prostration; they (feet) were raised and he was saying:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thy pleasure from Thy anger, and in Thy forgiveness from Thy punishment, and I seek refuge in Thee from Thee (Thy anger). I cannot reckon Thy praise. Thou art as Thou hast lauded Thyself
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، نَبَّأَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ وَسُجُودِهِ ‏ "‏ سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an mutarrifi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alshhikhhiyri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, nabbaaathu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu fiy rukuw'ihi wasujuwdihi ‏ "‏ subbuwhun qudduwsun rabbu almalaaiikaai waalrruwhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to pronounce while bowing and prostrating himself:All Glorious, All Holy, Lord of the Angels and the Spirit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُطَرِّفَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَحَدَّثَنِي هِشَامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaraniy qataadaau, qaala sami'tu mutarrifa bna 'abdi alllahi bni alshhikhhiyri, qaala aabuw daawuda wahaddathaniy hishaamun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an mutarrifin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَوْزَاعِيَّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ الْمُعَيْطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي مَعْدَانُ بْنُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الْيَعْمَرِيُّ، قَالَ لَقِيتُ ثَوْبَانَ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ أَخْبِرْنِي بِعَمَلٍ أَعْمَلُهُ يُدْخِلُنِي اللَّهُ بِهِ الْجَنَّةَ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ قُلْتُ بِأَحَبِّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَسَكَتَ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ عَلَيْكَ بِكَثْرَةِ السُّجُودِ لِلَّهِ فَإِنَّكَ لاَ تَسْجُدُ لِلَّهِ سَجْدَةً إِلاَّ رَفَعَكَ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً وَحَطَّ عَنْكَ بِهَا خَطِيئَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَعْدَانُ ثُمَّ لَقِيتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ لِي مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ لِي ثَوْبَانُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, qaala sami'tu alaawzaa'iyya, qaala haddathaniy alwaliydu bnu hishaamin almu'aytiyyu, haddathaniy ma'daanu bnu aabiy talhaaa alya'mariyyu, qaala laqiytu thawbaana mawlaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu aakhbirniy bi'amalin aa'maluhu yudkhiluniy alllahu bihi aljannaaa ‏.‏ aaw qaala qultu biaahabbi alaa'maali iilaa alllahi ‏.‏ fasakata thumma saaaltuhu fasakata thumma saaaltuhu althhaalithaaa faqaala saaaltu 'an dhalika rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ 'alayka bikathraai alssujuwdi lillahi faiinnaka laa tasjudu lillahi sajdaaan iilaaa rafa'aka alllahu bihaa darajaaan wahatta 'anka bihaa khatiyiaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ma'daanu thumma laqiytu aabaa alddardaa'i fasaaaltuhu faqaala liy mithla maa qaala liy thawbaanu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ma'dan b. Talha reported:I met Thauban, the freed slave. of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and asked him to tell me about an act for which, if I do it, Allah will admit me to Paradise, or I asked about the act which was loved most by Allah. He gave no reply. I again asked and he gave no reply. I asked him for the third time, and he said: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about that and he said: Make frequent prostrations before Allah, for you will not make one prostration without raising you a degree because of it, and removing a sin from you, because of it. Ma'dan said that then lie met Abu al-Darda' and when he asked him, he received a reply similar to that given by Thauban
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِقْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَوْزَاعِيَّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ كَعْبٍ الأَسْلَمِيُّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَبِيتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِوَضُوئِهِ وَحَاجَتِهِ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ سَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَسْأَلُكَ مُرَافَقَتَكَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوَغَيْرَ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ هُوَ ذَاكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَعِنِّي عَلَى نَفْسِكَ بِكَثْرَةِ السُّجُودِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu muwsaa aabuw saalihin, haddathanaa hiqlu bnu ziyaadin, qaala sami'tu alaawzaa'iyya, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa, haddathaniy rabiy'aau bnu ka'bin alaaslamiyyu, qaala kuntu aabiytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataytuhu biwaduwiihi wahaajatihi faqaala liy ‏"‏ sal ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu aasaaluka muraafaqataka fiy aljannaai ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aawaghayra dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu huwa dhaaka ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaa'inniy 'alaa nafsika bikathraai alssujuwdi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rabi'a b. Ka'b said:I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one night. and I brought him water and what he required. He said to me: Ask (anything you like). I said: I ask your company in Paradise. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Or anything else besides it. I said: That is all (what I require). He said: Then help me to achieve this for you by devoting yourself often to prostration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أُمِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعَةٍ وَنُهِيَ أَنْ يَكُفَّ شَعْرَهُ وَثِيَابَهُ ‏.‏ هَذَا حَدِيثُ يَحْيَى ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ وَنُهِيَ أَنْ يَكُفَّ شَعْرَهُ وَثِيَابَهُ الْكَفَّيْنِ وَالرُّكْبَتَيْنِ وَالْقَدَمَيْنِ وَالْجَبْهَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala aabuw alrrabiy'i, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala aumira alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yasjuda 'alaa sab'aain wanuhiya aan yakuffa sha'rahu wathiyaabahu ‏.‏ hadhaa hadiythu yahyaa ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw alrrabiy'i 'alaa sab'aai aa'zumin wanuhiya aan yakuffa sha'rahu wathiyaabahu alkaffayni waalrrukbatayni waalqadamayni waaljabhaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) had been commanded that he should prostrate on the seven (bones) and he was forbidden to fold back the hair and clothing. And in the narration transmitted by Abu Rabi' (the words are):" on the seven bones and I was forbidden to fold back the hair and clothing". According to Abu'l-Rabi' (the seven bones are): The hands, the knees, and the (extremities) of the feet and the forehead
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ وَلاَ أَكُفَّ ثَوْبًا وَلاَ شَعْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aumirtu aan aasjuda 'alaa sab'aai aa'zumin walaa aakuffa thawbana walaa sha'rana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ):I was commanded to prostrate myself on seven bones and not to fold back clothing or hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أُمِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعٍ وَنُهِيَ أَنْ يَكْفِتَ الشَّعْرَ وَالثِّيَابَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aumira alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yasjuda 'alaa sab'in wanuhiya aan yakfita alshha'ra waalthhiyaaba ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had been commanded to prostrate on seven (bones) and forbidden to fold back hair and clothing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ الْجَبْهَةِ - وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ - وَالْيَدَيْنِ وَالرِّجْلَيْنِ وَأَطْرَافِ الْقَدَمَيْنِ وَلاَ نَكْفِتَ الثِّيَابَ وَلاَ الشَّعْرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu taawusin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aumirtu aan aasjuda 'alaa sab'aai aa'zumin aljabhaai - waaashaara biyadihi 'alaa aanfihi - waalyadayni waalrrijlayni waaatraafi alqadamayni walaa nakfita althhiyaaba walaa alshha'ra ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:I have been commanded to prostrate myself on seven bones:" forehead," and then pointed with his hand towards his nose, hands, feet, and the extremities of the feet; and we were forbidden to fold back clothing and hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعٍ وَلاَ أَكْفِتَ الشَّعْرَ وَلاَ الثِّيَابَ الْجَبْهَةِ وَالأَنْفِ وَالْيَدَيْنِ وَالرُّكْبَتَيْنِ وَالْقَدَمَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy abnu jurayjin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aumirtu aan aasjuda 'alaa sab'in walaa aakfita alshha'ra walaa althhiyaaba aljabhaai waalaanfi waalyadayni waalrrukbatayni waalqadamayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I was commanded to prostrate myself on the seven (bones) and forbidden to fold back hair and clothing. (The seven bones are): forehead, nose, hands, knees and feet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُضَرَ - عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَجَدَ الْعَبْدُ سَجَدَ مَعَهُ سَبْعَةُ أَطْرَافٍ وَجْهُهُ وَكَفَّاهُ وَرُكْبَتَاهُ وَقَدَمَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa bakrun, - wahuwa abnu mudara - 'ani abni alhaadi, 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din, 'ani al'abbaasi bni 'abdi almuttalibi, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa sajada al'abdu sajada ma'ahu sab'aau aatraafin wajhuhu wakaffaahu warukbataahu waqadamaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It was narrated from Al-'Abbas bin 'Abdul Muttalib that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say:"When a person prostates, he prostates on seven part of the body: His face, his hands, his knees and his feet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ كُرَيْبًا مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ يُصَلِّي وَرَأْسُهُ مَعْقُوصٌ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ فَقَامَ فَجَعَلَ يَحُلُّهُ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ أَقْبَلَ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ مَا لَكَ وَرَأْسِي فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ هَذَا مَثَلُ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ مَكْتُوفٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu sawwaadin al'aamiriyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, aanna bukayrana, haddathahu aanna kuraybana mawlaa abni 'abbaasin haddathahu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, aannahu raaaa 'abda alllahi bna alhaarithi yusalliy waraasuhu ma'quwsun min waraaiihi faqaama faja'ala yahulluhu falammaa ansarafa aaqbala iilaa abni 'abbaasin faqaala maa laka waraasiy faqaala iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnamaa mathalu hadhaa mathalu alladhiy yusalliy wahuwa maktuwfun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abbas reported that he saw 'Abdullah b. al-Harith observing the prayer and (his hair) was plaited behind his head. He ('Abdullah b. 'Abbas) stood up and unfolded them. While going back (from the prayer) he met Ibn 'Abbas and said to him:Why is it that you touched my head? He (Ibn 'Abbas) replied: (The man who observes prayer with plaited hair) is like one who prays with his hands tied behind
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اعْتَدِلُوا فِي السُّجُودِ وَلاَ يَبْسُطْ أَحَدُكُمْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ انْبِسَاطَ الْكَلْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ a'tadiluwa fiy alssujuwdi walaa yabsut aahadukum dhiraa'ayhi anbisaata alkalbi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Observe moderation in prostration, and let none of you stretch out his forearms (on the ground) like a dog
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ‏ "‏ وَلاَ يَتَبَسَّطْ أَحَدُكُمْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ انْبِسَاطَ الْكَلْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h qaala wahaddathaniyhi yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythi abni ja'farin ‏ "‏ walaa yatabassat aahadukum dhiraa'ayhi anbisaata alkalbi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters. And in the hidith transmitted by Ibn Ja'far (the words are):" None of you should stretch out his forearms like the stretching out of a dog
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِيَادٍ، عَنْ إِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَجَدْتَ فَضَعْ كَفَّيْكَ وَارْفَعْ مِرْفَقَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu iiyaadin, 'an iiyaadin, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa sajadta fada' kaffayka waarfa' mirfaqayka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bira' (b. 'Azib) reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. When you prostrate yourself, place the palms of your hands on the ground and raise your elbows
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُضَرَ - عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى فَرَّجَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ بَيَاضُ إِبْطَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa bakrun, - wahuwa abnu mudara - 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni maalikin abni buhaynaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa sallaa farraja bayna yadayhi hattaa yabduwa bayaadu iibtayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Malik ibn Bujainah reported:When the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated, lie spread out his arms so that the whiteness of his armpits was visible
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَاللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَجَدَ يُجَنِّحُ فِي سُجُودِهِ حَتَّى يُرَى وَضَحُ إِبْطَيْهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ اللَّيْثِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا سَجَدَ فَرَّجَ يَدَيْهِ عَنْ إِبْطَيْهِ حَتَّى إِنِّي لأَرَى بَيَاضَ إِبْطَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu sawwaadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, waalllaythu bnu sa'din, kilaahumaa 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai 'amriw bni alhaarithi kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sajada yujannihu fiy sujuwdihi hattaa yuraa wadahu iibtayhi ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai alllaythi aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa sajada farraja yadayhi 'an iibtayhi hattaa iinniy laaraa bayaada iibtayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ja'far b. Rabi' with the same chain of transmitters. And in the narration transmitted by 'Amr b. al-Harith (the words are):" When the Messenger of Allah (rtiay peace be upon him) prostrated, he spread out his arms so that the whiteness of his armpits was visible." And in the narration transmitted by al-Laith (the words are:" When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated. he spread his hands from the armpits so that I saw their whiteness
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، يَزِيدَ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَجَدَ لَوْ شَاءَتْ بَهْمَةٌ أَنْ تَمُرَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ لَمَرَّتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alaasammi, 'an 'ammihi, yaziyda bni alaasammi 'an maymuwnaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sajada law shaa'at bahmaaun aan tamurra bayna yadayhi lamarrat ‏.‏
verses.translation: Maimuna reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated himself, if a lamb wanted to pass between his arms, it could pass
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَجَدَ خَوَّى بِيَدَيْهِ - يَعْنِي جَنَّحَ - حَتَّى يُرَى وَضَحُ إِبْطَيْهِ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ وَإِذَا قَعَدَ اطْمَأَنَّ عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُسْرَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa alfazaariyyu, qaala haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alaasammi, 'an yaziyda bni alaasammi, aannahu aakhbarahu 'an maymuwnaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sajada khawwaa biyadayhi - ya'niy jannaha - hattaa yuraa wadahu iibtayhi min waraaiihi waiidhaa qa'ada atmaaanna 'alaa fakhidhihi alyusraa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Maimuna, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated himself, he spread his arms, i. e. he separated them so much that the whiteness of his armpits became visible from behind and when he sat (for Jalsa) he rested on his left thigh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَجَدَ جَافَى حَتَّى يَرَى مَنْ خَلْفَهُ وَضَحَ إِبْطَيْهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكِيعٌ يَعْنِي بَيَاضَهُمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu li'amrinw - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa ja'faru bnu burqaana, 'an yaziyda bni alaasammi, 'an maymuwnaaa binti alhaarithi, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sajada jaafaa hattaa yaraa man khalfahu wadaha iibtayhi ‏.‏ qaala wakiy'un ya'niy bayaadahumaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Maimuna daughter of Harith reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated, he kept his hands so much apart from each other that when it was seen from behind the armpits became visible. Waki' said: That is their whiteness
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ، - يَعْنِي الأَحْمَرَ - عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، عَنْ بُدَيْلِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْجَوْزَاءِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَفْتِحُ الصَّلاَةَ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةَ بِـ ‏{‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}‏ وَكَانَ إِذَا رَكَعَ لَمْ يُشْخِصْ رَأْسَهُ وَلَمْ يُصَوِّبْهُ وَلِكَنْ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ وَكَانَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ حَتَّى يَسْتَوِيَ قَائِمًا وَكَانَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السَّجْدَةِ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ حَتَّى يَسْتَوِيَ جَالِسًا وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ التَّحِيَّةَ وَكَانَ يَفْرِشُ رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى وَيَنْصِبُ رِجْلَهُ الْيُمْنَى وَكَانَ يَنْهَى عَنْ عُقْبَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَيَنْهَى أَنْ يَفْتَرِشَ الرَّجُلُ ذِرَاعَيْهِ افْتِرَاشَ السَّبُعِ وَكَانَ يَخْتِمُ الصَّلاَةَ بِالتَّسْلِيمِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ وَكَانَ يَنْهَى عَنْ عَقِبِ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin, - ya'niy alaahmara - 'an husaynin almu'allimi, h qaala wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa husaynun almu'allimu, 'an budayli bni maysaraaa, 'an aabiy aljawzaa'i, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yastaftihu alssalaaaa bialttakbiyri waalqiraa'aaa bi ‏{‏ alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'aalamiyna‏}‏ wakaana iidhaa raka'a lam yushkhis raasahu walam yusawwibhu walikan bayna dhalika wakaana iidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i lam yasjud hattaa yastawiya qaaiimana wakaana iidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alssajdaai lam yasjud hattaa yastawiya jaalisana wakaana yaquwlu fiy kulli rak'atayni alttahiyyaaa wakaana yafrishu rijlahu alyusraa wayansibu rijlahu alyumnaa wakaana yanhaa 'an 'uqbaai alshhaytaani wayanhaa aan yaftarisha alrrajulu dhiraa'ayhi aftiraasha alssabu'i wakaana yakhtimu alssalaaaa bialttasliymi ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni numayrin 'an aabiy khaalidin wakaana yanhaa 'an 'aqibi alshhaytaani ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to begin prayer with takbir (saying Allahu Akbar) and the recitation: "Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe." When he bowed he neither kept his head up nor bent it down, but kept it between these extremes; when he raised his head after bowing he did not prostrate himself till he had stood erect; when he raised his head after prostration he did not prostrate himself again till he sat up. At the end of every two rak'ahs he recited the tahiyya; and he used to place his left foot flat (on the ground) and raise up the right; he prohibited the devil's way of sitting on the heels, and he forbade people to spread out their arms like a wild beast. And he used to finish the prayer with the taslim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا وَضَعَ أَحَدُكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِثْلَ مُؤْخِرَةِ الرَّحْلِ فَلْيُصَلِّ وَلاَ يُبَالِ مَنْ مَرَّ وَرَاءَ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an simaakin, 'an muwsaa bni talhaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa wada'a aahadukum bayna yadayhi mithla muukhiraai alrrahli falyusalli walaa yubaali man marra waraa'a dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Musa b. Talha reported it on the authority of his father:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When one of you places in front of him so me. thing such as the back of a saddle, he should pray without caring who passes on the other side of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الطَّنَافِسِيُّ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي وَالدَّوَابُّ تَمُرُّ بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مِثْلُ مُؤْخِرَةِ الرَّحْلِ تَكُونُ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ أَحَدِكُمْ ثُمَّ لاَ يَضُرُّهُ مَا مَرَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ ‏"‏ فَلاَ يَضُرُّهُ مَنْ مَرَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu numayrin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu 'ubaydin alttanaafisiyyu, 'an simaaki bni harbin, 'an muwsaa bni talhaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kunnaa nusalliy waalddawaabbu tamurru bayna aaydiynaa fadhakarnaa dhalika lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ mithlu muukhiraai alrrahli takuwnu bayna yadaa aahadikum thumma laa yadurruhu maa marra bayna yadayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala abnu numayrin ‏"‏ falaa yadurruhu man marra bayna yadayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Musa b. Talha reported on the authority of his father:We used to say prayer and the animals moved in front of us. We mentioned it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: If anything equal to the back of a saddle is in front of you, then what walks in front, no harm would come to him. Ibn Numair said: No harm would come whosoever walks in front
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ سُتْرَةِ الْمُصَلِّي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مِثْلُ مُؤْخِرَةِ الرَّحْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, aakhbaranaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy aayyuwba, 'an aabiy alaaswadi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an sutraai almusalliy faqaala ‏ "‏ mithlu muukhiraai alrrahli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about sutra of a worshipper; he said: Equal to the back of the saddle
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَيْوَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ عَنْ سُتْرَةِ الْمُصَلِّي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كَمُؤْخِرَةِ الرَّحْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, aakhbaranaa haywaau, 'an aabiy alaaswadi, muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm suiila fiy ghazwaai tabuwka 'an sutraai almusalliy faqaala ‏ "‏ kamuukhiraai alrrahli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked in the expedition of Tabuk about the sutra the worshipper; he said: Like the back of the saddle
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا خَرَجَ يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ أَمَرَ بِالْحَرْبَةِ فَتُوضَعُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَيُصَلِّي إِلَيْهَا وَالنَّاسُ وَرَاءَهُ وَكَانَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فِي السَّفَرِ فَمِنْ ثَمَّ اتَّخَذَهَا الأُمَرَاءُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa kharaja yawma al'iydi aamara bialharbaai fatuwda'u bayna yadayhi fayusalliy iilayhaa waalnnaasu waraa'ahu wakaana yaf'alu dhalika fiy alssafari famin thamma attakhadhahaa alaumaraa'u ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:When the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) went out on the 'Id day, he ordered to carry a spear-and it was fixed in front of him, and he said prayer towards its (direction), and the people were behind him. And he did it in the journey, and that is the reason why the Amirs carried it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَرْكُزُ - وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَغْرِزُ - الْعَنَزَةَ وَيُصَلِّي إِلَيْهَا ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ وَهْىَ الْحَرْبَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yarkuzu - waqaala aabuw bakrin yaghrizu - al'anazaaa wayusalliy iilayhaa ‏.‏ zaada abnu aabiy shaybaaa qaala 'ubaydu alllahi wahaa alharbaau ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) set up (sutra), and Abu Bakr said: He implanted iron-tipped spear and said prayer towards its direction. Ibn Abu Shaiba made this addition to it:" Ubaidullah said that it was a spear
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَعْرِضُ رَاحِلَتَهُ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي إِلَيْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu hanbalin, haddathanaa mu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana ya'ridu raahilatahu wahuwa yusalliy iilayhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar said:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to place his camel (towards the Ka'ba) and said prayer in its direction
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي إِلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى إِلَى بَعِيرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy iilaa raahilatihi ‏.‏ waqaala abnu numayrin iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa iilaa ba'iyrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to say prayer towards his camel. Ibn Numair said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer towards the camel
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْنُ بْنُ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَكَّةَ وَهُوَ بِالأَبْطَحِ فِي قُبَّةٍ لَهُ حَمْرَاءَ مِنْ أَدَمٍ - قَالَ - فَخَرَجَ بِلاَلٌ بِوَضُوئِهِ فَمِنْ نَائِلٍ وَنَاضِحٍ - قَالَ - فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهِ حُلَّةٌ حَمْرَاءُ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى بَيَاضِ سَاقَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَتَوَضَّأَ وَأَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلْتُ أَتَتَبَّعُ فَاهُ هَا هُنَا وَهَا هُنَا - يَقُولُ يَمِينًا وَشِمَالاً - يَقُولُ حَىَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ حَىَّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ رُكِزَتْ لَهُ عَنَزَةٌ فَتَقَدَّمَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يَمُرُّ بَيْنْ يَدَيْهِ الْحِمَارُ وَالْكَلْبُ لاَ يُمْنَعُ ثُمَّ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَزَلْ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى رَجَعَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'an wakiy'in, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa wakiy'un, - haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa 'awnu bnu aabiy juhayfaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm bimakkaaa wahuwa bialaabtahi fiy qubbaain lahu hamraa'a min aadamin - qaala - fakharaja bilaalun biwaduwiihi famin naaiilin wanaadihin - qaala - fakharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alayhi hullaaun hamraa'u kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa bayaadi saaqayhi - qaala - fatawaddaaa waaadhhana bilaalun - qaala - faja'altu aatatabba'u faahu haa hunaa wahaa hunaa - yaquwlu yamiynana washimaalaan - yaquwlu haaaa 'alaa alssalaaai haaaa 'alaa alfalaahi - qaala - thumma rukizat lahu 'anazaaun fataqaddama fasallaa alzzuhra rak'atayni yamurru bayn yadayhi alhimaaru waalkalbu laa yumna'u thumma sallaa al'asra rak'atayni thumma lam yazal yusalliy rak'atayni hattaa raja'a iilaa almadiynaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Juhaifa reported it on the authority of his father:I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in Mecca and he was (at that time) at al- Abtah in a red leather tent. And Bilal stepped out with ablution water for him. (And what was left out of that water) some of them got it (whereas others could not get it) and (those who got it) rubbed themselves with it. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stepped out with a red mantle on him and I was catching a glimpse of the whiteness of his shanks. The narrator said: He (the Holy Prophet) performed the ablution. and Bilal pronounced Adhan and I followed his mouth (as he turned) this side and that as he said on the right and the left:" Come to prayer, come to success." ' A spear was then fixed for him (on the ground). He stepped forward and said two rak'ahs of Zuhr, while there passed in front of him a donkey and a dog, and these were not checked. He then said two rak'ahs of the 'Asr prayer, and he then continued saying two rak'ahs till he came back to Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْنُ بْنُ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي قُبَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ مِنْ أَدَمٍ وَرَأَيْتُ بِلاَلاً أَخْرَجَ وَضُوءًا فَرَأَيْتُ النَّاسَ يَبْتَدِرُونَ ذَلِكَ الْوَضُوءَ فَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا تَمَسَّحَ بِهِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُصِبْ مِنْهُ أَخَذَ مِنْ بَلَلِ يَدِ صَاحِبِهِ ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُ بِلاَلاً أَخْرَجَ عَنَزَةً فَرَكَزَهَا وَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حُلَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ مُشَمِّرًا فَصَلَّى إِلَى الْعَنَزَةِ بِالنَّاسِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَرَأَيْتُ النَّاسَ وَالدَّوَابَّ يَمُرُّونَ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ الْعَنَزَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, haddathanaa 'awnu bnu aabiy juhayfaaa, aanna aabaahu, raaaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy qubbaain hamraa'a min aadamin waraaaytu bilaalaan aakhraja waduw'ana faraaaytu alnnaasa yabtadiruwna dhalika alwaduw'a faman aasaaba minhu shayiana tamassaha bihi waman lam yusib minhu aakhadha min balali yadi saahibihi thumma raaaytu bilaalaan aakhraja 'anazaaan farakazahaa wakharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hullaain hamraa'a mushammirana fasallaa iilaa al'anazaai bialnnaasi rak'atayni waraaaytu alnnaasa waalddawaabba yamurruwna bayna yadaai al'anazaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Juhaifa reported on the authority of his father:I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (in Mecca at al-Abtah) in a red leather tent. and I saw Bilal take the ablution water (left by Allah's Messenger), and I saw the people racing, with one another to get that ablution water. If anyone got some of it, he rubbed himself with it, and anyone who did not get any got some of the moisture from his companion's hand. I then saw Bilal take a staff and fix it in the ground, after which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out quickly in a red mantle and led the people in two rak'ahs facing the staff, and I saw people and animals passing in front of the staff
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ وَعُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ يَزِيدُ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بِالْهَاجِرَةِ خَرَجَ بِلاَلٌ فَنَادَى بِالصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa ja'faru bnu 'awnin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'umaysin, h qaala wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaaiidaaa, qaala haddathanaa maaliku bnu mighwalin, kilaahumaa 'an 'awni bni aabiy juhayfaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythi sufyaana wa'umara bni aabiy zaaiidaaa yaziydu ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din wafiy hadiythi maaliki bni mighwalin falammaa kaana bialhaajiraai kharaja bilaalun fanaadaa bialssalaaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aun b. Abu Juhaifa narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of his father a hadith like that of Sufyan, and 'Umar b. Abu Za'ida made this addition:Some of them tried to excel the others (in obtaining water), and in the hadith transmitted by Malik b. Mighwal (the words are): When it was noon, Bilal came out and summoned (people) to (noon) prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جُحَيْفَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْهَاجِرَةِ إِلَى الْبَطْحَاءِ فَتَوَضَّأَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَالْعَصْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ عَنَزَةٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَزَادَ فِيهِ عَوْنٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ وَكَانَ يَمُرُّ مِنْ وَرَائِهَا الْمَرْأَةُ وَالْحِمَارُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, qaala sami'tu aabaa juhayfaaa, qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhaajiraai iilaa albathaa'i fatawaddaaa fasallaa alzzuhra rak'atayni waal'asra rak'atayni wabayna yadayhi 'anazaaun ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau wazaada fiyhi 'awnun 'an aabiyhi aabiy juhayfaaa wakaana yamurru min waraaiihaa almaraaau waalhimaaru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Juhaifa reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went at noon towards al-Batha', he performed ablution, and said two rak'ahs of the Zuhr prayer and two of the 'Asr prayer, and there was a spear in front of him. Shu'ba said and Aun made this addition to it on the authority of his father Abu Juhaifa: And the woman and the donkey passed behind it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ الْحَكَمِ فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَأْخُذُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ وَضُوئِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa shu'baau, bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana mithlahu ‏.‏ wazaada fiy hadiythi alhakami faja'ala alnnaasu yaakhudhuwna min fadli waduwiihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shu'ba narrated the same on the basis of two authorities and in the hadith transmitted by Hakam (the words are):The people began to get water that was left out of his (the Prophet's) ablution
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَقْبَلْتُ رَاكِبًا عَلَى أَتَانٍ وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ، قَدْ نَاهَزْتُ الاِحْتِلاَمَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ بِمِنًى فَمَرَرْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ الصَّفِّ فَنَزَلْتُ فَأَرْسَلْتُ الأَتَانَ تَرْتَعُ وَدَخَلْتُ فِي الصَّفِّ فَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ ذَلِكَ عَلَىَّ أَحَدٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala aaqbaltu raakibana 'alaa aataanin waaanaa yawmaiidhin, qad naahaztu alaihtilaama warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy bialnnaasi biminana famarartu bayna yadaai alssaffi fanazaltu faaarsaltu alaataana tarta'u wadakhaltu fiy alssaffi falam yunkir dhalika 'alaaaa aahadun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:I came riding on a she-ass, and I was on the threshold of maturity, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was leading people in prayer at Mina. I passed in front of the row and got down, and sent the she-ass for grazing and joined the row, and nobody made any objection to it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، أَقْبَلَ يَسِيرُ عَلَى حِمَارٍ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي بِمِنًى فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ - قَالَ - فَسَارَ الْحِمَارُ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ بَعْضِ الصَّفِّ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ عَنْهُ فَصَفَّ مَعَ النَّاسِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, aakhbarahu aannahu, aaqbala yasiyru 'alaa himaarin warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun yusalliy biminana fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i yusalliy bialnnaasi - qaala - fasaara alhimaaru bayna yadaa ba'di alssaffi thumma nazala 'anhu fasaffa ma'a alnnaasi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abbas reported that he came riding on a donkey, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was leading the people in prayer at Mina on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and (the narrator) reported:The donkey passed in front of the row and then he got down from it And joined the row along with the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي بِعَرَفَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy bi'arafaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn 'Uyaina on the authority of al-Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters and he reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) was leading prayer at 'Arafa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِيهِ مِنًى وَلاَ عَرَفَةَ وَقَالَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ أَوْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ walam yadhkur fiyhi minana walaa 'arafaaa waqaala fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i aaw yawma alfathi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported by Ma'mar on the authority of al-Zuhri with the came chain of transmitters, but here no mention has been made of Mina or 'Arafa, and he said:It was in the Farewell Pilgrimage or on the Day of Victory
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ يُصَلِّي فَلاَ يَدَعْ أَحَدًا يَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلْيَدْرَأْهُ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُقَاتِلْهُ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْطَانٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa kaana aahadukum yusalliy falaa yada' aahadana yamurru bayna yadayhi walyadraahu maa astataa'a faiin aabaa falyuqaatilhu faiinnamaa huwa shaytaanun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:When any one of you prays he should not let anyone pass in front of him (if there is no sutra), and should try to turn him away as far as possible, but if he refuses to go, he should turn him away forcibly for he is a devil
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ هِلاَلٍ، - يَعْنِي حُمَيْدًا - قَالَ بَيْنَمَا أَنَا وَصَاحِبٌ، لِي نَتَذَاكَرُ حَدِيثًا إِذْ قَالَ أَبُو صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانُ أَنَا أُحَدِّثُكَ، مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، وَرَأَيْتُ، مِنْهُ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا أَنَا مَعَ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، يُصَلِّي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى شَىْءٍ يَسْتُرُهُ مِنَ النَّاسِ إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ شَابٌّ مِنْ بَنِي أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَجْتَازَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَدَفَعَ فِي نَحْرِهِ فَنَظَرَ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ مَسَاغًا إِلاَّ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ فَعَادَ فَدَفَعَ فِي نَحْرِهِ أَشَدَّ مِنَ الدَّفْعَةِ الأُولَى فَمَثَلَ قَائِمًا فَنَالَ مِنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ثُمَّ زَاحَمَ النَّاسَ فَخَرَجَ فَدَخَلَ عَلَى مَرْوَانَ فَشَكَا إِلَيْهِ مَا لَقِيَ - قَالَ - وَدَخَلَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ عَلَى مَرْوَانَ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَرْوَانُ مَا لَكَ وَلاِبْنِ أَخِيكَ جَاءَ يَشْكُوكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا صَلَّى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى شَىْءٍ يَسْتُرُهُ مِنَ النَّاسِ فَأَرَادَ أَحَدٌ أَنْ يَجْتَازَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَلْيَدْفَعْ فِي نَحْرِهِ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُقَاتِلْهُ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْطَانٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, haddathanaa abnu hilaalin, - ya'niy humaydana - qaala baynamaa aanaa wasaahibun, liy natadhaakaru hadiythana iidh qaala aabuw saalihin alssammaanu aanaa auhaddithuka, maa sami'tu min aabiy sa'iydin, waraaaytu, minhu qaala baynamaa aanaa ma'a aabiy sa'iydin, yusalliy yawma aljumu'aai iilaa shaa'in yasturuhu mina alnnaasi iidh jaa'a rajulun shaabbun min baniy aabiy mu'aytin aaraada aan yajtaaza bayna yadayhi fadafa'a fiy nahrihi fanazara falam yajid masaaghana iilaaa bayna yadaa aabiy sa'iydin fa'aada fadafa'a fiy nahrihi aashadda mina alddaf'aai alauwlaa famathala qaaiimana fanaala min aabiy sa'iydin thumma zaahama alnnaasa fakharaja fadakhala 'alaa marwaana fashakaa iilayhi maa laqiya - qaala - wadakhala aabuw sa'iydin 'alaa marwaana faqaala lahu marwaanu maa laka walaibni aakhiyka jaa'a yashkuwka ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw sa'iydin sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa sallaa aahadukum iilaa shaa'in yasturuhu mina alnnaasi faaaraada aahadun aan yajtaaza bayna yadayhi falyadfa' fiy nahrihi faiin aabaa falyuqaatilhu faiinnamaa huwa shaytaanun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Salih al-Samman reported:I narrate to you what I heard and saw from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: One day I was with Abu Sa'id and he was saying prayer on Friday turning to a thing which concealed him from the people when a young man from Banu Mu'ait came there and he tried to pass in front of him; he turned him back by striking his chest. He looked about but finding no other way to pass except in front of Abu Sa'id, made a second attempt. He (Abu Sa'id) turned him away by Striking his chest more vigorously than the first stroke. He stood up and had a scuffle with Abu Sa'id. Then the people gathered there He came out and went to Marwan and complained to him what had happened to him. Abu Sa'id too came to Marwan. Marwin said to him: What has happened to you and the son of your brother that he came to complain against you? Abu Sa'id said: I heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: When any one of you prays facing something which conceals him from people and anyone tries to pass in front of him, he should be turned away, but if he refuses, he should be forcibly restrained from it, for he is a devil
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ صَدَقَةَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ يُصَلِّي فَلاَ يَدَعْ أَحَدًا يَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُقَاتِلْهُ فَإِنَّ مَعَهُ الْقَرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
