verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa alddahhaaku bnu makhladin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alhamiydi bnu ja'farin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an mahmuwdi bni labiydin, aanna 'uthmaana bna 'affaana, aaraada binaa'a almasjidi fakariha alnnaasu dhalika faaahabbuwa aan yada'ahu 'alaa hayiatihi faqaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man banaa masjidana lillahi banaa alllahu lahu fiy aljannaai mithlahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mahmud b. Labid reported:When 'Uthman b. 'Affan intended to build the mosque (of the Prophet) the people did not approve of it. They liked that it should be kept in the same state. Thereupon he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: He who built a mosque for Allah, Allah would build a house for him like it in Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، وَعَلْقَمَةَ، قَالاَ أَتَيْنَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فِي دَارِهِ فَقَالَ أَصَلَّى هَؤُلاَءِ خَلْفَكُمْ فَقُلْنَا لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُومُوا فَصَلُّوا ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا بِأَذَانٍ وَلاَ إِقَامَةٍ - قَالَ - وَذَهَبْنَا لِنَقُومَ خَلْفَهُ فَأَخَذَ بِأَيْدِينَا فَجَعَلَ أَحَدَنَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَالآخَرَ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا رَكَعَ وَضَعْنَا أَيْدِيَنَا عَلَى رُكَبِنَا - قَالَ - فَضَرَبَ أَيْدِيَنَا وَطَبَّقَ بَيْنَ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَهُمَا بَيْنَ فَخِذَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا صَلَّى قَالَ إِنَّهُ سَتَكُونُ عَلَيْكُمْ أُمَرَاءُ يُؤَخِّرُونَ الصَّلاَةَ عَنْ مِيقَاتِهَا وَيَخْنُقُونَهَا إِلَى شَرَقِ الْمَوْتَى فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُمْ قَدْ فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ فَصَلُّوا الصَّلاَةَ لِمِيقَاتِهَا وَاجْعَلُوا صَلاَتَكُمْ مَعَهُمْ سُبْحَةً وَإِذَا كُنْتُمْ ثَلاَثَةً فَصَلُّوا جَمِيعًا وَإِذَا كُنْتُمْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَلْيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَفْرِشْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ عَلَى فَخِذَيْهِ وَلْيَجْنَأْ وَلْيُطَبِّقْ بَيْنَ كَفَّيْهِ فَلَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى اخْتِلاَفِ أَصَابِعِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرَاهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu aabuw kuraybin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, wa'alqamaaa, qaalaa aataynaa 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin fiy daarihi faqaala aasallaa hauulaa'i khalfakum faqulnaa laa ‏.‏ qaala faquwmuwa fasalluwa ‏.‏ falam yaamurnaa biaadhaanin walaa iiqaamaain - qaala - wadhahabnaa linaquwma khalfahu faaakhadha biaaydiynaa faja'ala aahadanaa 'an yamiynihi waalakhara 'an shimaalihi - qaala - falammaa raka'a wada'naa aaydiyanaa 'alaa rukabinaa - qaala - fadaraba aaydiyanaa watabbaqa bayna kaffayhi thumma aadkhalahumaa bayna fakhidhayhi - qaala - falammaa sallaa qaala iinnahu satakuwnu 'alaykum aumaraa'u yuuakhhiruwna alssalaaaa 'an miyqaatihaa wayakhnuquwnahaa iilaa sharaqi almawtaa faiidhaa raaaytumuwhum qad fa'aluwa dhalika fasalluwa alssalaaaa limiyqaatihaa waaj'aluwa salaatakum ma'ahum subhaaan waiidhaa kuntum thalaathaaan fasalluwa jamiy'ana waiidhaa kuntum aakthara min dhalika falyauummakum aahadukum waiidhaa raka'a aahadukum falyafrish dhiraa'ayhi 'alaa fakhidhayhi walyajnaa walyutabbiq bayna kaffayhi falakaaanniy aanzuru iilaa akhtilaafi aasaabi'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaraahum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Aswad and 'Alqama reported:We came to the house of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud. He said: Have these people said prayer behind you? We said: No. He said: Then stand up and say prayer. He neither ordered us to say Adhan nor Iqama. We went to stand behind him. He caught hold of our hands and mode one of us stand on his right hand and the other on his left side. When we bowed, we placed our hands on our knees. He struck our hands and put his hands together, palm to palm, then put them between his thighs. When he completed the prayer he said. There would soon come your Amirs, who would defer prayers from their appointed time and would make such delay that a little time is left before sunset. So when you see them doing so, say prayer at its appointed time and then say prayer along with them as (Nafl), and when you are three, pray together (standing in one row), and when you are more than three, appoint one amongst you as your Imam. And when any one of you bows he must place his hands upon hie thighs and kneel down. and putting his palms together place (them within his thighs). I perceive as if I am seeing the gap between the fingers of the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُفَضَّلٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَالأَسْوَدِ، أَنَّهُمَا دَخَلاَ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ وَجَرِيرٍ فَلَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى اخْتِلاَفِ أَصَابِعِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ رَاكِعٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu mushirin, h qaala wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, h qaala wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa mufaddalun, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, waalaaswadi, aannahumaa dakhalaa 'alaa 'abdi alllahi ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni mushirin wajariyrin falakaaanniy aanzuru iilaa akhtilaafi aasaabi'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa raaki'un ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Alqama and Aswad by another chain of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted by Ibn Mus-hir and Jabir the words are:" I perceive as if I am seeing the gap between the fingers of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was bowing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَالأَسْوَدِ، أَنَّهُمَا دَخَلاَ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ أَصَلَّى مَنْ خَلْفَكُمْ قَالاَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَجَعَلَ أَحَدَهُمَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَالآخَرَ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ ثُمَّ رَكَعْنَا فَوَضَعْنَا أَيْدِيَنَا عَلَى رُكَبِنَا فَضَرَبَ أَيْدِيَنَا ثُمَّ طَبَّقَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ جَعَلَهُمَا بَيْنَ فَخِذَيْهِ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى قَالَ هَكَذَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, waalaaswadi, aannahumaa dakhalaa 'alaa 'abdi alllahi faqaala aasallaa man khalfakum qaalaa na'am ‏.‏ faqaama baynahumaa waja'ala aahadahumaa 'an yamiynihi waalakhara 'an shimaalihi thumma raka'naa fawada'naa aaydiyanaa 'alaa rukabinaa fadaraba aaydiyanaa thumma tabbaqa bayna yadayhi thumma ja'alahumaa bayna fakhidhayhi falammaa sallaa qaala hakadhaa fa'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Alqama and Aswad reported that they went to 'Abdullah. He said:Have (people) behind you said prayer? They said: Yes. He stood between them ('Alqama and Aswad). One was on his right aide and the other was on his left. We then bowed and placed our hands on our knees. He struck our hands and then putting his hands together, palm to palm, placed them between his thighs. When he completed the prayer he said: This is how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِ أَبِي قَالَ وَجَعَلْتُ يَدَىَّ بَيْنَ رُكْبَتَىَّ فَقَالَ لِي أَبِي اضْرِبْ بِكَفَّيْكَ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى فَضَرَبَ يَدَىَّ وَقَالَ إِنَّا نُهِينَا عَنْ هَذَا وَأُمِرْنَا أَنْ نَضْرِبَ بِالأَكُفِّ عَلَى الرُّكَبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu - waalllafzu liqutaybaaa - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy ya'fuwrin, 'an mus'abi bni sa'din, qaala sallaytu iilaa janbi aabiy qaala waja'altu yadaaaa bayna rukbataaaa faqaala liy aabiy adrib bikaffayka 'alaa rukbatayka ‏.‏ qaala thumma fa'altu dhalika marraaan aukhraa fadaraba yadaaaa waqaala iinnaa nuhiynaa 'an hadhaa waaumirnaa aan nadriba bialaakuffi 'alaa alrrukabi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported:I said prayer by the side of my father and placed my hands between my knees. My father said to me: Place your hands on your knees. I repeated that (the previous act) for the second time, and he struck at my hands and said: We have been forbidden to do so and have been commanded to place our palms on the knees
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ فَنُهِينَا عَنْهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرَا مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, h qaala wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy ya'fuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi iilaa qawlihi fanuhiynaa 'anhu ‏.‏ walam yadhkuraa maa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Ya'fur with the same chain of transmitters up to these words:We have been forbidden from it and no mention of that has been made what follows it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ رَكَعْتُ فَقُلْتُ بِيَدَىَّ هَكَذَا - يَعْنِي طَبَّقَ بِهِمَا وَوَضَعَهُمَا بَيْنَ فَخِذَيْهِ - فَقَالَ أَبِي قَدْ كُنَّا نَفْعَلُ هَذَا ثُمَّ أُمِرْنَا بِالرُّكَبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'ani alzzubayri bni 'adiyyin, 'an mus'abi bni sa'din, qaala raka'tu faqultu biyadaaaa hakadhaa - ya'niy tabbaqa bihimaa wawada'ahumaa bayna fakhidhayhi - faqaala aabiy qad kunnaa naf'alu hadhaa thumma aumirnaa bialrrukabi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Sa'd reported:I bowed and my hands were in this state, i. e. they were put together, palm to palm, and were placed between his thighs. My father said: We used to do like this but were later on commanded to place them on the knees
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِ أَبِي فَلَمَّا رَكَعْتُ شَبَّكْتُ أَصَابِعِي وَجَعَلْتُهُمَا بَيْنَ رُكْبَتَىَّ فَضَرَبَ يَدَىَّ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى قَالَ قَدْ كُنَّا نَفْعَلُ هَذَا ثُمَّ أُمِرْنَا أَنْ نَرْفَعَ إِلَى الرُّكَبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhakamu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy khaalidin, 'ani alzzubayri bni 'adiyyin, 'ani mus'abi bni sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, qaala sallaytu iilaa janbi aabiy falammaa raka'tu shabbaktu aasaabi'iy waja'altuhumaa bayna rukbataaaa fadaraba yadaaaa falammaa sallaa qaala qad kunnaa naf'alu hadhaa thumma aumirnaa aan narfa'a iilaa alrrukabi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mus'ab b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported:I said prayer by the side of my father. When I bowed I intertwined my fingers and placed them between my knees. He struck my hands. When he completed the prayer he said: We used to do that but then were commanded to lift (our palms) to the knees
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - قَالاَ جَمِيعًا أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ طَاوُسًا يَقُولُ قُلْنَا لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الإِقْعَاءِ عَلَى الْقَدَمَيْنِ فَقَالَ هِيَ السُّنَّةُ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ إِنَّا لَنَرَاهُ جَفَاءً بِالرَّجُلِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بَلْ هِيَ سُنَّةُ نَبِيِّكَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, h qaala wahaddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, - wataqaarabaa fiy alllafzi - qaalaa jamiy'ana aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri aannahu sami'a taawusana yaquwlu qulnaa laibni 'abbaasin fiy aliiq'aa'i 'alaa alqadamayni faqaala hiya alssunnaau ‏.‏ faqulnaa lahu iinnaa lanaraahu jafaa'an bialrrajuli ‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'abbaasin bal hiya sunnaau nabiyyika sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tawus reported:We asked Ibn Abbas about sitting on one's buttocks (in prayer). (ala alqad mein) He said: It is sunnah. We said to him: We find it a sort of cruelty to the foot. Ibn 'Abbas said: It is the sunnah of your Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي لَفْظِ الْحَدِيثِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ السُّلَمِيِّ، قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا أُصَلِّي، مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ عَطَسَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ فَقُلْتُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ فَرَمَانِي الْقَوْمُ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ فَقُلْتُ وَاثُكْلَ أُمِّيَاهْ مَا شَأْنُكُمْ تَنْظُرُونَ إِلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَجَعَلُوا يَضْرِبُونَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ عَلَى أَفْخَاذِهِمْ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُهُمْ يُصَمِّتُونَنِي لَكِنِّي سَكَتُّ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبِأَبِي هُوَ وَأُمِّي مَا رَأَيْتُ مُعَلِّمًا قَبْلَهُ وَلاَ بَعْدَهُ أَحْسَنَ تَعْلِيمًا مِنْهُ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا كَهَرَنِي وَلاَ ضَرَبَنِي وَلاَ شَتَمَنِي قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الصَّلاَةَ لاَ يَصْلُحُ فِيهَا شَىْءٌ مِنْ كَلاَمِ النَّاسِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ التَّسْبِيحُ وَالتَّكْبِيرُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِجَاهِلِيَّةٍ وَقَدْ جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِالإِسْلاَمِ وَإِنَّ مِنَّا رِجَالاً يَأْتُونَ الْكُهَّانَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ تَأْتِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمِنَّا رِجَالٌ يَتَطَيَّرُونَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ شَىْءٌ يَجِدُونَهُ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ فَلاَ يَصُدَّنَّهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ ‏"‏ فَلاَ يَصُدَّنَّكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَمِنَّا رِجَالٌ يَخُطُّونَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ كَانَ نَبِيٌّ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ يَخُطُّ فَمَنْ وَافَقَ خَطَّهُ فَذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَتْ لِي جَارِيَةٌ تَرْعَى غَنَمًا لِي قِبَلَ أُحُدٍ وَالْجَوَّانِيَّةِ فَاطَّلَعْتُ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فَإِذَا الذِّيبُ قَدْ ذَهَبَ بِشَاةٍ مِنْ غَنَمِهَا وَأَنَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي آدَمَ آسَفُ كَمَا يَأْسَفُونَ لَكِنِّي صَكَكْتُهَا صَكَّةً فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَظَّمَ ذَلِكَ عَلَىَّ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ أُعْتِقُهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتِنِي بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِهَا فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ أَيْنَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فِي السَّمَاءِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْتِقْهَا فَإِنَّهَا مُؤْمِنَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ja'farin, muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa - wataqaarabaa fiy lafzi alhadiythi - qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an hajjaajin alssawwaafi, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an hilaali bni aabiy maymuwnaaa, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni alhakami alssulamiyyi, qaala baynaa aanaa ausalliy, ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh 'atasa rajulun mina alqawmi faqultu yarhamuka alllahu ‏.‏ faramaaniy alqawmu biaabsaarihim faqultu waathukla aummiyaah maa shaanukum tanzuruwna iilaaaa ‏.‏ faja'aluwa yadribuwna biaaydiyhim 'alaa aafkhaadhihim falammaa raaaytuhum yusammituwnaniy lakinniy sakattu falammaa sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fabiaabiy huwa waaummiy maa raaaytu mu'allimana qablahu walaa ba'dahu aahsana ta'liymana minhu fawaalllahi maa kaharaniy walaa darabaniy walaa shatamaniy qaala ‏"‏ iinna hadhihi alssalaaaa laa yasluhu fiyhaa shaa'un min kalaami alnnaasi iinnamaa huwa alttasbiyhu waalttakbiyru waqiraa'aau alqurani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy hadiythu 'ahdin bijaahiliyyaain waqad jaa'a alllahu bialiislaami waiinna minnaa rijaalaan yaatuwna alkuhhaana ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falaa taatihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala waminnaa rijaalun yatatayyaruwna ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ dhaaka shaa'un yajiduwnahu fiy suduwrihim falaa yasuddannahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu alssabbaahi ‏"‏ falaa yasuddannakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu waminnaa rijaalun yakhuttuwna ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ kaana nabiyyun mina alaanbiyaa'i yakhuttu faman waafaqa khattahu fadhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wakaanat liy jaariyaaun tar'aa ghanamana liy qibala auhudin waaljawwaaniyyaai faattala'tu dhaata yawmin faiidhaa aldhhiybu qad dhahaba bishaaain min ghanamihaa waaanaa rajulun min baniy adama asafu kamaa yaasafuwna lakinniy sakaktuhaa sakkaaan faaataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fa'azzama dhalika 'alaaaa qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aafalaa au'tiquhaa qaala ‏"‏ aitiniy bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaataytuhu bihaa faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ aayna alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat fiy alssamaa'i ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ man aanaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat aanta rasuwlu alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aa'tiqhaa faiinnahaa muuminaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mu'awiya b. al-Hakam said:While I was praying with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), a man in the company sneezed. I said: Allah have mercy on you! The people stared at me with disapproving looks, so I said: Woe be upon me, why is it that you stare at me? They began to strike their hands on their thighs, and when I saw them urging me to observe silence (I became angry) but I said nothing. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said the prayer (and I declare that neither before him nor after him have I seen a leader who gave better instruction than he for whom I would give my father and mother as ransom). I swear that he did not scold, beat or revile me but said: Talking to persons is not fitting during the prayer, for it consists of glorifying Allah, declaring his Greatness. and recitation of the Qur'an or words to that effect. I said: Messenger of Allah. I was till recently a pagan, but Allah has brought Islam to us; among us there are men who have recourse to Kahins. He said, Do not have recourse to them. I said. There are men who take omens. That is something which they find in their breasts, but let it not turn their way (from freedom of action). I said: Among us there are men who draw lines. He said: There was a prophet who drew lines, so if they do it as they did, that is allowable. I had a maid-servant who tended goats by the side of Uhud and Jawwaniya. One day I happened to pass that way and found that a wolf had carried a goat from her flock. I am after all a man from the posterity of Adam. I felt sorry as they (human beings) feel sorry. So I slapped her. I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and felt (this act of mine) as something grievous I said: Messenger of Allah, should I not grant her freedom? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Bring her to me. So I brought her to him. He said to her: Where is Allah? She said: He is in the heaven. He said: Who am I? She said: Thou art the Messenger of Allah. He said: Grant her freedom, she is a believing woman
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُسَلِّمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْنَا فَلَمَّا رَجَعْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِ النَّجَاشِي سَلَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْنَا فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كُنَّا نُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْكَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَتَرُدُّ عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الصَّلاَةِ شُغُلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, numayrin waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju - waaalfaazuhum mutaqaaribaaun - qaaluwa haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa nusallimu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy alssalaaai fayaruddu 'alaynaa falammaa raja'naa min 'indi alnnajaashiy sallamnaa 'alayhi falam yarudda 'alaynaa faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi kunnaa nusallimu 'alayka fiy alssalaaai fataruddu 'alaynaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna fiy alssalaaai shughulaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Masu'd) reported:We used to greet the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was engaged in prayer and he would respond to our greeting. But when we returned from the Negus we greeted him and he did not respond to us; so we said: Messenger of Allah. we used to greet you when you were engaged in prayer and you would respond to us. He replied: Prayer demands whole attention
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ السَّلُولِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هُرَيْمُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy abnu numayrin, haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin alssaluwliyyu, haddathanaa huraymu bnu sufyaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ شُبَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَتَكَلَّمُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ يُكَلِّمُ الرَّجُلُ صَاحِبَهُ وَهُوَ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ وَقُومُوا لِلَّهِ قَانِتِينَ‏}‏ فَأُمِرْنَا بِالسُّكُوتِ وَنُهِينَا عَنِ الْكَلاَمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'ani alhaarithi bni shubaylin, 'an aabiy 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an zaydi bni aarqama, qaala kunnaa natakallamu fiy alssalaaai yukallimu alrrajulu saahibahu wahuwa iilaa janbihi fiy alssalaaai hattaa nazalat ‏{‏ waquwmuwa lillahi qaanitiyna‏}‏ faaumirnaa bialssukuwti wanuhiynaa 'ani alkalaami ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Arqam reported:We used to talk while engaged in prayer and a person talked with a companion on his side in prayer till (this verse) was revealed:" And stand before Allah in devout obedience" (ii, 238) and we were commanded to observe silence (in prayer) and were forbidden to speak
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَوَكِيعٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, wawakiy'un, h qaala wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kulluhum 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Isma'il b. Abu Khalid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَنِي لِحَاجَةٍ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكْتُهُ وَهُوَ يَسِيرُ - قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ يُصَلِّي - فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَشَارَ إِلَىَّ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ دَعَانِي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّكَ سَلَّمْتَ آنِفًا وَأَنَا أُصَلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَهُوَ مُوَجِّهٌ حِينَئِذٍ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aannahu qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'athaniy lihaajaain thumma aadraktuhu wahuwa yasiyru - qaala qutaybaau yusalliy - fasallamtu 'alayhi faaashaara iilaaaa falammaa faragha da'aaniy faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnaka sallamta anifana waaanaa ausalliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahuwa muwajjihun hiynaiidhin qibala almashriqi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me on an errand. I (having done the business assigned to me came back and) joined him as he was going (on a ride). Qutaiba said that he was saying prayer while he rode. I greeted him. He gestured to me. When he completed the prayer. he called me and said: You greeted me just now while I was engaged in prayer. (Qutaiba said): His (Prophet's face) was towards the east, as he was praying
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ أَرْسَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُنْطَلِقٌ إِلَى بَنِي الْمُصْطَلِقِ فَأَتَيْتُهُ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ فَكَلَّمْتُهُ فَقَالَ لِي بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا - وَأَوْمَأَ زُهَيْرٌ بِيَدِهِ - ثُمَّ كَلَّمْتُهُ فَقَالَ لِي هَكَذَا - فَأَوْمَأَ زُهَيْرٌ أَيْضًا بِيَدِهِ نَحْوَ الأَرْضِ - وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُهُ يَقْرَأُ يُومِئُ بِرَأْسِهِ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا فَعَلْتَ فِي الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتُكَ لَهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَمْنَعْنِي أَنْ أُكَلِّمَكَ إِلاَّ أَنِّي كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ وَأَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ جَالِسٌ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ إِلَى بَنِي الْمُصْطَلِقِ فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى غَيْرِ الْكَعْبَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathaniy aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala aarsalaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa muntaliqun iilaa baniy almustaliqi faaataytuhu wahuwa yusalliy 'alaa ba'iyrihi fakallamtuhu faqaala liy biyadihi hakadhaa - waaawmaaa zuhayrun biyadihi - thumma kallamtuhu faqaala liy hakadhaa - faaawmaaa zuhayrun aaydana biyadihi nahwa alaardi - waaanaa aasma'uhu yaqraau yuwmiiu biraasihi falammaa faragha qaala ‏ "‏ maa fa'alta fiy alladhiy aarsaltuka lahu faiinnahu lam yamna'niy aan aukallimaka iilaaa aanniy kuntu ausalliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala zuhayrun waaabuw alzzubayri jaalisun mustaqbila alka'baai faqaala biyadihi aabuw alzzubayri iilaa baniy almustaliqi faqaala biyadihi iilaa ghayri alka'baai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent me (on an errand) while he was going to Banu Mustaliq. I came to him and he was engaged in prayer on the back of his camel. I talked to him and he gestured to me With his hand, and Zuhair gestured with his hand. I then again talked and he again (gestured to me with his hand). Zuhair pointed with his hand towards the ground. I heard him (the Holy Prophet) reciting the Qur'an and making a sign with his head. When he com- pleted the prayer he sa'id: What have you done (with regard to that business) for which I sent you? I could not talk with you but for the fact that I was engaged in prayer. Zuhair told that Abu Zubair was sitting with his face turned towards Qibla (as he transmitted this hadith). Abu Zuhair pointed towards Banu Mustaliq with his hand and the direction to which he pointed with his hand was not towards the Ka'ba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَعَثَنِي فِي حَاجَةٍ فَرَجَعْتُ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ وَوَجْهُهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَىَّ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَمْنَعْنِي أَنْ أَرُدَّ عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ أَنِّي كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an kathiyrin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabirin, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faba'athaniy fiy haajaain faraja'tu wahuwa yusalliy 'alaa raahilatihi wawajhuhu 'alaa ghayri alqiblaai fasallamtu 'alayhi falam yarudda 'alaaaa falammaa ansarafa qaala ‏ "‏ iinnahu lam yamna'niy aan aarudda 'alayka iilaaa aanniy kuntu ausalliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:We were in the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he sent me on an errand, and when I came back (I saw him) saying prayer on his ride and his face was not turned towards Qibla. I greeted him but he did not respond to me. As he completed the prayer, he said: Nothing prevented me from responding to your greeting but the fact that I was praying
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ شِنْظِيرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَاجَةٍ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa kathiyru bnu shinziyrin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabirin, qaala ba'athaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy haajaain ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi hammaadin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent Jabir on an errand has been reported by him through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ عِفْرِيتًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ جَعَلَ يَفْتِكُ عَلَىَّ الْبَارِحَةَ لِيَقْطَعَ عَلَىَّ الصَّلاَةَ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمْكَنَنِي مِنْهُ فَذَعَتُّهُ فَلَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَرْبِطَهُ إِلَى جَنْبِ سَارِيَةٍ مِنْ سَوَارِي الْمَسْجِدِ حَتَّى تُصْبِحُوا تَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَجْمَعُونَ - أَوْ كُلُّكُمْ - ثُمَّ ذَكَرْتُ قَوْلَ أَخِي سُلَيْمَانَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لاَ يَنْبَغِي لأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي ‏.‏ فَرَدَّهُ اللَّهُ خَاسِئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ مَنْصُورٍ شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, haddathanaa muhammadun, - wahuwa abnu ziyaadin - qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna 'ifriytana mina aljinni ja'ala yaftiku 'alaaaa albaarihaaa liyaqta'a 'alaaaa alssalaaaa waiinna alllaha aamkananiy minhu fadha'attuhu falaqad hamamtu aan aarbitahu iilaa janbi saariyaain min sawaariy almasjidi hattaa tusbihuwa tanzuruwna iilayhi aajma'uwna - aaw kullukum - thumma dhakartu qawla aakhiy sulaymaana rabbi aghfir liy wahab liy mulkana laa yanbaghiy laahadin min ba'diy ‏.‏ faraddahu alllahu khaasiiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala abnu mansuwrin shu'baau 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying:A highly wicked one amongst the Jinn escaped yesternight to interrupt my prayer, but Allah gave me power over him, so I seized him and intended to tie him to one of the pillars of the mosque in order that you, all together or all, might look at him, but I remembered the supplication of my brother Sulaiman:" My Lord, forgive me, give me such a kingdom as will not be possible for anyone after me" (Qur'an, xxxvii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، هُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَوْلُهُ فَذَعَتُّهُ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ فَقَالَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ فَدَعَتُّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, huwa abnu ja'farin h qaala wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa shabaabaau, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi walaysa fiy hadiythi abni ja'farin qawluhu fadha'attuhu ‏.‏ waaammaa abnu aabiy shaybaaa faqaala fiy riwaayatihi fada'attuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Ibn Abi Shaiba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَمِعْنَاهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلْعَنُكَ بِلَعْنَةِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ وَبَسَطَ يَدَهُ كَأَنَّهُ يَتَنَاوَلُ شَيْئًا فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ سَمِعْنَاكَ تَقُولُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ شَيْئًا لَمْ نَسْمَعْكَ تَقُولُهُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ وَرَأَيْنَاكَ بَسَطْتَ يَدَكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ إِبْلِيسَ جَاءَ بِشِهَابٍ مِنْ نَارٍ لِيَجْعَلَهُ فِي وَجْهِي فَقُلْتُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْكَ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ قُلْتُ أَلْعَنُكَ بِلَعْنَةِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ فَلَمْ يَسْتَأْخِرْ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ أَرَدْتُ أَخْذَهُ وَاللَّهِ لَوْلاَ دَعْوَةُ أَخِينَا سُلَيْمَانَ لأَصْبَحَ مُوثَقًا يَلْعَبُ بِهِ وِلْدَانُ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu salamaaa almuraadiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni saalihin, yaquwlu haddathaniy rabiy'aau bnu yaziyda, 'an aabiy iidriysa alkhawlaaniyyi, 'an aabiy alddardaa'i, qaala qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasami'naahu yaquwlu ‏"‏ aa'uwdhu bialllahi minka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ aal'anuka bila'naai alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thalaathana ‏.‏ wabasata yadahu kaaannahu yatanaawalu shayiana falammaa faragha mina alssalaaai qulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi qad sami'naaka taquwlu fiy alssalaaai shayiana lam nasma'ka taquwluhu qabla dhalika waraaaynaaka basatta yadaka ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinna 'aduwwa alllahi iibliysa jaa'a bishihaabin min naarin liyaj'alahu fiy wajhiy faqultu aa'uwdhu bialllahi minka ‏.‏ thalaatha marraatin thumma qultu aal'anuka bila'naai alllahi alttaammaai falam yastaakhir thalaatha marraatin thumma aaradtu aakhdhahu waalllahi lawlaa da'waau aakhiynaa sulaymaana laasbaha muwthaqana yal'abu bihi wildaanu aahli almadiynaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Darda' reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up (to pray) and we heard him say:" I seek refuge in Allah from thee." Then said:" curse thee with Allah's curse" three times, then he stretched out his hand as though he was taking hold of something. When he finished the prayer, we said: Messenger of Allah, we heard you say something during the prayer which we have not heard you say before, and we saw you stretch out your hand. He replied: Allah's enemy Iblis came with a flame of fire to put it in my face, so I said three times:" I Seek refuge in Allah from thee." Then I said three times:" I curse thee with Allah's full curse." But he did not retreat (on any one of these) three occasions. Thereafter I meant to seize him. I swear by Allah that had it not been for the supplication of my brother Sulaiman he would have been bound, and made an object of sport for the children of Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِمَالِكٍ حَدَّثَكَ عَامِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ حَامِلٌ أُمَامَةَ بِنْتَ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلأَبِي الْعَاصِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ فَإِذَا قَامَ حَمَلَهَا وَإِذَا سَجَدَ وَضَعَهَا قَالَ يَحْيَى قَالَ مَالِكٌ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa maalikun, 'an 'aamiri bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qultu limaalikin haddathaka 'aamiru bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, 'an 'amriw bni sulaymin alzzuraqiyyi, 'an aabiy qataadaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy wahuwa haamilun aumaamaaa binta zaynaba binti rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaabiy al'aasi bni alrrabiy'i faiidhaa qaama hamalahaa waiidhaa sajada wada'ahaa qaala yahyaa qaala maalikun na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatadi reported:I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying the prayer while he was carrying Umama, daughter of Zainab, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). and Abu'l-'As b. al-Rabi'. When he stood up, he took her up and when he prostrated he put her down, Yahya said: Malik replied in the affirmative
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، وَابْنِ، عَجْلاَنَ سَمِعَا عَامِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَؤُمُّ النَّاسَ وَأُمَامَةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي الْعَاصِ وَهْىَ ابْنَةُ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ فَإِذَا رَكَعَ وَضَعَهَا وَإِذَا رَفَعَ مِنَ السُّجُودِ أَعَادَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'uthmaana bni aabiy sulaymaana, waabni, 'ajlaana sami'aa 'aamira bna 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, yuhaddithu 'an 'amriw bni sulaymin alzzuraqiyyi, 'an aabiy qataadaaa alaansaariyyi, qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yauummu alnnaasa waaumaamaau bintu aabiy al'aasi wahaa abnaau zaynaba binti alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa 'aatiqihi faiidhaa raka'a wada'ahaa waiidhaa rafa'a mina alssujuwdi aa'aadahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada al-Ansari reported:I saw the Apostle (ﷺ) leading the people in prayer with Umima, daughter of Abu'l-'As and Zainab, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), on his shoulder. When he bowed, he put her down, and when he got up after prostration, he lifted her again
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، يَقُولُ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي لِلنَّاسِ وَأُمَامَةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي الْعَاصِ عَلَى عُنُقِهِ فَإِذَا سَجَدَ وَضَعَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an makhramaaa bni bukayrin, h qaala wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy makhramaau, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'amriw bni sulaymin alzzuraqiyyi, qaala sami'tu aabaa qataadaaa alaansaariyya, yaquwlu raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy lilnnaasi waaumaamaau bintu aabiy al'aasi 'alaa 'unuqihi faiidhaa sajada wada'ahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada reported:I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) leading the people in prayer with Umama daughter of Abu'l-'As on his neck; and when he prostrated he put her down
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، سَمِعَ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ، يَقُولُ بَيْنَا نَحْنُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ جُلُوسٌ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَنَّهُ أَمَّ النَّاسَ فِي تِلْكَ الصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h qaala wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw bakrin alhanafiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi bnu ja'farin, jamiy'ana 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an 'amriw bni sulaymin alzzuraqiyyi, sami'a aabaa qataadaaa, yaquwlu baynaa nahnu fiy almasjidi juluwsun kharaja 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihim ghayra aannahu lam yadhkur aannahu aamma alnnaasa fiy tilka alssalaaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada reported:As we were sitting in the mosque, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us, and the rest of the hadith is the same except that he made no mention that he led people in this prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ نَفَرًا، جَاءُوا إِلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَدْ تَمَارَوْا فِي الْمِنْبَرِ مِنْ أَىِّ عُودٍ هُوَ فَقَالَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ مِنْ أَىِّ عُودٍ هُوَ وَمَنْ عَمِلَهُ وَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ جَلَسَ عَلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا أَبَا عَبَّاسٍ فَحَدِّثْنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ إِنَّهُ لَيُسَمِّيهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏"‏ انْظُرِي غُلاَمَكِ النَّجَّارَ يَعْمَلْ لِي أَعْوَادًا أُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَعَمِلَ هَذِهِ الثَّلاَثَ دَرَجَاتٍ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوُضِعَتْ هَذَا الْمَوْضِعَ فَهْىَ مِنْ طَرْفَاءِ الْغَابَةِ ‏.‏ وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ عَلَيْهِ فَكَبَّرَ وَكَبَّرَ النَّاسُ وَرَاءَهُ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ فَنَزَلَ الْقَهْقَرَى حَتَّى سَجَدَ فِي أَصْلِ الْمِنْبَرِ ثُمَّ عَادَ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ آخِرِ صَلاَتِهِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أُيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنِّي صَنَعْتُ هَذَا لِتَأْتَمُّوا بِي وَلِتَعَلَّمُوا صَلاَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna nafarana, jaa'uwa iilaa sahli bni sa'din qad tamaarawa fiy alminbari min aaaai 'uwdin huwa faqaala aamaa waalllahi iinniy laa'rifu min aaaai 'uwdin huwa waman 'amilahu waraaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aawwala yawmin jalasa 'alayhi - qaala - faqultu lahu yaa aabaa 'abbaasin fahaddithnaa ‏.‏ qaala aarsala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa amraaaain qaala aabuw haazimin iinnahu layusammiyhaa yawmaiidhin ‏"‏ anzuriy ghulaamaki alnnajjaara ya'mal liy aa'waadana aukallimu alnnaasa 'alayhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fa'amila hadhihi althhalaatha darajaatin thumma aamara bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawudi'at hadhaa almawdi'a fahaa min tarfaa'i alghaabaai ‏.‏ walaqad raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama 'alayhi fakabbara wakabbara alnnaasu waraa'ahu wahuwa 'alaa alminbari thumma rafa'a fanazala alqahqaraa hattaa sajada fiy aasli alminbari thumma 'aada hattaa faragha min akhiri salaatihi thumma aaqbala 'alaa alnnaasi faqaala ‏"‏ yaa auyyuhaa alnnaasu iinniy sana'tu hadhaa litaatammuwa biy walita'allamuwa salaatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Hazim is reported on the authority of his father:Some people came to Sahl b. Sa'd and began to differ about the wood of which the (Prophet's pulpit was made. He (Sahl b. Sa'd) said: By Allah, I know of which wood it is made and who made it, and the day when I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seated himself on it on the first day. I said to him: O Abu Abbas (kunyah of Sabl b. Sa'd), narrate to us (all these facts), He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a person to a woman asking her to allow her slave, a carpenter, to work on woods (to prepare a pulpit) so that I should talk to the people (sitting on it). Abu Hazim said: He (Sahl b. Sa'd) pointed out the name of (that lady) that day. So he (the carpenter) made (a pulpit) with these three steps. Then the Messengerof Allah (ﷺ) commanded it to be placed here (where it is lying now). It was fashioned out of the wood of al-Ghaba. And I saw the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) standing upon it and glorifying Allah and the people also glorified Allah after him, while he was on the pulpit. He then raised (his head from prostration) and stepped back (on his heels) till he prostrated himself at the base of pulpit, and then returned (to the former place and this movement of one or two steps continued) till the prayer was complete. He then turned towards the people and said: O people, I have done it so that you should follow me and learn (my mode of) prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيُّ الْقُرَشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، أَنَّ رِجَالاً، أَتَوْا سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ أَتَوْا سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ فَسَأَلُوهُ مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ مِنْبَرُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَاقُوا الْحَدِيثَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni muhammadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdin alqaariyyu alqurashiyyu, haddathaniy aabuw haazimin, aanna rijaalaan, aatawa sahla bna sa'din h qaala wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy haazimin, qaala aatawa sahla bna sa'din fasaaaluwhu min aaaai shaa'in minbaru alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasaaquwa alhadiytha nahwa hadiythi abni aabiy haazimin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Hazim reported:They (the people) came to Sahl b. Sa'd and they asked him of what thing the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was made, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْقَنْطَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الرَّجُلُ مُخْتَصِرًا ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alhakamu bnu muwsaa alqantariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki, h qaala wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin, waaabuw ausaamaaa jamiy'ana 'an hishaamin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa aan yusalliya alrrajulu mukhtasirana ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy bakrin qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he forbade keeping one's hand on one's waist while praying, and in the narration of Abu Bakr (the words are):The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade to do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ مُعَيْقِيبٍ، قَالَ ذَكَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسْحَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ - يَعْنِي الْحَصَى - قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كُنْتَ لاَ بُدَّ فَاعِلاً فَوَاحِدَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa hishaamun alddastawaaiiyyu, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an mu'ayqiybin, qaala dhakara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almasha fiy almasjidi - ya'niy alhasaa - qaala ‏ "‏ iin kunta laa budda faa'ilaan fawaahidaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mu'aiqib quoted the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) mentioning the removal of pebbles from the ground where he prostrated himself. He (the Prophet) said:It you must do so, do it only once
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى بُصَاقًا فِي جِدَارِ الْقِبْلَةِ فَحَكَّهُ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ يُصَلِّي فَلاَ يَبْصُقْ قِبَلَ وَجْهِهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قِبَلَ وَجْهِهِ إِذَا صَلَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa busaaqana fiy jidaari alqiblaai fahakkahu thumma aaqbala 'alaa alnnaasi faqaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa kaana aahadukum yusalliy falaa yabsuq qibala wajhihi faiinna alllaha qibala wajhihi iidhaa sallaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw spittle on the wall towards Qibla, and scratched it away and then turning to the people said: When any one of you prays, he must not spit in front of him, for Allah is in front of him when he is engaged in prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ رَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ الضَّحَّاكَ فَإِنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ نُخَامَةً فِي الْقِبْلَةِ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy jamiy'ana, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, - ya'niy abna 'uthmaana h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu raaaa nukhaamaaan fiy qiblaai almasjidi ‏.‏ iilaaa alddahhaaka faiinna fiy hadiythihi nukhaamaaan fiy alqiblaai ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi maalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw sputum sticking to the Qibla wall of the mosque, the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَحَكَّهَا بِحَصَاةٍ ثُمَّ نَهَى أَنْ يَبْزُقَ الرَّجُلُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَوْ أَمَامَهُ وَلَكِنْ يَبْزُقُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَوْ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ الْيُسْرَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa nukhaamaaan fiy qiblaai almasjidi fahakkahaa bihasaaain thumma nahaa aan yabzuqa alrrajulu 'an yamiynihi aaw aamaamahu walakin yabzuqu 'an yasaarihi aaw tahta qadamihi alyusraa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) saw sputum sticking to the Qibla of the mosque. He scratched it off with a pebble and then forbade spitting on the right side or in front, but (it is permissible) to spit on the left side or under the left foot
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، وَأَبَا، سَعِيدٍ أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى نُخَامَةً ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, h qaala wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy kilaahumaa, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, waaabaa, sa'iydin aakhbaraahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa nukhaamaaan ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira and Abu Sa'id narrated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw sputum, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى بُصَاقًا فِي جِدَارِ الْقِبْلَةِ أَوْ مُخَاطًا أَوْ نُخَامَةً فَحَكَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa busaaqana fiy jidaari alqiblaai aaw mukhaatana aaw nukhaamaaan fahakkahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Apostle of Allah (may, peace be upon him) saw spittle or snot or sputum, sticking to the wall towards Qibla and scratched it off
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا بَالُ أَحَدِكُمْ يَقُومُ مُسْتَقْبِلَ رَبِّهِ فَيَتَنَخَّعُ أَمَامَهُ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يُسْتَقْبَلَ فَيُتَنَخَّعَ فِي وَجْهِهِ فَإِذَا تَنَخَّعَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَتَنَخَّعْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَلْيَقُلْ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَوَصَفَ الْقَاسِمُ فَتَفَلَ فِي ثَوْبِهِ ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بَعْضَهُ عَلَى بَعْضٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'ani alqaasimi bni mihraana, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa nukhaamaaan fiy qiblaai almasjidi faaaqbala 'alaa alnnaasi faqaala ‏ "‏ maa baalu aahadikum yaquwmu mustaqbila rabbihi fayatanakhha'u aamaamahu aayuhibbu aahadukum aan yustaqbala fayutanakhha'a fiy wajhihi faiidhaa tanakhha'a aahadukum falyatanakhha' 'an yasaarihi tahta qadamihi faiin lam yajid falyaqul hakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wawasafa alqaasimu fatafala fiy thawbihi thumma masaha ba'dahu 'alaa ba'din ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw some sputum in the direction of the Qibla of the mosque. He turned towards people and said:How Is it that someone amongst you stands before his Lord and then spits out in front of Him? Does any one of you like that he should be made to stand in front of someone and then spit at his face? So when any one of you spits, he must spit on his left side under his foot. But if he does not find (space to spit) he should do like this. Qasim (one of the narrators) spat in his cloth and then folded it and rubbed it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ هُشَيْمٍ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرُدُّ ثَوْبَهُ بَعْضَهُ عَلَى بَعْضٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, h qaala wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, h qaala wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, kulluhum 'ani alqaasimi bni mihraana, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa wazaada fiy hadiythi hushaymin qaala aabuw hurayraaa kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaruddu thawbahu ba'dahu 'alaa ba'din ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:I perceive as if I am looking at the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) folding up a part of his cloth with another one
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّهُ يُنَاجِي رَبَّهُ فَلاَ يَبْزُقَنَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلاَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَلَكِنْ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa kaana aahadukum fiy alssalaaai faiinnahu yunaajiy rabbahu falaa yabzuqanna bayna yadayhi walaa 'an yamiynihi walakin 'an shimaalihi tahta qadamihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you is engaged in prayer, he is holding intimate conversation with his Lord, so none of you must spit in front of him, or towards his right side, but towards his left side under his foot
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْبُزَاقُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ خَطِيئَةٌ وَكَفَّارَتُهَا دَفْنُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala, qutaybaau haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ albuzaaqu fiy almasjidi khatiyiaaun wakaffaaratuhaa dafnuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Spitting in a mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that it should be buried
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ قَتَادَةَ عَنِ التَّفْلِ، فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ التَّفْلُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ خَطِيئَةٌ وَكَفَّارَتُهَا دَفْنُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala saaaltu qataadaaa 'ani alttafli, fiy almasjidi faqaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alttaflu fiy almasjidi khatiyiaaun wakaffaaratuhaa dafnuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shu'ba reported:I asked Qatada about spitting, in the mosque. He said: I heard Anas b. Malik say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that it should be buried
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، وَشَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلٌ، مَوْلَى أَبِي عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَعْمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ الدِّيلِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ عُرِضَتْ عَلَىَّ أَعْمَالُ أُمَّتِي حَسَنُهَا وَسَيِّئُهَا فَوَجَدْتُ فِي مَحَاسِنِ أَعْمَالِهَا الأَذَى يُمَاطُ عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ وَوَجَدْتُ فِي مَسَاوِي أَعْمَالِهَا النُّخَاعَةَ تَكُونُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لاَ تُدْفَنُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a aldduba'iyyu, washaybaanu bnu farruwkha, qaalaa haddathanaa mahdiyyu bnu maymuwnin, haddathanaa waasilun, mawlaa aabiy 'uyaynaaa 'an yahyaa bni 'uqaylin, 'an yahyaa bni ya'mara, 'an aabiy alaaswadi alddiyliyyi, 'an aabiy dharrin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ 'uridat 'alaaaa aa'maalu aummatiy hasanuhaa wasayyiiuhaa fawajadtu fiy mahaasini aa'maalihaa alaadhaa yumaatu 'ani alttariyqi wawajadtu fiy masaawiy aa'maalihaa alnnukhaa'aaa takuwnu fiy almasjidi laa tudfanu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: The deeds of my people, good and bad, were presented before me, and I found the removal of something objectionable from the road among their good deeds, and the sputum mucus left unburied in the mosque among their evil deeds
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَأَيْتُهُ تَنَخَّعَ فَدَلَكَهَا بِنَعْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa kahmasun, 'an yaziyda bni 'abdi alllahi bni alshhikhhiyri, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sallaytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faraaaytuhu tanakhha'a fadalakahaa bina'lihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Shakhkhir reported on the authority of his father that he said:I said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and saw him spitting and rubbing it off with his shoe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ، يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَتَنَخَّعَ فَدَلَكَهَا بِنَعْلِهِ الْيُسْرَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy al'alaa'i, yaziyda bni 'abdi alllahi bni alshhikhhiyri 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sallaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fatanakhha'a fadalakahaa bina'lihi alyusraa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Shakhkhir narrated it on the authority of his father that he said prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he spat and then rubbed it off with his left shoe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي فِي النَّعْلَيْنِ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa bishru bnu almufaddali, 'an aabiy maslamaaa, sa'iydi bni yaziyda qaala qultu laanasi bni maalikin aakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy fiy alnna'layni qaala na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd b. Yazid reported:I said to Anas b. Malik: Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pray while putting on the shoes? He said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبُو مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسًا ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa 'abbaadu bnu al'awwaami, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu yaziyda aabuw maslamaaa, qaala saaaltu aanasana ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd b. Yazid Abu Mas'ama reported:I said to Anas like (that mentioned above)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى فِي خَمِيصَةٍ لَهَا أَعْلاَمٌ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ شَغَلَتْنِي أَعْلاَمُ هَذِهِ فَاذْهَبُوا بِهَا إِلَى أَبِي جَهْمٍ وَائْتُونِي بِأَنْبِجَانِيِّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, h qaala wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa fiy khamiysaain lahaa aa'laamun waqaala ‏ "‏ shaghalatniy aa'laamu hadhihi faadhhabuwa bihaa iilaa aabiy jahmin waaituwniy biaanbijaaniyyihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) prayed in a garment which had designs over it, so he (the Holy Prophet) said: Take it to Abu Jahm and bring me a plain blanket from him, because its designs have distracted me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي فِي خَمِيصَةٍ ذَاتِ أَعْلاَمٍ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى عَلَمِهَا فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلاَتَهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اذْهَبُوا بِهَذِهِ الْخَمِيصَةِ إِلَى أَبِي جَهْمِ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ وَائْتُونِي بِأَنْبِجَانِيِّهِ فَإِنَّهَا أَلْهَتْنِي آنِفًا فِي صَلاَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy fiy khamiysaain dhaati aa'laamin fanazara iilaa 'alamihaa falammaa qadaa salaatahu qaala ‏ "‏ adhhabuwa bihadhihi alkhamiysaai iilaa aabiy jahmi bni hudhayfaaa waaituwniy biaanbijaaniyyihi faiinnahaa aalhatniy anifana fiy salaatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood for prayer with a garment which had designs over it. He looked at these designs and after completing the prayer said: Take this garment to Abu Jahm b. Hudhaifa and bring me a blanket for it has distracted me just now
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَتْ لَهُ خَمِيصَةٌ لَهَا عَلَمٌ فَكَانَ يَتَشَاغَلُ بِهَا فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَأَعْطَاهَا أَبَا جَهْمٍ وَأَخَذَ كِسَاءً لَهُ أَنْبِجَانِيًّا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaanat lahu khamiysaaun lahaa 'alamun fakaana yatashaaghalu bihaa fiy alssalaaai faaa'taahaa aabaa jahmin waaakhadha kisaa'an lahu aanbijaaniyyana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Apostle of Allah (way peace be upon him) had a garment which had designs upon it and this distracted him in prayer. He gave it to Abu Jahm and took a plain garment in its place which is known anbijaniya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا حَضَرَ الْعَشَاءُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَابْدَءُوا بِالْعَشَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: aakhbaraniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa hadara al'ashaa'u waauqiymati alssalaaau faabda'uwa bial'ashaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying:When the supper is brought and the prayer begins, one, should first take food
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قُرِّبَ الْعَشَاءُ وَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَابْدَءُوا بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُصَلُّوا صَلاَةَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَلاَ تَعْجَلُوا عَنْ عَشَائِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa qurriba al'ashaa'u wahadarati alssalaaau faabda'uwa bihi qabla aan tusalluwa salaaaa almaghribi walaa ta'jaluwa 'an 'ashaaiikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the supper is brought before you, and it is also the time to say prayer, first take food before saying evening prayer and do not hasten (to prayer, leaving aside the food)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَحَفْصٌ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, wahafsun, wawakiy'un, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an aanasin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا وُضِعَ عَشَاءُ أَحَدِكُمْ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَابْدَءُوا بِالْعَشَاءِ وَلاَ يَعْجَلَنَّ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, qaala wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa wudi'a 'ashaa'u aahadikum waauqiymati alssalaaau faabda'uwa bial'ashaa'i walaa ya'jalanna hattaa yafrugha minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When the supper is served to any one of you and the prayer also begins. (in such a case) first take supper, and do not make haste (for prayer) till you have (taken the food)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْمُسَيَّبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عِيَاضٍ - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا الصَّلْتُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
