verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu iishaaqa almusayyabiyyu, haddathaniy aanasun, - ya'niy abna 'iyaadin - 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu mas'adaaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, h qaala wahaddathanaa alssaltu bnu mas'uwdin, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu muwsaa, 'an aayyuwba, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of Ibn 'Umar with another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ، قَالَ تَحَدَّثْتُ أَنَا وَالْقَاسِمُ، عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ - رضى الله عنها - حَدِيثًا وَكَانَ الْقَاسِمُ رَجُلاً لَحَّانَةً وَكَانَ لأُمِّ وَلَدٍ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ عَائِشَةُ مَا لَكَ لاَ تَحَدَّثُ كَمَا يَتَحَدَّثُ ابْنُ أَخِي هَذَا أَمَا إِنِّي قَدْ عَلِمْتُ مِنْ أَيْنَ أُتِيتَ ‏.‏ هَذَا أَدَّبَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَأَنْتَ أَدَّبَتْكَ أُمُّكَ - قَالَ - فَغَضِبَ الْقَاسِمُ وَأَضَبَّ عَلَيْهَا فَلَمَّا رَأَى مَائِدَةَ عَائِشَةَ قَدْ أُتِيَ بِهَا قَامَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ أَيْنَ قَالَ أُصَلِّي ‏.‏ قَالَتِ اجْلِسْ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنِّي أُصَلِّي ‏.‏ قَالَتِ اجْلِسْ غُدَرُ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ صَلاَةَ بِحَضْرَةِ الطَّعَامِ وَلاَ وَهُوَ يُدَافِعُهُ الأَخْبَثَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa haatimun, - huwa abnu iismaa'iyla - 'an ya'quwba bni mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy 'atiyqin, qaala tahaddathtu aanaa waalqaasimu, 'inda 'aaiishaaa - rda allh 'nha - hadiythana wakaana alqaasimu rajulaan lahhaanaaan wakaana laummi waladin faqaalat lahu 'aaiishaau maa laka laa tahaddathu kamaa yatahaddathu abnu aakhiy hadhaa aamaa iinniy qad 'alimtu min aayna autiyta ‏.‏ hadhaa aaddabathu aummuhu waaanta aaddabatka aummuka - qaala - faghadiba alqaasimu waaadabba 'alayhaa falammaa raaaa maaiidaaa 'aaiishaaa qad autiya bihaa qaama ‏.‏ qaalat aayna qaala ausalliy ‏.‏ qaalati ajlis ‏.‏ qaala iinniy ausalliy ‏.‏ qaalati ajlis ghudaru iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa salaaaa bihadraai altta'aami walaa wahuwa yudaafi'uhu alaakhbathaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Atiq reported:Al-Qasim was in the presence of 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) that I narrated a hadith and Qasim was a man who committed errors in (pronouncing words) and his mother was a freed slave-girl. 'A'isha said to him: What is the matter with you that you do not narrate as this son of my brother narrated (the ahaditb)? Well I know from where you picked it up. This is how his mother brought him up and how your mother brought you up. Qasim felt angry (on this remark of Hadrat 'A'isha) and showed bitterness towards her. When he saw that the table had been spread for 'A'isha, he stood up, 'A'isha, said: Where are you going? He said: (I am going) to say prayer. She said: Sit down (to take the food). He said: I must say prayer. She said: Sit down, ) faithless, for I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: No prayer can be (rightly said) when the food is there (before the worshipper), or when he is prompted by the call of nature
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو حَزْرَةَ الْقَاصُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي الْحَدِيثِ قِصَّةَ الْقَاسِمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - aakhbaraniy aabuw hazraaa alqaassu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy 'atiyqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi walam yadhkur fiy alhadiythi qissaaa alqaasimi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Atiq narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) on the authority of 'A'isha, but he made no mention of the account of Qasim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي غَزْوَةِ خَيْبَرَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ - يَعْنِي الثُّومَ - فَلاَ يَأْتِيَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ فِي غَزْوَةٍ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ خَيْبَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fiy ghazwaai khaybara ‏ "‏ man aakala min hadhihi alshhajaraai - ya'niy althhuwma - falaa yaatiyanna almasaajida ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala zuhayrun fiy ghazwaain ‏.‏ walam yadhkur khaybara ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said during the battle of Khaybar: He who ate of this plant, i. e. garlic, should not come to the mosques. In the narration of Zubair, there is only a mention of" battle" and not of Khaybar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْبَقْلَةِ فَلاَ يَقْرَبَنَّ مَسَاجِدَنَا حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ رِيحُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الثُّومَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, h qaala wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aakala min hadhihi albaqlaai falaa yaqrabanna masaajidanaa hattaa yadhhaba riyhuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'niy althhuwma ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who eats of this (offensive) plant must not approach our mosque, till its odor dies: (plant signifies) garlic
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ صُهَيْبٍ - قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسٌ عَنِ الثُّومِ، فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ فَلاَ يَقْرَبَنَّا وَلاَ يُصَلِّي مَعَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, - wahuwa abnu suhaybin - qaala suiila aanasun 'ani althhuwmi, faqaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aakala min hadhihi alshhajaraai falaa yaqrabannaa walaa yusalliy ma'anaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Suhaib reported:Anas was asked about the garlic; he stated that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: He who eats of this plant (garlic) should not approach us and pray along with us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ فَلاَ يَقْرَبَنَّ مَسْجِدَنَا وَلاَ يُؤْذِيَنَّا بِرِيحِ الثُّومِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'ani abni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aakala min hadhihi alshhajaraai falaa yaqrabanna masjidanaa walaa yuudhiyannaa biriyhi althhuwmi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who eats of this plant (garlic) should not approach our mosque and should not harm us with the odour of garlic
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ الْبَصَلِ وَالْكُرَّاثِ ‏.‏ فَغَلَبَتْنَا الْحَاجَةُ فَأَكَلْنَا مِنْهَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ الْمُنْتِنَةِ فَلاَ يَقْرَبَنَّ مَسْجِدَنَا فَإِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ تَأَذَّى مِمَّا يَتَأَذَّى مِنْهُ الإِنْسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa kathiyru bnu hishaamin, 'an hishaamin alddastawaaiiyyi, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aakli albasali waalkurraathi ‏.‏ faghalabatnaa alhaajaau faaakalnaa minhaa faqaala ‏ "‏ man aakala min hadhihi alshhajaraai almuntinaai falaa yaqrabanna masjidanaa faiinna almalaaiikaaa taaadhhaa mimmaa yataaadhhaa minhu aliinsu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade eating of onions and leek. When we were overpowered by a desire (to eat) we ate them. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: He who eats of this offensive plant must not approach our mosque, for the angels are harmed by the same things as men
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ - وَفِي رِوَايَةِ حَرْمَلَةَ وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ ثُومًا أَوْ بَصَلاً فَلْيَعْتَزِلْنَا أَوْ لِيَعْتَزِلْ مَسْجِدَنَا وَلْيَقْعُدْ فِي بَيْتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَنَّهُ أُتِيَ بِقِدْرٍ فِيهِ خَضِرَاتٌ مِنْ بُقُولٍ فَوَجَدَ لَهَا رِيحًا فَسَأَلَ فَأُخْبِرَ بِمَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْبُقُولِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَرِّبُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلَى بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ كَرِهَ أَكْلَهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ كُلْ فَإِنِّي أُنَاجِي مَنْ لاَ تُنَاجِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu aabiy rabaahin, aanna jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, qaala - wafiy riwaayaai harmalaaa waza'ama aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man aakala thuwmana aaw basalaan falya'tazilnaa aaw liya'tazil masjidanaa walyaq'ud fiy baytihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaannahu autiya biqidrin fiyhi khadiraatun min buquwlin fawajada lahaa riyhana fasaaala faaukhbira bimaa fiyhaa mina albuquwli faqaala ‏"‏ qarribuwhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaa ba'di aashaabihi falammaa raahu kariha aaklahaa qaala ‏"‏ kul faiinniy aunaajiy man laa tunaajiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who eats garlic or onion should remain away from us or from our mosque and stay in his house. A kettle was brought to him which had (cooked) vegetables in it, He smelt (offensive) odour in it. On asking he was informed of the vegetables (cooked in it). He said: Take it to such and such Companion. When he saw it, he also disliked eating it. (Upon this). he (the Holy Prophet) said: You may eat it, for I converse wkh one with whom you do not converse
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ - يُرِيدُ الثُّومَ - فَلاَ يَغْشَنَا فِي مَسْجِدِنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْبَصَلَ وَالْكُرَّاثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, h qaala wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaalaa jamiy'ana aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏ "‏ man aakala min hadhihi alshhajaraai - yuriydu althhuwma - falaa yaghshanaa fiy masjidinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri albasala waalkurraatha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Juraij has narrated it with the same chain of transmitters:He who eats of this plant, i. e. garlic, should not come to us in our mosque, and he made no mention of onions or leek
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ لَمْ نَعْدُ أَنْ فُتِحَتْ، خَيْبَرُ فَوَقَعْنَا أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي تِلْكَ الْبَقْلَةِ الثُّومِ وَالنَّاسُ جِيَاعٌ فَأَكَلْنَا مِنْهَا أَكْلاً شَدِيدًا ثُمَّ رُحْنَا إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَوَجَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرِّيحَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ الْخَبِيثَةِ شَيْئًا فَلاَ يَقْرَبَنَّا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّاسُ حُرِّمَتْ حُرِّمَتْ ‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ ذَاكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِي تَحْرِيمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لِي وَلَكِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ أَكْرَهُ رِيحَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala lam na'du aan futihat, khaybaru fawaqa'naa aashaaba rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy tilka albaqlaai althhuwmi waalnnaasu jiyaa'un faaakalnaa minhaa aaklaan shadiydana thumma ruhnaa iilaa almasjidi fawajada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alrriyha faqaala ‏"‏ man aakala min hadhihi alshhajaraai alkhabiythaai shayiana falaa yaqrabannaa fiy almasjidi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala alnnaasu hurrimat hurrimat ‏.‏ fabalagha dhaaka alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aayyuhaa alnnaasu iinnahu laysa biy tahriymu maa aahalla alllahu liy walakinnahaa shajaraaun aakrahu riyhahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported:We made no transgression but Khaybar was conquered. We, the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), fell upon this plant. i e. garlic. because the people were hungry. We ate it to our heart's content and then made our way towards the mosque. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sensed its odour and he said: He who takes anything of this offensive plant must not approach us in the mosque. The people said: Its (use) has been forbidden; its (use) bu been forbidden. This reached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: O people, I cannot forbid (the use of a thing) which Allah has made lawful, but (this garlic) is a plant the odour of which is repugnant to me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ خَبَّابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ عَلَى زَرَّاعَةِ بَصَلٍ هُوَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ فَنَزَلَ نَاسٌ مِنْهُمْ فَأَكَلُوا مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يَأْكُلْ آخَرُونَ فَرُحْنَا إِلَيْهِ فَدَعَا الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَأْكُلُوا الْبَصَلَ وَأَخَّرَ الآخَرِينَ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ رِيحُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an bukayri bni alaashajji, 'ani abni khabbaabin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marra 'alaa zarraa'aai basalin huwa waaashaabuhu fanazala naasun minhum faaakaluwa minhu walam yaakul akharuwna faruhnaa iilayhi fada'aa alladhiyna lam yaakuluwa albasala waaakhhara alakhariyna hattaa dhahaba riyhuhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) along with his Companions happened to pass by a field in which onions were sown. The people stopped there and ate out of that, but some of them did not eat. Then they (Propbet's Companions) went to him. He (first) called those who had not eaten the onions and kept the others (who had taken onions) waiting till its odour vanished
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، خَطَبَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَذَكَرَ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذَكَرَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ قَالَ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ كَأَنَّ دِيكًا نَقَرَنِي ثَلاَثَ نَقَرَاتٍ وَإِنِّي لاَ أُرَاهُ إِلاَّ حُضُورَ أَجَلِي وَإِنَّ أَقْوَامًا يَأْمُرُونَنِي أَنْ أَسْتَخْلِفَ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِيُضَيِّعَ دِينَهُ وَلاَ خِلاَفَتَهُ وَلاَ الَّذِي بَعَثَ بِهِ نَبِيَّهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنْ عَجِلَ بِي أَمْرٌ فَالْخِلاَفَةُ شُورَى بَيْنَ هَؤُلاَءِ السِّتَّةِ الَّذِينَ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ عَنْهُمْ رَاضٍ وَإِنِّي قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ أَقْوَامًا يَطْعَنُونَ فِي هَذَا الأَمْرِ أَنَا ضَرَبْتُهُمْ بِيَدِي هَذِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ فَإِنْ فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ أَعْدَاءُ اللَّهِ الْكَفَرَةُ الضُّلاَّلُ ثُمَّ إِنِّي لاَ أَدَعُ بَعْدِي شَيْئًا أَهَمَّ عِنْدِي مِنَ الْكَلاَلَةِ مَا رَاجَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي شَىْءٍ مَا رَاجَعْتُهُ فِي الْكَلاَلَةِ وَمَا أَغْلَظَ لِي فِي شَىْءٍ مَا أَغْلَظَ لِي فِيهِ حَتَّى طَعَنَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ فِي صَدْرِي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا عُمَرُ أَلاَ تَكْفِيكَ آيَةُ الصَّيْفِ الَّتِي فِي آخِرِ سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِنِّي إِنْ أَعِشْ أَقْضِ فِيهَا بِقَضِيَّةٍ يَقْضِي بِهَا مَنْ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَمَنْ لاَ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ عَلَى أُمَرَاءِ الأَمْصَارِ وَإِنِّي إِنَّمَا بَعَثْتُهُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْدِلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ وَلِيُعَلِّمُوا النَّاسَ دِينَهُمْ وَسُنَّةَ نَبِيِّهِمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَيَقْسِمُوا فِيهِمْ فَيْئَهُمْ وَيَرْفَعُوا إِلَىَّ مَا أَشْكَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تَأْكُلُونَ شَجَرَتَيْنِ لاَ أَرَاهُمَا إِلاَّ خَبِيثَتَيْنِ هَذَا الْبَصَلَ وَالثُّومَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا وَجَدَ رِيحَهُمَا مِنَ الرَّجُلِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَأُخْرِجَ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ فَمَنْ أَكَلَهُمَا فَلْيُمِتْهُمَا طَبْخًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hishaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an ma'daana bni aabiy talhaaa, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, khataba yawma aljumu'aai fadhakara nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wadhakara aabaa bakrin qaala iinniy raaaytu kaaanna diykana naqaraniy thalaatha naqaraatin waiinniy laa auraahu iilaaa huduwra aajaliy waiinna aaqwaamana yaamuruwnaniy aan aastakhlifa waiinna alllaha lam yakun liyudayyi'a diynahu walaa khilaafatahu walaa alladhiy ba'atha bihi nabiyyahu sla allh 'lyh wslm faiin 'ajila biy aamrun faalkhilaafaau shuwraa bayna hauulaa'i alssittaai alladhiyna tuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa 'anhum raadin waiinniy qad 'alimtu aanna aaqwaamana yat'anuwna fiy hadhaa alaamri aanaa darabtuhum biyadiy hadhihi 'alaa aliislaami faiin fa'aluwa dhalika faauwlaiika aa'daa'u alllahi alkafaraau alddulaaalu thumma iinniy laa aada'u ba'diy shayiana aahamma 'indiy mina alkalaalaai maa raaja'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy shaa'in maa raaja'tuhu fiy alkalaalaai wamaa aaghlaza liy fiy shaa'in maa aaghlaza liy fiyhi hattaa ta'ana biiisba'ihi fiy sadriy faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa 'umaru aalaa takfiyka ayaau alssayfi allatiy fiy akhiri suwraai alnnisaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waiinniy iin aa'ish aaqdi fiyhaa biqadiyyaain yaqdiy bihaa man yaqraau alqurana waman laa yaqraau alqurana thumma qaala alllahumma iinniy aushhiduka 'alaa aumaraa'i alaamsaari waiinniy iinnamaa ba'athtuhum 'alayhim liya'diluwa 'alayhim waliyu'allimuwa alnnaasa diynahum wasunnaaa nabiyyihim sla allh 'lyh wslm wayaqsimuwa fiyhim fayiahum wayarfa'uwa iilaaaa maa aashkala 'alayhim min aamrihim thumma iinnakum aayyuhaa alnnaasu taakuluwna shajaratayni laa aaraahumaa iilaaa khabiythatayni hadhaa albasala waalthhuwma laqad raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa wajada riyhahumaa mina alrrajuli fiy almasjidi aamara bihi faaukhrija iilaa albaqiy'i faman aakalahumaa falyumithumaa tabkhana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ma'dan b. Talha reported:'Umar b. Khattab, delivered the Friday sermon and he made a mention of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr. He (further) said: I saw in a dream that a cock pecked me twice, and I perceive that my death is near. Some people have suggested me to appoint my successor. And Allah would not destroy His religion. His caliphate and that with which He sent His Apostle (ﷺ) If death approaches me soon, the (issue) of Caliphate (would be decided) by the consent of these six men with whom the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) remained well pleased till his death. And I know fully well that some people would blame me that I killed with these very hands of mine some persons who apparently professed (Islam). And if they do this (blame me) they are the enemies of Allah, and are non-believers and have gone astray. And I leave not after me anything which to my mind seems more important than Kalala. And I never turned towards the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (for guidance) more often than this Kalala, and he (the Holy Prophet) was not annoyed with me on any other (issue) than this: (And he was so perturbed) that he struck his fingers on my chest and said: Does this verse. that is at the end of Surat al-Nisa'. which was revealed in the hot season not suffice you? And if I live longer I would decide this (problem so clearly) that one who reads the Qur'an, or one who does not read it, would be able to take (correct), decisions (under its light). He ('Umar) further said: Allah! I call You witness on these governors of lands, that I sent them to (the peoples of these lands) so that they should administer justice amongst them, teach them their religion and the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and distribute amongst them the spoils of war and refer to me that which they find difficult to perform. O people. you eat 'these two plants and these are onions and garlic. and I find them nothing but repugnant for I saw that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sensed the odour of these two from a person in a mosque, he was made to go to al-Baqi'. So he who eats it should (make its odour) die by cooking it well
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شَبَابَةَ بْنِ سَوَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, h qaala wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, kilaahumaa 'an shabaabaaa bni sawwaarin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, jamiy'ana 'an qataadaaa, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مَوْلَى شَدَّادِ بْنِ الْهَادِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَمِعَ رَجُلاً يَنْشُدُ ضَالَّةً فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَلْيَقُلْ لاَ رَدَّهَا اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ فَإِنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لَمْ تُبْنَ لِهَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amrinw haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an haywaaa, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy 'abdi alllahi, mawlaa shaddaadi bni alhaadi aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man sami'a rajulaan yanshudu daallaaan fiy almasjidi falyaqul laa raddahaa alllahu 'alayka faiinna almasaajida lam tubna lihadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If anyone hears a man crying out in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: May Allah not restore it to you, for the mosques were not built for this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الأَسْوَدِ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مَوْلَى شَدَّادٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa almuqriiu, haddathanaa haywaau, qaala sami'tu aabaa alaaswadi, yaquwlu haddathaniy aabuw 'abdi alllahi, mawlaa shaddaadin aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، نَشَدَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى الْجَمَلِ الأَحْمَرِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ وَجَدْتَ ‏.‏ إِنَّمَا بُنِيَتِ الْمَسَاجِدُ لِمَا بُنِيَتْ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa althhawriyyu, 'an 'alqamaaa bni marthadin, 'an sulaymaana bni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rajulaan, nashada fiy almasjidi faqaala man da'aa iilaa aljamali alaahmari ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa wajadta ‏.‏ iinnamaa buniyati almasaajidu limaa buniyat lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sulaiman b. Buraida narrated it on the authority of his father that a man cried out in the mosque saying:Who had called out for the red camel? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا صَلَّى قَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى الْجَمَلِ الأَحْمَرِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ وَجَدْتَ إِنَّمَا بُنِيَتِ الْمَسَاجِدُ لِمَا بُنِيَتْ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an aabiy sinaanin, 'an 'alqamaaa bni marthadin, 'an sulaymaana bni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa sallaa qaama rajulun faqaala man da'aa iilaa aljamali alaahmari faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa wajadta iinnamaa buniyati almasaajidu limaa buniyat lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sulaiman b. Buraida reported on the authority of his father that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said prayer a man stood up and said:Who called for a red camel? (Upon this) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ بَعْدَ مَا صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ ‏.‏ فَأَدْخَلَ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ بَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَذَكَرَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ هُوَ شَيْبَةُ بْنُ نَعَامَةَ أَبُو نَعَامَةَ رَوَى عَنْهُ مِسْعَرٌ وَهُشَيْمٌ وَجَرِيرٌ وَغَيْرُهُمْ مِنَ الْكُوفِيِّينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an muhammadi bni shaybaaa, 'an 'alqamaaa bni marthadin, 'ani abni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala jaa'a aa'raabiyyun ba'da maa sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alfajri ‏.‏ faaadkhala raasahu min baabi almasjidi fadhakara ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihimaa ‏.‏ qaala muslimun huwa shaybaau bnu na'aamaaa aabuw na'aamaaa rawaa 'anhu mis'arun wahushaymun wajariyrun waghayruhum mina alkuwfiyyiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Buraida narrated it on the authority of his father that a Bedouin came when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had completed the morning prayer. He thrust his head in the door of the mosque, and then the hadith (as narrated above) was narrated. This hadith has been reported by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا قَامَ يُصَلِّي جَاءَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَلَبَسَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى لاَ يَدْرِي كَمْ صَلَّى فَإِذَا وَجَدَ ذَلِكَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aahadakum iidhaa qaama yusalliy jaa'ahu alshhaytaanu falabasa 'alayhi hattaa laa yadriy kam sallaa faiidhaa wajada dhalika aahadukum falyasjud sajdatayni wahuwa jaalisun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you stands up to pray, the devil comes to him and confuses him to that he does not know how much he has prayed. If any one of you has such an experience he should perform two prostrations while sitting down (in qa'da)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ - ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, - wahuwa abnu 'uyaynaaa - h qaala wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by al-Zubri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا نُودِيَ بِالأَذَانِ أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَهُ ضُرَاطٌ حَتَّى لاَ يَسْمَعَ الأَذَانَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ الأَذَانُ أَقْبَلَ فَإِذَا ثُوِّبَ بِهَا أَدْبَرَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ التَّثْوِيبُ أَقْبَلَ يَخْطُرُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَنَفْسِهِ يَقُولُ اذْكُرْ كَذَا اذْكُرْ كَذَا ‏.‏ لِمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَذْكُرُ حَتَّى يَظَلَّ الرَّجُلُ إِنْ يَدْرِي كَمْ صَلَّى فَإِذَا لَمْ يَدْرِ أَحَدُكُمْ كَمْ صَلَّى فَلْيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, haddathahum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa nuwdiya bialaadhaani aadbara alshhaytaanu lahu duraatun hattaa laa yasma'a alaadhaana faiidhaa qudiya alaadhaanu aaqbala faiidhaa thuwwiba bihaa aadbara faiidhaa qudiya alttathwiybu aaqbala yakhturu bayna almar'i wanafsihi yaquwlu adhkur kadhaa adhkur kadhaa ‏.‏ limaa lam yakun yadhkuru hattaa yazalla alrrajulu iin yadriy kam sallaa faiidhaa lam yadri aahadukum kam sallaa falyasjud sajdatayni wahuwa jaalisun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When there is a call to prayer the devil runs back breaking the wind so that he may not hear the call, and when the call is complete he comes back. And when the takbir is pronounced he again runs back, and when takbir is over he comes back and distracts a man saying: Remember such and such, remember such and such, referring to something the man did not have in his mind. with the result that he does not know how much he has prayed; so when any one of you is not sure how much he has prayed. he should perform two prostrations while sitting (qa'da)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ إِذَا ثُوِّبَ بِالصَّلاَةِ وَلَّى وَلَهُ ضُرَاطٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ وَزَادَ ‏"‏ فَهَنَّاهُ وَمَنَّاهُ وَذَكَّرَهُ مِنْ حَاجَاتِهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَذْكُرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an 'abdi rabbihi bni sa'iydin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna alshhaytaana iidhaa thuwwiba bialssalaaai wallaa walahu duraatun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu wazaada ‏"‏ fahannaahu wamannaahu wadhakkarahu min haajaatihi maa lam yakun yadhkuru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The devil takes to his heels breaking wind when the prayer begins. and the rest is the same but with this addition:" He (the devil) makes him think of pleasant things (or things productive of enjoyment) and of the things wished for, and reminds him of such needs which he had forgotten
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ بَعْضِ الصَّلَوَاتِ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَلَمْ يَجْلِسْ فَقَامَ النَّاسُ مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلاَتَهُ وَنَظَرْنَا تَسْلِيمَهُ كَبَّرَ فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ قَبْلَ التَّسْلِيمِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an 'abdi alllahi abni buhaynaaa, qaala sallaa lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rak'atayni min ba'di alssalawaati thumma qaama falam yajlis faqaama alnnaasu ma'ahu falammaa qadaa salaatahu wanazarnaa tasliymahu kabbara fasajada sajdatayni wahuwa jaalisun qabla alttasliymi thumma sallama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Buhaina reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us two rak'ahs of prayer in one of the (obligatory) prayers and then got up and did not sit. and the people stood up along with him. When he finished the prayer and we expected him to pronounce salutation. he said:" Allah is Most Great" while sitting and made two prostrations before salutation and then pronounced (the, final) salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ الأَسْدِيِّ، حَلِيفِ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ فِي صَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ وَعَلَيْهِ جُلُوسٌ فَلَمَّا أَتَمَّ صَلاَتَهُ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ يُكَبِّرُ فِي كُلِّ سَجْدَةٍ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ وَسَجَدَهُمَا النَّاسُ مَعَهُ مَكَانَ مَا نَسِيَ مِنَ الْجُلُوسِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h qaala wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an 'abdi alllahi abni buhaynaaa alaasdiyyi, haliyfi baniy 'abdi almuttalibi aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama fiy salaaai alzzuhri wa'alayhi juluwsun falammaa aatamma salaatahu sajada sajdatayni yukabbiru fiy kulli sajdaain wahuwa jaalisun qabla aan yusallima wasajadahumaa alnnaasu ma'ahu makaana maa nasiya mina aljuluwsi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Buhaina al-Asadi, the ally of Abual-Muttalib, reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up in the noon prayer (though) he hadith sit (after the two rak'ahs). When he completed the prayer he performed two prostrations and said," Allah is the Most Great" in each prostration, while he was sitting before pronouncing salutation, and the people performed prostration along with him. That was a compensation for he had forgotten to observe jalsa (after two rak'ahs)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ الأَزْدِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ فِي الشَّفْعِ الَّذِي يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَمَضَى فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي آخِرِ الصَّلاَةِ سَجَدَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni maalikin abni buhaynaaa alaazdiyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama fiy alshhaf'i alladhiy yuriydu aan yajlisa fiy salaatihi famadaa fiy salaatihi falammaa kaana fiy akhiri alssalaaai sajada qabla aan yusallima thumma sallama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Malik ibn Buhaina al-Asadi reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up (at the end of two rak'ahs) when he had to sit and proceeded on with the prayer. But when he was at the end of the prayer, he performed a prostration before the salutation and then pronounced the salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا شَكَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ كَمْ صَلَّى ثَلاَثًا أَمْ أَرْبَعًا فَلْيَطْرَحِ الشَّكَّ وَلْيَبْنِ عَلَى مَا اسْتَيْقَنَ ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ فَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى خَمْسًا شَفَعْنَ لَهُ صَلاَتَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى إِتْمَامًا لأَرْبَعٍ كَانَتَا تَرْغِيمًا لِلشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu aahmada bni aabiy khalafin, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu daawuda, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa shakka aahadukum fiy salaatihi falam yadri kam sallaa thalaathana aam aarba'ana falyatrahi alshhakka walyabni 'alaa maa astayqana thumma yasjudu sajdatayni qabla aan yusallima faiin kaana sallaa khamsana shafa'na lahu salaatahu waiin kaana sallaa iitmaamana laarba'in kaanataa targhiymana lilshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you is in doubt about his prayer and he does Dot know how much he has prayed, three or four (rak'ahs). he should cast aside his doubt and base his prayer on what he is sure of. then perform two prostrations before giving salutations. If he has prayed five rak'ahs, they will make his prayer an even number for him, and if he has prayed exactly four, they will be humiliation for the devil
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي دَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي مَعْنَاهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ السَّلاَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni wahbin, haddathaniy 'ammiy 'abdu alllahi, haddathaniy daawudu bnu qaysin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy ma'naahu qaala ‏ "‏ yasjudu sajdatayni qabla alssalaami ‏"‏ ‏.‏ kamaa qaala sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters and he said:He should perform two prostrations before the salutation, as it was mentioned by Sulaiman b. Bilal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ ابْنَا أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، - قَالَ عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ زَادَ أَوْ نَقَصَ - فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قِيلَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَحَدَثَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ شَىْءٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا صَلَّيْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا - قَالَ - فَثَنَى رِجْلَيْهِ وَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَوْ حَدَثَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ شَىْءٌ أَنْبَأْتُكُمْ بِهِ وَلَكِنْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ أَنْسَى كَمَا تَنْسَوْنَ فَإِذَا نَسِيتُ فَذَكِّرُونِي وَإِذَا شَكَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَلْيَتَحَرَّ الصَّوَابَ فَلْيُتِمَّ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ لْيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu, waaabuw bakrin abnaa aabiy shaybaaa waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma jamiy'ana 'an jariyrin, - qaala 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, - 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala iibraahiymu zaada aaw naqasa - falammaa sallama qiyla lahu yaa rasuwla alllahi aahadatha fiy alssalaaai shaa'un qaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa sallayta kadhaa wakadhaa - qaala - fathanaa rijlayhi waastaqbala alqiblaaa fasajada sajdatayni thumma sallama thumma aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi faqaala ‏"‏ iinnahu law hadatha fiy alssalaaai shaa'un aanbaatukum bihi walakin iinnamaa aanaa basharun aansaa kamaa tansawna faiidhaa nasiytu fadhakkiruwniy waiidhaa shakka aahadukum fiy salaatihi falyataharra alssawaaba falyutimma 'alayhi thumma lyasjud sajdatayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Alqama narrated It on the authority of 'Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) who said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the prayer; (the narrator added): He made some act of omission or commission when he pronounced salutation; it was said to him: Messenger of Allah, is there something new about the prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: What is it? They said: You said prayer in such and such away. He (the narrator) said: He (the Holy Prophet) turned his feet and faced the Qibla and performed two prostrations and then pronounced salutations, and then turned his face towards us and said: If there is anything new about prayer (new command from the Lord) I informed you of that. But I am a human being and I forget as you for. get, so when I forget, remind me, and when any one of you is in doubt about his prayer. he should aim at what Is correct. and complete his prayer in that respect and then make two prostrations
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بِشْرٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ بِشْرٍ ‏"‏ فَلْيَنْظُرْ أَحْرَى ذَلِكَ لِلصَّوَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ وَكِيعٍ ‏"‏ فَلْيَتَحَرَّ الصَّوَابَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu bishrin, h qaala wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, kilaahumaa 'an mis'arin, 'an mansuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni bishrin ‏"‏ falyanzur aahraa dhalika lilssawaabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai wakiy'in ‏"‏ falyataharra alssawaaba ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters, with a slight modification of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ مَنْصُورٌ ‏ "‏ فَلْيَنْظُرْ أَحْرَى ذَلِكَ لِلصَّوَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu hassaana, haddathanaa wuhaybu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa mansuwrun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala mansuwrun ‏ "‏ falyanzur aahraa dhalika lilssawaabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters, but with these words:" He should aim at correct (prayer) and it is advisable
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلْيَتَحَرَّ الصَّوَابَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu bnu sa'iydin alaumawiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ falyataharra alssawaaba ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters with the words:He should aim at what is correct and complete
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلْيَتَحَرَّ أَقْرَبَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى الصَّوَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ falyataharra aaqraba dhalika iilaa alssawaabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters and said:" He should aim at correctness and that is right
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلْيَتَحَرَّ الَّذِي يُرَى أَنَّهُ الصَّوَابُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa fudaylu bnu 'iyaadin, 'an mansuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ falyataharra alladhiy yuraa aannahu alssawaabu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported by Mansur with the same chain of transwitters and he said:" He should aim at what is according to him correct
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ هَؤُلاَءِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلْيَتَحَرَّ الصَّوَابَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, 'an mansuwrin, biiisnaadi hauulaa'i waqaala ‏ "‏ falyataharra alssawaaba ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur and he said:" He should aim at correctness
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ خَمْسًا فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قِيلَ لَهُ أَزِيدَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا صَلَّيْتَ خَمْسًا ‏.‏ فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa alzzuhra khamsana falammaa sallama qiyla lahu aaziyda fiy alssalaaai qaala ‏ "‏ wamaa dhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa sallayta khamsana ‏.‏ fasajada sajdatayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said five rak'ahs of the noon prayer and when he completed the prayer, It was said to him: Has there been (commanded) an addition In prayer? He said: What is it? They said: You have said five rak'ahs, so he performed two prostrations
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ صَلَّى بِهِمْ خَمْسًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, 'ani alhasani bni 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, aannahu sallaa bihim khamsana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Alqama reported:He (the Holy Prophet) had led them five rak'ahs in prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا عَلْقَمَةُ الظُّهْرَ خَمْسًا فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَالَ الْقَوْمُ يَا أَبَا شِبْلٍ قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ خَمْسًا ‏.‏ قَالَ كَلاَّ مَا فَعَلْتُ ‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى - قَالَ - وَكُنْتُ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْقَوْمِ وَأَنَا غُلاَمٌ فَقُلْتُ بَلَى قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ خَمْسًا ‏.‏ قَالَ لِي وَأَنْتَ أَيْضًا يَا أَعْوَرُ تَقُولُ ذَاكَ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْفَتَلَ فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمْسًا فَلَمَّا انْفَتَلَ تَوَشْوَشَ الْقَوْمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ زِيدَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَإِنَّكَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ خَمْسًا ‏.‏ فَانْفَتَلَ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ أَنْسَى كَمَا تَنْسَوْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ فَإِذَا نَسِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alhasani bni 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an iibraahiyma bni suwaydin, qaala sallaa binaa 'alqamaau alzzuhra khamsana falammaa sallama qaala alqawmu yaa aabaa shiblin qad sallayta khamsana ‏.‏ qaala kalaaa maa fa'altu ‏.‏ qaaluwa balaa - qaala - wakuntu fiy naahiyaai alqawmi waaanaa ghulaamun faqultu balaa qad sallayta khamsana ‏.‏ qaala liy waaanta aaydana yaa aa'waru taquwlu dhaaka qaala qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala faanfatala fasajada sajdatayni thumma sallama thumma qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khamsana falammaa anfatala tawashwasha alqawmu baynahum faqaala ‏"‏ maa shaanukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi hal ziyda fiy alssalaaai qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa faiinnaka qad sallayta khamsana ‏.‏ faanfatala thumma sajada sajdatayni thumma sallama thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa aanaa basharun mithlukum aansaa kamaa tansawna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wazaada abnu numayrin fiy hadiythihi ‏"‏ faiidhaa nasiya aahadukum falyasjud sajdatayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibrahim b. Suwaid-reported:'Alqama led us in the noon prayer and be offered five rak'ahs; when the prayer was complete, the people said to him: Abu Shibl, you have offered five rak'ahs. He said: No, I have not done that. They said: Yes (you said five rak'ahs). He (the narrator) said: And I was sitting in a corner among people and I was just a boy. I (also) said: Yes, you have offered five (rak'ahs). He said to me: O, one-eyed, do you say the same thing? I said: Yes. Upon this he turned (his face) and performed two prostrations and then gave salutations, and then reported 'Abdullah as saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in prayer and offered five rak'ahs. And as he turned away the people began to whisper amongst themselves. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What is the matter with you? They said: Has the prayer been extended? He said: No. They said: You have in fact said five rak'ahs. He (the Holy Prophet) then turned his back (and faced the Qibla) and performed two prostrations and then gave salutations and further said: Verily I am a human being like you, I forget just as you forget. Ibn Numair made this addition:" When any one of you forgets, he must perform two prostrations
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَوْنُ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ الْكُوفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ النَّهْشَلِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمْسًا فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَزِيدَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا صَلَّيْتَ خَمْسًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ أَذْكُرُ كَمَا تَذْكُرُونَ وَأَنْسَى كَمَا تَنْسَوْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَىِ السَّهْوِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'awnu bnu salaaamin alkuwfiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw bakrin alnnahshaliyyu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alaaswadi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khamsana faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi aaziyda fiy alssalaaai qaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa sallayta khamsana ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa aanaa basharun mithlukum aadhkuru kamaa tadhkuruwna waaansaa kamaa tansawna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma sajada sajdataai alssahwi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us five (rak'ahs in prayer). We said: Messenger of Allah, has the prayer been extended? He said: What is the matter? They said: You have said five (rak'ahs). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Verily I am a human being like you. I remember as you remember and I forget just as you forget. He then performed two prostrations as (compensation of) forgetfulness
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَزَادَ أَوْ نَقَصَ - قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَالْوَهْمُ مِنِّي - فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَزِيدَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ شَىْءٌ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ أَنْسَى كَمَا تَنْسَوْنَ فَإِذَا نَسِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَحَوَّلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu mushirin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fazaada aaw naqasa - qaala iibraahiymu waalwahmu minniy - faqiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi aaziyda fiy alssalaaai shaa'un faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa aanaa basharun mithlukum aansaa kamaa tansawna faiidhaa nasiya aahadukum falyasjud sajdatayni wahuwa jaalisun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma tahawwala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasajada sajdatayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer and he omitted or committed (something). Ibrahim (one of the narrators of this hadith) said: It is my doubt, and it was said: Messenger of Allah, has there been any addition to the prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Verily I am a human being like you. I forget just as you forget so when any one of you forgets, he must perform two prostrations, and he (the Holy Prophet) was sitting and then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned (his face towards the Qibla) and performed two prostrations
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَىِ السَّهْوِ بَعْدَ السَّلاَمِ وَالْكَلاَمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h qaala wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa hafsun, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sajada sajdataai alssahwi ba'da alssalaami waalkalaami ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) performed two prostrations for forgetfulness after salutation and talking
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجُعْفِيُّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ صَلَّيْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِمَّا زَادَ أَوْ نَقَصَ - قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ مَا جَاءَ ذَاكَ إِلاَّ مِنْ قِبَلِي - قَالَ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَحَدَثَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ شَىْءٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ الَّذِي صَنَعَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا زَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَوْ نَقَصَ فَلْيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin alju'fiyyu, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an sulaymaana, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala sallaynaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiimmaa zaada aaw naqasa - qaala iibraahiymu waaymu alllahi maa jaa'a dhaaka iilaaa min qibaliy - qaala faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi aahadatha fiy alssalaaai shaa'un faqaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqulnaa lahu alladhiy sana'a faqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa zaada alrrajulu aaw naqasa falyasjud sajdatayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma sajada sajdatayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported:We prayed along with the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) and he committed or omitted (something). Ibrahim said: By Allah, this is a misgiving of mine only. We said: Messenger of Allah, is there something new about the prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No. We told him about what he had done. He (the Holy Prophet) said: When a man commits or omits (something in prayer), he should perform two prostrations, and he then himself performed two prostrations
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ سِيرِينَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِحْدَى صَلاَتَىِ الْعَشِيِّ إِمَّا الظُّهْرَ وَإِمَّا الْعَصْرَ فَسَلَّمَ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ أَتَى جِذْعًا فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَاسْتَنَدَ إِلَيْهَا مُغْضَبًا وَفِي الْقَوْمِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ فَهَابَا أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَا وَخَرَجَ سَرَعَانُ النَّاسِ قُصِرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَقَامَ ذُو الْيَدَيْنِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَقُصِرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ أَمْ نَسِيتَ فَنَظَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمِينًا وَشِمَالاً فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا يَقُولُ ذُو الْيَدَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا صَدَقَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ إِلاَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ فَرَفَعَ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ وَسَجَدَ ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأُخْبِرْتُ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَسَلَّمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - haddathanaa aayyuwbu, qaala sami'tu muhammada bna siyriyna, yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iihdaa salaataai al'ashiyyi iimmaa alzzuhra waiimmaa al'asra fasallama fiy rak'atayni thumma aataa jidh'ana fiy qiblaai almasjidi faastanada iilayhaa mughdabana wafiy alqawmi aabuw bakrin wa'umaru fahaabaa aan yatakallamaa wakharaja sara'aanu alnnaasi qusirati alssalaaau faqaama dhuw alyadayni faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaqusirati alssalaaau aam nasiyta fanazara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yamiynana washimaalaan faqaala ‏ "‏ maa yaquwlu dhuw alyadayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa sadaqa lam tusalli iilaaa rak'atayni ‏.‏ fasallaa rak'atayni wasallama thumma kabbara thumma sajada thumma kabbara farafa'a thumma kabbara wasajada thumma kabbara warafa'a ‏.‏ qaala waaukhbirtu 'an 'imraana bni husaynin aannahu qaala wasallama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Sirin reported Abu Huraira as saying:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in one of the two evening prayers, Zuhr or `Asr, and gave salutations after two rak`ahs and going towards a piece of wood which was placed to the direction of the Qibla in the mosque, leaned on it looking as if he were angry. Abu Bakr and `Umar were among the people and they were too afraid to speak to him and the people came out in haste (saying): The prayer has been shortened. But among them was a man called Dhul-Yadain who said: Messenger of Allah, has the prayer been shortened or have you forgotten? The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) looked to the right and left and said: What was Dhul-Yadain saying? They said: He is right. You (the Holy Prophet) offered but two rak`ahs. He offered two (more) rak`ahs and gave salutation, then said takbir and prostrated and lifted (his head) and then said takbir and prostrated, then said takbir and lifted (his head). He (the narrator) says: It has been reported to me by `Imran b. Husain that he said: He (then) gave salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِحْدَى صَلاَتَىِ الْعَشِيِّ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iihdaa salaataai al'ashiyyi ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi sufyaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in one of the evening prayers. And this hadith was narrated like one transmitted by Sufyan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْعَصْرِ فَسَلَّمَ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَقَامَ ذُو الْيَدَيْنِ فَقَالَ أَقُصِرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَمْ نَسِيتَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ لَمْ يَكُنْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ قَدْ كَانَ بَعْضُ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَدَقَ ذُو الْيَدَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَأَتَمَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ بَعْدَ التَّسْلِيمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an daawuda bni alhusayni, 'an aabiy sufyaana, mawlaa abni aabiy aahmada aannahu qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu sallaa lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa al'asri fasallama fiy rak'atayni faqaama dhuw alyadayni faqaala aaqusirati alssalaaau yaa rasuwla alllahi aam nasiyta faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kullu dhalika lam yakun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala qad kaana ba'du dhalika yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faaaqbala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alnnaasi faqaala ‏"‏ aasadaqa dhuw alyadayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa na'am yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faaatamma rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa baqiya mina alssalaaai thumma sajada sajdatayni wahuwa jaalisun ba'da alttasliymi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in the 'Asr prayer and gave salutation after two rak'ahs. Dhu'l-Yadain (the possessor of long arms) stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, has the prayer been shortened or have you forgotten? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Nothing like this has happened (neither the prayer has been shortened nor have I forgotten). He (Dhu'l-Yadain) said: Messenger of Allah, something has definitely happened. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned towards people and said: Is Dhu'l-Yadain true (in his assertion)? They said: Messenger of Allah, he is true. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) completed the rest of the prayer. and then performed two prostrations while he was sitting after salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ الْخَزَّازُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَقُصِرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ أَمْ نَسِيتَ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu iismaa'iyla alkhazzaazu, haddathanaa 'aliyyun, - wahuwa abnu almubaaraki - haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa, haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa rak'atayni min salaaai alzzuhri thumma sallama faaataahu rajulun min baniy sulaymin faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaqusirati alssalaaau aam nasiyta wasaaqa alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said two rak'ahs of the noon prayer and then gave salutation when a man from Band Sulaim came to him and said: Messenger of Allah. has the prayer been shortened, or have you forgotten? -and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا أُصَلِّي، مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الظُّهْرِ سَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an shaybaana, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala baynaa aanaa ausalliy, ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alzzuhri sallama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alrrak'atayni faqaama rajulun min baniy sulaymin ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:I offered with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the noon prayer and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave salutation after two rak'ahs. A person from Bani Sulaim stood up, and the rest of the hadith was narrated as mentioned above
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ فَسَلَّمَ فِي ثَلاَثِ رَكَعَاتٍ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ مَنْزِلَهُ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ الْخِرْبَاقُ وَكَانَ فِي يَدَيْهِ طُولٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ صَنِيعَهُ ‏.‏ وَخَرَجَ غَضْبَانَ يَجُرُّ رِدَاءَهُ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَصَدَقَ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, - 'an khaalidin, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy almuhallabi, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa al'asra fasallama fiy thalaathi raka'aatin thumma dakhala manzilahu faqaama iilayhi rajulun yuqaalu lahu alkhirbaaqu wakaana fiy yadayhi tuwlun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ fadhakara lahu saniy'ahu ‏.‏ wakharaja ghadbaana yajurru ridaa'ahu hattaa antahaa iilaa alnnaasi faqaala ‏ "‏ aasadaqa hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'am ‏.‏ fasallaa rak'aaan thumma sallama thumma sajada sajdatayni thumma sallama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the afternoon prayer and gave the salutation. at the end of three rak'ahs and then went into his house. A man called al-Khirbaq, who bad long aims, got up and went to him, and addressed him as Messenger of Allah and mentioned to him what he had done. He came out angrily trailing his mantle, and when he came to the people he said: Is this man telling the truth? They said: Yes. He then said one rak'ah and then gave salutation and then performed two prostrations and then gave salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - وَهُوَ الْحَذَّاءُ - عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، قَالَ سَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ثَلاَثِ رَكَعَاتٍ مِنَ الْعَصْرِ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَدَخَلَ الْحُجْرَةَ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ بَسِيطُ الْيَدَيْنِ فَقَالَ أَقُصِرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ مُغْضَبًا فَصَلَّى الرَّكْعَةَ الَّتِي كَانَ تَرَكَ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَىِ السَّهْوِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - wahuwa alhadhhaa'u - 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy almuhallabi, 'an 'imraana bni alhusayni, qaala sallama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy thalaathi raka'aatin mina al'asri thumma qaama fadakhala alhujraaa faqaama rajulun basiytu alyadayni faqaala aaqusirati alssalaaau yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ fakharaja mughdabana fasallaa alrrak'aaa allatiy kaana taraka thumma sallama thumma sajada sajdataai alssahwi thumma sallama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said three rak'ahs of the 'Asr prayer and then got up and went to his apartment. A man possessing large arms stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, bias the player been shortened? He came out angrily, and said the rak'ah which he had omitted and then gave salutation. then performed two prostrations of forgetfulness and then gave salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانِ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ فَيَقْرَأُ سُورَةً فِيهَا سَجْدَةٌ فَيَسْجُدُ وَنَسْجُدُ مَعَهُ حَتَّى مَا يَجِدُ بَعْضُنَا مَوْضِعًا لِمَكَانِ جَبْهَتِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, kulluhum 'an yahyaa alqattaani, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau alqurana fayaqraau suwraaan fiyhaa sajdaaun fayasjudu wanasjudu ma'ahu hattaa maa yajidu ba'dunaa mawdi'ana limakaani jabhatihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while reciting the Qur'an recited its surah containing sajda, and he performed prostration and we also prostrated along with him (but we were so overcrowded) that some of us could not find a place for our forehead (when prostrating ourselves)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ رُبَّمَا قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقُرْآنَ فَيَمُرُّ بِالسَّجْدَةِ فَيَسْجُدُ بِنَا حَتَّى ازْدَحَمْنَا عِنْدَهُ حَتَّى مَا يَجِدُ أَحَدُنَا مَكَانًا لِيَسْجُدَ فِيهِ فِي غَيْرِ صَلاَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala rubbamaa qaraaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alqurana fayamurru bialssajdaai fayasjudu binaa hattaa azdahamnaa 'indahu hattaa maa yajidu aahadunaa makaanana liyasjuda fiyhi fiy ghayri salaaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:Sometimes the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the Qur'an, and would pass by (recite) the verse of sajda and performed prostration and he did this along with us, but we were so crowded in his company that none of us could find a place for performing prostration. (and it was done on occasions) other than prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَسْوَدَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ ‏{‏ وَالنَّجْمِ‏}‏ فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا وَسَجَدَ مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ شَيْخًا أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ حَصًى أَوْ تُرَابٍ فَرَفَعَهُ إِلَى جَبْهَتِهِ وَقَالَ يَكْفِينِي هَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ بَعْدُ قُتِلَ كَافِرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu alaaswada, yuhaddithu 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaraaa ‏{‏ waalnnajmi‏}‏ fasajada fiyhaa wasajada man kaana ma'ahu ghayra aanna shaykhana aakhadha kaffana min hasana aaw turaabin farafa'ahu iilaa jabhatihi waqaala yakfiyniy hadhaa ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi laqad raaaytuhu ba'du qutila kaafirana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b.
