'Umar) reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) recited (Surat) al Najm and performed prostration during its recital and all those who were along with him also prostrated themselves except one old man who took a handful of pebbles or dust in his palm and lifted it to his forehead and said: This is sufficient for me. 'Abdullah said: I saw that he was later killed in a state of unbelief
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُصَيْفَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَأَلَ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ، مَعَ الإِمَامِ فَقَالَ لاَ قِرَاءَةَ مَعَ الإِمَامِ فِي شَىْءٍ ‏.‏ وَزَعَمَ أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏ وَالنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَى‏}‏ فَلَمْ يَسْجُدْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waabnu, hujrin qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, wahuwa abnu ja'farin 'an yaziyda bni khusayfaaa, 'ani abni qusaytin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, aannahu aakhbarahu aannahu, saaala zayda bna thaabitin 'ani alqiraa'aai, ma'a aliimaami faqaala laa qiraa'aaa ma'a aliimaami fiy shaa'in ‏.‏ waza'ama aannahu qaraaa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏ waalnnajmi iidhaa hawaa‏}‏ falam yasjud ‏.‏
verses.translation: ta' b. Yasar reported that he had asked Zaid b. Thabit about recital along with the Imam, to which he said:There should be no recital along with the Imam in anything, and alleged that he recited:" By the star when it sets" (Surah Najm) before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he did not prostrate himself
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَرَأَ لَهُمْ ‏{‏ إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ‏}‏ فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ أَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَجَدَ فِيهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni yaziyda, mawlaa alaaswadi bni sufyaana 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaraaa lahum ‏{‏ iidhaa alssamaa'u anshaqqat‏}‏ fasajada fiyhaa falammaa ansarafa aakhbarahum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sajada fiyhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Salama b. 'Abual-Rahman reported:Abu Huraira recited before them:" hen the heaven burst asunder" (al-Qur'an, lxxxiv. 1) and performed prostration. After completing (the prayer) he informed them that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has prostrated himself at it (this verse)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, h qaala wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an hishaamin, kilaahumaa 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by AbuSalama on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ مِينَاءَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَجَدْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ‏{‏ إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aayyuwba bni muwsaa, 'an 'ataa'i bni miynaa'a, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala sajadnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ‏{‏ iidhaa alssamaa'u anshaqqat‏}‏ wa ‏{‏ aqraa biasmi rabbika‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:We performed prostration along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (as he recited these verses: )" When the heaven burst asunder" and" Read in the name of Thy Lord" (al-Qur'an, xcvi)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، مَوْلَى بَنِي مَخْزُومٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَجَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ‏{‏ إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an safwaana bni sulaymin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, mawlaa baniy makhzuwmin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala sajada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ‏{‏ iidhaa alssamaa'u anshaqqat‏}‏ wa ‏{‏ aqraa biasmi rabbika‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prostrated himself (while reciting these verses)." When the heaven burst asunder" ;" Read in the name of Thy Lord
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy ja'farin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Abual-Rahman al-Araj on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ صَلاَةَ الْعَتَمَةِ فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏ إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ‏}‏ فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ مَا هَذِهِ السَّجْدَةُ فَقَالَ سَجَدْتُ بِهَا خَلْفَ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ أَزَالُ أَسْجُدُ بِهَا حَتَّى أَلْقَاهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى فَلاَ أَزَالُ أَسْجُدُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa haddathanaa almu'tamiru, 'an aabiyhi, 'an bakrin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, qaala sallaytu ma'a aabiy hurayraaa salaaaa al'atamaai faqaraaa ‏{‏ iidhaa alssamaa'u anshaqqat‏}‏ fasajada fiyhaa ‏.‏ faqultu lahu maa hadhihi alssajdaau faqaala sajadtu bihaa khalfa aabiy alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaa aazaalu aasjudu bihaa hattaa aalqaahu ‏.‏ waqaala abnu 'abdi alaa'laa falaa aazaalu aasjuduhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Rafi' reported:I said the night prayer along with Abu Huraira and -as he recited:" When the heaven burst asunder," he performed prostration. Isaid to him: What prostration is this? He said: I prostrated myself (on this occasion of recital) behind Abu'I-Qasim (Muhammad. may peace be upon him), and Iwould go on doing this till I meet him (in the next world). Ibn 'Abu al-A'la said: (Abu Huraira uttered this: ) I would not abandon performing prostration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمُ بْنُ أَخْضَرَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَقُولُوا خَلْفَ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, h qaala wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - h qaala wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdaaa, haddathanaa sulaymu bnu aakhdara, kulluhum 'ani alttaymiyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ ghayra aannahum lam yaquwluwa khalfa aabiy alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Tamimi with the same chain of transmitters except for this that they made no mention of:" Behind Abu'l-Qasim" (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَسْجُدُ فِي ‏{‏ إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ‏}‏ فَقُلْتُ تَسْجُدُ فِيهَا فَقَالَ نَعَمْ رَأَيْتُ خَلِيلِي صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْجُدُ فِيهَا فَلاَ أَزَالُ أَسْجُدُ فِيهَا حَتَّى أَلْقَاهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ قُلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy maymuwnaaa, 'an aabiy raafi'in, qaala raaaytu aabaa hurayraaa yasjudu fiy ‏{‏ iidhaa alssamaa'u anshaqqat‏}‏ faqultu tasjudu fiyhaa faqaala na'am raaaytu khaliyliy sla allh 'lyh wslm yasjudu fiyhaa falaa aazaalu aasjudu fiyhaa hattaa aalqaahu ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau qultu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Rafi' reported:I saw Abu Huraira performing prostration (while reciting this verse: )" When the heaven burst asunder." I said to him: Do you prostrate yourself (while reciting) i? He said: Yes, I saw my best Friend (ﷺ) prostrating himself on (the recital of this verse) and I shall continue prostrating till I meet him. Shu'ba asked: Do you mean (by Friend) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? He said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ رِبْعِيٍّ الْقَيْسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِشَامٍ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَعَدَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ جَعَلَ قَدَمَهُ الْيُسْرَى بَيْنَ فَخِذِهِ وَسَاقِهِ وَفَرَشَ قَدَمَهُ الْيُمْنَى وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ الْيُسْرَى وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُمْنَى وَأَشَارَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ma'mari bni rib'iyyin alqaysiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw hishaamin almakhzuwmiyyu, 'an 'abdi alwaahidi, - wahuwa abnu ziyaadin - haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu hakiymin, haddathaniy 'aamiru bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qa'ada fiy alssalaaai ja'ala qadamahu alyusraa bayna fakhidhihi wasaaqihi wafarasha qadamahu alyumnaa wawada'a yadahu alyusraa 'alaa rukbatihi alyusraa wawada'a yadahu alyumnaa 'alaa fakhidhihi alyumnaa waaashaara biiisba'ihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Zubair narrated on the authority of his father:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat in prayer. he placed the left foot between his thigh and shank and stretched the right foot and placed his left hand on his left knee and placed his right hand on his right thigh, and raised his finger
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَعَدَ يَدْعُو وَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُمْنَى وَيَدَهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُسْرَى وَأَشَارَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ السَّبَّابَةِ وَوَضَعَ إِبْهَامَهُ عَلَى إِصْبَعِهِ الْوُسْطَى وَيُلْقِمُ كَفَّهُ الْيُسْرَى رُكْبَتَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni 'ajlaana, h qaala wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, 'ani abni 'ajlaana, 'an 'aamiri bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qa'ada yad'uw wada'a yadahu alyumnaa 'alaa fakhidhihi alyumnaa wayadahu alyusraa 'alaa fakhidhihi alyusraa waaashaara biiisba'ihi alssabbaabaai wawada'a iibhaamahu 'alaa iisba'ihi alwustaa wayulqimu kaffahu alyusraa rukbatahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Zubair narrated on the authority of his father that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat for supplication, i. e. tashahhud (blessing and supplication), he placed his right hand on his right thigh and his left hand on his left thigh, and pointed with his forefinger, and placed his thumb on his (milddle) finger, and covered his knee with the palm of his left hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا جَلَسَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَرَفَعَ إِصْبَعَهُ الْيُمْنَى الَّتِي تَلِي الإِبْهَامَ فَدَعَا بِهَا وَيَدَهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ الْيُسْرَى بَاسِطُهَا عَلَيْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa jalasa fiy alssalaaai wada'a yadayhi 'alaa rukbatayhi warafa'a iisba'ahu alyumnaa allatiy taliy aliibhaama fada'aa bihaa wayadahu alyusraa 'alaa rukbatihi alyusraa baasituhaa 'alayhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat for tashahhud he placed his left hand on his left knee. and his right hand on his right knee. and he raised his right finger, which is next to the thumb, making supplication in this way, and he stretched his left hand on his left knee
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا قَعَدَ فِي التَّشَهُّدِ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ الْيُسْرَى وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ الْيُمْنَى وَعَقَدَ ثَلاَثَةً وَخَمْسِينَ وَأَشَارَ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa qa'ada fiy alttashahhudi wada'a yadahu alyusraa 'alaa rukbatihi alyusraa wawada'a yadahu alyumnaa 'alaa rukbatihi alyumnaa wa'aqada thalaathaaan wakhamsiyna waaashaara bialssabbaabaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Another version on the authority of Ibn Umar says:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat for tashahhud, he placed his left hand on his left knee and placed his right hand on his right knee, and he formed a ring like (fifty-three) and pointed with his finger of attestation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُعَاوِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ رَآنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ وَأَنَا أَعْبَثُ بِالْحَصَى فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ نَهَانِي فَقَالَ اصْنَعْ كَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْنَعُ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَكَيْفَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْنَعُ قَالَ كَانَ إِذَا جَلَسَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَضَعَ كَفَّهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُمْنَى وَقَبَضَ أَصَابِعَهُ كُلَّهَا وَأَشَارَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ الَّتِي تَلِي الإِبْهَامَ وَوَضَعَ كَفَّهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُسْرَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an muslimi bni aabiy maryama, 'an 'aliyyi bni 'abdi alrrahmani almu'aawiyyi, aannahu qaala raaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara waaanaa aa'bathu bialhasaa fiy alssalaaai falammaa ansarafa nahaaniy faqaala asna' kamaa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasna'u ‏.‏ faqultu wakayfa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasna'u qaala kaana iidhaa jalasa fiy alssalaaai wada'a kaffahu alyumnaa 'alaa fakhidhihi alyumnaa waqabada aasaabi'ahu kullahaa waaashaara biiisba'ihi allatiy taliy aliibhaama wawada'a kaffahu alyusraa 'alaa fakhidhihi alyusraa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. 'Abual-Rahman al-Mu'awi reported:'Abdullah b. Umar saw me playing with pebbles during prayer. After finishing the prayer he forbade me (to do it) and said: Do as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to do. I said: How did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) do? He said that he (the Messenger of Allah) sat at tashahhud, placed his right palm on the right thigh and closed all his fingers and pointed with the help of finger next to the thumb, and placed his left palm on his left thigh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُعَاوِيِّ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَزَادَ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَكَانَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُسْلِمٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muslimi bni aabiy maryama, 'an 'aliyyi bni 'abdi alrrahmani almu'aawiyyi, qaala sallaytu iilaa janbi abni 'umara ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi maalikin wazaada qaala sufyaanu fakaana yahyaa bnu sa'iydin haddathanaa bihi 'an muslimin thumma haddathaniyhi muslimun ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، وَمَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، أَنَّ أَمِيرًا، كَانَ بِمَكَّةَ يُسَلِّمُ تَسْلِيمَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنَّى عَلِقَهَا قَالَ الْحَكَمُ فِي حَدِيثِهِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَفْعَلُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, 'ani alhakami, wamansuwrin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an aabiy ma'marin, aanna aamiyrana, kaana bimakkaaa yusallimu tasliymatayni faqaala 'abdu alllahi aannaa 'aliqahaa qaala alhakamu fiy hadiythihi iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaf'aluhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ma'mar reported:There was an Amir in Mecca who pronounced taslim twice. Abdullah said: Where did he get this sunnah? Al-Hakam said: There is a hadith to the effect that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did like It
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - قَالَ شُعْبَةُ - رَفَعَهُ مَرَّةً - أَنَّ أَمِيرًا أَوْ رَجُلاً سَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنَّى عَلِقَهَا
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu hanbalin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, 'ani alhakami, 'an mujaahidin, 'an aabiy ma'marin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, - qaala shu'baau - rafa'ahu marraaan - aanna aamiyrana aaw rajulaan sallama tasliymatayni faqaala 'abdu alllahi aannaa 'aliqahaa
verses.translation: Abdullah reported:An Amir or a person pronounced taslim twice. 'Abdullah said: Where did he get this sunnah?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَرَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ حَتَّى أَرَى بَيَاضَ خَدِّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin, 'an iismaa'iyla bni muhammadin, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kuntu aaraa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusallimu 'an yamiynihi wa'an yasaarihi hattaa aaraa bayaada khaddihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd reported:I saw the Messenger of Allah (may peace be open him) pronouncing taslim on his right and on his left till I saw the whiteness of his cheek
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي بِذَا أَبُو مَعْبَدٍ، - ثُمَّ أَنْكَرَهُ بَعْدُ - عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَعْرِفُ انْقِضَاءَ صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالتَّكْبِيرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, qaala aakhbaraniy bidhaa aabuw ma'badin, - thumma aankarahu ba'du - 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kunnaa na'rifu anqidaa'a salaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialttakbiyri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas said:We used to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished his prayer when we heard the takbir (Allah-O-Akbar)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يُخْبِرُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْرِفُ انْقِضَاءَ صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لأَبِي مَعْبَدٍ فَأَنْكَرَهُ وَقَالَ لَمْ أُحَدِّثْكَ بِهَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو وَقَدْ أَخْبَرَنِيهِ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an aabiy ma'badin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin aannahu sami'ahu yukhbiru, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala maa kunnaa na'rifu anqidaa'a salaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa bialttakbiyri ‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw fadhakartu dhalika laabiy ma'badin faaankarahu waqaala lam auhaddithka bihadhaa ‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw waqad aakhbaraniyhi qabla dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:We knew the finishing of the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) through takbir. 'Amr (b. Dinar) said: I made a mention of it to Abu Mas'ud. hue he rejected it and said: I never narrated it to you. 'Amr said: He did narrate it before this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا مَعْبَدٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَفْعَ الصَّوْتِ بِالذِّكْرِ حِينَ يَنْصَرِفُ النَّاسُ مِنَ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ كَانَ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَأَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ إِذَا انْصَرَفُوا بِذَلِكَ إِذَا سَمِعْتُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu haatimin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, h qaala wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, aanna aabaa ma'badin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin aakhbarahu aanna abna 'abbaasin aakhbarahu aanna raf'a alssawti bialdhhikri hiyna yansarifu alnnaasu mina almaktuwbaai kaana 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ waaannahu qaala qaala abnu 'abbaasin kuntu aa'lamu iidhaa ansarafuwa bidhalika iidhaa sami'tuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:Dhikr (mentioning the name of Allah) in a loud voice after obligatory prayers was (a common practice) during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ; and when I heard that I came to knew that they (the people) had finished the prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ هَارُونُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدِي امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ وَهْىَ تَقُولُ هَلْ شَعَرْتِ أَنَّكُمْ تُفْتَنُونَ فِي الْقُبُورِ قَالَتْ فَارْتَاعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا تُفْتَنُ يَهُودُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَلَبِثْنَا لَيَالِيَ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلْ شَعَرْتِ أَنَّهُ أُوحِيَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّكُمْ تُفْتَنُونَ فِي الْقُبُورِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدُ يَسْتَعِيذُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaala haaruwnu haddathanaa waqaala, harmalaau aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhala 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indiy amraaaaun mina alyahuwdi wahaa taquwlu hal sha'arti aannakum tuftanuwna fiy alqubuwri qaalat faartaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa tuftanu yahuwdu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau falabithnaa layaaliya thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hal sha'arti aannahu auwhiya iilaaaa aannakum tuftanuwna fiy alqubuwri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau fasami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'du yasta'iydhu min 'adhaabi alqabri ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Prophet (ﷺ) entered my house when a Jewess was with me and she was saying: Do you know that you would be put to trial in the grave? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) trembled (on hearing this) and said: It is the Jews only who would-be put to trial. 'A'isha said: We passed some nights and then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do you know that it has been revealed to me:" You would be put to trial in the grave"? 'A'isha said: 1 heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seeking refuge from the torment of the grave after this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، قَالَ حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَسْتَعِيذُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, wa'amruw bnu sawwaadin, qaala harmalaau aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da dhalika yasta'iydhu min 'adhaabi alqabri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seeking refuge from the torment of the grave after this (after the revelation)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَتْ عَلَىَّ عَجُوزَانِ مِنْ عُجُزِ يَهُودِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَتَا إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْقُبُورِ يُعَذَّبُونَ فِي قُبُورِهِمْ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَكَذَّبْتُهُمَا وَلَمْ أُنْعِمْ أَنْ أُصَدِّقَهُمَا فَخَرَجَتَا وَدَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ عَجُوزَيْنِ مِنْ عُجُزِ يَهُودِ الْمَدِينَةِ دَخَلَتَا عَلَىَّ فَزَعَمَتَا أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْقُبُورِ يُعَذَّبُونَ فِي قُبُورِهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ صَدَقَتَا إِنَّهُمْ يُعَذَّبُونَ عَذَابًا تَسْمَعُهُ الْبَهَائِمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَمَا رَأَيْتُهُ بَعْدُ فِي صَلاَةٍ إِلاَّ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, kilaahumaa 'an jariyrin, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhalat 'alaaaa 'ajuwzaani min 'ujuzi yahuwdi almadiynaai faqaalataa iinna aahla alqubuwri yu'adhhabuwna fiy qubuwrihim ‏.‏ qaalat fakadhhabtuhumaa walam aun'im aan ausaddiqahumaa fakharajataa wadakhala 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu lahu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna 'ajuwzayni min 'ujuzi yahuwdi almadiynaai dakhalataa 'alaaaa faza'amataa aanna aahla alqubuwri yu'adhhabuwna fiy qubuwrihim faqaala ‏ "‏ sadaqataa iinnahum yu'adhhabuwna 'adhaabana tasma'uhu albahaaiimu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat famaa raaaytuhu ba'du fiy salaaain iilaaa yata'awwadhu min 'adhaabi alqabri ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:There came to me two old women from the old Jewesses of Medina and said: The people of the grave are tormented in their graves. I contradicted them and I did not deem it proper to testify them. They went away and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to me and I said to him: Messenger of Allah I there came to me two old women from the old Jewesses of Medina and asserted that the people of the graves would be tormented therein. He (the Prophet) said: They told the truth; they would be tormented (so much) that the animals would listen to it. She ('A'isha) said: Never did I see him (the Holy Prophet) afterwards but seeking refuge from the torment of the grave in prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَفِيهِ قَالَتْ وَمَا صَلَّى صَلاَةً بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ سَمِعْتُهُ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hannaadu bnu alssariyyi, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an aash'atha, 'an aabiyhi, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, bihadhaa alhadiythi wafiyhi qaalat wamaa sallaa salaaaan ba'da dhalika iilaaa sami'tuhu yata'awwadhu min 'adhaabi alqabri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Masruq reported this hadith on the authority of 'A'isha who said:Never did he (the Holy Prophet) say prayer after this in which I did not hear him seeking refuge from the torment of the grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَعِيذُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, qaala haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasta'iydhu fiy salaatihi min fitnaai alddajjaali ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:1 heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) seeking refuge from the trial of Dajjal (Antichrist) in prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، - حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَعَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا تَشَهَّدَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ أَرْبَعٍ يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, waabnu, numayrin waaabuw kuraybin wazuhayru bnu harbin jamiy'ana 'an wakiy'in, - qaala aabuw kuraybin haddathanaa wakiy'un, - haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an hassaana bni 'atiyyaaa, 'an muhammadi bni aabiy 'aaiishaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, wa'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa tashahhada aahadukum falyasta'idh bialllahi min aarba'in yaquwlu alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabi jahannama wamin 'adhaabi alqabri wamin fitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati wamin sharri fitnaai almasiyhi alddajjaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: When any one of you utters tashahhud (in prayer) he must seek refuge with Allah from four (trials) and should thus say:" O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the Hell, from the torment of the grave, from the trial of life and death and from the evil of the trial of Masih al-Dajjal" (Antichrist)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَدْعُو فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقَالَ لَهُ قَائِلٌ مَا أَكْثَرَ مَا تَسْتَعِيذُ مِنَ الْمَغْرَمِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا غَرِمَ حَدَّثَ فَكَذَبَ وَوَعَدَ فَأَخْلَفَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yad'uw fiy alssalaaai ‏"‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabi alqabri waaa'uwdhu bika min fitnaai almasiyhi alddajjaali waaa'uwdhu bika min fitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina almaathami waalmaghrami ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqaala lahu qaaiilun maa aakthara maa tasta'iydhu mina almaghrami yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinna alrrajula iidhaa gharima haddatha fakadhaba wawa'ada faaakhlafa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to supplicate in prayer thus:" O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the grave, and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of the Masih al-Dajjal (Antichrist) and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of life and death. O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from sin and debt." She ('A'isha) reported: Someone said to him - (the Holy Prophet): Messenger of Allah! why is it that you so often seek refuge from debt? He said: When a (person) incurs debt, (he is obliged) to tell lies and break promise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا فَرَغَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ التَّشَهُّدِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ أَرْبَعٍ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِقْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ يُونُسَ - جَمِيعًا عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا فَرَغَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ التَّشَهُّدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ‏"‏ الآخِرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathaniy alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathanaa hassaanu bnu 'atiyyaaa, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy 'aaiishaaa, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa faragha aahadukum mina alttashahhudi alakhiri falyata'awwadh bialllahi min aarba'in min 'adhaabi jahannama wamin 'adhaabi alqabri wamin fitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati wamin sharri almasiyhi alddajjaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi alhakamu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa hiqlu bnu ziyaadin, h qaala wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, - ya'niy abna yuwnusa - jamiy'ana 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa faragha aahadukum mina alttashahhudi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri ‏"‏ alakhira ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When any one of you completes the last tashahhud. he should seek refuge with Allah from four (trials). I.e. from the torment of Hell, from the torment of grave, from the trial of life and death, and from the mischief of Masih at-Dajjal (Antichrist). This hadith has been narrated by al-Auza'i with the same chain of transmitters but with these words:" When any one of you completes the tashahhud" and he made no mention of the words" the last
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَفِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَشَرِّ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an hishaamin, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabi alqabri wa'adhaabi alnnaari wafitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati washarri almasiyhi alddajjaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: O Allah! I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the grave, and the torment of Hell, and the trial of life and death and the mischief of Masih al-Dajjal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ عُوذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ عُوذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ عُوذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ عُوذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an taawusin, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ 'uwdhuwa bialllahi min 'adhaabi alllahi 'uwdhuwa bialllahi min 'adhaabi alqabri 'uwdhuwa bialllahi min fitnaai almasiyhi alddajjaali 'uwdhuwa bialllahi min fitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying:Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell, seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave, and seek refuge with Allah from the trial of Masih al-Dajjal and seek refuge with Allah from the trial of life and death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Ibn Tawus from his father on the authority of AbuHuraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted by A'raj on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَفِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an budaylin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaqiyqin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yata'awwadhu min 'adhaabi alqabri wa'adhaabi jahannama wafitnaai alddajjaali ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to seek refuge from the torment of the grave, torment of Hell and the trial of Dajjal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، - فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ - عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُعَلِّمُهُمْ هَذَا الدُّعَاءَ كَمَا يُعَلِّمُهُمُ السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ قُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ طَاوُسًا قَالَ لاِبْنِهِ أَدَعَوْتَ بِهَا فِي صَلاَتِكَ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَعِدْ صَلاَتَكَ لأَنَّ طَاوُسًا رَوَاهُ عَنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ أَوْ أَرْبَعَةٍ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, - fiymaa quriia 'alayhi - 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yu'allimuhum hadhaa alddu'aa'a kamaa yu'allimuhumu alssuwraaa mina alqurani yaquwlu ‏ "‏ quwluwa alllahumma iinnaa na'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabi jahannama waaa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabi alqabri waaa'uwdhu bika min fitnaai almasiyhi alddajjaali waaa'uwdhu bika min fitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala muslimu bnu alhajjaaji balaghaniy aanna taawusana qaala laibnihi aada'awta bihaa fiy salaatika faqaala laa ‏.‏ qaala aa'id salaataka laanna taawusana rawaahu 'an thalaathaain aaw aarba'aain aaw kamaa qaala ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach them this supplication (in the same spirit) with which he used to teach them a surah of the Qur'an. He would thus instruct us:"Say, O Allah, we seek refuge with Thee from the torment of Hell. And I seek refuge with Thee from the torment of the grave, and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of al-Masih ad-Dajjal, and I seek refuge with Thee from the trial of life and death." Muslim b. Hajjaj said: It has reached me that Tawus said to his son: Did you make this supplication in prayer? He said: No. (Upon this) he (Tawus) said: Repeat the prayer. Tawus has narrated this hadith through three or four (transmitters) with words to the same effect
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، - اسْمُهُ شَدَّادُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ - عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا انْصَرَفَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ اسْتَغْفَرَ ثَلاَثًا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ فَقُلْتُ لِلأَوْزَاعِيِّ كَيْفَ الاِسْتِغْفَارُ قَالَ تَقُولُ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa daawudu bnu rushaydin, haddathanaa alwaliydu, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, 'an aabiy 'ammaarin, - asmuhu shaddaadu bnu 'abdi alllahi - 'an aabiy aasmaa'a, 'an thawbaana, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa ansarafa min salaatihi astaghfara thalaathana waqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma aanta alssalaamu waminka alssalaamu tabaarakta dhaa aljalaali waaliikraami ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alwaliydu faqultu lilaawzaa'iyyi kayfa alaistighfaaru qaala taquwlu aastaghfiru alllaha aastaghfiru alllaha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished his prayer. He begged forgiveness three times and said: O Allah! Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee; Blessed art Thou, O Possessor of Glory and Honour. Walid reported: I said to Auza'i: How is the seeking of forgiveness? He replied: You should say: I beg forgiveness from Allah, I beg forgiveness from Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَلَّمَ لَمْ يَقْعُدْ إِلاَّ مِقْدَارَ مَا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏"‏ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an 'aasimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sallama lam yaq'ud iilaaa miqdaara maa yaquwlu ‏"‏ alllahumma aanta alssalaamu waminka alssalaamu tabaarakta dhaa aljalaali waaliikraami ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni numayrin ‏"‏ yaa dhaa aljalaali waaliikraami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced salutation, he salutation longer than it took him to say: O Allah: Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee, blessed art Thou, Possessor of Glory and ]Honour; and in the narration of Ibn Numair the words are:" O Possessor of Glory and Honour
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ، - يَعْنِي الأَحْمَرَ - عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin, - ya'niy alaahmara - 'an 'aasimin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ yaa dhaa aljalaali waaliikraami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Numair narrated it with the same chain of transmitters and said:O Possessor of Glory and Honour
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، وَخَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'aasimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, wakhaalidin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, kilaahumaa 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aannahu kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yaa dhaa aljalaali waaliikraami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Abdullah b. Harith on the authority of A'isha except for the words that he (the Holy Prophet) used to say:" 0 Possessor of Glory and Honour
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ كَتَبَ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'ani almusayyabi bni raafi'in, 'an warraadin, mawlaa almughiyraai bni shu'baaa qaala kataba almughiyraau bnu shu'baaa iilaa mu'aawiyaaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa faragha mina alssalaaai wasallama qaala ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun alllahumma laa maani'a limaa aa'tayta walaa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta walaa yanfa'u dhaa aljaddi minka aljaddu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mughira b. Shu'ba wrote to Mu'awiya:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished the prayer and pronounced salutation he uttered (this supplication):" There is no god but Allah. He is alone, Who has no partner. To Him belongs the sovereignty and to Him praise is due and He is Potent over every. thing. O Allah! no one can withhold what Thou givest, or give what Thou withholdest, and the riches cannot avail a wealthy person with Thee
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِمَا قَالَ فَأَمْلاَهَا عَلَىَّ الْمُغِيرَةُ وَكَتَبْتُ بِهَا إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waaahmadu bnu sinaanin qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'ani almusayyabi bni raafi'in, 'an warraadin, mawlaa almughiyraai bni shu'baaa 'ani almughiyraai, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ mithlahu qaala aabuw bakrin waaabuw kuraybin fiy riwaayatihimaa qaala faaamlaahaa 'alaaaa almughiyraau wakatabtu bihaa iilaa mu'aawiyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Mughira b. Shu'ba with another chain of transmitters. Abu Bakr and Abu Kuraib narrated in their narration (that Warrad reported):Mughira gave me dictation of it and 1 wrote it to Mu'awiya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدَةُ بْنُ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، أَنَّ وَرَّادًا، مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ كَتَبَ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ - كَتَبَ ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابَ لَهُ وَرَّادٌ - إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ حِينَ سَلَّمَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏ إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ ‏ "‏ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'abdaau bnu aabiy lubaabaaa, aanna warraadana, mawlaa almughiyraai bni shu'baaa qaala kataba almughiyraau bnu shu'baaa iilaa mu'aawiyaaa - kataba dhalika alkitaaba lahu warraadun - iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu hiyna sallama ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihimaa ‏.‏ iilaaa qawlahu ‏ "‏ wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faiinnahu lam yadhkur ‏.‏
verses.translation: Warrad, the freed slave of Mughira b. Shu'ba, reported:Mughira b. Shu'ba wrote to Mu'awiya (it was Warrad who wrote this letter for him, i. e. Mughira): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying:" When the salutation is pronounced." and the rest of the hadith is the same except this that he made no mention of:" He is Potent over everything
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْمُفَضَّلِ ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي أَزْهَرُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، كَاتِبِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ كَتَبَ مُعَاوِيَةُ إِلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَنْصُورٍ وَالأَعْمَشِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haamidu bnu 'umara albakraawiyyu, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna almufaddali h qaala wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy aazharu, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, 'an warraadin, kaatibi almughiyraai bni shu'baaa qaala kataba mu'aawiyaau iilaa almughiyraai ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi mansuwrin waalaa'mashi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Warrad, the scribe of Mughira b. Shu'ba, reported:Mu'awiya wrote to Mughira (the contents) of the hadith as transmitted by Mansur and A'mash
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، وَعَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، سَمِعَا وَرَّادًا، كَاتِبَ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ يَقُولُ كَتَبَ مُعَاوِيَةُ إِلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ اكْتُبْ إِلَىَّ بِشَىْءٍ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ إِذَا قَضَى الصَّلاَةَ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara almakkiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu aabiy lubaabaaa, wa'abdu almaliki bnu 'umayrin, sami'aa warraadana, kaatiba almughiyraai bni shu'baaa yaquwlu kataba mu'aawiyaau iilaa almughiyraai aktub iilaaaa bishaa'in sami'tahu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala fakataba iilayhi sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu iidhaa qadaa alssalaaaa ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun alllahumma laa maani'a limaa aa'tayta walaa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta walaa yanfa'u dhaa aljaddi minka aljaddu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Warrad, the scribe of Mughira b. Shu'ba, reported:Mu'awiya wrote to Mughira: Write to me anything which you heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). So he (Mughira) wrote to him (Mu'awiya): I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) uttering (these words) at the completion of prayer:" There is no god but Allah. He is alone and there is no partner with Him. Sovereignty belongs to Him and to Him is praise due and He is Potent over everything. O Allah! no one can withhold what Thou givest, or give what Thou withholdest, and riches cannot avail a wealthy person with Thee
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ حِينَ يُسَلِّمُ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهَلِّلُ بِهِنَّ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, qaala kaana abnu alzzubayri yaquwlu fiy duburi kulli salaaain hiyna yusallimu ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu walaa na'budu iilaaa iiyyaahu lahu alnni'maau walahu alfadlu walahu althhanaa'u alhasanu laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu mukhlisiyna lahu alddiyna walaw kariha alkaafiruwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhallilu bihinna dubura kulli salaaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Zubair reported:Ibn Zubair uttered at the end of every prayer after pronouncing salutation (these words):" There is no god but Allah. He is alone. There is no partner with Him. Sovereignty belongs to Him and He is Potent over everything. There is no might or power except with Allah. There is no god but Allah and we do not worship but Him alone. To Him belong all bounties, to Him belongs all Grace, and to Him is worthy praise accorded. There is no god but Allah, to Whom we are sincere in devotion, even though the unbelievers should disapprove it." (The narrator said): He (the Holy Prophet) uttered it at the end of every (obligatory) prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، مَوْلًى لَهُمْ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، كَانَ يُهَلِّلُ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ وَقَالَ فِي آخِرِهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهَلِّلُ بِهِنَّ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, mawlana lahum aanna 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri, kaana yuhallilu dubura kulli salaaain ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni numayrin waqaala fiy akhirihi thumma yaquwlu abnu alzzubayri kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhallilu bihinna dubura kulli salaaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Zubair reported:Abdullah b Zubair used to say La ilaha il-Allah at the end of every prayer like the hadith narrated by Ibn Numair and he reported it in the end, and then reported Ibn Zubair saying: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) uttered La ilaha il-Allah at the end of every prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَخْطُبُ عَلَى هَذَا الْمِنْبَرِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ إِذَا سَلَّمَ فِي دُبُرِ الصَّلاَةِ أَوِ الصَّلَوَاتِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, haddathanaa alhajjaaju bnu aabiy 'uthmaana, haddathaniy aabuw alzzubayri, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri, yakhtubu 'alaa hadhaa alminbari wahuwa yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu iidhaa sallama fiy duburi alssalaaai aawi alssalawaati ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi hishaami bni 'urwaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Zubair reported:I heard Abdullah b. Zubair addressing (people) on the pulpit and saying: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced salutation at the end of the prayer or prayers, and then he made a mention of the hadith as transmitted by Hisham b. 'Urwa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ فِي إِثْرِ الصَّلاَةِ إِذَا سَلَّمَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا وَقَالَ فِي آخِرِهِ وَكَانَ يَذْكُرُ ذَلِكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu salamaaa almuraadiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni saalimin, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, aanna aabaa alzzubayri almakkiyya, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri, wahuwa yaquwlu fiy iithri alssalaaai iidhaa sallama ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihimaa waqaala fiy akhirihi wakaana yadhkuru dhalika 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Zubair al-Makki reported that he had heard 'Abdullah b. Zubair uttering (the words) like that of the hadith (narrated above) at the end of the prayer after pronouncing salutation. He at the conclusion also said that he was making a mention of that from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، - وَهَذَا حَدِيثُ قُتَيْبَةَ أَنَّ فُقَرَاءَ، الْمُهَاجِرِينَ أَتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا ذَهَبَ أَهْلُ الدُّثُورِ بِالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى وَالنَّعِيمِ الْمُقِيمِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يُصَلُّونَ كَمَا نُصَلِّي وَيَصُومُونَ كَمَا نَصُومُ وَيَتَصَدَّقُونَ وَلاَ نَتَصَدَّقُ وَيُعْتِقُونَ وَلاَ نُعْتِقُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَفَلاَ أُعَلِّمُكُمْ شَيْئًا تُدْرِكُونَ بِهِ مَنْ سَبَقَكُمْ وَتَسْبِقُونَ بِهِ مَنْ بَعْدَكُمْ وَلاَ يَكُونُ أَحَدٌ أَفْضَلَ مِنْكُمْ إِلاَّ مَنْ صَنَعَ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تُسَبِّحُونَ وَتُكَبِّرُونَ وَتَحْمَدُونَ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو صَالِحٍ فَرَجَعَ فُقَرَاءُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا سَمِعَ إِخْوَانُنَا أَهْلُ الأَمْوَالِ بِمَا فَعَلْنَا فَفَعَلُوا مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ غَيْرُ قُتَيْبَةَ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ قَالَ سُمَىٌّ فَحَدَّثْتُ بَعْضَ أَهْلِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ فَقَالَ وَهِمْتَ إِنَّمَا قَالَ ‏"‏ تُسَبِّحُ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَتَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَتُكَبِّرُ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى أَبِي صَالِحٍ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ ذَلِكَ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي فَقَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ مِنْ جَمِيعِهِنَّ ثَلاَثَةً وَثَلاَثِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَجْلاَنَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ رَجَاءَ بْنَ حَيْوَةَ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِمِثْلِهِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aasimu bnu alnnadri alttaymiyyu, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, h qaala wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni 'ajlaana, kilaahumaa 'an sumaaain, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, - wahadhaa hadiythu qutaybaaa aanna fuqaraa'a, almuhaajiriyna aatawa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa dhahaba aahlu aldduthuwri bialddarajaati al'ulaa waalnna'iymi almuqiymi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yusalluwna kamaa nusalliy wayasuwmuwna kamaa nasuwmu wayatasaddaquwna walaa natasaddaqu wayu'tiquwna walaa nu'tiqu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aafalaa au'allimukum shayiana tudrikuwna bihi man sabaqakum watasbiquwna bihi man ba'dakum walaa yakuwnu aahadun aafdala minkum iilaaa man sana'a mithla maa sana'tum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ tusabbihuwna watukabbiruwna watahmaduwna dubura kulli salaaain thalaathana wathalaathiyna marraaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw saalihin faraja'a fuqaraa'u almuhaajiriyna iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa sami'a iikhwaanunaa aahlu alaamwaali bimaa fa'alnaa fafa'aluwa mithlahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ dhalika fadlu alllahi yuutiyhi man yashaa'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wazaada ghayru qutaybaaa fiy hadhaa alhadiythi 'ani alllaythi 'ani abni 'ajlaana qaala sumaaaun fahaddathtu ba'da aahliy hadhaa alhadiytha faqaala wahimta iinnamaa qaala ‏"‏ tusabbihu alllaha thalaathana wathalaathiyna watahmadu alllaha thalaathana wathalaathiyna watukabbiru alllaha thalaathana wathalaathiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faraja'tu iilaa aabiy saalihin faqultu lahu dhalika faaakhadha biyadiy faqaala alllahu aakbaru wasubhaana alllahi waalhamdu lillahi waalllahu aakbaru wasubhaana alllahi waalhamdu lillahi hattaa tablugha min jamiy'ihinna thalaathaaan wathalaathiyna ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'ajlaana fahaddathtu bihadhaa alhadiythi rajaa'a bna haywaaa fahaddathaniy bimithlihi 'an aabiy saalihin 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The poor amongst the emigrants came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: The possessors of great wealth have obtained the highest ranks and the lasting bliss. He (the Holy Prophet) said: How is that? They said: They pray as we pray, and they observe fast as we observe fast, and they give charity but we do not give charity, and they set slaves free but we do not set slaves free. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Shall I not teach you something by which you will catch upon those who have preceded you, and get ahead of those who come after you, only those who do as you do being more excellent than you? They said: Yes, Messenger of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Extol Allah, declare His Greatness, and Praise Him thirty-three times after every prayer. Abu Salih said: The poor amongst the emigrants returned to the Messenger of Allah (may peace upon him) saying: Our brethren, the possessors, of property have heard what we have done and they did the same. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: This is Allah's Grace which He gives to whom He wishes. Sumayy reported: I made a mention of this hadith to some members of my family (and one of them) said: You have forgotten; he (the Holy Prophet) had said (like this): "Extol Allah thirty-three time, praise Allah thirty-three times and declare His Greatness thirty-three times." Ibn `Ajlan said: I made a mention of this hadith to Raja' b. Haiwa and he narrated to me a hadith like this from Abu Salih from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the authority of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ الْعَيْشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ذَهَبَ أَهْلُ الدُّثُورِ بِالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى وَالنَّعِيمِ الْمُقِيمِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ قُتَيْبَةَ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ أَدْرَجَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَوْلَ أَبِي صَالِحٍ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فُقَرَاءُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ ‏.‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ يَقُولُ سُهَيْلٌ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ فَجَمِيعُ ذَلِكَ كُلِّهُ ثَلاَثَةٌ وَثَلاَثُونَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaama al'ayshiyyu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa rawhun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahum qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi dhahaba aahlu aldduthuwri bialddarajaati al'ulaa waalnna'iymi almuqiymi ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi qutaybaaa 'ani alllaythi iilaaa aannahu aadraja fiy hadiythi aabiy hurayraaa qawla aabiy saalihin thumma raja'a fuqaraa'u almuhaajiriyna ‏.‏ iilaa akhiri alhadiythi wazaada fiy alhadiythi yaquwlu suhaylun iihdaa 'ashraaa iihdaa 'ashraaa fajamiy'u dhalika kullihu thalaathaaun wathalaathuwna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira narrated it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that they (the poor among the emigrants) said:Messenger of Allah, the possessors of great wealth have obtained the highest ranks and lasting bliss, and the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Qutaiba on the authority of Laith except that he inserted the words of Abu Salih in the narration of Abu Huraira that" the poor of the emigrants came back," to the end of the hadith,, but this addition was made that Suhail said (that every part of the supplication, i. e. Glorification of Allah, His Praise and declaration of His Greatness) should be uttered eleven times making the total as thirty-three
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَكَمَ بْنَ عُتَيْبَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مُعَقِّبَاتٌ لاَ يَخِيبُ قَائِلُهُنَّ - أَوْ فَاعِلُهُنَّ - دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ ثَلاَثٌ وَثَلاَثُونَ تَسْبِيحَةً وَثَلاَثٌ وَثَلاَثُونَ تَحْمِيدَةً وَأَرْبَعٌ وَثَلاَثُونَ تَكْبِيرَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'iysaa, aakhbaranaa abnu almubaaraki, aakhbaranaa maaliku bnu mighwalin, qaala sami'tu alhakama bna 'utaybaaa, yuhaddithu 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mu'aqqibaatun laa yakhiybu qaaiiluhunna - aaw faa'iluhunna - dubura kulli salaaain maktuwbaain thalaathun wathalaathuwna tasbiyhaaan wathalaathun wathalaathuwna tahmiydaaan waaarba'un wathalaathuwna takbiyraaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ka'b b. 'Ujra reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There are certain ejaculations, the repeaters of which or the performers of which after every prescribed prayer will never be caused disappointment:" Glory be to Allah" thirty-three times." Praise be to Allah" thirty-three times, and" Allah is most Great" thirty-four times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ الْمَذْحِجِيِّ، - قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ مَوْلَى سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ - عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَبَّحَ اللَّهَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَكَبَّرَ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ فَتِلْكَ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ وَقَالَ تَمَامَ الْمِائَةِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ غُفِرَتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alhamiydi bnu bayaanin alwaasitiyyu, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiy 'ubaydin almadhhijiyyi, - qaala muslimun aabuw 'ubaydin mawlaa sulaymaana bni 'abdi almaliki - 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man sabbaha alllaha fiy duburi kulli salaaain thalaathana wathalaathiyna wahamida alllaha thalaathana wathalaathiyna wakabbara alllaha thalaathana wathalaathiyna fatilka tis'aaun watis'uwna waqaala tamaama almiaiaai laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun ghufirat khataayaahu waiin kaanat mithla zabadi albahri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If anyone extols Allah after every prayer thirty-three times, and praises Allah thirty-three times, and declares His Greatness thirty-three times, ninety-nine times in all, and says to complete a hundred:" There is no god but Allah, having no partner with Him, to Him belongs sovereignty and to Him is praise due, and He is Potent over everything," his sins will be forgiven even If these are as abundant as the foam of the sea
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu zakariyyaa'a, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiy 'ubaydin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ وَحُدِّثْتُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَسَّانَ، وَيُونُسَ الْمُؤَدِّبِ، و غَيْرِهِمَا قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا نَهَضَ مِنَ الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ اسْتَفْتَحَ الْقِرَاءَةَ بِـ ‏{‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}‏ وَلَمْ يَسْكُتْ ‏.‏
