verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَالشَّمْسُ مُرْتَفِعَةٌ حَيَّةٌ فَيَذْهَبُ الذَّاهِبُ إِلَى الْعَوَالِي فَيَأْتِي الْعَوَالِيَ وَالشَّمْسُ مُرْتَفِعَةٌ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قُتَيْبَةُ فَيَأْتِي الْعَوَالِيَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h qaala wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy al'asra waalshhamsu murtafi'aaun hayyaaun fayadhhabu aldhhaahibu iilaa al'awaaliy fayaatiy al'awaaliya waalshhamsu murtafi'aaun ‏.‏ walam yadhkur qutaybaau fayaatiy al'awaaliya ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray the afternoon prayer when the sun was high and bright, then one would go off to al-'Awali and get there while the sun was still high. Ibn Qutaiba made no mention of" one would go off to al-'Awali
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ بِمِثْلِهِ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasin, ‏.‏ aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy al'asra bimithlihi sawaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to offer the afternoon prayer like the one narrated above has been transmitted by Anas b. Malik by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ يَذْهَبُ الذَّاهِبُ إِلَى قُبَاءٍ فَيَأْتِيهِمْ وَالشَّمْسُ مُرْتَفِعَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kunnaa nusalliy al'asra thumma yadhhabu aldhhaahibu iilaa qubaa'in fayaatiyhim waalshhamsu murtafi'aaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:We used to offer the 'Asr prayer, then one would go to Quba' and reach there and the sun would be still high
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ الإِنْسَانُ إِلَى بَنِي عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ فَيَجِدُهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ الْعَصْرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kunnaa nusalliy al'asra thumma yakhruju aliinsaanu iilaa baniy 'amriw bni 'awfin fayajiduhum yusalluwna al'asra ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:We used to offer the afternoon prayer (at such a time) that a person would go to Bani 'Amr b. Auf and he would find them busy offering the afternoon prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَى أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فِي دَارِهِ بِالْبَصْرَةِ حِينَ انْصَرَفَ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ وَدَارُهُ بِجَنْبِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَلَمَّا دَخَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ قَالَ أَصَلَّيْتُمُ الْعَصْرَ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ إِنَّمَا انْصَرَفْنَا السَّاعَةَ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَلُّوا الْعَصْرَ ‏.‏ فَقُمْنَا فَصَلَّيْنَا فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفْنَا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تِلْكَ صَلاَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ يَجْلِسُ يَرْقُبُ الشَّمْسَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَتْ بَيْنَ قَرْنَىِ الشَّيْطَانِ قَامَ فَنَقَرَهَا أَرْبَعًا لاَ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِيهَا إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, wamuhammadu bnu alssabbaahi, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'ani al'alaa'i bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu dakhala 'alaa aanasi bni maalikin fiy daarihi bialbasraai hiyna ansarafa mina alzzuhri wadaaruhu bijanbi almasjidi falammaa dakhalnaa 'alayhi qaala aasallaytumu al'asra faqulnaa lahu iinnamaa ansarafnaa alssaa'aaa mina alzzuhri ‏.‏ qaala fasalluwa al'asra ‏.‏ faqumnaa fasallaynaa falammaa ansarafnaa qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ tilka salaaau almunaafiqi yajlisu yarqubu alshhamsa hattaa iidhaa kaanat bayna qarnaai alshhaytaani qaama fanaqarahaa aarba'ana laa yadhkuru alllaha fiyhaa iilaaa qaliylaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ala' b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported that they came to the house of Anas b. Malik in Basra after saying the noon prayer. His (Anas) house was situated by the side of the mosque. As revisited him he (Anas) said:Have you said the afternoon prayer? We said to him: It is just a few minutes before that we finished the noon prayer. He said: Offer the afternoon prayer. So we stood up and said our prayer. And when we completed it, he said: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: This is how the hypocrite prays: he sits watching the sun, and when it is between the horns of devil, he rises and strikes the ground four times (in haste) mentioning Allah a little during it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ بْنَ سَهْلٍ، يَقُولُ صَلَّيْنَا مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ الظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ خَرَجْنَا حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا عَلَى أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فَوَجَدْنَاهُ يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ فَقُلْتُ يَا عَمِّ مَا هَذِهِ الصَّلاَةُ الَّتِي صَلَّيْتَ قَالَ الْعَصْرُ وَهَذِهِ صَلاَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم الَّتِي كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa mansuwru bnu aabiy muzaahimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki, 'an aabiy bakri bni 'uthmaana bni sahli bni hunayfin, qaala sami'tu aabaa aumaamaaa bna sahlin, yaquwlu sallaynaa ma'a 'umara bni 'abdi al'aziyzi alzzuhra thumma kharajnaa hattaa dakhalnaa 'alaa aanasi bni maalikin fawajadnaahu yusalliy al'asra faqultu yaa 'ammi maa hadhihi alssalaaau allatiy sallayta qaala al'asru wahadhihi salaaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh t'ala 'lyh wslm allatiy kunnaa nusalliy ma'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Umama b. Sahl reported:We offered the noon prayer with Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz. We then set out till we came to Anas b. Malik and found him busy in saying the afternoon prayer. I said to him: O uncle! which is this prayer that you are offering? He said: It is the afternoon prayer and this is the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that we offered along with him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمُرَادِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالَ عَمْرٌو أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّ مُوسَى بْنَ سَعْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَصْرَ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سَلِمَةَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا نُرِيدُ أَنْ نَنْحَرَ جَزُورًا لَنَا وَنَحْنُ نُحِبُّ أَنْ تَحْضُرَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقْنَا مَعَهُ فَوَجَدْنَا الْجَزُورَ لَمْ تُنْحَرْ فَنُحِرَتْ ثُمَّ قُطِّعَتْ ثُمَّ طُبِخَ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ أَكَلْنَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْمُرَادِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ وَعَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu sawwaadin al'aamiriyyu, wamuhammadu bnu salamaaa almuraadiyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, - waaalfaazuhum mutaqaaribaaun - qaala 'amrunw aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, aanna muwsaa bna sa'din alaansaariyya, haddathahu 'an hafsi bni 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qaala sallaa lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'asra falammaa ansarafa aataahu rajulun min baniy salimaaa faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa nuriydu aan nanhara jazuwrana lanaa wanahnu nuhibbu aan tahdurahaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faantalaqa waantalaqnaa ma'ahu fawajadnaa aljazuwra lam tunhar fanuhirat thumma qutti'at thumma tubikha minhaa thumma aakalnaa qabla aan taghiyba alshhamsu ‏.‏ waqaala almuraadiyyu haddathanaa abnu wahbin 'ani abni lahiy'aaa wa'amriw bni alhaarithi fiy hadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in the afternoon prayer. When he completed it, a person from Bani Salama came to him and said: Messenger of Allah, we intend to slaughter our came and we are desirous that you should also be present there (on this occasion). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes. He (the person) went and we also went along with him and we found that the camel had not been slaughtered yet. Then it was slaughtered, and it was cut into pieces and then some of those were cooked, and then we ate (them) before the setting of the sun. This hadith has also been narrated by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّجَاشِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ تُنْحَرُ الْجَزُورُ فَتُقْسَمُ عَشَرَ قِسَمٍ ثُمَّ تُطْبَخُ فَنَأْكُلُ لَحْمًا نَضِيجًا قَبْلَ مَغِيبِ الشَّمْسِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an aabiy alnnajaashiyyi, qaala sami'tu raafi'a bna khadiyjin, yaquwlu kunnaa nusalliy al'asra ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma tunharu aljazuwru fatuqsamu 'ashara qisamin thumma tutbakhu fanaakulu lahmana nadiyjana qabla maghiybi alshhamsi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi' b. Khadij reported:We used to say the afternoon prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and then the camel was slaughtered and ten parts of it were distributed; then it was cooked and then we ate this cooked meat before the sinking of the sun
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَشُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنَّا نَنْحَرُ الْجَزُورَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, washu'aybu bnu iishaaqa alddimashqiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala kunnaa nanharu aljazuwra 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da al'asri ‏.‏ walam yaqul kunnaa nusalliy ma'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported by 'Auza'i with the same chain of transmitters:We used to slaughter the camel during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) after the 'Asr prayer, but he made no mention of:" We used to pray along with him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الَّذِي تَفُوتُهُ صَلاَةُ الْعَصْرِ كَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alladhiy tafuwtuhu salaaau al'asri kaaannamaa wutira aahlahu wamaalahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:He who misses the afternoon prayer, it is as though he has been deprived of his family and his property
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو يَبْلُغُ بِهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَفَعَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, ‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw yablughu bihi ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw bakrin rafa'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated as Marfu by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ فَاتَتْهُ الْعَصْرُ فَكَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man faatathu al'asru fakaaannamaa wutira aahlahu wamaalahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah relates on the authority of his father. He who missed his afternoon prayer it is as though he was deprived of his family and property
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ الأَحْزَابِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَلأَ اللَّهُ قُبُورَهُمْ وَبُيُوتَهُمْ نَارًا كَمَا حَبَسُونَا وَشَغَلُونَا عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى حَتَّى غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an muhammadin, 'an 'abiydaaa, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala lammaa kaana yawmu alaahzaabi qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ malaa alllahu qubuwrahum wabuyuwtahum naarana kamaa habasuwnaa washaghaluwnaa 'ani alssalaaai alwustaa hattaa ghaabati alshhamsu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported:When it was the day (of the Battle) of Ahzab, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: May Allah fill their graves and houses with fire, as they detained us and diverted us from the middle prayer, till the sun set
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa almu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, jamiy'ana 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي حَسَّانَ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ ‏ "‏ شَغَلُونَا عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى حَتَّى آبَتِ الشَّمْسُ مَلأَ اللَّهُ قُبُورَهُمْ نَارًا أَوْ بُيُوتَهُمْ أَوْ بُطُونَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ فِي الْبُيُوتِ وَالْبُطُونِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy hassaana, 'an 'abiydaaa, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alaahzaabi ‏ "‏ shaghaluwnaa 'an salaaai alwustaa hattaa abati alshhamsu malaa alllahu qubuwrahum naarana aaw buyuwtahum aaw butuwnahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ shakka shu'baau fiy albuyuwti waalbutuwni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: On the day (of the Battle) of Ahzab we were diverted from the middle prayer, till the sun set. May Allah fill their graves or their houses, or their stomachs with fire. The narrator is in doubt about" houses" and" stomachs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ بُيُوتَهُمْ وَقُبُورَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَشُكَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ buyuwtahum waqubuwrahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yashukka ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has heed narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters. And he said:Their houses and their graves (be filled with fire), and did not express doubt over the words," houses" and" graves
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْجَزَّارِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، سَمِعَ عَلِيًّا، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ وَهُوَ قَاعِدٌ عَلَى فُرْضَةٍ مِنْ فُرَضِ الْخَنْدَقِ ‏ "‏ شَغَلُونَا عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى حَتَّى غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ مَلأَ اللَّهُ قُبُورَهُمْ وَبُيُوتَهُمْ - أَوْ قَالَ قُبُورَهُمْ وَبُطُونَهُمْ - نَارًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an shu'baaa, 'ani alhakami, 'an yahyaa bni aljazzaari, 'an 'aliyyin, h wahaddathanaahu 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an yahyaa, sami'a 'aliyyana, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alaahzaabi wahuwa qaa'idun 'alaa furdaain min furadi alkhandaqi ‏ "‏ shaghaluwnaa 'ani alssalaaai alwustaa hattaa gharabati alshhamsu malaa alllahu qubuwrahum wabuyuwtahum - aaw qaala qubuwrahum wabutuwnahum - naarana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yahya heard 'Ali saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said on the day (of the Battle) of Ahzab, while sitting in one of the openings of the ditch:They (the enemies) have diverted us from the middle prayer till the sun set. May Allah fill their graves and their houses with fire, or their graves and stomachs with fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، عَنْ شُتَيْرِ بْنِ شَكَلٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ ‏ "‏ شَغَلُونَا عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ مَلأَ اللَّهُ بُيُوتَهُمْ وَقُبُورَهُمْ نَارًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ صَلاَّهَا بَيْنَ الْعِشَاءَيْنِ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw kuraybin qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an muslimi bni subayhin, 'an shutayri bni shakalin, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alaahzaabi ‏ "‏ shaghaluwnaa 'ani alssalaaai alwustaa salaaai al'asri malaa alllahu buyuwtahum waqubuwrahum naarana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma salaaahaa bayna al'ishaa'ayni bayna almaghribi waal'ishaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said on the day (of the Battle) of Ahzab: They diverted us from saying the middle prayer, i. e. the 'Asr prayer. May Allah fill their houses and graves with fire; he then observed this prayer between the evening prayer and the night prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَوْنُ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ الْكُوفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ الْيَامِيُّ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَبَسَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى احْمَرَّتِ الشَّمْسُ أَوِ اصْفَرَّتْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ شَغَلُونَا عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ مَلأَ اللَّهُ أَجْوَافَهُمْ وَقُبُورَهُمْ نَارًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَشَا اللَّهُ أَجْوَافَهُمْ وَقُبُورَهُمْ نَارًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'awnu bnu salaaamin alkuwfiyyu, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu talhaaa alyaamiyyu, 'an zubaydin, 'an murraaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala habasa almushrikuwna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an salaaai al'asri hattaa ahmarrati alshhamsu aawi asfarrat faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ shaghaluwnaa 'ani alssalaaai alwustaa salaaai al'asri malaa alllahu aajwaafahum waqubuwrahum naarana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ hashaa alllahu aajwaafahum waqubuwrahum naarana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported that the polytheists detained the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from observing the afternoon prayer till the sun became red or it became yellow. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:They have diverted us from (offering) the middle prayer. i. e. the 'Asr prayer. May Allah fill their bellies and their graves with fire, or he said: May Allah stuff their bellies and their graves with fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي يُونُسَ، مَوْلَى عَائِشَةَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَمَرَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ أَنْ أَكْتُبَ لَهَا مُصْحَفًا وَقَالَتْ إِذَا بَلَغْتَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ فَآذِنِّي ‏{‏ حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى‏}‏ فَلَمَّا بَلَغْتُهَا آذَنْتُهَا فَأَمْلَتْ عَلَىَّ حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى وَصَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ ‏.‏ وَقُومُوا لِلَّهِ قَانِتِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ سَمِعْتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'ani alqa'qaa'i bni hakiymin, 'an aabiy yuwnusa, mawlaa 'aaiishaaa aannahu qaala aamaratniy 'aaiishaau aan aaktuba lahaa mushafana waqaalat iidhaa balaghta hadhihi alayaaa faadhinniy ‏{‏ haafizuwa 'alaa alssalawaati waalssalaaai alwustaa‏}‏ falammaa balaghtuhaa adhantuhaa faaamlat 'alaaaa haafizuwa 'alaa alssalawaati waalssalaaai alwustaa wasalaaai al'asri ‏.‏ waquwmuwa lillahi qaanitiyna ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau sami'tuhaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Yunus, the freed slave of 'A'isha said:'A'isha ordered me to transcribe a copy of the Qur'an for her and said: When you reach this verse:" Guard the prayers and the middle prayer" (ii. 238), inform me; so when I reached it, I informed her and she gave me dictation (like this): Guard the prayers and the middle prayer and the afternoon prayer, and stand up truly obedient to Allah. 'A'isha said: This is how I have heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو غَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ جَعَلَ يَسُبُّ كُفَّارَ قُرَيْشٍ وَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ مَا كِدْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ الْعَصْرَ حَتَّى كَادَتْ أَنْ تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنْ صَلَّيْتُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَنَزَلْنَا إِلَى بُطْحَانَ فَتَوَضَّأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَوَضَّأْنَا فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَصْرَ بَعْدَ مَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ ثُمَّ صَلَّى بَعْدَهَا الْمَغْرِبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, 'an mu'aadhi bni hishaamin, - qaala aabuw ghassaana haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, yawma alkhandaqi ja'ala yasubbu kuffaara qurayshin waqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi waalllahi maa kidtu aan ausalliya al'asra hattaa kaadat aan taghruba alshhamsu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ fawaalllahi iin sallaytuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fanazalnaa iilaa buthaana fatawaddaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm watawaddaanaa fasallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'asra ba'da maa gharabati alshhamsu thumma sallaa ba'dahaa almaghriba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Umar b. al-Khattab had been cursing the pagans of the Quraish an the day (of the Battle) of Khandaq (Ditch). (He came to the Holy Prophet) and said:Messenger of Allah, by God, I could not say. the 'Asr prayer till the sun set. Upon this the Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Allah I, too, have not observed it. So we went to a valley. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) performed ablution and we too performed ablution, and then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said the 'Asr prayer after the sun had set. and then said the evening prayer after it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'an 'aliyyi bni almubaaraki, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported by Yahya b. Abd Kathir with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَتَعَاقَبُونَ فِيكُمْ مَلاَئِكَةٌ بِاللَّيْلِ وَمَلاَئِكَةٌ بِالنَّهَارِ وَيَجْتَمِعُونَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَصَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ الَّذِينَ بَاتُوا فِيكُمْ فَيَسْأَلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ كَيْفَ تَرَكْتُمْ عِبَادِي فَيَقُولُونَ تَرَكْنَاهُمْ وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ وَأَتَيْنَاهُمْ وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yata'aaqabuwna fiykum malaaiikaaun bialllayli wamalaaiikaaun bialnnahaari wayajtami'uwna fiy salaaai alfajri wasalaaai al'asri thumma ya'ruju alladhiyna baatuwa fiykum fayasaaluhum rabbuhum wahuwa aa'lamu bihim kayfa taraktum 'ibaadiy fayaquwluwna taraknaahum wahum yusalluwna waaataynaahum wahum yusalluwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Angels take turns among you by night and by day, and they all assemble at the dawn and afternoon prayers. Those (of the angels) who spend the night among you, then, ascend, and their Lord asks them, though He is the best informed about them: How did you leave My servants? -they say: We left them while they were praying and we came to them while they were praying
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ يَتَعَاقَبُونَ فِيكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ waalmalaaiikaau yata'aaqabuwna fiykum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi aabiy alzzinaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Angels take turns among you by night and by day, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَرِيرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ نَظَرَ إِلَى الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّكُمْ سَتَرَوْنَ رَبَّكُمْ كَمَا تَرَوْنَ هَذَا الْقَمَرَ لاَ تُضَامُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَتِهِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَنْ لاَ تُغْلَبُوا عَلَى صَلاَةٍ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الْعَصْرَ وَالْفَجْرَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ جَرِيرٌ ‏{‏ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa alfazaariyyu, aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy khaalidin, haddathanaa qaysu bnu aabiy haazimin, qaala sami'tu jariyra bna 'abdi alllahi, wahuwa yaquwlu kunnaa juluwsana 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh nazara iilaa alqamari laylaaa albadri faqaala ‏"‏ aamaa iinnakum satarawna rabbakum kamaa tarawna hadhaa alqamara laa tudaammuwna fiy ruuyatihi faiini astata'tum aan laa tughlabuwa 'alaa salaaain qabla tuluw'i alshhamsi waqabla ghuruwbihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'niy al'asra waalfajra thumma qaraaa jariyrun ‏{‏ wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuluw'i alshhamsi waqabla ghuruwbihaa‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jarir b. Abdullah is reported to have said:We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he looked at the full moon and observed: You shall see your Lord as you are seeing this moon, and you will not be harmed by seeing Him. So if you can, do not let -yourselves be overpowered in case of prayer observed before the rising of the sun and its setting, i. e. the 'Asr prayer and the morning prayer. Jarir then recited it:" Celebrate the praise of thy Lord before the rising of the sun and before Its setting" (xx)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ وَوَكِيعٌ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَا إِنَّكُمْ سَتُعْرَضُونَ عَلَى رَبِّكُمْ فَتَرَوْنَهُ كَمَا تَرَوْنَ هَذَا الْقَمَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ جَرِيرٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa wawakiy'un bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ aamaa iinnakum satu'raduwna 'alaa rabbikum fatarawnahu kamaa tarawna hadhaa alqamara ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala thumma qaraaa ‏.‏ walam yaqul jariyrun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Waki' reported (this hadith) with the same chain of transmitters (that the Holy Prophet) said:You will be soon presented before your Lord, and you will see Him as you are seeing this moon, and then recited (the above-mentioned verse). But (in this hadith) no mention is made of Jarir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، - عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، وَمِسْعَرٍ، وَالْبَخْتَرِيِّ بْنِ الْمُخْتَارِ، سَمِعُوهُ مِنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ رُؤَيْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَنْ يَلِجَ النَّارَ أَحَدٌ صَلَّى قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الْفَجْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ آنْتَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعَتْهُ أُذُنَاىَ وَوَعَاهُ قَلْبِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma jamiy'ana 'an wakiy'in, - qaala aabuw kuraybin haddathanaa wakiy'un, - 'ani abni aabiy khaalidin, wamis'arin, waalbakhtariyyi bni almukhtaari, sami'uwhu min aabiy bakri bni 'umaaraaa bni ruuaybaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ lan yalija alnnaara aahadun sallaa qabla tuluw'i alshhamsi waqabla ghuruwbihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'niy alfajra waal'asra ‏.‏ faqaala lahu rajulun min aahli albasraai anta sami'ta hadhaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala alrrajulu waaanaa aashhadu aanniy sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sami'athu audhunaaaa wawa'aahu qalbiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umara b. Ruwaiba is reported to have said on the authority of his father:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: He who observes prayer before the rising of the sun and its setting, i.e. the dawn prayer and the afternoon prayer, would not enter the (Hell) fire. A person belonging to Basra said to him: Did you yourself hear it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? He said: Yes. The person (from Basra) said: I bear witness that I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ); my ears heard it and my heart retained it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ رُؤَيْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَلِجُ النَّارَ مَنْ صَلَّى قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَعِنْدَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ فَقَالَ آنْتَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ أَشْهَدُ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ لَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُهُ بِالْمَكَانِ الَّذِي سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy bukayrin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'ani abni 'umaaraaa bni ruuaybaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yaliju alnnaara man sallaa qabla tuluw'i alshhamsi waqabla ghuruwbihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wa'indahu rajulun min aahli albasraai faqaala anta sami'ta hadhaa mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am aashhadu bihi 'alayhi ‏.‏ qaala waaanaa aashhadu laqad sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwluhu bialmakaani alladhiy sami'tahu minhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umara b. Ruwaiba reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:He who said prayer before the rising of the sun and its setting would not enter the fire (of Hell), and there was a man from Basra (sitting) beside him who said: Did you hear it from the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him)? He said: Yes, I bear witness to it. The man from Basra said: I bear witness that I did hear from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying it from the place that you heard from him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَمْرَةَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ صَلَّى الْبَرْدَيْنِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin alaazdiyyu, haddathanaa hammaamu bnu yahyaa, haddathaniy aabuw jamraaa aldduba'iyyu, 'an aabiy bakrin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man sallaa albardayni dakhala aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakr reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:He who observed two prayers at two cool (hours) would enter Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ خِرَاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَنَسَبَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَقَالاَ ابْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa bishru bnu alssariyyi, h qaala wahaddathanaa abnu khiraashin, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aasimin, qaalaa jamiy'ana haddathanaa hammaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wanasabaa aabaa bakrin faqaalaa abnu aabiy muwsaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by the same chain of transmitters by Hammam, and said about Abu Bakr that he was Ibn Abu Musa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ إِذَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَتَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa haatimun, - wahuwa abnu iismaa'iyla - 'an yaziyda bni aabiy 'ubaydin, 'an salamaaa bni alaakwa'i, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy almaghriba iidhaa gharabati alshhamsu watawaarat bialhijaabi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salama b. al-Akwa' reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray the evening prayer when the sun had set and disappeared (behind the horizon)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو النَّجَاشِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَنْصَرِفُ أَحَدُنَا وَإِنَّهُ لَيُبْصِرُ مَوَاقِعَ نَبْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathaniy aabuw alnnajaashiyyi, qaala sami'tu raafi'a bna khadiyjin, yaquwlu kunnaa nusalliy almaghriba ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayansarifu aahadunaa waiinnahu layubsiru mawaaqi'a nablihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi' b. Khadij reported:We used to observe the evening prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and then one of us would go away and he could see the (distant) place where his arrow would fall
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو النَّجَاشِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa shu'aybu bnu iishaaqa alddimashqiyyu, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathaniy aabuw alnnajaashiyyi, haddathaniy raafi'u bnu khadiyjin, qaala kunnaa nusalliy almaghriba ‏.‏ binahwihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this, i. e." We used to observe evening prayer...." so on and so forth, has been narrated by Rafi' b. Khadij by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً مِنَ اللَّيَالِي بِصَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ وَهِيَ الَّتِي تُدْعَى الْعَتَمَةَ فَلَمْ يَخْرُجْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ نَامَ النِّسَاءُ وَالصِّبْيَانُ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لأَهْلِ الْمَسْجِدِ حِينَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ مَا يَنْتَظِرُهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْشُوَ الإِسْلاَمُ فِي النَّاسِ ‏.‏ زَادَ حَرْمَلَةُ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَذُكِرَ لِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَنْزُرُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَذَاكَ حِينَ صَاحَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amruw bnu sawwaadin al'aamiriyyu, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, aanna abna shihaabin, aakhbarahu qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat aa'tama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laylaaan mina alllayaaliy bisalaaai al'ishaa'i wahiya allatiy tud'aa al'atamaaa falam yakhruj rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa qaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi naama alnnisaa'u waalssibyaanu fakharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala laahli almasjidi hiyna kharaja 'alayhim ‏"‏ maa yantaziruhaa aahadun min aahli alaardi ghayrukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wadhalika qabla aan yafshuwa aliislaamu fiy alnnaasi ‏.‏ zaada harmalaau fiy riwaayatihi qaala abnu shihaabin wadhukira liy aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ wamaa kaana lakum aan tanzuruwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wadhaaka hiyna saaha 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha. the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) deferred one night the 'Isya' prayer. And this is called 'Atama. And the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not come out till Umar b. Khattab told (him) that the women and children had gone to sleep. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out towards them and said to the people of the mosque: None except you from the people of the earth waits for it (for the night prayer at this late hour), and it was before Islam had spread amongst people. And in the narration transmitted by Ibn Shihab the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is reported to have said: It is not meant that you should compel the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for prayer. And (this he said) when 'Umar b. Khattab called (the Holy Prophet) in a loud voice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ الزُّهْرِيِّ وَذُكِرَ لِي ‏.‏ وَمَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏ walam yadhkur qawla alzzuhriyyi wadhukira liy ‏.‏ wamaa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters, but therein no mention has been made of the words of al-Zuhri:It was narrated to me, and that which followed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالُوا جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَعْتَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ عَامَّةُ اللَّيْلِ وَحَتَّى نَامَ أَهْلُ الْمَسْجِدِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَوَقْتُهَا لَوْلاَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنْ يَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, kilaahumaa 'an muhammadi bni bakrin, h qaala wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, h qaala wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, - waaalfaazuhum mutaqaaribaaun - qaaluwa jamiy'ana 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy almughiyraau bnu hakiymin, 'an aummi kulthuwmin binti aabiy bakrin, aannahaa aakhbarathu 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat aa'tama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata laylaain hattaa dhahaba 'aammaau alllayli wahattaa naama aahlu almasjidi thumma kharaja fasallaa faqaala ‏"‏ iinnahu lawaqtuhaa lawlaa aan aashuqqa 'alaa aummatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alrrazzaaqi ‏"‏ lawlaa aan yashuqqa 'alaa aummatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) one night delayed (observing the 'Isya' prayer) till a great part of the night was over and the people in the mosque had gone to sleep. He (the Holy Prophet) then came out and observed prayer and said: This is the proper time for it; were it not that I would impose a burden on my people (I would normally pray at this time). In the hadith transmitters by 'Abd al-Razzaq (the words are):" Were it not that it would impose burden on my people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ مَكَثْنَا ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ نَنْتَظِرُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - لِصَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ الآخِرَةِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا حِينَ ذَهَبَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ فَلاَ نَدْرِي أَشَىْءٌ شَغَلَهُ فِي أَهْلِهِ أَوْ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ حِينَ خَرَجَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَنْتَظِرُونَ صَلاَةً مَا يَنْتَظِرُهَا أَهْلُ دِينٍ غَيْرُكُمْ وَلَوْلاَ أَنْ يَثْقُلَ عَلَى أُمَّتِي لَصَلَّيْتُ بِهِمْ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ الْمُؤَذِّنَ فَأَقَامَ الصَّلاَةَ وَصَلَّى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, zuhayrun haddathanaa jariyrun, - 'an mansuwrin, 'ani alhakami, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala makathnaa dhaata laylaain nantaziru rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - lisalaaai al'ishaa'i alakhiraai fakharaja iilaynaa hiyna dhahaba thuluthu alllayli aaw ba'dahu falaa nadriy aashaa'un shaghalahu fiy aahlihi aaw ghayru dhalika faqaala hiyna kharaja ‏ "‏ iinnakum latantaziruwna salaaaan maa yantaziruhaa aahlu diynin ghayrukum walawlaa aan yathqula 'alaa aummatiy lasallaytu bihim hadhihi alssaa'aaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aamara almuuadhhina faaaqaama alssalaaaa wasallaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported:We waited one night in expectation of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for the last prayer of the night, and he came out to us when a third of the night had passed even after that. We do not know whether he had been occupied with family business or something else. When he came cut he said: You are waiting for prayer, for which the followers of no other religion wait. except you. Were it not a burden for my Ummah, I would have led them (in the 'Isya' prayer) at this hour. He then ordered the Mu'adhdbin (to call for prayer) and then stood up for prayer and observed prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شُغِلَ عَنْهَا لَيْلَةً فَأَخَّرَهَا حَتَّى رَقَدْنَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظْنَا ثُمَّ رَقَدْنَا ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظْنَا ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ اللَّيْلَةَ يَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلاَةَ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shughila 'anhaa laylaaan faaakhharahaa hattaa raqadnaa fiy almasjidi thumma astayqaznaa thumma raqadnaa thumma astayqaznaa thumma kharaja 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaala ‏ "‏ laysa aahadun min aahli alaardi alllaylaaa yantaziru alssalaaaa ghayrukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was one night occupied (in some work) and he delayed it ('Isya' prayer) till we went to sleep in the mosque. We then woke up and again went to sleep and again woke up. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then came to us and said:None among the people of the earth except you waits for prayer in the night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، ‏.‏ أَنَّهُمْ سَأَلُوا أَنَسًا عَنْ خَاتَمِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَخَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِشَاءَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى شَطْرِ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ كَادَ يَذْهَبُ شَطْرُ اللَّيْلِ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ صَلَّوْا وَنَامُوا وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمْ تَزَالُوا فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا انْتَظَرْتُمُ الصَّلاَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ خَاتَمِهِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَرَفَعَ إِصْبَعَهُ الْيُسْرَى بِالْخِنْصَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa bahzu bnu aasadin al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, ‏.‏ aannahum saaaluwa aanasana 'an khaatami, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aakhhara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'ishaa'a dhaata laylaain iilaa shatri alllayli aaw kaada yadhhabu shatru alllayli thumma jaa'a faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna alnnaasa qad sallawa wanaamuwa waiinnakum lam tazaaluwa fiy salaaain maa antazartumu alssalaaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aanasun kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi khaatamihi min fiddaain warafa'a iisba'ahu alyusraa bialkhinsari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thabit reported:They (the believers) asked Anas about the ring of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: One night the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delayed (observing) the 'Isya' prayer up to the midnight or midnight was about to be over. He then came and said: (Other) people have offered prayers and slept, but you are constantly in prayer as long as you wait for prayer. Anas said: I perceive as if I am seeing the lustre of his silver ring, and lifted his, small left finger (in order to show how the Prophet had lifted it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ، سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ نَظَرْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً حَتَّى كَانَ قَرِيبٌ مِنْ نِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ خَاتَمِهِ فِي يَدِهِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa aabuw zaydin, sa'iydu bnu alrrabiy'i haddathanaa qurraau bnu khaalidin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala nazarnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laylaaan hattaa kaana qariybun min nisfi alllayli thumma jaa'a fasallaa thumma aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi fakaaannamaa aanzuru iilaa wabiysi khaatamihi fiy yadihi min fiddaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:We waited for the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon hi n) one night, till it was about midnight. He (the Holy Prophet) came and observed prayer and then turned his face towards us, as it I was seeing the lustre of the silver ring on his finger
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ الْعَطَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu alssabbaahi al'attaaru, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi almajiydi alhanafiyyu, haddathanaa qurraau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur thumma aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Qurra with the same chain of transmitters, but therein he did not mention:" He turned his face towards us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَأَصْحَابِي الَّذِينَ، قَدِمُوا مَعِي فِي السَّفِينَةِ نُزُولاً فِي بَقِيعِ بُطْحَانَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَكَانَ يَتَنَاوَبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ صَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ نَفَرٌ مِنْهُمْ قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى فَوَافَقْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَأَصْحَابِي وَلَهُ بَعْضُ الشُّغُلِ فِي أَمْرِهِ حَتَّى أَعْتَمَ بِالصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى ابْهَارَّ اللَّيْلُ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلاَتَهُ قَالَ لِمَنْ حَضَرَهُ ‏"‏ عَلَى رِسْلِكُمْ أُعْلِمُكُمْ وَأَبْشِرُوا أَنَّ مِنْ نِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنَ النَّاسِ أَحَدٌ يُصَلِّي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا صَلَّى هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لاَ نَدْرِي أَىَّ الْكَلِمَتَيْنِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى فَرَجَعْنَا فَرِحِينَ بِمَا سَمِعْنَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin alaash'ariyyu, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala kuntu aanaa waaashaabiy alladhiyna, qadimuwa ma'iy fiy alssafiynaai nuzuwlaan fiy baqiy'i buthaana warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialmadiynaai fakaana yatanaawabu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda salaaai al'ishaa'i kulla laylaain nafarun minhum qaala aabuw muwsaa fawaafaqnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanaa waaashaabiy walahu ba'du alshhughuli fiy aamrihi hattaa aa'tama bialssalaaai hattaa abhaarra alllaylu thumma kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa bihim falammaa qadaa salaatahu qaala liman hadarahu ‏"‏ 'alaa rislikum au'limukum waaabshiruwa aanna min ni'maai alllahi 'alaykum aannahu laysa mina alnnaasi aahadun yusalliy hadhihi alssaa'aaa ghayrukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ maa sallaa hadhihi alssaa'aaa aahadun ghayrukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ laa nadriy aaaaa alkalimatayni qaala qaala aabuw muwsaa faraja'naa farihiyna bimaa sami'naa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported:I and my companions who had sailed along with me in the boat landed with me in the valley of Buthan while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was staying in Medina. A party of people amongst them went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) every night at the time of the 'Isya' prayer turn by turn. Abu Musa said: (One night) we (I and my companions) went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was occupied in some matter till there was a delay in prayer so much so that it was the middle of the night. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then came out and led them (Musa's companions) in prayer. And when he had observed his prayer he said to the audience present: Take it easy, I am going to give you information and glad tidings that it is the blessing of Allah upon you for there is none among the people, except you, who prays at this hour (of the night), or he said: None except you observed prayer at this. (late) hour. He (i. e. the narrator) said: I am not sure which of these two sentences he actually uttered. Abu Musa, said: We came back happy for what we heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ أَىُّ حِينٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ الْعِشَاءَ الَّتِي يَقُولُهَا النَّاسُ الْعَتَمَةَ إِمَامًا وَخِلْوًا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ أَعْتَمَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ الْعِشَاءَ - قَالَ - حَتَّى رَقَدَ نَاسٌ وَاسْتَيْقَظُوا وَرَقَدُوا وَاسْتَيْقَظُوا فَقَامَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَخَرَجَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ الآنَ يَقْطُرُ رَأْسُهُ مَاءً وَاضِعًا يَدَهُ عَلَى شِقِّ رَأْسِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْلاَ أَنْ يَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي لأَمَرْتُهُمْ أَنْ يُصَلُّوهَا كَذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاسْتَثْبَتُّ عَطَاءً كَيْفَ وَضَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ كَمَا أَنْبَأَهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَبَدَّدَ لِي عَطَاءٌ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ شَيْئًا مِنْ تَبْدِيدٍ ثُمَّ وَضَعَ أَطْرَافَ أَصَابِعِهِ عَلَى قَرْنِ الرَّأْسِ ثُمَّ صَبَّهَا يُمِرُّهَا كَذَلِكَ عَلَى الرَّأْسِ حَتَّى مَسَّتْ إِبْهَامُهُ طَرَفَ الأُذُنِ مِمَّا يَلِي الْوَجْهَ ثُمَّ عَلَى الصُّدْغِ وَنَاحِيَةِ اللِّحْيَةِ لاَ يُقَصِّرُ وَلاَ يَبْطِشُ بِشَىْءٍ إِلاَّ كَذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ كَمْ ذُكِرَ لَكَ أَخَّرَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَتَئِذٍ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي ‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَهَا إِمَامًا وَخِلْوًا مُؤَخَّرَةً كَمَا صَلاَّهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَتَئِذٍ فَإِنْ شَقَّ عَلَيْكَ ذَلِكَ خِلْوًا أَوْ عَلَى النَّاسِ فِي الْجَمَاعَةِ وَأَنْتَ إِمَامُهُمْ فَصَلِّهَا وَسَطًا لاَ مُعَجَّلَةً وَلاَ مُؤَخَّرَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala qultu li'ataa'in aaaau hiynin aahabbu iilayka aan ausalliya al'ishaa'a allatiy yaquwluhaa alnnaasu al'atamaaa iimaamana wakhilwana qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin yaquwlu aa'tama nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata laylaain al'ishaa'a - qaala - hattaa raqada naasun waastayqazuwa waraqaduwa waastayqazuwa faqaama 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi faqaala alssalaaaa ‏.‏ faqaala 'ataa'un qaala abnu 'abbaasin fakharaja nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaaanniy aanzuru iilayhi alana yaqturu raasuhu maa'an waadi'ana yadahu 'alaa shiqqi raasihi qaala ‏ "‏ lawlaa aan yashuqqa 'alaa aummatiy laamartuhum aan yusalluwhaa kadhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faastathbattu 'ataa'an kayfa wada'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu 'alaa raasihi kamaa aanbaaahu abnu 'abbaasin fabaddada liy 'ataa'un bayna aasaabi'ihi shayiana min tabdiydin thumma wada'a aatraafa aasaabi'ihi 'alaa qarni alrraasi thumma sabbahaa yumirruhaa kadhalika 'alaa alrraasi hattaa massat iibhaamuhu tarafa alaudhuni mimmaa yaliy alwajha thumma 'alaa alssudghi wanaahiyaai alllihyaai laa yuqassiru walaa yabtishu bishaa'in iilaaa kadhalika ‏.‏ qultu li'ataa'in kam dhukira laka aakhharahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm laylataiidhin qaala laa aadriy ‏.‏ qaala 'ataa'un aahabbu iilaaaa aan ausalliyahaa iimaamana wakhilwana muuakhharaaan kamaa salaaahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm laylataiidhin faiin shaqqa 'alayka dhalika khilwana aaw 'alaa alnnaasi fiy aljamaa'aai waaanta iimaamuhum fasallihaa wasatana laa mu'ajjalaaan walaa muuakhharaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Juraij reported:I said to Ata': Which time do you deem fit for me to say the 'Isya' prayer, -as an Imam or alone, -that time which is called by people 'Atama? He said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas saying: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) one night delayed the 'Isya' prayer till the people went to sleep. They woke up and again went to sleep and again woke up. Then 'Umar b. Khattab stood up and said (loudly)" Prayer." Ata' further reported that Ibn 'Abbas said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came out, and as if I am still seeing him with water trickling from his head, and with his hand placed on one side of the head, and he said: Were it not hard for my Ummah, I would have ordered them to observe this prayer like this (i. e. at late hours). I inquired from 'Ata' how the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) placed his hand upon his head as Ibn Abbas had informed. So Ata' spread his fingers a little and then placed the ends of his fingers on the side of his head. He then moved them like this over his head till the thumb touched that part of the ear which is near the face and then it (went) to the earlock and the part of the heard. It (the bind) neither held nor caught anything but this is how (it moved oil). I said to Ata': Was it mentioned to you (by Ibn Abbas) how long did the Apostle (ﷺ) delay it (the prayer) during that eight? He said: I do not know (I cannot give you the exact time). Ali' said: I love that I should say prayer, whether as an Imam or alone at delayed hours as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that night, but if It is hard upon you in your individual capacity or upon people in the congregation and you are their Imam, then say prayer ('Isha') at the middle hours neither too early nor too late
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُؤَخِّرُ صَلاَةَ الْعِشَاءِ الآخِرَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an simaakin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuuakhhiru salaaaa al'ishaa'i alakhiraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) postponed the last 'Isha' prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الصَّلَوَاتِ نَحْوًا مِنْ صَلاَتِكُمْ وَكَانَ يُؤَخِّرُ الْعَتَمَةَ بَعْدَ صَلاَتِكُمْ شَيْئًا وَكَانَ يُخِفُّ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كَامِلٍ يُخَفِّفُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an simaakin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy alssalawaati nahwana min salaatikum wakaana yuuakhhiru al'atamaaa ba'da salaatikum shayiana wakaana yukhiffu alssalaaaa ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy kaamilin yukhaffifu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe prayers like your prayers, but he would delay the prayer after nightfall to a little after the time you observed it, and he would shorten the prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَبِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَغْلِبَنَّكُمُ الأَعْرَابُ عَلَى اسْمِ صَلاَتِكُمْ أَلاَ إِنَّهَا الْعِشَاءُ وَهُمْ يُعْتِمُونَ بِالإِبِلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani abni aabiy labiydin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa taghlibannakumu alaa'raabu 'alaa asmi salaatikum aalaa iinnahaa al'ishaa'u wahum yu'timuwna bialiibili ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Let the bedouin not gain upper hand over you in regard to the name of your prayer. See I (The night prayer should be called) 'Isya' (and the bedouins call it Atama (because) they milk their camels late
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي لَبِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَغْلِبَنَّكُمُ الأَعْرَابُ عَلَى اسْمِ صَلاَتِكُمُ الْعِشَاءِ فَإِنَّهَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ الْعِشَاءُ وَإِنَّهَا تُعْتِمُ بِحِلاَبِ الإِبِلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy labiydin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taghlibannakumu alaa'raabu 'alaa asmi salaatikumu al'ishaa'i faiinnahaa fiy kitaabi alllahi al'ishaa'u waiinnahaa tu'timu bihilaabi aliibili ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Let the bedouin not gain upper band over you In regard to the name of your prayer, i. e. night prayer, for it is mentioned 'Isya' in the Book of Allah (i. e. the Qur'an). (The bedouin call it 'Atama because) they make delay in milling their she-camels
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ نِسَاءَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ، كُنَّ يُصَلِّينَ الصُّبْحَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ يَرْجِعْنَ مُتَلَفِّعَاتٍ بِمُرُوطِهِنَّ لاَ يَعْرِفُهُنَّ أَحَدٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, kulluhum 'an sufyaana bni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna nisaa'a almuuminaati, kunna yusalliyna alssubha ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma yarji'na mutalaffi'aatin bimuruwtihinna laa ya'rifuhunna aahadun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The believing women used to pray the morning prayer with the Messenger of Allah and then return wrapped in their mantles. No one could recognise them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ لَقَدْ كَانَ نِسَاءٌ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَشْهَدْنَ الْفَجْرَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَلَفِّعَاتٍ بِمُرُوطِهِنَّ ثُمَّ يَنْقَلِبْنَ إِلَى بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَمَا يُعْرَفْنَ مِنْ تَغْلِيسِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, aanna abna shihaabin, aakhbarahu qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat laqad kaana nisaa'un mina almuuminaati yashhadna alfajra ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mutalaffi'aatin bimuruwtihinna thumma yanqalibna iilaa buyuwtihinna wamaa yu'rafna min taghliysi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialssalaaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported:The believing women observed the morning prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wrapped in their mantles. They then went back to their houses and were unrecognisable, because of the Messenger of Allah's (ﷺ) praying in the darkness before dawn
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُوسَى الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ إِنْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ فَيَنْصَرِفُ النِّسَاءُ مُتَلَفِّعَاتٍ بِمُرُوطِهِنَّ مَا يُعْرَفْنَ مِنَ الْغَلَسِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ مُتَلَفِّفَاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, waiishaaqu bnu muwsaa alaansaariyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa ma'nun, 'an maalikin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat iin kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm layusalliy alssubha fayansarifu alnnisaa'u mutalaffi'aatin bimuruwtihinna maa yu'rafna mina alghalasi ‏.‏ waqaala alaansaariyyu fiy riwaayatihi mutalaffifaatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe the morning prayer, and the women would go back wrapped in their mantles being unrecognisable because of the darkness before dawn. (Ishaq b. Musa) al-Ansari (one of the transmitters in this chain of narration) narrated" wrapped" (only) in his narration. (No mention was made of mantles)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمَ الْحَجَّاجُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَسَأَلْنَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ بِالْهَاجِرَةِ وَالْعَصْرَ وَالشَّمْسُ نَقِيَّةٌ وَالْمَغْرِبَ إِذَا وَجَبَتْ وَالْعِشَاءَ أَحْيَانًا يُؤَخِّرُهَا وَأَحْيَانًا يُعَجِّلُ كَانَ إِذَا رَآهُمْ قَدِ اجْتَمَعُوا عَجَّلَ وَإِذَا رَآهُمْ قَدْ أَبْطَئُوا أَخَّرَ وَالصُّبْحَ كَانُوا أَوْ - قَالَ - كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّيهَا بِغَلَسٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h qaala wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni alhasani bni 'aliyyin, qaala lammaa qadima alhajjaaju almadiynaaa fasaaalnaa jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi faqaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy alzzuhra bialhaajiraai waal'asra waalshhamsu naqiyyaaun waalmaghriba iidhaa wajabat waal'ishaa'a aahyaanana yuuakhhiruhaa waaahyaanana yu'ajjilu kaana iidhaa raahum qadi ajtama'uwa 'ajjala waiidhaa raahum qad aabtaiuwa aakhhara waalssubha kaanuwa aaw - qaala - kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliyhaa bighalasin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. 'Amr b. al-Hasan b. 'All reported:When Hajjaj came to Medina we asked Jabir b. Abdullah (about the timings of prayer as observed by the Holy Prophet). He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to pray afternoon prayer in the midday heat; the afternoon prayer when the sun was bright; the evening prayer when the sun had completely set; and as for the night prayer, he sometimes delayed and sometimes (observed it) at earlier hours. When he found them (his Companions) assembled (at earlier hours) he (prayed) early. and when he saw them coming late, he delayed the (prayer). and the morning prayer the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed in the darkness before dawn
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ كَانَ الْحَجَّاجُ يُؤَخِّرُ الصَّلَوَاتِ فَسَأَلْنَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ غُنْدَرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'din, sami'a muhammada bna 'amriw bni alhasani bni 'aliyyin, qaala kaana alhajjaaju yuuakhhiru alssalawaati fasaaalnaa jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi bimithli hadiythi ghundarin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. 'Amr al-Hasan b. 'All reported:Hajjaj used to delay the prayers, and so we asked Jabir b. 'Abdullah, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَيَّارُ بْنُ سَلاَمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَسْأَلُ أَبَا بَرْزَةَ، عَنْ صَلاَةِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - قُلْتُ آنْتَ سَمِعْتَهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ كَأَنَّمَا أَسْمَعُكَ السَّاعَةَ - قَالَ - سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ كَانَ لاَ يُبَالِي بَعْضَ تَأْخِيرِهَا - قَالَ يَعْنِي الْعِشَاءَ - إِلَى نِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ وَلاَ يُحِبُّ النَّوْمَ قَبْلَهَا وَلاَ الْحَدِيثَ بَعْدَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ ثُمَّ لَقِيتُهُ بَعْدُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ وَكَانَ يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ حِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ وَالْعَصْرَ يَذْهَبُ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالشَّمْسُ حَيَّةٌ - قَالَ - وَالْمَغْرِبَ لاَ أَدْرِي أَىَّ حِينٍ ذَكَرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ لَقِيتُهُ بَعْدُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ وَكَانَ يُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ فَيَنْصَرِفُ الرَّجُلُ فَيَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَجْهِ جَلِيسِهِ الَّذِي يَعْرِفُ فَيَعْرِفُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِيهَا بِالسِّتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِائَةِ ‏.‏
