verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaraniy sayyaaru bnu salaamaaa, qaala sami'tu aabiy yasaalu aabaa barzaaa, 'an salaaai, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - qultu anta sami'tahu qaala faqaala kaaannamaa aasma'uka alssaa'aaa - qaala - sami'tu aabiy yasaaluhu 'an salaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala kaana laa yubaaliy ba'da taakhiyrihaa - qaala ya'niy al'ishaa'a - iilaa nisfi alllayli walaa yuhibbu alnnawma qablahaa walaa alhadiytha ba'dahaa ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau thumma laqiytuhu ba'du fasaaaltuhu faqaala wakaana yusalliy alzzuhra hiyna tazuwlu alshhamsu waal'asra yadhhabu alrrajulu iilaa aaqsaa almadiynaai waalshhamsu hayyaaun - qaala - waalmaghriba laa aadriy aaaaa hiynin dhakara ‏.‏ qaala thumma laqiytuhu ba'du fasaaaltuhu faqaala wakaana yusalliy alssubha fayansarifu alrrajulu fayanzuru iilaa wajhi jaliysihi alladhiy ya'rifu faya'rifuhu ‏.‏ qaala wakaana yaqraau fiyhaa bialssittiyna iilaa almiaiaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sayyar b. Salama reported:I heard my father asking Abu Barza (al- Aslami) about the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I (Shu'ba, one of the narrators) said: Did you hear it (from Abu Barza)? He said: 1 feel as if I am bearing you at this very time. He said: I heard my father asking about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he (Abu Barza) making this reply: He (the Holy Prophet) did not mind delaying-some (prayer) i. e. 'Isya' prayer, even up to the midnight and did not like sleeping before observing it, and talking after it. Shu'ba said: I met him subsequently and asked him (about the prayers of the Holy Prophet) and he said: He observed the noon prayer when the sun was past the meridian, he would pray the afternoon prayer, after which a person would o to the outskirts of Medina and the sun was still bright; (I forgot what he said about the evening prayer) ; I then met him on a subsequent occasion and asked him (about the prayers of the Holy Prophet; and he said: He would observe the morning prayer (at such a time) so that a man would go back and would recognise his neighbour by casting a glance at his face, and he would recite from sixty to one hundred verses in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَيَّارِ بْنِ سَلاَمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا بَرْزَةَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يُبَالِي بَعْضَ تَأْخِيرِ صَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى نِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ وَكَانَ لاَ يُحِبُّ النَّوْمَ قَبْلَهَا وَلاَ الْحَدِيثَ بَعْدَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ ثُمَّ لَقِيتُهُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى فَقَالَ أَوْ ثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sayyaari bni salaamaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa barzaaa, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yubaaliy ba'da taakhiyri salaaai al'ishaa'i iilaa nisfi alllayli wakaana laa yuhibbu alnnawma qablahaa walaa alhadiytha ba'dahaa ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau thumma laqiytuhu marraaan aukhraa faqaala aaw thuluthi alllayli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sayyar b. Salama reported:I heard Abu Barza saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not mind some delay in the 'Isha' prayer even up to midnight and he did not like sleeping before (observing it) and talking after it. Shu'ba said: I again met him (Sayyar b. Salama) for the second time and he said: Even up to the third (part) of the night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الْكَلْبِيُّ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ سَيَّارِ بْنِ سَلاَمَةَ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا بَرْزَةَ الأَسْلَمِيَّ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُؤَخِّرُ الْعِشَاءَ إِلَى ثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ وَيَكْرَهُ النَّوْمَ قَبْلَهَا وَالْحَدِيثَ بَعْدَهَا وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ مِنَ الْمِائَةِ إِلَى السِّتِّينَ وَكَانَ يَنْصَرِفُ حِينَ يَعْرِفُ بَعْضُنَا وَجْهَ بَعْضٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa suwaydu bnu 'amrinw alkalbiyyu, 'an hammaadi bni salamaaa, 'an sayyaari bni salaamaaa aabiy alminhaali, qaala sami'tu aabaa barzaaa alaaslamiyya, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuuakhhiru al'ishaa'a iilaa thuluthi alllayli wayakrahu alnnawma qablahaa waalhadiytha ba'dahaa wakaana yaqraau fiy salaaai alfajri mina almiaiaai iilaa alssittiyna wakaana yansarifu hiyna ya'rifu ba'dunaa wajha ba'din ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Barza b. Aslami is reported to have said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delayed the night prayer till a third of the night had passed and he did not approve of sleeping before it, and talking after it, and he used to recite in the morning prayer from one hundred to sixty verses (and completed the prayer at such hours) when we recognised the faces of one another
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ أَنْتَ إِذَا كَانَتْ عَلَيْكَ أُمَرَاءُ يُؤَخِّرُونَ الصَّلاَةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا أَوْ يُمِيتُونَ الصَّلاَةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي قَالَ ‏"‏ صَلِّ الصَّلاَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا فَإِنْ أَدْرَكْتَهَا مَعَهُمْ فَصَلِّ فَإِنَّهَا لَكَ نَافِلَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ خَلَفٌ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, h qaala wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, waaabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aabiy 'imraana aljawniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaamiti, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi ‏"‏ kayfa aanta iidhaa kaanat 'alayka aumaraa'u yuuakhhiruwna alssalaaaa 'an waqtihaa aaw yumiytuwna alssalaaaa 'an waqtihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu famaa taamuruniy qaala ‏"‏ salli alssalaaaa liwaqtihaa faiin aadraktahaa ma'ahum fasalli faiinnahaa laka naafilaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur khalafun 'an waqtihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: How would you act when you are under the rulers who would delay the prayer beyond its prescribed time, or they would make prayer a dead thing as far as its proper time is concerned? I said: What do you command? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Observe the prayer at Its proper time, and if you can say it along with them do so, for it would be a superetogatory prayer for you. Khalaf (one of the narrators in the above hadith) has not mentioned" beyond their (prescribed) time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ إِنَّهُ سَيَكُونُ بَعْدِي أُمَرَاءُ يُمِيتُونَ الصَّلاَةَ فَصَلِّ الصَّلاَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا فَإِنْ صَلَّيْتَ لِوَقْتِهَا كَانَتْ لَكَ نَافِلَةً وَإِلاَّ كُنْتَ قَدْ أَحْرَزْتَ صَلاَتَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa ja'faru bnu sulaymaana, 'an aabiy 'imraana aljawniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaamiti, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa aabaa dharrin iinnahu sayakuwnu ba'diy aumaraa'u yumiytuwna alssalaaaa fasalli alssalaaaa liwaqtihaa faiin sallayta liwaqtihaa kaanat laka naafilaaan waiilaaa kunta qad aahrazta salaataka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: O Abu Dharr, you would soon find after me rulers who would make their prayers dead. You should say prayer at its prescribed time. If you say prayer at its prescribed time that would be a supererogatory prayer for you, otherwise you saved your prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ إِنَّ خَلِيلِي أَوْصَانِي أَنْ أَسْمَعَ وَأُطِيعَ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَبْدًا مُجَدَّعَ الأَطْرَافِ وَأَنْ أُصَلِّيَ الصَّلاَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا ‏ "‏ فَإِنْ أَدْرَكْتَ الْقَوْمَ وَقَدْ صَلَّوْا كُنْتَ قَدْ أَحْرَزْتَ صَلاَتَكَ وَإِلاَّ كَانَتْ لَكَ نَافِلَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy 'imraana, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaamiti, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala iinna khaliyliy aawsaaniy aan aasma'a waautiy'a waiin kaana 'abdana mujadda'a alaatraafi waaan ausalliya alssalaaaa liwaqtihaa ‏ "‏ faiin aadrakta alqawma waqad sallawa kunta qad aahrazta salaataka waiilaaa kaanat laka naafilaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported:My friend (the Holy Prophet) bade me to hear and obey (the ruler) even if he is a slave having his feet and arms cut off, and observe prayer at its prescribed time. (And further said): It you find people having observed the prayer, you in fact saved your prayer, otherwise (if you join with them) that would be a Nafl prayer for you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْعَالِيَةِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضَرَبَ فَخِذِي ‏"‏ كَيْفَ أَنْتَ إِذَا بَقِيتَ فِي قَوْمٍ يُؤَخِّرُونَ الصَّلاَةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ مَا تَأْمُرُ قَالَ ‏"‏ صَلِّ الصَّلاَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا ثُمَّ اذْهَبْ لِحَاجَتِكَ فَإِنْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَأَنْتَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَصَلِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an budaylin, qaala sami'tu aabaa al'aaliyaai, yuhaddithu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaamiti, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wadaraba fakhidhiy ‏"‏ kayfa aanta iidhaa baqiyta fiy qawmin yuuakhhiruwna alssalaaaa 'an waqtihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qaala maa taamuru qaala ‏"‏ salli alssalaaaa liwaqtihaa thumma adhhab lihaajatika faiin auqiymati alssalaaau waaanta fiy almasjidi fasalli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) struck my thigh and said: How would you act if you survive among the people who would delay prayers beyond their (prescribed) time? He (Abu Dharr) said: What do you command (under this situation)? He (the Holy Prophet) slid: Observe prayer at its prescribed time, then go (to meet) your needs, and if the Iqama is pronounced, and you are present in the mosque, then observe prayer (along with the Jama'at)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ الْبَرَّاءِ، قَالَ أَخَّرَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ الصَّلاَةَ فَجَاءَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ فَأَلْقَيْتُ لَهُ كُرْسِيًّا فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهِ فَذَكَرْتُ لَهُ صَنِيعَ ابْنِ زِيَادٍ فَعَضَّ عَلَى شَفَتِهِ وَضَرَبَ فَخِذِي وَقَالَ إِنِّي سَأَلْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ كَمَا سَأَلْتَنِي فَضَرَبَ فَخِذِي كَمَا ضَرَبْتُ فَخِذَكَ وَقَالَ إِنِّي سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا سَأَلْتَنِي فَضَرَبَ فَخِذِي كَمَا ضَرَبْتُ فَخِذَكَ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلِّ الصَّلاَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا فَإِنْ أَدْرَكَتْكَ الصَّلاَةُ مَعَهُمْ فَصَلِّ وَلاَ تَقُلْ إِنِّي قَدْ صَلَّيْتُ فَلاَ أُصَلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy al'aaliyaai albarraa'i, qaala aakhhara abnu ziyaadin alssalaaaa fajaa'aniy 'abdu alllahi bnu alssaamiti faaalqaytu lahu kursiyyana fajalasa 'alayhi fadhakartu lahu saniy'a abni ziyaadin fa'adda 'alaa shafatihi wadaraba fakhidhiy waqaala iinniy saaaltu aabaa dharrin kamaa saaaltaniy fadaraba fakhidhiy kamaa darabtu fakhidhaka waqaala iinniy saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kamaa saaaltaniy fadaraba fakhidhiy kamaa darabtu fakhidhaka waqaala ‏ "‏ salli alssalaaaa liwaqtihaa faiin aadrakatka alssalaaau ma'ahum fasalli walaa taqul iinniy qad sallaytu falaa ausalliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu'l-'Aliyat al-Bara reported:Ibn Ziyad delayed the prayer. 'Abdullah b. Samit came to me and I placed a chair for him and he sat in it and I made a mention of whit Ibn Ziyad had done. He bit hit lips (as a sign of extreme anger and annoyance) and struck at my thigh and said: I asked Abu Dharr as you have asked me, and he struck my thigh just as I have struck your thigh, and said: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as you have asked me and he struck my thigh just as I have struck your thigh, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Observe prayer at its prescribed time, and if you can say prayer along with them. do so, and do not say." I have observed prayer and so I shall not pray
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي نَعَامَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ - أَوْ قَالَ كَيْفَ أَنْتَ - إِذَا بَقِيتَ فِي قَوْمٍ يُؤَخِّرُونَ الصَّلاَةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا فَصَلِّ الصَّلاَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَصَلِّ مَعَهُمْ فَإِنَّهَا زِيَادَةُ خَيْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'aasimu bnu alnnadri alttaymiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy na'aamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaamiti, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala qaala ‏ "‏ kayfa aantum - aaw qaala kayfa aanta - iidhaa baqiyta fiy qawmin yuuakhhiruwna alssalaaaa 'an waqtihaa fasalli alssalaaaa liwaqtihaa thumma iin auqiymati alssalaaau fasalli ma'ahum faiinnahaa ziyaadaau khayrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported:(The Messenger of Allah) said: How would you, or how would thou, act if you survive to live among people who defer prayer beyond the (prescribed) time? (The narrator said: Allah and His Messenger know best). whereupon he said: Observe prayer at its prescribed time, but if the Iqama is pronounced for (congregational) prayer, then observe prayer along with them. for herein is an excess of virtue
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - وَهْوَ ابْنُ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ مَطَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ الْبَرَّاءِ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ نُصَلِّي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ خَلْفَ أُمَرَاءَ فَيُؤَخِّرُونَ الصَّلاَةَ - قَالَ - فَضَرَبَ فَخِذِي ضَرْبَةً أَوْجَعَتْنِي وَقَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَضَرَبَ فَخِذِي وَقَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلُّوا الصَّلاَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا وَاجْعَلُوا صَلاَتَكُمْ مَعَهُمْ نَافِلَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ذُكِرَ لِي أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَرَبَ فَخِذَ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - wahwa abnu hishaamin - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an matarin, 'an aabiy al'aaliyaai albarraa'i, qaala qultu li'abdi alllahi bni alssaamiti nusalliy yawma aljumu'aai khalfa aumaraa'a fayuuakhhiruwna alssalaaaa - qaala - fadaraba fakhidhiy darbaaan aawja'atniy waqaala saaaltu aabaa dharrin 'an dhalika fadaraba fakhidhiy waqaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ salluwa alssalaaaa liwaqtihaa waaj'aluwa salaatakum ma'ahum naafilaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala waqaala 'abdu alllahi dhukira liy aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm daraba fakhidha aabiy dharrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu'l-'Aliyat al-Bara' reported:I said to 'Abdullah b. Samit: We say our Jumu'a prayer behind those rulers who defer the prayer. He ('Abdullah b. Samit), struck. my thigh that I felt pain and said: I asked Abu Dharr about it, he struck my thigh and said: I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it. Upon this he said: Observe prayer at its prescribed time, and treat prayer along with them (along with those Imams who deter prayer) as Nafl. 'Abdullah said: It was narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) struck the thigh of Abd Dharr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الْجَمَاعَةِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ صَلاَةِ أَحَدِكُمْ وَحْدَهُ بِخَمْسَةٍ وَعِشْرِينَ جُزْءًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ salaaau aljamaa'aai aafdalu min salaaai aahadikum wahdahu bikhamsaain wa'ishriyna juz'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Prayer said in a congregation is twenty-five degrees more excellent than prayer said by a single person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ تَفْضُلُ صَلاَةٌ فِي الْجَمِيعِ عَلَى صَلاَةِ الرَّجُلِ وَحْدَهُ خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَتَجْتَمِعُ مَلاَئِكَةُ اللَّيْلِ وَمَلاَئِكَةُ النَّهَارِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏ وَقُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ إِنَّ قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ tafdulu salaaaun fiy aljamiy'i 'alaa salaaai alrrajuli wahdahu khamsana wa'ishriyna darajaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ watajtami'u malaaiikaau alllayli wamalaaiikaau alnnahaari fiy salaaai alfajri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa aqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏ waqurana alfajri iinna qurana alfajri kaana mashhuwdana‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Prayer said in a congregation is twenty-five degrees more excellent than prayer said by a single person. He (Abu Huraira further) said: The angels of the night and the angels of the day meet together. Abu Huraira said: Recite it you like:" Surely the recital of the Qur'an at dawn is witnessed" (al-Qur'an, xvii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدٌ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ بِخَمْسٍ وَعِشْرِينَ جُزْءًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydun, waaabuw salamaaa aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi 'abdi alaa'laa 'an ma'marin iilaaa aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ bikhamsin wa'ishriyna juz'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira with another chain of transmitters with a very slight change of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الأَغَرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الْجَمَاعَةِ تَعْدِلُ خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الْفَذِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa aaflahu, 'an aabiy bakri bni muhammadi bni 'amriw bni hazmin, 'an salmaana alaagharri, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ salaaau aljamaa'aai ta'dilu khamsana wa'ishriyna min salaaai alfadhhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Prayer said in a congregation is equivalent to twenty-five (prayers) as compared with the prayer said by a single person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخُوَارِ، أَنَّهُ بَيْنَا هُوَ جَالِسٌ مَعَ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ إِذْ مَرَّ بِهِمْ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ خَتَنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ زَبَّانٍ مَوْلَى الْجُهَنِيِّينَ فَدَعَاهُ نَافِعٌ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَلاَةٌ مَعَ الإِمَامِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ خَمْسٍ وَعِشْرِينَ صَلاَةً يُصَلِّيهَا وَحْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, qaalaa haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu 'ataa'i bni aabiy alkhuwaari, aannahu baynaa huwa jaalisun ma'a naafi'i bni jubayri bni mut'imin iidh marra bihim aabuw 'abdi alllahi khatanu zaydi bni zabbaanin mawlaa aljuhaniyyiyna fada'aahu naafi'un faqaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ salaaaun ma'a aliimaami aafdalu min khamsin wa'ishriyna salaaaan yusalliyhaa wahdahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: Prayer along with the Imam is twenty-five times more excellent than prayer said by a single person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الْجَمَاعَةِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الْفَذِّ بِسَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ salaaau aljamaa'aai aafdalu min salaaai alfadhhi bisab'in wa'ishriyna darajaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assaying:Prayer said in a congregation is twenty-seven degrees more excellent than prayer said by a single person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي الْجَمَاعَةِ تَزِيدُ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ وَحْدَهُ سَبْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ salaaau alrrajuli fiy aljamaa'aai taziydu 'alaa salaatihi wahdahu sab'ana wa'ishriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The prayer of a person in congregation is twenty-seven times in excess to the prayer said alone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالاَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ‏"‏ بِضْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏"‏ سَبْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, waabnu, numayrin h qaala wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy qaalaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ qaala abnu numayrin 'an aabiyhi, ‏"‏ bid'ana wa'ishriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw bakrin fiy riwaayatihi ‏"‏ sab'ana wa'ishriyna darajaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Numair reported it on the authority of his father (a preference of) more than twenty (degrees) and Abu Bakr in his narration (has narrated it) twenty- seven degrees
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بِضْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu raafi'in, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ bid'ana wa'ishriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as some and twenty (degrees)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَدَ نَاسًا فِي بَعْضِ الصَّلَوَاتِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ رَجُلاً يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ أُخَالِفَ إِلَى رِجَالٍ يَتَخَلَّفُونَ عَنْهَا فَآمُرَ بِهِمْ فَيُحَرِّقُوا عَلَيْهِمْ بِحُزَمِ الْحَطَبِ بُيُوتَهُمْ وَلَوْ عَلِمَ أَحَدُهُمْ أَنَّهُ يَجِدُ عَظْمًا سَمِينًا لَشَهِدَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي صَلاَةَ الْعِشَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqada naasana fiy ba'di alssalawaati faqaala ‏ "‏ laqad hamamtu aan amura rajulaan yusalliy bialnnaasi thumma aukhaalifa iilaa rijaalin yatakhallafuwna 'anhaa faamura bihim fayuharriquwa 'alayhim bihuzami alhatabi buyuwtahum walaw 'alima aahaduhum aannahu yajidu 'azmana samiynana lashahidahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'niy salaaaa al'ishaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) found some people absenting from certain prayers and he said: I intend that I order (a) person to lead people in prayer, and then go to the persons who do not join the (congregational prayer) and then order their houses to be burnt by the bundles of fuel. If one amongst them were to know that he would find a fat fleshy bone he would attend the night prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَثْقَلَ صَلاَةٍ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ صَلاَةُ الْعِشَاءِ وَصَلاَةُ الْفَجْرِ وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِيهِمَا لأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا وَلَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَتُقَامَ ثُمَّ آمُرَ رَجُلاً فَيُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ أَنْطَلِقَ مَعِي بِرِجَالٍ مَعَهُمْ حُزَمٌ مِنْ حَطَبٍ إِلَى قَوْمٍ لاَ يَشْهَدُونَ الصَّلاَةَ فَأُحَرِّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ بُيُوتَهُمْ بِالنَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu lahumaa - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna aathqala salaaain 'alaa almunaafiqiyna salaaau al'ishaa'i wasalaaau alfajri walaw ya'lamuwna maa fiyhimaa laatawhumaa walaw habwana walaqad hamamtu aan amura bialssalaaai fatuqaama thumma amura rajulaan fayusalliya bialnnaasi thumma aantaliqa ma'iy birijaalin ma'ahum huzamun min hatabin iilaa qawmin laa yashhaduwna alssalaaaa faauharriqa 'alayhim buyuwtahum bialnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The most burdensome prayers for the hypocrites are the night prayer and the morning prayer. If they were to know the blessings they have in store, they would have come to them, even though crawling, and I thought that I should order the prayer to be commenced and command a person to lead people in prayer, and I should then go along with some persons having a fagot of fuel with them to the people who have not attended the prayer (in congregation) and would burn their houses with fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ فِتْيَانِي أَنْ يَسْتَعِدُّوا لِي بِحُزَمٍ مِنْ حَطَبٍ ثُمَّ آمُرَ رَجُلاً يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ تُحَرَّقُ بُيُوتٌ عَلَى مَنْ فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laqad hamamtu aan amura fityaaniy aan yasta'idduwa liy bihuzamin min hatabin thumma amura rajulaan yusalliy bialnnaasi thumma tuharraqu buyuwtun 'alaa man fiyhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:This is what Abu Huraira reported to us from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and (in this connection) he narrated some ahadith, one of them is: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I intend that I should command my young men to gather bundles fuel for me, and then order a person to lead people in prayer, and then burn the houses with their inmates (who have not joined the congregation)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma 'an wakiy'in, 'an ja'fari bni burqaana, 'an yaziyda bni alaasammi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ binahwihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَخَلَّفُونَ عَنِ الْجُمُعَةِ ‏ "‏ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ رَجُلاً يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ أُحَرِّقَ عَلَى رِجَالٍ يَتَخَلَّفُونَ عَنِ الْجُمُعَةِ بُيُوتَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, 'an aabiy alaahwasi, sami'ahu minhu, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala liqawmin yatakhallafuwna 'ani aljumu'aai ‏ "‏ laqad hamamtu aan amura rajulaan yusalliy bialnnaasi thumma auharriqa 'alaa rijaalin yatakhallafuwna 'ani aljumu'aai buyuwtahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying about people who are absent from Jumu'a prayer:I intend that I should command a person to lead people in prayer, and then burn those persons who absent themselves from Jumu'a prayer in their houses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ الْفَزَارِيِّ، - قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا الْفَزَارِيُّ، - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ أَعْمَى فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِي قَائِدٌ يَقُودُنِي إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُرَخِّصَ لَهُ فَيُصَلِّيَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَرَخَّصَ لَهُ فَلَمَّا وَلَّى دَعَاهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَسْمَعُ النِّدَاءَ بِالصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَجِبْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wasuwaydu bnu sa'iydin, waya'quwbu alddawraqiyyu, kulluhum 'an marwaana alfazaariyyi, - qaala qutaybaau haddathanaa alfazaariyyu, - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni alaasammi, qaala haddathanaa yaziydu bnu alaasammi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun aa'maa faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnahu laysa liy qaaiidun yaquwduniy iilaa almasjidi ‏.‏ fasaaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yurakhhisa lahu fayusalliya fiy baytihi farakhhasa lahu falammaa wallaa da'aahu faqaala ‏"‏ hal tasma'u alnnidaa'a bialssalaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaajib ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:There came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a blind man and said: Messenger of Allah, I have no one to guide me to the mosque. He, therefore, asked. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permission to say prayer in his house. He (tee Holy Prophet) granted him permission. Then when the man turned away he called him and said: Do you hear the call to prayer? He said: Yes. He (the Prophet then) said: Respond to it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا وَمَا يَتَخَلَّفُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ إِلاَّ مُنَافِقٌ قَدْ عُلِمَ نِفَاقُهُ أَوْ مَرِيضٌ إِنْ كَانَ الْمَرِيضُ لَيَمْشِي بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ الصَّلاَةَ - وَقَالَ - إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَّمَنَا سُنَنَ الْهُدَى وَإِنَّ مِنْ سُنَنِ الْهُدَى الصَّلاَةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي يُؤَذَّنُ فِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'umayrin, 'an aabiy alaahwasi, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi laqad raaaytunaa wamaa yatakhallafu 'ani alssalaaai iilaaa munaafiqun qad 'ulima nifaaquhu aaw mariydun iin kaana almariydu layamshiy bayna rajulayni hattaa yaatiya alssalaaaa - waqaala - iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'allamanaa sunana alhudaa waiinna min sunani alhudaa alssalaaaa fiy almasjidi alladhiy yuuadhhanu fiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported:I have seen the time when no one stayed away from prayer except a hypocrite, whose hypocrisy was well known, or a sick man, but if a sick man could walk between two persons (i.e. with the help of two persons with one on each side) he would come to prayer. And (further) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) taught us the paths of right guidance, among which is prayer in the mosque in which the Adhan is called
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعُمَيْسِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الأَقْمَرِ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَلْقَى اللَّهَ غَدًا مُسْلِمًا فَلْيُحَافِظْ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ الصَّلَوَاتِ حَيْثُ يُنَادَى بِهِنَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَرَعَ لِنَبِيِّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُنَنَ الْهُدَى وَإِنَّهُنَّ مِنْ سُنَنِ الْهُدَى وَلَوْ أَنَّكُمْ صَلَّيْتُمْ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ كَمَا يُصَلِّي هَذَا الْمُتَخَلِّفُ فِي بَيْتِهِ لَتَرَكْتُمْ سُنَّةَ نَبِيِّكُمْ وَلَوْ تَرَكْتُمْ سُنَّةَ نَبِيِّكُمْ لَضَلَلْتُمْ وَمَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَتَطَهَّرُ فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ ثُمَّ يَعْمِدُ إِلَى مَسْجِدٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِلاَّ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ خَطْوَةٍ يَخْطُوهَا حَسَنَةً وَيَرْفَعُهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً وَيَحُطُّ عَنْهُ بِهَا سَيِّئَةً وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا وَمَا يَتَخَلَّفُ عَنْهَا إِلاَّ مُنَافِقٌ مَعْلُومُ النِّفَاقِ وَلَقَدْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ يُؤْتَى بِهِ يُهَادَى بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ حَتَّى يُقَامَ فِي الصَّفِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa alfadlu bnu dukaynin, 'an aabiy al'umaysi, 'an 'aliyyi bni alaaqmari, 'an aabiy alaahwasi, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala man sarrahu aan yalqaa alllaha ghadana muslimana falyuhaafiz 'alaa hauulaa'i alssalawaati haythu yunaadaa bihinna faiinna alllaha shara'a linabiyyikum sla allh 'lyh wslm sunana alhudaa waiinnahunna min sunani alhudaa walaw aannakum sallaytum fiy buyuwtikum kamaa yusalliy hadhaa almutakhallifu fiy baytihi lataraktum sunnaaa nabiyyikum walaw taraktum sunnaaa nabiyyikum ladalaltum wamaa min rajulin yatatahharu fayuhsinu alttuhuwra thumma ya'midu iilaa masjidin min hadhihi almasaajidi iilaaa kataba alllahu lahu bikulli khatwaain yakhtuwhaa hasanaaan wayarfa'uhu bihaa darajaaan wayahuttu 'anhu bihaa sayyiiaaan walaqad raaaytunaa wamaa yatakhallafu 'anhaa iilaaa munaafiqun ma'luwmu alnnifaaqi walaqad kaana alrrajulu yuutaa bihi yuhaadaa bayna alrrajulayni hattaa yuqaama fiy alssaffi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported:He who likes to meet Allah tomorrow as Muslim, he should persevere in observing these prayers, when a call is announced for them, for Allah has laid down for your Prophet the paths of right guidance, and these (prayers) are among the paths of right guidance. If you were to pray in your houses as this man why stays away (from the mosque) prays in his house, you would abandon the practice of your Prophet, and if you were to abandon the practice of your Prophet, you would go astray. No man purifies himself, doing it well, then makes for one of those mosques without Allah recording a blessing for him for every step he takes raising him a degree for it, and effacing a sin from him for it. I have seen the time when no one stayed away from it, except a hypocrite, who was well known for his hypocrisy, whereas a man would be brought swaying (due to weakness) between two men till he was set up in a row
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، عَنْ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، قَالَ كُنَّا قُعُودًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَأَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ يَمْشِي فَأَتْبَعَهُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ بَصَرَهُ حَتَّى خَرَجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَمَّا هَذَا فَقَدْ عَصَى أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an iibraahiyma bni almuhaajiri, 'an aabiy alshha'thaa'i, qaala kunnaa qu'uwdana fiy almasjidi ma'a aabiy hurayraaa faaadhhana almuuadhhinu faqaama rajulun mina almasjidi yamshiy faaatba'ahu aabuw hurayraaa basarahu hattaa kharaja mina almasjidi faqaala aabuw hurayraaa aammaa hadhaa faqad 'asaa aabaa alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sha'tha' reported:While we were sitting with Abu Huraira in a mosque a man went out of the mosque after the call to prayer had been announced. (A man stood up in the mosque and set off.) Abu Huraira's eyes followed him till he went out of the mosque. Upon this Abu Huraira said: This man has disobeyed Abu'l- Qasim (Muhammad) (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، - هُوَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ - عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ الْمُحَارِبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، وَرَأَى، رَجُلاً يَجْتَازُ الْمَسْجِدَ خَارِجًا بَعْدَ الأَذَانِ فَقَالَ أَمَّا هَذَا فَقَدْ عَصَى أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara almakkiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, - huwa abnu 'uyaynaaa - 'an 'umara bni sa'iydin, 'an aash'atha bni aabiy alshha'thaa'i almuhaaribiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, waraaaa, rajulaan yajtaazu almasjida khaarijana ba'da alaadhaani faqaala aammaa hadhaa faqad 'asaa aabaa alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sha'tha' al-Muharibi reported on the authority of his father, who said:I heard it from Abu Huraira that he saw a person getting out of the mosque after the call to prayer had been announced. Upon this he remarked: This (man) disobeyed Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ الْمَسْجِدَ بَعْدَ صَلاَةِ الْمَغْرِبِ فَقَعَدَ وَحْدَهُ فَقَعَدْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ صَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَامَ نِصْفَ اللَّيْلِ وَمَنْ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا صَلَّى اللَّيْلَ كُلَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa almughiyraau bnu salamaaa almakhzuwmiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - wahuwa abnu ziyaadin - haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu hakiymin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabiy 'amraaa, qaala dakhala 'uthmaanu bnu 'affaana almasjida ba'da salaaai almaghribi faqa'ada wahdahu faqa'adtu iilayhi faqaala yaa abna aakhiy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man sallaa al'ishaa'a fiy jamaa'aain fakaaannamaa qaama nisfa alllayli waman sallaa alssubha fiy jamaa'aain fakaaannamaa sallaa alllayla kullahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Abd 'Amr reported:'Uthman b. 'Affan (narrated the mosque after evening prayer and sat alone. I also sat alone with him, so he said: 0, son of my brother, I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: He who observed the 'Isha' prayer in congregation, it was as if he prayed up to midnight, and he who prayed the morning prayer in congregation, it was as if he prayed the whole night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَسَدِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaasadiyyu, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy sahlin, 'uthmaana bni hakiymin bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by the chain of transmitters by Abu Sahl 'Uthman b. Hakim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جُنْدَبَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ فَهُوَ فِي ذِمَّةِ اللَّهِ فَلاَ يَطْلُبَنَّكُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذِمَّتِهِ بِشَىْءٍ فَيُدْرِكَهُ فَيَكُبَّهُ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna mufaddalin - 'an khaalidin, 'an aanasi bni siyriyna, qaala sami'tu jundaba bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man sallaa alssubha fahuwa fiy dhimmaai alllahi falaa yatlubannakumu alllahu min dhimmatihi bishaa'in fayudrikahu fayakubbahu fiy naari jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jundab b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who prayed the morning prayer (in congregation) he is in fact under the protection of Allah. And it can never happen that Allah should demand anything from you in connection with the protection (that He guarantees) and one should not get it. He would then throw him in the fire of Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جُنْدَبًا الْقَسْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ صَلَّى صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ فَهْوَ فِي ذِمَّةِ اللَّهِ فَلاَ يَطْلُبَنَّكُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذِمَّتِهِ بِشَىْءٍ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يَطْلُبْهُ مِنْ ذِمَّتِهِ بِشَىْءٍ يُدْرِكْهُ ثُمَّ يَكُبَّهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an khaalidin, 'an aanasi bni siyriyna, qaala sami'tu jundabana alqasriyya, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man sallaa salaaaa alssubhi fahwa fiy dhimmaai alllahi falaa yatlubannakumu alllahu min dhimmatihi bishaa'in faiinnahu man yatlubhu min dhimmatihi bishaa'in yudrikhu thumma yakubbahu 'alaa wajhihi fiy naari jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Sirin reported:I heard Jundab b. Qasri saying that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who observed the morning prayer (in congregation), he is in fact under the protection of Allah and it never happens that Allah should make a demand in connection with the protection (that He guarantees and should not get it) for when he asks for anything in relation to His protection, he definitely secures it. He then throws him flatly in the Hell-fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ جُنْدَبِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏ "‏ فَيَكُبَّهُ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu haaruwna, 'an daawuda bni aabiy hindin, 'ani alhasani, 'an jundabi bni sufyaana, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa walam yadhkur ‏ "‏ fayakubbahu fiy naari jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Jundab b. Sufyan in from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with the same chain of transmitters, but this has not been mentioned:" He would throw him in fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ مَحْمُودَ بْنَ الرَّبِيعِ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عِتْبَانَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ وَهُوَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ أَنَّهُ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ أَنْكَرْتُ بَصَرِي وَأَنَا أُصَلِّي لِقَوْمِي وَإِذَا كَانَتِ الأَمْطَارُ سَالَ الْوَادِي الَّذِي بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ وَلَمْ أَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ آتِيَ مَسْجِدَهُمْ فَأُصَلِّيَ لَهُمْ وَدِدْتُ أَنَّكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تَأْتِي فَتُصَلِّي فِي مُصَلًّى ‏.‏ فَأَتَّخِذَهُ مُصَلًّى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَأَفْعَلُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عِتْبَانُ فَغَدَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ حِينَ ارْتَفَعَ النَّهَارُ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَذِنْتُ لَهُ فَلَمْ يَجْلِسْ حَتَّى دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ تُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ مِنْ بَيْتِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَشَرْتُ إِلَى نَاحِيَةٍ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَبَّرَ فَقُمْنَا وَرَاءَهُ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ - قَالَ - وَحَبَسْنَاهُ عَلَى خَزِيرٍ صَنَعْنَاهُ لَهُ - قَالَ - فَثَابَ رِجَالٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الدَّارِ حَوْلَنَا حَتَّى اجْتَمَعَ فِي الْبَيْتِ رِجَالٌ ذَوُو عَدَدٍ فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ أَيْنَ مَالِكُ بْنُ الدُّخْشُنِ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ ذَلِكَ مُنَافِقٌ لاَ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَقُلْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ أَلاَ تَرَاهُ قَدْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالُوا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّمَا نَرَى وَجْهَهُ وَنَصِيحَتَهُ لِلْمُنَافِقِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَ عَلَى النَّارِ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ يَبْتَغِي بِذَلِكَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُ الْحُصَيْنَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ - وَهُوَ أَحَدُ بَنِي سَالِمٍ وَهُوَ مِنْ سَرَاتِهِمْ - عَنْ حَدِيثِ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ فَصَدَّقَهُ بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna mahmuwda bna alrrabiy'i alaansaariyya, haddathahu aanna 'itbaana bna maalikin wahuwa min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mimman shahida badrana mina alaansaari aannahu aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy qad aankartu basariy waaanaa ausalliy liqawmiy waiidhaa kaanati alaamtaaru saala alwaadiy alladhiy bayniy wabaynahum walam aastati' aan atiya masjidahum faausalliya lahum wadidtu aannaka yaa rasuwla alllahi taatiy fatusalliy fiy musallana ‏.‏ faaattakhidhahu musallana ‏.‏ qaala faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ saaaf'alu iin shaa'a alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'itbaanu faghadaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin alssiddiyqu hiyna artafa'a alnnahaaru faastaadhana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaadhintu lahu falam yajlis hattaa dakhala albayta thumma qaala ‏"‏ aayna tuhibbu aan ausalliya min baytiki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaashartu iilaa naahiyaain mina albayti faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakabbara faqumnaa waraa'ahu fasallaa rak'atayni thumma sallama - qaala - wahabasnaahu 'alaa khaziyrin sana'naahu lahu - qaala - fathaaba rijaalun min aahli alddaari hawlanaa hattaa ajtama'a fiy albayti rijaalun dhawuw 'adadin faqaala qaaiilun minhum aayna maaliku bnu alddukhshuni faqaala ba'duhum dhalika munaafiqun laa yuhibbu alllaha warasuwlahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taqul lahu dhalika aalaa taraahu qad qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ yuriydu bidhalika wajha alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qaaluwa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala faiinnamaa naraa wajhahu wanasiyhatahu lilmunaafiqiyna ‏.‏ qaala faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faiinna alllaha qad harrama 'alaa alnnaari man qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏.‏ yabtaghiy bidhalika wajha alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin thumma saaaltu alhusayna bna muhammadin alaansaariyya - wahuwa aahadu baniy saalimin wahuwa min saraatihim - 'an hadiythi mahmuwdi bni alrrabiy'i fasaddaqahu bidhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mahmud b. al-Rabi' reported that 'Ibn b. Malik, who was one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and who participated in the (Battle of) Badr and was among the Ansar (of Medina), told that he came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said:Messenger of Allah, I have lost my eyesight and I lead my people in prayer. When there is a downpour there is then a current (of water) in the valley that stands between me and them and I find it impossible to go to their mosque and lead them in prayer. Messenger of Allah, I earnestly beg of you that you should come and observe prayer at a place of worship (in my house) so that I should then use it as a place of worship. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Well, it God so wills. I would soon do so. 'Itban said: On the following day when the day dawned, the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) came along with Abu Bakr at-Siddiq, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked permission (to get into the house). I gave him the permission, and be did not sit after entering the house, when he said: At what place in your house you desire me to say prayer? I ('Itban b. Malik) said: I pointed to a corner in the house, The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood (at that place for prayer) and pronounced Allah-o-Akbar (Allah is the Greatest) (as an expression for the commencement of prayer). We too stood behind him, and he said two rak'ahs and then pronounced salutation (marking the end of the prayer). We detained him (the Holy Prophet) for the meat curry we had prepared for, him. The people of the neighbouring houses came and thus there was a good gathering in (our house). One of them said: Where is Malik b. Dukhshun? Upon this one of them remarked: He is a hypocrite; he does not love Allah and His Messenger. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not say so about him. Don't you see that he utters La ilaha ill-Allah (There is no god but Allah) and seeks the pleasure of Allah through it? They said: Allah and His Messenger know beet. One (among the audience) said: We see his inclination and wellwishing for hypocrites only. Upon this the Messenger of Allah' (ﷺ) again said: Verily Allah has forbidden the Fire for one who says: There is no god but Allah, thereby seeking Allah's pleasure. Ibn Shihab said: I asked Husain b. Muhammad al-Ansar (he was one of the leaders of Banu Salim) about the hadith transmitted by Mahmud b. Rabi' and he testified it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَحْمُودُ بْنُ رَبِيعٍ، عَنْ عِتْبَانَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَيْنَ مَالِكُ بْنُ الدُّخْشُنِ أَوِ الدُّخَيْشِنِ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ مَحْمُودٌ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ نَفَرًا فِيهِمْ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ فَقَالَ مَا أَظُنُّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ مَا قُلْتَ - قَالَ - فَحَلَفْتُ إِنْ رَجَعْتُ إِلَى عِتْبَانَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ - قَالَ - فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا قَدْ ذَهَبَ بَصَرُهُ وَهُوَ إِمَامُ قَوْمِهِ فَجَلَسْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ فَحَدَّثَنِيهِ كَمَا حَدَّثَنِيهِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ ثُمَّ نَزَلَتْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَرَائِضُ وَأُمُورٌ نُرَى أَنَّ الأَمْرَ انْتَهَى إِلَيْهَا فَمَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ أَنْ لاَ يَغْتَرَّ فَلاَ يَغْتَرَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, qaala aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy mahmuwdu bnu rabiy'in, 'an 'itbaana bni maalikin, qaala aataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi yuwnusa ghayra aannahu qaala faqaala rajulun aayna maaliku bnu alddukhshuni aawi alddukhayshini wazaada fiy alhadiythi qaala mahmuwdun fahaddathtu bihadhaa alhadiythi nafarana fiyhim aabuw aayyuwba alaansaariyyu faqaala maa aazunnu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala maa qulta - qaala - fahalaftu iin raja'tu iilaa 'itbaana aan aasaalahu - qaala - faraja'tu iilayhi fawajadtuhu shaykhana kabiyrana qad dhahaba basaruhu wahuwa iimaamu qawmihi fajalastu iilaa janbihi fasaaaltuhu 'an hadhaa alhadiythi fahaddathaniyhi kamaa haddathaniyhi aawwala marraain ‏.‏ qaala alzzuhriyyu thumma nazalat ba'da dhalika faraaiidu waaumuwrun nuraa aanna alaamra antahaa iilayhaa famani astataa'a aan laa yaghtarra falaa yaghtarra ‏.‏
verses.translation: Itban b. Malik reported:I came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the rest of the hadith is the same as narrated (above) except this that a man said: Where is Malik b. Dukhshun or Dukhaishin, and also made this addition that Mahmud said: I narrated this ver hadith to many people and among them was Abu Ayyub al-Ansari who said: I cannot think that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) could have said so as you say. He (the narrator) said: I took an oath that if I ever go to 'Itban. I would ask him about it. So I went to him and found him to be a very aged man, having lost his eyesight, but he was the Imam of the people. I sat by his side and asked about this hadith and he narrated it In the same way as he had narrated it for the first time. Then so many other obligatory acts and commands were revealed which we see having been completed. So he who wants that he should not be deceived would not be deceived
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، قَالَ إِنِّي لأَعْقِلُ مَجَّةً مَجَّهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ دَلْوٍ فِي دَارِنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ مَحْمُودٌ فَحَدَّثَنِي عِتْبَانُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ بَصَرِي قَدْ سَاءَ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ فَصَلَّى بِنَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَحَبَسْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى جَشِيشَةٍ صَنَعْنَاهَا لَهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ مِنْ زِيَادَةِ يُونُسَ وَمَعْمَرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, qaala haddathaniy alzzuhriyyu, 'an mahmuwdi bni alrrabiy'i, qaala iinniy laa'qilu majjaaan majjahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min dalwin fiy daarinaa ‏.‏ qaala mahmuwdun fahaddathaniy 'itbaanu bnu maalikin qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna basariy qad saa'a ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha iilaa qawlihi fasallaa binaa rak'atayni wahabasnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa jashiyshaain sana'naahaa lahu ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu min ziyaadaai yuwnusa wama'marin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mahmud b. Rabi' reported:I well remember the disgorge of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that he did (with water) from a bucket of our house. Mahmud said: 'Itban b. Malik narrated it to me that he had said: Messenger of Allah, I have lost my eyesight, and the rest of the hadith is the same up to these words:" He led us in two rak'ahs of prayer and we detained the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) for serving him the pudding that we had prepared for him," and no mention has been made of what follows next from the addition made by Yunus and Ma'mar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ جَدَّتَهُ، مُلَيْكَةَ دَعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِطَعَامٍ صَنَعَتْهُ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُومُوا فَأُصَلِّيَ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى حَصِيرٍ لَنَا قَدِ اسْوَدَّ مِنْ طُولِ مَا لُبِسَ فَنَضَحْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ فَقَامَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَفَفْتُ أَنَا وَالْيَتِيمُ وَرَاءَهُ وَالْعَجُوزُ مِنْ وَرَائِنَا فَصَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna jaddatahu, mulaykaaa da'at rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lita'aamin sana'athu faaakala minhu thumma qaala ‏ "‏ quwmuwa faausalliya lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aanasu bnu maalikin faqumtu iilaa hasiyrin lanaa qadi aswadda min tuwli maa lubisa fanadahtuhu bimaa'in faqaama 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasafaftu aanaa waalyatiymu waraa'ahu waal'ajuwzu min waraaiinaa fasallaa lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rak'atayni thumma ansarafa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that his grandmother, Mulaika, invited the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) to a dinner which she had prepared. He (the Holy Prophet) ate out of that and then said:Stand up so that I should observe prayer (in order to bless) you Anas b. Malik said: I stood up on a mat (belonging to us) which had turned dark on account of its long use. I sprinkled water over it (in order to soften it), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood upon it, and I and an orphan formed a row behind him (the Holy Prophet) and the old woman was behind us, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in two rak'ahs of prayer and then went back
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ شَيْبَانُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا فَرُبَّمَا تَحْضُرُ الصَّلاَةُ وَهْوَ فِي بَيْتِنَا فَيَأْمُرُ بِالْبِسَاطِ الَّذِي تَحْتَهُ فَيُكْنَسُ ثُمَّ يُنْضَحُ ثُمَّ يَؤُمُّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَقُومُ خَلْفَهُ فَيُصَلِّي بِنَا وَكَانَ بِسَاطُهُمْ مِنْ جَرِيدِ النَّخْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, waaabuw alrrabiy'i, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alwaarithi, qaala shaybaanu haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahsana alnnaasi khuluqana farubbamaa tahduru alssalaaau wahwa fiy baytinaa fayaamuru bialbisaati alladhiy tahtahu fayuknasu thumma yundahu thumma yauummu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanaquwmu khalfahu fayusalliy binaa wakaana bisaatuhum min jariydi alnnakhli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wits the best among people in character. On occasions, the time of prayer would come while he was in our house. He would then order to spread the mat lying under him. That was dusted and then water was sprinkled over it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then led the prayer and we stood behind him, and that mat was made of the leaves of date-palm
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْنَا وَمَا هُوَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَأُمِّي وَأُمُّ حَرَامٍ خَالَتِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قُومُوا فَلأُصَلِّيَ بِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِ صَلاَةٍ فَصَلَّى بِنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لِثَابِتٍ أَيْنَ جَعَلَ أَنَسًا مِنْهُ قَالَ جَعَلَهُ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ دَعَا لَنَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ فَقَالَتْ أُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خُوَيْدِمُكَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَعَا لِي بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَكَانَ فِي آخِرِ مَا دَعَا لِي بِهِ أَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa haashimu bnu alqaasimi, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala dakhala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaynaa wamaa huwa iilaaa aanaa waaummiy waaummu haraamin khaalatiy faqaala ‏"‏ quwmuwa falausalliya bikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fiy ghayri waqti salaaain fasallaa binaa ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun lithaabitin aayna ja'ala aanasana minhu qaala ja'alahu 'alaa yamiynihi ‏.‏ thumma da'aa lanaa aahla albayti bikulli khayrin min khayri alddunyaa waalakhiraai faqaalat aummiy yaa rasuwla alllahi khuwaydimuka ad'u alllaha lahu ‏.‏ qaala fada'aa liy bikulli khayrin wakaana fiy akhiri maa da'aa liy bihi aan qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aakthir maalahu wawaladahu wabaarik lahu fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thabit reported on the authority of Anas:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came to us and there was none in our house but I, my mother and my aunt Umm Haram. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Stand up so that I may lead you in prayer (and there was no time for prescribed prayer). He led us in prayer. A person said to Thabit: Where stood Anas with him (the Holy Prophet)? He replied: He was on the right side. He then blessed us, the members of the household with every good of this world and of the Hereafter. My mother said: Messenger of Allah (and then, pointing towards Anas, said), here is your little servant, invoke the blessing of Allah upon him too. He then blessed me with every good, and he concluded his blessings for me (with these words): Allah! increase his wealth, and his children and make (them the source of) blessing for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُخْتَارِ، سَمِعَ مُوسَى بْنَ أَنَسٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى بِهِ وَبِأُمِّهِ أَوْ خَالَتِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَقَامَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَأَقَامَ الْمَرْأَةَ خَلْفَنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni almukhtaari, sami'a muwsaa bna aanasin, yuhaddithu 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa bihi wabiaummihi aaw khaalatihi ‏.‏ qaala faaaqaamaniy 'an yamiynihi waaaqaama almaraaaa khalfanaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. al-Mukhtar heard Musa b. Anas narrating on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led him, his mother or his aunt in prayer. He made me, stand on his right side and made the woman stand, behind us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'niy abna mahdiyyin - qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has also been narrated by Shu'ba with this chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي مَيْمُونَةُ، زَوْجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي وَأَنَا حِذَاءَهُ وَرُبَّمَا أَصَابَنِي ثَوْبُهُ إِذَا سَجَدَ وَكَانَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى خُمْرَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abbaadu bnu al'awwaami, kilaahumaa 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaddaadin, qaala haddathatniy maymuwnaau, zawju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy waaanaa hidhaa'ahu warubbamaa aasaabaniy thawbuhu iidhaa sajada wakaana yusalliy 'alaa khumraain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Maimuna, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said prayer while I was by his side, and at times when he prostrated his cloth touched me, and he prayed on a small mat
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ، أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدَهُ يُصَلِّي عَلَى حَصِيرٍ يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, jamiy'ana 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu, aannahu dakhala 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawajadahu yusalliy 'alaa hasiyrin yasjudu 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that he went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and found him observing prayer on a mat and prostrating on that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، - قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ تَزِيدُ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَصَلاَتِهِ فِي سُوقِهِ بِضْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ أَحَدَهُمْ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ أَتَى الْمَسْجِدَ لاَ يَنْهَزُهُ إِلاَّ الصَّلاَةُ لاَ يُرِيدُ إِلاَّ الصَّلاَةَ فَلَمْ يَخْطُ خَطْوَةً إِلاَّ رُفِعَ لَهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةٌ وَحُطَّ عَنْهُ بِهَا خَطِيئَةٌ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَإِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ كَانَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ مَا كَانَتِ الصَّلاَةُ هِيَ تَحْبِسُهُ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مَا دَامَ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ يَقُولُونَ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيْهِ مَا لَمْ يُؤْذِ فِيهِ مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, - qaala aabuw kuraybin haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, - 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ salaaau alrrajuli fiy jamaa'aain taziydu 'alaa salaatihi fiy baytihi wasalaatihi fiy suwqihi bid'ana wa'ishriyna darajaaan wadhalika aanna aahadahum iidhaa tawaddaaa faaahsana alwuduw'a thumma aataa almasjida laa yanhazuhu iilaaa alssalaaau laa yuriydu iilaaa alssalaaaa falam yakhtu khatwaaan iilaaa rufi'a lahu bihaa darajaaun wahutta 'anhu bihaa khatiyiaaun hattaa yadkhula almasjida faiidhaa dakhala almasjida kaana fiy alssalaaai maa kaanati alssalaaau hiya tahbisuhu waalmalaaiikaau yusalluwna 'alaa aahadikum maa daama fiy majlisihi alladhiy sallaa fiyhi yaquwluwna alllahumma arhamhu alllahumma aghfir lahu alllahumma tub 'alayhi maa lam yuudhi fiyhi maa lam yuhdith fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A man's prayer in congregation is more valuable than twenty degrees and some above them as compared with his prayer in his house and his market, for when he performs ablution doing it well, then goes out to the mosque, and he is impelled (to do so) only by (the love of congregational) prayer, he has no other objective before him but prayer. He does not take a step without being raised a degree for it and having a sin remitted for it, till he enters the mosque, and when he is busy in prayer after having entered the mosque. the angels continue to invoke blessing on him as long as he is in his place of worship. saying: O Allah, show him mercy, and pardon him! Accept his repentance (and the angels continue this supplication for him) so long as he does not do any harm in it, or as long as his ablution is not broken
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِ مَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abtharun, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu bakkaari bni alrrayyaani, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu zakariyyaa'a, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bimithli ma'naahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith having the same meaning (as mentioned above) has been transmitted by A'mash
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مَا دَامَ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ وَأَحَدُكُمْ فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا كَانَتِ الصَّلاَةُ تَحْبِسُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba alssakhtiyaaniyyi, 'ani abni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna almalaaiikaaa tusalliy 'alaa aahadikum maa daama fiy majlisihi taquwlu alllahumma aghfir lahu alllahumma arhamhu maa lam yuhdith waaahadukum fiy salaaain maa kaanati alssalaaau tahbisuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The angels invoke blessings on everyone among you so long as he is in a place of worship with these words: O Allah! pardon him, O Allah, have mercy upon him, (and they continue to do so) as long as, he ablution (of the worshipper) is not broken, and one among you is in prayer and so long as he is detained for the prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزَالُ الْعَبْدُ فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا كَانَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ يَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلاَةَ وَتَقُولُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ ‏.‏ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ أَوْ يُحْدِثَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا يُحْدِثُ قَالَ يَفْسُو أَوْ يَضْرِطُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yazaalu al'abdu fiy salaaain maa kaana fiy musalaaahu yantaziru alssalaaaa wataquwlu almalaaiikaau alllahumma aghfir lahu alllahumma arhamhu ‏.‏ hattaa yansarifa aaw yuhditha ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu maa yuhdithu qaala yafsuw aaw yadritu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The servant is constantly in prayer so long as he is in a place of worship waiting for the prayer (to be observed in congregation), and the angels invoke (blessings upon him in these words): O Allah! pardon him. O Allah! show mercy to him, (and they continue to do so) till he returns (from the mosque having completed the prayer) or his ablution breaks. I said: How is the ablution broken? He said: By breaking of the wind noiselessly or with noise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
