verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna almughiyraai - haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni rabaahin, 'an aabiy qataadaaa, qaala khatabanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ iinnakum tasiyruwna 'ashiyyatakum walaylatakum wataatuwna almaa'a iin shaa'a alllahu ghadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faantalaqa alnnaasu laa yalwiy aahadun 'alaa aahadin - qaala aabuw qataadaaa - fabaynamaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasiyru hattaa abhaarra alllaylu waaanaa iilaa janbihi - qaala - fana'asa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm famaala 'an raahilatihi faaataytuhu fada'amtuhu min ghayri aan auwqizahu hattaa a'tadala 'alaa raahilatihi - qaala - thumma saara hattaa tahawwara alllaylu maala 'an raahilatihi - qaala - fada'amtuhu min ghayri aan auwqizahu hattaa a'tadala 'alaa raahilatihi - qaala - thumma saara hattaa iidhaa kaana min akhiri alssahari maala maylaaan hiya aashaddu mina almaylatayni alauwlayayni hattaa kaada yanjafilu faaataytuhu fada'amtuhu farafa'a raasahu faqaala ‏"‏ man hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu aabuw qataadaaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ mataa kaana hadhaa masiyraka minniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu maa zaala hadhaa masiyriy mundhu alllaylaai ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hafizaka alllahu bimaa hafizta bihi nabiyyahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ hal taraanaa nakhfaa 'alaa alnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ hal taraa min aahadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu hadhaa raakibun ‏.‏ thumma qultu hadhaa raakibun akharu ‏.‏ hattaa ajtama'naa fakunnaa sab'aaa rakbin - qaala - famaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alttariyqi fawada'a raasahu thumma qaala ‏"‏ ahfazuwa 'alaynaa salaatanaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakaana aawwala mani astayqaza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalshhamsu fiy zahrihi - qaala - faqumnaa fazi'iyna thumma qaala ‏"‏ arkabuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ farakibnaa fasirnaa hattaa iidhaa artafa'ati alshhamsu nazala thumma da'aa bimiydaaaain kaanat ma'iy fiyhaa shaa'un min maa'in - qaala - fatawaddaaa minhaa wuduw'ana duwna wuduw'in - qaala - wabaqiya fiyhaa shaa'un min maa'in thumma qaala laabiy qataadaaa ‏"‏ ahfaz 'alaynaa miydaaataka fasayakuwnu lahaa nabaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aadhhana bilaalun bialssalaaai fasallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rak'atayni thumma sallaa alghadaaaa fasana'a kamaa kaana yasna'u kulla yawmin - qaala - warakiba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm warakibnaa ma'ahu - qaala - faja'ala ba'dunaa yahmisu iilaa ba'din maa kaffaaraau maa sana'naa bitafriytinaa fiy salaatinaa thumma qaala ‏"‏ aamaa lakum fiyya auswaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ aamaa iinnahu laysa fiy alnnawmi tafriytun iinnamaa alttafriytu 'alaa man lam yusalli alssalaaaa hattaa yajiy'a waqtu alssalaaai alaukhraa faman fa'ala dhalika falyusallihaa hiyna yantabihu lahaa faiidhaa kaana alghadu falyusallihaa 'inda waqtihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ maa tarawna alnnaasa sana'uwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma qaala ‏"‏ aasbaha alnnaasu faqaduwa nabiyyahum faqaala aabuw bakrin wa'umaru rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'dakum lam yakun liyukhallifakum ‏.‏ waqaala alnnaasu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna aaydiykum faiin yutiy'uwa aabaa bakrin wa'umara yarshuduwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faantahaynaa iilaa alnnaasi hiyna amtadda alnnahaaru wahamiya kullu shaa'in wahum yaquwluwna yaa rasuwla alllahi halaknaa 'atishnaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa hulka 'alaykum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ aatliquwa liy ghumariy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wada'aa bialmiydaaaai faja'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasubbu waaabuw qataadaaa yasqiyhim falam ya'du aan raaaa alnnaasu maa'an fiy almiydaaaai takaabbuwa 'alayhaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aahsinuwa almalaa kullukum sayarwaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fafa'aluwa faja'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasubbu waaasqiyhim hattaa maa baqiya ghayriy waghayru rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - thumma sabba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala liy ‏"‏ ashrab ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu laa aashrabu hattaa tashraba yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ iinna saaqiya alqawmi akhiruhum shurbana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fasharibtu washariba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - faaataa alnnaasu almaa'a jaammiyna riwaa'an ‏.‏ qaala faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu rabaahin iinniy lauhaddithu hadhaa alhadiytha fiy masjidi aljaami'i iidh qaala 'imraanu bnu husaynin anzur aayyuhaa alfataa kayfa tuhaddithu faiinniy aahadu alrrakbi tilka alllaylaaa ‏.‏ qaala qultu faaanta aa'lamu bialhadiythi ‏.‏ faqaala mimman aanta qultu mina alaansaari ‏.‏ qaala haddith faaantum aa'lamu bihadiythikum ‏.‏ qaala fahaddathtu alqawma faqaala 'imraanu laqad shahidtu tilka alllaylaaa wamaa sha'artu aanna aahadana hafizahu kamaa hafiztuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatida reported:The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) addressed us and said: You would travel In the evening and the might till (God willing) you would come in the morning to a place of water. So the people travelled (self absorbed) without paying any heed to one another, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also travelled till It was midnight. I was by his side. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to doze and leaned (to one side) of his camel. I came to him and I lent him support without awaking him till he sat poised on his ride. He went on travelling till a major part of the night was over and (he again) leaned (to one side) of his camel. I supported him without awaking him till he sat" bed on his ride. and then travelled till it was near dawn. He (again) leaned which was far more inclined than the two earlier leanings and he was about to fall down. So I came to him and supported him and he lifted his head and said; Who is this? I said: it is Abu Qatida. He (the Prophet again) said: Since how long have you been travelling along with me like this? I said: I have been travelling in this very state since the night. He said: May Allah protect you, as you have protected His Apostle (from falling down), and again said: Do you see that we are hidden from the people? - and again said: Do you see anyone? I said: Here is a rider. I again said: Here Is another rider till we gathered together and we were seven riders. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stepped aside of the highway and placed his head (for sleep and said): Guard for us our prayers. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was the first to wake up and the rays of the sun were falling on his back. We got up startled He (the Holy Prophet) said: Ride on So we rode on till the sun had (sufficiently) risen. He then came down from his camel and called for a jug of water which I had with me. There was a little water in that. He performed ablution with that which was less thorough as compared with his usual ablutions and some water of that had been left. He (the Holy Prophet) said to Abu Qatida: Keep a watch over your jug of water; it would have (a miraculous) condition about it. Then Bilal summoned (people) to prayer and then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed two rak'ahs and then said the morning prayer as he said every day. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (then) rode on and we rode along with him and some of us whispered to the others saying: How would there be compensation for omission in our prayers? Upon this he (the Messenger of Allah) said: Is there not in me (my life) a model for you? There is no omission in sleeping. The (cognizable) emission is that one should not say prayer (intentionally) till the time of the other prayer comes. So he who did like it (omitted prayer in sleep or due to other unavoidable circumstances) should say prayer when he becomes aware of it and on the next day he should observe it at its prescribed time. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What do you think the people would have done (at this hour)? They would have in the morning found their Apostle missing from amongst them and then Abu Bakr and 'Umar would have told them that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) must be behind you, he cannot leave you behind (him), but the people said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) is ahead of you. So if you had obeyed Abu Bakr and Umar, you would have gone on the right path. So we proceeded on till we came up to the people (from whom we had lagged behind) and the day had considerably risen and everything became hot, and they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Messenger of Allah, we are dying of thirst. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) remarked: There is no destruction for you. And again said: Bring that small cup of mine and he then asked for the jug of water to be brought to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to pour water (in that small cup) and Abu Qatida gave them to drink. And when the people saw that there was (a little) water in the jug, they fell upon it. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Behave well; the water (is enough) to satiate all of you. Then they (the Companions) began to receive (their share of) water with calmness (without showing any anxiety) and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to fill (the cap), and I began to serve them till no one was left except me and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He then filled (the cup) with water and said to me: Drink it. I said: Messenger of Allah, I would not drink till you drink. Upon this he said: The server of the people Is the last among them to drink. So I drank and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also drank and the people came to the place of water quite happy and satiated. 'Abdullah b. Rabah said: I am going to narrate this hadith in the great mosque, when 'Imran b. Husain said: See, O young man, how will you narrate for I was also one of the riders on that night? I said: So you must be knowing this hadith well. He said: Who are you? I said: I am one of the Ansar. Upon this he said: You narrate, for you know your hadith better. I, therefore, narrated it to the people. 'Imran said: I was also present that night, but I know not anyone else who learnt it so well as you have learnt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلْمُ بْنُ زَرِيرٍ الْعُطَارِدِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيَّ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَسِيرٍ لَهُ فَأَدْلَجْنَا لَيْلَتَنَا حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ فِي وَجْهِ الصُّبْحِ عَرَّسْنَا فَغَلَبَتْنَا أَعْيُنُنَا حَتَّى بَزَغَتِ الشَّمْسُ - قَالَ - فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنَّا أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَكُنَّا لاَ نُوقِظُ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ مَنَامِهِ إِذَا نَامَ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ عُمَرُ فَقَامَ عِنْدَ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَعَلَ يُكَبِّرُ وَيَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ وَرَأَى الشَّمْسَ قَدْ بَزَغَتْ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْتَحِلُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَارَ بِنَا حَتَّى إِذَا ابْيَضَّتِ الشَّمْسُ نَزَلَ فَصَلَّى بِنَا الْغَدَاةَ فَاعْتَزَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ لَمْ يُصَلِّ مَعَنَا فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا فُلاَنُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ مَعَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ أَصَابَتْنِي جَنَابَةٌ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَيَمَّمَ بِالصَّعِيدِ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ عَجَّلَنِي فِي رَكْبٍ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ نَطْلُبُ الْمَاءَ وَقَدْ عَطِشْنَا عَطَشًا شَدِيدًا ‏.‏ فَبَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ نَسِيرُ إِذَا نَحْنُ بِامْرَأَةٍ سَادِلَةٍ رِجْلَيْهَا بَيْنَ مَزَادَتَيْنِ فَقُلْنَا لَهَا أَيْنَ الْمَاءُ قَالَتْ أَيْهَاهْ أَيْهَاهْ لاَ مَاءَ لَكُمْ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا فَكَمْ بَيْنَ أَهْلِكِ وَبَيْنَ الْمَاءِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ مَسِيرَةُ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا انْطَلِقِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَلَمْ نُمَلِّكْهَا مِنْ أَمْرِهَا شَيْئًا حَتَّى انْطَلَقْنَا بِهَا فَاسْتَقْبَلْنَا بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهَا فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ مِثْلَ الَّذِي أَخْبَرَتْنَا وَأَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا مُوتِمَةٌ لَهَا صِبْيَانٌ أَيْتَامٌ فَأَمَرَ بِرَاوِيَتِهَا فَأُنِيخَتْ فَمَجَّ فِي الْعَزْلاَوَيْنِ الْعُلْيَاوَيْنِ ثُمَّ بَعَثَ بِرَاوِيَتِهَا فَشَرِبْنَا وَنَحْنُ أَرْبَعُونَ رَجُلاً عِطَاشٌ حَتَّى رَوِينَا وَمَلأْنَا كُلَّ قِرْبَةٍ مَعَنَا وَإِدَاوَةٍ وَغَسَّلْنَا صَاحِبَنَا غَيْرَ أَنَّا لَمْ نَسْقِ بَعِيرًا وَهِيَ تَكَادُ تَنْضَرِجُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ - يَعْنِي الْمَزَادَتَيْنِ - ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَاتُوا مَا كَانَ عِنْدَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَمَعْنَا لَهَا مِنْ كِسَرٍ وَتَمْرٍ وَصَرَّ لَهَا صُرَّةً فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ اذْهَبِي فَأَطْعِمِي هَذَا عِيَالَكِ وَاعْلَمِي أَنَّا لَمْ نَرْزَأْ مِنْ مَائِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَتَتْ أَهْلَهَا قَالَتْ لَقَدْ لَقِيتُ أَسْحَرَ الْبَشَرِ أَوْ إِنَّهُ لَنَبِيٌّ كَمَا زَعَمَ كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ ذَيْتَ وَذَيْتَ ‏.‏ فَهَدَى اللَّهُ ذَاكَ الصِّرْمَ بِتِلْكَ الْمَرْأَةِ فَأَسْلَمَتْ وَأَسْلَمُوا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu sa'iydi bni sakhrin alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi almajiydi, haddathanaa salmu bnu zariyrin al'utaaridiyyu, qaala sami'tu aabaa rajaa'in al'utaaridiyya, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, qaala kuntu ma'a nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy masiyrin lahu faaadlajnaa laylatanaa hattaa iidhaa kaana fiy wajhi alssubhi 'arrasnaa faghalabatnaa aa'yununaa hattaa bazaghati alshhamsu - qaala - fakaana aawwala mani astayqaza minnaa aabuw bakrin wakunnaa laa nuwqizu nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min manaamihi iidhaa naama hattaa yastayqiza thumma astayqaza 'umaru faqaama 'inda nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faja'ala yukabbiru wayarfa'u sawtahu bialttakbiyri hattaa astayqaza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa rafa'a raasahu waraaaa alshhamsa qad bazaghat qaala ‏"‏ artahiluwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasaara binaa hattaa iidhaa abyaddati alshhamsu nazala fasallaa binaa alghadaaaa faa'tazala rajulun mina alqawmi lam yusalli ma'anaa falammaa ansarafa qaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa fulaanu maa mana'aka aan tusalliya ma'anaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala yaa nabiyya alllahi aasaabatniy janaabaaun ‏.‏ faaamarahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatayammama bialssa'iydi fasallaa thumma 'ajjalaniy fiy rakbin bayna yadayhi natlubu almaa'a waqad 'atishnaa 'atashana shadiydana ‏.‏ fabaynamaa nahnu nasiyru iidhaa nahnu biamraaaain saadilaain rijlayhaa bayna mazaadatayni faqulnaa lahaa aayna almaa'u qaalat aayhaah aayhaah laa maa'a lakum ‏.‏ qulnaa fakam bayna aahliki wabayna almaa'i ‏.‏ qaalat masiyraau yawmin walaylaain ‏.‏ qulnaa antaliqiy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaalat wamaa rasuwlu alllahi falam numallikhaa min aamrihaa shayiana hattaa antalaqnaa bihaa faastaqbalnaa bihaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahaa faaakhbarathu mithla alladhiy aakhbaratnaa waaakhbarathu aannahaa muwtimaaun lahaa sibyaanun aaytaamun faaamara biraawiyatihaa faauniykhat famajja fiy al'azlaawayni al'ulyaawayni thumma ba'atha biraawiyatihaa fasharibnaa wanahnu aarba'uwna rajulaan 'itaashun hattaa rawiynaa wamalanaa kulla qirbaain ma'anaa waiidaawaain waghassalnaa saahibanaa ghayra aannaa lam nasqi ba'iyrana wahiya takaadu tandariju mina almaa'i - ya'niy almazaadatayni - thumma qaala ‏"‏ haatuwa maa kaana 'indakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fajama'naa lahaa min kisarin watamrin wasarra lahaa surraaan faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ adhhabiy faaat'imiy hadhaa 'iyaalaki waa'lamiy aannaa lam narzaa min maaiiki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa aatat aahlahaa qaalat laqad laqiytu aashara albashari aaw iinnahu lanabiyyun kamaa za'ama kaana min aamrihi dhayta wadhayta ‏.‏ fahadaa alllahu dhaaka alssirma bitilka almaraaai faaaslamat waaaslamuwa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported:I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey. We travelled the whole of the night, and when it was about to dawn, we got down for rest, and were overpowered (by sleep) till the sun shone. Abu Bakr was the first to awake amongst us. and we did not awake the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from his sleep allowing him to wake up (of his own accord). It was 'Umar who then woke up. He stood by the side of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and recited takbir in a loud voice till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) woke up. When he lifted his head, he saw that the sun had arisen; he then said: Proceed on. He travelled along with us till the sun shone brightly. He came down (from his camel) and led us in the morning prayer. A person, however, remained away from the people and did not say, prayer along with us. After having completed the prayer, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: O, so and so, what prevented you from observing prayer with us? He said: Apostle of Allah! I was not in a state of purity. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered him arid lie performed Tayammum with dust and said prayer. He then urged me to go ahead immediately along with other riders to find out water, for we felt very thirsty. We were traveling when we came across a woman who was sitting (on a camel) with her feet hanging over two leathern water bags. We said to her: How far is water available? She, said: Far, very far, very far. You cannot get water. We (again) said: How much distance is there between (the residence of) your family and water? She said: It is a day and night journey. We said to her: You go to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: Who is the Messenger of Allah? We somehow or the other managed to bring her to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he asked about her, and she informed him as she had informed us that she was a widow having orphan children. He ordered that her camel should be made to kneal down and he gargled in the opening (of her leathern water-bag). The camel was then raised up and we forty thirsty men drank water till we were completely satiated, and we filled up all leathern water-bags and water-skins that we had with us and we washed our companions, but we did not make any camel drink, and (the leathern water-bags) were about to burst (on account of excess of water). He then said: Bring whatever you have with you. So we collected the bits (of estable things) and dates and packed them up in a bundle, and said to her: Take it away. This is meant for your children, and know that we have not its any way done any loss to your water. W hen she came to her family she said: I have met the greatest magician amongst human beings, or he is an apostle, as he claims to be, and she then narrated what had happened and Allah guided aright those people through that woman. She affirmed her faith in Islam and so did the people embrace Islam
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفُ بْنُ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيِّ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَسَرَيْنَا لَيْلَةً حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ قُبَيْلَ الصُّبْحِ وَقَعْنَا تِلْكَ الْوَقْعَةَ الَّتِي لاَ وَقْعَةَ عِنْدَ الْمُسَافِرِ أَحْلَى مِنْهَا فَمَا أَيْقَظَنَا إِلاَّ حَرُّ الشَّمْسِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ سَلْمِ بْنِ زَرِيرٍ وَزَادَ وَنَقَصَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَرَأَى مَا أَصَابَ النَّاسَ وَكَانَ أَجْوَفَ جَلِيدًا فَكَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِشِدَّةِ صَوْتِهِ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَكَوْا إِلَيْهِ الَّذِي أَصَابَهُمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ ضَيْرَ ارْتَحِلُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, haddathanaa 'awfu bnu aabiy jamiylaaa alaa'raabiyyu, 'an aabiy rajaa'in al'utaaridiyyi, 'an 'imraana bni alhusayni, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin fasaraynaa laylaaan hattaa iidhaa kaana min akhiri alllayli qubayla alssubhi waqa'naa tilka alwaq'aaa allatiy laa waq'aaa 'inda almusaafiri aahlaa minhaa famaa aayqazanaa iilaaa harru alshhamsi ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythi salmi bni zariyrin wazaada wanaqasa ‏.‏ waqaala fiy alhadiythi falammaa astayqaza 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi waraaaa maa aasaaba alnnaasa wakaana aajwafa jaliydana fakabbara warafa'a sawtahu bialttakbiyri hattaa astayqaza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lishiddaai sawtihi bialttakbiyri falammaa astayqaza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shakawa iilayhi alladhiy aasaabahum faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa dayra artahiluwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported:We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a journey and we travelled throughout the night till at the end, just before dawn, we lay down (for rest), and nothing is sweeter for a traveller than this and none awakened us but the heat of the sun, and the rest of the hadith is the same (as mentioned above) except this additien:" When 'Umar b. Khattab woke up, he saw what had happened to the people. And he was a man having a big belly and strongly built; he recited takbir in a loud voice till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) woke up by the loudness of his voice in takbir. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got up, the people told him what had happened. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is no harm; you better proceed further," and (the rest of the hadith) was narrated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَعَرَّسَ بِلَيْلٍ اضْطَجَعَ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ وَإِذَا عَرَّسَ قُبَيْلَ الصُّبْحِ نَصَبَ ذِرَاعَهُ وَوَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ عَلَى كَفِّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an humaydin, 'an bakri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni rabaahin, 'an aabiy qataadaaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa kaana fiy safarin fa'arrasa bilaylin adtaja'a 'alaa yamiynihi waiidhaa 'arrasa qubayla alssubhi nasaba dhiraa'ahu wawada'a raasahu 'alaa kaffihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in a journey he got down for rest at night, and he used to lie down on his right side, and when he lay down for rest before the dawn, he used to stretch his forearm and place his head over his palm
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلاَةً فَلْيُصَلِّهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا لاَ كَفَّارَةَ لَهَا إِلاَّ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ لِذِكْرِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man nasiya salaaaan falyusallihaa iidhaa dhakarahaa laa kaffaaraaa lahaa iilaaa dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qataadaau waaaqimi alssalaaaa lidhikriy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qatada reported from Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:He who forgets the prayer should say it when he remembers it, there is no explation for it, except this. Qatada said: (Allah says)" And observe prayer for remembrance of Me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏ "‏ لاَ كَفَّارَةَ لَهَا إِلاَّ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wasa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy 'awaanaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm walam yadhkur ‏ "‏ laa kaffaaraaa lahaa iilaaa dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada, but here no mention has been made of" There is no explation for it except this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلاَةً أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا فَكَفَّارَتُهَا أَنْ يُصَلِّيَهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man nasiya salaaaan aaw naama 'anhaa fakaffaaratuhaa aan yusalliyahaa iidhaa dhakarahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qatada narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:He who forgets the prayer, or he slept (and it was omitted), its expiation is (only) that he should observe it when he remembers it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 5 — The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَقَدَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ أَوْ غَفَلَ عَنْهَا فَلْيُصَلِّهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ لِذِكْرِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa almuthannaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa raqada aahadukum 'ani alssalaaai aaw ghafala 'anhaa falyusallihaa iidhaa dhakarahaa faiinna alllaha yaquwlu aaqimi alssalaaaa lidhikriy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qatada reported it on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:When any one of you omits the prayer due to sleep or he forgets it, he should observe it when he remembers it, for Allah has said:" Observe prayer for remembrance of Me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ فُرِضَتِ الصَّلاَةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي الْحَضَرِ وَالسَّفَرِ فَأُقِرَّتْ صَلاَةُ السَّفَرِ وَزِيدَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْحَضَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat furidati alssalaaau rak'atayni rak'atayni fiy alhadari waalssafari faauqirrat salaaau alssafari waziyda fiy salaaai alhadari ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported:The prayer was prescribed as two rak'ahs, two rak'ahs both in journey and at the place of residence. The prayer while travelling remained as it was (originally prescribed), but an addition was made in the prayer (observed) at the place of residence
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ الصَّلاَةَ حِينَ فَرَضَهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ أَتَمَّهَا فِي الْحَضَرِ فَأُقِرَّتْ صَلاَةُ السَّفَرِ عَلَى الْفَرِيضَةِ الأُولَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat farada alllahu alssalaaaa hiyna faradahaa rak'atayni thumma aatammahaa fiy alhadari faauqirrat salaaau alssafari 'alaa alfariydaai alauwlaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said Allah prescribed the prayer as two rak'ahs, then it was completed (to four rak'ahs) at the place of residence, but was retained in the same position in journey as it was first made obligatory
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ الصَّلاَةَ، أَوَّلَ مَا فُرِضَتْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَأُقِرَّتْ صَلاَةُ السَّفَرِ وَأُتِمَّتْ صَلاَةُ الْحَضَرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ فَقُلْتُ لِعُرْوَةَ مَا بَالُ عَائِشَةَ تُتِمُّ فِي السَّفَرِ قَالَ إِنَّهَا تَأَوَّلَتْ كَمَا تَأَوَّلَ عُثْمَانُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alssalaaaa, aawwala maa furidat rak'atayni faauqirrat salaaau alssafari waautimmat salaaau alhadari ‏.‏ qaala alzzuhriyyu faqultu li'urwaaa maa baalu 'aaiishaaa tutimmu fiy alssafari qaala iinnahaa taaawwalat kamaa taaawwala 'uthmaanu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The prayer was prescribed as consisting of two rak'ahs, the prayer in travelling remained the same, but the prayer at the place of residence was completed. (Zuhri said he asked 'Urwa why 'A'isha said prayer in the complete form during journey, and he replied that she interpreted the matter herself as 'Uthman did)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَابَيْهِ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ‏{‏ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ تَقْصُرُوا، مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ إِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَنْ يَفْتِنَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا‏}‏ فَقَدْ أَمِنَ النَّاسُ فَقَالَ عَجِبْتُ مِمَّا عَجِبْتَ مِنْهُ فَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ صَدَقَةٌ تَصَدَّقَ اللَّهُ بِهَا عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْبَلُوا صَدَقَتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin wazuhayru bnu harbin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'ani abni aabiy 'ammaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni baabayhi, 'an ya'laa bni aumayyaaa, qaala qultu li'umara bni alkhattaabi ‏{‏ laysa 'alaykum junaahun aan taqsuruwa, mina alssalaaai iin khiftum aan yaftinakumu alladhiyna kafaruwa‏}‏ faqad aamina alnnaasu faqaala 'ajibtu mimmaa 'ajibta minhu fasaaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ sadaqaaun tasaddaqa alllahu bihaa 'alaykum faaqbaluwa sadaqatahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yahya b. Umayya said:I told 'Umar b. al-Khattab that Allah had said:" You may shorten the prayer only if you fear that those who are unbelievers may afflict you" (Qur'an, iv. 101), whereas the people are now safe. He replied: I wondered about it in the same way as you wonder about it, so I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it and he said: It is an act of charity which Allah has done to you, so accept His charity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَابَيْهِ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy 'ammaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni baabayhi, 'an ya'laa bni aumayyaaa, qaala qultu li'umara bni alkhattaabi ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni iidriysa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ya'la b. Umayya reported:I said to 'Umar b. al-Khattab, and the rest of the hadlth is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَخْنَسِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ الصَّلاَةَ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْحَضَرِ أَرْبَعًا وَفِي السَّفَرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَفِي الْخَوْفِ رَكْعَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wasa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an bukayri bni alaakhnasi, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala farada alllahu alssalaaaa 'alaa lisaani nabiyyikum sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alhadari aarba'ana wafiy alssafari rak'atayni wafiy alkhawfi rak'aaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:Allah has prescribed the prayer through the word of your Prophet (ﷺ) as four rak'ahs when resident, two when travelling, and one when danger is present
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، - قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا قَاسِمُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ الْمُزَنِيُّ، - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ عَائِذٍ الطَّائِيُّ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَخْنَسِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَرَضَ الصَّلاَةَ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمُسَافِرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَعَلَى الْمُقِيمِ أَرْبَعًا وَفِي الْخَوْفِ رَكْعَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, jamiy'ana 'ani alqaasimi bni maalikin, - qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa qaasimu bnu maalikin almuzaniyyu, - haddathanaa aayyuwbu bnu 'aaiidhin alttaaiiyyu, 'an bukayri bni alaakhnasi, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala iinna alllaha farada alssalaaaa 'alaa lisaani nabiyyikum sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa almusaafiri rak'atayni wa'alaa almuqiymi aarba'ana wafiy alkhawfi rak'aaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:Allah has prescribed the prayer by the tongue of your Apostle (ﷺ) as two rak'ahs for the traveller, four for the resident, and one in danger
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ سَلَمَةَ الْهُذَلِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ كَيْفَ أُصَلِّي إِذَا كُنْتُ بِمَكَّةَ إِذَا لَمْ أُصَلِّ مَعَ الإِمَامِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ سُنَّةَ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an muwsaa bni salamaaa alhudhaliyyi, qaala saaaltu abna 'abbaasin kayfa ausalliy iidhaa kuntu bimakkaaa iidhaa lam ausalli ma'a aliimaami ‏.‏ faqaala rak'atayni sunnaaa aabiy alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Musa b. Salama Hudhali said:I asked Ibn 'Abbas: How should I say prayer when I am in Mecca, and when I do not pray along with the Imam? He said: Two rak'ahs (of prayer) is the Sunnah of Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu minhaalin alddariyru, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa aabiy jamiy'ana, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Qatada with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ - قَالَ - فَصَلَّى لَنَا الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ وَأَقْبَلْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى جَاءَ رَحْلَهُ وَجَلَسَ وَجَلَسْنَا مَعَهُ فَحَانَتْ مِنْهُ الْتِفَاتَةٌ نَحْوَ حَيْثُ صَلَّى فَرَأَى نَاسًا قِيَامًا فَقَالَ مَا يَصْنَعُ هَؤُلاَءِ قُلْتُ يُسَبِّحُونَ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَوْ كُنْتُ مُسَبِّحًا لأَتْمَمْتُ صَلاَتِي يَا ابْنَ أَخِي إِنِّي صَحِبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي السَّفَرِ فَلَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى قَبَضَهُ اللَّهُ وَصَحِبْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى قَبَضَهُ اللَّهُ وَصَحِبْتُ عُمَرَ فَلَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى قَبَضَهُ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ صَحِبْتُ عُثْمَانَ فَلَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى قَبَضَهُ اللَّهُ وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏ لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu hafsi bni 'aasimi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sahibtu abna 'umara fiy tariyqi makkaaa - qaala - fasallaa lanaa alzzuhra rak'atayni thumma aaqbala waaaqbalnaa ma'ahu hattaa jaa'a rahlahu wajalasa wajalasnaa ma'ahu fahaanat minhu altifaataaun nahwa haythu sallaa faraaaa naasana qiyaamana faqaala maa yasna'u hauulaa'i qultu yusabbihuwna ‏.‏ qaala law kuntu musabbihana laatmamtu salaatiy yaa abna aakhiy iinniy sahibtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssafari falam yazid 'alaa rak'atayni hattaa qabadahu alllahu wasahibtu aabaa bakrin falam yazid 'alaa rak'atayni hattaa qabadahu alllahu wasahibtu 'umara falam yazid 'alaa rak'atayni hattaa qabadahu alllahu thumma sahibtu 'uthmaana falam yazid 'alaa rak'atayni hattaa qabadahu alllahu waqad qaala alllahu ‏{‏ laqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi auswaaun hasanaaun‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hafs b. 'Asim said:I accompanied Ibn 'Umar on the road to Mecca and he led us in two rak'ahs at the noon prayer, then he went forward and we too went along with him to a place where he alighted, and he sat and we sat along with him, and he cast a glance to the side where he said prayer and he saw people standing and asked: What are they doing? I said: They are engaged in glorifying Allah, offering Sunnah prayer. He said: If I had done so I would have perfected my prayer; O my nephew! I accompanied the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey, and he made no addittion to two rak'ahs, till Allah called him. I accompanied Abu Bakr and he made no addition to two rak'ahs till Allah caused him to die. I accompanied 'Umar and he made no addition to two rak'ahs till Allah caused him to die. I accompanied 'Uthman and he made no addition to two rak'ahs, till Allah caused him to die, and Allah has said:" There is a model pattern for you in the Messenger of Allah" (al-Qur'an, xxxiii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، قَالَ مَرِضْتُ مَرَضًا فَجَاءَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَعُودُنِي قَالَ وَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ السُّبْحَةِ، فِي السَّفَرِ فَقَالَ صَحِبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي السَّفَرِ فَمَا رَأَيْتُهُ يُسَبِّحُ وَلَوْ كُنْتُ مُسَبِّحًا لأَتْمَمْتُ وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ إِسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - 'an 'umara bni muhammadin, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, qaala maridtu maradana fajaa'a abnu 'umara ya'uwduniy qaala wasaaaltuhu 'ani alssubhaai, fiy alssafari faqaala sahibtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssafari famaa raaaytuhu yusabbihu walaw kuntu musabbihana laatmamtu waqad qaala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏ laqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi iiswaaun hasanaaun‏}‏
verses.translation: Hafs b. 'Asim reported:I fell ill and lbn 'Umar came to inquire after my health, and I asked him about the glorification of Allah (i. e. prayer) while travelling. Thereupon he said: I accompanied the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey but I did not see him glorifying Him, and were I to glorify (Him). I would have completed the prayer. Allah, the Exalted, has said:" Verily there is a model pattern for you in the Messenger of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَرْبَعًا وَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaaluwa haddathanaa hammaadun, wahuwa abnu zaydin h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa alzzuhra bialmadiynaai aarba'ana wasallaa al'asra bidhiy alhulayfaai rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said four rak'ahs in the noon prayer while at Medina, but he offered two rak'ahs in the afternoon prayer at Dhu'l-Hulaifa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، سَمِعَا أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظُّهْرَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَرْبَعًا وَصَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ الْعَصْرَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almunkadiri, waiibraahiymu bnu maysaraaa, sami'aa aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu sallaytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alzzuhra bialmadiynaai aarba'ana wasallaytu ma'ahu al'asra bidhiy alhulayfaai rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik is reported to have said:I observed four rak'ahs in the noon prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Medina, and said two rak'ahs in the afternoon prayer at Dhu'l-Hulaifa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ غُنْدَرٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، غُنْدَرٌ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْهُنَائِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ عَنْ قَصْرِ الصَّلاَةِ، فَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا خَرَجَ مَسِيرَةَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَمْيَالٍ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةِ فَرَاسِخَ - شُعْبَةُ الشَّاكُّ - صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, kilaahumaa 'an ghundarin, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, ghundarun - 'an shu'baaa, 'an yahyaa bni yaziyda alhunaaiiyyi, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin 'an qasri alssalaaai, faqaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa kharaja masiyraaa thalaathaai aamyaalin aaw thalaathaai faraasikha - shu'baau alshhaakku - sallaa rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yahya b. Yazid al-Huna'i reported:I asked Anas b. Malik about shortening of prayer. He said: When the Messenger of' Allah (ﷺ) had covered a distance of three miles or three farsakh (Shu'ba, one of the narrators, had some doubt about it) he observed two rak'ahs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ مَهْدِيٍّ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ السِّمْطِ إِلَى قَرْيَةٍ عَلَى رَأْسِ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ أَوْ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ مِيلاً فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَقَالَ رَأَيْتُ عُمَرَ صَلَّى بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا أَفْعَلُ كَمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْعَلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni mahdiyyin, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an yaziyda bni khumayrin, 'an habiybi bni 'ubaydin, 'an jubayri bni nufayrin, qaala kharajtu ma'a shurahbiyla bni alssimti iilaa qaryaain 'alaa raasi sab'aaa 'ashara aaw thamaaniyaaa 'ashara miylaan fasallaa rak'atayni ‏.‏ faqultu lahu faqaala raaaytu 'umara sallaa bidhiy alhulayfaai rak'atayni faqultu lahu faqaala iinnamaa aaf'alu kamaa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaf'alu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jubair b. Nufair reported:I went along with Shurahbil b. al-Simt to a village which was situated at a distance of seventeen or eighteen miles, and he said only two rak'ahs of prayer. I said to him (about it) and he said: I saw 'Umar observing two rak'ahs at Dhu'l-Hulaifa and I (too) said to him (about it) and he said: I am doing the same as I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَنِ ابْنِ السِّمْطِ، وَلَمْ يُسَمِّ شُرَحْبِيلَ وَقَالَ إِنَّهُ أَتَى أَرْضًا يُقَالُ لَهَا دَوْمِينُ مِنْ حِمْصَ عَلَى رَأْسِ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ مِيلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ waqaala 'ani abni alssimti, walam yusammi shurahbiyla waqaala iinnahu aataa aardana yuqaalu lahaa dawmiynu min himsa 'alaa raasi thamaaniyaaa 'ashara miylaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Shu'ba with the same chain of narrators and it is narrated from Simt, and the name of Shurahbil has not been mentioned, and he said that he had gone to a place called Dumin, situated at a distance of eighteen miles from Hims
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى رَجَعَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ كَمْ أَقَامَ بِمَكَّةَ قَالَ عَشْرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina almadiynaai iilaa makkaaa fasallaa rak'atayni rak'atayni hattaa raja'a ‏.‏ qultu kam aaqaama bimakkaaa qaala 'ashrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:We went out from Medina to Mecca with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he prayed two rak'ahs at each time of prayer till we returned to Medina. I said: For how long did he stay in Mecca? He said: (For) ten (days)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ هُشَيْمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, h wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, jamiy'ana 'an yahyaa bni aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi hushaymin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Anas by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ خَرَجْنَا مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu kharajnaa mina almadiynaai iilaa alhajji ‏.‏ thumma dhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yahya b. Abu Ishaq reported:I heard Anas b. Malik say: We went out for Pilgrimage from Medina. The rest is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْحَجَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, jamiy'ana 'ani althhawriyyi, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi walam yadhkuri alhajja ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Anas, but no mention has been made of Pilgrimage
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ صَلَّى صَلاَةَ الْمُسَافِرِ بِمِنًى وَغَيْرِهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَعُثْمَانُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَدْرًا مِنْ خِلاَفَتِهِ ثُمَّ أَتَمَّهَا أَرْبَعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, wahuwa abnu alhaarithi 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu sallaa salaaaa almusaafiri biminana waghayrihi rak'atayni waaabuw bakrin wa'umaru wa'uthmaanu rak'atayni sadrana min khilaafatihi thumma aatammahaa aarba'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed the prayer of a traveller, i. e. two rak'ahs in Mina, and other places; so did Abu Bakr and 'Umar, and 'Uthman too observed two rak'ahs at the beginning of his caliphate, but he then completed four
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ بِمِنًى ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, h wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, jamiy'ana 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala biminana ‏.‏ walam yaqul waghayrihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been reported by Zuhri, with the same chain of transmitters, and in it mention was made of Mina only, but not of other places
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِنًى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ بَعْدَهُ وَعُمَرُ بَعْدَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُثْمَانُ صَدْرًا مِنْ خِلاَفَتِهِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ عُثْمَانَ صَلَّى بَعْدُ أَرْبَعًا ‏.‏ فَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ إِذَا صَلَّى مَعَ الإِمَامِ صَلَّى أَرْبَعًا وَإِذَا صَلاَّهَا وَحْدَهُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biminana rak'atayni waaabuw bakrin ba'dahu wa'umaru ba'da aabiy bakrin wa'uthmaanu sadrana min khilaafatihi thumma iinna 'uthmaana sallaa ba'du aarba'ana ‏.‏ fakaana abnu 'umara iidhaa sallaa ma'a aliimaami sallaa aarba'ana waiidhaa salaaahaa wahdahu sallaa rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said two rak'ahs at Mina, and Abu Bakr after him, and 'Umar after Abu Bakr, and 'Uthman at the beginning of his caliphate; then 'Uthman observed four rak'ahs, and when Ibn 'Umar prayed with the Imam, he said four rak'ahs, but when he observed prayer alone, he said two rak'ahs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu almuthannaa, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, wahuwa alqattaanu h wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, h wahaddathanaahu abnu numayrin, haddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu khaalidin, kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، سَمِعَ حَفْصَ بْنَ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِنًى صَلاَةَ الْمُسَافِرِ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَعُثْمَانُ ثَمَانِيَ سِنِينَ أَوْ قَالَ سِتَّ سِنِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ حَفْصٌ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُصَلِّي بِمِنًى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي فِرَاشَهُ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَىْ عَمِّ لَوْ صَلَّيْتَ بَعْدَهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَوْ فَعَلْتُ لأَتْمَمْتُ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an khubaybi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, sami'a hafsa bna 'aasimin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biminana salaaaa almusaafiri waaabuw bakrin wa'umaru wa'uthmaanu thamaaniya siniyna aaw qaala sitta siniyna ‏.‏ qaala hafsun wakaana abnu 'umara yusalliy biminana rak'atayni thumma yaatiy firaashahu ‏.‏ faqultu aaa 'ammi law sallayta ba'dahaa rak'atayni ‏.‏ qaala law fa'altu laatmamtu alssalaaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said in Mina the prayer of a traveller (short prayer) ; Abu Bakr and 'Umar did the same and 'Uthmia did it for eight years or six years. Hafs (one of the narrators) said: Ibn 'Umar would also say two rak'ahs at Mina and then go to bed. I said to him: O uncle, I wish you could have said two rak'ahs (of Sunnah prayer after shorenting the Fard prayer). He said: Were I to do that, I would have completed the prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَقُولاَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ بِمِنًى ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ قَالاَ صَلَّى فِي السَّفَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa khaalidun ya'niy abna alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alssamadi, qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yaquwlaa fiy alhadiythi biminana ‏.‏ walakin qaalaa sallaa fiy alssafari ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but no mention has been made of Mina, but they (the narrators) only said:He prayed while travelling
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يَقُولُ صَلَّى بِنَا عُثْمَانُ بِمِنًى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَقِيلَ ذَلِكَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَاسْتَرْجَعَ ثُمَّ قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِنًى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَصَلَّيْتُ مَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ بِمِنًى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَصَلَّيْتُ مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ بِمِنًى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَلَيْتَ حَظِّي مِنْ أَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ رَكْعَتَانِ مُتَقَبَّلَتَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, 'ani alaa'mashi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, qaala sami'tu 'abda alrrahmani bna yaziyda, yaquwlu sallaa binaa 'uthmaanu biminana aarba'a raka'aatin faqiyla dhalika li'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin faastarja'a thumma qaala sallaytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biminana rak'atayni wasallaytu ma'a aabiy bakrin alssiddiyqi biminana rak'atayni wasallaytu ma'a 'umara bni alkhattaabi biminana rak'atayni falayta hazziy min aarba'i raka'aatin rak'ataani mutaqabbalataani ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibrahim reported:I heard 'Abd al-Rahman as saying; 'Uthman led us four rak'ahs of prayer at Mina. It was reported to Abdullah b. Mas'ud and he recited:" Surely we are Allah's and to Him shall we return," and then said: I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Mina two rak'ahs of prayer. I prayed along with Abu Bakr al-Siddiq two rak'ahs of prayer at Mina. I prayed along with 'Umar b. Khattab two rak'ahs of prayer at Mina. I wish I had my share of the two rak'ahs acceptable (to God) for the four rak'ahs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، وَابْنُ، خَشْرَمٍ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, waabnu, khashramin qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been reported by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِنًى - آمَنَ مَا كَانَ النَّاسُ وَأَكْثَرَهُ - رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala, qutaybaau haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an haarithaaa bni wahbin, qaala sallaytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biminana - amana maa kaana alnnaasu waaaktharahu - rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Haritha b. Wahb reported:I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) two rak'ahs and most of them offered two rak'ahs only in Mina, while the people felt secure
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنِي حَارِثَةُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ الْخُزَاعِيُّ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِنًى وَالنَّاسُ أَكْثَرُ مَا كَانُوا فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ حَارِثَةُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ الْخُزَاعِيُّ هُوَ أَخُو عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ لأُمِّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, haddathaniy haarithaau bnu wahbin alkhuzaa'iyyu, qaala sallaytu khalfa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biminana waalnnaasu aaktharu maa kaanuwa fasallaa rak'atayni fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏.‏ qaala muslimun haarithaau bnu wahbin alkhuzaa'iyyu huwa aakhuw 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi laummihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Wahb al-Khuza'i reported:I prayed behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Mina, and there was the greatest number of people, and they prayed two rak'ahs on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage. (Muslim said: Haritha b. Wahb al-Khuza'i is the brother of 'Ubaidullah b. 'Umar son of Khattab from the side of his mother)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَذَّنَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ذَاتِ بَرْدٍ وَرِيحٍ فَقَالَ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي الرِّحَالِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ إِذَا كَانَتْ لَيْلَةٌ بَارِدَةٌ ذَاتُ مَطَرٍ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي الرِّحَالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, aadhhana bialssalaaai fiy laylaain dhaati bardin wariyhin faqaala aalaa salluwa fiy alrrihaali ‏.‏ thumma qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamuru almuuadhhina iidhaa kaanat laylaaun baaridaaun dhaatu matarin yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aalaa salluwa fiy alrrihaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar announced Adhan for prayer on a cold, windy night. Then added:Pray in your dwellings; and then said: When it was a cold, rainy night, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to command the Mu'adhdhin to say" Pray in your dwellings
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ نَادَى بِالصَّلاَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ذَاتِ بَرْدٍ وَرِيحٍ وَمَطَرٍ فَقَالَ فِي آخِرِ نِدَائِهِ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي رِحَالِكُمْ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي الرِّحَالِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ إِذَا كَانَتْ لَيْلَةٌ بَارِدَةٌ أَوْ ذَاتُ مَطَرٍ فِي السَّفَرِ أَنْ يَقُولَ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي رِحَالِكُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu naadaa bialssalaaai fiy laylaain dhaati bardin wariyhin wamatarin faqaala fiy akhiri nidaaiihi aalaa salluwa fiy rihaalikum aalaa salluwa fiy alrrihaali ‏.‏ thumma qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaamuru almuuadhhina iidhaa kaanat laylaaun baaridaaun aaw dhaatu matarin fiy alssafari aan yaquwla aalaa salluwa fiy rihaalikum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that he summoned (people) to pray on a cold, windy and rainy night, and then observed at the end of the Adhin:Pray in your dwellings, pray in your dwellings, and then said: When it was a cold night or it was raining in a journey the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to command the Mu'adhdhin to announce: Pray in your dwellings
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ نَادَى بِالصَّلاَةِ بِضَجْنَانَ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَقَالَ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي رِحَالِكُمْ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يُعِدْ ثَانِيَةً أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي الرِّحَالِ ‏.‏ مِنْ قَوْلِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu naadaa bialssalaaai bidajnaana thumma dhakara bimithlihi waqaala aalaa salluwa fiy rihaalikum ‏.‏ walam yu'id thaaniyaaan aalaa salluwa fiy alrrihaali ‏.‏ min qawli abni 'umara ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that he summoned (people) to prayer at a place (known as) Dajnan, and the rest of the hadith is the same, and then said:Pray in your dwellings, but he did not repeat for the second time words of Ibn 'Umar (Pray in your dwellings)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَمُطِرْنَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لِيُصَلِّ مَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ فِي رَحْلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, h wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, qaala haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin famutirnaa faqaala ‏ "‏ liyusalli man shaa'a minkum fiy rahlihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:We set cut with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on a journey when it began to rain. Upon this he said: He who desires may pray in his dwelling
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، صَاحِبِ الزِّيَادِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِمُؤَذِّنِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ إِذَا قُلْتَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَلاَ تَقُلْ حَىَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ قُلْ صَلُّوا فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ - قَالَ - فَكَأَنَّ النَّاسَ اسْتَنْكَرُوا ذَاكَ فَقَالَ أَتَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ ذَا قَدْ فَعَلَ ذَا مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي إِنَّ الْجُمُعَةَ عَزْمَةٌ وَإِنِّي كَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُحْرِجَكُمْ فَتَمْشُوا فِي الطِّينِ وَالدَّحْضِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an 'abdi alhamiydi, saahibi alzziyaadiyyi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, aannahu qaala limuuadhhinihi fiy yawmin matiyrin iidhaa qulta aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu aashhadu aanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi falaa taqul haaaa 'alaa alssalaaai qul salluwa fiy buyuwtikum - qaala - fakaaanna alnnaasa astankaruwa dhaaka faqaala aata'jabuwna min dhaa qad fa'ala dhaa man huwa khayrun minniy iinna aljumu'aaa 'azmaaun waiinniy karihtu aan auhrijakum fatamshuwa fiy alttiyni waalddahdi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that he said to the Mu'adhdhin on a rainy day:When you have announced" I testify that there is no god but Allah; I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah," do not say:" Come to the prayer," but make this announcement:" Say prayer in your houses." He (the narrator) said that the people disapproved of it. Ibn 'Abbas said: Are you astonished at it? He (the Holy Prophet), who is better than I, did it. Jumu'a prayer is no doubt obligatory, but I do not like that I should (force you) to come out and walk in mud and slippery ground
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي رَدْغٍ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْجُمُعَةَ وَقَالَ قَدْ فَعَلَهُ مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي ‏.‏ يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ أَبُو كَامِلٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - 'an 'abdi alhamiydi, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna alhaarithi, qaala khatabanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abbaasin fiy yawmin dhiy radghin ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa walam yadhkuri aljumu'aaa waqaala qad fa'alahu man huwa khayrun minniy ‏.‏ ya'niy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala aabuw kaamilin haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an 'aasimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, binahwihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Hamid reported:I heard 'Abdullah b. al-Harith say: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas addressed us on a rainy day, and the rest of the hadith is the same, but he made no mention of Jumu'a prayer, and added: He who did it (who commanded us to say prayer in our houses), i. e. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), is better than I
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، - هُوَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ - حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَعَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِهِ يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, - huwa alzzahraaniyyu - haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - haddathanaa aayyuwbu, wa'aasimun alaahwalu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur fiy hadiythihi ya'niy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ayyub and 'Asim al-Ahwal with the same chain of transmitters, but in this hadith it is not recorded:" i. e. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ، صَاحِبُ الزِّيَادِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنُ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ فِي يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَقَالَ وَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ تَمْشُوا فِي الدَّحْضِ وَالزَّلَلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa abnu shumaylin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi, saahibu alzziyaadiyyi qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna alhaarithi, qaala aadhhana muuadhhinu abni 'abbaasin yawma jumu'aain fiy yawmin matiyrin ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa waqaala wakarihtu aan tamshuwa fiy alddahdi waalzzalali ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Harith reported that Ibn 'Abbas commanded the Mu'adhdhin to (summon the people to prayer on Friday and make announcement to say prayer in their houses) when it was rainy, and the rest of the hadith is the same (except this) that he said:I do not like you should walk in muddy slippery place
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَمَرَ مُؤَذِّنَهُ - فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ - فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ فِي يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَذَكَرَ فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ فَعَلَهُ مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي ‏.‏ يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'aamirin, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kilaahumaa 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, aanna abna 'abbaasin, aamara muuadhhinahu - fiy hadiythi ma'marin - fiy yawmi jumu'aain fiy yawmin matiyrin ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihim wadhakara fiy hadiythi ma'marin fa'alahu man huwa khayrun minniy ‏.‏ ya'niy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Harith reported that the Mu'adhdhin of Ibn 'Abba said Adhan on Friday (and then made the announcement to say prayer in houses) because it was a rainy day; as it has been narrated by Ma'mar and others, and in this hadith it was mentioned:He who did it, i. e. the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), was better than I
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، - قَالَ وُهَيْبٌ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهُ مِنْهُ - قَالَ أَمَرَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ مُؤَذِّنَهُ فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ فِي يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa aahmadu bnu iishaaqa alhadramiyyu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, - qaala wuhaybun lam yasma'hu minhu - qaala aamara abnu 'abbaasin muuadhhinahu fiy yawmi jumu'aain fiy yawmin matiyrin ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this that Ibn 'Abbas ordered his Mu'adhdhin (to summon people to prayer and then make announcement to say prayer in their houses) on Friday which was a rainy day, has been transmitted by 'Abdullah b. Harith. Wuhaib, however, says that he did not hear it from him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي سُبْحَتَهُ حَيْثُمَا تَوَجَّهَتْ بِهِ نَاقَتُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy subhatahu haythumaa tawajjahat bihi naaqatuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say Nafl prayer on (the back of) his camel in whatever direction it took him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ حَيْثُ تَوَجَّهَتْ بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy 'alaa raahilatihi haythu tawajjahat bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Apostle (ﷺ) used to pray on (the back of) his camel in whatever direction it took him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ مُقْبِلٌ مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ حَيْثُ كَانَ وَجْهُهُ - قَالَ - وَفِيهِ نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللَّهِ‏}‏
