verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an zuraaraaa, aanna sa'da bna hishaami bni 'aamirin, aaraada aan yaghzuwa, fiy sabiyli alllahi faqadima almadiynaaa faaaraada aan yabiy'a 'aqaarana lahu bihaa fayaj'alahu fiy alssilaahi waalkuraa'i wayujaahida alrruwma hattaa yamuwta falammaa qadima almadiynaaa laqiya aunaasana min aahli almadiynaai fanahawhu 'an dhalika waaakhbaruwhu aanna rahtana sittaaan aaraaduwa dhalika fiy hayaaai nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanahaahum nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala ‏"‏ aalaysa lakum fiyya auswaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa haddathuwhu bidhalika raaja'a amraaatahu waqad kaana tallaqahaa waaashhada 'alaa raj'atihaa faaataa abna 'abbaasin fasaaalahu 'an witri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala abnu 'abbaasin aalaa aadulluka 'alaa aa'lami aahli alaardi biwitri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala man qaala 'aaiishaau ‏.‏ faatihaa faasaalhaa thumma aitiniy faaakhbirniy biraddihaa 'alayka faantalaqtu iilayhaa faaataytu 'alaa hakiymi bni aaflaha faastalhaqtuhu iilayhaa faqaala maa aanaa biqaaribihaa laanniy nahaytuhaa aan taquwla fiy haatayni alshhiy'atayni shayiana faaabat fiyhimaa iilaaa mudiyyana ‏.‏ - qaala - faaaqsamtu 'alayhi fajaa'a faantalaqnaa iilaa 'aaiishaaa faastaadhannaa 'alayhaa faaadhinat lanaa fadakhalnaa 'alayhaa ‏.‏ faqaalat aahakiymun fa'arafathu ‏.‏ faqaala na'am ‏.‏ faqaalat man ma'aka qaala sa'du bnu hishaamin ‏.‏ qaalat man hishaamun qaala abnu 'aamirin fatarahhamat 'alayhi waqaalat khayrana - qaala qataadaau wakaana ausiyba yawma auhudin ‏.‏ faqultu yaa aumma almuuminiyna aanbiiiyniy 'an khuluqi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaalat aalasta taqraau alqurana qultu balaa ‏.‏ qaalat faiinna khuluqa nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana alqurana ‏.‏ - qaala - fahamamtu aan aaquwma walaa aasaala aahadana 'an shaa'in hattaa aamuwta thumma badaa liy faqultu aanbiiiyniy 'an qiyaami rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaalat aalasta taqraau ‏{‏ yaa aayyuhaa almuzzammilu‏}‏ qultu balaa ‏.‏ qaalat faiinna alllaha 'azza wajalla aftarada qiyaama alllayli fiy aawwali hadhihi alssuwraai faqaama nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabuhu hawlaan waaamsaka alllahu khaatimatahaa athnaa 'ashara shahrana fiy alssamaa'i hattaa aanzala alllahu fiy akhiri hadhihi alssuwraai alttakhfiyfa fasaara qiyaamu alllayli tatawwu'ana ba'da fariydaain ‏.‏ - qaala - qultu yaa aumma almuuminiyna aanbiiiyniy 'an witri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaalat kunnaa nu'iddu lahu siwaakahu watahuwrahu fayab'athuhu alllahu maa shaa'a aan yab'athahu mina alllayli fayatasawwaku wayatawaddaau wayusalliy tis'a raka'aatin laa yajlisu fiyhaa iilaaa fiy althhaaminaai fayadhkuru alllaha wayahmaduhu wayad'uwhu thumma yanhadu walaa yusallimu thumma yaquwmu fayusalliy alttaasi'aaa thumma yaq'udu fayadhkuru alllaha wayahmaduhu wayad'uwhu thumma yusallimu tasliymana yusmi'unaa thumma yusalliy rak'atayni ba'da maa yusallimu wahuwa qaa'idun fatilka iihdaa 'ashraaa rak'aaan yaa bunaaaa falammaa aasanna nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaakhadha alllahma aawtara bisab'in wasana'a fiy alrrak'atayni mithla saniy'ihi alaawwali fatilka tis'un yaa bunaaaa wakaana nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sallaa salaaaan aahabba aan yudaawima 'alayhaa wakaana iidhaa ghalabahu nawmun aaw waja'un 'an qiyaami alllayli sallaa mina alnnahaari thintaa 'ashraaa rak'aaan walaa aa'lamu nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaraaa alqurana kullahu fiy laylaain walaa sallaa laylaaan iilaa alssubhi walaa saama shahrana kaamilaan ghayra ramadaana ‏.‏ - qaala - faantalaqtu iilaa abni 'abbaasi fahaddathtuhu bihadiythihaa faqaala sadaqat law kuntu aaqrabuhaa aaw aadkhulu 'alayhaa laataytuhaa hattaa tushaafihaniy bihi ‏.‏ - qaala - qultu law 'alimtu aannaka laa tadkhulu 'alayhaa maa haddathtuka hadiythahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd b. Hisham b. 'Amir decided to participate in the expedition for the sake of Allah, so he came to Medina and he decided to dispose of his property there and buy arms and horses instead and fight against the Romans to the end of his life. When he came to Medina, he met the people of Medina. They dissuaded him to do such a thing, and informed him that a group of six men had decided to do so during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade them to do it, and said:Is there not for you a model pattern in me? And when they narrated this to him (Sa'd b. Hisham), he returned to his wife, though he had divorced her and made (people) witness to his reconciliation. He then came to Ibn 'Abbas and asked him about the Witr of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Ibn 'Abbas said: Should I not lead you to one who knows best amongst the people of the world about the Witr of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? He said: Who is it? He (Ibn 'Abbas) said: It is 'A'isha. So go to her and ask her (about Witr) and then come to me and inform me about her answer that she would give you. So I came to Hakim b. Aflah and requested him to take me to her. He said: I would not go to her, for I forbade her to speak anything (about the conflict) between the two groupS, but she refused (to accept my advice) and went (to participate in that corflict). I (requested) him (Hakim) with an oath to lead me to her. So we went to 'A'isha and we begged permission to meet her. She granted us permission and we went in. She said: Are you Hakim? (She recognised him.) He replied: Yes. She said: Who is there with you? He said: He is Sa'd b. Hisham. She said: Which Hisham? He said: He is Hisham b. 'Amir. She blessed him ('Amir) with mercy from Allah and spoke good of him (Qatada said that he died as a martyr in Uhud). I said: Mother of the Faithful, tell me about the character of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: Don't you read the Qur'an? I said: Yes. Upon this she said: The character of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was the Qur'an. He said: I felt inclined to get up and not ask anything (further) till death. But then I changed my mind and said: Inform me about the observance (of the night prayer) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: Did you not recite:" O thou wrapped up"? He said: Yes. She said: Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious, made the observance of the night prayer at the beginning of this Surah obligatory. So the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him and his Companions around him observed this (night prayer) for one year. Allah held back the concluding portion of this Surah for twelve months in the Heaven till (at the end of this period) Allah revealed the concluding verses of this Surah which lightened (the burden of this prayer), and the night prayer became a supererogatory prayer after being an obligatory one. I said: Mother of the Faithful, inform me about the Witr of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). She said: I used to prepare tooth stick for him and water for his ablution, and Allah would rouse him to the extent He wished during the night. He would use the tooth stick, and perform ablution, and would offer nine rak'ahs, and would not sit but in the eighth one and would remember Allah, and praise Him and supplicate Him, then he would get up without uttering the salutation and pray the ninth rak'ah. He would then sit, remember, praise Him and supplicate Him and then utter a salutation loud enough for us to hear. He would then pray two rak'ahs sitting after uttering the salutation, and that made eleven rak'ahs. O my son, but when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) grew old and put on flesh, he observed Witr of seven, doing in the two rak'ahs as he had done formerly, and that made nine. O my son, and when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer, he liked to keep on observing it, and when sleep or pain overpowered him and made it impossible (for him) to observe prayer in the night, he prayed twelve rak'ahs daring the day. I am not aware of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) having recited the whole Qur'an during one single night, or praying through the night till morning, or fasting a complete month, except Ramadan. He (the narrator) said: I then went to Ibn 'Abbas and narrated to him the hadith (transmitted from her), and he said: She says the truth If I went to her and got into her presence, I would have listened to it orally from her. He said: If I were to know that you do not go to her. I would not have transmitted this hadith to you narrated by her

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، أَنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لِيَبِيعَ عَقَارَهُ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an zuraaraaa bni aawfaa, 'an sa'di bni hishaamin, aannahu tallaqa amraaatahu thumma antalaqa iilaa almadiynaai liyabiy'a 'aqaarahu ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zurara b. Aufa said that Sa'd b. Hisham divorced his wife, and then proceeded to Medina to sell his property, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْوِتْرِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِقِصَّتِهِ وَقَالَ فِيهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ هِشَامٌ قُلْتُ ابْنُ عَامِرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نِعْمَ الْمَرْءُ كَانَ عَامِرٌ أُصِيبَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an zuraaraaa bni aawfaa, 'an sa'di bni hishaamin, aannahu qaala antalaqtu iilaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin fasaaaltuhu 'ani alwitri ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha biqissatihi waqaala fiyhi qaalat man hishaamun qultu abnu 'aamirin ‏.‏ qaalat ni'ma almar'u kaana 'aamirun ausiyba yawma auhudin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd b. Hisham reported:I went to 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas and asked him about the Witr prayer, and the rest of the hadith is the same as recorded in this event. She (Hadrat 'A'isha) said: Who is that Hisham? I said: Son of 'Amir. She said: What a fine man 'Amir was! He died as a martyr in the Battle of Uhud
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، كَانَ جَارًا لَهُ فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ وَفِيهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ هِشَامٌ قَالَ ابْنُ عَامِرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نِعْمَ الْمَرْءُ كَانَ أُصِيبَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ‏.‏ وَفِيهِ فَقَالَ حَكِيمُ بْنُ أَفْلَحَ أَمَا إِنِّي لَوْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّكَ لاَ تَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا مَا أَنْبَأْتُكَ بِحَدِيثِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an zuraaraaa bni aawfaa, aanna sa'da bna hishaamin, kaana jaarana lahu faaakhbarahu aannahu, tallaqa amraaatahu ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi sa'iydin wafiyhi qaalat man hishaamun qaala abnu 'aamirin ‏.‏ qaalat ni'ma almar'u kaana ausiyba ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma auhudin ‏.‏ wafiyhi faqaala hakiymu bnu aaflaha aamaa iinniy law 'alimtu aannaka laa tadkhulu 'alayhaa maa aanbaatuka bihadiythihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zurara b. Aufa reported that Sa'd b. Hisham was his neighbour and he informed him that he had divorced his wife and he narrated the hadith like the one transmitted by Sa'd. She ('A'isha) said:Who is Hisham? He said: The son of 'Amir. She said: What a fine man he was; he participated in the Battle of Uhud along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Hakim b. Aflah said: If I ever knew that you do not go to 'A'isha, I would not have informed you about her hadith (So that you would have gone to her and heard it from her orally)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، قَالَ سَعِيدٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا فَاتَتْهُ الصَّلاَةُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مِنْ وَجَعٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ صَلَّى مِنَ النَّهَارِ ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy 'awaanaaa, qaala sa'iydun haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an zuraaraaa bni aawfaa, 'an sa'di bni hishaamin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa faatathu alssalaaau mina alllayli min waja'in aaw ghayrihi sallaa mina alnnahaari thintaa 'ashraaa rak'aaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) missed the night prayer due to pain or any other reason, he observed twelve rak'ahs during the daytime
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ يُونُسَ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا عَمِلَ عَمَلاً أَثْبَتَهُ وَكَانَ إِذَا نَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ مَرِضَ صَلَّى مِنَ النَّهَارِ ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ لَيْلَةً حَتَّى الصَّبَاحِ وَمَا صَامَ شَهْرًا مُتَتَابِعًا إِلاَّ رَمَضَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, - wahuwa abnu yuwnusa - 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an zuraaraaa, 'an sa'di bni hishaamin alaansaariyyi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa 'amila 'amalaan aathbatahu wakaana iidhaa naama mina alllayli aaw marida sallaa mina alnnahaari thintaa 'ashraaa rak'aaan ‏.‏ qaalat wamaa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama laylaaan hattaa alssabaahi wamaa saama shahrana mutataabi'ana iilaaa ramadaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) decided upon doing any act, he continued to do it, and when he slept at night or fell sick he observed twelve rak'ahs during the daytime. I am not aware of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observing prayer during the whole of the night till morning, or observing fast for a whole month continuously except that of Ramadan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَاهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ نَامَ عَنْ حِزْبِهِ أَوْ عَنْ شَىْءٍ مِنْهُ فَقَرَأَهُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَصَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ كُتِبَ لَهُ كَأَنَّمَا قَرَأَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa bni yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani alssaaiibi bni yaziyda, wa'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, aakhbaraahu 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdin alqaariyyi, qaala sami'tu 'umara bna alkhattaabi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man naama 'an hizbihi aaw 'an shaa'in minhu faqaraaahu fiymaa bayna salaaai alfajri wasalaaai alzzuhri kutiba lahu kaaannamaa qaraaahu mina alllayli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. Khattab reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Should anyone fall asleep and fail to recite his portion of the Qur'an, or a part of it, if he recites it between the dawn prayer and the noon prayer, it will be recorded for him as though he had recited it during the night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ، رَأَى قَوْمًا يُصَلُّونَ مِنَ الضُّحَى فَقَالَ أَمَا لَقَدْ عَلِمُوا أَنَّ الصَّلاَةَ فِي غَيْرِ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ أَفْضَلُ ‏.‏ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الأَوَّابِينَ حِينَ تَرْمَضُ الْفِصَالُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an aayyuwba, 'ani alqaasimi alshhaybaaniyyi, aanna zayda bna aarqama, raaaa qawmana yusalluwna mina aldduhaa faqaala aamaa laqad 'alimuwa aanna alssalaaaa fiy ghayri hadhihi alssaa'aai aafdalu ‏.‏ iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ salaaau alaawwaabiyna hiyna tarmadu alfisaalu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Arqam, on seeing some people praying in the forenoon, said:They well know that prayer at another time than this is more excellent, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The prayer of those who are penitent is observed when your weaned camels feel the heat of the sun
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أَهْلِ قُبَاءٍ وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الأَوَّابِينَ إِذَا رَمِضَتِ الْفِصَالُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an hishaami bni aabiy 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa alqaasimu alshhaybaaniyyu, 'an zaydi bni aarqama, qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa aahli qubaa'in wahum yusalluwna faqaala ‏ "‏ salaaau alaawwaabiyna iidhaa ramidati alfisaalu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Arqam reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out to the people of Quba' and saw them observing prayer; upon this he said:The prayer of the penitent should be observed when the young weaned camels feel heat of the sun
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا خَشِيَ أَحَدُكُمُ الصُّبْحَ صَلَّى رَكْعَةً وَاحِدَةً تُوتِرُ لَهُ مَا قَدْ صَلَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, wa'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rajulaan, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an salaaai alllayli faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ salaaau alllayli mathnaa mathnaa faiidhaa khashiya aahadukumu alssubha sallaa rak'aaan waahidaaan tuwtiru lahu maa qad sallaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that a person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the night prayer. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Prayer during the night should consist of pairs of rak'ahs, but if one of you fears morning is near, he should pray one rak'ah which will make his prayer an odd number for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا خَشِيتَ الصُّبْحَ فَأَوْتِرْ بِرَكْعَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa 'amrunw, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'umara, h wahaddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rajulaan, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an salaaai alllayli faqaala ‏ "‏ mathnaa mathnaa faiidhaa khashiyta alssubha faaawtir birak'aain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported on the authority of his father that a person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the night prayer. He said:It consists of pairs of rak'ahs, but if one fears morning is near, he should make it an odd number by praying one rak'ah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ وَحُمَيْدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ حَدَّثَاهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا خِفْتَ الصُّبْحَ فَأَوْتِرْ بِوَاحِدَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna abna shihaabin, haddathahu aanna saalima bna 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara wahumayda bna 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin haddathaahu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi, aannahu qaala qaama rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa salaaau alllayli qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ salaaau alllayli mathnaa mathnaa faiidhaa khifta alssubha faaawtir biwaahidaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported:A man stood up and said. Messenger of Allah, how is the night prayer? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The night prayer consists of pair, but if you apprehend the rise of dawn, make it odd number by observing one rak'ah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَبُدَيْلٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ السَّائِلِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا خَشِيتَ الصُّبْحَ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَةً وَاجْعَلْ آخِرَ صَلاَتِكَ وِتْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ وَأَنَا بِذَلِكَ الْمَكَانِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ أَدْرِي هُوَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ أَوْ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, wabudaylun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaqiyqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rajulaan, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa baynahu wabayna alssaaiili faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa salaaau alllayli qaala ‏ "‏ mathnaa mathnaa faiidhaa khashiyta alssubha fasalli rak'aaan waaj'al akhira salaatika witrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma saaalahu rajulun 'alaa raasi alhawli waaanaa bidhalika almakaani min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaa aadriy huwa dhalika alrrajulu aaw rajulun akharu faqaala lahu mithla dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported:A person asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as I stood between him (the Holy Prophet) and the inquirer and he said: Messenger of Allah, how is the night prayer? He (the Holy Prophet) said: It consists of pairs of rak'ahs, but if you apprehend morning, you should pray one rak'ah and make the end of your prayer as Witr. Then a person asked him (the Holy Prophet) at the end of the year and I was at that place near the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ; but I do not know whether he was the same person or another person, but he (the Holy Prophet) gave him the same reply
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَبُدَيْلٌ، وَعِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُدَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَالزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ الْخِرِّيتِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَا بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ وَمَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw kaamilin, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, wabudaylun, wa'imraanu bnu hudayrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaqiyqin, 'ani abni 'umara, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydin alghubariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, waalzzubayru bnu alkhirriyti, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaqiyqin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala saaala rajulun alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakaraa bimithlihi walaysa fiy hadiythihimaa thumma saaalahu rajulun 'alaa raasi alhawli wamaa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith his been narrated by Ibn 'Umar by another chain of trans- mitters but it does not have these words:" Then a person asked him at the end of the year," and what follows subsequently
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، - قَالَ هَارُونُ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، - أَخْبَرَنِي عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَادِرُوا الصُّبْحَ بِالْوِتْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, wasurayju bnu yuwnusa, waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'ani abni aabiy zaaiidaaa, - qaala haaruwnu haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, - aakhbaraniy 'aasimun alaahwalu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaqiyqin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ baadiruwa alssubha bialwitri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as say- ing:Hasten to pray Witr before morning
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ مَنْ صَلَّى مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيَجْعَلْ آخِرَ صَلاَتِهِ وِتْرًا فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُ بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, qaala man sallaa mina alllayli falyaj'al akhira salaatihi witrana faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaamuru bidhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar said:He who prayed at night should make Witr the end of his prayer, for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اجْعَلُوا آخِرَ صَلاَتِكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وِتْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aj'aluwa akhira salaatikum bialllayli witrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Make Witr the end of your night prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يَقُولُ مَنْ صَلَّى مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيَجْعَلْ آخِرَ صَلاَتِهِ وِتْرًا قَبْلَ الصُّبْحِ كَذَلِكَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy naafi'un, aanna abna 'umara, kaana yaquwlu man sallaa mina alllayli falyaj'al akhira salaatihi witrana qabla alssubhi kadhalika kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamuruhum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported Ibn 'Umar as saying:He who observed the night prayer should make Witr the end of his prayer before dawn. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to order them thus
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مِجْلَزٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْوِتْرُ رَكْعَةٌ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, qaala haddathaniy aabuw mijlazin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alwitru rak'aaun min akhiri alllayli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Witr is a rak'ah at the end of the prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْوِتْرُ رَكْعَةٌ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy mijlazin, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alwitru rak'aaun min akhiri alllayli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Witr is a rak'ah at the end of the night prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الْوِتْرِ، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ رَكْعَةٌ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ رَكْعَةٌ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aabiy mijlazin, qaala saaaltu abna 'abbaasin 'ani alwitri, faqaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ rak'aaun min akhiri alllayli ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaaltu abna 'umara faqaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ rak'aaun min akhiri alllayli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mijlaz reported:I asked Ibn 'Abbas about the Witr prayer. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: It is a rak'ah at the end of the night prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً نَادَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أُوتِرُ صَلاَةَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ صَلَّى فَلْيُصَلِّ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِنْ أَحَسَّ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ سَجَدَ سَجْدَةً فَأَوْتَرَتْ لَهُ مَا صَلَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi bni kathiyrin, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna abna 'umara, haddathahum aanna rajulaan naadaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy almasjidi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa auwtiru salaaaa alllayli faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man sallaa falyusalli mathnaa mathnaa faiin aahassa aan yusbiha sajada sajdaaan faaawtarat lahu maa sallaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw kuraybin 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi ‏.‏ walam yaquli abni 'umara ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:A person called (the attention) of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he was in the mosque, and said: Messenger of Allah, how should I make the rak'ahs of the night prayer an odd number? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said: He who prays (night prayer) he should observe it in pairs, but if he apprehends the rise of morning, he should observe one rak'ah; that would make the number odd (for the rak'ahs) observed by him. This was narrated by Abu Kuraib 'Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah and Ibn 'Umar did not make mention of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ قُلْتُ أَرَأَيْتَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْغَدَاةِ أَأُطِيلُ فِيهِمَا الْقِرَاءَةَ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى وَيُوتِرُ بِرَكْعَةٍ - قَالَ - قُلْتُ إِنِّي لَسْتُ عَنْ هَذَا أَسْأَلُكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَضَخْمٌ أَلاَ تَدَعُنِي أَسْتَقْرِئُ لَكَ الْحَدِيثَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى وَيُوتِرُ بِرَكْعَةٍ وَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْغَدَاةِ كَأَنَّ الأَذَانَ بِأُذُنَيْهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ خَلَفٌ أَرَأَيْتَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْغَدَاةِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ صَلاَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aanasi bni siyriyna, qaala saaaltu abna 'umara qultu aaraaayta alrrak'atayni qabla salaaai alghadaaai aaautiylu fiyhimaa alqiraa'aaa qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy mina alllayli mathnaa mathnaa wayuwtiru birak'aain - qaala - qultu iinniy lastu 'an hadhaa aasaaluka ‏.‏ qaala iinnaka ladakhmun aalaa tada'uniy aastaqriiu laka alhadiytha kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy mina alllayli mathnaa mathnaa wayuwtiru birak'aain wayusalliy rak'atayni qabla alghadaaai kaaanna alaadhaana biaudhunayhi ‏.‏ qaala khalafun aaraaayta alrrak'atayni qabla alghadaaai walam yadhkur salaaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Sirin reported:I asked Ibn 'Umar to tell me about the practice of the Prophet (ﷺ) in regard to two rak'ahs before the dawn prayer: Should I make lengthy recitation in them? He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe, the night prayer in pairs and then made the number odd by observing one rak'ah. I said: I am not asking you about it. He said: You are a bulky man, will you not show me the patience to narrate to you the hadith completely? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe the night prayer in pairs and then made the number odd by observing one rak'ah, and then he observed two rak'ahs before dawn quite close to the call for prayer (Khalaf said:" Did you see [yourself the Prophet observing] the two rak'ahs before the dawn?" and he made no mention of prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ وَزَادَ وَيُوتِرُ بِرَكْعَةٍ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏.‏ وَفِيهِ فَقَالَ بَهْ بَهْ إِنَّكَ لَضَخْمٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aanasi bni siyriyna, qaala saaaltu abna 'umara ‏.‏ bimithlihi wazaada wayuwtiru birak'aain min akhiri alllayli ‏.‏ wafiyhi faqaala bah bah iinnaka ladakhmun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Sirin reported:I asked Ibn 'Umar like this (as recorded in the previous hadith) and he made this addition:" And he (the Holy Prophet) made the end of the night prayer as odd number by one rak'ah." And there is also (this addition):" Stop, stop, you are bulky
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ حُرَيْثٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ أَنَّ الصُّبْحَ يُدْرِكُكَ فَأَوْتِرْ بِوَاحِدَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ مَا مَثْنَى مَثْنَى قَالَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu 'uqbaaa bna huraythin, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, yuhaddithu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ salaaau alllayli mathnaa mathnaa faiidhaa raaayta aanna alssubha yudrikuka faaawtir biwaahidaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqiyla laibni 'umara maa mathnaa mathnaa qaala aan yusallima fiy kulli rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The night prayer consists of pairs and when you see the approach of dawn, make this number odd by one rak'ah. It was said to Ibn 'Umar: What does the (word) pair imply? He said: (It means) that salutation is uttered after every two rak'ahs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَوْتِرُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُصْبِحُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, 'an ma'marin, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aawtiruwa qabla aan tusbihuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id (al Khudri) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Observe Witr prayer before it is morning. Abu Sa'id reported that they (the Prophet's Companions) asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about Witr (prayer). (In reply to their inquiry) he said: Observe Witr prayer before it is morning
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو نَضْرَةَ الْعَوَقِيُّ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ، سَأَلُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْوِتْرِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَوْتِرُوا قَبْلَ الصُّبْحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an shaybaana, 'an yahyaa, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw nadraaa al'awaqiyyu, aanna aabaa sa'iydin, aakhbarahum aannahum, saaaluwa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alwitri faqaala ‏ "‏ aawtiruwa qabla alssubhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that they (some of the Companions) of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about Witr. He said:Observe Witr before morning
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ خَافَ أَنْ لاَ يَقُومَ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيُوتِرْ أَوَّلَهُ وَمَنْ طَمِعَ أَنْ يَقُومَ آخِرَهُ فَلْيُوتِرْ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ فَإِنَّ صَلاَةَ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ مَشْهُودَةٌ وَذَلِكَ أَفْضَلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ مَحْضُورَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hafsun, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man khaafa aan laa yaquwma min akhiri alllayli falyuwtir aawwalahu waman tami'a aan yaquwma akhirahu falyuwtir akhira alllayli faiinna salaaaa akhiri alllayli mashhuwdaaun wadhalika aafdalu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw mu'aawiyaaa mahduwraaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If anyone is afraid that he may not get up in the latter part of the night, he should observe Witr in the first part of it; and if anyone is eager to get up in the last part of it, he should observe Witr at the end of the night, for prayer at the end of the night is witnessed (by the angels) and that is preferable
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ - عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَيُّكُمْ خَافَ أَنْ لاَ يَقُومَ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيُوتِرْ ثُمَّ لْيَرْقُدْ وَمَنْ وَثِقَ بِقِيَامٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيُوتِرْ مِنْ آخِرِهِ فَإِنَّ قِرَاءَةَ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ مَحْضُورَةٌ وَذَلِكَ أَفْضَلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, - wahuwa abnu 'ubaydi alllahi - 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aayyukum khaafa aan laa yaquwma min akhiri alllayli falyuwtir thumma lyarqud waman wathiqa biqiyaamin mina alllayli falyuwtir min akhirihi faiinna qiraa'aaa akhiri alllayli mahduwraaun wadhalika aafdalu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who amongst you is afraid that he may not be able to get up at the end of the night should observe Witr (in the first part) and then sleep, and he who is confident of getting up and praying at night (i. e. Tahajjud prayer) should observe it at the end of it, for the recitation at the end of the night is witnessed*, and that is better. *: meaning, "by angels" (Sharh an-Nawawi)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَفْضَلُ الصَّلاَةِ طُولُ الْقُنُوتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'aasimin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aafdalu alssalaaai tuwlu alqunuwti ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The most excellent prayer is that in which the duration of standing is longer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الصَّلاَةِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ طُولُ الْقُنُوتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau alssalaaai aafdalu qaala ‏ "‏ tuwlu alqunuwti ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'ani alaa'mashi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about the prayer which was most excellent. He said: That in which the standing is longer. (This hadith is narrated by another chain of transmitters too)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي اللَّيْلِ لَسَاعَةً لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ خَيْرًا مِنْ أَمْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ وَذَلِكَ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna fiy alllayli lasaa'aaan laa yuwaafiquhaa rajulun muslimun yasaalu alllaha khayrana min aamri alddunyaa waalakhiraai iilaaa aa'taahu iiyyaahu wadhalika kulla laylaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir said he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say:There is an hour during the night in which no Muslim individual will ask Allah for good in this world and the next without His giving it to him; and that applies to every night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ سَاعَةً لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ خَيْرًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna mina alllayli saa'aaan laa yuwaafiquhaa 'abdun muslimun yasaalu alllaha khayrana iilaaa aa'taahu iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: There is an hour during the night in which no Muslim bondman will ask Allah for good in this world and the next but He will grant it to him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَغَرِّ، وَعَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَنْزِلُ رَبُّنَا تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا حِينَ يَبْقَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرُ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ وَمَنْ يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ وَمَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy 'abdi alllahi alaagharri, wa'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yanzilu rabbunaa tabaaraka wata'aalaa kulla laylaain iilaa alssamaa'i alddunyaa hiyna yabqaa thuluthu alllayli alakhiru fayaquwlu man yad'uwniy faaastajiyba lahu waman yasaaluniy faau'tiyahu waman yastaghfiruniy faaaghfira lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Our Lord, the Blessed and the Exalted, descends every night to the lowest heaven when one-third of the latter part of the night is left, and says: Who supplicates Me so that I may answer him? Who asks Me so that I may give to him? Who asks Me forgiveness so that I may forgive him?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ حِينَ يَمْضِي ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الأَوَّلُ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ فَلاَ يَزَالُ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُضِيءَ الْفَجْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyyu - 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yanzilu alllahu iilaa alssamaa'i alddunyaa kulla laylaain hiyna yamdiy thuluthu alllayli alaawwalu fayaquwlu aanaa almaliku aanaa almaliku man dhaa alladhiy yad'uwniy faaastajiyba lahu man dhaa alladhiy yasaaluniy faau'tiyahu man dhaa alladhiy yastaghfiruniy faaaghfira lahu falaa yazaalu kadhalika hattaa yudiy'a alfajru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Allah descends every night to the lowest heaven when one-third of the first part of the night is over and says: I am the Lord; I am the Lord: who is there to supplicate Me so that I answer him? Who is there to beg of Me so that I grant him? Who is there to beg forgiveness from Me so that I forgive him? He continues like this till the day breaks
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا مَضَى شَطْرُ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ ثُلُثَاهُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا فَيَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ سَائِلٍ يُعْطَى هَلْ مِنْ دَاعٍ يُسْتَجَابُ لَهُ هَلْ مِنْ مُسْتَغْفِرٍ يُغْفَرُ لَهُ حَتَّى يَنْفَجِرَ الصُّبْحُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw almughiyraai, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa madaa shatru alllayli aaw thuluthaahu yanzilu alllahu tabaaraka wata'aalaa iilaa alssamaa'i alddunyaa fayaquwlu hal min saaiilin yu'taa hal min daa'in yustajaabu lahu hal min mustaghfirin yughfaru lahu hattaa yanfajira alssubhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When half of the night or two-third of it is over. Allah, the Blessed and the Exalted, descends to the lowest heaven and says: Is there any beggar, so that he be given? Is there any supplicator so that he be answered? Is there any beggar of forgiveness so that he be forgiven? (And Allah continues it saying) till it is daybreak
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَاضِرٌ أَبُو الْمُوَرِّعِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ مَرْجَانَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا لِشَطْرِ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ لِثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ أَوْ يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ مَنْ يُقْرِضُ غَيْرَ عَدِيمٍ وَلاَ ظَلُومٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ ابْنُ مَرْجَانَةَ هُوَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَمَرْجَانَةُ أُمُّهُ ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ يَبْسُطُ يَدَيْهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى يَقُولُ مَنْ يُقْرِضُ غَيْرَ عَدُومٍ وَلاَ ظَلُومٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa muhaadirun aabuw almuwarri'i, haddathanaa sa'du bnu sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu marjaanaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yanzilu alllahu fiy alssamaa'i alddunyaa lishatri alllayli aaw lithuluthi alllayli alakhiri fayaquwlu man yad'uwniy faaastajiyba lahu aaw yasaaluniy faau'tiyahu ‏.‏ thumma yaquwlu man yuqridu ghayra 'adiymin walaa zaluwmin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala muslimun abnu marjaanaaa huwa sa'iydu bnu 'abdi alllahi wamarjaanaau aummuhu ‏.‏ haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an sa'di bni sa'iydin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada ‏"‏ thumma yabsutu yadayhi tabaaraka wata'aalaa yaquwlu man yuqridu ghayra 'aduwmin walaa zaluwmin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Allah descends to the lowest heaven at half of the night or at one-third of the latter part and says: Who is there to supplicate Me so that I answer him? Who is there to ask Me so that I grant him? And then says: Who will lend to One Who is neither indigent nor tyrant? (This hadith has been narrated by Sa'd b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters with this addition:" Then the Blessed and the Exalted (Lord) stretches His Hands and says: Who will lend to One Who is neither indigent nor tyrant?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ ابْنَا أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنَىْ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَغَرِّ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ، يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ قَالاَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْهِلُ حَتَّى إِذَا ذَهَبَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الأَوَّلُ نَزَلَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا فَيَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مُسْتَغْفِرٍ هَلْ مِنْ تَائِبٍ هَلْ مِنْ سَائِلٍ هَلْ مِنْ دَاعٍ حَتَّى يَنْفَجِرَ الْفَجْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, waaabuw bakrin abnaa aabiy shaybaaa waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu - waalllafzu laibnaa aabiy shaybaaa - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaagharri aabiy muslimin, yarwiyhi 'an aabiy sa'iydin, waaabiy, hurayraaa qaalaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha yumhilu hattaa iidhaa dhahaba thuluthu alllayli alaawwalu nazala iilaa alssamaa'i alddunyaa fayaquwlu hal min mustaghfirin hal min taaiibin hal min saaiilin hal min daa'in hattaa yanfajira alfajru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id and Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Allah waits till when one-third of the first part of the night is over; He descends to the lowest heaven and says: It there any supplicator of forgiveness? Is there any penitant? Is there any petitioner (for mercy and favour)? Is there any solicitor? -till it is daybreak
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ، مَنْصُورٍ أَتَمُّ وَأَكْثَرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ ghayra aanna hadiytha, mansuwrin aatammu waaaktharu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Ishaq with the same chain uf transmitters except this that the hadith transmitted by Mansur (the above one) is more comprehensive and lengthy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man qaama ramadaana iiymaanana waahtisaabana ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who observed prayer at night during Ramadan, because of faith and seeking his reward from Allah, his previous sins would be forgiven
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُرَغِّبُ فِي قِيَامِ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُمْ فِيهِ بِعَزِيمَةٍ فَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَتُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالأَمْرُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ كَانَ الأَمْرُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ فِي خِلاَفَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَصَدْرًا مِنْ خِلاَفَةِ عُمَرَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuraghhibu fiy qiyaami ramadaana min ghayri aan yaamurahum fiyhi bi'aziymaain fayaquwlu ‏ "‏ man qaama ramadaana iiymaanana waahtisaabana ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fatuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalaamru 'alaa dhalika thumma kaana alaamru 'alaa dhalika fiy khilaafaai aabiy bakrin wasadrana min khilaafaai 'umara 'alaa dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to exhort (his Companions) to pray (at night) during Ramadan without commanding them to observe it as an obligatory act, and say: He who observed the night prayer in Ramadan because of faith and seeking his reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, this was the practice, and it continued thus during Abu Bakr's caliphate and the early part of 'Umar's caliphate
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, haddathahum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man saama ramadaana iiymaanana waahtisaabana ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi waman qaama laylaaa alqadri iiymaanana waahtisaabana ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who observed the fasts of Ramadan with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven, and he who observed prayer on Lailat-ul- Qadr with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَقُمْ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فَيُوَافِقُهَا - أُرَاهُ قَالَ - إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathaniy warqaa'u, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man yaqum laylaaa alqadri fayuwaafiquhaa - auraahu qaala - iiymaanana waahtisaabana ghufira lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who prayed on the Lailat-ul-Qadr (the Majestic Night) knowing that it is (the same night). I (believe) that he (the Prophet also) said: (He who does) it with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), his sins would be forgiven
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَصَلَّى بِصَلاَتِهِ نَاسٌ ثُمَّ صَلَّى مِنَ الْقَابِلَةِ فَكَثُرَ النَّاسُ ثُمَّ اجْتَمَعُوا مِنَ اللَّيْلَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ فَلَمْ يَخْرُجْ إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ الَّذِي صَنَعْتُمْ فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْنِي مِنَ الْخُرُوجِ إِلَيْكُمْ إِلاَّ أَنِّي خَشِيتُ أَنْ تُفْرَضَ عَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَذَلِكَ فِي رَمَضَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa fiy almasjidi dhaata laylaain fasallaa bisalaatihi naasun thumma sallaa mina alqaabilaai fakathura alnnaasu thumma ajtama'uwa mina alllaylaai althhaalithaai aawi alrraabi'aai falam yakhruj iilayhim rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa aasbaha qaala ‏ "‏ qad raaaytu alladhiy sana'tum falam yamna'niy mina alkhuruwji iilaykum iilaaa aanniy khashiytu aan tufrada 'alaykum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wadhalika fiy ramadaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed one night in the mosque and people also prayed along with him. He then prayed on the following night and there were many persons. Then on the third or fourth night (many people) gathered there, but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not come out to them (for leading the Tarawih prayer). When it was morning he said:I saw what you were doing, but I desisted to come to you (and lead the prayer) for I feared that this prayer might become obligatory for you. (He the narrator) said: It was the month of Ramadan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنْ جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ فَصَلَّى فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَصَلَّى رِجَالٌ بِصَلاَتِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ النَّاسُ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ بِذَلِكَ فَاجْتَمَعَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْهُمْ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَصَلَّوْا بِصَلاَتِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ النَّاسُ يَذْكُرُونَ ذَلِكَ فَكَثُرَ أَهْلُ الْمَسْجِدِ مِنَ اللَّيْلَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ فَخَرَجَ فَصَلَّوْا بِصَلاَتِهِ فَلَمَّا كَانَتِ اللَّيْلَةُ الرَّابِعَةُ عَجَزَ الْمَسْجِدُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ فَلَمْ يَخْرُجْ إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَطَفِقَ رِجَالٌ مِنْهُمْ يَقُولُونَ الصَّلاَةَ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَخْرُجْ إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى خَرَجَ لِصَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ فَلَمَّا قَضَى الْفَجْرَ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ ثُمَّ تَشَهَّدَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَخْفَ عَلَىَّ شَأْنُكُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ وَلَكِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَنْ تُفْرَضَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ فَتَعْجِزُوا عَنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, aakhbarathu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja min jawfi alllayli fasallaa fiy almasjidi fasallaa rijaalun bisalaatihi faaasbaha alnnaasu yatahaddathuwna bidhalika faajtama'a aaktharu minhum fakharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alllaylaai althhaaniyaai fasallawa bisalaatihi faaasbaha alnnaasu yadhkuruwna dhalika fakathura aahlu almasjidi mina alllaylaai althhaalithaai fakharaja fasallawa bisalaatihi falammaa kaanati alllaylaau alrraabi'aau 'ajaza almasjidu 'an aahlihi falam yakhruj iilayhim rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatafiqa rijaalun minhum yaquwluwna alssalaaaa ‏.‏ falam yakhruj iilayhim rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa kharaja lisalaaai alfajri falammaa qadaa alfajra aaqbala 'alaa alnnaasi thumma tashahhada faqaala ‏ "‏ aammaa ba'du faiinnahu lam yakhfa 'alaaaa shaanukumu alllaylaaa walakinniy khashiytu aan tufrada 'alaykum salaaau alllayli fata'jizuwa 'anhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out during the night and observed prayer in the mosque and some of the people prayed along with him. When it was morning the people talked about this and so a large number of people gathered there. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out for the second night, and they (the people) prayed along with him. When it was morning the people began to talk about it. So the mosque thronged with people on the third night. He (the Holy Prophet) came out and they prayed along with him. When it was the fourth night, the mosque was filled to its utmost capacity but the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not come out. Some persons among then cried:" Prayer." But the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not come to them till he came out for the morning prayer. When he had completed the morning prayer, he turned his face to the people and recited Tashahhud (I bear testi- mony that there is no god but Allah and I bear testimony that Muhammad is His Messen- ger) and then said: Your affair was not hidden from me in the night, but I was afraid that (my observing prayer continuously) might make the night prayer obligatory for you and you might be unable to perform it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ زِرٍّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ، يَقُولُ - وَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ مَنْ قَامَ السَّنَةَ أَصَابَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ - فَقَالَ أُبَىٌّ وَاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ إِنَّهَا لَفِي رَمَضَانَ - يَحْلِفُ مَا يَسْتَثْنِي - وَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ أَىُّ لَيْلَةٍ هِيَ ‏.‏ هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقِيَامِهَا هِيَ لَيْلَةُ صَبِيحَةِ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ وَأَمَارَتُهَا أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فِي صَبِيحَةِ يَوْمِهَا بَيْضَاءَ لاَ شُعَاعَ لَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathaniy 'abdaau, 'an zirrin, qaala sami'tu aubaaaa bna ka'bin, yaquwlu - waqiyla lahu iinna 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin yaquwlu man qaama alssanaaa aasaaba laylaaa alqadri - faqaala aubaaaun waalllahi alladhiy laa iilaha iilaaa huwa iinnahaa lafiy ramadaana - yahlifu maa yastathniy - wawaalllahi iinniy laa'lamu aaaau laylaain hiya ‏.‏ hiya alllaylaau allatiy aamaranaa bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biqiyaamihaa hiya laylaau sabiyhaai sab'in wa'ishriyna waaamaaratuhaa aan tatlu'a alshhamsu fiy sabiyhaai yawmihaa baydaa'a laa shu'aa'a lahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zirr (b. Hubaish) reported:I heard from Ubayy b. Ka'b a statement made by 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud in which he said: He who gets up for prayer (every night) during the year will hit upon Lailat-ul-Qadr. Ubayy said: By Allah I there is no god but He, that (Lailat-ul-Qadr) is in Ramadhan (He swore without reservation: ) By Allah, I know the night; it is the night on which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to pray. It is that which precedes the morning of twenty-seventy and its indication is that the sun rises bright on that day without rays
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَةَ بْنَ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ أُبَىٌّ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُهَا وَأَكْثَرُ عِلْمِي هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقِيَامِهَا هِيَ لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ - وَإِنَّمَا شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ فِي هَذَا الْحَرْفِ - هِيَ اللَّيْلَةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَنَا بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي بِهَا صَاحِبٌ لِي عَنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu 'abdaaa bna aabiy lubaabaaa, yuhaddithu 'an zirri bni hubayshin, 'an aubaaai bni ka'bin, qaala aubaaaun fiy laylaai alqadri waalllahi iinniy laa'lamuhaa waaaktharu 'ilmiy hiya alllaylaau allatiy aamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biqiyaamihaa hiya laylaau sab'in wa'ishriyna - waiinnamaa shakka shu'baau fiy hadhaa alharfi - hiya alllaylaau allatiy aamaranaa bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy bihaa saahibun liy 'anhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubayy b Ka'b reported:By Allah, I know about Lailat-ul Qadr and I know it fully well that it is the twenty-seventh night (during Ramadan) on which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to observe prayer. (Shu'ba was in doubt about these words:" the night on which the Messenger of Allah [may peace be upon him] commanded us to observe the prayer." This has been transmitted to me by a friend of mine
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ إِنَّمَا شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ ‏.‏ وَمَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu walam yadhkur iinnamaa shakka shu'baau ‏.‏ wamaa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shu'ba reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention that Shu'ba was in doubt and what follows subsequently
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ بِتُّ لَيْلَةً عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَأَتَى حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ نَامَ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَأَتَى الْقِرْبَةَ فَأَطْلَقَ شِنَاقَهَا ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا بَيْنَ الْوُضُوءَيْنِ وَلَمْ يُكْثِرْ وَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَصَلَّى فَقُمْتُ فَتَمَطَّيْتُ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَرَى أَنِّي كُنْتُ أَنْتَبِهُ لَهُ فَتَوَضَّأْتُ فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي فَأَدَارَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ فَتَتَامَّتْ صَلاَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ اللَّيْلِ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ فَنَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ وَكَانَ إِذَا نَامَ نَفَخَ فَأَتَاهُ بِلاَلٌ فَآذَنَهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ وَكَانَ فِي دُعَائِهِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا وَعَنْ يَسَارِي نُورًا وَفَوْقِي نُورًا وَتَحْتِي نُورًا وَأَمَامِي نُورًا وَخَلْفِي نُورًا وَعَظِّمْ لِي نُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ كُرَيْبٌ وَسَبْعًا فِي التَّابُوتِ فَلَقِيتُ بَعْضَ وَلَدِ الْعَبَّاسِ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِنَّ فَذَكَرَ عَصَبِي وَلَحْمِي وَدَمِي وَشَعَرِي وَبَشَرِي وَذَكَرَ خَصْلَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu haashimi bni hayyaana al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'niy abna mahdiyyin - haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an salamaaa bni kuhaylin, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala bittu laylaaan 'inda khaalatiy maymuwnaaa faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alllayli faaataa haajatahu thumma ghasala wajhahu wayadayhi thumma naama thumma qaama faaataa alqirbaaa faaatlaqa shinaaqahaa thumma tawaddaaa wuduw'ana bayna alwuduw'ayni walam yukthir waqad aablagha thumma qaama fasallaa faqumtu fatamattaytu karaahiyaaa aan yaraa aanniy kuntu aantabihu lahu fatawaddaatu faqaama fasallaa faqumtu 'an yasaarihi faaakhadha biyadiy faaadaaraniy 'an yamiynihi fatataammat salaaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alllayli thalaatha 'ashraaa rak'aaan thumma adtaja'a fanaama hattaa nafakha wakaana iidhaa naama nafakha faaataahu bilaalun faadhanahu bialssalaaai faqaama fasallaa walam yatawaddaa wakaana fiy du'aaiihi ‏ "‏ alllahumma aj'al fiy qalbiy nuwrana wafiy basariy nuwrana wafiy sam'iy nuwrana wa'an yamiyniy nuwrana wa'an yasaariy nuwrana wafawqiy nuwrana watahtiy nuwrana waaamaamiy nuwrana wakhalfiy nuwrana wa'azzim liy nuwrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala kuraybun wasab'ana fiy alttaabuwti falaqiytu ba'da waladi al'abbaasi fahaddathaniy bihinna fadhakara 'asabiy walahmiy wadamiy washa'ariy wabashariy wadhakara khaslatayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn `Abbas reported:I spent a night with my maternal aunt (sister of my mother) Maimuna. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) got up during the night and relieved himself, then washed his face and hands and went to sleep. He then got up again, and came to the water skin and loosened its straps, then performed good ablution between the two extremes. He then stood up and observed prayer. I also stood up and stretched my body fearing that he might be under the impression that I was there to find out (what he did at night). So I also performed ablution and stood up to pray, but I stood on his left. He took hold of my hand and made me go around to his right side. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) completed thirteen rak`ahs of his night prayer. He then lay down and slept and snored (and it was his habit to snore while asleep). Then Bilal came and he informed him about the prayer. He (the Holy Prophet) then stood up for prayer and did not perform ablution, and his supplication included these words: "O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my sight, light in my hearing, light on my right hand, light on my left hand, light above me, light below me, light in front of me, light behind me, and enhance light for me." Kuraib (the narrator) said: There are seven (words more) which are in my heart (but I cannot recall them) and I met some of the descendants of Al-`Abbas and they narrated these words to me and mentioned in them: (Light) in my sinew, in my flesh, in my blood, in my hair, in my skin, and made a mention of two more things
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
