verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy alssaliyli, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni rabaahin alaansaariyyi, 'an aubaaai bni ka'bin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa aabaa almundhiri aatadriy aaaau ayaain min kitaabi alllahi ma'aka aa'zamu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa almundhiri aatadriy aaaau ayaain min kitaabi alllahi ma'aka aa'zamu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu alllahu laa iilaha iilaaa huwa alhaaau alqayyuwmu ‏.‏ qaala fadaraba fiy sadriy waqaala ‏"‏ waalllahi liyahnika al'ilmu aabaa almundhiri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubayy b. Ka'b said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Abu' al-Mundhir, do you know the verse from the Book of Allah which, according to you, is the greatest? I said: Allah and His Apostle (ﷺ) know best. He again said: Abu'l-Mundhir, do you know the verse from the Book of Allah which, according to you, is the greatest? I said: Allah, there is no god but He, the Living, the Eternal. Thereupon he struck me on my breast and said: May knowledge be pleasant for you, O Abu'l-Mundhir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏" قَالُوا : وَكَيْفَ يَقْرَأْ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ؟ قَالَ : " قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ " ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an ma'daana bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aabiy alddardaa'i, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aaya'jizu aahadukum aan yaqraaa fiy laylaain thulutha alqurani ‏" qaaluwa : wakayfa yaqraa thulutha alqurani ؟ qaala : " qul huwa alllahu aahadun ta'dilu thulutha alqurani " ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Darda' reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Is any one of you incapable of reciting a third of the Qur'an in a night? They (the Companions) asked: How could one recite a third of the Qur'an (in a night)? Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: "'Say: He is Allah, One' (Qur'an. cxii) is equivalent to a third of the Qur'an
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانٌ الْعَطَّارُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا مِنْ قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَزَّأَ الْقُرْآنَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَجْزَاءٍ فَجَعَلَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ جُزْءًا مِنْ أَجْزَاءِ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa aabaanun al'attaaru, jamiy'ana 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihimaa min qawli alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha jazzaaa alqurana thalaathaaa aajzaa'in faja'ala qul huwa alllahu aahadun juz'ana min aajzaa'i alqurani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters in these words:He (the Messenger of Allah) said: Allah divided the Qur'an into three parts, and he made:" Say: He, Allah is One." one part out of the (three) parts of the Qur'an
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى، - قَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ احْشِدُوا فَإِنِّي سَأَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكُمْ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَشَدَ مَنْ حَشَدَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ فَقَالَ بَعْضُنَا لِبَعْضٍ إِنِّي أُرَى هَذَا خَبَرٌ جَاءَهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَذَاكَ الَّذِي أَدْخَلَهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي قُلْتُ لَكُمْ سَأَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكُمْ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ أَلاَ إِنَّهَا تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, waya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an yahyaa, - qaala abnu haatimin haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, - haddathanaa yaziydu bnu kaysaana, haddathanaa aabuw haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ahshiduwa faiinniy saaaqraau 'alaykum thulutha alqurani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fahashada man hashada thumma kharaja nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaraaa ‏{‏ qul huwa alllahu aahadun‏}‏ thumma dakhala faqaala ba'dunaa liba'din iinniy auraa hadhaa khabarun jaa'ahu mina alssamaa'i fadhaaka alladhiy aadkhalahu ‏.‏ thumma kharaja nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy qultu lakum saaaqraau 'alaykum thulutha alqurani aalaa iinnahaa ta'dilu thulutha alqurani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Get together. for I am going to recite one-third of the Qur'an before you. And those who could get together gathered there. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out and recited:" Say: He, Allah, is One." He then entered (his house). Some of us said to the others: Perhaps there has been some news from the heaven on account of which he has gone Inside (the house). The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) again came out and said: I told you that I was going to recite one-third of the Qur'in; keep in mind, this (Surah Ikhlas) is equivalent to one-third of the Qur'an
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ بَشِيرٍ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكُمْ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ‏}‏ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa waasilu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an bashiyrin aabiy iismaa'iyla, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kharaja iilaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aaqraau 'alaykum thulutha alqurani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaraaa ‏{‏ qul huwa alllahu aahadun * alllahu alssamadu‏}‏ hattaa khatamahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out to us and said: I am going to recite before you one-third of the Qur'an. He (the Holy Prophet) then recited:" Say: He is Allah, One--Allah, the Eternal," to the end of the Surah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا الرِّجَالِ، مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَتْ فِي حَجْرِ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ رَجُلاً عَلَى سَرِيَّةٍ وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ لأَصْحَابِهِ فِي صَلاَتِهِمْ فَيَخْتِمُ بِـ ‏{‏ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا ذُكِرَ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سَلُوهُ لأَىِّ شَىْءٍ يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَأَلُوهُ فَقَالَ لأَنَّهَا صِفَةُ الرَّحْمَنِ فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ بِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَخْبِرُوهُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّهُ
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni wahbin, haddathanaa 'ammiy 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy hilaalin, aanna aabaa alrrijaali, muhammada bna 'abdi alrrahmani haddathahu 'an aummihi, 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani wakaanat fiy hajri 'aaiishaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an 'aaiishaaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha rajulaan 'alaa sariyyaain wakaana yaqraau laashaabihi fiy salaatihim fayakhtimu bi ‏{‏ qul huwa alllahu aahadun‏}‏ falammaa raja'uwa dhukira dhalika lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ saluwhu laaaai shaa'in yasna'u dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasaaaluwhu faqaala laannahaa sifaau alrrahmani faaanaa auhibbu aan aaqraaa bihaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aakhbiruwhu aanna alllaha yuhibbuhu
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a man in charge of an expedition and he would recite for his Companions during their prayer, ending (recitation) with:" Say, He is God, One." When they returned mention was made of it to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He (the Holy Prophet) told them to ask him why he had done like that. So they asked him and he said: Verily, it is an attribute of the Compassionate One, and (for this reason) I love to recite it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thereupon said: Inform him that Allah loves him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلَمْ تَرَ آيَاتٍ أُنْزِلَتِ اللَّيْلَةَ لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلُهُنَّ قَطُّ ‏{‏ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an bayaanin, 'an qaysi bni aabiy haazimin, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalam tara ayaatin aunzilati alllaylaaa lam yura mithluhunna qattu ‏{‏ qul aa'uwdhu birabbi alfalaqi‏}‏ wa ‏{‏ qul aa'uwdhu birabbi alnnaasi‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. 'Amir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:What wonderful verses have been sent down today. the like of which has never been seen! They are:" Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the dawn," and" Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of men
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُنْزِلَ - أَوْ أُنْزِلَتْ - عَلَىَّ آيَاتٌ لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلُهُنَّ قَطُّ الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an qaysin, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aunzila - aaw aunzilat - 'alaaaa ayaatun lam yura mithluhunna qattu almu'awwidhatayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. 'Amir reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: There have been sent down to me verses the like of which had never been seen before. They are the Mu'awwadhatain
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ، بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ وَكَانَ مِنْ رُفَعَاءِ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kilaahumaa 'an iismaa'iyla, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy ausaamaaa 'an 'uqbaaa, bni 'aamirin aljuhaniyyi wakaana min rufa'aa'i aashaabi muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters directly from the Companions of Muhammad (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ حَسَدَ إِلاَّ فِي اثْنَتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْقُرْآنَ فَهُوَ يَقُومُ بِهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَهُوَ يُنْفِقُهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, kulluhum 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa hasada iilaaa fiy athnatayni rajulun ataahu alllahu alqurana fahuwa yaquwmu bihi anaa'a alllayli waanaa'a alnnahaari warajulun ataahu alllahu maalaan fahuwa yunfiquhu anaa'a alllayli waanaa'a alnnahaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim narrated on the authority of his father (Ibn 'Umar) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Envy is not justified but in case of two persons only: one who, having been given (knowledge of) the Qur'an by Allah, recites it during the night and day (and also acts upon it) and a man who, having been given wealth by God, spends it during the night and the day (for the welfare of others. seeking the pleasure of the Lord)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ حَسَدَ إِلاَّ عَلَى اثْنَتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ هَذَا الْكِتَابَ فَقَامَ بِهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَتَصَدَّقَ بِهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa hasada iilaaa 'alaa athnatayni rajulun ataahu alllahu hadhaa alkitaaba faqaama bihi anaa'a alllayli waanaa'a alnnahaari warajulun ataahu alllahu maalaan fatasaddaqa bihi anaa'a alllayli waanaa'a alnnahaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim son of Abdullah b. 'Umar is reported to have said on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed:Envy is not justified but in case of two persons only: one who, having been given (knowledge of) the Qur'an by Allah, recites it during the night and during the day (and acts upon it), and the person who, having been given wealth by God, gives it in charity during the night and the day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ حَسَدَ إِلاَّ فِي اثْنَتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَسَلَّطَهُ عَلَى هَلَكَتِهِ فِي الْحَقِّ وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ حِكْمَةً فَهُوَ يَقْضِي بِهَا وَيُعَلِّمُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu mas'uwdin h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy wamuhammadu bnu bishrin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an qaysin, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa hasada iilaaa fiy athnatayni rajulun ataahu alllahu maalaan fasallatahu 'alaa halakatihi fiy alhaqqi warajulun ataahu alllahu hikmaaan fahuwa yaqdiy bihaa wayu'allimuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There should be no envy but only in case of two persons: one having been endowed with wealth and power to spend it in the cause of Truth, and (the other) who has been endowed with wisdom and he decides cases with the help of it and teaches it (to others)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ وَاثِلَةَ، أَنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْحَارِثِ، لَقِيَ عُمَرَ بِعُسْفَانَ وَكَانَ عُمَرُ يَسْتَعْمِلُهُ عَلَى مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ مَنِ اسْتَعْمَلْتَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْوَادِي فَقَالَ ابْنَ أَبْزَى ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَنِ ابْنُ أَبْزَى قَالَ مَوْلًى مِنْ مَوَالِينَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاسْتَخْلَفْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مَوْلًى قَالَ إِنَّهُ قَارِئٌ لِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَإِنَّهُ عَالِمٌ بِالْفَرَائِضِ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ أَمَا إِنَّ نَبِيَّكُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْفَعُ بِهَذَا الْكِتَابِ أَقْوَامًا وَيَضَعُ بِهِ آخَرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathaniy aabiy, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'aamiri bni waathilaaa, aanna naafi'a bna 'abdi alhaarithi, laqiya 'umara bi'usfaana wakaana 'umaru yasta'miluhu 'alaa makkaaa faqaala mani asta'malta 'alaa aahli alwaadiy faqaala abna aabzaa ‏.‏ qaala wamani abnu aabzaa qaala mawlana min mawaaliynaa ‏.‏ qaala faastakhlafta 'alayhim mawlana qaala iinnahu qaariiun likitaabi alllahi 'azza wajalla waiinnahu 'aalimun bialfaraaiidi ‏.‏ qaala 'umaru aamaa iinna nabiyyakum sla allh 'lyh wslm qad qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha yarfa'u bihadhaa alkitaabi aaqwaamana wayada'u bihi akhariyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Wathila reported that Nafi' b. 'Abd al-Harith met 'Umar at 'Usfan and 'Umar had employed him as collector in Mecca. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said to him (Nafi'):Whom have you appointed as collector over the people of the valley? He said: Ibn Abza. He said: Who is Ibn Abza? He said: He is one of our freed slaves. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: So you have appointed a freed slave over them. He said: He is well versed In the Book of Allah. the Exalted and Great, and he is well versed In the commandments and injunctions (of the Shari'ah). 'Umar said: So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: By this Book, Allah would exalt some peoples and degrade others
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ وَاثِلَةَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، أَنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ، عَبْدِ الْحَارِثِ الْخُزَاعِيَّ لَقِيَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ بِعُسْفَانَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa qaalaa aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'aamiru bnu waathilaaa alllaythiyyu, aanna naafi'a bna, 'abdi alhaarithi alkhuzaa'iyya laqiya 'umara bna alkhattaabi bi'usfaana ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi iibraahiyma bni sa'din 'ani alzzuhriyyi, ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ، حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَا أَقْرَؤُهَا وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْرَأَنِيهَا فَكِدْتُ أَنْ أَعْجَلَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَمْهَلْتُهُ حَتَّى انْصَرَفَ ثُمَّ لَبَّبْتُهُ بِرِدَائِهِ فَجِئْتُ بِهِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ هَذَا يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَا أَقْرَأْتَنِيهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرْسِلْهُ اقْرَأْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَرَأَ الْقِرَاءَةَ الَّتِي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقْرَأُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِيَ ‏"‏ اقْرَأْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَرَأْتُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَكَذَا أُنْزِلَتْ إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ أُنْزِلَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdin alqaariyyi, qaala sami'tu 'umara bna alkhattaabi, yaquwlu sami'tu hishaama bna, hakiymi bni hizaamin yaqraau suwraaa alfurqaani 'alaa ghayri maa aaqrauuhaa wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqraaaniyhaa fakidtu aan aa'jala 'alayhi thumma aamhaltuhu hattaa ansarafa thumma labbabtuhu biridaaiihi fajiitu bihi rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy sami'tu hadhaa yaqraau suwraaa alfurqaani 'alaa ghayri maa aaqraataniyhaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aarsilhu aqraa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaraaa alqiraa'aaa allatiy sami'tuhu yaqraau faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hakadhaa aunzilat ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala liya ‏"‏ aqraa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaraatu faqaala ‏"‏ hakadhaa aunzilat iinna hadhaa alqurana aunzila 'alaa sab'aai aahrufin faaqra'uwa maa tayassara minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. Khattab said:I heard Hisham b. Hakim b. Hizam reciting Surah al-Furqan in a style different from that in which I used to recite it, and in which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had taught me to recite it. I was about to dispute with him (on this style) but I delayed till he had finished that (the recitation). Then I caught hold of his cloak and brought him to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, I heard this man reciting Surah al-Furqan in a style different from the one in which you taught me to recite. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told (me) to leave him alone and asked him to recite. He then recited in the style in which I beard him recite it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then said: Thus was it sent down. He then told me to recite and I recited it, and he said: Thus was it sent down. The Qur'an was sent down in seven dialects. So recite what seems easy therefrom
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ الْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيَّ، أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّهُمَا، سَمِعَا عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَكِيمٍ، يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفُرْقَانِ فِي حَيَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَزَادَ فَكِدْتُ أُسَاوِرُهُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَتَصَبَّرْتُ حَتَّى سَلَّمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna almiswara bna makhramaaa, wa'abda alrrahmani bna 'abdin alqaariyya, aakhbaraahu aannahumaa, sami'aa 'umara bna alkhattaabi, yaquwlu sami'tu hishaama bna hakiymin, yaqraau suwraaa alfurqaani fiy hayaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bimithlihi wazaada fakidtu ausaawiruhu fiy alssalaaai fatasabbartu hattaa sallama ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted thus by 'Umar b. Khattab (with a slight change of words):" I heard Hisham b. Hakim reciting Surah al-Furqan during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." The rest is the same but with this addition:" I was about to catch hold of him in prayer, but I exercised patience till he pronounced salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، كَرِوَايَةِ يُونُسَ بِإِسْنَادِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, kariwaayaai yuwnusa biiisnaadihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Zuhri
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقْرَأَنِي جِبْرِيلُ - عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَلَى حَرْفٍ فَرَاجَعْتُهُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أَسْتَزِيدُهُ فَيَزِيدُنِي حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ تِلْكَ السَّبْعَةَ الأَحْرُفَ إِنَّمَا هِيَ فِي الأَمْرِ الَّذِي يَكُونُ وَاحِدًا لاَ يَخْتَلِفُ فِي حَلاَلٍ وَلاَ حَرَامٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna abna 'abbaasin, haddathahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aaqraaaniy jibriylu - 'alayhi alssalaamu - 'alaa harfin faraaja'tuhu falam aazal aastaziyduhu fayaziyduniy hattaa antahaa iilaa sab'aai aahrufin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin balaghaniy aanna tilka alssab'aaa alaahrufa iinnamaa hiya fiy alaamri alladhiy yakuwnu waahidana laa yakhtalifu fiy halaalin walaa haraamin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Gabriel taught me to recite in one style. I replied to him and kept asking him to give more (styles), till he reached seven modes (of recitation). Ibn Shibab said: It has reached me that these seven styles are essentially one, not differing about what is permitted and what is forbidden
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of trans- mitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَدَخَلَ رَجُلٌ يُصَلِّي فَقَرَأَ قِرَاءَةً أَنْكَرْتُهَا عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ آخَرُ فَقَرَأَ قِرَاءَةً سِوَى قِرَاءَةِ صَاحِبِهِ فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا الصَّلاَةَ دَخَلْنَا جَمِيعًا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ هَذَا قَرَأَ قِرَاءَةً أَنْكَرْتُهَا عَلَيْهِ وَدَخَلَ آخَرُ فَقَرَأَ سِوَى قِرَاءَةِ صَاحِبِهِ فَأَمَرَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَءَا فَحَسَّنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَأْنَهُمَا فَسُقِطَ فِي نَفْسِي مِنَ التَّكْذِيبِ وَلاَ إِذْ كُنْتُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَلَمَّا رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا قَدْ غَشِيَنِي ضَرَبَ فِي صَدْرِي فَفِضْتُ عَرَقًا وَكَأَنَّمَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَرَقًا فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ يَا أُبَىُّ أُرْسِلَ إِلَىَّ أَنِ اقْرَإِ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى حَرْفٍ فَرَدَدْتُ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ هَوِّنْ عَلَى أُمَّتِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy khaalidin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'iysaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an jaddihi, 'an aubaaai bni ka'bin, qaala kuntu fiy almasjidi fadakhala rajulun yusalliy faqaraaa qiraa'aaan aankartuhaa 'alayhi thumma dakhala akharu faqaraaa qiraa'aaan siwaa qiraa'aai saahibihi falammaa qadaynaa alssalaaaa dakhalnaa jamiy'ana 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu iinna hadhaa qaraaa qiraa'aaan aankartuhaa 'alayhi wadakhala akharu faqaraaa siwaa qiraa'aai saahibihi faaamarahumaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqara'aa fahassana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm shaanahumaa fasuqita fiy nafsiy mina alttakdhiybi walaa iidh kuntu fiy aljaahiliyyaai falammaa raaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa qad ghashiyaniy daraba fiy sadriy fafidtu 'araqana wakaaannamaa aanzuru iilaa alllahi 'azza wajalla faraqana faqaala liy ‏"‏ yaa aubaaau aursila iilaaaa aani aqraii alqurana 'alaa harfin faradadtu iilayhi aan hawwin 'alaa aummatiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported:I was in the mosque when a man entered and prayed and recited (the Qur'in) in a style to which I objected. Then another man entered (the mosque) and recited in a style different from that of his companion. When we had finished the prayer, we all went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him: This man recited in a style to which I objected, and the other entered and recited in a style different from that of his companion. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked them to recite and so they recited, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) expressed approval of their affairs (their modes of recitation). and there occurred In my mind a sort of denial which did not occur even during the Days of Ignorance. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saw how I was affected (by a wrong idea), he struck my chest, whereupon I broke into sweating and felt as though I were looking at Allah with fear. He (the Holy Prophet) said to me: Ubayy. a message was sent to me to recite the Qur'an in one dialect, and I replied: Make (things) easy for my people. It was conveyed to me for the second time that it should be recited in two dialects. I again replied to him: Make affairs easy for my people. It was again conveyed to me for the third time to recite in seven dialects And (I was further told): You have got a seeking for every reply that I sent you, which you should seek from Me. I said: O Allah! forgive my people, forgive my people, and I have deferred the third one for the day on which the entire creation will turn to me, including even Ibrahim (peace be upon him) (for intercession)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي، خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِيسَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، أَخْبَرَنِي أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ جَالِسًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ إِذْ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَصَلَّى فَقَرَأَ قِرَاءَةً وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathaniy iismaa'iylu bnu aabiy, khaalidin haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'iysaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, aakhbaraniy aubaaau bnu ka'bin, aannahu kaana jaalisana fiy almasjidi iidh dakhala rajulun fasallaa faqaraaa qiraa'aaan waaqtassa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythi abni numayrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported that he was sitting in a mosque that a person entered it and he observed prayer, and made recitation, the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ عِنْدَ أَضَاةِ بَنِي غِفَارٍ - قَالَ - فَأَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ أُمَّتُكَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى حَرْفٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ مُعَافَاتَهُ وَمَغْفِرَتَهُ وَإِنَّ أُمَّتِي لاَ تُطِيقُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ الثَّانِيَةَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ أُمَّتُكَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى حَرْفَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ مُعَافَاتَهُ وَمَغْفِرَتَهُ وَإِنَّ أُمَّتِي لاَ تُطِيقُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ أُمَّتُكَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى ثَلاَثَةِ أَحْرُفٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ مُعَافَاتَهُ وَمَغْفِرَتَهُ وَإِنَّ أُمَّتِي لاَ تُطِيقُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ الرَّابِعَةَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ أُمَّتُكَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَحْرُفٍ فَأَيُّمَا حَرْفٍ قَرَءُوا عَلَيْهِ فَقَدْ أَصَابُوا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaahu abnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'an aubaaai bni ka'bin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana 'inda aadaaai baniy ghifaarin - qaala - faaataahu jibriylu 'alayhi alssalaamu faqaala iinna alllaha yaamuruka aan taqraaa aummatuka alqurana 'alaa harfin ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aasaalu alllaha mu'aafaatahu wamaghfiratahu waiinna aummatiy laa tutiyqu dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aataahu althhaaniyaaa faqaala iinna alllaha yaamuruka aan taqraaa aummatuka alqurana 'alaa harfayni faqaala ‏"‏ aasaalu alllaha mu'aafaatahu wamaghfiratahu waiinna aummatiy laa tutiyqu dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma jaa'ahu althhaalithaaa faqaala iinna alllaha yaamuruka aan taqraaa aummatuka alqurana 'alaa thalaathaai aahrufin ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aasaalu alllaha mu'aafaatahu wamaghfiratahu waiinna aummatiy laa tutiyqu dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma jaa'ahu alrraabi'aaa faqaala iinna alllaha yaamuruka aan taqraaa aummatuka alqurana 'alaa sab'aai aahrufin faaayyumaa harfin qara'uwa 'alayhi faqad aasaabuwa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was near the tank of Banu Ghifar that Gabriel came to him and said:Allah has commanded you to recite to your people the Qur'an in one dialect. Upon this he said: I ask from Allah pardon and forgiveness. My people are not capable of doing it. He then came for the second time and said: Allah has commanded you that you should recite the Qur'an to your people in two dialects. Upon this he (the Holy prophet) again said: I seek pardon and forgiveness from Allah, my people would not be able to do so. He (Gabriel) came for the third time and said: Allah has commanded you to recite the Qur'an to your people in three dialects. Upon this he said: I ask pardon and forgiveness from Allah. My people would not be able to do it. He then came to him for the fourth time and said: Allah has commanded you to recite the Qur'an to your people in seven dialects, and in whichever dialect they would recite, they would be right
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ نَهِيكُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ كَيْفَ تَقْرَأُ هَذَا الْحَرْفَ أَلِفًا تَجِدُهُ أَمْ يَاءً مِنْ مَاءٍ غَيْرِ آسِنٍ أَوْ مِنْ مَاءٍ غَيْرِ يَاسِنٍ قَالَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَكُلَّ الْقُرْآنِ قَدْ أَحْصَيْتَ غَيْرَ هَذَا قَالَ إِنِّي لأَقْرَأُ الْمُفَصَّلَ فِي رَكْعَةٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هَذًّا كَهَذِّ الشِّعْرِ إِنَّ أَقْوَامًا يَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لاَ يُجَاوِزُ تَرَاقِيَهُمْ وَلَكِنْ إِذَا وَقَعَ فِي الْقَلْبِ فَرَسَخَ فِيهِ نَفَعَ إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الصَّلاَةِ الرُّكُوعُ وَالسُّجُودُ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ النَّظَائِرَ الَّتِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرُنُ بَيْنَهُنَّ سُورَتَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَدَخَلَ عَلْقَمَةُ فِي إِثْرِهِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَقَالَ قَدْ أَخْبَرَنِي بِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي بَجِيلَةَ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ نَهِيكُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin jamiy'ana 'an wakiy'in, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa wakiy'un, - 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, qaala jaa'a rajulun yuqaalu lahu nahiyku bnu sinaanin iilaa 'abdi alllahi faqaala yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani kayfa taqraau hadhaa alharfa aalifana tajiduhu aam yaa'an min maa'in ghayri asinin aaw min maa'in ghayri yaasinin qaala faqaala 'abdu alllahi wakulla alqurani qad aahsayta ghayra hadhaa qaala iinniy laaqraau almufassala fiy rak'aain ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi hadhhana kahadhhi alshhi'ri iinna aaqwaamana yaqra'uwna alqurana laa yujaawizu taraaqiyahum walakin iidhaa waqa'a fiy alqalbi farasakha fiyhi nafa'a iinna aafdala alssalaaai alrrukuw'u waalssujuwdu iinniy laa'lamu alnnazaaiira allatiy kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqrunu baynahunna suwratayni fiy kulli rak'aain ‏.‏ thumma qaama 'abdu alllahi fadakhala 'alqamaau fiy iithrihi thumma kharaja faqaala qad aakhbaraniy bihaa ‏.‏ qaala abnu numayrin fiy riwaayatihi jaa'a rajulun min baniy bajiylaaa iilaa 'abdi alllahi walam yaqul nahiyku bnu sinaanin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Wa'il reported that a person named Nabik b. Sinan came to Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) and said:Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, how do you recite this word (alif) or (ya)? Would you read It as: min ma'in ghaira asin or au min ma'in ghaira ghaira yasin. (al-Qur'an, xlvii. 15)? 'Abdullah said: You (seem to) have memorised the whole of the Qur'an except this. He (again) said: I recite all the mufassal surahs in one rak'ah. Upon this 'Abdullah said: (You must have been reciting It) hastily like the recitation of poetry. Verily. there are people who recite the Qur'an, but it does not go down beyond their collar bones. It is (a fact with the Qur'an) that it is beneficial only when it settles in the heart and is rooted deeply in it. The best of (the acts) in prayer are bowing and prostration. I am quite aware of the occasions when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) combined together two surahs in every rak'ah. 'Abdullah then stood up and went out with 'Alqama following in his footstep. He said Ibn Numair had told him that the narration was like that:" A person belonging to Banu Bajila came to 'Abdullah," and he did not mention (the name of) Nahik b. Sinan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُقَالُ لَهُ نَهِيكُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَجَاءَ عَلْقَمَةُ لِيَدْخُلَ عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ سَلْهُ عَنِ النَّظَائِرِ الَّتِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ بِهَا فِي رَكْعَةٍ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ فَسَأَلَهُ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ عِشْرُونَ سُورَةً مِنَ الْمُفَصَّلِ فِي تَأْلِيفِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa 'abdi alllahi yuqaalu lahu nahiyku bnu sinaanin ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi wakiy'in ghayra aannahu qaala fajaa'a 'alqamaau liyadkhula 'alayhi faqulnaa lahu salhu 'ani alnnazaaiiri allatiy kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau bihaa fiy rak'aain fadakhala 'alayhi fasaaalahu thumma kharaja 'alaynaa faqaala 'ishruwna suwraaan mina almufassali fiy taaliyfi 'abdi alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Wa'il reported:A person came to 'Abdullah, who was called Nahik b. Sinan, and the rest of the hadith is the same but for this:" Alqama came to him ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) and we said to him: Ask him about the manners in which he combined (two surahs) in one rak'ah. So he went to him and asked him and then came to us and said: Twenty are the mufassal surahs in the compilation (of the Qur'an) made by 'Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمَا وَقَالَ إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ النَّظَائِرَ الَّتِي كَانَ يَقْرَأُ بِهِنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اثْنَتَيْنِ فِي رَكْعَةٍ ‏.‏ عِشْرِينَ سُورَةً فِي عَشْرِ رَكَعَاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihimaa waqaala iinniy laa'rifu alnnazaaiira allatiy kaana yaqraau bihinna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm athnatayni fiy rak'aain ‏.‏ 'ishriyna suwraaan fiy 'ashri raka'aatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters in which ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) said:" I know the manners in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the two surahs in one rak'ah and then twenty surahs in ten rak'ahs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلٌ الأَحْدَبُ، عَنْ أَبِي، وَائِلٍ قَالَ غَدَوْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ يَوْمًا بَعْدَ مَا صَلَّيْنَا الْغَدَاةَ فَسَلَّمْنَا بِالْبَابِ فَأَذِنَ لَنَا - قَالَ - فَمَكَثْنَا بِالْبَابِ هُنَيَّةً - قَالَ - فَخَرَجَتِ الْجَارِيَةُ فَقَالَتْ أَلاَ تَدْخُلُونَ فَدَخَلْنَا فَإِذَا هُوَ جَالِسٌ يُسَبِّحُ فَقَالَ مَا مَنَعَكُمْ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا وَقَدْ أُذِنَ لَكُمْ فَقُلْنَا لاَ إِلاَّ أَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنَّ بَعْضَ أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ نَائِمٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ظَنَنْتُمْ بِآلِ ابْنِ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ غَفْلَةً قَالَ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ يُسَبِّحُ حَتَّى ظَنَّ أَنَّ الشَّمْسَ قَدْ طَلَعَتْ فَقَالَ يَا جَارِيَةُ انْظُرِي هَلْ طَلَعَتْ قَالَ فَنَظَرَتْ فَإِذَا هِيَ لَمْ تَطْلُعْ فَأَقْبَلَ يُسَبِّحُ حَتَّى إِذَا ظَنَّ أَنَّ الشَّمْسَ قَدْ طَلَعَتْ قَالَ يَا جَارِيَةُ انْظُرِي هَلْ طَلَعَتْ فَنَظَرَتْ فَإِذَا هِيَ قَدْ طَلَعَتْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هَذَا - فَقَالَ مَهْدِيٌّ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ - وَلَمْ يُهْلِكْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا - قَالَ - فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ قَرَأْتُ الْمُفَصَّلَ الْبَارِحَةَ كُلَّهُ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هَذًّا كَهَذِّ الشِّعْرِ إِنَّا لَقَدْ سَمِعْنَا الْقَرَائِنَ وَإِنِّي لأَحْفَظُ الْقَرَائِنَ الَّتِي كَانَ يَقْرَؤُهُنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ مِنَ الْمُفَصَّلِ وَسُورَتَيْنِ مِنْ آلِ حم
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa mahdiyyu bnu maymuwnin, haddathanaa waasilun alaahdabu, 'an aabiy, waaiilin qaala ghadawnaa 'alaa 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin yawmana ba'da maa sallaynaa alghadaaaa fasallamnaa bialbaabi faaadhina lanaa - qaala - famakathnaa bialbaabi hunayyaaan - qaala - fakharajati aljaariyaau faqaalat aalaa tadkhuluwna fadakhalnaa faiidhaa huwa jaalisun yusabbihu faqaala maa mana'akum aan tadkhuluwa waqad audhina lakum faqulnaa laa iilaaa aannaa zanannaa aanna ba'da aahli albayti naaiimun ‏.‏ qaala zanantum biali abni aummi 'abdin ghaflaaan qaala thumma aaqbala yusabbihu hattaa zanna aanna alshhamsa qad tala'at faqaala yaa jaariyaau anzuriy hal tala'at qaala fanazarat faiidhaa hiya lam tatlu' faaaqbala yusabbihu hattaa iidhaa zanna aanna alshhamsa qad tala'at qaala yaa jaariyaau anzuriy hal tala'at fanazarat faiidhaa hiya qad tala'at ‏.‏ faqaala alhamdu lillahi alladhiy aaqaalanaa yawmanaa hadhaa - faqaala mahdiyyun waaahsibuhu qaala - walam yuhliknaa bidhunuwbinaa - qaala - faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi qaraatu almufassala albaarihaaa kullahu - qaala - faqaala 'abdu alllahi hadhhana kahadhhi alshhi'ri iinnaa laqad sami'naa alqaraaiina waiinniy laahfazu alqaraaiina allatiy kaana yaqrauuhunna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thamaaniyaaa 'ashara mina almufassali wasuwratayni min ali hm
verses.translation: Abu Wa'il reported:One day we went to 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud after we had observed the dawn prayer and we paid salutation at the door. He permitted us to enter, but we stayed for a while at the door, when the slave-girl came out and said: Why don't you come in? So we went in and (we found 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud) sitting and glorifying Allah (i. e. he was busy in dhikr) and he said: What obstructed you from coming in though you had been granted permission for it? We said: There was nothing (behind it) but we entertained the idea that some inmate of the house might be sleeping. He said: Do you presume any idleness on the part of the family of Ibn Umm 'Abd (the mother of Abdullah b. Mas'ud)? He was again busy with the glorification of Allah till he thought that the sun had risen. He said: Girl, see whether (the sun) has arisen. She glanced but it had not risen (by that time). He was again busy with the glorification (of Allah) and he (again) thought that the sun had arisen. She glanced (and confirmed) that, it had risen. Upon this he ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) said: Praise be to Allah Who did not call us to account for our sins today. Mahdi said: I think that he said, He did not destroy us for our sins. One among the people said: I recited all the mufassal surahs during the night. 'Abdullah said: (You must have recited them) like the (recitation) of poetry. I heard (the Holy Prophet) combining (the sarahs) and I remember the combinations which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made In the recitation (of surahs). These were constituted of eighteen mufassal surahs and two surahs (commencing with) Ha-Mim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجُعْفِيُّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي بَجِيلَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ نَهِيكُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَقْرَأُ الْمُفَصَّلَ فِي رَكْعَةٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هَذًّا كَهَذِّ الشِّعْرِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ النَّظَائِرَ الَّتِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ بِهِنَّ سُورَتَيْنِ فِي رَكْعَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin alju'fiyyu, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an mansuwrin, 'an shaqiyqin, qaala jaa'a rajulun min baniy bajiylaaa yuqaalu lahu nahiyku bnu sinaanin iilaa 'abdi alllahi faqaala iinniy aaqraau almufassala fiy rak'aain ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi hadhhana kahadhhi alshhi'ri laqad 'alimtu alnnazaaiira allatiy kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau bihinna suwratayni fiy rak'aain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shaqiq reported:A person from Banu Bajila who was called Nabik b. Sinan came to Abdullah and said: I recite mufassal surahs in one rak'ah. Upon this 'Abdullah said: (You recite) like the recitation of poetry. I know the manner in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited two surahs in one rak'ah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، جَاءَ إِلَى ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي قَرَأْتُ الْمُفَصَّلَ اللَّيْلَةَ كُلَّهُ فِي رَكْعَةٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هَذًّا كَهَذِّ الشِّعْرِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَرَفْتُ النَّظَائِرَ الَّتِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرُنُ بَيْنَهُنَّ - قَالَ - فَذَكَرَ عِشْرِينَ سُورَةً مِنَ الْمُفَصَّلِ سُورَتَيْنِ سُورَتَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, aannahu sami'a aabaa waaiilin, yuhaddithu aanna rajulaan, jaa'a iilaa abni mas'uwdin faqaala iinniy qaraatu almufassala alllaylaaa kullahu fiy rak'aain ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi hadhhana kahadhhi alshhi'ri faqaala 'abdu alllahi laqad 'araftu alnnazaaiira allatiy kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqrunu baynahunna - qaala - fadhakara 'ishriyna suwraaan mina almufassali suwratayni suwratayni fiy kulli rak'aain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Wa'il reported:A person came to 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud and said: I recited all the mufassal surahs in one rak'ah during the night. 'Abdullah said: You must have recited hastily like the recitation of poetry. 'Abdullah said: I remember well the manner in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to combine them, and he then mentioned twenty of the mufassal surahs, and (their combinations in) two in every rak'ah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ الأَسْوَدَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ وَهُوَ يُعَلِّمُ الْقُرْآنَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ كَيْفَ تَقْرَأُ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ أَدَالاً أَمْ ذَالاً قَالَ بَلْ دَالاً سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مُدَّكِرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ دَالاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, qaala raaaytu rajulaan saaala alaaswada bna yaziyda wahuwa yu'allimu alqurana fiy almasjidi faqaala kayfa taqraau hadhihi alayaaa fahal min muddakirin aadaalaan aam dhaalaan qaala bal daalaan sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ muddakirin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ daalaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ishaq reported:I saw a man asking Aswad b. Yazid who taught the Qur'an in the mosque: How do you recite the verse (fahal min muddakir) whether (the word muddakir) Is with (d) or (dh)? He (Aswad) said: It was with (d). I heard Abdullah b. Mas'ud saying that he had heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting (muddakir) with (d)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ هَذَا الْحَرْفَ ‏ "‏ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yaqraau hadhaa alharfa ‏ "‏ fahal min muddakirin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ishaq is reported to have said on the authority of Aswad who quoted on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite these words as (fahal min muddakir)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ قَدِمْنَا الشَّامَ فَأَتَانَا أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ فَقَالَ أَفِيكُمْ أَحَدٌ يَقْرَأُ عَلَى قِرَاءَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَيْفَ سَمِعْتَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ يَقْرَأُ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى‏}‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى * وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَنَا وَاللَّهِ هَكَذَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَؤُهَا وَلَكِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ وَمَا خَلَقَ ‏.‏ فَلاَ أُتَابِعُهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala qadimnaa alshhaama faaataanaa aabuw alddardaa'i faqaala aafiykum aahadun yaqraau 'alaa qiraa'aai 'abdi alllahi faqultu na'am aanaa ‏.‏ qaala fakayfa sami'ta 'abda alllahi yaqraau hadhihi alayaaa ‏{‏ waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa‏}‏ qaala sami'tuhu yaqraau ‏{‏ waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa * waaldhhakari waalaunthaa‏}‏ ‏.‏ qaala waaanaa waalllahi hakadhaa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqrauuhaa walakin hauulaa'i yuriyduwna aan aaqraaa wamaa khalaqa ‏.‏ falaa autaabi'uhum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Alqama reported. We went to Syria and Abu Darda' came to us and said:Is there anyone among you who recites according to the recitation of Abdullah? I said: Yes, it is I. He again said: How did you hear 'Abdullah reciting this verse: (wa'l-lail-i-idha yaghsha = when the night covers)? He ('Alqama) said: I heard him reciting it (like this) (wa'l-lail-i-idha yaghsha) wa-dhakar wal untha = when the night covers and the males and the females). Upon this he said: By Allah, I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting in this way, but they (the Muslims of Syria) desire us to recite: (wa ma khalaqa), but I do not yield to their desire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَتَى عَلْقَمَةُ الشَّامَ فَدَخَلَ مَسْجِدًا فَصَلَّى فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى حَلْقَةٍ فَجَلَسَ فِيهَا - قَالَ - فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَعَرَفْتُ فِيهِ تَحَوُّشَ الْقَوْمِ وَهَيْئَتَهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَلَسَ إِلَى جَنْبِي ثُمَّ قَالَ أَتَحْفَظُ كَمَا كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَقْرَأُ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mughiyraaa, 'an iibraahiyma, qaala aataa 'alqamaau alshhaama fadakhala masjidana fasallaa fiyhi thumma qaama iilaa halqaain fajalasa fiyhaa - qaala - fajaa'a rajulun fa'araftu fiyhi tahawwusha alqawmi wahayiatahum ‏.‏ qaala fajalasa iilaa janbiy thumma qaala aatahfazu kamaa kaana 'abdu alllahi yaqraau fadhakara bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibrahim reported:'Alqama came to Syria and entered the mosque and prayed there and then went to a (place where people were sitting in a) circle and he sat therein. Then a person came there and I perceived that the people were annoyed and perturbed (on this arrival). and he sat on my side and then said: Do you remember how 'Abdullah used to recite (the Qur'an)? And then the rest of the hadith was narrated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي، هِنْدٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ لَقِيتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ فَقَالَ لِي مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ قُلْتُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ ‏.‏ قَالَ مِنْ أَيِّهِمْ قُلْتُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَلْ تَقْرَأُ عَلَى قِرَاءَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاقْرَأْ ‏{‏ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى‏}‏ قَالَ فَقَرَأْتُ ‏{‏ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى * وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى * وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَحِكَ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَكَذَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَؤُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an daawuda bni aabiy, hindin 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala laqiytu aabaa alddardaa'i faqaala liy mimman aanta qultu min aahli al'iraaqi ‏.‏ qaala min aayyihim qultu min aahli alkuwfaai ‏.‏ qaala hal taqraau 'alaa qiraa'aai 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin qaala qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala faaqraa ‏{‏ waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa‏}‏ qaala faqaraatu ‏{‏ waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa * waalnnahaari iidhaa tajallaa * waaldhhakari waalaunthaa‏}‏ ‏.‏ qaala fadahika thumma qaala hakadhaa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqrauuhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Alqama reported:I met Abu Darda', and he said to me: To which country do you belong? I said: I am one of the people of Iraq. He again said: To which city? I replied: City of Kufa. He again said: Do you recite according to the recitation of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud? I said: Yes. He said: Recite this verse (By the night when it covers) So I recited it: (By the night when it covers, and the day when it shines, and the creating of the male and the female). He laughed and said: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting like this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ الشَّامَ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa daawudu, 'an 'aamirin, 'an 'alqamaaa, qaala aataytu alshhaama falaqiytu aabaa alddardaa'i fadhakara bimithli hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ وَعَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an muhammadi bni yahyaa bni habbaana, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alssalaaai ba'da al'asri hattaa taghruba alshhamsu wa'ani alssalaaai ba'da alssubhi hattaa tatlu'a alshhamsu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira is reported to have said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited to observe prayer after the 'Asr prayer till the sun is set, and after the dawn till the sun rises
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ، - قَالَ دَاوُدُ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، - أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ غَيْرَ، وَاحِدٍ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهُمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَكَانَ أَحَبَّهُمْ إِلَىَّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ وَبَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa daawudu bnu rushaydin, waiismaa'iylu bnu saalimin, jamiy'ana 'an hushaymin, - qaala daawudu haddathanaa hushaymun, - aakhbaranaa mansuwrun, 'an qataadaaa, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw al'aaliyaai, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala sami'tu ghayra, waahidin, min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm minhum 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi wakaana aahabbahum iilaaaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alssalaaai ba'da alfajri hattaa tatlu'a alshhamsu waba'da al'asri hattaa taghruba alshhamsu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:I heard it from so many Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and one among them is 'Umar b. Khattab, and he is most dear to me among them that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited observing of prayer after the dawn prayer till the sun rose and after the 'Asr till the sun set
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ، الْمِسْمَعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ، بْنُ هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي كُلُّهُمْ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ وَهِشَامٍ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَشْرُقَ الشَّمْسُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathaniy aabuw ghassaana, almisma'iyyu haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa mu'aadhu, bnu hishaamin haddathaniy aabiy kulluhum, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythi sa'iydin wahishaamin ba'da alssubhi hattaa tashruqa alshhamsu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters with a minor alteration of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ وَلاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, aanna abna shihaabin, aakhbarahu qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda alllaythiyyu, aannahu sami'a aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa salaaaa ba'da salaaai al'asri hattaa taghruba alshhamsu walaa salaaaa ba'da salaaai alfajri hattaa tatlu'a alshhamsu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:No prayer is valid after the 'Asr prayer till the sun sets and no prayer is valid after the dawn prayer till the sun rises
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَتَحَرَّى أَحَدُكُمْ فَيُصَلِّي عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَلاَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yataharraa aahadukum fayusalliy 'inda tuluw'i alshhamsi walaa 'inda ghuruwbihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Let not any one of you intend to observe prayer at the time of the rising of the sun or of the setting sun
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَحَرَّوْا بِصَلاَتِكُمْ طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَلاَ غُرُوبَهَا فَإِنَّهَا تَطْلُعُ بِقَرْنَىْ شَيْطَانٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni, numayrin haddathanaa aabiy wamuhammadu bnu bishrin, qaalaa jamiy'ana haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taharrawa bisalaatikum tuluw'a alshhamsi walaa ghuruwbahaa faiinnahaa tatlu'u biqarnaa shaytaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not intend to observe prayer at the time of the rising of the sun nor at its setting, for it rises between the horns of Satan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَابْنُ، بِشْرٍ قَالُوا جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا بَدَا حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَأَخِّرُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَبْرُزَ وَإِذَا غَابَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَأَخِّرُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni, numayrin haddathanaa aabiy waabnu, bishrin qaaluwa jamiy'ana haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa badaa haajibu alshhamsi faaakhhiruwa alssalaaaa hattaa tabruza waiidhaa ghaaba haajibu alshhamsi faaakhhiruwa alssalaaaa hattaa taghiyba ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When the rim of the sun starts appearing defer prayer till it completely appears, and when the rim of the sun disappears defer prayer till it completely disappears
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ خَيْرِ بْنِ نُعَيْمٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ هُبَيْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي تَمِيمٍ الْجَيْشَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَصْرَةَ الْغِفَارِيِّ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَصْرَ بِالْمُخَمَّصِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الصَّلاَةَ عُرِضَتْ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَضَيَّعُوهَا فَمَنْ حَافَظَ عَلَيْهَا كَانَ لَهُ أَجْرُهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَهَا حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الشَّاهِدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَالشَّاهِدُ النَّجْمُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an khayri bni nu'aymin alhadramiyyi, 'ani abni hubayraaa, 'an aabiy tamiymin aljayshaaniyyi, 'an aabiy basraaa alghifaariyyi, qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'asra bialmukhammasi faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna hadhihi alssalaaaa 'uridat 'alaa man kaana qablakum fadayya'uwhaa faman haafaza 'alayhaa kaana lahu aajruhu marratayni walaa salaaaa ba'dahaa hattaa yatlu'a alshhaahidu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waalshhaahidu alnnajmu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Basra Ghifari reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in the 'Asr prayer at (the place known as) Mukhammas, and then said: This prayer was presented to those gone before you, but they lost it, and he who guards it has two rewards in store for him. And no prayer is valid after till the onlooker appears (by onlooker is meant the evening star)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ خَيْرِ بْنِ نُعَيْمٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ هُبَيْرَةَ السَّبَائِيِّ، - وَكَانَ ثِقَةً - عَنْ أَبِي تَمِيمٍ الْجَيْشَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَصْرَةَ الْغِفَارِيِّ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَصْرَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani abni iishaaqa, qaala haddathaniy yaziydu bnu aabiy habiybin, 'an khayri bni nu'aymin alhadramiyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni hubayraaa alssabaaiiyyi, - wakaana thiqaaan - 'an aabiy tamiymin aljayshaaniyyi, 'an aabiy basraaa alghifaariyyi, qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'asra ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Basra Ghifari through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُلَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ ثَلاَثُ سَاعَاتٍ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَانَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ فِيهِنَّ أَوْ أَنْ نَقْبُرَ فِيهِنَّ مَوْتَانَا حِينَ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ بَازِغَةً حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ وَحِينَ يَقُومُ قَائِمُ الظَّهِيرَةِ حَتَّى تَمِيلَ الشَّمْسُ وَحِينَ تَضَيَّفُ الشَّمْسُ لِلْغُرُوبِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an muwsaa bni 'ulaaain, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu 'uqbaaa bna 'aamirin aljuhaniyya, yaquwlu thalaathu saa'aatin kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaanaa aan nusalliya fiyhinna aaw aan naqbura fiyhinna mawtaanaa hiyna tatlu'u alshhamsu baazighaaan hattaa tartafi'a wahiyna yaquwmu qaaiimu alzzahiyraai hattaa tamiyla alshhamsu wahiyna tadayyafu alshhamsu lilghuruwbi hattaa taghruba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. 'Amir said:There were three times at which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to pray, or bury our dead: When the sun begins to rise till it is fully up, when the sun is at its height at midday till it passes over the meridian, and when the sun draws near to setting till it sets
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمَعْقِرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَدَّادُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَبُو عَمَّارٍ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، - قَالَ عِكْرِمَةُ وَلَقِيَ شَدَّادٌ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ وَوَاثِلَةَ وَصَحِبَ أَنَسًا إِلَى الشَّامِ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ فَضْلاً وَخَيْرًا - عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ قَالَ قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَسَةَ السُّلَمِيُّ كُنْتُ وَأَنَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَظُنُّ أَنَّ النَّاسَ عَلَى ضَلاَلَةٍ وَأَنَّهُمْ لَيْسُوا عَلَى شَىْءٍ وَهُمْ يَعْبُدُونَ الأَوْثَانَ فَسَمِعْتُ بِرَجُلٍ بِمَكَّةَ يُخْبِرُ أَخْبَارًا فَقَعَدْتُ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِي فَقَدِمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُسْتَخْفِيًا جُرَءَاءُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمُهُ فَتَلَطَّفْتُ حَتَّى دَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ بِمَكَّةَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ مَا أَنْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا نَبِيٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَمَا نَبِيٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَرْسَلَنِي اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَبِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ أَرْسَلَكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَرْسَلَنِي بِصِلَةِ الأَرْحَامِ وَكَسْرِ الأَوْثَانِ وَأَنْ يُوَحَّدَ اللَّهُ لاَ يُشْرَكُ بِهِ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهُ فَمَنْ مَعَكَ عَلَى هَذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ حُرٌّ وَعَبْدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَعَهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَبِلاَلٌ مِمَّنْ آمَنَ بِهِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي مُتَّبِعُكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَسْتَطِيعُ ذَلِكَ يَوْمَكَ هَذَا أَلاَ تَرَى حَالِي وَحَالَ النَّاسِ وَلَكِنِ ارْجِعْ إِلَى أَهْلِكَ فَإِذَا سَمِعْتَ بِي قَدْ ظَهَرْتُ فَأْتِنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَهَبْتُ إِلَى أَهْلِي وَقَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَكُنْتُ فِي أَهْلِي فَجَعَلْتُ أَتَخَبَّرُ الأَخْبَارَ وَأَسْأَلُ النَّاسَ حِينَ قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ حَتَّى قَدِمَ عَلَىَّ نَفَرٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ يَثْرِبَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقُلْتُ مَا فَعَلَ هَذَا الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ فَقَالُوا النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ سِرَاعٌ وَقَدْ أَرَادَ قَوْمُهُ قَتْلَهُ فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِيعُوا ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ فَقَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَعْرِفُنِي قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ أَنْتَ الَّذِي لَقِيتَنِي بِمَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ بَلَى ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي عَمَّا عَلَّمَكَ اللَّهُ وَأَجْهَلُهُ ‏.‏ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ صَلِّ صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ ثُمَّ أَقْصِرْ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ فَإِنَّهَا تَطْلُعُ حِينَ تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَىْ شَيْطَانٍ وَحِينَئِذٍ يَسْجُدُ لَهَا الْكُفَّارُ ثُمَّ صَلِّ فَإِنَّ الصَّلاَةَ مَشْهُودَةٌ مَحْضُورَةٌ حَتَّى يَسْتَقِلَّ الظِّلُّ بِالرُّمْحِ ثُمَّ أَقْصِرْ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّ حِينَئِذٍ تُسْجَرُ جَهَنَّمُ فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَ الْفَىْءُ فَصَلِّ فَإِنَّ الصَّلاَةَ مَشْهُودَةٌ مَحْضُورَةٌ حَتَّى تُصَلِّيَ الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ أَقْصِرْ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ فَإِنَّهَا تَغْرُبُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَىْ شَيْطَانٍ وَحِينَئِذٍ يَسْجُدُ لَهَا الْكُفَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ فَالْوُضُوءُ حَدِّثْنِي عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ يُقَرِّبُ وَضُوءَهُ فَيَتَمَضْمَضُ وَيَسْتَنْشِقُ فَيَنْتَثِرُ إِلاَّ خَرَّتْ خَطَايَا وَجْهِهِ وَفِيهِ وَخَيَاشِيمِهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ كَمَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ خَرَّتْ خَطَايَا وَجْهِهِ مِنْ أَطْرَافِ لِحْيَتِهِ مَعَ الْمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَغْسِلُ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ إِلاَّ خَرَّتْ خَطَايَا يَدَيْهِ مِنْ أَنَامِلِهِ مَعَ الْمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ رَأْسَهُ إِلاَّ خَرَّتْ خَطَايَا رَأْسِهِ مِنْ أَطْرَافِ شَعْرِهِ مَعَ الْمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَغْسِلُ قَدَمَيْهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ إِلاَّ خَرَّتْ خَطَايَا رِجْلَيْهِ مِنْ أَنَامِلِهِ مَعَ الْمَاءِ فَإِنْ هُوَ قَامَ فَصَلَّى فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ وَمَجَّدَهُ بِالَّذِي هُوَ لَهُ أَهْلٌ وَفَرَّغَ قَلْبَهُ لِلَّهِ إِلاَّ انْصَرَفَ مِنْ خَطِيئَتِهِ كَهَيْئَتِهِ يَوْمَ وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَدَّثَ عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَسَةَ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ صَاحِبَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو أُمَامَةَ يَا عَمْرَو بْنَ عَبَسَةَ انْظُرْ مَا تَقُولُ فِي مَقَامٍ وَاحِدٍ يُعْطَى هَذَا الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ عَمْرٌو يَا أَبَا أُمَامَةَ لَقَدْ كَبِرَتْ سِنِّي وَرَقَّ عَظْمِي وَاقْتَرَبَ أَجَلِي وَمَا بِي حَاجَةٌ أَنْ أَكْذِبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلاَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ لَوْ لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا - حَتَّى عَدَّ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ - مَا حَدَّثْتُ بِهِ أَبَدًا وَلَكِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu ja'farin alma'qiriyyu, haddathanaa alnnadru bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau bnu 'ammaarin, haddathanaa shaddaadu bnu 'abdi alllahi aabuw 'ammaarin, wayahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy aumaamaaa, - qaala 'ikrimaau walaqiya shaddaadun aabaa aumaamaaa wawaathilaaa wasahiba aanasana iilaa alshhaami waaathnaa 'alayhi fadlaan wakhayrana - 'an aabiy aumaamaaa qaala qaala 'amruw bnu 'abasaaa alssulamiyyu kuntu waaanaa fiy aljaahiliyyaai aazunnu aanna alnnaasa 'alaa dalaalaain waaannahum laysuwa 'alaa shaa'in wahum ya'buduwna alaawthaana fasami'tu birajulin bimakkaaa yukhbiru aakhbaarana faqa'adtu 'alaa raahilatiy faqadimtu 'alayhi faiidhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mustakhfiyana jura'aa'u 'alayhi qawmuhu fatalattaftu hattaa dakhaltu 'alayhi bimakkaaa faqultu lahu maa aanta qaala ‏"‏ aanaa nabiyyun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu wamaa nabiyyun qaala ‏"‏ aarsalaniy alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu wabiaaaai shaa'in aarsalaka qaala ‏"‏ aarsalaniy bisilaai alaarhaami wakasri alaawthaani waaan yuwahhada alllahu laa yushraku bihi shaa'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu lahu faman ma'aka 'alaa hadhaa qaala ‏"‏ hurrun wa'abdun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wama'ahu yawmaiidhin aabuw bakrin wabilaalun mimman amana bihi ‏.‏ faqultu iinniy muttabi'uka ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinnaka laa tastatiy'u dhalika yawmaka hadhaa aalaa taraa haaliy wahaala alnnaasi walakini arji' iilaa aahlika faiidhaa sami'ta biy qad zahartu faatiniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fadhahabtu iilaa aahliy waqadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa wakuntu fiy aahliy faja'altu aatakhabbaru alaakhbaara waaasaalu alnnaasa hiyna qadima almadiynaaa hattaa qadima 'alaaaa nafarun min aahli yathriba min aahli almadiynaai faqultu maa fa'ala hadhaa alrrajulu alladhiy qadima almadiynaaa faqaaluwa alnnaasu iilayhi siraa'un waqad aaraada qawmuhu qatlahu falam yastatiy'uwa dhalika ‏.‏ faqadimtu almadiynaaa fadakhaltu 'alayhi faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aata'rifuniy qaala ‏"‏ na'am aanta alladhiy laqiytaniy bimakkaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu balaa ‏.‏ faqultu yaa nabiyya alllahi aakhbirniy 'ammaa 'allamaka alllahu waaajhaluhu ‏.‏ aakhbirniy 'ani alssalaaai qaala ‏"‏ salli salaaaa alssubhi thumma aaqsir 'ani alssalaaai hattaa tatlu'a alshhamsu hattaa tartafi'a faiinnahaa tatlu'u hiyna tatlu'u bayna qarnaa shaytaanin wahiynaiidhin yasjudu lahaa alkuffaaru thumma salli faiinna alssalaaaa mashhuwdaaun mahduwraaun hattaa yastaqilla alzzillu bialrrumhi thumma aaqsir 'ani alssalaaai faiinna hiynaiidhin tusjaru jahannamu faiidhaa aaqbala alfaa'u fasalli faiinna alssalaaaa mashhuwdaaun mahduwraaun hattaa tusalliya al'asra thumma aaqsir 'ani alssalaaai hattaa taghruba alshhamsu faiinnahaa taghrubu bayna qarnaa shaytaanin wahiynaiidhin yasjudu lahaa alkuffaaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu yaa nabiyya alllahi faalwuduw'u haddithniy 'anhu qaala ‏"‏ maa minkum rajulun yuqarribu waduw'ahu fayatamadmadu wayastanshiqu fayantathiru iilaaa kharrat khataayaa wajhihi wafiyhi wakhayaashiymihi thumma iidhaa ghasala wajhahu kamaa
