aamarahu alllahu iilaaa kharrat khataayaa wajhihi min aatraafi lihyatihi ma'a almaa'i thumma yaghsilu yadayhi iilaa almirfaqayni iilaaa kharrat khataayaa yadayhi min aanaamilihi ma'a almaa'i thumma yamsahu raasahu iilaaa kharrat khataayaa raasihi min aatraafi sha'rihi ma'a almaa'i thumma yaghsilu qadamayhi iilaa alka'bayni iilaaa kharrat khataayaa rijlayhi min aanaamilihi ma'a almaa'i faiin huwa qaama fasallaa fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi wamajjadahu bialladhiy huwa lahu aahlun wafarragha qalbahu lillahi iilaaa ansarafa min khatiyiatihi kahayiatihi yawma waladathu aummuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fahaddatha 'amruw bnu 'abasaaa bihadhaa alhadiythi aabaa aumaamaaa saahiba rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lahu aabuw aumaamaaa yaa 'amraw bna 'abasaaa anzur maa taquwlu fiy maqaamin waahidin yu'taa hadhaa alrrajulu faqaala 'amrunw yaa aabaa aumaamaaa laqad kabirat sinniy waraqqa 'azmiy waaqtaraba aajaliy wamaa biy haajaaun aan aakdhiba 'alaa alllahi walaa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi law lam aasma'hu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa marraaan aaw marratayni aaw thalaathana - hattaa 'adda sab'a marraatin - maa haddathtu bihi aabadana walakinniy sami'tuhu aakthara min dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr b. 'Abasa Sulami reported:In the state of the Ignorance (before embracing Islam), I used to think that the people were in error and they were not on anything (which may be called the right path) and worshipped the idols. Meanwhile, I heard of a man in Mecca who was giving news (on the basis of his prophetic knowledge) ; so I sat on my ride and went to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was at that time hiding as his people had made life hard for him. I adopted a friendly attitude (towards the Meccans and thus managed) to enter Mecca and go to him (the Holy Prophet) and I said to him: Who are you? He said: I am a Prophet (of Allah). I again said: Who is a Prophet? He said: (I am a Prophet in the sense that) I have been sent by Allah. I said: What is that which you have been sent with? He said: I have been sent to join ties of relationship (with kindness and affection), to break the Idols, and to proclaim the oneness of Allah (in a manner that) nothing is to be associated with Him. I said: Who is with you in this (in these beliefs and practices)? He said: A free man and a slave. He (the narrator) said: Abu Bakr and Bilal were there with him among those who had embraced Islam by that time. I said: I intend to follow you. He said: During these days you would not be able to do so. Don't you see the (hard) condition under which I and (my) people are living? You better go back to your people and when you hear that I have been granted victory, you come to me. So I went to my family. I was in my home when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to Medina. I was among my people and used to seek news and ask people when he arrived in Medina. Then a group of people belonging to Yathrib (Medina) came. I said (to them): How is that person getting on who has come to Medina? They said: The people are hastening to him, while his people (the polytheists of Mecca) planned to kill him, but they could not do so. I (on hearing it) came to Medina and went to him and said: Messenger of Allah, do you recognise me? He said: Yes, you are the same man who met me at Mecca. I said: It is so. I again said: Prophet of Allah, tell me that which Allah has taught you and which I do not know, tell me about the prayer. He said: Observe the dawn prayer, then stop praying when the sun is rising till it is fully up, for when it rises it comes up between the horns of Satan, and the unbelievers prostrate themselves to it at that time. Then pray, for the prayer is witnessed and attended (by angels) till the shadow becomes about the length of a lance; then cease prayer, for at that time Hell is heated up. Then when the shadow moves forward, pray, for the prayer is witnessed and attended by angels, till you pray the afternoon prayer, then cease prayer till the sun sets, for it sets between the horns of devil, and at that time the unbelievers prostrate themselves before it. I said: Apostle of Allah, tell me about ablution also. He said: None of you who uses water for ablution and rinses his mouth, snuffs up water and blows it, but the sins of his face, and his mouth and his nostrils fall out. When he washes his face, as Allah has commanded him, the sins of his face fall out from the end of his beard with water. Then (when) he washes his forearms up to the elbows, the sins of his arms fall out along with water from his finger-tips. And when he wipes his head, the sins of his head fall out from the points of his hair along with water. And (when) he washes his feet up to the ankles, the sins of his feet fall out from his toes along with water. And if he stands to pray and praises Allah, lauds Him and glorifies Him with what becomes Him and shows wholehearted devotion to Allah, his sins would depart leaving him (as innocent) as he was on the day his mother bore him. 'Amr b. 'Abasa narrated this hadith to Abu Umama, a Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and Abu Umama said to him: 'Amr b. 'Abasa, think what you are saying that such (a great reward) is given to a man at one place (only in the act of ablution and prayer). Upon this 'Amr said: Abu Umama, I have grown old and my bones have become weak and I am at the door of death; what impetus is there for me to attribute a lie to Allah and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? Had I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) once, twice, or three times (even seven times), I would have never narrated it, but I have heard it from him on occasions more than these
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ وَهِمَ عُمَرُ إِنَّمَا نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُتَحَرَّى طُلُوعُ الشَّمْسِ وَغُرُوبُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat wahima 'umaru iinnamaa nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yutaharraa tuluw'u alshhamsi waghuruwbuhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that 'Umar misconstrued the fact that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had prohibited the observance of prayer at the time of the rising sun and at the time of its setting
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لَمْ يَدَعْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَتَحَرَّوْا طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَلاَ غُرُوبَهَا فَتُصَلُّوا عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat lam yada' rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alrrak'atayni ba'da al'asri ‏.‏ qaala faqaalat 'aaiishaau qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tataharrawa tuluw'a alshhamsi walaa ghuruwbahaa fatusalluwa 'inda dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not abandon observing two rak'ahs after 'Asr, but she reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not get used to observe prayer at the time of the rising sun and at the time of its setting and (exhorted the Muslims) to pray at their times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنَ أَزْهَرَ وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ أَرْسَلُوهُ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا اقْرَأْ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمَ مِنَّا جَمِيعًا وَسَلْهَا عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ وَقُلْ إِنَّا أُخْبِرْنَا أَنَّكِ تُصَلِّينَهُمَا وَقَدْ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهُمَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَكُنْتُ أَصْرِفُ مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ النَّاسَ عَنْهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ كُرَيْبٌ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهَا وَبَلَّغْتُهَا مَا أَرْسَلُونِي بِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ سَلْ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُمْ بِقَوْلِهَا فَرَدُّونِي إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ بِمِثْلِ مَا أَرْسَلُونِي بِهِ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنْهُمَا ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُهُ يُصَلِّيهِمَا أَمَّا حِينَ صَلاَّهُمَا فَإِنَّهُ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ وَعِنْدِي نِسْوَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي حَرَامٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَصَلاَّهُمَا فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ الْجَارِيَةَ فَقُلْتُ قُومِي بِجَنْبِهِ فَقُولِي لَهُ تَقُولُ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَسْمَعُكَ تَنْهَى عَنْ هَاتَيْنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ وَأَرَاكَ تُصَلِّيهِمَا فَإِنْ أَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ فَاسْتَأْخِرِي عَنْهُ - قَالَ - فَفَعَلَتِ الْجَارِيَةُ فَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ فَاسْتَأْخَرَتْ عَنْهُ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا بِنْتَ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ سَأَلْتِ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ إِنَّهُ أَتَانِي نَاسٌ مِنْ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ بِالإِسْلاَمِ مِنْ قَوْمِهِمْ فَشَغَلُونِي عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ فَهُمَا هَاتَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - 'an bukayrin, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, wa'abda alrrahmani, bna aazhara waalmiswara bna makhramaaa aarsaluwhu iilaa 'aaiishaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa aqraa 'alayhaa alssalaama minnaa jamiy'ana wasalhaa 'ani alrrak'atayni ba'da al'asri waqul iinnaa aukhbirnaa aannaki tusalliynahumaa waqad balaghanaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'anhumaa ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin wakuntu aasrifu ma'a 'umara bni alkhattaabi alnnaasa 'anhaa ‏.‏ qaala kuraybun fadakhaltu 'alayhaa waballaghtuhaa maa aarsaluwniy bihi ‏.‏ faqaalat sal aumma salamaaa ‏.‏ fakharajtu iilayhim faaakhbartuhum biqawlihaa faradduwniy iilaa aummi salamaaa bimithli maa aarsaluwniy bihi iilaa 'aaiishaaa ‏.‏ faqaalat aummu salamaaa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaa 'anhumaa thumma raaaytuhu yusalliyhimaa aammaa hiyna salaaahumaa faiinnahu sallaa al'asra thumma dakhala wa'indiy niswaaun min baniy haraamin mina alaansaari fasalaaahumaa faaarsaltu iilayhi aljaariyaaa faqultu quwmiy bijanbihi faquwliy lahu taquwlu aummu salamaaa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy aasma'uka tanhaa 'an haatayni alrrak'atayni waaaraaka tusalliyhimaa faiin aashaara biyadihi faastaakhiriy 'anhu - qaala - fafa'alati aljaariyaau faaashaara biyadihi faastaakharat 'anhu falammaa ansarafa qaala ‏ "‏ yaa binta aabiy aumayyaaa saaalti 'ani alrrak'atayni ba'da al'asri iinnahu aataaniy naasun min 'abdi alqaysi bialiislaami min qawmihim fashaghaluwniy 'ani alrrak'atayni alllatayni ba'da alzzuhri fahumaa haataani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Kuraib, the freed slave of Ibn 'Abbas, reported that 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas, 'Abd al-Rahman b. Azhar, al-Miswar b. Makhrama sent him to 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), telling him to give her their greetings, and ask her about the two rak'ahs after the afternoon prayer, (for)" we have heard that you observe them whereas it has been conveyed to us that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited their observance." Ibn 'Abbas said:I along with 'Umar b. al-Khattab dissuaded people to do so (to observe two rak'ahs of prayer). Kuraib said: I went to her ('A'isha) and conveyed to her the message with which I was sent. She said: (Better) ask Umm Salama. So I went to them (those who had sent him to Hadrat 'A'isha) and informed them about what she had said. They sent me back to Umm Salama with that with which I was sent to 'A'isha. Umm Salama said: I beard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibiting them, and then afterwards I saw him observing them. And when he observed them (two rak'ahs) he had already observed the 'Asr prayer. Then he (the Holy Prophet) came, while there were with me ladies of Banu Haram, a tribe of the Ansar and he (the Holy Prophet) observed them (the two rak'ahs). I sent a slave-girl to him asking her to stand by his side and say to him that Umm Salama says: Messenger of Allah, I heard you prohibiting these two rak'ahs, whereas I saw you observing them; and if he (the Holy Prophet) points with his hand (to wait), then do wait. The slave-girl did like that. He (the Holy Prophet) pointed out with his hand and she got aside and waited, and when he had finished (the prayer) he said: Daughter of Abu Umayya. you have asked about the two rak'ahs after the 'Asr prayer. Some people of 'Abu al-Qais came to me for embracing Islam and hindered me from observing the two rak'ahs which come after the noon prayer. So those are the two I have been praying
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي حَرْمَلَةَ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ، كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّيهِمَا بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَقَالَتْ كَانَ يُصَلِّيهِمَا قَبْلَ الْعَصْرِ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ شُغِلَ عَنْهُمَا أَوْ نَسِيَهُمَا فَصَلاَّهُمَا بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ ثُمَّ أَثْبَتَهُمَا وَكَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى صَلاَةً أَثْبَتَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ تَعْنِي دَاوَمَ عَلَيْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaala abnu aayyuwba haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - aakhbaraniy muhammadun, - wahuwa abnu aabiy harmalaaa - qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa, aannahu saaala 'aaiishaaa 'ani alssajdatayni alllatayni, kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliyhimaa ba'da al'asri faqaalat kaana yusalliyhimaa qabla al'asri thumma iinnahu shughila 'anhumaa aaw nasiyahumaa fasalaaahumaa ba'da al'asri thumma aathbatahumaa wakaana iidhaa sallaa salaaaan aathbatahaa ‏.‏ qaala yahyaa bnu aayyuwba qaala iismaa'iylu ta'niy daawama 'alayhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Salama asked 'A'isha about the two prostrations (i. e. rak'ahs) which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made after the 'Asr. She said:He (the Holy Prophet) observed them before the 'Asr prayer, but then he was hindered to do so, or he forgot them and then he observed them after the 'Asr, and then he continued observing them. (It was his habit) that when he (the Holy Prophet) observed prayer, he then continued observing it. Isma'il said: It implies that he always did that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا تَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ عِنْدِي قَطُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy jamiy'ana, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat maa taraka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rak'atayni ba'da al'asri 'indiy qattu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not abandon at all observing two rak'ahs after the 'Asr in my house
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ صَلاَتَانِ مَا تَرَكَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِي قَطُّ سِرًّا وَلاَ عَلاَنِيَةً رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, h wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, aakhbaranaa aabuw iishaaqa alshhaybaaniyyu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni alaaswadi 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat salaataani maa tarakahumaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy baytiy qattu sirrana walaa 'alaaniyaaan rak'atayni qabla alfajri warak'atayni ba'da al'asri ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Two are the prayers which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) always observed in my house-openly or secretly-two rak'ahs before the dawn and two rak'ahs after the 'Asr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، وَمَسْرُوقٍ، قَالاَ نَشْهَدُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا كَانَ يَوْمُهُ الَّذِي كَانَ يَكُونُ عِنْدِي إِلاَّ صَلاَّهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِي ‏.‏ تَعْنِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi, wamasruwqin, qaalaa nashhadu 'alaa 'aaiishaaa aannahaa qaalat maa kaana yawmuhu alladhiy kaana yakuwnu 'indiy iilaaa salaaahumaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy baytiy ‏.‏ ta'niy alrrak'atayni ba'da al'asri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aswad and Masruq reported:We bear testimony to the fact that 'A'isha said: Never was there a day that he (the Holy Prophet) was with me and he did not observe two rak'ahs of prayer in my house, i. e. two rak'ahs after the Asr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ فُضَيْلٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، - عَنْ مُخْتَارِ بْنِ فُلْفُلٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ عَنِ التَّطَوُّعِ، بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَقَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ يَضْرِبُ الأَيْدِي عَلَى صَلاَةٍ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ وَكُنَّا نُصَلِّي عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْمَغْرِبِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَّهُمَا قَالَ كَانَ يَرَانَا نُصَلِّيهِمَا ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا وَلَمْ يَنْهَنَا
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'ani abni fudaylin, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, - 'an mukhtaari bni fulfulin, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin 'ani alttatawwu'i, ba'da al'asri faqaala kaana 'umaru yadribu alaaydiy 'alaa salaaain ba'da al'asri wakunnaa nusalliy 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm rak'atayni ba'da ghuruwbi alshhamsi qabla salaaai almaghribi ‏.‏ faqultu lahu aakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaahumaa qaala kaana yaraanaa nusalliyhimaa ‏.‏ falam yaamurnaa walam yanhanaa
verses.translation: Mukhtar b. Fulful said:I asked Anas b. Malik about the voluntary prayers after the afternoon prayer, and he replied: 'Umar struck hit hands on prayer observed after the 'Asr prayer and we used to observe two rak'ahs after the sun set before the evening prayer during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). I said to him: Did the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observe them? He said: He saw us observing them, but he neither commanded us nor forbade us to do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ صُهَيْبٍ - عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَإِذَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ لِصَلاَةِ الْمَغْرِبِ ابْتَدَرُوا السَّوَارِيَ فَيَرْكَعُونَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ الْغَرِيبَ لَيَدْخُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَيَحْسِبُ أَنَّ الصَّلاَةَ قَدْ صُلِّيَتْ مِنْ كَثْرَةِ مَنْ يُصَلِّيهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, - wahuwa abnu suhaybin - 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kunnaa bialmadiynaai faiidhaa aadhhana almuuadhhinu lisalaaai almaghribi abtadaruwa alssawaariya fayarka'uwna rak'atayni rak'atayni hattaa iinna alrrajula alghariyba layadkhulu almasjida fayahsibu aanna alssalaaaa qad sulliyat min kathraai man yusalliyhimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:When we were in Medina, the moment the Mu'adhdhin made the call to the sunset prayer, the people hastened to the pillars of the mosque and prayed two rak'ahs with the result that any stranger coming into the mosque would think that the obligatory prayer had been observed owing to the number who were praying then
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنْ كَهْمَسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بَيْنَ كُلِّ أَذَانَيْنِ صَلاَةٌ - قَالَهَا ثَلاَثًا قَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ - لِمَنْ شَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, wawakiy'un, 'an kahmasin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu buraydaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mughaffalin almuzaniyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ bayna kulli aadhaanayni salaaaun - qaalahaa thalaathana qaala fiy althhaalithaai - liman shaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mughaffal reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) u saying:There Is between the two calls (Adhan and Iqama) a prayer. And he mentioned it three times, and at the third time he said: This applies to those who wish to do it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ ‏ "‏ لِمَنْ شَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi, bni buraydaaa 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mughaffalin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ mithlahu iilaaa aannahu qaala fiy alrraabi'aai ‏ "‏ liman shaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Abdullah b. Mughaffal by another chain of transmitters, but with this variation that he (the Holy Prophet) said at the fourth time:" He who wishes (may do to)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْخَوْفِ بِإِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ رَكْعَةً وَالطَّائِفَةُ الأُخْرَى مُوَاجِهَةُ الْعَدُوِّ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا وَقَامُوا فِي مَقَامِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ مُقْبِلِينَ عَلَى الْعَدُوِّ وَجَاءَ أُولَئِكَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى بِهِمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَضَى هَؤُلاَءِ رَكْعَةً وَهَؤُلاَءِ رَكْعَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alkhawfi biiihdaa alttaaiifatayni rak'aaan waalttaaiifaau alaukhraa muwaajihaau al'aduwwi thumma ansarafuwa waqaamuwa fiy maqaami aashaabihim muqbiliyna 'alaa al'aduwwi wajaa'a auwlaiika thumma sallaa bihimu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm rak'aaan thumma sallama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qadaa hauulaa'i rak'aaan wahauulaa'i rak'aaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. Abdullah b. 'Umar reported:The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) led on* of the two groups In one rak'ah of prayer in danger, while the other group faced the -enemy. Then they (the members of the first group) went back and replaced their companions who were facing the enemy. and then they (the members of the second group) came and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led them in one rak'ah of prayer. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced salutation, and then they (the members of the Ant group) completed the rak'ah and they (the members of the second group) completed the rak'ah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْخَوْفِ وَيَقُولُ صَلَّيْتُهَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِهَذَا الْمَعْنَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa fulayhun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, bni 'umara 'an aabiyhi, aannahu kaana yuhaddithu 'an salaaai, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alkhawfi wayaquwlu sallaytuhaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bihadhaa alma'naa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ، عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْخَوْفِ فِي بَعْضِ أَيَّامِهِ فَقَامَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مَعَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ بِإِزَاءِ الْعَدُوِّ فَصَلَّى بِالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ ذَهَبُوا وَجَاءَ الآخَرُونَ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ قَضَتِ الطَّائِفَتَانِ رَكْعَةً رَكْعَةً - قَالَ - وَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَإِذَا كَانَ خَوْفٌ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَصَلِّ رَاكِبًا أَوْ قَائِمًا تُومِئُ إِيمَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, 'an sufyaana, 'an muwsaa bni, 'uqbaaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alkhawfi fiy ba'di aayyaamihi faqaamat taaiifaaun ma'ahu wataaiifaaun biiizaa'i al'aduwwi fasallaa bialladhiyna ma'ahu rak'aaan thumma dhahabuwa wajaa'a alakharuwna fasallaa bihim rak'aaan thumma qadati alttaaiifataani rak'aaan rak'aaan - qaala - waqaala abnu 'umara faiidhaa kaana khawfun aakthara min dhalika fasalli raakibana aaw qaaiimana tuwmiiu iiymaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer in danger on some day (in this way):a group stood with him (the Holy Prophet) (for prayer) and the other group stood In front of the enemy. Then those who were with (him) observed one rak'ah of prayer and they went back and the others came and they observed one rak'ah (with him). Then both the groups completed one rak'ah each. Ibn Umar said: When there is greater danger, then observe prayer even on the ride or with the help of gestures in a standing posture
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْخَوْفِ فَصَفَّنَا صَفَّيْنِ صَفٌّ خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْعَدُوُّ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَكَبَّرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَبَّرْنَا جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ رَكَعَ وَرَكَعْنَا جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ وَرَفَعْنَا جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ انْحَدَرَ بِالسُّجُودِ وَالصَّفُّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ وَقَامَ الصَّفُّ الْمُؤَخَّرُ فِي نَحْرِ الْعَدُوِّ فَلَمَّا قَضَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم السُّجُودَ وَقَامَ الصَّفُّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ انْحَدَرَ الصَّفُّ الْمُؤَخَّرُ بِالسُّجُودِ وَقَامُوا ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ الصَّفُّ الْمُؤَخَّرُ وَتَأَخَّرَ الصَّفُّ الْمُقَدَّمُ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَكَعْنَا جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ وَرَفَعْنَا جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ انْحَدَرَ بِالسُّجُودِ وَالصَّفُّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ الَّذِي كَانَ مُؤَخَّرًا فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى وَقَامَ الصَّفُّ الْمُؤَخَّرُ فِي نُحُورِ الْعَدُوِّ فَلَمَّا قَضَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم السُّجُودَ وَالصَّفُّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ انْحَدَرَ الصَّفُّ الْمُؤَخَّرُ بِالسُّجُودِ فَسَجَدُوا ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَلَّمْنَا جَمِيعًا ‏.‏ قَالَ جَابِرٌ كَمَا يَصْنَعُ حَرَسُكُمْ هَؤُلاَءِ بِأُمَرَائِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu aabiy sulaymaana, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala shahidtu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alkhawfi fasaffanaa saffayni saffun khalfa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waal'aduwwu baynanaa wabayna alqiblaai fakabbara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wakabbarnaa jamiy'ana thumma raka'a waraka'naa jamiy'ana thumma rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i warafa'naa jamiy'ana thumma anhadara bialssujuwdi waalssaffu alladhiy yaliyhi waqaama alssaffu almuuakhharu fiy nahri al'aduwwi falammaa qadaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alssujuwda waqaama alssaffu alladhiy yaliyhi anhadara alssaffu almuuakhharu bialssujuwdi waqaamuwa thumma taqaddama alssaffu almuuakhharu wataaakhhara alssaffu almuqaddamu thumma raka'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waraka'naa jamiy'ana thumma rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i warafa'naa jamiy'ana thumma anhadara bialssujuwdi waalssaffu alladhiy yaliyhi alladhiy kaana muuakhharana fiy alrrak'aai alauwlaa waqaama alssaffu almuuakhharu fiy nuhuwri al'aduwwi falammaa qadaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alssujuwda waalssaffu alladhiy yaliyhi anhadara alssaffu almuuakhharu bialssujuwdi fasajaduwa thumma sallama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wasallamnaa jamiy'ana ‏.‏ qaala jaabirun kamaa yasna'u harasukum hauulaa'i biaumaraaiihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:I observed prayer in danger with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We drew ourselves up in two rows, one row behind him with the enemy between us and the Qibla. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah is Most Great, and we all said it. He then bowed and we all bowed. He then raised his head from bowing, we all raised (our heads). He then went down in prostration along with the row close to him, and the rear row faced the enemy; then when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) completed the prostration, ; and then stood up, the row near to him also did it; then went down the rear row in prostration; then they stood up; then the rear row went to the front and the front row went to the rear. Then the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) bowed down and we all bowed. He then raised his head from bowing and we also raised (our heads). He and the row close to him which I had been in the rear then went down in prostration In the first rak'ah, whereas the rear row faced the enemy. And when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the rear row close to him had finished the prostration, the rear row went down and prostrated themselves; then the Messenger of Allah pronounced the salutation and we also pronounced the salutation. (Jabir said we hadith) as your guards behave with their chiefs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْمًا مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ فَقَاتَلُونَا قِتَالاً شَدِيدًا فَلَمَّا صَلَّيْنَا الظُّهْرَ قَالَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ لَوْ مِلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَيْلَةً لاَقْتَطَعْنَاهُمْ ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَ جِبْرِيلُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَلِكَ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - وَقَالُوا إِنَّهُ سَتَأْتِيهِمْ صَلاَةٌ هِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الأَوْلاَدِ فَلَمَّا حَضَرَتِ الْعَصْرُ - قَالَ - صَفَّنَا صَفَّيْنِ وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ - قَالَ - فَكَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَبَّرْنَا وَرَكَعَ فَرَكَعْنَا ثُمَّ سَجَدَ وَسَجَدَ مَعَهُ الصَّفُّ الأَوَّلُ فَلَمَّا قَامُوا سَجَدَ الصَّفُّ الثَّانِي ثُمَّ تَأَخَّرَ الصَّفُّ الأَوَّلُ وَتَقَدَّمَ الصَّفُّ الثَّانِي فَقَامُوا مَقَامَ الأَوَّلِ فَكَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَبَّرْنَا وَرَكَعَ فَرَكَعْنَا ثُمَّ سَجَدَ وَسَجَدَ مَعَهُ الصَّفُّ الأَوَّلُ وَقَامَ الثَّانِي فَلَمَّا سَجَدَ سَجَدَ الصَّفُّ الثَّانِي ثُمَّ جَلَسُوا جَمِيعًا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ ثُمَّ خَصَّ جَابِرٌ أَنْ قَالَ كَمَا يُصَلِّي أُمَرَاؤُكُمْ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala ghazawnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qawmana min juhaynaaa faqaataluwnaa qitaalaan shadiydana falammaa sallaynaa alzzuhra qaala almushrikuwna law milnaa 'alayhim maylaaan laaqtata'naahum ‏.‏ faaakhbara jibriylu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhalika fadhakara dhalika lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - waqaaluwa iinnahu sataatiyhim salaaaun hiya aahabbu iilayhim mina alaawlaadi falammaa hadarati al'asru - qaala - saffanaa saffayni waalmushrikuwna baynanaa wabayna alqiblaai - qaala - fakabbara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakabbarnaa waraka'a faraka'naa thumma sajada wasajada ma'ahu alssaffu alaawwalu falammaa qaamuwa sajada alssaffu althhaaniy thumma taaakhhara alssaffu alaawwalu wataqaddama alssaffu althhaaniy faqaamuwa maqaama alaawwali fakabbara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakabbarnaa waraka'a faraka'naa thumma sajada wasajada ma'ahu alssaffu alaawwalu waqaama althhaaniy falammaa sajada sajada alssaffu althhaaniy thumma jalasuwa jamiy'ana sallama 'alayhim rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala aabuw alzzubayri thumma khassa jaabirun aan qaala kamaa yusalliy aumaraauukum hauulaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:We fought In the company of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with the tribe of Juhaina. They fought with us terribly. When we had finished the noon prayer, the polytheists said: Had we attacked them at once. we would have killed them. Gabriel informed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about It (about their evil design). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a mention of it to us, adding that they (the polytheists) had also said: Shortly there would be time for the 'Asr prayer. which is dearer o them (the Muslims) than even their children. So when the time of the 'Asr prayer came. we formed ourselves into two rows, while the polytheists were between us and the Qibla. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah is Most Great, and we also said so. He bowed and we also bowed. He went down in prostration and the first row prostrated along with him. When they stood up, the second row went down in prostration. Then the first row went into the rear, and the second row came in the front and occupied the place of the first row. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then said: Allah is Most Great, and we also said so. He then bowed, and we also bowed. He then went down in prostration and along with him the row also (went down in prostration), and the second row remained standing. And when the second row had also prostrated and all of them sat down then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) pronounced salutation to them. Abu Zubair said: Jabir made a mention specially of this thing: just as your chiefs observe prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ، الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَوَّاتِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى بِأَصْحَابِهِ فِي الْخَوْفِ فَصَفَّهُمْ خَلْفَهُ صَفَّيْنِ فَصَلَّى بِالَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ قَامَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ قَائِمًا حَتَّى صَلَّى الَّذِينَ خَلْفَهُمْ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمُوا وَتَأَخَّرَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا قُدَّامَهُمْ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ قَعَدَ حَتَّى صَلَّى الَّذِينَ تَخَلَّفُوا رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni, alqaasimi 'an aabiyhi, 'an saalihi bni khawwaati bni jubayrin, 'an sahli bni aabiy hathmaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa biaashaabihi fiy alkhawfi fasaffahum khalfahu saffayni fasallaa bialladhiyna yaluwnahu rak'aaan thumma qaama falam yazal qaaiimana hattaa sallaa alladhiyna khalfahum rak'aaan thumma taqaddamuwa wataaakhhara alladhiyna kaanuwa quddaamahum fasallaa bihim rak'aaan thumma qa'ada hattaa sallaa alladhiyna takhallafuwa rak'aaan thumma sallama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Abu Hathma reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led his Companions in prayer in danger. He made them stand in two rows behind him. He led them who were close to him in one rak'ah. He then stood up and kept standing till those who were behind them observed one rak'ah. Then they (those standing in the second row) came in front and those who were in front went into the rear. He then led them In one rak'ah. He then sat down, till those who were behind him observed one rak'ah and then pronounced salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ صَالِحِ، بْنِ خَوَّاتٍ عَمَّنْ صَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ ذَاتِ الرِّقَاعِ صَلاَةَ الْخَوْفِ أَنَّ طَائِفَةً صَفَّتْ مَعَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ وِجَاهَ الْعَدُوِّ ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى بِالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ ثَبَتَ قَائِمًا وَأَتَمُّوا لأَنْفُسِهِمْ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا فَصَفُّوا وِجَاهَ الْعَدُوِّ وَجَاءَتِ الطَّائِفَةُ الأُخْرَى فَصَلَّى بِهِمُ الرَّكْعَةَ الَّتِي بَقِيَتْ ثُمَّ ثَبَتَ جَالِسًا وَأَتَمُّوا لأَنْفُسِهِمْ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ بِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an yaziyda bni ruwmaana, 'an saalihi, bni khawwaatin 'amman sallaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma dhaati alrriqaa'i salaaaa alkhawfi aanna taaiifaaan saffat ma'ahu wataaiifaaun wijaaha al'aduwwi ‏.‏ fasallaa bialladhiyna ma'ahu rak'aaan thumma thabata qaaiimana waaatammuwa laanfusihim ‏.‏ thumma ansarafuwa fasaffuwa wijaaha al'aduwwi wajaa'ati alttaaiifaau alaukhraa fasallaa bihimu alrrak'aaa allatiy baqiyat thumma thabata jaalisana waaatammuwa laanfusihim thumma sallama bihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yazid b. Ruman told on the authority of Salih b. Khawwat on the authority of one who prayed in time of danger with Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) at the Battle of Dhat ar-Riqa' that a group formed a row and prayed along with him, and a group faced the enemy. He led the group which was along with him in a rak'ah, then remained standing while they finished the prayer by themselves. Then they departed and formed a row facing the enemy. Then the second group came and he led them in the remaining rak'ah, after which he remained seated while they finished the prayer themselves. He then led them in salutation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِذَاتِ الرِّقَاعِ قَالَ كُنَّا إِذَا أَتَيْنَا عَلَى شَجَرَةٍ ظَلِيلَةٍ تَرَكْنَاهَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَسَيْفُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُعَلَّقٌ بِشَجَرَةٍ فَأَخَذَ سَيْفَ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاخْتَرَطَهُ فَقَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَخَافُنِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَنْ يَمْنَعُكَ مِنِّي قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَمْنَعُنِي مِنْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَهَدَّدَهُ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَغْمَدَ السَّيْفَ وَعَلَّقَهُ - قَالَ - فَنُودِيَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَصَلَّى بِطَائِفَةٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ تَأَخَّرُوا وَصَلَّى بِالطَّائِفَةِ الأُخْرَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَالَ فَكَانَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعُ رَكَعَاتٍ وَلِلْقَوْمِ رَكْعَتَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa aabaanu bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa yahyaa, bnu aabiy kathiyrin 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an jaabirin, qaala aaqbalnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa iidhaa kunnaa bidhaati alrriqaa'i qaala kunnaa iidhaa aataynaa 'alaa shajaraain zaliylaain taraknaahaa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - fajaa'a rajulun mina almushrikiyna wasayfu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mu'allaqun bishajaraain faaakhadha sayfa nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faakhtaratahu faqaala lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aatakhaafuniy qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faman yamna'uka minniy qaala ‏"‏ alllahu yamna'uniy minka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fatahaddadahu aashaabu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaghmada alssayfa wa'allaqahu - qaala - fanuwdiya bialssalaaai fasallaa bitaaiifaain rak'atayni thumma taaakhharuwa wasallaa bialttaaiifaai alaukhraa rak'atayni qaala fakaanat lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aarba'u raka'aatin walilqawmi rak'ataani ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:We went forward with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and when we reached Dhat ar-Riqa', we came to a shady tree which -we left for him One of the polytheists came there and, seeing the sword of the Messenger (ﷺ) hanging by a free. took it up. drew it from the scabbard and said to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Are you afraid of Me? He (the Holy Prophet) said: No. He again said: Who would protect you from me? He said: Allah will protect me from you. The Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) threatened him. He sheathed the sword and hung it up. Then call to prayer was made and he (the Holy Prophet) led a group in two rak'ah. Then (the members of this group) withdrew and he led the second group in two rak'ah. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed four rak'ah and people observed two rak'ah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 6 — The Book of Prayer - Travellers
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَسَّانَ - حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَلاَّمٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ جَابِرًا، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، صَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الْخَوْفِ فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِإِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ صَلَّى بِالطَّائِفَةِ الأُخْرَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ وَصَلَّى بِكُلِّ طَائِفَةٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna hassaana - haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, - wahuwa abnu salaaamin - aakhbaraniy yahyaa, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna jaabirana, aakhbarahu aannahu, sallaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alkhawfi fasallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biiihdaa alttaaiifatayni rak'atayni thumma sallaa bialttaaiifaai alaukhraa rak'atayni fasallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aarba'a raka'aatin wasallaa bikulli taaiifaain rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported that Jabir told him that he had observed the prayer in danger with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (first) led one of the two groups in two rak'ah of prayer. and then led the second group in two rak'ah of prayer. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed four rak'ah and led in two rak'ah each of the groups
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ الْجُمُعَةَ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa aaraada aahadukum aan yaatiya aljumu'aaa falyaghtasil ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah is reported to have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you intends to come for Jumu'a prayer, he should take a bath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏ "‏ مَنْ جَاءَ مِنْكُمُ الْجُمُعَةَ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni, shihaabin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala wahuwa qaaiimun 'alaa alminbari ‏ "‏ man jaa'a minkumu aljumu'aaa falyaghtasil ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar is reported to have said that The Messenger of Allah (may peace be up on him) was standing on the pulpit when he said this:He who comes for Jumu'a he should take a bath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ابْنَىْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم .‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy abnu shihaabin, 'an saalimin, wa'abdi alllahi, abnaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm .‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Umar by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Umar) reported on the authority of his father that he heard like this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، بَيْنَا هُوَ يَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَادَاهُ عُمَرُ أَيَّةُ سَاعَةٍ هَذِهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي شُغِلْتُ الْيَوْمَ فَلَمْ أَنْقَلِبْ إِلَى أَهْلِي حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ النِّدَاءَ فَلَمْ أَزِدْ عَلَى أَنْ تَوَضَّأْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ وَالْوُضُوءَ أَيْضًا وَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْغُسْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, ‏.‏ aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, baynaa huwa yakhtubu alnnaasa yawma aljumu'aai dakhala rajulun min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanaadaahu 'umaru aayyaau saa'aain hadhihi faqaala iinniy shughiltu alyawma falam aanqalib iilaa aahliy hattaa sami'tu alnnidaa'a falam aazid 'alaa aan tawaddaatu ‏.‏ qaala 'umaru waalwuduw'a aaydana waqad 'alimta aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaamuru bialghusli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. 'Umar) reported from his father that while he was addressing the people on Friday (sermon), a person, one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), entered (the mosque). Umar said to him loudly:What is this hour (for attending the prayer)? He said: I was busy today and I did not return to my house when I heard the call (to Friday prayer), and I did no more but performed ablution only. Upon this Umar said: just ablution! You know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded (us) to take a bath (on Friday)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِذْ دَخَلَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ فَعَرَّضَ بِهِ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ مَا بَالُ رِجَالٍ يَتَأَخَّرُونَ بَعْدَ النِّدَاءِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَا زِدْتُ حِينَ سَمِعْتُ النِّدَاءَ أَنْ تَوَضَّأْتُ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلْتُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ وَالْوُضُوءَ أَيْضًا أَلَمْ تَسْمَعُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, haddathaniy aabuw hurayraaa, qaala baynamaa 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi yakhtubu alnnaasa yawma aljumu'aai iidh dakhala 'uthmaanu bnu 'affaana fa'arrada bihi 'umaru faqaala maa baalu rijaalin yataaakhharuwna ba'da alnnidaa'i ‏.‏ faqaala 'uthmaanu yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna maa zidtu hiyna sami'tu alnnidaa'a aan tawaddaatu thumma aaqbaltu ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru waalwuduw'a aaydana aalam tasma'uwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa jaa'a aahadukum iilaa aljumu'aai falyaghtasil ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:Umar b. Khattab was delivering a sermon to the people on Friday when 'Uthman b. 'Affan came there. 'Umar hinting to him said: What would become of those persons who come after the call to prayer? Upon this 'Uthman said: Commander of the faithful, I did no more than this that after listening to the call, I performed ablution and came (to the mosque). 'Umar said: Just ablution! Did you not hear the Messenger of Allah (my peace be upon him) say this: When any one of you comes for Jumu'a, he should take a bath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ، بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْغُسْلُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an safwaana bni sulaymin, 'an 'ataa'i, bni yasaarin 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alghuslu yawma aljumu'aai waajibun 'alaa kulli muhtalimin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Taking a bath on Friday is essential for every adult person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّاسُ يَنْتَابُونَ الْجُمُعَةَ مِنْ مَنَازِلِهِمْ مِنَ الْعَوَالِي فَيَأْتُونَ فِي الْعَبَاءِ وَيُصِيبُهُمُ الْغُبَارُ فَتَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمُ الرِّيحُ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنْسَانٌ مِنْهُمْ وَهُوَ عِنْدِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ تَطَهَّرْتُمْ لِيَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy ja'farin, aanna muhammada bna ja'farin, haddathahu 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat kaana alnnaasu yantaabuwna aljumu'aaa min manaazilihim mina al'awaaliy fayaatuwna fiy al'abaa'i wayusiybuhumu alghubaaru fatakhruju minhumu alrriyhu faaataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinsaanun minhum wahuwa 'indiy faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law aannakum tatahhartum liyawmikum hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aisha reported:The people came for Jumu'a prayer from their houses in the neighbouring villages dressed in woollen garments on which dust was settled and this emitted a foul smell. A person among them (those who were dressed so) came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was in my house. The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said to him: Were you to cleanse yourselves on this day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّاسُ أَهْلَ عَمَلٍ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ كُفَاةٌ فَكَانُوا يَكُونُ لَهُمْ تَفَلٌ فَقِيلَ لَهُمْ لَوِ اغْتَسَلْتُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat kaana alnnaasu aahla 'amalin walam yakun lahum kufaaaun fakaanuwa yakuwnu lahum tafalun faqiyla lahum lawi aghtasaltum yawma aljumu'aai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aisha reported:The people (mostly) were workers and they had no servants. Ill-smell thus emitted out of them. It was said to them: Were you to take bath on Friday
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ، الْحَارِثِ أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، وَبُكَيْرَ بْنَ الأَشَجِّ، حَدَّثَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو، بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ غُسْلُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ وَسِوَاكٌ وَيَمَسُّ مِنَ الطِّيبِ مَا قَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا لَمْ يَذْكُرْ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ وَقَالَ فِي الطِّيبِ وَلَوْ مِنْ طِيبِ الْمَرْأَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amruw bnu sawwaadin al'aamiriyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amruw bnu, alhaarithi aanna sa'iyda bna aabiy hilaalin, wabukayra bna alaashajji, haddathaahu 'an aabiy bakri bni almunkadiri, 'an 'amriw, bni sulaymin 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ghuslu yawmi aljumu'aai 'alaa kulli muhtalimin wasiwaakun wayamassu mina alttiybi maa qadara 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaaa aanna bukayrana lam yadhkur 'abda alrrahmani waqaala fiy alttiybi walaw min tiybi almaraaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman son of Abd Sa'id al-Khudri reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Bathing on Friday for every adult, using of Miswak and applying some perfume, that is available-these are essential. So far as the perfume is concerned, it may be that used by a lady
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ قَوْلَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ طَاوُسٌ فَقُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَيَمَسُّ طِيبًا أَوْ دُهْنًا إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهِ قَالَ لاَ أَعْلَمُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu, bnu raafi'in haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy iibraahiymu bnu maysaraaa, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aannahu dhakara qawla alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alghusli yawma aljumu'aai ‏.‏ qaala taawusun faqultu laibni 'abbaasin wayamassu tiybana aaw duhnana iin kaana 'inda aahlihi qaala laa aa'lamuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Tawus reported that Ibn Abbas narrated the words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about taking bath on Friday. Tawus said:I asked Ibn Abbas it one should apply to oneself perfume or oil which is available with his wife. He (Ibn Abbas) said: I do not know of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi, alllahi haddathanaa alddahhaaku bnu makhladin, kilaahumaa 'ani abni jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Juraij with the came chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ حَقٌّ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ فِي كُلِّ سَبْعَةِ أَيَّامٍ يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ وَجَسَدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ haqqun lillahi 'alaa kulli muslimin aan yaghtasila fiy kulli sab'aai aayyaamin yaghsilu raasahu wajasadahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. it is the right of Allah upon every Muslim that he should take a bath (at least) on one day (Friday) during the seven days (of the week) and he should wash his head and body
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ ثُمَّ رَاحَ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ بَدَنَةً وَمَنْ رَاحَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ بَقَرَةً وَمَنْ رَاحَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ كَبْشًا أَقْرَنَ وَمَنْ رَاحَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الرَّابِعَةِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ دَجَاجَةً وَمَنْ رَاحَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الْخَامِسَةِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ بَيْضَةً فَإِذَا خَرَجَ الإِمَامُ حَضَرَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الذِّكْرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an sumaaain, mawlaa aabiy bakrin 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani aghtasala yawma aljumu'aai ghusla aljanaabaai thumma raaha fakaaannamaa qarraba badanaaan waman raaha fiy alssaa'aai althhaaniyaai fakaaannamaa qarraba baqaraaan waman raaha fiy alssaa'aai althhaalithaai fakaaannamaa qarraba kabshana aaqrana waman raaha fiy alssaa'aai alrraabi'aai fakaaannamaa qarraba dajaajaaan waman raaha fiy alssaa'aai alkhaamisaai fakaaannamaa qarraba baydaaan faiidhaa kharaja aliimaamu hadarati almalaaiikaau yastami'uwna aldhhikra ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of, Allah (ﷺ) said. He who takes a bath on Friday, the bath which is obligatory after the sexual discharge and then goes (to the mosque), he is like one who offers a she-camel as a sacrifice, and he who comes at the second hour would be like one who offers a cow, and he who comes at the third hour is live one who offers a ram with horns, and he who comes at the fourth hour is like one who offers a hen, and he who comes at the fifth hour is like one who offers an egg. And when the Imam comes out, the angels are also present and listen to the mention of God (the sermon)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، قَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ أَنْصِتْ ‏.‏ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, qaala abnu rumhin aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa qulta lisaahibika aansit ‏.‏ yawma aljumu'aai waaliimaamu yakhtubu faqad laghawta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If you (even) ask your companion to be quiet on Friday while the Imam is delivering the sermon, you have in fact talked irrelevance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ قَارِظٍ، وَعَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu, khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'umara bni 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni iibraahiyma bni qaarizin, wa'ani abni almusayyabi, aannahumaa haddathaahu aanna aabaa hurayraaa qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ، شِهَابٍ بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَارِظٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy abnu, shihaabin bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana fiy hadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aanna abna jurayjin qaala iibraahiymu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni qaarizin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Juraij narrated a similar Hadith (as no. 1965) from Ibn Shihab with both chains, except that Ibn Juraij said:"Ibrahim bin 'Abdullah bin Qariz
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ أَنْصِتْ ‏.‏ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ فَقَدْ لَغِيتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو الزِّنَادِ هِيَ لُغَةُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa qulta lisaahibika aansit ‏.‏ yawma aljumu'aai waaliimaamu yakhtubu faqad laghiyta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw alzzinaadi hiya lughaau aabiy hurayraaa waiinnamaa huwa faqad laghawta ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira, but instead of the word laghauta the word laghita has been used. Abu Zinad (one of the narrators) says that laghita is the dialect of Abu Huraira, whereas it is laghauta
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَكَرَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ فِيهِ سَاعَةٌ لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ قُتَيْبَةُ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ يُقَلِّلُهَا
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhakara yawma aljumu'aai faqaala ‏ "‏ fiyhi saa'aaun laa yuwaafiquhaa 'abdun muslimun wahuwa yusalliy yasaalu alllaha shayiana iilaaa aa'taahu iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ zaada qutaybaau fiy riwaayatihi waaashaara biyadihi yuqalliluhaa
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is a time on Friday at which no Muslim servant would pray and would ask Allah for a thing (that is good) but He would give it to him. Qutaiba pointed with the help of his hand that it (the time) is short
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ لَسَاعَةً لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا مُسْلِمٌ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ خَيْرًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ." وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ يُقَلِّلُهَا يُزَهِّدُهَا
verses.translit: hadaathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, hadaathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, hadaathanaa aayuuwbu, 'an muhamaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinaa fiy aljumu'aai lasaa'aaan laa yuwaafiquhaa muslimun qaaiimun yusaliiy yasaalu allaaha khayrana iilaaa aa'taahu iiyaaahu." waqaala biyadihi yuqaliiluhaa yuzahiiduhaa
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Abu'l-Qasim (the kunya of the Holy Prophet) (ﷺ) as saying:There is a time on Friday at which no Muslim would stand and pray and beg Allah for what Is good but He would give it to him; and he pointed with his hand that (this time) is short and narrow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy humaydu bnu mas'adaaa albaahiliyyu, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna mufaddalin - haddathanaa salamaau, wahuwa abnu 'alqamaaa 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira by another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ الْجُمَحِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُسْلِمٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ لَسَاعَةً لا يُوَافِقُهَا مُسْلِمٌ يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ فِيهَا خَيْرًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَهِيَ سَاعَةٌ خَفِيفَةٌ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu salaaamin aljumahiyyu, haddathanaa alrrabiy'u, - ya'niy abna muslimin - 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iinna fiy aljumu'aai lasaa'aaan la yuwaafiquhaa muslimun yasaalu alllaha fiyhaa khayrana iilaaa aa'taahu iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wahiya saa'aaun khafiyfaaun
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:"There is a time on Friday at which no Muslim would ask Allah for what is good but He would give it to him." And further said: "This is a very short time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ وَهِيَ سَاعَةٌ خَفِيفَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ walam yaqul wahiya saa'aaun khafiyfaaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported this hadith from Abu Huraira who reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) but he did not say:" That time is short
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ، بُكَيْرٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْرَمَةُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَسَمِعْتَ أَبَاكَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي شَأْنِ سَاعَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ نَعَمْ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «هِيَ مَا بَيْنَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ الإِمَامُ إِلَى أَنْ تُقْضَى الصَّلاَةُ»
verses.translit: wahadaathaniy aabuw altaaahiri, wa'aliyuu bnu khashramin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an makhramaaa bni, bukayrin h wahadaathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyuu, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaalaa hadaathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa makhramaau, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy burdaaa bni aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyii, qaala qaala liy 'abdu allaahi bnu 'umara aasami'ta aabaaka yuhadiithu 'an rasuwli allaahi salaaa allaahu 'alayhi wasalaama fiy shaani saa'aai aljumu'aai qaala: qultu na'am sami'tuhu yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla allaahi salaaa allaahu 'alayhi wasalaama yaquwlu: «hiya maa bayna aan yajlisa aliimaamu iilaa aan tuqdaa alsaalaaau»
verses.translation: Abu Burda b. Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported:'Abdullah b. Umar said to me: Did you hear anything from your father narrating something from the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about the time on Friday? I said: Yes, I heard him say from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (these words):" It is between the time when the Imam sits down and the end of the prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ يَوْمٍ طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ فِيهِ خُلِقَ آدَمُ وَفِيهِ أُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَفِيهِ أُخْرِجَ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alrrahmani alaa'raju, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khayru yawmin tala'at 'alayhi alshhamsu yawmu aljumu'aai fiyhi khuliqa adamu wafiyhi audkhila aljannaaa wafiyhi aukhrija minhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created, on it he was made to enter Paradise, on it he. was expelled from it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ يَوْمٍ طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ فِيهِ خُلِقَ آدَمُ وَفِيهِ أُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَفِيهِ أُخْرِجَ مِنْهَا وَلاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ إِلاَّ فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy alhizaamiyya - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ khayru yawmin tala'at 'alayhi alshhamsu yawmu aljumu'aai fiyhi khuliqa adamu wafiyhi audkhila aljannaaa wafiyhi aukhrija minhaa walaa taquwmu alssaa'aau iilaaa fiy yawmi aljumu'aai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying:The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created. on it he was made to enter Paradise, on it he was expelled from it. And the last hour will take place on no day other than Friday
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ وَنَحْنُ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بَيْدَ أَنَّ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ أُوتِيَتِ الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا وَأُوتِينَاهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ ثُمَّ هَذَا الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا هَدَانَا اللَّهُ لَهُ فَالنَّاسُ لَنَا فِيهِ تَبَعٌ الْيَهُودُ غَدًا وَالنَّصَارَى بَعْدَ غَدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ nahnu alakhiruwna wanahnu alssaabiquwna yawma alqiyaamaai bayda aanna kulla aummaain auwtiyati alkitaaba min qablinaa waauwtiynaahu min ba'dihim thumma hadhaa alyawmu alladhiy katabahu alllahu 'alaynaa hadaanaa alllahu lahu faalnnaasu lanaa fiyhi taba'un alyahuwdu ghadana waalnnasaaraa ba'da ghadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
