verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:We who are the last shall be the first on the Day of Resurrection, except that every Ummah was given the Book before us and we were given it after them. It was this day which Allah prescribed for us and guided us to it and the people came after us with regard to it, the Jews observing the next day and the Christians the day following that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَابْنِ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ وَنَحْنُ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, waabni taawusin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ nahnu alakhiruwna wanahnu alssaabiquwna yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:We are the last and would be the first on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ الأَوَّلُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَنَحْنُ أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ بَيْدَ أَنَّهُمْ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا وَأُوتِينَاهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ فَاخْتَلَفُوا فَهَدَانَا اللَّهُ لِمَا اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ فَهَذَا يَوْمُهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ هَدَانَا اللَّهُ لَهُ - قَالَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ - فَالْيَوْمُ لَنَا وَغَدًا لِلْيَهُودِ وَبَعْدَ غَدٍ لِلنَّصَارَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ nahnu alakhiruwna alaawwaluwna yawma alqiyaamaai wanahnu aawwalu man yadkhulu aljannaaa bayda aannahum auwtuwa alkitaaba min qablinaa waauwtiynaahu min ba'dihim faakhtalafuwa fahadaanaa alllahu limaa akhtalafuwa fiyhi mina alhaqqi fahadhaa yawmuhumu alladhiy akhtalafuwa fiyhi hadaanaa alllahu lahu - qaala yawmu aljumu'aai - faalyawmu lanaa waghadana lilyahuwdi waba'da ghadin lilnnasaaraa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:We are the last (but) we would be the first on the Day of Resurrection, and we would be the first to enter Paradise, but that they were given the Book before us and we were given after them. They disagreed and Allah guided us aright on whatever they disagreed regarding the truth. And it was this day of theirs about which they disagreed, but Allah guided us to it, and that is Friday for us; the next day is for the Jews and the day following for the Christians
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، أَخِي وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بَيْدَ أَنَّهُمْ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا وَأُوتِينَاهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ وَهَذَا يَوْمُهُمُ الَّذِي فُرِضَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَاخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ فَهَدَانَا اللَّهُ لَهُ فَهُمْ لَنَا فِيهِ تَبَعٌ فَالْيَهُودُ غَدًا وَالنَّصَارَى بَعْدَ غَدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, aakhiy wahbi bni munabbihin qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an muhammadin, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ nahnu alakhiruwna alssaabiquwna yawma alqiyaamaai bayda aannahum auwtuwa alkitaaba min qablinaa waauwtiynaahu min ba'dihim wahadhaa yawmuhumu alladhiy furida 'alayhim faakhtalafuwa fiyhi fahadaanaa alllahu lahu fahum lanaa fiyhi taba'un faalyahuwdu ghadana waalnnasaaraa ba'da ghadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), as saying:We who are the last would be the first on the Day of Resurrection but they (other Ummahs) were given the Book before us and we were given after them, and this was the day that was prescribed for them but they disagreed on it. And Allah guided us to it. and they came after us with regard to it, the Jews observing the next day and the Christians the day following that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَوَاصِلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ، الأَشْجَعِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَعَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالاَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَضَلَّ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْجُمُعَةِ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَنَا فَكَانَ لِلْيَهُودِ يَوْمُ السَّبْتِ وَكَانَ لِلنَّصَارَى يَوْمُ الأَحَدِ فَجَاءَ اللَّهُ بِنَا فَهَدَانَا اللَّهُ لِيَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَجَعَلَ الْجُمُعَةَ وَالسَّبْتَ وَالأَحَدَ وَكَذَلِكَ هُمْ تَبَعٌ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا وَالأَوَّلُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الْمَقْضِيُّ لَهُمْ قَبْلَ الْخَلاَئِقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ وَاصِلٍ الْمَقْضِيُّ بَيْنَهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, wawaasilu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an aabiy maalikin, alaashja'iyyi 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, wa'an rib'iyyi bni hiraashin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaalaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aadalla alllahu 'ani aljumu'aai man kaana qablanaa fakaana lilyahuwdi yawmu alssabti wakaana lilnnasaaraa yawmu alaahadi fajaa'a alllahu binaa fahadaanaa alllahu liyawmi aljumu'aai faja'ala aljumu'aaa waalssabta waalaahada wakadhalika hum taba'un lanaa yawma alqiyaamaai nahnu alakhiruwna min aahli alddunyaa waalaawwaluwna yawma alqiyaamaai almaqdiyyu lahum qabla alkhalaaiiqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai waasilin almaqdiyyu baynahum ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated by Abu Huraira and Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:It was Friday from which Allah diverted those who were before us. For the Jews (the day set aside for prayer) was Sabt (Saturday), and for the Christians it was Sunday. And Allah turned towards us and guided us to Friday (as the day of prayer) for us. In fact, He (Allah) made Friday, Saturday and Sunday (as days of prayer). In this order would they (Jews and Christians) come after us on the Day of Resurrection. We are the last of (the Ummahs) among the people in this world and the first among the created to be judged on the Day of Resurrection. In one narration it is: ', to be judged among them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ طَارِقٍ، حَدَّثَنِي رِبْعِيُّ بْنُ، حِرَاشٍ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ هُدِينَا إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ وَأَضَلَّ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ فُضَيْلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, aakhbaranaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an sa'di bni taariqin, haddathaniy rib'iyyu bnu, hiraashin 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ hudiynaa iilaa aljumu'aai waaadalla alllahu 'anhaa man kaana qablanaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara bima'naa hadiythi abni fudaylin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:We were guided aright to Friday (as a day of prayer and meditation), but Allah diverted those who were before us from it. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، الأَغَرُّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ كَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ مَلاَئِكَةٌ يَكْتُبُونَ الأَوَّلَ فَالأَوَّلَ فَإِذَا جَلَسَ الإِمَامُ طَوَوُا الصُّحُفَ وَجَاءُوا يَسْتَمِعُونَ الذِّكْرَ وَمَثَلُ الْمُهَجِّرِ كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي يُهْدِي الْبَدَنَةَ ثُمَّ كَالَّذِي يُهْدِي بَقَرَةً ثُمَّ كَالَّذِي يُهْدِي الْكَبْشَ ثُمَّ كَالَّذِي يُهْدِي الدَّجَاجَةَ ثُمَّ كَالَّذِي يُهْدِي الْبَيْضَةَ»
verses.translit: wahadaathaniy aabuw altaaahiri, waharmalaau, wa'amruw bnu sawaaadin al'aamiriyuu, qaala aabuw altaaahiri hadaathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy aabuw 'abdi allaahi, alaagharuu aanaahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa kaana yawmu aljumu'aai kaana 'alaa kulii baabin min aabwaabi almasjidi malaaiikaaun yaktubuwna alaawaala faalaawaala faiidhaa jalasa aliimaamu tawawua alsuuhufa wajaa'uwa yastami'uwna aldhiikra wamathalu almuhajiiri kamathali alaadhiy yuhdiy albadanaaa thumaa kaalaadhiy yuhdiy baqaraaan thumaa kaalaadhiy yuhdiy alkabsha thumaa kaalaadhiy yuhdiy aldaajaajaaa thumaa kaalaadhiy yuhdiy albaydaaa»
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When it is Friday, the angels stand at every door of the mosque and record the people in the order of their arrival, and when the Imam sits (on the pulpit for delivering the sermon) they fold up their sheets (manuscripts of the Qur'an) and listen to the mention (of Allah). And he who comes early is like one who offers a she-camel as a sacrifice, the next like one who offers a cow, the next a ram, the next a hen, the next an egg
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, 'an sufyaana, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ عَلَى كُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ مَلَكٌ يَكْتُبُ الأَوَّلَ فَالأَوَّلَ - مَثَّلَ الْجَزُورَ ثُمَّ نَزَّلَهُمْ حَتَّى صَغَّرَ إِلَى مَثَلِ الْبَيْضَةِ - فَإِذَا جَلَسَ الإِمَامُ طُوِيَتِ الصُّحُفُ وَحَضَرُوا الذِّكْرَ ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ 'alaa kulli baabin min aabwaabi almasjidi malakun yaktubu alaawwala faalaawwala - mathhala aljazuwra thumma nazzalahum hattaa saghhara iilaa mathali albaydaai - faiidhaa jalasa aliimaamu tuwiyati alssuhufu wahadaruwa aldhhikra ‏"‏ ‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is an angel on every door of the mosque recording him first who (comes) first (to the mosque for Friday prayer). And he [the Prophet] likened him to one who offers a camel as a sacrifice and then he went on in the descending order till he reached the point at which the minimum (sacrifice) is that of an egg. And when the Imam sits (on the pulpit) the sheets are folded and they (the angels) attend to the mention of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ أَتَى الْجُمُعَةَ فَصَلَّى مَا قُدِّرَ لَهُ ثُمَّ أَنْصَتَ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْ خُطْبَتِهِ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّيَ مَعَهُ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ الأُخْرَى وَفَضْلَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aumayyaau bnu bistaamin, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa rawhun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani aghtasala thumma aataa aljumu'aaa fasallaa maa quddira lahu thumma aansata hattaa yafrugha min khutbatihi thumma yusalliya ma'ahu ghufira lahu maa baynahu wabayna aljumu'aai alaukhraa wafadla thalaathaai aayyaamin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu-Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who took a bath and then came for Jumu'a prayer and then prayed what was fixed for him, then kept silence till the Imam finished the sermon, and then prayed along with him, his sins between that time and the next Friday would be forgiven, and even of three days more
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ أَتَى الْجُمُعَةَ فَاسْتَمَعَ وَأَنْصَتَ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَزِيَادَةُ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَنْ مَسَّ الْحَصَى فَقَدْ لَغَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man tawaddaaa faaahsana alwuduw'a thumma aataa aljumu'aaa faastama'a waaansata ghufira lahu maa baynahu wabayna aljumu'aai waziyaadaau thalaathaai aayyaamin waman massa alhasaa faqad laghaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who performed ablution well, then came to Friday prayer, listened (to the sermon), kept silence all (his sins) between that time and the next Friday would be forgiven with three days extra, and he who touched pebbles caused an interruption
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ آدَمَ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ نَرْجِعُ فَنُرِيحُ نَوَاضِحَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ حَسَنٌ فَقُلْتُ لِجَعْفَرٍ فِي أَىِّ سَاعَةٍ تِلْكَ قَالَ زَوَالَ الشَّمْسِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa yahyaa, bnu adama haddathanaa hasanu bnu 'ayyaashin, 'an ja'fari bni muhammadin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa nusalliy ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma narji'u fanuriyhu nawaadihanaa ‏.‏ qaala hasanun faqultu lija'farin fiy aaaai saa'aain tilka qaala zawaala alshhamsi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:We used to observe (Jumu'a) prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and then we returned and gave rest to our camels used for carrying water. Hassan[ (one of the narrators) said: I asked Ja'far what time that was. He said.. It is the time when the sun passes the meridian
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مَتَى كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الْجُمُعَةَ قَالَ كَانَ يُصَلِّي ثُمَّ نَذْهَبُ إِلَى جِمَالِنَا فَنُرِيحُهَا ‏.‏ زَادَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ حِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ يَعْنِي النَّوَاضِحَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, h wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi, alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hassaana, qaalaa jamiy'ana haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an ja'farin, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu saaala jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi mataa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy aljumu'aaa qaala kaana yusalliy thumma nadhhabu iilaa jimaalinaa fanuriyhuhaa ‏.‏ zaada 'abdu alllahi fiy hadiythihi hiyna tazuwlu alshhamsu ya'niy alnnawaadiha ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ja'far reported on the authority of his father:that he asked Jabir b. 'Abdullah when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed Jumu'a prayer. He said: He used to observe prayer, and we then went (back) to our camels and gave them rest. 'Abdullah made this addition in his narration: "Till the sun passed the meridian. and the camels used for carrying water (took rest)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ مَا كُنَّا نَقِيلُ وَلاَ نَتَغَدَّى إِلاَّ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ - زَادَ ابْنُ حُجْرٍ - فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, wayahyaa bnu yahyaa, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahlin, qaala maa kunnaa naqiylu walaa nataghaddaa iilaaa ba'da aljumu'aai - zaada abnu hujrin - fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Said said:We did not have a siesta or lunch till after the Friday prayer. (Ibn Hajr added: ) "During the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ، الْحَارِثِ الْمُحَارِبِيِّ عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُجَمِّعُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ ثُمَّ نَرْجِعُ نَتَتَبَّعُ الْفَىْءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaalaa aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'an ya'laa bni, alhaarithi almuhaaribiyyi 'an iiyaasi bni salamaaa bni alaakwa'i, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kunnaa nujammi'u ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa zaalati alshhamsu thumma narji'u natatabba'u alfaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Iyas b. Salama b. al-Akwa' reported on the authority of his father:We used to observe the Friday prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) when the sun passed the meridian. and we then returned and tried to find out afternoon shadow (of the walls for protecting themselves from the heat of the sun)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْجُمُعَةَ فَنَرْجِعُ وَمَا نَجِدُ لِلْحِيطَانِ فَيْئًا نَسْتَظِلُّ بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu 'abdi almaliki, haddathanaa ya'laa bnu alhaarithi, 'an iiyaasi bni salamaaa bni alaakwa'i, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kunnaa nusalliy ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aljumu'aaa fanarji'u wamaa najidu lilhiytaani fayiana nastazillu bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Iyas b. Salama b. Akwa' reported on the authority of his father, saying:We used to observe the Friday prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and when we returned we did not find the shadow of the walls in which we could take protection (from the heat of the sun)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ جَمِيعًا عَنْ خَالِدٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو كَامِلٍ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، - حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَائِمًا ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَمَا يَفْعَلُونَ الْيَوْمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, waaabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu jamiy'ana 'an khaalidin, - qaala aabuw kaamilin haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, - haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu yawma aljumu'aai qaaiimana thumma yajlisu thumma yaquwmu ‏.‏ qaala kamaa yaf'aluwna alyawma ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to deliver the sermon on Friday while standing. He would then sit and then stand (for the second sermon) as they (the Muslims) do nowadays
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَتْ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خُطْبَتَانِ يَجْلِسُ بَيْنَهُمَا يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَيُذَكِّرُ النَّاسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wahasanu bnu alrrabiy'i, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an simaakin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala kaanat lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm khutbataani yajlisu baynahumaa yaqraau alqurana wayudhakkiru alnnaasa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura said:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) gave two sermons between which he sat, recited the Qur'an and exhorted the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ، سَمُرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَخْطُبُ قَائِمًا ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيَخْطُبُ قَائِمًا فَمَنْ نَبَّأَكَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَخْطُبُ جَالِسًا فَقَدْ كَذَبَ فَقَدْ وَاللَّهِ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَلْفَىْ صَلاَةٍ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an simaakin, qaala aanbaaaniy jaabiru bnu, samuraaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yakhtubu qaaiimana thumma yajlisu thumma yaquwmu fayakhtubu qaaiimana faman nabbaaaka aannahu kaana yakhtubu jaalisana faqad kadhaba faqad waalllahi sallaytu ma'ahu aakthara min aalfaa salaaain
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to deliver the sermon while standing. He would then sit down and then stand up and address in a standing posture; and whoever informed you that he (the Holy Prophet) delivered the sermon while sitting told a lie. By Allah. I prayed with him more than two thousand times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، - قَالَ عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَخْطُبُ قَائِمًا يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَجَاءَتْ عِيرٌ مِنَ الشَّامِ فَانْفَتَلَ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهَا حَتَّى لَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ اثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلاً فَأُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ الَّتِي فِي الْجُمُعَةِ ‏{‏ وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انْفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, kilaahumaa 'an jariyrin, - qaala 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, - 'an husayni bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri, bni 'abdi alllahi aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yakhtubu qaaiimana yawma aljumu'aai fajaa'at 'iyrun mina alshhaami faanfatala alnnaasu iilayhaa hattaa lam yabqa iilaaa athnaa 'ashara rajulaan faaunzilat hadhihi alayaau allatiy fiy aljumu'aai ‏{‏ waiidhaa raaawa tijaaraaan aaw lahwana anfadduwa iilayhaa watarakuwka qaaiimana‏}‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that the Apostle (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday in a standing posture when a caravan from Syria arrived. The people flocked towards it till no one was left (with the Holy Prophet) but twelve persons, and it was on this occasion that this verse in regard to Jumu'a was revealed." And when they see merchandise or sport. they break away to it and leave thee standing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ قَائِمًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'an husaynin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu ‏.‏ walam yaqul qaaiimana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Husain with the same chain of transmitters but with this alteration that he did not make mention of the standing position
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا رِفَاعَةُ بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي الطَّحَّانَ - عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، وَأَبِي، سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَدِمَتْ سُوَيْقَةٌ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهَا فَلَمْ يَبْقَ إِلاَّ اثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلاً أَنَا فِيهِمْ - قَالَ - فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏ وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انْفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa rifaa'aau bnu alhaythami alwaasitiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy alttahhaana - 'an husaynin, 'an saalimin, waaabiy, sufyaana 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma aljumu'aai faqadimat suwayqaaun qaala fakharaja alnnaasu iilayhaa falam yabqa iilaaa athnaa 'ashara rajulaan aanaa fiyhim - qaala - faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏ waiidhaa raaawa tijaaraaan aaw lahwana anfadduwa iilayhaa watarakuwka qaaiimana‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:I was along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Friday when a caravan arrived. The people went to it, and none but twelve persons were left behind and I was one of them; and it was on this occasion that this verse was revealed:" And when they see merchandise or sport away to it, and leave thee standing" (lxii. 1 1). they break
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، وَسَالِمِ، بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِذْ قَدِمَتْ عِيرٌ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَابْتَدَرَهَا أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى لَمْ يَبْقَ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ اثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلاً فِيهِمْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ - قَالَ - وَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انْفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu saalimin, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa husaynun, 'an aabiy sufyaana, wasaalimi, bni aabiy alja'di 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala baynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun yawma aljumu'aai iidh qadimat 'iyrun iilaa almadiynaai faabtadarahaa aashaabu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa lam yabqa ma'ahu iilaaa athnaa 'ashara rajulaan fiyhim aabuw bakrin wa'umaru - qaala - wanazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ waiidhaa raaawa tijaaraaan aaw lahwana anfadduwa iilayhaa‏}‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:While the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering (a sermon) on Friday, a caravan of merchandise came to Medina. The Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) rushed towards it till only twelve persons were left with him including Abu Bakr and 'Umar; and it was at this occasion that this verse was revealed." And when they see merchandise or sport, they break away to it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أُمِّ الْحَكَمِ يَخْطُبُ قَاعِدًا فَقَالَ انْظُرُوا إِلَى هَذَا الْخَبِيثِ يَخْطُبُ قَاعِدًا وَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏ وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انْفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, 'an aabiy 'ubaydaaa, 'an ka'bi bni 'ujraaa, qaala dakhala almasjida wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu aummi alhakami yakhtubu qaa'idana faqaala anzuruwa iilaa hadhaa alkhabiythi yakhtubu qaa'idana waqaala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏ waiidhaa raaawa tijaaraaan aaw lahwana anfadduwa iilayhaa watarakuwka qaaiimana‏}‏
verses.translation: Ka'b b. 'Ujra reported that he entered the mosque and saw Abd al-Rahman b. Umm Hakam delivering the sermon in a sitting posture. Upon this he said:Look at this wretched person; he delivers the sermon while sitting, whereas Allah said:" And when they see merchandise or sport, they break away to it and leave thee standing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تَوْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَلاَّمٍ - عَنْ زَيْدٍ، - يَعْنِي أَخَاهُ - أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَلاَّمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مِينَاءَ، أَنَّحَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّهُمَا، سَمِعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عَلَى أَعْوَادِ مِنْبَرِهِ ‏ "‏ لَيَنْتَهِيَنَّ أَقْوَامٌ عَنْ وَدْعِهِمُ الْجُمُعَاتِ أَوْ لَيَخْتِمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَيَكُونُنَّ مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa aabuw tawbaaa, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau, - wahuwa abnu salaaamin - 'an zaydin, - ya'niy aakhaahu - aannahu sami'a aabaa salaaamin, qaala haddathaniy alhakamu bnu miynaa'a, aannahaddathaahu aannahumaa, sami'aa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu 'alaa aa'waadi minbarihi ‏ "‏ layantahiyanna aaqwaamun 'an wad'ihimu aljumu'aati aaw layakhtimanna alllahu 'alaa quluwbihim thumma layakuwnunna mina alghaafiliyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar and Abu Huraira said that they heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say on the planks of his pulpit:People must cease to neglect the Friday prayer or Allah will seal their hearts and then they will be among the negligent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَانَتْ صَلاَتُهُ قَصْدًا وَخُطْبَتُهُ قَصْدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanu bnu alrrabiy'i, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an simaakin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala kuntu ausalliy ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakaanat salaatuhu qasdana wakhutbatuhu qasdana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:I used to pray with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and both his prayer and sermon were of moderate length
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، حَدَّثَنِي سِمَاكُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلَوَاتِ فَكَانَتْ صَلاَتُهُ قَصْدًا وَخُطْبَتُهُ قَصْدًا ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ زَكَرِيَّاءُ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, haddathaniy simaaku bnu harbin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala kuntu ausalliy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alssalawaati fakaanat salaatuhu qasdana wakhutbatuhu qasdana ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy bakrin zakariyyaa'u 'an simaakin
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:I used to observe prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his prayer was of moderate length and his sermon too was of moderate length
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا خَطَبَ احْمَرَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ وَعَلاَ صَوْتُهُ وَاشْتَدَّ غَضَبُهُ حَتَّى كَأَنَّهُ مُنْذِرُ جَيْشٍ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ صَبَّحَكُمْ وَمَسَّاكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةَ كَهَاتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَيَقْرُنُ بَيْنَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ وَخَيْرُ الْهُدَى هُدَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَشَرُّ الأُمُورِ مُحْدَثَاتُهَا وَكُلُّ بِدْعَةٍ ضَلاَلَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَنَا أَوْلَى بِكُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ مَنْ تَرَكَ مَالاً فَلأَهْلِهِ وَمَنْ تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضَيَاعًا فَإِلَىَّ وَعَلَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu almuthanaaa, hadaathanaa 'abdu alwahaaabi bnu 'abdi almajiydi, 'an ja'fari bni muhamaadin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi allaahi, qaala kaana rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa khataba ahmaraat 'aynaahu wa'alaa sawtuhu waashtadaa ghadabuhu hataaa kaaanaahu mundhiru jayshin yaquwlu ‏"‏ sabaahakum wamasaaakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wayaquwlu ‏"‏ bu'ithtu aanaa waalsaaa'aaa kahaatayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wayaqrunu bayna iisba'ayhi alsaabaaabaai waalwustaa wayaquwlu ‏"‏ aamaaa ba'du faiinaa khayra alhadiythi kitaabu allaahi wakhayru alhudaa hudaa muhamaadin washaruu alaumuwri muhdathaatuhaa wakuluu bid'aain dalaalaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumaa yaquwlu ‏"‏ aanaa aawlaa bikulii muuminin min nafsihi man taraka maalaan falaahlihi waman taraka daynana aaw dayaa'ana faiilaaaa wa'alaaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah said:When Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) delivered the sermon, his eyes became red, his voice rose, and his anger increased so that he was like one giving a warning against the enemy and saying: "The enemy has made a morning attack on you and in the evening too." He would also say: "The Last Hour and I have been sent like these two." And he would join his forefinger and middle finger; and would further say: "The best of the speech is embodied in the Book of Allah, and the best of the guidance is the guidance given by Muhammad. And the most evil affairs are their innovations; and every innovation is error." He would further say:, I am more dear to a Muslim even than his self; and he who left behind property that is for his family; and he who dies under debt or leaves children (in helplessness), the responsibility (of paying his debt and bringing up his children) lies on me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ، بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ كَانَتْ خُطْبَةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ يَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيُثْنِي عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ عَلَى إِثْرِ ذَلِكَ وَقَدْ عَلاَ صَوْتُهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahadaathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, hadaathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, hadaathaniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, hadaathaniy ja'faru, bnu muhamaadin 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi allaahi, yaquwlu kaanat khutbaau alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma aljumu'aai yahmadu allaaha wayuthniy 'alayhi thumaa yaquwlu 'alaa iithri dhalika waqad 'alaa sawtuhu ‏.‏ thumaa saaqa alhadiytha bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ja'far b. Muhammad said on the authority of his father:I heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying that in the sermon of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) he praised Allah, lauded Him (and subsequently said [other words] and raised his voice, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ يَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيُثْنِي عَلَيْهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللَّهُ فَلاَ مُضِلَّ لَهُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلاَ هَادِيَ لَهُ وَخَيْرُ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ الثَّقَفِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an ja'farin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaabirin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu alnnaasa yahmadu alllaha wayuthniy 'alayhi bimaa huwa aahluhu thumma yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man yahdihi alllahu falaa mudilla lahu waman yudlil falaa haadiya lahu wakhayru alhadiythi kitaabu alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma saaqa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythi althhaqafiyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), while delivering the sermon' to the people, praised Allah, and lauded Him for what He deserves, and would then say:He whom Allah guides aright, there is none to mislead him, and he who is led astray, there is none to guide him (aright), and the best of the talk is embodied in the Book of Allah. And the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، - قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، وَهُوَ أَبُو هَمَّامٍ - حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ ضِمَادًا، قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَزْدِ شَنُوءَةَ وَكَانَ يَرْقِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الرِّيحِ فَسَمِعَ سُفَهَاءَ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ مُحَمَّدًا مَجْنُونٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَوْ أَنِّي رَأَيْتُ هَذَا الرَّجُلَ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يَشْفِيهِ عَلَى يَدَىَّ - قَالَ - فَلَقِيَهُ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنِّي أَرْقِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الرِّيحِ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَشْفِي عَلَى يَدِي مَنْ شَاءَ فَهَلْ لَكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللَّهُ فَلاَ مُضِلَّ لَهُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلاَ هَادِيَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمَّا بَعْدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَعِدْ عَلَىَّ كَلِمَاتِكَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏.‏ فَأَعَادَهُنَّ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ لَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ قَوْلَ الْكَهَنَةِ وَقَوْلَ السَّحَرَةِ وَقَوْلَ الشُّعَرَاءِ فَمَا سَمِعْتُ مِثْلَ كَلِمَاتِكَ هَؤُلاَءِ وَلَقَدْ بَلَغْنَ نَاعُوسَ الْبَحْرِ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ هَاتِ يَدَكَ أُبَايِعْكَ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ - قَالَ - فَبَايَعَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَعَلَى قَوْمِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَعَلَى قَوْمِي - قَالَ - فَبَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً فَمَرُّوا بِقَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ صَاحِبُ السَّرِيَّةِ لِلْجَيْشِ هَلْ أَصَبْتُمْ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَصَبْتُ مِنْهُمْ مِطْهَرَةً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رُدُّوهَا فَإِنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ قَوْمُ ضِمَادٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alaa'laa, - qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathaniy 'abdu alaa'laa, wahuwa aabuw hammaamin - haddathanaa daawudu, 'an 'amriw bni sa'iydin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna dimaadana, qadima makkaaa wakaana min aazdi shanuw'aaa wakaana yarqiy min hadhihi alrriyhi fasami'a sufahaa'a min aahli makkaaa yaquwluwna iinna muhammadana majnuwnun ‏.‏ faqaala law aanniy raaaytu hadhaa alrrajula la'alla alllaha yashfiyhi 'alaa yadaaaa - qaala - falaqiyahu faqaala yaa muhammadu iinniy aarqiy min hadhihi alrriyhi waiinna alllaha yashfiy 'alaa yadiy man shaa'a fahal laka faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna alhamda lillahi nahmaduhu wanasta'iynuhu man yahdihi alllahu falaa mudilla lahu waman yudlil falaa haadiya lahu waaashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu waaanna muhammadana 'abduhu warasuwluhu aammaa ba'du ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala aa'id 'alaaaa kalimaatika hauulaa'i ‏.‏ faaa'aadahunna 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaatha marraatin - qaala - faqaala laqad sami'tu qawla alkahanaai waqawla alssaharaai waqawla alshhu'araa'i famaa sami'tu mithla kalimaatika hauulaa'i walaqad balaghna naa'uwsa albahri - qaala - faqaala haati yadaka aubaayi'ka 'alaa aliislaami - qaala - fabaaya'ahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wa'alaa qawmika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wa'alaa qawmiy - qaala - faba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sariyyaaan famarruwa biqawmihi faqaala saahibu alssariyyaai liljayshi hal aasabtum min hauulaa'i shayiana faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi aasabtu minhum mitharaaan ‏.‏ faqaala rudduwhaa faiinna hauulaa'i qawmu dimaadin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:Dimad came to Mecca and he belonged to the tribe of Azd Shanu'a, and he used to protect the person who was under the influence of charm. He heard the foolish people of Mecca say that Muhammad (ﷺ) was under the spell. Upon this he said: If 1 were to come across this man, Allah might cure him at my hand. He met him and said: Muhammad, I can protect (one) who is under the influence of charm, and Allah cures one whom He so desires at my hand. Do you desire (this)? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Praise is due to Allah, we praise Him, ask His help; and he whom Allah guides aright there is none to lead him astray, and he who is led astray there is none to guide him, and I bear testimony to the fact that there is no god but Allah, He is One, having no partner with Him, and that Muhammad is His Servant and Messenger. Now after this he (Dimad) said: Repeat these words of yours before me, and the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) repeated these to him thrice; and he said I have heard the words of soothsayers and the words of magicians, and the words of poets, but I have never heard such words as yours, and they reach the depth (of the ocean of eloquence) ; bring forth your hand so that I should take oath of fealty to you on Islam. So he took an oath of allegiance to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It (this allegiance of yours) is on behalf of your people too. He said: It is on behalf of my people too. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent an expedition and the flying column passed by his people. The leader of the flying column said to the detachment: Did you find anything from these people? One of the people said: I found a utensil for water. Upon this he (the commander) said: Return it, for he is one of the people of Dimad
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبْجَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ وَاصِلِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو وَائِلٍ خَطَبَنَا عَمَّارٌ فَأَوْجَزَ وَأَبْلَغَ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ قُلْنَا يَا أَبَا الْيَقْظَانِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتَ وَأَوْجَزْتَ فَلَوْ كُنْتَ تَنَفَّسْتَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ طُولَ صَلاَةِ الرَّجُلِ وَقِصَرَ خُطْبَتِهِ مَئِنَّةٌ مِنْ فِقْهِهِ فَأَطِيلُوا الصَّلاَةَ وَاقْصُرُوا الْخُطْبَةَ وَإِنَّ مِنَ الْبَيَانِ سِحْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy surayju bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi almaliki bni aabjara, 'an aabiyhi, 'an waasili bni hayyaana, qaala qaala aabuw waaiilin khatabanaa 'ammaarun faaawjaza waaablagha falammaa nazala qulnaa yaa aabaa alyaqzaani laqad aablaghta waaawjazta falaw kunta tanaffasta ‏.‏ faqaala iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna tuwla salaaai alrrajuli waqisara khutbatihi maiinnaaun min fiqhihi faaatiyluwa alssalaaaa waaqsuruwa alkhutbaaa waiinna mina albayaani sihrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Wa'il reported:'Ammar delivered to us the sermon. It was short and eloquent. When he (, Ammir) descended (from the pulpit) we said to him: 0 Abd al-Yaqzn, you have delivered a short and eloquent sermon. Would that you had lengthened (the sermon). He said: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: The lengthening of prayer by a man and the shortness of the sermon is the sign of his understanding (of faith). So lengthen the prayer and shorten the sermon, for there is charm (in precise) expression
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، خَطَبَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ رَشِدَ وَمَنْ يَعْصِهِمَا فَقَدْ غَوَى ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بِئْسَ الْخَطِيبُ أَنْتَ ‏.‏ قُلْ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ فَقَدْ غَوِيَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni rufay'in, 'an tamiymi bni tarafaaa, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, aanna rajulaan, khataba 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala man yuti'i alllaha warasuwlahu faqad rashida waman ya'sihimaa faqad ghawaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ biisa alkhatiybu aanta ‏.‏ qul waman ya'si alllaha warasuwlahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu numayrin faqad ghawiya ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi b. Hatim reported:that a person recited a sermon before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) thus: He who obeys Allah and His Apostle, he in fact follows the right path, and he who disobeys both of them, he goes astray. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: What a bad speaker you are; say: He who disobeys Allah and His Apostle. Ibn Numair added: He in fact went astray
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْحَاقُ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، - عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ عَطَاءً، يُخْبِرُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ، يَعْلَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏{‏ وَنَادَوْا يَا مَالِكُ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waiishaaqu alhanzaliyyu jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala qutaybaau haddathanaa sufyaanu, - 'an 'amrinw, sami'a 'ataa'an, yukhbiru 'an safwaana bni, ya'laa 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau 'alaa alminbari ‏{‏ wanaadawa yaa maaliku‏}‏
verses.translation: Safwan b. Ya'la reported on the authority of his father that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting (verses of the Qur'an) on the pulpit. and" They cried:0 Malik
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، بْنُ بِلاَلٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أُخْتٍ، لِعَمْرَةَ قَالَتْ أَخَذْتُ ‏{‏ ق وَالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيدِ‏}‏ مِنْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ بِهَا عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فِي كُلِّ جُمُعَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu hassaana, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, bnu bilaalin 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aukhtin, li'amraaa qaalat aakhadhtu ‏{‏ q waalqurani almajiydi‏}‏ min fiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma aljumu'aai wahuwa yaqraau bihaa 'alaa alminbari fiy kulli jumu'aain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amra daughter of Abd al-Rahman reported on the authority of the sister of Amra:I memorised (surah) "Qaf, by the glorious Qur'an" from the mouth of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Friday for he recited it on the pulpit on every Friday
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أُخْتٍ، لِعَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ كَانَتْ أَكْبَرَ مِنْهَا ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an yahyaa bni aayyuwba, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa, 'an aukhtin, li'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani kaanat aakbara minhaa ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi sulaymaana bni bilaalin ‏.‏
verses.translation: The daughter of Haritha b. Nu'man said:I did not memorise (Surah) Qaf but from the mouth of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as he used to deliver the. sermon along with it on every Friday. She also added: Our oven and that of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was one
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خُبَيْبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَعْنٍ عَنْ بِنْتٍ لِحَارِثَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَتْ مَا حَفِظْتُ ‏{‏ ق‏}‏ إِلاَّ مِنْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ بِهَا كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَكَانَ تَنُّورُنَا وَتَنُّورُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاحِدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an khubaybin, 'an 'abdi, alllahi bni muhammadi bni ma'nin 'an bintin lihaarithaaa bni alnnu'maani, qaalat maa hafiztu ‏{‏ q‏}‏ iilaaa min fiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu bihaa kulla jumu'aain ‏.‏ qaalat wakaana tannuwrunaa watannuwru rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waahidana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Bisham hint Haritha b. Nu'man said:Our oven and that of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was one for two years, or for one year or for a part of a year; and I learnt" Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an" from no other source than the tongue of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who used to recite it every Friday on the pulpit when he delivered the sermon to the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ هِشَامٍ بِنْتِ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَتْ لَقَدْ كَانَ تَنُّورُنَا وَتَنُّورُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاحِدًا سَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ سَنَةً وَبَعْضَ سَنَةٍ وَمَا أَخَذْتُ ‏{‏ ق وَالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيدِ‏}‏ إِلاَّ عَنْ لِسَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَؤُهَا كُلَّ يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ إِذَا خَطَبَ النَّاسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahadaathanaa 'amrunw alnaaaqidu, hadaathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, hadaathanaa aabiy, 'an muhamaadi, bni iishaaqa qaala hadaathaniy 'abdu allaahi bnu aabiy bakri bni muhamaadi bni 'amriw bni hazmin alaansaariyuu, 'an yahyaa bni 'abdi allaahi bni 'abdi alraahmani bni sa'di bni zuraaraaa, 'an aumii hishaamin binti haarithaaa bni alnuu'maani, qaalat laqad kaana tanuuwrunaa watanuuwru rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waahidana sanatayni aaw sanaaan waba'da sanaain wamaa aakhadhtu ‏{‏ q waalqurani almajiydi‏}‏ iilaaa 'an lisaani rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqrauuhaa kulaa yawmi jumu'aain 'alaa alminbari iidhaa khataba alnaaasa ‏.‏
verses.translation: It was narrated that Umm Hisham bin Harithah bin An-Nu'man said:"Our oven and the oven of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) were the same for two years, or for one year and part of a year. And I only learned "Surah Qaf. By the Glorious Quran" from the tongue of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), who used to recited it every Friday from the Minbar, when he addresses the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، بْنِ رُؤَيْبَةَ قَالَ رَأَى بِشْرَ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ قَبَّحَ اللَّهُ هَاتَيْنِ الْيَدَيْنِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا يَزِيدُ عَلَى أَنْ يَقُولَ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا ‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ الْمُسَبِّحَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahadaathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu iidriysa, 'an husaynin, 'an 'umaaraaa, bni ruuaybaaa qaala raaaa bishra bna marwaana 'alaa alminbari raafi'ana yadayhi faqaala qabaaha allaahu haatayni alyadayni laqad raaaytu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa yaziydu 'alaa aan yaquwla biyadihi hakadhaa ‏.‏ waaashaara biiisba'ihi almusabiihaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umara b. Ruwaiba said he saw Bishr b. Marwan on the pulpit raising his hands and said:Allah, disfigure these hands! I have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gesture no more than this with his hands, and he pointed with his forefinger
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ بِشْرَ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَارَةُ بْنُ رُؤَيْبَةَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an husayni bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala raaaytu bishra bna marwaana yawma jumu'aain yarfa'u yadayhi ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaaraau bnu ruuaybaaa ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters on the authority of Husain b. Abd al-Rahman
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَ هُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَصَلَّيْتَ يَا فُلاَنُ "‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُمْ فَارْكَعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, - wa huwa abnu zaydin - 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala baynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu yawma aljumu'aai iidh jaa'a rajulun faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aasallayta yaa fulaanu "‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qum faarka' ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday a person came there, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him:So and so, have you prayed (two rak'ahs)? He said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Then stand and pray
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَيَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا قَالَ حَمَّادٌ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waya'quwbu alddawraqiyyu, 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kamaa qaala hammaadun walam yadhkuri alrrak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Jabir through another chain of transmitters but Hammad (one of the narrators) made no mention of the two rak'ahs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ الْمَسْجِدَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَلَّيْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُمْ فَصَلِّ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ قُتَيْبَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala qutaybaau haddathanaa waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu dakhala rajulun almasjida warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu yawma aljumu'aai faqaala ‏"‏ aasallayta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qum fasalli alrrak'atayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai qutaybaaa qaala ‏"‏ salli rak'atayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah said that a person entered the Mosque while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said:Have you observed prayer? He said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Stand and offer the two rak'ahs. According to Qutaiba, the words are:" He said: Offer two rak'ahs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ يَخْطُبُ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ أَرَكَعْتَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ. فَقَالَ: «ارْكَعْ»
verses.translit: wahadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala abnu raafi'in hadaathanaa 'abdu alraazaaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, aanaahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi allaahi, yaquwlu jaa'a rajulun waalnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari yawma aljumu'aai yakhtubu faqaala lahu ‏ "‏ aaraka'ta rak'atayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa. faqaala: «arka'»
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a person came (in the Mosque) while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday (standing) on the pulpit. He (the Holy Prophet) said to him:Have you offered two rak'ahs? He said: No. Upon this he said: Then observe (them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَقَدْ خَرَجَ الإِمَامُ فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amrinw, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm khataba faqaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa jaa'a aahadukum yawma aljumu'aai waqad kharaja aliimaamu falyusalli rak'atayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) delivered the sermon and said:When any one of you comes for the Friday (prayer) and the Imam comes out (from his apartment), (even then) should observe two rak'ahs (of prayer)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ جَاءَ سُلَيْكٌ الْغَطَفَانِيُّ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَاعِدٌ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَقَعَدَ سُلَيْكٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرَكَعْتَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُمْ فَارْكَعْهُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aannahu qaala jaa'a sulaykun alghatafaaniyyu yawma aljumu'aai warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaa'idun 'alaa alminbari faqa'ada sulaykun qabla aan yusalliya faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaraka'ta rak'atayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qum faarka'humaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Sulaik Ghatafani came on Friday (for prayer) while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was sitting on the pulpit. Sulaik also sat down before observing prayer. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said:Have you observed two rak'ahs? He said: No. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Stand and observe them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ خَشْرَمٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ سُلَيْكٌ الْغَطَفَانِيُّ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ فَجَلَسَ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ يَا سُلَيْكُ قُمْ فَارْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَتَجَوَّزْ فِيهِمَا - ثُمَّ قَالَ - إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَلْيَتَجَوَّزْ فِيهِمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, kilaahumaa 'an 'iysaa bni yuwnusa, - qaala abnu khashramin aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, - 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala jaa'a sulaykun alghatafaaniyyu yawma aljumu'aai warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu fajalasa faqaala lahu ‏ "‏ yaa sulayku qum faarka' rak'atayni watajawwaz fiyhimaa - thumma qaala - iidhaa jaa'a aahadukum yawma aljumu'aai waaliimaamu yakhtubu falyarka' rak'atayni walyatajawwaz fiyhimaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:Sulaik Ghatafani came on Friday when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon. He (Sulaik) sat down. He (the Holy Prophet) said to him: 0 Sulaik I stand and observe two rak'ahs and make them short, and then said: When any one of you comes on Friday, while the Imam delivers the sermon, he should observe two rak'ahs and should make them short
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو رِفَاعَةَ انْتَهَيْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ غَرِيبٌ جَاءَ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ دِينِهِ لاَ يَدْرِي مَا دِينُهُ - قَالَ - فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَرَكَ خُطْبَتَهُ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَىَّ فَأُتِيَ بِكُرْسِيٍّ حَسِبْتُ قَوَائِمَهُ حَدِيدًا - قَالَ - فَقَعَدَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَعَلَ يُعَلِّمُنِي مِمَّا عَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ أَتَى خُطْبَتَهُ فَأَتَمَّ آخِرَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, haddathanaa humaydu bnu hilaalin, qaala qaala aabuw rifaa'aaa antahaytu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yakhtubu qaala faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi rajulun ghariybun jaa'a yasaalu 'an diynihi laa yadriy maa diynuhu - qaala - faaaqbala 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wataraka khutbatahu hattaa antahaa iilaaaa faautiya bikursiyyin hasibtu qawaaiimahu hadiydana - qaala - faqa'ada 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waja'ala yu'allimuniy mimmaa 'allamahu alllahu thumma aataa khutbatahu faaatamma akhirahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Rifa'a reported:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) when he was delivering the sermon, and I said: Messenger of Allah, here is a stranger and he wants to learn about this religion and he does not know what this religion is. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) looked at me and left his sermon till he came to me, and he was given a chair and I thought that Its legs were made of iron. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sat In it and he began to teach me what Allah had taught him. He then came (to the pulpit) for his sermon and completed it to the end
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ اسْتَخْلَفَ مَرْوَانُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَخَرَجَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَصَلَّى لَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ الْجُمُعَةَ فَقَرَأَ بَعْدَ سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الآخِرَةِ ‏{‏ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ‏}‏ - قَالَ - فَأَدْرَكْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ حِينَ انْصَرَفَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّكَ قَرَأْتَ بِسُورَتَيْنِ كَانَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ يَقْرَأُ بِهِمَا بِالْكُوفَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ بِهِمَا يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - wahuwa abnu bilaalin - 'an ja'farin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni aabiy raafi'in, qaala astakhlafa marwaanu aabaa hurayraaa 'alaa almadiynaai wakharaja iilaa makkaaa fasallaa lanaa aabuw hurayraaa aljumu'aaa faqaraaa ba'da suwraai aljumu'aai fiy alrrak'aai alakhiraai ‏{‏ iidhaa jaa'aka almunaafiquwna‏}‏ - qaala - faaadraktu aabaa hurayraaa hiyna ansarafa faqultu lahu iinnaka qaraata bisuwratayni kaana 'aliyyu bnu aabiy taalibin yaqraau bihimaa bialkuwfaai ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw hurayraaa iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau bihimaa yawma aljumu'aai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abu Rafi' said:Marwan appointed Abu Huraira as his deputy in Medina and he himself left for Mecca. Abu Huraira led us in the Jumu'a prayer and recited after Surah Jumu'a in the second rak'ah:" When the hypocrites came to thee" (Surah 63). I then met Abu Huraira as he came back and said to him: You have recited two surahs which 'Ali b. Abu Talib used to recite in Kufah. Upon this Abu Huraira said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reciting these two in the Friday (prayer)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ اسْتَخْلَفَ مَرْوَانُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، رِوَايَةِ حَاتِمٍ فَقَرَأَ بِسُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي السَّجْدَةِ الأُولَى وَفِي الآخِرَةِ ‏{‏ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ‏}‏ وَرِوَايَةُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ مِثْلُ حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaalaa haddathanaa haatimu bnu iismaa'iyla, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - kilaahumaa 'an ja'farin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy raafi'in, qaala astakhlafa marwaanu aabaa hurayraaa ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aanna fiy, riwaayaai haatimin faqaraaa bisuwraai aljumu'aai fiy alssajdaai alauwlaa wafiy alakhiraai ‏{‏ iidhaa jaa'aka almunaafiquwna‏}‏ wariwaayaau 'abdi al'aziyzi mithlu hadiythi sulaymaana bni bilaalin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated by Abdullah b. Abu Rafi' with the same chain of transmitters but with this modification:" That he recited Surah Jumu'a (lxii.) in the first rak'ah and" The hypocrites came" in the second rak'ah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْحَاقُ جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ، سَالِمٍ مَوْلَى النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ وَفِي الْجُمُعَةِ بِـ ‏{‏ سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعْلَى‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ‏}‏ قَالَ وَإِذَا اجْتَمَعَ الْعِيدُ وَالْجُمُعَةُ فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ يَقْرَأُ بِهِمَا أَيْضًا فِي الصَّلاَتَيْنِ
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waiishaaqu jamiy'ana 'an jariyrin, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa jariyrun, - 'an iibraahiyma bni muhammadi bni almuntashiri, 'an aabiyhi, 'an habiybi bni, saalimin mawlaa alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy al'iydayni wafiy aljumu'aai bi ‏{‏ sabbihi asma rabbika alaa'laa‏}‏ wa ‏{‏ hal aataaka hadiythu alghaashiyaai‏}‏ qaala waiidhaa ajtama'a al'iydu waaljumu'aau fiy yawmin waahidin yaqraau bihimaa aaydana fiy alssalaatayni
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite on two 'Ids and in Friday prayer:" Glorify The name of Thy Lord, the Most High" (Surah lxxxvii.), and:" Has there come to thee the news of the overwhelming event" (lxxxviii.). And when the 'Id and Jumu'a combined on a day he recited these two (surah) in both the prayers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an iibraahiyma bni muhammadi bni almuntashiri, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibrahim b Muhammad b. al-Muntashir with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ كَتَبَ الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ إِلَى النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ يَسْأَلُهُ أَىَّ شَىْءٍ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ سِوَى سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏ هَلْ أَتَاكَ‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an damraaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi qaala kataba alddahhaaku bnu qaysin iilaa alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin yasaaluhu aaaaa shaa'in qaraaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma aljumu'aai siwaa suwraai aljumu'aai faqaala kaana yaqraau ‏{‏ hal aataaka‏}‏
verses.translation: Dahhak b. Qais wrote to Nu'man b. Bashir asking him what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited on Friday besides Surah Jumu'a He said that he recited:" Has there reached..." (Surah lxxxviii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُخَوَّلِ، بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْبَطِينِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ ‏{‏ الم * تَنْزِيلُ‏}‏ السَّجْدَةُ وَ ‏{‏ هَلْ أَتَى عَلَى الإِنْسَانِ حِينٌ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ‏}‏ وَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي صَلاَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, 'an sufyaana, 'an mukhawwali, bni raashidin 'an muslimin albatiyni, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy salaaai alfajri yawma aljumu'aai ‏{‏ alm * tanziylu‏}‏ alssajdaau wa ‏{‏ hal aataa 'alaa aliinsaani hiynun mina alddahri‏}‏ waaanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy salaaai aljumu'aai suwraaa aljumu'aai waalmunaafiqiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the morning prayer on Friday Surah" Alif-Lam-Mim, Tanz'il ul-Sajda" (Surah xxxii.): Surely there came over the man a time" (Surah lxxvii) and he used to recite in Jumu'a prayer Surahs Jumu'a and al-Munafiqin
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, kilaahumaa 'an sufyaana, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Sufyan with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُخَوَّلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ فِي الصَّلاَتَيْنِ كِلْتَيْهِمَا ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mukhawwalin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu fiy alssalaatayni kiltayhimaa ‏.‏ kamaa qaala sufyaanu
verses.translation: Mukhawwil has narrated this hadith on the authority of Sufyan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الْفَجْرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ ‏{‏ الم * تَنْزِيلُ‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ هَلْ أَتَى‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi, alrrahmani alaa'raji 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ aannahu kaana yaqraau fiy alfajri yawma aljumu'aai ‏{‏ alm * tanziylu‏}‏ wa ‏{‏ hal aataa‏}‏
