verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the dawn prayer on Friday" Alif-Lam-Mim, Tanzil" and" Surely there came
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الصُّبْحِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ بِـ ‏{‏ الم * تَنْزِيلُ‏}‏ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى وَفِي الثَّانِيَةِ ‏{‏ هَلْ أَتَى عَلَى الإِنْسَانِ حِينٌ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْئًا مَذْكُورًا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an iibraahiyma bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, ‏.‏ aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy alssubhi yawma aljumu'aai bi ‏{‏ alm * tanziylu‏}‏ fiy alrrak'aai alauwlaa wafiy althhaaniyaai ‏{‏ hal aataa 'alaa aliinsaani hiynun mina alddahri lam yakun shayiana madhkuwrana‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite in the dawn prayer on Friday:" Alif-Lam-Mim, Tanzil" in the first rak'ah, and in the second one:" Surely there came over the man a time when he was nothing that could be mentioned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا صَلَّى أَحَدُكُمُ الْجُمُعَةَ فَلْيُصَلِّ بَعْدَهَا أَرْبَعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa sallaa aahadukumu aljumu'aaa falyusalli ba'dahaa aarba'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you observes the Jumu'a prayer (two obligatory rak'ahs in congregation), he should observe four (rak'ahs) afterwards
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُمْ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَصَلُّوا أَرْبَعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ - زَادَ عَمْرٌو فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ قَالَ سُهَيْلٌ فَإِنْ عَجِلَ بِكَ شَىْءٌ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ إِذَا رَجَعْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa sallaytum ba'da aljumu'aai fasalluwa aarba'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ - zaada 'amrunw fiy riwaayatihi qaala abnu iidriysa qaala suhaylun faiin 'ajila bika shaa'un fasalli rak'atayni fiy almasjidi warak'atayni iidhaa raja'ta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Suhail reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:When you observe prayer after (the two obligatory rak'ahs) of Jumu'ah, you should observe four rak'ahs (and 'Amr in his narration has made this addition that Ibn Idris said this on the authority of Suhail): And if you are in a hurry on account of something, you should observe two rak'ahs in the mosque and two when you return (to your house)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مُصَلِّيًا بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَلْيُصَلِّ أَرْبَعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏"‏ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, kilaahumaa 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man kaana minkum musalliyana ba'da aljumu'aai falyusalli aarba'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi jariyrin ‏"‏ minkum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one amongst you observes prayer after Jumu'a, he should observe four rak'ahs. (In the hadith transmitted by Jarir the word minkum is not recorded)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى الْجُمُعَةَ انْصَرَفَ فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْتِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aannahu kaana iidhaa sallaa aljumu'aaa ansarafa fasajada sajdatayni fiy baytihi thumma qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasna'u dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that when 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) observed the Friday prayer and came back he observed two rak'ahs in his house, and then said:The Messenger of Allah (may peace be updn him) used to do this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ وَصَفَ تَطَوُّعَ صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَكَانَ لاَ يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْتِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَظُنُّنِي قَرَأْتُ فَيُصَلِّي أَوْ أَلْبَتَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aannahu wasafa tatawwu'a salaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fakaana laa yusalliy ba'da aljumu'aai hattaa yansarifa fayusalliy rak'atayni fiy baytihi ‏.‏ qaala yahyaa aazunnuniy qaraatu fayusalliy aaw aalbattaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar, while describing the Nafl prayer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), said:He did not observe (Nafl) prayer after Jumu'a till he went back and observed two rak'ahs in his house. Yahya said: I guess that I uttered these words (before Imam Malik) that he of course observed (them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, numayrin qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa sufyaanu, bnu 'uyaynaaa haddathanaa 'amrunw, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy ba'da aljumu'aai rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim narrated on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to observe two rak'ahs after Jumu'a
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ، بْنُ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخُوَارِ أَنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، أَرْسَلَهُ إِلَى السَّائِبِ ابْنِ أُخْتِ نَمِرٍ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ شَىْءٍ، رَآهُ مِنْهُ مُعَاوِيَةُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ الْجُمُعَةَ فِي الْمَقْصُورَةِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ الإِمَامُ قُمْتُ فِي مَقَامِي فَصَلَّيْتُ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ أَرْسَلَ إِلَىَّ فَقَالَ لاَ تَعُدْ لِمَا فَعَلْتَ إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ الْجُمُعَةَ فَلاَ تَصِلْهَا بِصَلاَةٍ حَتَّى تَكَلَّمَ أَوْ تَخْرُجَ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَنَا بِذَلِكَ أَنْ لاَ تُوصَلَ صَلاَةٌ حَتَّى نَتَكَلَّمَ أَوْ نَخْرُجَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'umaru, bnu 'ataa'i bni aabiy alkhuwaari aanna naafi'a bna jubayrin, aarsalahu iilaa alssaaiibi abni aukhti namirin yasaaluhu 'an shaa'in, raahu minhu mu'aawiyaau fiy alssalaaai faqaala na'am ‏.‏ sallaytu ma'ahu aljumu'aaa fiy almaqsuwraai falammaa sallama aliimaamu qumtu fiy maqaamiy fasallaytu falammaa dakhala aarsala iilaaaa faqaala laa ta'ud limaa fa'alta iidhaa sallayta aljumu'aaa falaa tasilhaa bisalaaain hattaa takallama aaw takhruja faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamaranaa bidhalika aan laa tuwsala salaaaun hattaa natakallama aaw nakhruja ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. `Ata' b. Abu Khuwar said that Nafi` b. Jubair sent him to al- Sa'ib the son of Namir's sister to ask him about what he had seen in the prayer of Mu`awiya. He said:Yes, I observed the Jumu`a prayer along with him in Maqsura and when the Imam pronounced salutation I stood up at my place and observed (Sunan rak`ahs). As he entered (the apartment) he sent for me and said: Do not repeat what you have done. Whenever you have observed the Jumu`a prayer, do not observe (Sunan prayer) till you, have talked or gone out, for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had ordered us to do this and not to combine two (types of) prayers without talking or going out
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — The Book of Prayer - Friday
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ، أَنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، أَرْسَلَهُ إِلَى السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ابْنِ أُخْتِ نَمِرٍ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قُمْتُ فِي مَقَامِي وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الإِمَامَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu 'ataa'in, aanna naafi'a bna jubayrin, aarsalahu iilaa alssaaiibi bni yaziyda abni aukhti namirin ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala falammaa sallama qumtu fiy maqaamiy walam yadhkuri aliimaama ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith is narrated on the authority of 'Umar b. Ata' but with this modification:When he (the Imam) pronounced salutation I stood up at my place. No mention was made of the Imam in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، - قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ شَهِدْتُ صَلاَةَ الْفِطْرِ مَعَ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ فَكُلُّهُمْ يُصَلِّيهَا قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ ثُمَّ يَخْطُبُ قَالَ فَنَزَلَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ حِينَ يُجَلِّسُ الرِّجَالَ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ يَشُقُّهُمْ حَتَّى جَاءَ النِّسَاءَ وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ فَقَالَ ‏{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَى أَنْ لاَ يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا‏}‏ فَتَلاَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ حِينَ فَرَغَ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ أَنْتُنَّ عَلَى ذَلِكِ ‏"‏ فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ لَمْ يُجِبْهُ غَيْرُهَا مِنْهُنَّ نَعَمْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ لاَ يُدْرَى حِينَئِذٍ مَنْ هِيَ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتَصَدَّقْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبَسَطَ بِلاَلٌ ثَوْبَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَلُمَّ فِدًى لَكُنَّ أَبِي وَأُمِّي ‏.‏ فَجَعَلْنَ يُلْقِينَ الْفَتَخَ وَالْخَوَاتِمَ فِي ثَوْبِ بِلاَلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, - qaala abnu raafi'in haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, - aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy alhasanu bnu muslimin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni, 'abbaasin qaala shahidtu salaaaa alfitri ma'a nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabiy bakrin wa'umara wa'uthmaana fakulluhum yusalliyhaa qabla alkhutbaai thumma yakhtubu qaala fanazala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaaanniy aanzuru iilayhi hiyna yujallisu alrrijaala biyadihi thumma aaqbala yashuqquhum hattaa jaa'a alnnisaa'a wama'ahu bilaalun faqaala ‏{‏ yaa aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu iidhaa jaa'aka almuuminaatu yubaayi'naka 'alaa aan laa yushrikna bialllahi shayiana‏}‏ fatalaa hadhihi alayaaa hattaa faragha minhaa thumma qaala hiyna faragha minhaa ‏"‏ aantunna 'alaa dhaliki ‏"‏ faqaalati amraaaaun waahidaaun lam yujibhu ghayruhaa minhunna na'am yaa nabiyya alllahi laa yudraa hiynaiidhin man hiya qaala ‏"‏ fatasaddaqna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fabasata bilaalun thawbahu thumma qaala halumma fidana lakunna aabiy waaummiy ‏.‏ faja'alna yulqiyna alfatakha waalkhawaatima fiy thawbi bilaalin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:I participated in the Fitr prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr, 'Umar and 'Uthman, and all of them observed this prayer before the Khutba, and then he (the Holy Prophet) delivered the sermon. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) descended (from the pulpit) and I (perceive) as if I am seeing him as he is commanding people with his hand to sit down. He then made his way through their (assembly) till he came to the women. Bilal was with him. He then recited (this verse): O Prophet, when believing women come to thee giving thee a pledge that they will not associate aught with Allah" (lx. 12) till he finished (his address to) them and then said: Do you conform to it (what has been described in the verse)? Only one woman among them replied: Yes, Apostle of Allah, but none else replied. He (the narrator) said: It could not be ascertained who actually she was. He (the Holy Prophet) exhorted them to give alms. Bilal stretched his cloth and then said: Come forward with alms. Let my father and mother be taken as ransom for you. And they began to throw rings and ringlets in the cloth of Bilal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ فَصَلَّى فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ ثُمَّ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَزَلَ وَأَتَى النِّسَاءَ فَذَكَّرَهُنَّ وَهُوَ يَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَى يَدِ بِلاَلٍ وَبِلاَلٌ بَاسِطٌ ثَوْبَهُ يُلْقِينَ النِّسَاءُ صَدَقَةً ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ زَكَاةَ يَوْمِ الْفِطْرِ قَالَ لاَ وَلَكِنْ صَدَقَةً يَتَصَدَّقْنَ بِهَا حِينَئِذٍ تُلْقِي الْمَرْأَةُ فَتَخَهَا وَيُلْقِينَ وَيُلْقِينَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ أَحَقًّا عَلَى الإِمَامِ الآنَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ النِّسَاءَ حِينَ يَفْرُغُ فَيُذَكِّرَهُنَّ قَالَ إِي لَعَمْرِي إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَحَقٌّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَا لَهُمْ لاَ يَفْعَلُونَ ذَلِكَ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, qaala abnu raafi'in haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala sami'tuhu yaquwlu iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama yawma alfitri fasallaa fabadaaa bialssalaaai qabla alkhutbaai thumma khataba alnnaasa falammaa faragha nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nazala waaataa alnnisaa'a fadhakkarahunna wahuwa yatawakkaau 'alaa yadi bilaalin wabilaalun baasitun thawbahu yulqiyna alnnisaa'u sadaqaaan ‏.‏ qultu li'ataa'in zakaaaa yawmi alfitri qaala laa walakin sadaqaaan yatasaddaqna bihaa hiynaiidhin tulqiy almaraaau fatakhahaa wayulqiyna wayulqiyna ‏.‏ qultu li'ataa'in aahaqqana 'alaa aliimaami alana aan yaatiya alnnisaa'a hiyna yafrughu fayudhakkirahunna qaala iiy la'amriy iinna dhalika lahaqqun 'alayhim wamaa lahum laa yaf'aluwna dhalika
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) stood up on the day of 'Id al-Fitr and observed prayer. And he commenced the prayer before the sermon. He then delivered the sermon. When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had finished (the sermon) he came down from (the pulpit), and made his way to the women and exhorted them (to do good acts), and he was leaning on the hand of Bilal. Bilal had stretched his cloth in which women were throwing alms. I (one of the narrators) said to 'Ata' (the other narrator): It must be Zakat on the day of Fitr. He ('Ata') said: No. It was alms (which) they were giving on that occasion, and a woman gave her ring, and then others gave, and then others gave. I said to 'Ata': Is It right now for the Imam to come to the women when he has finished (his address to the men) that he should exhort them (to good deeds)? He said: (Why not) by my life, it is right for them (to do so). What is the matter with them that they do not do it now?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانٍ وَلاَ إِقَامَةٍ ثُمَّ قَامَ مُتَوَكِّئًا عَلَى بِلاَلٍ فَأَمَرَ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ وَحَثَّ عَلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَوَعَظَ النَّاسَ وَذَكَّرَهُمْ ثُمَّ مَضَى حَتَّى أَتَى النِّسَاءَ فَوَعَظَهُنَّ وَذَكَّرَهُنَّ فَقَالَ تَصَدَّقْنَ فَإِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُنَّ حَطَبُ جَهَنَّمَ فَقَامَتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ سِطَةِ النِّسَاءِ سَفْعَاءُ الْخَدَّيْنِ فَقَالَتْ لِمَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ لِأَنَّكُنَّ تُكْثِرْنَ الشَّكَاةَ وَتَكْفُرْنَ الْعَشِيرَ قَالَ فَجَعَلْنَ يَتَصَدَّقْنَ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِنَّ يُلْقِينَ فِي ثَوْبِ بِلَالٍ مِنْ أَقْرِطَتِهِنَّ وَخَوَاتِمِهِنَّ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu aabiy sulaymaana, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala shahidtu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alssalaaaa yawma al'iydi fabadaaa bialssalaaai qabla alkhutbaai bighayri aadhaanin walaa iiqaamaain thumma qaama mutawakkiiana 'alaa bilaalin faaamara bitaqwaa alllahi wahathha 'alaa taa'atihi wawa'aza alnnaasa wadhakkarahum thumma madaa hattaa aataa alnnisaa'a fawa'azahunna wadhakkarahunna faqaala tasaddaqna faiinna aaktharakunna hatabu jahannama faqaamat amraaaaun min sitaai alnnisaa'i saf'aa'u alkhaddayni faqaalat lima yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala liaannakunna tukthirna alshhakaaaa watakfurna al'ashiyra qaala faja'alna yatasaddaqna min huliyyihinna yulqiyna fiy thawbi bilaalin min aaqritatihinna wakhawaatimihinna
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:I observed prayer with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the 'Id day. He commenced with prayer before the sermon without Adhan and Iqama. He then stood up leaning on Bilal, and he commanded (them) to be on guard (against evil for the sake of) Allah, and he exhorted (them) on obedience to Him, and he preached to the people and admonished them. He then walked on till he came to the women and preached to them and admonished them, and asked them to give alms, for most of them are the fuel for Hell. A woman having a dark spot on the cheek stood up and said: Why is it so, Messenger of Allah? He said: For you grumble often and show ingratitude to your spouse. And then they began to give alms out of their ornaments such as their earrings and rings which they threw on to the cloth of Bilal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، وَعَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالاَ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُؤَذَّنُ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ وَلاَ يَوْمَ الأَضْحَى ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, wa'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyi, qaalaa lam yakun yuuadhhanu yawma alfitri walaa yawma alaadhaa ‏.‏ thumma saaaltuhu ba'da hiynin 'an dhalika faaakhbaraniy qaala aakhbaraniy jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas and Jaibir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported:There was no Adhan on the (occasion) of Id-ul-Fitr and Id-ul-Adha. I (Ibn Juraij) said: I asked him after some time about it. He ('Ata', one of the narrators) said: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari told me: There is neither any Adhan on Id-ul-Fitr when the Imam comes out, nor even after his coming out; their is neither lqama nor call nor anything of the sort of calling on that day and nor Iqama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَرْسَلَ إِلَى ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَوَّلَ مَا بُويِعَ لَهُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُؤَذَّنُ لِلصَّلاَةِ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ فَلاَ تُؤَذِّنْ لَهَا - قَالَ - فَلَمْ يُؤَذِّنْ لَهَا ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يَوْمَهُ وَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ مَعَ ذَلِكَ إِنَّمَا الْخُطْبَةُ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ وَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ قَدْ كَانَ يُفْعَلُ - قَالَ - فَصَلَّى ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aanna abna 'abbaasin, aarsala iilaa abni alzzubayri aawwala maa buwyi'a lahu aannahu lam yakun yuuadhhanu lilssalaaai yawma alfitri falaa tuuadhhin lahaa - qaala - falam yuuadhhin lahaa abnu alzzubayri yawmahu waaarsala iilayhi ma'a dhalika iinnamaa alkhutbaau ba'da alssalaaai waiinna dhalika qad kaana yuf'alu - qaala - fasallaa abnu alzzubayri qabla alkhutbaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ata' reported that Ibn 'Abbas sent (him) to Ibn Zubair at the commencement of the oath of allegiance to him (for Caliphate saying):As there is no Adhan on 'Id-ul-Fitr, so you should not pronounce it. Ibn Zubair did not pronounce Adhan on that day. He (Ibn 'Abbas) also sent him (with this message) that sermon (is to be delivered) after the prayer, and thus it was done. So lbn Zubair observed prayer before Khutba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ، سَمُرَةَ قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِيدَيْنِ غَيْرَ مَرَّةٍ وَلاَ مَرَّتَيْنِ بِغَيْرِ أَذَانٍ وَلاَ إِقَامَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wahasanu bnu alrrabiy'i, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an simaakin, 'an jaabiri bni, samuraaa qaala sallaytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'iydayni ghayra marraain walaa marratayni bighayri aadhaanin walaa iiqaamaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura said:I prayed with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayers on two I'ds wore than once or twice without there being Adhan and Iqama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ كَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ الْعِيدَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, waaabuw ausaamaaa 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabaa bakrin wa'umara kaanuwa yusalluwna al'iydayni qabla alkhutbaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Abu Bakr and 'Umar used to observe the two 'Id prayers before the sermon
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَخْرُجُ يَوْمَ الأَضْحَى وَيَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ فَيَبْدَأُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَإِذَا صَلَّى صَلاَتَهُ وَسَلَّمَ قَامَ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَهُمْ جُلُوسٌ فِي مُصَلاَّهُمْ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ بِبَعْثٍ ذَكَرَهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَوْ كَانَتْ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ بِغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ أَمَرَهُمْ بِهَا وَكَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تَصَدَّقُوا تَصَدَّقُوا تَصَدَّقُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَكْثَرَ مَنْ يَتَصَدَّقُ النِّسَاءُ ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى كَانَ مَرْوَانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ فَخَرَجْتُ مُخَاصِرًا مَرْوَانَ حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا الْمُصَلَّى فَإِذَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ قَدْ بَنَى مِنْبَرًا مِنْ طِينٍ وَلَبِنٍ فَإِذَا مَرْوَانُ يُنَازِعُنِي يَدَهُ كَأَنَّهُ يَجُرُّنِي نَحْوَ الْمِنْبَرِ وَأَنَا أَجُرُّهُ نَحْوَ الصَّلاَةِ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ قُلْتُ أَيْنَ الاِبْتِدَاءُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ لاَ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ قَدْ تُرِكَ مَا تَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ كَلاَّ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ تَأْتُونَ بِخَيْرٍ مِمَّا أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an daawuda bni qaysin, 'an 'iyaadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni sa'din, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yakhruju yawma alaadhaa wayawma alfitri fayabdaau bialssalaaai faiidhaa sallaa salaatahu wasallama qaama faaaqbala 'alaa alnnaasi wahum juluwsun fiy musalaaahum faiin kaana lahu haajaaun biba'thin dhakarahu lilnnaasi aaw kaanat lahu haajaaun bighayri dhalika aamarahum bihaa wakaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ tasaddaquwa tasaddaquwa tasaddaquwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakaana aakthara man yatasaddaqu alnnisaa'u thumma yansarifu falam yazal kadhalika hattaa kaana marwaanu bnu alhakami fakharajtu mukhaasirana marwaana hattaa aataynaa almusallaa faiidhaa kathiyru bnu alssalti qad banaa minbarana min tiynin walabinin faiidhaa marwaanu yunaazi'uniy yadahu kaaannahu yajurruniy nahwa alminbari waaanaa aajurruhu nahwa alssalaaai falammaa raaaytu dhalika minhu qultu aayna alaibtidaa'u bialssalaaai faqaala laa yaa aabaa sa'iydin qad turika maa ta'lamu ‏.‏ qultu kalaaa waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laa taatuwna bikhayrin mimmaa aa'lamu ‏.‏ thalaatha miraarin thumma ansarafa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to go out on the day of Adha and on the day of Fitr and commenced the prayer. And after having observed his prayer and pronounced the salutation, he stood up facing people as they were seated at their places of worship. And if he intended to send out an army he made mention of it to the people, and if he intended any other thing besides it, he commanded them (to do that). He used to say (to the people):Give alms, give alms, give alms, and the majority that gave alms was of women. He then returned and this (practice) remained (in vogue) till Marwan b. al- Hakam (came into power). I went out hand in hand with Marwan till we came to the place of worship and there Kathir b. Salt had built a pulpit of clay and brick. Marwan began to tug me with his hand as though he were pulling me towards the pulpit, while I was pulling him towards the prayer. When I saw him doing that I said: What has happened to the practice of beginning with prayer? He said: No, Abu Sa'id, what you are familiar with has been abandoned. I thereupon said (three times and went back): By no means, by Him in Whose hand my life is, you are not doing anything better than what I am familiar with
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ أَمَرَنَا - تَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم - أَنْ نُخْرِجَ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ الْعَوَاتِقَ وَذَوَاتِ الْخُدُورِ وَأَمَرَ الْحُيَّضَ أَنْ يَعْتَزِلْنَ مُصَلَّى الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an muhammadin, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat aamaranaa - ta'niy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm - aan nukhrija fiy al'iydayni al'awaatiqa wadhawaati alkhuduwri waaamara alhuyyada aan ya'tazilna musallaa almuslimiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya said:He (the Messenger of Allah) commanded us that we should take out unmarried women and the screened away ladies for 'Id prayers, and he commanded the menstruating women to remain away from the place of worship of the Muslims
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ، سِيرِينَ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ بِالْخُرُوجِ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ وَالْمُخَبَّأَةُ وَالْبِكْرُ قَالَتِ الْحُيَّضُ يَخْرُجْنَ فَيَكُنَّ خَلْفَ النَّاسِ يُكَبِّرْنَ مَعَ النَّاسِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'an hafsaaa binti, siyriyna 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat kunnaa nuumaru bialkhuruwji fiy al'iydayni waalmukhabbaaaau waalbikru qaalati alhuyyadu yakhrujna fayakunna khalfa alnnaasi yukabbirna ma'a alnnaasi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Atiyya reported:We were commanded to go out as well as the hidden away ladies and those unmarried. She said menstruating women were to come out amongst you, but remain behind people and pronounce takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) along with them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ، سِيرِينَ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نُخْرِجَهُنَّ فِي الْفِطْرِ وَالأَضْحَى الْعَوَاتِقَ وَالْحُيَّضَ وَذَوَاتِ الْخُدُورِ فَأَمَّا الْحُيَّضُ فَيَعْتَزِلْنَ الصَّلاَةَ وَيَشْهَدْنَ الْخَيْرَ وَدَعْوَةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِحْدَانَا لاَ يَكُونُ لَهَا جِلْبَابٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لِتُلْبِسْهَا أُخْتُهَا مِنْ جِلْبَابِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an hafsaaa binti, siyriyna 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat aamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nukhrijahunna fiy alfitri waalaadhaa al'awaatiqa waalhuyyada wadhawaati alkhuduwri faaammaa alhuyyadu faya'tazilna alssalaaaa wayashhadna alkhayra wada'waaa almuslimiyna ‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iihdaanaa laa yakuwnu lahaa jilbaabun qaala ‏ "‏ litulbishaa aukhtuhaa min jilbaabihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us to bring out on'Id-ul-Fitr and 'Id-ul-Adha young women, menstruating women and screened away ladies, menstruating women kept back from prayer, but participated in goodness and supplication of the Muslims. I said: Messenger of Allah, one of us does not have an outer garment (to cover her face and body). He said: Let her sister cover her with her outer garment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، سَأَلَ أَبَا وَاقِدٍ اللَّيْثِيَّ مَا كَانَ يَقْرَأُ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الأَضْحَى وَالْفِطْرِ فَقَالَ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا بِـ ‏{‏ ق وَالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيدِ‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an damraaa bni sa'iydin almaaziniyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, saaala aabaa waaqidin alllaythiyya maa kaana yaqraau bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alaadhaa waalfitri faqaala kaana yaqraau fiyhimaa bi ‏{‏ q waalqurani almajiydi‏}‏ wa ‏{‏ aqtarabati alssaa'aau waanshaqqa alqamaru‏}‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that (his father) 'Umar b. Khattab asked Abu Waqid al-Laithi what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to recite on 'Id-ul-Adha and 'Id-ul-Fitr. He said:He used to recite in them:" Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an" (Surah 1)," The Hour drew near, and the moon was rent asunder" (Surah liv)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ، بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَاقِدٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ عَمَّا قَرَأَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي يَوْمِ الْعِيدِ فَقُلْتُ بِـ ‏{‏ اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ ق وَالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيدِ‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu, haddathanaa fulayhun, 'an damraaa, bni sa'iydin 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an aabiy waaqidin alllaythiyyi, qaala saaalaniy 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi 'ammaa qaraaa bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy yawmi al'iydi faqultu bi ‏{‏ aqtarabati alssaa'aau‏}‏ wa ‏{‏ q waalqurani almajiydi‏}‏
verses.translation: Utba reported that his father Waqid al-Laithi said:'Umar b. Khattab asked me what the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited on 'Id day. I said:" The Hour drew near" and Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعِنْدِي جَارِيَتَانِ مِنْ جَوَارِي الأَنْصَارِ تُغَنِّيَانِ بِمَا تَقَاوَلَتْ بِهِ الأَنْصَارُ يَوْمَ بُعَاثٍ قَالَتْ وَلَيْسَتَا بِمُغَنِّيَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَبِمُزْمُورِ الشَّيْطَانِ فِي بَيْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذَلِكَ فِي يَوْمِ عِيدٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ عِيدًا وَهَذَا عِيدُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhala 'alaaaa aabuw bakrin wa'indiy jaariyataani min jawaariy alaansaari tughanniyaani bimaa taqaawalat bihi alaansaaru yawma bu'aathin qaalat walaysataa bimughanniyatayni ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin aabimuzmuwri alshhaytaani fiy bayti rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wadhalika fiy yawmi 'iydin ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa aabaa bakrin iinna likulli qawmin 'iydana wahadhaa 'iydunaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Abu Bakr came to see me and I had two girls with me from among the girls of the Ansar and they were singing what the Ansar recited to one another at the Battle of Bu'ath. They were not, however, singing girls. Upon this Abu Bakr said: What I (the playing of) this wind instrument of Satan in the house of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and this too on 'Id day? Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Abu Bakr, every people have a festival and it is our festival (so let them play on)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِيهِ جَارِيَتَانِ تَلْعَبَانِ بِدُفٍّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiyhi jaariyataani tal'abaani biduffin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but there the words are:" Two girls were playing upon a tambourine
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَعِنْدَهَا جَارِيَتَانِ فِي أَيَّامِ مِنًى تُغَنِّيَانِ وَتَضْرِبَانِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُسَجًّى بِثَوْبِهِ فَانْتَهَرَهُمَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَكَشَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْهُ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ دَعْهُمَا يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَإِنَّهَا أَيَّامُ عِيدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتُرُنِي بِرِدَائِهِ وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْحَبَشَةِ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ وَأَنَا جَارِيَةٌ فَاقْدِرُوا قَدْرَ الْجَارِيَةِ الْعَرِبَةِ الْحَدِيثَةِ السِّنِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna abna shihaabin, haddathahu 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aabaa bakrin, dakhala 'alayhaa wa'indahaa jaariyataani fiy aayyaami minana tughanniyaani watadribaani warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm musajjana bithawbihi faantaharahumaa aabuw bakrin fakashafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'anhu waqaala ‏ "‏ da'humaa yaa aabaa bakrin faiinnahaa aayyaamu 'iydin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaalat raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasturuniy biridaaiihi waaanaa aanzuru iilaa alhabashaai wahum yal'abuwna waaanaa jaariyaaun faaqdiruwa qadra aljaariyaai al'aribaai alhadiythaai alssinni ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Abu Bakr came to her and there were with her two girls on Adha days who were singing and beating the tambourine and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had wrapped himself with his mantle. Abu Bakr scolded them. The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) uncovered (his face) and said:Abu Bakr, leave them alone for these are the days of 'Id. And 'A'isha said: I recapitulate to my mind the fact that once the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) screened me with his mantle and I saw the sports of the Abyssinians, and I was only a girl, and so you can well imagine how a girl of tender age is fond of watching the sport
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُومُ عَلَى بَابِ حُجْرَتِي - وَالْحَبَشَةُ يَلْعَبُونَ بِحِرَابِهِمْ فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - يَسْتُرُنِي بِرِدَائِهِ لِكَىْ أَنْظُرَ إِلَى لَعِبِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ مِنْ أَجْلِي حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَنَا الَّتِي أَنْصَرِفُ ‏.‏ فَاقْدُرُوا قَدْرَ الْجَارِيَةِ الْحَدِيثَةِ السِّنِّ حَرِيصَةً عَلَى اللَّهْوِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, bni alzzubayri qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau waalllahi laqad raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwmu 'alaa baabi hujratiy - waalhabashaau yal'abuwna bihiraabihim fiy masjidi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - yasturuniy biridaaiihi likaa aanzura iilaa la'ibihim thumma yaquwmu min aajliy hattaa aakuwna aanaa allatiy aansarifu ‏.‏ faaqduruwa qadra aljaariyaai alhadiythaai alssinni hariysaaan 'alaa alllahwi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:BY Allah, I remember the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) standing on the door of my apartment screening me with his mantle enabling me to see the sport of the Abyssinians as they played with their daggers in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upom him). He (the Holy Prophet) kept standing for my sake till I was satiated and then I went back; and thus you can well imagine how long a girl tender of age who is fond of sports (could have watched it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِهَارُونَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدِي جَارِيَتَانِ تُغَنِّيَانِ بِغِنَاءِ بُعَاثٍ فَاضْطَجَعَ عَلَى الْفِرَاشِ وَحَوَّلَ وَجْهَهُ فَدَخَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَانْتَهَرَنِي وَقَالَ مِزْمَارُ الشَّيْطَانِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعْهُمَا ‏"‏ فَلَمَّا غَفَلَ غَمَزْتُهُمَا فَخَرَجَتَا وَكَانَ يَوْمَ عِيدٍ يَلْعَبُ السُّودَانُ بِالدَّرَقِ وَالْحِرَابِ فَإِمَّا سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَإِمَّا قَالَ ‏"‏ تَشْتَهِينَ تَنْظُرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ فَأَقَامَنِي وَرَاءَهُ خَدِّي عَلَى خَدِّهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ دُونَكُمْ يَا بَنِي أَرْفَدَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ حَتَّى إِذَا مَلِلْتُ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَسْبُكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاذْهَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, wayuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, - waalllafzu lihaaruwna - qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amrunw, aanna muhammada bna 'abdi alrrahmani, haddathahu 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indiy jaariyataani tughanniyaani bighinaa'i bu'aathin faadtaja'a 'alaa alfiraashi wahawwala wajhahu fadakhala aabuw bakrin faantaharaniy waqaala mizmaaru alshhaytaani 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaqbala 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ da'humaa ‏"‏ falammaa ghafala ghamaztuhumaa fakharajataa wakaana yawma 'iydin yal'abu alssuwdaanu bialddaraqi waalhiraabi faiimmaa saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waiimmaa qaala ‏"‏ tashtahiyna tanzuriyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu na'am faaaqaamaniy waraa'ahu khaddiy 'alaa khaddihi wahuwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ duwnakum yaa baniy aarfadaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ hattaa iidhaa maliltu qaala ‏"‏ hasbuki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faadhhabiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came (to my apartment) while there were two girls with me singing the song of the Battle of Bu`ath. He lay down on the bed and turned away his face. Then came Abu Bakr and he scolded me and said: Oh! this musical instrument of the devil in the house of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned towards him and said: Leave them alone. And when he (the Holy Prophet) became unattentive, I hinted them and they went out, and it was the day of `Id and the black men were playing with shields and spears. (I do not remember) whether I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) or whether he said to me if I desired to see (that sport). I said: Yes. I stood behind him with his face parallel to my face, and he said: O Banu Arfada, be busy (in your sports) till I was satiated. He said (to me): Is that enough? I said: Yes. Upon this he asked me to go
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَ حَبَشٌ يَزْفِنُونَ فِي يَوْمِ عِيدٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَدَعَانِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَضَعْتُ رَأْسِي عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ فَجَعَلْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَى لَعِبِهِمْ حَتَّى كُنْتُ أَنَا الَّتِي أَنْصَرِفُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ إِلَيْهِمْ
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat jaa'a habashun yazfinuwna fiy yawmi 'iydin fiy almasjidi fada'aaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fawada'tu raasiy 'alaa mankibihi faja'altu aanzuru iilaa la'ibihim hattaa kuntu aanaa allatiy aansarifu 'ani alnnazari iilayhim
verses.translation: A'isha reported that some Abyssinians came and gave a demonstration of armed fight on the 'Id day in the mosque. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) invited me (to see that fight). I placed my head on his shoulder and began to see their sport till it was I who turned away from watching them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu zakariyyaa'a bni aabiy zaaiidaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu, numayrin haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, kilaahumaa 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkuraa fiy almasjidi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Hisham with the same chain of transmitters but (the narrators) did not make mention of the mosque
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، وَعُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ أَبِي، عَاصِمٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُقْبَةَ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لِلَعَّابِينَ وَدِدْتُ أَنِّي أَرَاهُمْ قَالَتْ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقُمْتُ عَلَى الْبَابِ أَنْظُرُ بَيْنَ أُذُنَيْهِ وَعَاتِقِهِ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ فُرْسٌ أَوْ حَبَشٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ لِي ابْنُ عَتِيقٍ بَلْ حَبَشٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu diynaarin, wa'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, kulluhum 'an aabiy, 'aasimin - waalllafzu li'uqbaaa - qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu bnu 'umayrin, aakhbaratniy 'aaiishaau, aannahaa qaalat lila''aabiyna wadidtu aanniy aaraahum qaalat faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqumtu 'alaa albaabi aanzuru bayna audhunayhi wa'aatiqihi wahum yal'abuwna fiy almasjidi ‏.‏ qaala 'ataa'un fursun aaw habashun ‏.‏ qaala waqaala liy abnu 'atiyqin bal habashun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha said that she sent a message to the players (of this armed fight) saying:I like to see them (fighting). She further said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up and I stood at the door (behind him) and saw (this fight) between his ears and his shoulders they played in the mosque. 'Ata' (one of the narra- tors) said: Were they persians or Abyssinians? Ibn 'Atiq told me they were Abyssinians
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 8 — The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا الْحَبَشَةُ يَلْعَبُونَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِحِرَابِهِمْ إِذْ دَخَلَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَأَهْوَى إِلَى الْحَصْبَاءِ يَحْصِبُهُمْ بِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعْهُمْ يَا عُمَرُ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'ani abni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala baynamaa alhabashaau yal'abuwna 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihiraabihim iidh dakhala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi faaahwaa iilaa alhasbaa'i yahsibuhum bihaa ‏.‏ faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ da'hum yaa 'umaru
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:While the Abyssinians were busy playing with their arms in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) 'Umar b. Khattab came there. He bent down to take up pebbles to throw at them (in order to make them go off). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: 'Umar, leave them alone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبَّادَ بْنَ تَمِيمٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ الْمَازِنِيَّ، يَقُولُ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى فَاسْتَسْقَى وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ حِينَ اسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, aannahu sami'a 'abbaada bna tamiymin, yaquwlu sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna zaydin almaaziniyya, yaquwlu kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa almusallaa faastasqaa wahawwala ridaa'ahu hiyna astaqbala alqiblaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Zaid b. Mazini reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the place of prayer and prayed for rain and turned round his mantle while facing the Qibla
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى فَاسْتَسْقَى وَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ وَقَلَبَ رِدَاءَهُ وَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, qaala kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa almusallaa faastasqaa waastaqbala alqiblaaa waqalaba ridaa'ahu wasallaa rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Tamim narrated on the authority of his uncle ('Abdullah b. Zaid) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out to the place of prayer and prayed for rain and faced towards Qibla, and turned round his mantle and prayed two rak'ahs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ عَبَّادَ بْنَ تَمِيمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى يَسْتَسْقِي وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ اسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw bakri bnu muhammadi bni 'amrinw, aanna 'abbaada bna tamiymin, aakhbarahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna zaydin alaansaariyya aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja iilaa almusallaa yastasqiy waaannahu lammaa aaraada aan yad'uwa astaqbala alqiblaaa wahawwala ridaa'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Zaid al-Ansari reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out to the place of prayer in order to offer prayer for rainfall. And when he intended to make supplication he faced Qibla and turned round his mantle
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبَّادُ بْنُ تَمِيمٍ الْمَازِنِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَمَّهُ، وَكَانَ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا يَسْتَسْقِي فَجَعَلَ إِلَى النَّاسِ ظَهْرَهُ يَدْعُو اللَّهَ وَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni, shihaabin qaala aakhbaraniy 'abbaadu bnu tamiymin almaaziniyyu, aannahu sami'a 'ammahu, wakaana, min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana yastasqiy faja'ala iilaa alnnaasi zahrahu yad'uw alllaha waastaqbala alqiblaaa wahawwala ridaa'ahu thumma sallaa rak'atayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abbad b. Tamim Mazini heard his uncle, who was one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), as saying:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out one day in order to pray for rain. He turned his back towards people, supplicated before Allah, facing towards Qibla, and turned his mantle round and then observed two rak'ahs of prayer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الدُّعَاءِ حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ إِبْطَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy bukayrin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yarfa'u yadayhi fiy alddu'aa'i hattaa yuraa bayaadu iibtayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raising his hands (high enough) in supplication (for rain) that the whiteness of his armpits became visible
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَسْقَى فَأَشَارَ بِظَهْرِ كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm astasqaa faaashaara bizahri kaffayhi iilaa alssamaa'i
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed for rain pointing the back of his hands to the sky
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، وَعَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ لاَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ إِلاَّ فِي الاِسْتِسْقَاءِ حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ إِبْطَيْهِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الأَعْلَى قَالَ يُرَى بَيَاضُ إِبْطِهِ أَوْ بَيَاضُ إِبْطَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, wa'abdu alaa'laa, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana laa yarfa'u yadayhi fiy shaa'in min du'aaiihi iilaaa fiy alaistisqaa'i hattaa yuraa bayaadu iibtayhi ‏.‏ ghayra aanna 'abda alaa'laa qaala yuraa bayaadu iibtihi aaw bayaadu iibtayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was not accustomed to raice his hands in any supplication he made except when praying for rain. (He would then raise [his hands] high enough) that the whiteness of his armpits became visible. 'Abd al-A'la said that (he was in doubt whether it was) the whiteness of his armpit or armpits
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, aannahaddathahum 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّجُمُعَةٍ مِنْ بَابٍ كَانَ نَحْوَ دَارِ الْقَضَاءِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ يَخْطُبُ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمًا ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلَكَتِ الأَمْوَالُ وَانْقَطَعَتِ السُّبُلُ فَادْعُ اللَّهِ يُغِثْنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ وَلاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا نَرَى فِي السَّمَاءِ مِنْ سَحَابٍ وَلاَ قَزَعَةٍ وَمَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ سَلْعٍ مِنْ بَيْتٍ وَلاَ دَارٍ - قَالَ - فَطَلَعَتْ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ سَحَابَةٌ مِثْلُ التُّرْسِ فَلَمَّا تَوَسَّطَتِ السَّمَاءَ انْتَشَرَتْ ثُمَّ أَمْطَرَتْ - قَالَ - فَلاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْنَا الشَّمْسَ سَبْتًا - قَالَ - ثُمَّ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْبَابِ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ الْمُقْبِلَةِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ يَخْطُبُ فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُ قَائِمًا فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلَكَتِ الأَمْوَالُ وَانْقَطَعَتِ السُّبُلُ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكْهَا عَنَّا - قَالَ - فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَوْلَنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَانْقَلَعَتْ وَخَرَجْنَا نَمْشِي فِي الشَّمْسِ ‏.‏ قَالَ شَرِيكٌ فَسَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ أَهُوَ الرَّجُلُ الأَوَّلُ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an shariyki bni aabiy namirin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannajumu'aain min baabin kaana nahwa daari alqadaa'i warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun yakhtubu faastaqbala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimana thumma qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi halakati alaamwaalu waanqata'ati alssubulu faad'u alllahi yughithnaa ‏.‏ qaala farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aaghithnaa alllahumma aaghithnaa alllahumma aaghithnaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aanasun walaa waalllahi maa naraa fiy alssamaa'i min sahaabin walaa qaza'aain wamaa baynanaa wabayna sal'in min baytin walaa daarin - qaala - fatala'at min waraaiihi sahaabaaun mithlu alttursi falammaa tawassatati alssamaa'a antasharat thumma aamtarat - qaala - falaa waalllahi maa raaaynaa alshhamsa sabtana - qaala - thumma dakhala rajulun min dhalika albaabi fiy aljumu'aai almuqbilaai warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun yakhtubu faastaqbalahu qaaiimana faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi halakati alaamwaalu waanqata'ati alssubulu faad'u alllaha yumsikhaa 'annaa - qaala - farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma hawlanaa walaa 'alaynaa alllahumma 'alaa alakaami waalzziraabi wabutuwni alaawdiyaai wamanaabiti alshhajari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faanqala'at wakharajnaa namshiy fiy alshhamsi ‏.‏ qaala shariykun fasaaaltu aanasa bna maalikin aahuwa alrrajulu alaawwalu qaala laa aadriy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that a person entered the mosque through the door situated on theside of Daral-Qada' during Friday (prayer) and the messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon while standing. He came and stood in front of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said:Messenger of Allah, the camels died and the passages were blocked; so supplicate Allah to send down rain upon us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) raised his hands and then said: (O Allah, send down rain upon us; O Allah, send dowp rain upon us; O Allah, send down rain upon us. Anas said: By Allah, we did not see any cloud or any patch of it, and there was neither any house or building standing between us and the (hillock) Sal'a. There appeared a cloud in the shape of a shield from behind it, and as it (came high) in the sky it spread and then there was a downpour of rain. By Allah, we did not see the sun throughout the week. Then (that very man) came on the coming Friday through the same door when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was standing and delivering the sermon. He stood in front of him and said: Messenger of Allah, our animals died and the passages blocked. Supplicate Allah to stop the rain for us. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) again raised his hands and said: O Allah, let it (rain) fall in our suburbs and not on us, O Allah (send it down) on the hillocks and small mountains and the river-beds and at places where trees grow. The rain stopped, and as we stepped out we were walking in sun- shine. He (the narrator) said to Sharik: I asked Anas b. Malik if he was the same man. He said: I do not know
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أَصَابَتِ النَّاسَ سَنَةٌ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِذْ قَامَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلَكَ الْمَالُ وَجَاعَ الْعِيَالُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏ وَفِيهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا يُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى نَاحِيَةٍ إِلاَّ تَفَرَّجَتْ حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فِي مِثْلِ الْجَوْبَةِ وَسَالَ وَادِي قَنَاةَ شَهْرًا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَجِئْ أَحَدٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ إِلاَّ أَخْبَرَ بِجَوْدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa daawudu bnu rushaydin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, haddathaniy iishaaqu, bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala aasaabati alnnaasa sanaaun 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fabaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu alnnaasa 'alaa alminbari yawma aljumu'aai iidh qaama aa'raabiyyun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi halaka almaalu wajaa'a al'iyaalu ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naahu ‏.‏ wafiyhi qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma hawaalaynaa walaa 'alaynaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famaa yushiyru biyadihi iilaa naahiyaain iilaaa tafarrajat hattaa raaaytu almadiynaaa fiy mithli aljawbaai wasaala waadiy qanaaaa shahrana ‏.‏ walam yajii aahadun min naahiyaain iilaaa aakhbara bijawdin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The people were in the grip of famine during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and (once) as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon standing on the pulpit on Friday, a bedouin stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, the animals died and the children suffered starvation. The rest of the hadith is the same (and the words are) that he (the Holy Prophet) said: O Allah, send down rain in our suburbs but not on us. He (the narrator) said: To whichever directions he pointed with his hands, the clouds broke up and I saw Medina like the opening of a (courtyard) and the stream of Qanat flowed for one month, and none came from any part (of Arabia) but with the news of heavy rainfall
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ النَّاسُ فَصَاحُوا وَقَالُوا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ قَحِطَ الْمَطَرُ وَاحْمَرَّ الشَّجَرُ وَهَلَكَتِ الْبَهَائِمُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَفِيهِ مِنْ رِوَايَةِ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى فَتَقَشَّعَتْ عَنِ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏ فَجَعَلَتْ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, wamuhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa mu'tamirun, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu yawma aljumu'aai faqaama iilayhi alnnaasu fasaahuwa waqaaluwa yaa nabiyya alllahi qahita almataru waahmarra alshhajaru wahalakati albahaaiimu ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha wafiyhi min riwaayaai 'abdi alaa'laa fataqashha'at 'ani almadiynaai ‏.‏ faja'alat
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that while the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was delivering the sermon on Friday, people stood up before him and said in a loud voice:Apostle of Allah, there is a drought and the trees have become yellow, the animals have died; and the rest of the hadith is the same, and in the narration transmitted by 'Abd al-A'la the words are:" The clouds cleard from Medina and it began to rain around it and not a single drop of rain fell in Medina. And as I looked towards Medina, I found it hollow like (the hollowness of) a basin
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، بِنَحْوِهِ وَزَادَ فَأَلَّفَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَ السَّحَابِ وَمَكَثْنَا حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ الرَّجُلَ الشَّدِيدَ تُهِمُّهُ نَفْسُهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَهْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an sulaymaana bni almughiyraai, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, binahwihi wazaada faaallafa alllahu bayna alssahaabi wamakathnaa hattaa raaaytu alrrajula alshhadiyda tuhimmuhu nafsuhu aan yaatiya aahlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas but with this addition:" Allah gathered the clouds and as we (were obliged) to stay back I saw that even the strong man, impelled by a desire to go to his family, (could not do so)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ، أَنَّ حَفْصَ بْنَ، عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ وَزَادَ فَرَأَيْتُ السَّحَابَ يَتَمَزَّقُ كَأَنَّهُ الْمُلاَءُ حِينَ تُطْوَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy ausaamaau, aanna hafsa bna, 'ubaydi alllahi bni aanasi bni maalikin haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu jaa'a aa'raabiyyun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma aljumu'aai wahuwa 'alaa alminbari ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha wazaada faraaaytu alssahaaba yatamazzaqu kaaannahu almulaa'u hiyna tutwaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah b. Anas b. Malik heard (his father) Anas b. Malik as saying:A bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Friday as he was (delivering the sermon on his) pulpit; and the rest of the hadith is the same but with this addition:" I saw the cloud clearing just as a sheet is folded
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ أَصَابَنَا وَنَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَطَرٌ قَالَ فَحَسَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثَوْبَهُ حَتَّى أَصَابَهُ مِنْ الْمَطَرِ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَ صَنَعْتَ هَذَا قَالَ لِأَنَّهُ حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِرَبِّهِ تَعَالَى
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa ja'faru bnu sulaymaana, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala aanasun aasaabanaa wanahnu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm matarun qaala fahasara rasuwlu alllahi sallaa alllahu 'alayhi wasallama thawbahu hattaa aasaabahu min almatari faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi lima sana'ta hadhaa qaala liaannahu hadiythu 'ahdin birabbihi ta'aalaa
verses.translation: Anas (b. Malik) reported:It rained upon us as we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) removed his cloth (from a part of his body) till the rain fell on it. We said: Messenger of Allah, why did you do this? He said: It is because it (the rainfall) has just come from the Exalted Lord
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الرِّيحِ وَالْغَيْمِ عُرِفَ ذَلِكَ فِي وَجْهِهِ أَقْبَلَ وَأَدْبَرَ فَإِذَا مَطَرَتْ سُرَّ بِهِ وَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَذَابًا سُلِّطَ عَلَى أُمَّتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَيَقُولُ إِذَا رَأَى الْمَطَرَ ‏"‏ رَحْمَةٌ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an ja'farin, - wahuwa abnu muhammadin - 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy rabaahin, aannahu sami'a 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm taquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa kaana yawmu alrriyhi waalghaymi 'urifa dhalika fiy wajhihi aaqbala waaadbara faiidhaa matarat surra bihi wadhahaba 'anhu dhalika ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau fasaaaltuhu faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy khashiytu aan yakuwna 'adhaabana sullita 'alaa aummatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wayaquwlu iidhaa raaaa almatara ‏"‏ rahmaaun‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ata' b. Abi Rabah reported that he heard 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him), as saying:When there was on any day windstorm or dark cloud (its effects) could be read on the face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he moved forward and backward (in a state of anxiety) ; and when it rained, he was delighted and it (the state of restlessness) disappeared. 'A'isha said: I asked him the reason of this anxiety and he said: I was afraid that it might be a calamity that might fall upon my Ummah, and when he saw rainfall he said: It is the mercy (of Allah)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، يُحَدِّثُنَا عَنْ عَطَاءِ، بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا عَصَفَتِ الرِّيحُ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَإِذَا تَخَيَّلَتِ السَّمَاءُ تَغَيَّرَ لَوْنُهُ وَخَرَجَ وَدَخَلَ وَأَقْبَلَ وَأَدْبَرَ فَإِذَا مَطَرَتْ سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ فَعَرَفْتُ ذَلِكَ فِي وَجْهِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ يَا عَائِشَةُ كَمَا قَالَ قَوْمُ عَادٍ ‏{‏ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala sami'tu abna jurayjin, yuhaddithunaa 'an 'ataa'i, bni aabiy rabaahin 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa 'asafati alrriyhu qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma iinniy aasaaluka khayrahaa wakhayra maa fiyhaa wakhayra maa aursilat bihi waaa'uwdhu bika min sharrihaa washarri maa fiyhaa washarri maa aursilat bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat waiidhaa takhayyalati alssamaa'u taghayyara lawnuhu wakharaja wadakhala waaaqbala waaadbara faiidhaa matarat surriya 'anhu fa'araftu dhalika fiy wajhihi ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau fasaaaltuhu faqaala ‏"‏ la'allahu yaa 'aaiishaau kamaa qaala qawmu 'aadin ‏{‏ falammaa raaawhu 'aaridana mustaqbila aawdiyatihim qaaluwa hadhaa 'aaridun mumtirunaa‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ata' b. Rabah reported on the authority of 'A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him), who said:Whenever the wind was stormy, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to say: O Allah! I ask Thee for what is good in it, and the good which it contains, and the good of that which it was sent for. I seek refuge with Thee from what is evil in it, what evil it contains, and the evil of that what it was sent for; and when there was a thunder and lightning in the sky, his colour underwent a change, and he went out and in, backwards and forwards; and when the rain came, he felt relieved, and I noticed that (the sign of relief) on his face. 'A'isha asked him (about it) and he said: It may be as the people of 'Ad said: When they saw a cloud formation coming to their valley they said:" It is a cloud which would give us rain" (Qur'an, xlvi)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُسْتَجْمِعًا ضَاحِكًا حَتَّى أَرَى مِنْهُ لَهَوَاتِهِ إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَتَبَسَّمُ - قَالَتْ- وَكَانَ إِذَا رَأَى غَيْمًا أَوْ رِيحًا عُرِفَ ذَلِكَ فِي وَجْهِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَى النَّاسَ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an 'amriw bni alhaarithi, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, aanna aabaa alnnadri, haddathahu 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat maa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mustajmi'ana daahikana hattaa aaraa minhu lahawaatihi iinnamaa kaana yatabassamu - qaalat- wakaana iidhaa raaaa ghaymana aaw riyhana 'urifa dhalika fiy wajhihi ‏.‏ faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraa alnnaasa
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), reported:I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laugh to such an extent that I could see his uvula-whereas he used to smile only-and when he saw dark clouds or wind, (the signs of fear) were depicted on his face. I said: Messenger of Allah, I find people being happy when they ace the dark cloud in the hope that it would bring rain, but I find that when you see that (the cloud) there is an anxiety on your face. He said: 'A'isha, I am afraid that there may be a calamity in it, for a people was afflicted with wind, when the people saw the calamity they said:" It is a cloud which would give us rain" (Qur'an. xlvi)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نُصِرْتُ بِالصَّبَا وَأُهْلِكَتْ عَادٌ بِالدَّبُورِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ nusirtu bialssabaa waauhlikat 'aadun bialddabuwri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I have been helped by the east wind and the 'Ad were destroyed by the west wind
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 9 — The Book of Prayer - Rain
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبَانٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مَسْعُودِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
