verses.translation: Umm Salama, the wife of the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like the hadith transmitted by Abu Usama, but with this addition that she said:" When Abu Salama died I said: Who is better than Abu Salama, the Companion of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and Allah decided for me and I said (these words contained in the supplication mentioned above) and I was married to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا حَضَرْتُمُ الْمَرِيضَ أَوِ الْمَيِّتَ فَقُولُوا خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ يُؤَمِّنُونَ عَلَى مَا تَقُولُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا مَاتَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ قَدْ مَاتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُولِي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلَهُ وَأَعْقِبْنِي مِنْهُ عُقْبَى حَسَنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ فَأَعْقَبَنِي اللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لِي مِنْهُ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa hadartumu almariyda aawi almayyita faquwluwa khayrana faiinna almalaaiikaaa yuuamminuwna 'alaa maa taquwluwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat falammaa maata aabuw salamaaa aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aabaa salamaaa qad maata qaala ‏"‏ quwliy alllahumma aghfir liy walahu waaa'qibniy minhu 'uqbaa hasanaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu faaa'qabaniy alllahu man huwa khayrun liy minhu muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Whenever you visit the sick or the dead, supplicate for good because angels say" Amen" to whatever you say. She added: When Abu Salama died, I went to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, Abu Salama has died. He told me to recite:" O Allah! forgive me and him (Abu Salama) and give me a better substitute than he." So I said (this), and Allah gave me in exchange Muhammad, who is better for me than him (Abu Salama)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ ذُؤَيْبٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أَبِي سَلَمَةَ وَقَدْ شَقَّ بَصَرُهُ فَأَغْمَضَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الرُّوحَ إِذَا قُبِضَ تَبِعَهُ الْبَصَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَضَجَّ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَدْعُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ يُؤَمِّنُونَ عَلَى مَا تَقُولُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لأَبِي سَلَمَةَ وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ ‏.‏ وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa alfazaariyyu, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an qabiysaaa bni dhuuaybin, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat dakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa aabiy salamaaa waqad shaqqa basaruhu faaaghmadahu thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna alrruwha iidhaa qubida tabi'ahu albasaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadajja naasun min aahlihi faqaala ‏"‏ laa tad'uwa 'alaa aanfusikum iilaaa bikhayrin faiinna almalaaiikaaa yuuamminuwna 'alaa maa taquwluwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aghfir laabiy salamaaa waarfa' darajatahu fiy almahdiyyiyna waakhlufhu fiy 'aqibihi fiy alghaabiriyna waaghfir lanaa walahu yaa rabba al'aalamiyna waafsah lahu fiy qabrihi ‏.‏ wanawwir lahu fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama reported:The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon came to Abu Salama (as he died). His eyes were fixedly open. He closed them, and then said: When the soul is taken away the sight follows it. Some of the people of his family wept and wailed. So he said: Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for angels say" Amen" to what you say. He then said: O Allah, forgive Abu Salama, raise his degree among those who are rightly guided, grant him a successor in his descendants who remain. Forgive us and him, O Lord of the Universe, and make his grave spacious, and grant him light in it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْقَطَّانُ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى بْنُ مُعَاذِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي تَرِكَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَوْسِعْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلِ ‏"‏ افْسَحْ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ قَالَ خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ وَدَعْوَةٌ أُخْرَى سَابِعَةٌ نَسِيتُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu muwsaa alqattaanu alwaasitiyyu, haddathanaa almuthannaa bnu mu'aadhi bni mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu alhasani, haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ waakhlufhu fiy tarikatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aawsi' lahu fiy qabrihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yaquli ‏"‏ afsah lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wazaada qaala khaalidun alhadhhaa'u wada'waaun aukhraa saabi'aaun nasiytuhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Khalid al Hadhdha' with the same chain of transmitters but with this alteration that he said:(O Allah! ) let Thee be the caretaker of what is left by him, and he said: Grant him expansion of the grave, but he did not say: Make his grave spacious. Khalid said: He supplicated for the seventh (thing too) which I have forgotten
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ، يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلَمْ تَرَوُا الإِنْسَانَ إِذَا مَاتَ شَخَصَ بَصَرُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَذَلِكَ حِينَ يَتْبَعُ بَصَرُهُ نَفْسَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, 'ani al'alaa'i bni, ya'quwba qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalam tarawua aliinsaana iidhaa maata shakhasa basaruhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa balaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fadhalika hiyna yatba'u basaruhu nafsahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Did you not see when the man died and his eyes were fixedly open? He (Abu Huraira) said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) said: It is due to the fact that when (the soul leaves the body) his eyesight follows the soul
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'ani al'alaa'i, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of 'Ala' with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ، عُيَيْنَةَ - قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، - عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ لَمَّا مَاتَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ قُلْتُ غَرِيبٌ وَفِي أَرْضِ غُرْبَةٍ لأَبْكِيَنَّهُ بُكَاءً يُتَحَدَّثُ عَنْهُ ‏.‏ فَكُنْتُ قَدْ تَهَيَّأْتُ لِلْبُكَاءِ عَلَيْهِ إِذْ أَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الصَّعِيدِ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُسْعِدَنِي فَاسْتَقْبَلَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَتُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تُدْخِلِي الشَّيْطَانَ بَيْتًا أَخْرَجَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ فَكَفَفْتُ عَنِ الْبُكَاءِ فَلَمْ أَبْكِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma kulluhum 'ani abni, 'uyaynaaa - qaala abnu numayrin haddathanaa sufyaanu, - 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'ubaydi bni 'umayrin, qaala qaalat aummu salamaaa lammaa maata aabuw salamaaa qultu ghariybun wafiy aardi ghurbaain laabkiyannahu bukaa'an yutahaddathu 'anhu ‏.‏ fakuntu qad tahayyaatu lilbukaa'i 'alayhi iidh aaqbalati amraaaaun mina alssa'iydi turiydu aan tus'idaniy faastaqbalahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala ‏ "‏ aaturiydiyna aan tudkhiliy alshhaytaana baytana aakhrajahu alllahu minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ marratayni fakafaftu 'ani albukaa'i falam aabki ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama reported:When Abu Salama died I said: I am a stranger in a strange land; I shall weep for him in a manner that would be talked of. I made preparation for weeping for him when a woman from the upper side of the city came there who intended to help me (in weeping). She happened to come across the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he said: Do you intend to bring the devil into a house from which Allah has twice driven him out? I (Umm Salama), therefore, refrained from weeping and I did not weep
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ إِحْدَى بَنَاتِهِ تَدْعُوهُ وَتُخْبِرُهُ أَنَّ صَبِيًّا لَهَا - أَوِ ابْنًا لَهَا - فِي الْمَوْتِ فَقَالَ لِلرَّسُولِ ‏"‏ ارْجِعْ إِلَيْهَا فَأَخْبِرْهَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَمُرْهَا فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ ‏"‏ فَعَادَ الرَّسُولُ فَقَالَ إِنَّهَا قَدْ أَقْسَمَتْ لَتَأْتِيَنَّهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَامَ مَعَهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ وَمُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ وَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُمْ فَرُفِعَ إِلَيْهِ الصَّبِيُّ وَنَفْسُهُ تَقَعْقَعُ كَأَنَّهَا فِي شَنَّةٍ فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ سَعْدٌ مَا هَذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ رَحْمَةٌ جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِ عِبَادِهِ وَإِنَّمَا يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الرُّحَمَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana alnnahdiyyi, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, qaala kunnaa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaarsalat iilayhi iihdaa banaatihi tad'uwhu watukhbiruhu aanna sabiyyana lahaa - aawi abnana lahaa - fiy almawti faqaala lilrrasuwli ‏"‏ arji' iilayhaa faaakhbirhaa iinna lillahi maa aakhadha walahu maa aa'taa wakullu shaa'in 'indahu biaajalin musammana famurhaa faltasbir waltahtasib ‏"‏ fa'aada alrrasuwlu faqaala iinnahaa qad aaqsamat lataatiyannahaa ‏.‏ qaala faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaama ma'ahu sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa wamu'aadhu bnu jabalin waantalaqtu ma'ahum farufi'a iilayhi alssabiyyu wanafsuhu taqa'qa'u kaaannahaa fiy shannaain fafaadat 'aynaahu faqaala lahu sa'dun maa hadhaa yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ hadhihi rahmaaun ja'alahaa alllahu fiy quluwbi 'ibaadihi waiinnamaa yarhamu alllahu min 'ibaadihi alrruhamaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid reported:While we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), one of his daughters sent to him (the Messenger) to call him and inform him that her child or her son was dying. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) told the messenger to go back and tell her that what Allah had taken belonged to Him, and to him belonged what He granted; and He has an appointed time for everything. So you (the messenger) order her to show endurance and seek reward from Allah. The messenger came back and said: She adjures him to come to her. He got up to go accompanied by Sa'd b. 'Ubada, Mu'adh b. Jabal, and I also went along with them. The child was lifted to him and his soul was feeling as restless as if it was in an old (waterskin). His (Prophet's) eyes welled up with tears. Sa'd said: What is this, Messenger of Allah? He replied: This is compassion which Allah has placed in the hearts of His servants, and God shows compassion only to those of His servants who are compassionate
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ حَمَّادٍ أَتَمُّ وَأَطْوَلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy, shaybaaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, jamiy'ana 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ ghayra aanna hadiytha hammaadin aatammu waaatwalu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters on the authority of 'Asim al-Ahwal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الصَّدَفِيُّ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ اشْتَكَى سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ شَكْوَى لَهُ فَأَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُهُ مَعَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَسَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَدَهُ فِي غَشِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَقَدْ قَضَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَبَكَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا رَأَى الْقَوْمُ بُكَاءَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَكَوْا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ تَسْمَعُونَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يُعَذِّبُ بِدَمْعِ الْعَيْنِ وَلاَ بِحُزْنِ الْقَلْبِ وَلَكِنْ يُعَذِّبُ بِهَذَا - وَأَشَارَ إِلَى لِسَانِهِ - أَوْ يَرْحَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa alssadafiyyu, wa'amruw bnu sawwaadin al'aamiriyyu, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an sa'iydi bni alhaarithi alaansaariyyi, 'an 'abdi, alllahi bni 'umara qaala ashtakaa sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa shakwaa lahu faaataa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduhu ma'a 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin wasa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin wa'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin falammaa dakhala 'alayhi wajadahu fiy ghashiyyaain faqaala ‏"‏ aaqad qadaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ fabakaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa raaaa alqawmu bukaa'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bakawa faqaala ‏"‏ aalaa tasma'uwna iinna alllaha laa yu'adhhibu bidam'i al'ayni walaa bihuzni alqalbi walakin yu'adhhibu bihadhaa - waaashaara iilaa lisaanihi - aaw yarhamu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar said that Sa'd b. Ubada complained of illness. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to visit him accompanied by 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf, Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas and 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud. As he entered (his room) he found him in a swoon. Upon this he said:Has he died? They said: Messenger of Allah, it is not so. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wept. When the people saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) weeping, they also began to weep. He said. Listen, Allah does not punish for the tears that the eye sheds or the grief the heart feels, but He punishes for this (pointing to his tongue), or He may show mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَهْضَمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ غَزِيَّةَ - عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أَخَا الأَنْصَارِ كَيْفَ أَخِي سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ صَالِحٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ يَعُودُهُ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ وَقُمْنَا مَعَهُ وَنَحْنُ بِضْعَةَ عَشَرَ مَا عَلَيْنَا نِعَالٌ وَلاَ خِفَافٌ وَلاَ قَلاَنِسُ وَلاَ قُمُصٌ نَمْشِي فِي تِلْكَ السِّبَاخِ حَتَّى جِئْنَاهُ فَاسْتَأْخَرَ قَوْمُهُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِ حَتَّى دَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ الَّذِينَ مَعَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu jahdamin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'an 'umaaraaa, - ya'niy abna ghaziyyaaa - 'an sa'iydi bni alhaarithi bni almu'allaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aannahu qaala kunnaa juluwsana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh jaa'ahu rajulun mina alaansaari fasallama 'alayhi thumma aadbara alaansaariyyu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa aakhaa alaansaari kayfa aakhiy sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala saalihun ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man ya'uwduhu minkum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama waqumnaa ma'ahu wanahnu bid'aaa 'ashara maa 'alaynaa ni'aalun walaa khifaafun walaa qalaanisu walaa qumusun namshiy fiy tilka alssibaakhi hattaa jiinaahu faastaakhara qawmuhu min hawlihi hattaa danaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabuhu alladhiyna ma'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported:While we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), a person, one of the Ansar, came to him and greeted him. The Ansari then turned back. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: o brother of Ansar, how is my brother Sa'd be 'Ubada? He said: He is better. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who amongst you would visit him? He (the Holy Prophet) stood up and we also got up along with him, and we were more than ten persons. We had neither shoes with us, nor socks, nor caps, nor shirts. We walked on the barren land till we came to him. The people around him kept away till the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his Companions with him came near him (Sa'd b. 'Ubada)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ الصَّدْمَةِ الأُولَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an thaabitin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alssabru 'inda alssadmaai alauwlaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Endurance is to be shown at the first blow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَى عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ تَبْكِي عَلَى صَبِيٍّ لَهَا فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ اتَّقِي اللَّهَ وَاصْبِرِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ وَمَا تُبَالِي بِمُصِيبَتِي ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ قِيلَ لَهَا إِنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهَا مِثْلُ الْمَوْتِ فَأَتَتْ بَابَهُ فَلَمْ تَجِدْ عَلَى بَابِهِ بَوَّابِينَ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَمْ أَعْرِفْكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا الصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ أَوَّلِ صَدْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ عِنْدَ أَوَّلِ الصَّدْمَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aataa 'alaa amraaaain tabkiy 'alaa sabiyyin lahaa faqaala lahaa ‏"‏ attaqiy alllaha waasbiriy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat wamaa tubaaliy bimusiybatiy ‏.‏ falammaa dhahaba qiyla lahaa iinnahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faaakhadhahaa mithlu almawti faaatat baabahu falam tajid 'alaa baabihi bawwaabiyna faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi lam aa'rifka ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa alssabru 'inda aawwali sadmaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ 'inda aawwali alssadmaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to a woman who had been weeping for her (dead) child, and said to her:Fear Allah and show endurance. She (not recognising him) said: You have not been afflicted as I have been. When he (the Holy Prophet) had departed, it was said to her that he was the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), she was mortally shocked. She came to his door and she did not find doorkeepers at his door. She said: Messenger of Allah. I did not recognise you. He said: Endurance is to be shown at first blow, or at the first blow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالُوا جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُمَرَ بِقِصَّتِهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِامْرَأَةٍ عِنْدَ قَبْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun ya'niy abna alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw, h wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, qaaluwa jamiy'ana haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwa hadiythi 'uthmaana bni 'umara biqissatihi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alssamadi marra alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biamraaaain 'inda qabrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this is narrated with the same chain of transmitters but with the addition of these words:" The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a woman (who was sitting) by the side of a grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ بِشْرٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ حَفْصَةَ، بَكَتْ عَلَى عُمَرَ فَقَالَ مَهْلاً يَا بُنَيَّةُ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ يُعَذَّبُ بِبُكَاءِ أَهْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni bishrin, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin al'abdiyyu, - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala haddathanaa naafi'un, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aanna hafsaaa, bakat 'alaa 'umara faqaala mahlaan yaa bunayyaau aalam ta'lamiy aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna almayyita yu'adhhabu bibukaa'i aahlihi 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that Hafsa wept for 'Umar (when he was about to die). He ('Umar) said:Be quiet, my daughter. Don't you know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said:" The deceased is punished because of his family's weeping over the death"?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمَيِّتُ يُعَذَّبُ فِي قَبْرِهِ بِمَا نِيحَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almayyitu yu'adhhabu fiy qabrihi bimaa niyha 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The dead is punished in the grave because of wailing on it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ، بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمَيِّتُ يُعَذَّبُ فِي قَبْرِهِ بِمَا نِيحَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an sa'iydi, bni almusayyabi 'ani abni 'umara, 'an 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almayyitu yu'adhhabu fiy qabrihi bimaa niyha 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same hadith is narrated on the authority of 'Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي، صَالِحٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لَمَّا طُعِنَ عُمَرُ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ فَصِيحَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ أَمَا عَلِمْتُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ لَيُعَذَّبُ بِبُكَاءِ الْحَىِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy, saalihin 'ani abni 'umara, qaala lammaa tu'ina 'umaru aughmiya 'alayhi fasiyha 'alayhi falammaa aafaaqa qaala aamaa 'alimtum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna almayyita layu'adhhabu bibukaa'i alhaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:When 'Umar was wounded he fainted, and there was a loud lamentation over him. When he regained consciousness he said: Didn't you know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" The dead is punished because of the weeping of the living"?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا أُصِيبَ عُمَرُ جَعَلَ صُهَيْبٌ يَقُولُ وَاأَخَاهْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ يَا صُهَيْبُ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ لَيُعَذَّبُ بِبُكَاءِ الْحَىِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala lammaa ausiyba 'umaru ja'ala suhaybun yaquwlu waaaakhaah ‏.‏ faqaala lahu 'umaru yaa suhaybu aamaa 'alimta aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna almayyita layu'adhhabu bibukaa'i alhaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Burda narrated on the authority of his father that when 'Umar was wounded Suhaib uttered (loudly in lamentation):O brother! Upon this 'Umar said: Suhaib, did you not know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:" The dead is punished because of the lamentation of the living"?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ أَبُو يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ، عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ لَمَّا أُصِيبَ عُمَرُ أَقْبَلَ صُهَيْبٌ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَى عُمَرَ فَقَامَ بِحِيَالِهِ يَبْكِي فَقَالَ عُمَرُ عَلاَمَ تَبْكِي أَعَلَىَّ تَبْكِي قَالَ إِي وَاللَّهِ لَعَلَيْكَ أَبْكِي يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يُبْكَى عَلَيْهِ يُعَذَّبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِمُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ تَقُولُ إِنَّمَا كَانَ أُولَئِكَ الْيَهُودَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, aakhbaranaa shu'aybu bnu safwaana aabuw yahyaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni, 'umayrin 'an aabiy burdaaa bni aabiy muwsaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala lammaa ausiyba 'umaru aaqbala suhaybun min manzilihi hattaa dakhala 'alaa 'umara faqaama bihiyaalihi yabkiy faqaala 'umaru 'alaama tabkiy aa'alaaaa tabkiy qaala iiy waalllahi la'alayka aabkiy yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna ‏.‏ qaala waalllahi laqad 'alimta aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man yubkaa 'alayhi yu'adhhabu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fadhakartu dhalika limuwsaa bni talhaaa faqaala kaanat 'aaiishaau taquwlu iinnamaa kaana auwlaiika alyahuwda ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported that when 'Umar was wounded, there came Suhaib from his house and went to 'Umar and stood by his side, and began to wail. Upon this 'Umar said:What are you weeping for? Are you weeping for me? He said: By Allah, it is for you that I weep, O Commander of the believers. He said: By Allah, you already know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: He who is lamented upon is punished. I made a mention of it to Musa b. Talha, and he said that 'A'isha told that it concerned the Jews (only)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، لَمَّا طُعِنَ عَوَّلَتْ عَلَيْهِ حَفْصَةُ فَقَالَ يَا حَفْصَةُ أَمَا سَمِعْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْمُعَوَّلُ عَلَيْهِ يُعَذَّبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَعَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ صُهَيْبٌ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا صُهَيْبُ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ ‏"‏ أَنَّ الْمُعَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ يُعَذَّبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, lammaa tu'ina 'awwalat 'alayhi hafsaau faqaala yaa hafsaau aamaa sami'ti rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ almu'awwalu 'alayhi yu'adhhabu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wa'awwala 'alayhi suhaybun faqaala 'umaru yaa suhaybu aamaa 'alimta ‏"‏ aanna almu'awwala 'alayhi yu'adhhabu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that when 'Umar b. Khattab was wounded Hafsa lamented for him. Upon this he said:O Hafsa, did you not hear the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying:" One who is lamented would be punished"? Suhaib also lamented over him. 'Umar told him also: O Suhaib, didn't you know that one who is lamented is punished?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، كُنَّا فِي جَنَازَةِ أُمِّ أَبَانٍ بِنْتِ عُثْمَانَ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَلَمْ يَنُصَّ رَفْعَ الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا نَصَّهُ أَيُّوبُ وَابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ وَحَدِيثُهُمَا أَتَمُّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَمْرٍو ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala 'amrunw 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, kunnaa fiy janaazaai aummi aabaanin binti 'uthmaana wasaaqa alhadiytha walam yanussa raf'a alhadiythi 'an 'umara 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kamaa nassahu aayyuwbu waabnu jurayjin wahadiythuhumaa aatammu min hadiythi 'amrinw ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr reported on the authority of Ibn Abu Mulaika:We were with the bier of Umm Aban, daughter of 'Uthman, and the rest of the hadith is the same, but he did not narrate it as a marfu' hadith on the authority of 'Umar from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as it was narrated by Ayyub and Ibn Juraij, and the hadith narrated by them (Ayyub and Ibn Juraij) is more complete than that of 'Amr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّحَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ يُعَذَّبُ بِبُكَاءِ الْحَىِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy 'umaru bnu muhammadin, aannahaddathahu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna almayyita yu'adhhabu bibukaa'i alhaaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:The dead is punished because of the lamentation of the living
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، - قَالَ خَلَفٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، - عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ قَوْلُ ابْنِ عُمَرَ الْمَيِّتُ يُعَذَّبُ بِبُكَاءِ أَهْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ سَمِعَ شَيْئًا فَلَمْ يَحْفَظْهُ إِنَّمَا مَرَّتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَنَازَةُ يَهُودِيٍّ وَهُمْ يَبْكُونَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنْتُمْ تَبْكُونَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيُعَذَّبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, jamiy'ana 'an hammaadin, - qaala khalafun haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, - 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala dhukira 'inda 'aaiishaaa qawlu abni 'umara almayyitu yu'adhhabu bibukaa'i aahlihi 'alayhi ‏.‏ faqaalat rahima alllahu aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani sami'a shayiana falam yahfazhu iinnamaa marrat 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm janaazaau yahuwdiyyin wahum yabkuwna 'alayhi faqaala ‏ "‏ aantum tabkuwna waiinnahu layu'adhhabu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham b. 'Urwa narrated on the authority of his father that the saying of Ibn 'Umar, viz." The dead would be punished because of the lamentation of his family over him" was mentioned to 'A'isha. Upon this she said:May Allah have mercy upon Abu 'Abd al-Rahman (the kunya of Ibn 'Umar) that he heard something but could not retain it (well). (The fact is) that the bier of a Jew passed before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and (the members of his family) were waiting over him. Upon this he said: You are wailing and he is being punished
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَرْفَعُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ يُعَذَّبُ فِي قَبْرِهِ بِبُكَاءِ أَهْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ وَهَلَ إِنَّمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَيُعَذَّبُ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ أَوْ بِذَنْبِهِ وَإِنَّ أَهْلَهُ لَيَبْكُونَ عَلَيْهِ الآنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَذَاكَ مِثْلُ قَوْلِهِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ عَلَى الْقَلِيبِ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَفِيهِ قَتْلَى بَدْرٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ مَا قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَسْمَعُونَ مَا أَقُولُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ وَهَلَ إِنَّمَا قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ مَا كُنْتُ أَقُولُ لَهُمْ حَقٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَتْ ‏{‏ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتَى‏}‏ ‏{‏ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ‏}‏ يَقُولُ حِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا مَقَاعِدَهُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala dhukira 'inda 'aaiishaaa aanna abna 'umara, yarfa'u iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna almayyita yu'adhhabu fiy qabrihi bibukaa'i aahlihi 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat wahala iinnamaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahu layu'adhhabu bikhatiyiatihi aaw bidhanbihi waiinna aahlahu layabkuwna 'alayhi alana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wadhaaka mithlu qawlihi iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama 'alaa alqaliybi yawma badrin wafiyhi qatlaa badrin mina almushrikiyna faqaala lahum maa qaala ‏"‏ iinnahum layasma'uwna maa aaquwlu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqad wahala iinnamaa qaala ‏"‏ iinnahum laya'lamuwna aanna maa kuntu aaquwlu lahum haqqun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaraaat ‏{‏ iinnaka laa tusmi'u almawtaa‏}‏ ‏{‏ wamaa aanta bimusmi'in man fiy alqubuwri‏}‏ yaquwlu hiyna tabawwa'uwa maqaa'idahum mina alnnaari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham narrated on the authority of his father that it was mentioned to 'A'isha that Ibn 'Umar had narrated as marfu' hadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that the dead would be punished in the grave because of the lamentation of his family for him. Upon this she said:He (Ibn 'Umar) missed (the point). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had (in fact) said: He (the dead) is punished for his faults or for his sins, and the members of his family are wailing for him now. (This misunderstanding of Ibn 'Umar is similar to his saying: ) The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood by the well in which were lying the dead bodies of those polytheists who had been killed on the Day of Badr, and he said to them what he had to say, i. e.: They hear what I say. But he (Ibn 'Umar) misunderstood. The Prophet (ﷺ) had only said: They (the dead) understand that what I used to say to them was truth. She then recited:" Certainly, thou canst not make the dead hear the call" (xxvii. 80), nor can you make those hear who are in the graves, nor can you inform them when they have taken their seats in Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ وَحَدِيثُ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ أَتَمُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi bima'naa hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa wahadiythu aabiy ausaamaaa aatammu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters. The hadith narrated by Abu Usama is more complete
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، سَمِعَتْ عَائِشَةَ، وَذُكِرَ، لَهَا أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ لَيُعَذَّبُ بِبُكَاءِ الْحَىِّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكْذِبْ وَلَكِنَّهُ نَسِيَ أَوْ أَخْطَأَ إِنَّمَا مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى يَهُودِيَّةٍ يُبْكَى عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَبْكُونَ عَلَيْهَا وَإِنَّهَا لَتُعَذَّبُ فِي قَبْرِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, aabiy bakrin 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahaa aakhbarathu aannahaa, sami'at 'aaiishaaa, wadhukira, lahaa aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, yaquwlu iinna almayyita layu'adhhabu bibukaa'i alhaaai ‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau yaghfiru alllahu laabiy 'abdi alrrahmani aamaa iinnahu lam yakdhib walakinnahu nasiya aaw aakhtaaa iinnamaa marra rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa yahuwdiyyaain yubkaa 'alayhaa faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnahum layabkuwna 'alayhaa waiinnahaa latu'adhhabu fiy qabrihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amra daughter of 'Abd al Rahman narrated that she heard (from) 'A'isha and made a mention to her about 'Abdullah b. 'Umar as saying:The dead is punished because of the lamentation of the living. Upon this 'A'isha said: May Allah have mercy upon the father of 'Abd al-Rahman (Ibn 'Umar). He did not tell a lie, but he forgot or made a mistake. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) happened to pass by a (dead) Jewess who was being lamented. Upon this he said: They weep over her and she is being punished in the grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ الطَّائِيِّ، وَمُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ نِيحَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْكُوفَةِ قَرَظَةُ بْنُ كَعْبٍ فَقَالَ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ نِيحَ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّهُ يُعَذَّبُ بِمَا نِيحَ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sa'iydi bni 'ubaydin alttaaiiyyi, wamuhammadi, bni qaysin 'an 'aliyyi bni rabiy'aaa, qaala aawwalu man niyha 'alayhi bialkuwfaai qarazaau bnu ka'bin faqaala almughiyraau bnu shu'baaa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man niyha 'alayhi faiinnahu yu'adhhabu bimaa niyha 'alayhi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Rabi'a reported that the first one who was lamented upon in Kufa was Qaraza b. Ka'b. Mughira b. Shu'ba said:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: He who is lamented upon would be punished because of the lamentation for him on the Day of judgment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، الأَسْدِيُّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ الأَسْدِيِّ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu qaysin, alaasdiyyu 'an 'aliyyi bni rabiy'aaa alaasdiyyi, 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Mughira b. Shu'ba from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِي الْفَزَارِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، الطَّائِيُّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa marwaanu, - ya'niy alfazaariyya - haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ubaydin, alttaaiiyyu 'an 'aliyyi bni rabiy'aaa, 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، أَنَّ زَيْدًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَلاَّمٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا مَالِكٍ الأَشْعَرِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَرْبَعٌ فِي أُمَّتِي مِنْ أَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ لاَ يَتْرُكُونَهُنَّ الْفَخْرُ فِي الأَحْسَابِ وَالطَّعْنُ فِي الأَنْسَابِ وَالاِسْتِسْقَاءُ بِالنُّجُومِ وَالنِّيَاحَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ النَّائِحَةُ إِذَا لَمْ تَتُبْ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهَا تُقَامُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَعَلَيْهَا سِرْبَالٌ مِنْ قَطِرَانٍ وَدِرْعٌ مِنْ جَرَبٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa aabaanu bnu yaziyda, h wahaddathaniy iishaaqu, bnu mansuwrin - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa habbaanu bnu hilaalin, haddathanaa aabaanun, haddathanaa yahyaa, aanna zaydana, haddathahu aanna aabaa salaaamin haddathahu aanna aabaa maalikin alaash'ariyya haddathahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aarba'un fiy aummatiy min aamri aljaahiliyyaai laa yatrukuwnahunna alfakhru fiy alaahsaabi waaltta'nu fiy alaansaabi waalaistisqaa'u bialnnujuwmi waalnniyaahaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ alnnaaiihaau iidhaa lam tatub qabla mawtihaa tuqaamu yawma alqiyaamaai wa'alayhaa sirbaalun min qatiraanin wadir'un min jarabin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Malik al-Ash'ari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Among my people there are four characteristics belonging to pre-Islamic period which they do not abandon: boasting of high rank, reviling other peoples' genealogies, seeking rain by stars, and walling. And he (further) said: If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a garment of pitch and a chemise of mange
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَمْرَةُ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ عَائِشَةَ، تَقُولُ لَمَّا جَاءَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَتْلُ ابْنِ حَارِثَةَ وَجَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَوَاحَةَ جَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعْرَفُ فِيهِ الْحُزْنُ قَالَتْ وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ مِنْ صَائِرِ الْبَابِ - شَقِّ الْبَابِ - فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ نِسَاءَ جَعْفَرٍ وَذَكَرَ بُكَاءَهُنَّ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ فَيَنْهَاهُنَّ فَذَهَبَ فَأَتَاهُ فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُنَّ لَمْ يُطِعْنَهُ فَأَمَرَهُ الثَّانِيَةَ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ فَيَنْهَاهُنَّ فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ غَلَبْنَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَزَعَمَتْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اذْهَبْ فَاحْثُ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِنَّ مِنَ التُّرَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ أَرْغَمَ اللَّهُ أَنْفَكَ وَاللَّهِ مَا تَفْعَلُ مَا أَمَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا تَرَكْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْعَنَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa bna sa'iydin, yaquwlu aakhbaratniy 'amraau, aannahaa sami'at 'aaiishaaa, taquwlu lammaa jaa'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qatlu abni haarithaaa waja'fari bni aabiy taalibin wa'abdi alllahi bni rawaahaaa jalasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'rafu fiyhi alhuznu qaalat waaanaa aanzuru min saaiiri albaabi - shaqqi albaabi - faaataahu rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna nisaa'a ja'farin wadhakara bukaa'ahunna faaamarahu aan yadhhaba fayanhaahunna fadhahaba faaataahu fadhakara aannahunna lam yuti'nahu faaamarahu althhaaniyaaa aan yadhhaba fayanhaahunna fadhahaba thumma aataahu faqaala waalllahi laqad ghalabnanaa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaalat faza'amat aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ adhhab faahthu fiy aafwaahihinna mina altturaabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau faqultu aarghama alllahu aanfaka waalllahi maa taf'alu maa aamaraka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wamaa tarakta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina al'anaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was told that Ibn Haritha, Ja'far b. Abu Talib and Abdullah b. Rawaha were killed, he sat down, showing signs of grief. She (further) said:I was looking (at him) through the crevice of the door. A man came to him and mentioned that Ja'far's women were lamenting. He (the Holy Prophet) commanded him to go and forbid them (to do so). So he went away but came back and told (him) that they did not obey (him). He commanded him a second time to go and forbid them (to do so). He again went but came back to him and said: I swear by God, Messenger of Allah, that they have overpowered us. She ('A'isha) said that she thought the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had told (her) to throw dust in their mouths. Thereupon 'A'isha said: May Allah humble you! You did not do what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered you, nor did you stop annoying Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُسْلِمٍ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وَمَا تَرَكْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْعِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni saalihin, h wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muslimin - kulluhum 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'abdi al'aziyzi wamaa tarakta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina al'iyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters like one narrated by 'Abd al-'Aziz (with the change of these words):" You did not spare the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) the botheration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ الْبَيْعَةِ أَلاَّ نَنُوحَ فَمَا وَفَتْ مِنَّا امْرَأَةٌ إِلاَّ خَمْسٌ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ وَأُمُّ الْعَلاَءِ وَابْنَةُ أَبِي سَبْرَةَ امْرَأَةُ مُعَاذٍ أَوِ ابْنَةُ أَبِي سَبْرَةَ وَامْرَأَةُ مُعَاذٍ .‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an muhammadin, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat aakhadha 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'a albay'aai aalaaa nanuwha famaa wafat minnaa amraaaaun iilaaa khamsun aummu sulaymin waaummu al'alaa'i waabnaau aabiy sabraaa amraaaau mu'aadhin aawi abnaau aabiy sabraaa waamraaaau mu'aadhin .‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took a promise from us along with the oath of Allegiance that we would not lament. But only five among us fulfilled the promise (and they are) Umm Sulaim, and Umm al-'Ala', and the daughter of Abu Sabra the wife of Mu'adh, or daughter of Abu Sabra and wife of Mu'adh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَسْبَاطٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْبَيْعَةِ أَلاَّ تَنُحْنَ فَمَا وَفَتْ مِنَّا غَيْرُ خَمْسٍ مِنْهُنَّ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aasbaatun, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an hafsaaa, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat aakhadha 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy albay'aai aalaaa tanuhna famaa wafat minnaa ghayru khamsin minhunna aummu sulaymin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took pledge from us (including this promise) that we would not lament. Only five amongst us fulfilled the promise, and one of them (who fulfilled the promise) was Umm Sulaim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَازِمٍ، - حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ، عَطِيَّةَ قَالَتْ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَى أَنْ لاَ يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا‏}‏ ‏{‏ وَلاَ يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ‏}‏ قَالَتْ كَانَ مِنْهُ النِّيَاحَةُ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ آلَ فُلاَنٍ فَإِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا أَسْعَدُونِي فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَلاَ بُدَّ لِي مِنْ أَنْ أُسْعِدَهُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِلاَّ آلَ فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa muhammadu bnu khaazimin, - haddathanaa 'aasimun, 'an hafsaaa, 'an aummi, 'atiyyaaa qaalat lammaa nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ yubaayi'naka 'alaa aan laa yushrikna bialllahi shayiana‏}‏ ‏{‏ walaa ya'siynaka fiy ma'ruwfin‏}‏ qaalat kaana minhu alnniyaahaau ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iilaaa ala fulaanin faiinnahum kaanuwa aas'aduwniy fiy aljaahiliyyaai falaa budda liy min aan aus'idahum ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iilaaa ala fulaanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hafsa narrated on the authority of Umm 'Atiyya that she said:When this verse was revealed:" When believing women came to thee giving thee a pledge that they will not associate aught with Allah, and will not disobey thee in good" (lx. 12), she (Umm Atiyya) said: In (this pledge) was also included wailing. I said: Messenger of Allah, except members of such a tribe who helped me (in lamentation) during pre-Islamic days, there is left no alternative for me, but that I should also help them. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: (Yes) but only in case of the members of such a tribe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ قَالَتْ أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ كُنَّا نُنْهَى عَنِ اتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَائِزِ وَلَمْ يُعْزَمْ عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, aakhbaranaa aayyuwbu, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, qaala qaalat aummu 'atiyyaaa kunnaa nunhaa 'ani attibaa'i aljanaaiizi walam yu'zam 'alaynaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:We were forbidden to follow the bier, but it was not made absolute on us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ نُهِينَا عَنِ اتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَائِزِ، وَلَمْ يُعْزَمْ عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kilaahumaa 'an hishaamin, 'an hafsaaa, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat nuhiynaa 'ani attibaa'i aljanaaiizi, walam yu'zam 'alaynaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:We were refrained from following the bier, but it was not made absolute on us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نَغْسِلُ ابْنَتَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ ذَلِكَ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَاجْعَلْنَ فِي الآخِرَةِ كَافُورًا أَوْ شَيْئًا مِنْ كَافُورٍ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُنَّ فَآذِنَّنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا آذَنَّاهُ فَأَلْقَى إِلَيْنَا حِقْوَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشْعِرْنَهَا إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat dakhala 'alaynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu naghsilu abnatahu faqaala ‏"‏ aghsilnahaa thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw aakthara min dhalika iin raaaytunna dhalika bimaa'in wasidrin waaj'alna fiy alakhiraai kaafuwrana aaw shayiana min kaafuwrin faiidhaa faraghtunna faadhinnaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa faraghnaa adhannaahu faaalqaa iilaynaa hiqwahu faqaala ‏"‏ aash'irnahaa iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) came to us when we were bathing his daughter, and he told us: Wash her with water and (with the leaves of) the lote tree, three or five times, or more than that if you think fit, and put camphor or something like camphor in the last washing; then inform me when you have finished. So when we had finished, we informed him, and he gave to us his (own) under-garment saying:" Put it next her body
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ مَشَطْنَاهَا ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an hafsaaa binti siyriyna, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat mashatnaahaa thalaathaaa quruwnin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:We braided her hair in three plaits
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ تُوُفِّيَتْ إِحْدَى بَنَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ قَالَتْ أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نَغْسِلُ ابْنَتَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ تُوُفِّيَتِ ابْنَتُهُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, waqutaybaau, bnu sa'iydin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, kulluhum 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat tuwuffiyat iihdaa banaati alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa qaalat aataanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu naghsilu abnatahu ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi maalikin qaalat dakhala 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna tuwuffiyati abnatuhu ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi yaziyda bni zuray'in 'an aayyuwba 'an muhammadin 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:One of the daughters of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) died. And in the hadith transmitted by Ibn 'Ulayya (the words are): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to us and we were washing his daughter. And in the hadith transmitted by Malik (the words are): There came in (our apartment) the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) when his daughter died. The rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Yazid b. Zurai' from Ayyub from Muhammad from Umm 'Atiyya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ سَبْعًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكِ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ ذَلِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ وَجَعَلْنَا رَأْسَهَا ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an hafsaaa, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, ‏.‏ binahwihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw sab'ana aaw aakthara min dhaliki iin raaaytunna dhaliki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat hafsaau 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa waja'alnaa raasahaa thalaathaaa quruwnin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted by Hafsa on the authority of Umm 'Atiyya with the exception (of these words that the Prophet asked them to wash her dead body):" three times, five times, seven times, or more than that, if you deem fit:" Hafsa (further) said on the authority of Umm 'Atiyya: We braided (the hair) of her head in three plaits
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، وَأَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، قَالَ وَقَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتِ اغْسِلْنَهَا وِتْرًا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ سَبْعًا قَالَ وَقَالَتْ أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ مَشَطْنَاهَا ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, waaakhbaranaa aayyuwbu, qaala waqaalat hafsaau 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalati aghsilnahaa witrana thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw sab'ana qaala waqaalat aummu 'atiyyaaa mashatnaahaa thalaathaaa quruwnin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:We washed her an odd number of times, i. e. three, five or seven times; and Umm 'Atiyya (further) said: We braided her hair in three plaits
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، - قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَازِمٍ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا مَاتَتْ زَيْنَبُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا وِتْرًا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا وَاجْعَلْنَ فِي الْخَامِسَةِ كَافُورًا أَوْ شَيْئًا مِنْ كَافُورٍ فَإِذَا غَسَلْتُنَّهَا فَأَعْلِمْنَنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَأَعْلَمْنَاهُ ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَانَا حِقْوَهُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشْعِرْنَهَا إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, - qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa muhammadu bnu khaazimin aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, - haddathanaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, 'an hafsaaa binti siyriyna, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat lammaa maatat zaynabu bintu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aghsilnahaa witrana thalaathana aaw khamsana waaj'alna fiy alkhaamisaai kaafuwrana aaw shayiana min kaafuwrin faiidhaa ghasaltunnahaa faaa'limnaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faaa'lamnaahu ‏.‏ faaa'taanaa hiqwahu waqaala ‏"‏ aash'irnahaa iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:When Zainab the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) died, he said to us: Wash her odd number of times, i. e. three or five times, and put camphor or something-like camphor at the fifth time, and after you have washed her inform me. So we informed him and he gave us his under-garment, saying:" Put it next her body
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نَغْسِلُ إِحْدَى بَنَاتِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا وِتْرًا خَمْسًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ أَيُّوبَ وَعَاصِمٍ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالَتْ فَضَفَرْنَا شَعْرَهَا ثَلاَثَةَ أَثْلاَثٍ قَرْنَيْهَا وَنَاصِيَتَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, 'an hafsaaa, binti siyriyna 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat aataanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu naghsilu iihdaa banaatihi faqaala ‏ "‏ aghsilnahaa witrana khamsana aaw aakthara min dhaliki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi aayyuwba wa'aasimin waqaala fiy alhadiythi qaalat fadafarnaa sha'rahaa thalaathaaa aathlaathin qarnayhaa wanaasiyatahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported:There came to us the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as we were washing one of his daughters. So he said: Wash her (dead body) an odd number of times, five times or more than that, the rest of the hadith is the same. She (further) said: We braided her hair in three plaits: (two) on the sides of her head and one on her forehead
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَيْثُ أَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَغْسِلَ ابْنَتَهُ قَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ ابْدَأْنَ بِمَيَامِنِهَا وَمَوَاضِعِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an khaalidin, 'an hafsaaa binti siyriyna, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm haythu aamarahaa aan taghsila abnatahu qaala lahaa ‏ "‏ abdaana bimayaaminihaa wamawaadi'i alwuduw'i minhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported that when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked her to wash his daughter, he told her to start from the right side, and with those parts of the body over which Wudu' is performed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، - عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُنَّ فِي غَسْلِ ابْنَتِهِ ‏ "‏ ابْدَأْنَ بِمَيَامِنِهَا وَمَوَاضِعِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu kulluhum 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, - 'an khaalidin, 'an hafsaaa, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahunna fiy ghasli abnatihi ‏ "‏ abdaana bimayaaminihaa wamawaadi'i alwuduw'i minhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm 'Atiyya reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to them (the women) in regard to the washing of his daughter to start from the right side and with those parts of the body over which Wudu' is performed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ خَبَّابِ بْنِ الأَرَتِّ، قَالَ هَاجَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ نَبْتَغِي وَجْهَ اللَّهِ فَوَجَبَ أَجْرُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ فَمِنَّا مَنْ مَضَى لَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْ أَجْرِهِ شَيْئًا مِنْهُمْ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ ‏.‏ قُتِلَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ لَهُ شَىْءٌ يُكَفَّنُ فِيهِ إِلاَّ نَمِرَةٌ فَكُنَّا إِذَا وَضَعْنَاهَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ خَرَجَتْ رِجْلاَهُ وَإِذَا وَضَعْنَاهَا عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ خَرَجَ رَأْسُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ضَعُوهَا مِمَّا يَلِي رَأْسَهُ وَاجْعَلُوا عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَيْنَعَتْ لَهُ ثَمَرَتُهُ فَهُوَ يَهْدِبُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu liyahyaa qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, - 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an khabbaabi bni alaaratti, qaala haajarnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy sabiyli alllahi nabtaghiy wajha alllahi fawajaba aajrunaa 'alaa alllahi faminnaa man madaa lam yaakul min aajrihi shayiana minhum mus'abu bnu 'umayrin ‏.‏ qutila yawma auhudin falam yuwjad lahu shaa'un yukaffanu fiyhi iilaaa namiraaun fakunnaa iidhaa wada'naahaa 'alaa raasihi kharajat rijlaahu waiidhaa wada'naahaa 'alaa rijlayhi kharaja raasuhu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ da'uwhaa mimmaa yaliy raasahu waaj'aluwa 'alaa rijlayhi aliidhkhira ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waminnaa man aayna'at lahu thamaratuhu fahuwa yahdibuhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Khabbab al-Aratt reported:We migrated with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the path of Allah seeking Allah's pleasure alone. Thus our reward was assured with Allah. And amongst us were those who spent life (in such a state of piety and austerity) that nothing consumed their reward. Mus'ab b. 'Umair was one of them. He was killed on the Day of Uhud, and nothing but a woollen cloak was found to shroud him. When we covered his head with it, his feet became uncovered, and when we covered his feet, his head was uncovered. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Place it (this cloak) on the side of his head and cover his feet with grass. And there is one amongst us for whom the fruit is ripened and he enjoys it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, h wahaddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Uyaina on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُفِّنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ بِيضٍ سَحُولِيَّةٍ مِنْ كُرْسُفٍ لَيْسَ فِيهَا قَمِيصٌ وَلاَ عِمَامَةٌ أَمَّا الْحُلَّةُ فَإِنَّمَا شُبِّهَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فِيهَا أَنَّهَا اشْتُرِيَتْ لَهُ لِيُكَفَّنَ فِيهَا فَتُرِكَتِ الْحُلَّةُ وَكُفِّنَ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ بِيضٍ سَحُولِيَّةٍ فَأَخَذَهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ لأَحْبِسَنَّهَا حَتَّى أُكَفِّنَ فِيهَا نَفْسِي ثُمَّ قَالَ لَوْ رَضِيَهَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لِنَبِيِّهِ لَكَفَّنَهُ فِيهَا ‏.‏ فَبَاعَهَا وَتَصَدَّقَ بِثَمَنِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, - 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuffina rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy thalaathaai aathwaabin biydin sahuwliyyaain min kursufin laysa fiyhaa qamiysun walaa 'imaamaaun aammaa alhullaau faiinnamaa shubbiha 'alaa alnnaasi fiyhaa aannahaa ashturiyat lahu liyukaffana fiyhaa faturikati alhullaau wakuffina fiy thalaathaai aathwaabin biydin sahuwliyyaain faaakhadhahaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy bakrin faqaala laahbisannahaa hattaa aukaffina fiyhaa nafsiy thumma qaala law radiyahaa alllahu 'azza wajalla linabiyyihi lakaffanahu fiyhaa ‏.‏ fabaa'ahaa watasaddaqa bithamanihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was shrouded in three cotton garments of white Yamani stuff from Sahul, among which was neither a shirt nor a turban; and so far as Hullah is concerned there was some doubt about it in the minds of people, that it was brought for him in order to shroud him with it, but it was abandoned, and he was shrouded in three cotton garments of white Yamani stuff from Sahul. Then 'Abdullah b. Abu Bakr got it and said:I would keep it in order to shroud myself in it. He then said: If Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, would have desired it for His Apostle, he would have been shrouded with it. So he sold it and gave its price in charity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أُدْرِجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حُلَّةٍ يَمَنِيَّةٍ كَانَتْ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ثُمَّ نُزِعَتْ عَنْهُ وَكُفِّنَ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ سُحُولٍ يَمَانِيَةٍ لَيْسَ فِيهَا عِمَامَةٌ وَلاَ قَمِيصٌ فَرَفَعَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْحُلَّةَ فَقَالَ أُكَفَّنُ فِيهَا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَمْ يُكَفَّنْ فِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأُكَفَّنُ فِيهَا ‏.‏ فَتَصَدَّقَ بِهَا ‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat audrija rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hullaain yamaniyyaain kaanat li'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin thumma nuzi'at 'anhu wakuffina fiy thalaathaai aathwaabin suhuwlin yamaaniyaain laysa fiyhaa 'imaamaaun walaa qamiysun farafa'a 'abdu alllahi alhullaaa faqaala aukaffanu fiyhaa ‏.‏ thumma qaala lam yukaffan fiyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaukaffanu fiyhaa ‏.‏ fatasaddaqa bihaa ‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was wrapped in a Yamani wrapper which belonged to 'Abdullah b Abu Bakr; then it was removed from him, and he was shrouded in three cotton sheets of white Yamani stuff from Sahul among which was neither a shirt nor a turban. 'Abdullah took up the Hullah and said:I would be shrouded in it, but then said: How is it that I should be shrouded in it in which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was not shrouded! So he gave it in charity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، وَابْنُ، عُيَيْنَةَ وَابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ وَعَبْدَةُ وَوَكِيعٌ ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ قِصَّةُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, waabnu, 'uyaynaaa waabnu iidriysa wa'abdaau wawakiy'un h wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, kulluhum 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walaysa fiy hadiythihim qissaau 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but in the hadith narrated by him there is no mention of the story of 'Abdullah b. Abu Bakr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ لَهَا فِي كَمْ كُفِّنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ سَحُولِيَّةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an yaziyda, 'an muhammadi bni iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy salamaaa, aannahu qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu lahaa fiy kam kuffina rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat fiy thalaathaai aathwaabin sahuwliyyaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Salama said:I asked 'A'isha with how many garments the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was shourded. She said: With three garments of Sahul
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
