verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ، الآخَرَانِ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَتْ سُجِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ مَاتَ بِثَوْبِ حِبَرَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wahasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaraniy waqaala, alakharaani haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni, shihaabin aanna aabaa salamaaa bna 'abdi alrrahmani, aakhbarahu aanna 'aaiishaaa aumma almuuminiyna qaalat sujjiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna maata bithawbi hibaraain ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upom him) died, he was covered with a Yamani wrapper
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaala aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi sawaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ يَوْمًا فَذَكَرَ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ قُبِضَ فَكُفِّنَ فِي كَفَنٍ غَيْرِ طَائِلٍ وَقُبِرَ لَيْلاً فَزَجَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُقْبَرَ الرَّجُلُ بِاللَّيْلِ حَتَّى يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُضْطَرَّ إِنْسَانٌ إِلَى ذَلِكَ وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَفَّنَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيُحَسِّنْ كَفَنَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, qaalaa haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yuhaddithu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm khataba yawmana fadhakara rajulaan min aashaabihi qubida fakuffina fiy kafanin ghayri taaiilin waqubira laylaan fazajara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuqbara alrrajulu bialllayli hattaa yusallaa 'alayhi iilaaa aan yudtarra iinsaanun iilaa dhalika waqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa kaffana aahadukum aakhaahu falyuhassin kafanahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one day in the course of his sermon made mention of a person among his Companions who had died and had been wrapped in a shroud not long (enough to cover his whole body) and was buried during the night. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) reprimanded (the audience) that a person was buried during the night (in a state that) funeral prayer could not be offered (over him by the Messenger of Allah). (And this is permissible only) when it becomes a dire necessity for a man. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) also said: When any one of you shrouds his brother, he should shroud him well
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَسْرِعُوا بِالْجَنَازَةِ فَإِنْ تَكُ صَالِحَةً فَخَيْرٌ - لَعَلَّهُ قَالَ - تُقَدِّمُونَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ تَكُنْ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَشَرٌّ تَضَعُونَهُ عَنْ رِقَابِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, - 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aasri'uwa bialjanaazaai faiin taku saalihaaan fakhayrun - la'allahu qaala - tuqaddimuwnahaa 'alayhi waiin takun ghayra dhalika fasharrun tada'uwnahu 'an riqaabikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Make haste at a funeral; if the dead person was good, it is a good state to which you are sending him on; but if he was otherwise it is an evil of which you are ridding yourselves
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ قَالَ لاَ أَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ رَفَعَ الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy hafsaaa, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi ma'marin qaala laa aa'lamuhu iilaaa rafa'a alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by another chain of transmitters except with this variation (of words) that in the hadith narrated by Ma'mar (the words are):" I do not know whether the hadith is marfu
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، قَالَ هَارُونُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو أُمَامَةَ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَسْرِعُوا بِالْجَنَازَةِ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ صَالِحَةً قَرَّبْتُمُوهَا إِلَى الْخَيْرِ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ كَانَ شَرًّا تَضَعُونَهُ عَنْ رِقَابِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, wahaaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, qaala haaruwnu haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy aabuw aumaamaaa bnu sahli bni hunayfin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aasri'uwa bialjanaazaai faiin kaanat saalihaaan qarrabtumuwhaa iilaa alkhayri waiin kaanat ghayra dhalika kaana sharrana tada'uwnahu 'an riqaabikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger as saying:Hasten at a funeral, for if (the dead person) is good, you would (soon) bring him close to the good. And if it is otherwise, it is an evil of which you are ridding yourselves
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِهَارُونَ وَحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالَ هَارُونُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ هُرْمُزَ الأَعْرَجُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ شَهِدَ الْجَنَازَةَ حَتَّى يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا فَلَهُ قِيرَاطٌ وَمَنْ شَهِدَهَا حَتَّى تُدْفَنَ فَلَهُ قِيرَاطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ وَمَا الْقِيرَاطَانِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مِثْلُ الْجَبَلَيْنِ الْعَظِيمَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ انْتَهَى حَدِيثُ أَبِي الطَّاهِرِ وَزَادَ الآخَرَانِ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ قَالَ سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَهُ حَدِيثُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ لَقَدْ ضَيَّعْنَا قَرَارِيطَ كَثِيرَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, wahaaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, - waalllafzu lihaaruwna waharmalaaa - qaala haaruwnu haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin aakhbaraniy yuwnusu 'ani abni shihaabin qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu hurmuza alaa'raju aanna aabaa hurayraaa qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man shahida aljanaazaaa hattaa yusallaa 'alayhaa falahu qiyraatun waman shahidahaa hattaa tudfana falahu qiyraataani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qiyla wamaa alqiyraataani qaala ‏"‏ mithlu aljabalayni al'aziymayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ antahaa hadiythu aabiy alttaahiri wazaada alakharaani qaala abnu shihaabin qaala saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara wakaana abnu 'umara yusalliy 'alayhaa thumma yansarifu falammaa balaghahu hadiythu aabiy hurayraaa qaala laqad dayya'naa qaraariyta kathiyraaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who attends the funeral till the prayer is offered for (the dead), for him is the reward of one qirat, and he who attends (and stays) till he is buried, for him is the reward of two qirats. It was said: What are the qirats? He said: They are equivalent to two huge mountains. Two other narrators added: Ibn 'Umar used to pray and then depart (without waiting for the burial of the dead). When the tradition of Abu Huraira reached him, he said:" We have lost many qirats
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ، بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى قَوْلِهِ الْجَبَلَيْنِ الْعَظِيمَيْنِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرَا مَا بَعْدَهُ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى حَتَّى يُفْرَغَ مِنْهَا وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ حَتَّى تُوضَعَ فِي اللَّحْدِ
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, h wahaddathanaa abnu raafi'in, wa'abdu, bnu humaydin 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, kilaahumaa 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa qawlihi aljabalayni al'aziymayni ‏.‏ walam yadhkuraa maa ba'dahu wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alaa'laa hattaa yufragha minhaa wafiy hadiythi 'abdi alrrazzaaqi hattaa tuwda'a fiy alllahdi
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of narrators up to these words:" two great mountains." No mention is made of what followed (these words) ; and in the hadith transmitted by 'Abd al- A'la (the words are):" till (the burial) is complete." In the hadith transmitted by 'Abd ar-Razzaq (the words are):" till he is placed in the grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ، بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي رِجَالٌ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَهَا حَتَّى تُدْفَنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylu, bnu khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin, aannahu qaala haddathaniy rijaalun, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi ma'marin waqaala ‏ "‏ wamani attaba'ahaa hattaa tudfana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on thp authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters (with these words):" He who followed it (the bier) till he (the dead) is buried
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنِي سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جَنَازَةٍ وَلَمْ يَتْبَعْهَا فَلَهُ قِيرَاطٌ فَإِنْ تَبِعَهَا فَلَهُ قِيرَاطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ وَمَا الْقِيرَاطَانِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَصْغَرُهُمَا مِثْلُ أُحُدٍ ‏"‏ .‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathaniy suhaylun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man sallaa 'alaa janaazaain walam yatba'haa falahu qiyraatun faiin tabi'ahaa falahu qiyraataani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qiyla wamaa alqiyraataani qaala ‏"‏ aasgharuhumaa mithlu auhudin ‏"‏ .‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who offered prayer over the dead, but did not follow the bier, for him is the reward of one qirat, and he who followed it, for him is the reward of two qirats. It was asked what the qirats were. He said: The smaller amongst the two is equivalent to Uhud
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جَنَازَةٍ فَلَهُ قِيرَاطٌ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَهَا حَتَّى تُوضَعَ فِي الْقَبْرِ فَقِيرَاطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ وَمَا الْقِيرَاطُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مِثْلُ أُحُدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an yaziyda bni kaysaana, haddathaniy aabuw haazimin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man sallaa 'alaa janaazaain falahu qiyraatun wamani attaba'ahaa hattaa tuwda'a fiy alqabri faqiyraataani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa aabaa hurayraaa wamaa alqiyraatu qaala ‏"‏ mithlu auhudin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who offers prayer for the dead, for him is (the reward of) one qirat; and he who follows the bier till it is placed in the grave, for him (is the reward of) two qirats. I (Abu Hazim, one of the narrators) said: Abu Huraira, what is a qirat? He said: It is like the hill of Uhud
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَازِمٍ - حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، قَالَ قِيلَ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ إِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَبِعَ جَنَازَةً فَلَهُ قِيرَاطٌ مِنَ الأَجْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ أَكْثَرَ عَلَيْنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏ فَبَعَثَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ فَسَأَلَهَا فَصَدَّقَتْ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَقَدْ فَرَّطْنَا فِي قَرَارِيطَ كَثِيرَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyrun, - ya'niy abna haazimin - haddathanaa naafi'un, qaala qiyla laibni 'umara iinna aabaa hurayraaa yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man tabi'a janaazaaan falahu qiyraatun mina alaajri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'umara aakthara 'alaynaa aabuw hurayraaa ‏.‏ faba'atha iilaa 'aaiishaaa fasaaalahaa fasaddaqat aabaa hurayraaa faqaala abnu 'umara laqad farratnaa fiy qaraariyta kathiyraain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' narrated that it was said to Ibn 'Umar that Abu Huraira reported to have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who follows the bier, for him is the reward of one qirat. Ibn 'Umar said: Abu Huraira narrated it too often. So he sent (a messenger to) 'A'isha to ascertain (the fact). She ('A'isha) testified Abu Huraira. Ibn 'Umar said: We missed so many qirats
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنِي حَيْوَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ دَاوُدَ بْنَ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ قَاعِدًا عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ إِذْ طَلَعَ خَبَّابٌ صَاحِبُ الْمَقْصُورَةِ فَقَالَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ أَلاَ تَسْمَعُ مَا يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ إِنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ خَرَجَ مَعَ جَنَازَةٍ مِنْ بَيْتِهَا وَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ تَبِعَهَا حَتَّى تُدْفَنَ كَانَ لَهُ قِيرَاطَانِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ كُلُّ قِيرَاطٍ مِثْلُ أُحُدٍ وَمَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ رَجَعَ كَانَ لَهُ مِنَ الأَجْرِ مِثْلُ أُحُدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ خَبَّابًا إِلَى عَائِشَةَ يَسْأَلُهَا عَنْ قَوْلِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِ فَيُخْبِرُهُ مَا قَالَتْ وَأَخَذَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ قَبْضَةً مِنْ حَصَى الْمَسْجِدِ يُقَلِّبُهَا فِي يَدِهِ حَتَّى رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ الرَّسُولُ فَقَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ صَدَقَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏ فَضَرَبَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ بِالْحَصَى الَّذِي كَانَ فِي يَدِهِ الأَرْضَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَقَدْ فَرَّطْنَا فِي قَرَارِيطَ كَثِيرَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, haddathaniy haywaau, haddathaniy aabuw sakhrin, 'an yaziyda bni 'abdi alllahi bni qusaytin, aannahu haddathahu aanna daawuda bna 'aamiri bni sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin haddathahu 'an aabiyhi, aannahu kaana qaa'idana 'inda 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara iidh tala'a khabbaabun saahibu almaqsuwraai faqaala yaa 'abda alllahi bna 'umara aalaa tasma'u maa yaquwlu aabuw hurayraaa iinnahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man kharaja ma'a janaazaain min baytihaa wasallaa 'alayhaa thumma tabi'ahaa hattaa tudfana kaana lahu qiyraataani min aajrin kullu qiyraatin mithlu auhudin waman sallaa 'alayhaa thumma raja'a kaana lahu mina alaajri mithlu auhudin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaarsala abnu 'umara khabbaabana iilaa 'aaiishaaa yasaaluhaa 'an qawli aabiy hurayraaa thumma yarji'u iilayhi fayukhbiruhu maa qaalat waaakhadha abnu 'umara qabdaaan min hasaa almasjidi yuqallibuhaa fiy yadihi hattaa raja'a iilayhi alrrasuwlu faqaala qaalat 'aaiishaau sadaqa aabuw hurayraaa ‏.‏ fadaraba abnu 'umara bialhasaa alladhiy kaana fiy yadihi alaarda thumma qaala laqad farratnaa fiy qaraariyta kathiyraain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Dawud b. 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported on the authority of his father that while he was sitting along with 'Abdullah b. 'Umar, Khabbab, the owner of Maqsura, said:Ibn 'Umar, do you hear what Abu Huraira says that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say:" He who goes out with the bier when taken out from its residence and offers prayer for it and he then follows it till it is buried, he would have two qirats of reward, each qirat being equivalent to Uhud; and he who, after having offered prayer, (directly) came back would have his reward (as great) as Uhud"? Ibn 'Umar sent Khabbab to 'A'isha in order to ask her about the words of Abu Huraira (and also told him) to come back to him (Ibn 'Umar) and inform him what 'A'isha said. (In the meanwhile) Ibn 'Umar took up a handful of pebbles and turned them over in his hand till the messenger (Khabbab) came back to him and told (him) that 'A'isha testified (the statement of) Abu Huraira. Ibn 'Umar threw the pebbles he had in his hand on the ground and then said: We missed a large number of qirats
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الْيَعْمَرِيِّ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى جَنَازَةٍ فَلَهُ قِيرَاطٌ فَإِنْ شَهِدَ دَفْنَهَا فَلَهُ قِيرَاطَانِ الْقِيرَاطُ مِثْلُ أُحُدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathaniy qataadaau, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an ma'daana bni aabiy talhaaa alya'mariyyi, 'an thawbaana, mawlaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man sallaa 'alaa janaazaain falahu qiyraatun faiin shahida dafnahaa falahu qiyraataani alqiyraatu mithlu auhudin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who offered prayer for the dead, for him is the reward of one qirat, and he who attended its burial, he would have two qirats as his reward. And qirat is equivalent to Uhud
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ وَهِشَامٍ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْقِيرَاطِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مِثْلُ أُحُدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy abnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy qaala, wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa aabaanun, kulluhum 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi sa'iydin wahishaamin suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alqiyraati faqaala ‏ "‏ mithlu auhudin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Qatada with the same chain of transmitters. And in the hadith transmitted by Sa'id and Hisham, (the words are):" The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about qirat, and he said: It is equivalent to Uhud
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَلاَّمُ بْنُ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، - رَضِيعِ عَائِشَةَ - عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ مَيِّتٍ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ أُمَّةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يَبْلُغُونَ مِائَةً كُلُّهُمْ يَشْفَعُونَ لَهُ إِلاَّ شُفِّعُوا فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ شُعَيْبَ بْنَ الْحَبْحَابِ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'iysaa, haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, aakhbaranaa salaaamu bnu aabiy mutiy'in, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni yaziyda, - radiy'i 'aaiishaaa - 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa min mayyitin yusalliy 'alayhi aummaaun mina almuslimiyna yablughuwna miaiaaan kulluhum yashfa'uwna lahu iilaaa shuffi'uwa fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fahaddathtu bihi shu'ayba bna alhabhaabi faqaala haddathaniy bihi aanasu bnu maalikin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying:If a company of Muslims numbering one hundred pray over a dead person, all of them interceding for him, their intercession for him will be accepted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَالْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ السَّكُونِيُّ، قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ حَدَّثَنِي وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ مَاتَ ابْنٌ لَهُ بِقُدَيْدٍ أَوْ بِعُسْفَانَ فَقَالَ يَا كُرَيْبُ انْظُرْ مَا اجْتَمَعَ لَهُ مِنَ النَّاسِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجْتُ فَإِذَا نَاسٌ قَدِ اجْتَمَعُوا لَهُ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ تَقُولُ هُمْ أَرْبَعُونَ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَخْرِجُوهُ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَمُوتُ فَيَقُومُ عَلَى جَنَازَتِهِ أَرْبَعُونَ رَجُلاً لاَ يُشْرِكُونَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ شَفَّعَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, wahaaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waalwaliydu bnu shujaa'in alssakuwniyyu, qaala alwaliydu haddathaniy waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy aabuw sakhrin, 'an shariyki bni 'abdi, alllahi bni aabiy namirin 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, aannahu maata abnun lahu biqudaydin aaw bi'usfaana faqaala yaa kuraybu anzur maa ajtama'a lahu mina alnnaasi ‏.‏ qaala fakharajtu faiidhaa naasun qadi ajtama'uwa lahu faaakhbartuhu faqaala taquwlu hum aarba'uwna qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala aakhrijuwhu faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ maa min rajulin muslimin yamuwtu fayaquwmu 'alaa janaazatihi aarba'uwna rajulaan laa yushrikuwna bialllahi shayiana iilaaa shaffa'ahumu alllahu fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni ma'ruwfin 'an shariyki bni aabiy namirin 'an kuraybin 'ani abni 'abbaasin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that his son died in Qudaid or 'Usfan. He said to Kuraib to see as to how many people had gathered there for his (funeral). He (Kuraib) said:So I went out and I informed him about the people who had gathered there. He (Ibn 'Abbas) said: Do you think they are forty? He (Kuraib) said: Yes. Ibn 'Abbas then said to them: Bring him (the dead body) out for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If any Muslim dies and forty men who associate nothing with Allah stand over his prayer (they offer prayer over him), Allah will accept them as intercessors for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، - أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مُرَّ بِجَنَازَةٍ فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهَا خَيْرٌ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَجَبَتْ وَجَبَتْ وَجَبَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَمُرَّ بِجَنَازَةٍ فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهَا شَرٌّ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَجَبَتْ وَجَبَتْ وَجَبَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فِدًى لَكَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي مُرَّ بِجَنَازَةٍ فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهَا خَيْرًا فَقُلْتَ وَجَبَتْ وَجَبَتْ وَجَبَتْ ‏.‏ وَمُرَّ بِجَنَازَةٍ فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَيْهَا شَرٌّ فَقُلْتَ وَجَبَتْ وَجَبَتْ وَجَبَتْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ أَثْنَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ خَيْرًا وَجَبَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ وَمَنْ أَثْنَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ شَرًّا وَجَبَتْ لَهُ النَّارُ أَنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءُ اللَّهِ فِي الأَرْضِ أَنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءُ اللَّهِ فِي الأَرْضِ أَنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءُ اللَّهِ فِي الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu kulluhum 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, - waalllafzu liyahyaa qaala haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, - aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, bnu suhaybin 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala murra bijanaazaain faauthniya 'alayhaa khayrun faqaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wajabat wajabat wajabat ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wamurra bijanaazaain faauthniya 'alayhaa sharrun faqaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wajabat wajabat wajabat ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'umaru fidana laka aabiy waaummiy murra bijanaazaain faauthniya 'alayhaa khayrana faqulta wajabat wajabat wajabat ‏.‏ wamurra bijanaazaain faauthniya 'alayhaa sharrun faqulta wajabat wajabat wajabat faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man aathnaytum 'alayhi khayrana wajabat lahu aljannaau waman aathnaytum 'alayhi sharrana wajabat lahu alnnaaru aantum shuhadaa'u alllahi fiy alaardi aantum shuhadaa'u alllahi fiy alaardi aantum shuhadaa'u alllahi fiy alaardi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:There passed a bier (being carried by people) and it was lauded in good terms. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It has become certain, it has become certain, it has become certain. And there passed a bier and it was condemned in bad words. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It has become certain, it has become certain, it has become certain. 'Umar said: May my father and mother be ransom for you! There passed a bier and it was praised in good terms, and you said: It has become certain, it has become certain, it has become certain. And there passed a bier and it was condemned in bad words, and you said: It has become certain, it has become certain, it has become certain. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) said: He whom you praised in good terms, Paradise has become certain for him, and he whom you condemned in bad words, Hell has become certain for him. You are Allah's witnesses in the earth, you are Allah's witnesses in the earth, you are Allah's witnesses in the earth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ مُرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِجَنَازَةٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ أَتَمُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun ya'niy abna zaydin, h wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu, yahyaa aakhbaranaa ja'faru bnu sulaymaana, kilaahumaa 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala murra 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bijanaazaain ‏.‏ fadhakara bima'naa hadiythi 'abdi al'aziyzi 'an aanasin ghayra aanna hadiytha 'abdi al'aziyzi aatammu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو، بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ بْنِ رِبْعِيٍّ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُرَّ عَلَيْهِ بِجَنَازَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُسْتَرِيحٌ وَمُسْتَرَاحٌ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الْمُسْتَرِيحُ وَالْمُسْتَرَاحُ مِنْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ الْعَبْدُ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَسْتَرِيحُ مِنْ نَصَبِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْعَبْدُ الْفَاجِرُ يَسْتَرِيحُ مِنْهُ الْعِبَادُ وَالْبِلاَدُ وَالشَّجَرُ وَالدَّوَابُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw, bni halhalaaa 'an ma'badi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiy qataadaaa bni rib'iyyin, aannahu kaana yuhaddithu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm murra 'alayhi bijanaazaain faqaala ‏"‏ mustariyhun wamustaraahun minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi maa almustariyhu waalmustaraahu minhu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ al'abdu almuuminu yastariyhu min nasabi alddunyaa waal'abdu alfaajiru yastariyhu minhu al'ibaadu waalbilaadu waalshhajaru waalddawaabbu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qatada b. Rib'i reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Whenever a bier passed before him, he said: He is the one to find relief and the one with (the departure of him) other will find relief. They said: Apostle of Allah, who is al-Mustarih and al-Mustarah? Upon this he said: The believing servant finds relief from the troubles of the world, and in the death of a wicked person, the people, towns, trees and animals find rellef
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنٍ لِكَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ‏ "‏ يَسْتَرِيحُ مِنْ أَذَى الدُّنْيَا وَنَصَبِهَا إِلَى رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alllahi bni sa'iydi bni aabiy hindin, 'an muhammadi bni 'amrinw, 'ani abnin lika'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiy qataadaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wafiy hadiythi yahyaa bni sa'iydin ‏ "‏ yastariyhu min aadhaa alddunyaa wanasabihaa iilaa rahmaai alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: In the hadith transmitted by Yahya b. Sa'id on the authority of Qatada (the words are):(The believing servant) finds relief from the troubles of the world and its hardships and (gets into) the Mercy of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَعَى لِلنَّاسِ النَّجَاشِيَ فِي الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ فَخَرَجَ بِهِمْ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى وَكَبَّرَ أَرْبَعَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm na'aa lilnnaasi alnnajaashiya fiy alyawmi alladhiy maata fiyhi fakharaja bihim iilaa almusallaa wakabbara aarba'a takbiyraatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave the people news of the death of Negus on the day he died, and he took them out to the place of prayer and observed four takbirs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ، بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ نَعَى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّجَاشِيَ صَاحِبَ الْحَبَشَةِ فِي الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اسْتَغْفِرُوا لأَخِيكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَفَّ بِهِمْ بِالْمُصَلَّى فَصَلَّى فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylu, bnu khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, waaabiy, salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani aannahumaa haddathaahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala na'aa lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alnnajaashiya saahiba alhabashaai fiy alyawmi alladhiy maata fiyhi faqaala ‏ "‏ astaghfiruwa laakhiykum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin wahaddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi aanna aabaa hurayraaa haddathahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saffa bihim bialmusallaa fasallaa fakabbara 'alayhi aarba'a takbiyraatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave us the news of the death of Negus, the ruler of Abyssinia, on the day when he died, and he said (to us): Beg pardon for your brother. Ibn Shihab said that Sa'id b. Musayyib had told that Abu Huraira had narrated to him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) drew them up in a row in a place of prayer, and offered prayer and recited four takbirs for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، كَرِوَايَةِ عُقَيْلٍ بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wahasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaaluwa haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, kariwaayaai 'uqaylin bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ سَلِيمِ بْنِ حَيَّانٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مِينَاءَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, 'an saliymi bni hayyaanin, qaala haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu miynaa'a, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered prayer for Ashama, the Negus, and recited four takbirs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَاتَ الْيَوْمَ عَبْدٌ لِلَّهِ صَالِحٌ أَصْحَمَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ فَأَمَّنَا وَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maata alyawma 'abdun lillahi saalihun aashamaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama faaammanaa wasallaa 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There died today the pious servant of Allah, Ashama. So he stood up and led us in (funeral prayer) over him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ح . وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي، الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَخًا لَكُمْ قَدْ مَاتَ فَقُومُوا فَصَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُمْنَا فَصَفَّنَا صَفَّيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydin alghubariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabiri, bni 'abdi alllahi h . wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy, alzzubayri 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna aakhana lakum qad maata faquwmuwa fasalluwa 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqumnaa fasaffanaa saffayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A brother of yours has died, so stand up and offer prayer over him. So we stood up and drew ourselves up into two rows
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَخًا لَكُمْ قَدْ مَاتَ فَقُومُوا فَصَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي النَّجَاشِيَ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ زُهَيْرٍ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَخَاكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa, bnu aayyuwba haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy almuhallabi, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna aakhana lakum qad maata faquwmuwa fasalluwa 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'niy alnnajaashiya wafiy riwaayaai zuhayrin ‏"‏ iinna aakhaakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A brother of yours has died; so stand up and offer prayer for him, i. e. Negus. And in the hadith transmitted by Zubair (the words are):" Your brother
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ، إِدْرِيسَ عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى عَلَى قَبْرٍ بَعْدَ مَا دُفِنَ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعًا ‏.‏ قَالَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ فَقُلْتُ لِلشَّعْبِيِّ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ بِهَذَا قَالَ الثِّقَةُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏ هَذَا لَفْظُ حَدِيثِ حَسَنٍ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ قَالَ انْتَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى قَبْرٍ رَطْبٍ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَصَفُّوا خَلْفَهُ وَكَبَّرَ أَرْبَعًا ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَامِرٍ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ قَالَ الثِّقَةُ مَنْ شَهِدَهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanu bnu alrrabiy'i, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu, iidriysa 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'ani alshha'biyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa 'alaa qabrin ba'da maa dufina fakabbara 'alayhi aarba'ana ‏.‏ qaala alshhaybaaniyyu faqultu lilshha'biyyi man haddathaka bihadhaa qaala althhiqaau 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abbaasin ‏.‏ hadhaa lafzu hadiythi hasanin wafiy riwaayaai abni numayrin qaala antahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa qabrin ratbin fasallaa 'alayhi wasaffuwa khalfahu wakabbara aarba'ana ‏.‏ qultu li'aamirin man haddathaka qaala althhiqaau man shahidahu abnu 'abbaasin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sha'bi reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer over a grave after the dead was buried and he recited four takbirs over him. Shaibani said:I said to Sha'bi: Who narrated it to you? He said: An authentic one, 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas. This is the word of a hasan hadith. In the narration of Ibn Numair (the words are): The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went to the grave which had been newly prepared and prayed over it, and they also prayed who were behind him and he recited four takbirs. I said to 'Amir: Who narrated it to you? He said: An authentic one who saw him, i e. Ibn 'Abbas
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, h wahaddathanaa hasanu bnu alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, kullu hauulaa'i 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi walaysa fiy hadiythi aahadin minhum aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kabbara 'alayhi aarba'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters, but in one of them (these words are found):" The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) recited four takbirs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الرَّازِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الضُّرَيْسِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي صَلاَتِهِ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ ‏.‏ لَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ وَكَبَّرَ أَرْبَعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, jamiy'ana 'an wahbi bni jariyrin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw ghassaana, muhammadu bnu 'amrinw alrraaziyyu haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aldduraysi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu tahmaana, 'an aabiy hasiynin, kilaahumaa 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy salaatihi 'alaa alqabri nahwa hadiythi alshhaybaaniyyi ‏.‏ laysa fiy hadiythihim wakabbara aarba'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: The hadith as narrated by Shaibani has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَرْعَرَةَ السَّامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى عَلَى قَبْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muhammadi bni 'ar'araaa alssaamiyyu, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an habiybi bni alshhahiydi, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa 'alaa qabrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) observed prayer on the grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كَامِلٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَوْدَاءَ كَانَتْ تَقُمُّ الْمَسْجِدَ - أَوْ شَابًّا - فَفَقَدَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَ عَنْهَا - أَوْ عَنْهُ - فَقَالُوا مَاتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَلاَ كُنْتُمْ آذَنْتُمُونِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَأَنَّهُمْ صَغَّرُوا أَمْرَهَا - أَوْ أَمْرَهُ - فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دُلُّونِي عَلَى قَبْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَدَلُّوهُ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْقُبُورَ مَمْلُوءَةٌ ظُلْمَةً عَلَى أَهْلِهَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يُنَوِّرُهَا لَهُمْ بِصَلاَتِي عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, waaabuw kaamilin fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu - waalllafzu laabiy kaamilin - qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, - wahuwa abnu zaydin 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa aanna amraaaaan, sawdaa'a kaanat taqummu almasjida - aaw shaabbana - fafaqadahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaala 'anhaa - aaw 'anhu - faqaaluwa maata ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aafalaa kuntum adhantumuwniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakaaannahum saghharuwa aamrahaa - aaw aamrahu - faqaala ‏"‏ dulluwniy 'alaa qabrihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadalluwhu fasallaa 'alayhaa thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna hadhihi alqubuwra mamluw'aaun zulmaaan 'alaa aahlihaa waiinna alllaha 'azza wajalla yunawwiruhaa lahum bisalaatiy 'alayhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that a dark-complexioned woman (or a youth) used to sweep the mosque. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) missed her (or him) and inquired about her (or him). The people told him that she (or he) had died. He asked why they did not inform him, and it appears as if they had treated her (or him) or her (or his) affairs as of little account. He (the Holy Prophet) said:Lead me to her (or his) grave. They led him to that place and he said prayer over her (or him) and then remarked: Verily, these graves are full of darkness for their dwellers. Verily, the Mighty and Glorious Allah illuminates them for their occupants by reason of my prayer over them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، - وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى قَالَ كَانَ زَيْدٌ يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى جَنَائِزِنَا أَرْبَعًا وَإِنَّهُ كَبَّرَ عَلَى جَنَازَةٍ خَمْسًا فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُكَبِّرُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaaluwa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, - waqaala aabuw bakrin 'an shu'baaa, - 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni aabiy laylaa qaala kaana zaydun yukabbiru 'alaa janaaiizinaa aarba'ana waiinnahu kabbara 'alaa janaazaain khamsana fasaaaltuhu faqaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yukabbiruhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Laila that Zaid used to recite four takbirs on our funerals and he recited five takbirs on one funeral. I asked him the reason (for this variation), to which he replied:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited thus
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ الْجَنَازَةَ فَقُومُوا لَهَا حَتَّى تُخَلِّفَكُمْ أَوْ تُوضَعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, numayrin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aamiri bni rabiy'aaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa raaaytumu aljanaazaaa faquwmuwa lahaa hattaa tukhallifakum aaw tuwda'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Amir Ibn Rabi'a (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:Whenever you see a funeral procession, stand up for that until it moves away or is lowered on the ground
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمُ الْجَنَازَةَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَاشِيًا مَعَهَا فَلْيَقُمْ حَتَّى تُخَلِّفَهُ أَوْ تُوضَعَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تُخَلِّفَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, jamiy'ana 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi yuwnusa aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin haddathanaa laythun h wahaddathanaa abnu rumhin aakhbaranaa alllaythu 'an naafi'in 'ani abni 'umara 'an 'aamiri bni rabiy'aaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa raaaa aahadukumu aljanaazaaa faiin lam yakun maashiyana ma'ahaa falyaqum hattaa tukhallifahu aaw tuwda'a min qabli aan tukhallifahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of 'Amir ibn Rabi'a (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:Should any one of you come across a funeral procession, and if he does not intend to accompany it, he must stand up until it passes by him or is placed upon the ground before it passes him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ، ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمُ الْجَنَازَةَ فَلْيَقُمْ حِينَ يَرَاهَا حَتَّى تُخَلِّفَهُ إِذَا كَانَ غَيْرَ مُتَّبِعِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw kaamilin, haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniy ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, jamiy'ana 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi alllaythi bni sa'din ghayra aanna hadiytha, abni jurayjin qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa raaaa aahadukumu aljanaazaaa falyaqum hiyna yaraahaa hattaa tukhallifahu iidhaa kaana ghayra muttabi'ihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Ibn Juraij that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:Should anyone amongst you see a bier he must stand up so long as it is within sight in case he does not intend to follow it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا اتَّبَعْتُمْ جَنَازَةً فَلاَ تَجْلِسُوا حَتَّى تُوضَعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa attaba'tum janaazaaan falaa tajlisuwa hattaa tuwda'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:When you follow a bier, do not sit until it is placed on the (ground)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ، هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ الْجَنَازَةَ فَقُومُوا فَمَنْ تَبِعَهَا فَلاَ يَجْلِسْ حَتَّى تُوضَعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy surayju bnu yuwnusa, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an hishaamin alddastawaaiiyyi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu, hishaamin haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy, sa'iydin alkhudriyyi aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa raaaytumu aljanaazaaa faquwmuwa faman tabi'ahaa falaa yajlis hattaa tuwda'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:Whenever you come across a bier you should stand up, and he who follows it should not sit down till it is placed on the ground
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ مَرَّتْ جَنَازَةٌ فَقَامَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقُمْنَا مَعَهُ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا يَهُودِيَّةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَوْتَ فَزَعٌ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ الْجَنَازَةَ فَقُومُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy surayju bnu yuwnusa, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an hishaamin alddastawaaiiyyi, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni miqsamin, 'an jaabiri, bni 'abdi alllahi qaala marrat janaazaaun faqaama lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqumnaa ma'ahu faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnahaa yahuwdiyyaaun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna almawta faza'un faiidhaa raaaytumu aljanaazaaa faquwmuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Jabir ibn 'Abdullah:There passed a bier and the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up for it and we also stood up along with him. We said: Messenger of Allah, that was the bier of a Jewess. Upon this he remarked: Verily, death is a matter of consternation, so whenever you come across a bier stand up
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِجَنَازَةٍ مَرَّتْ بِهِ حَتَّى تَوَارَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabirana, yaquwlu qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lijanaazaain marrat bihi hattaa tawaarat ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Juraij told me that Abu Zubair heard Jabir say that the Prophet (ﷺ) kept standing for a bier until it disappeared
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَيْضًا أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ لِجَنَازَةِ يَهُودِيٍّ حَتَّى تَوَارَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri aaydana aannahu sami'a jaabirana, yaquwlu qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabuhu lijanaazaai yahuwdiyyin hattaa tawaarat ‏.‏
verses.translation: Again Abu Zubair heard Jabir say that the Prophet (ﷺ) and his Companions kept standing for a bier of a Jew until it disappeared from sight
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، أَنَّ قَيْسَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، وَسَهْلَ بْنَ حُنَيْفٍ، كَانَا بِالْقَادِسِيَّةِ فَمَرَّتْ بِهِمَا جَنَازَةٌ فَقَامَا فَقِيلَ لَهُمَا إِنَّهَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏ فَقَالاَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّتْ بِهِ جَنَازَةٌ فَقَامَ فَقِيلَ إِنَّهُ يَهُودِيٌّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلَيْسَتْ نَفْسًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِيهِ فَقَالاَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَرَّتْ عَلَيْنَا جَنَازَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, aanna qaysa bna sa'din, wasahla bna hunayfin, kaanaa bialqaadisiyyaai famarrat bihimaa janaazaaun faqaamaa faqiyla lahumaa iinnahaa min aahli alaardi ‏.‏ faqaalaa iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marrat bihi janaazaaun faqaama faqiyla iinnahu yahuwdiyyun ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ aalaysat nafsana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an shaybaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiyhi faqaalaa kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm famarrat 'alaynaa janaazaaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Ibn Abu Laila that while Qais b. Sa'd and Sahl b. Hunaif were both in Qadislyya a bier passed by them and they both stood up. They were told that it was the bier of one of the people of the land (non-Muslim). They said that a bier passed before the Prophet (ﷺ) and he stood up. He was told that he (the dead man) was a Jew. Upon this he remarked:Was he not a human being or did he not have a soul? And in the hadith narrated by 'Amr b. Murra with the same chain of transmitters, (the words) are:" There passed a bier before us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ رَآنِي نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ وَنَحْنُ فِي جَنَازَةٍ قَائِمًا وَقَدْ جَلَسَ يَنْتَظِرُ أَنْ تُوضَعَ الْجَنَازَةُ فَقَالَ لِي مَا يُقِيمُكَ فَقُلْتُ أَنْتَظِرُ أَنْ تُوضَعَ الْجَنَازَةُ لِمَا يُحَدِّثُ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَافِعٌ فَإِنَّ مَسْعُودَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنِي عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَعَدَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an waaqidi bni 'amriw bni sa'di bni mu'aadhin, aannahu qaala raaniy naafi'u bnu jubayrin wanahnu fiy janaazaain qaaiimana waqad jalasa yantaziru aan tuwda'a aljanaazaau faqaala liy maa yuqiymuka faqultu aantaziru aan tuwda'a aljanaazaau limaa yuhaddithu aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu ‏.‏ faqaala naafi'un faiinna mas'uwda bna alhakami haddathaniy 'an 'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin aannahu qaala qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qa'ada ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Waqid:Nafi' b. Jubair saw me and we were standing for a bier, while he was sitting and waiting for the bier to be placed on the ground. He said to me: What makes you keep standing? I said: I am waiting that the bier may be placed on the ground (and I am doing that) on the hadith narrated to me by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. Upon this Nafi' said: Verily, Mas'ud b. Hakam reported to me on the authority of Hadrat 'Ali b. Abu Talib that the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up first (for a bier) and then sat down
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، - قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي وَاقِدُ، بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ أَنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ مَسْعُودَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ الأَنْصَارِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، يَقُولُ فِي شَأْنِ الْجَنَائِزِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ ثُمَّ قَعَدَ ‏.‏ وَإِنَّمَا حَدَّثَ بِذَلِكَ لأَنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ رَأَى وَاقِدَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو قَامَ حَتَّى وُضِعَتِ الْجَنَازَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'ani althhaqafiyyi, - qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - qaala sami'tu yahyaa bna sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy waaqidu, bnu 'amriw bni sa'di bni mu'aadhin alaansaariyyu aanna naafi'a bna jubayrin, aakhbarahu aanna mas'uwda bna alhakami alaansaariyya aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin, yaquwlu fiy shaani aljanaaiizi iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama thumma qa'ada ‏.‏ waiinnamaa haddatha bidhalika laanna naafi'a bna jubayrin raaaa waaqida bna 'amrinw qaama hattaa wudi'ati aljanaazaau ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mas'ud b. al-Hakam al-Ansari informed Nafi' that he had heard Hadrat 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him), son of Abu Talib, say about the biers:Verily, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to stand first but later on kept sitting; but it is also narrated that Nafi' ibn Jubair saw Waqid b. 'Amr standing for a bier till it was placed down
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Yahya b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَسْعُودَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ رَأَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ فَقُمْنَا وَقَعَدَ فَقَعَدْنَا ‏.‏ يَعْنِي فِي الْجَنَازَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi, bni almunkadiri qaala sami'tu mas'uwda bna alhakami, yuhaddithu 'an 'aliyyin, qaala raaaynaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama faqumnaa waqa'ada faqa'adnaa ‏.‏ ya'niy fiy aljanaazaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. Munkadir that he said:I heard from Mas'ud b. al-Hakam who narrated it on the authority of Hadrat 'Ali that he said: We saw the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up for a (bier) and we also stood up; he sat down and we too sat down
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَوْفَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى جَنَازَةٍ فَحَفِظْتُ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلاً خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ أَوْ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَنَا ذَلِكَ الْمَيِّتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَيْضًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy mu'aawiyaau bnu saalihin, 'an habiybi bni 'ubaydin, 'an jubayri bni nufayrin, sami'ahu yaquwlu sami'tu 'awfa bna maalikin, yaquwlu sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa janaazaain fahafiztu min du'aaiihi wahuwa yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma aghfir lahu waarhamhu wa'aafihi waa'fu 'anhu waaakrim nuzulahu wawassi' mudkhalahu waaghsilhu bialmaa'i waalthhalji waalbaradi wanaqqihi mina alkhataayaa kamaa naqqayta althhawba alaabyada mina alddanasi waaabdilhu daarana khayrana min daarihi waaahlaan khayrana min aahlihi wazawjana khayrana min zawjihi waaadkhilhu aljannaaa waaa'idhhu min 'adhaabi alqabri aaw min 'adhaabi alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala hattaa tamannaytu aan aakuwna aanaa dhalika almayyita ‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu jubayrin haddathahu 'an aabiyhi 'an 'awfi bni maalikin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadhaa alhadiythi aaydana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jubair b. Nufair says:I heard it from 'Auf b. Malik that the Prophet (ﷺ) said prayer on the dead body, and I remembered his prayer:" O Allah! forgive him, have mercy upon him, give him peace and absolve him. Receive him with honour and make his grave spacious; wash him with water, snow and hail. Cleanse him from faults as Thou wouldst cleanse a white garment from impurity. Requite him with an abode more excellent than his abode, with a family better than his family, and with a mate better than his mate. Admit him to the Garden, and protect him from the torment of the grave and the torment of the Fire." ('Auf bin Malik) said: I earnestly desired that I were this dead body
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ، صَالِحٍ بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu, saalihin bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi abni wahbin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ، ذَكْوَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَلَّى عَلَى أُمِّ كَعْبٍ مَاتَتْ وَهِيَ نُفَسَاءُ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهَا وَسَطَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu sa'iydin, 'an husayni bni, dhakwaana qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu buraydaaa, 'an samuraaa bni jundabin, qaala sallaytu khalfa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasallaa 'alaa aummi ka'bin maatat wahiya nufasaa'u faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lilssalaaai 'alayhaa wasatahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Samura b. Jundub said:I prayed behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he prayed for a woman who had died in the state of delivery. He stood in front of her waist
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، وَالْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرُوا أُمَّ كَعْبٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, wayaziydu bnu haaruwna, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, aakhbaranaa abnu almubaaraki, waalfadlu bnu muwsaa, kulluhum 'an husaynin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkuruwa aumma ka'bin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Husain with the same chain of transmitters, but no mention is made of Umm Ka'b
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ سَمُرَةُ بْنُ جُنْدُبٍ لَقَدْ كُنْتُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُلاَمًا فَكُنْتُ أَحْفَظُ عَنْهُ فَمَا يَمْنَعُنِي مِنَ الْقَوْلِ إِلاَّ أَنَّ هَا هُنَا رِجَالاً هُمْ أَسَنُّ مِنِّي وَقَدْ صَلَّيْتُ وَرَاءَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ مَاتَتْ فِي نِفَاسِهَا فَقَامَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَسَطَهَا ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ الْمُثَنَّى قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ قَالَ فَقَامَ عَلَيْهَا لِلصَّلاَةِ وَسَطَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wa'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an husaynin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni buraydaaa, qaala qaala samuraau bnu jundubin laqad kuntu 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghulaamana fakuntu aahfazu 'anhu famaa yamna'uniy mina alqawli iilaaa aanna haa hunaa rijaalaan hum aasannu minniy waqad sallaytu waraa'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa amraaaain maatat fiy nifaasihaa faqaama 'alayhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssalaaai wasatahaa ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni almuthannaa qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu buraydaaa qaala faqaama 'alayhaa lilssalaaai wasatahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Samura b. Jundub said:I was a young boy during the time of the Prophet (ﷺ) and I retained in my mind (what I learnt from him), and nothing restrained me from speaking except the fact that there were persons far more advanced in age than I. Verily, I said prayer behind the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) over a woman who had died in the state of delivery, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up to say prayer in front of the middle part of her body. And in the tradition narrated on the authority of Ibn Muthanna the words are:" (The Holy Prophet) stood in the middle part of her body for offering prayer for her
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ، سَمُرَةَ قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِفَرَسٍ مُعْرَوْرًى فَرَكِبَهُ حِينَ انْصَرَفَ مِنْ جَنَازَةِ ابْنِ الدَّحْدَاحِ وَنَحْنُ نَمْشِي حَوْلَهُ ‏.‏
