verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa waqaala, yahyaa aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'an maaliki bni mighwalin, 'an simaaki bni harbin, 'an jaabiri bni, samuraaa qaala autiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bifarasin mu'rawrana farakibahu hiyna ansarafa min janaazaai abni alddahdaahi wanahnu namshiy hawlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Jabir ibn Samura that an unsaddled horse was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he rode on it when he returned after having offered the funeral prayer of Ibn Dahdah and we walked on foot around him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى ابْنِ الدَّحْدَاحِ ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِفَرَسٍ عُرْىٍ فَعَقَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَرَكِبَهُ فَجَعَلَ يَتَوَقَّصُ بِهِ وَنَحْنُ نَتَّبِعُهُ نَسْعَى خَلْفَهُ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ كَمْ مِنْ عِذْقٍ مُعَلَّقٍ - أَوْ مُدَلًّى - فِي الْجَنَّةِ لاِبْنِ الدَّحْدَاحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ ‏"‏ لأَبِي الدَّحْدَاحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaaki bni harbin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa abni alddahdaahi thumma autiya bifarasin 'urain fa'aqalahu rajulun farakibahu faja'ala yatawaqqasu bihi wanahnu nattabi'uhu nas'aa khalfahu - qaala - faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ kam min 'idhqin mu'allaqin - aaw mudallana - fiy aljannaai laibni alddahdaahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw qaala shu'baau ‏"‏ laabiy alddahdaahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir ibn Samura reported that the Prophet (ﷺ) said (funeral) prayer on Ibn Dahdah:then an unsaddled horse was brought to him and a person hobbled it, and he (the Messenger of Allah) rode upon it and it bounded and we followed it and ran after it. One of the people said that the Prophet (ﷺ) remarked: How many among hanging bunches in the Paradise are meant for Ibn Dahdah?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمِسْوَرِيُّ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ، مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي هَلَكَ فِيهِ الْحَدُوا لِي لَحْدًا وَانْصِبُوا عَلَىَّ اللَّبِنَ نَصْبًا كَمَا صُنِعَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin almiswariyyu, 'an iismaa'iyla bni, muhammadi bni sa'din 'an 'aamiri bni sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, aanna sa'da bna aabiy waqqaasin, qaala fiy maradihi alladhiy halaka fiyhi alhaduwa liy lahdana waansibuwa 'alaaaa alllabina nasbana kamaa suni'a birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas told that Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas said during his illness of which he died:" Make a niche for me in the side of the grave and set up bricks over me as was done in case of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، وَوَكِيعٌ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَمْرَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ جُعِلَ فِي قَبْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَطِيفَةٌ حَمْرَاءُ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ أَبُو جَمْرَةَ اسْمُهُ نَصْرُ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ وَأَبُو التَّيَّاحِ اسْمُهُ يَزِيدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ مَاتَا بِسَرَخْسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, wawakiy'un, jamiy'ana 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, bnu sa'iydin haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa aabuw jamraaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala ju'ila fiy qabri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qatiyfaaun hamraa'u ‏.‏ qaala muslimun aabuw jamraaa asmuhu nasru bnu 'imraana waaabuw alttayyaahi asmuhu yaziydu bnu humaydin maataa bisarakhsa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas said that a piece of red stuff was put in the grave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، - فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي الطَّاهِرِ - أَنَّ أَبَا عَلِيٍّ الْهَمْدَانِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ - وَفِي، رِوَايَةِ هَارُونَ - أَنَّ ثُمَامَةَ بْنَ، شُفَىٍّ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ بِأَرْضِ الرُّومِ بِرُودِسَ فَتُوُفِّيَ صَاحِبٌ لَنَا فَأَمَرَ فَضَالَةُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ بِقَبْرِهِ فَسُوِّيَ ثُمَّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُ بِتَسْوِيَتِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amrinw haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, - fiy riwaayaai aabiy alttaahiri - aanna aabaa 'aliyyin alhamdaaniyya, haddathahu - wafiy, riwaayaai haaruwna - aanna thumaamaaa bna, shufaaain haddathahu qaala kunnaa ma'a fadaalaaa bni 'ubaydin biaardi alrruwmi biruwdisa fatuwuffiya saahibun lanaa faaamara fadaalaau bnu 'ubaydin biqabrihi fasuwwiya thumma qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamuru bitaswiyatihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thumama b. Shafayy reported:When we were with Fadala b. 'Ubaid in the country of the Romans at a place (known as) Rudis, a friend of ours died. Fadala b. 'Ubaid ordered to prepare a grave for him and then it was levelled; and then he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanding (us) to level the grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، الْهَيَّاجِ الأَسَدِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ لِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَلاَّ أَبْعَثُكَ عَلَى مَا بَعَثَنِي عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ لاَ تَدَعَ تِمْثَالاً إِلاَّ طَمَسْتَهُ وَلاَ قَبْرًا مُشْرِفًا إِلاَّ سَوَّيْتَهُ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي حَبِيبٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ وَلاَ صُورَةً إِلاَّ طَمَسْتَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an habiybi bni aabiy thaabitin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy, alhayyaaji alaasadiyyi qaala qaala liy 'aliyyu bnu aabiy taalibin aalaaa aab'athuka 'alaa maa ba'athaniy 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan laa tada'a timthaalaan iilaaa tamastahu walaa qabrana mushrifana iilaaa sawwaytahu ‏.‏ wahaddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu khalaaadin albaahiliyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathaniy habiybun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala walaa suwraaan iilaaa tamastahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu'l-Hayyaj al-Asadi told that 'Ali (b. Abu Talib) said to him:Should I not send you on the same mission as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me? Do not leave an image without obliterating it, or a high grave without levelling It. This hadith has been reported by Habib with the same chain of transmitters and he said: (Do not leave) a picture without obliterating it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُجَصَّصَ الْقَبْرُ وَأَنْ يُقْعَدَ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْ يُبْنَى عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an aabiy, alzzubayri 'an jaabirin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yujassasa alqabru waaan yuq'ada 'alayhi waaan yubnaa 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir said:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that the graves should be plastered or they be used as sitting places (for the people), or a building should be built over them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, jamiy'ana 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi, alllahi yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نُهِيَ عَنْ تَقْصِيصِ الْقُبُورِ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala nuhiya 'an taqsiysi alqubuwri, ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir said that he was forbidden to plaster graves
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لأَنْ يَجْلِسَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى جَمْرَةٍ فَتُحْرِقَ ثِيَابَهُ فَتَخْلُصَ إِلَى جِلْدِهِ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ عَلَى قَبْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laan yajlisa aahadukum 'alaa jamraain fatuhriqa thiyaabahu fatakhlusa iilaa jildihi khayrun lahu min aan yajlisa 'alaa qabrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It is better that one of you should sit on live coals which would burn his clothing and come in contact with his skin than that he should sit on a grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَمْرٌو، النَّاقِدُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya h wahaddathaniyhi 'amrunw, alnnaaqidu haddathanaa aabuw aahmada alzzubayriyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'an suhaylin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated by Suhail with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ بُسْرِ، بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَرْثَدٍ الْغَنَوِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَجْلِسُوا عَلَى الْقُبُورِ وَلاَ تُصَلُّوا إِلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'ani abni jaabirin, 'an busri, bni 'ubaydi alllahi 'an waathilaaa, 'an aabiy marthadin alghanawiyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tajlisuwa 'alaa alqubuwri walaa tusalluwa iilayhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Marthad al-Ghanawi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not sit on the graves and do not pray facing towards them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ الْبَجَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الأَسْقَعِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَرْثَدٍ الْغَنَوِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُصَلُّوا إِلَى الْقُبُورِ وَلاَ تَجْلِسُوا عَلَيْهَا‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa hasanu bnu alrrabiy'i albajaliyyu, haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, 'an busri bni 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an aabiy iidriysa alkhawlaaniyyi, 'an waathilaaa bni alaasqa'i, 'an aabiy marthadin alghanawiyyi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tusalluwa iilaa alqubuwri walaa tajlisuwa 'alayhaa‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Marthad al-Ghanawi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not pray facing towards the graves, and do not sit on them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - قَالَ عَلِيٌّ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَمَرَتْ أَنْ يُمَرَّ، بِجَنَازَةِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَتُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَأَنْكَرَ النَّاسُ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَتْ مَا أَسْرَعَ مَا نَسِيَ النَّاسُ مَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى سُهَيْلِ ابْنِ الْبَيْضَاءِ إِلاَّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, - waalllafzu liishaaqa - qaala 'aliyyun haddathanaa waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, 'an 'abdi alwaahidi bni hamzaaa, 'an 'abbaadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, aamarat aan yumarra, bijanaazaai sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin fiy almasjidi fatusalliya 'alayhi faaankara alnnaasu dhalika 'alayhaa faqaalat maa aasra'a maa nasiya alnnaasu maa sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa suhayli abni albaydaa'i iilaaa fiy almasjidi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abbad b. 'Abdullah b. Zubair reported that 'A'isha ordered the bier of Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas to be brought into the mosque so that she should pray for him. The people disapproved this (act) of hers. She said:How soon the people have forgotten that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered not the funeral prayer of Suhail b al-Baida' but in a mosque
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ أَرْسَلَ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَمُرُّوا بِجَنَازَتِهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَيُصَلِّينَ عَلَيْهِ فَفَعَلُوا فَوُقِفَ بِهِ عَلَى حُجَرِهِنَّ يُصَلِّينَ عَلَيْهِ أُخْرِجَ بِهِ مِنْ بَابِ الْجَنَائِزِ الَّذِي كَانَ إِلَى الْمَقَاعِدِ فَبَلَغَهُنَّ أَنَّ النَّاسَ عَابُوا ذَلِكَ وَقَالُوا مَا كَانَتِ الْجَنَائِزُ يُدْخَلُ بِهَا الْمَسْجِدَ ‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ مَا أَسْرَعَ النَّاسَ إِلَى أَنْ يَعِيبُوا مَا لاَ عِلْمَ لَهُمْ بِهِ ‏.‏ عَابُوا عَلَيْنَا أَنْ يُمَرَّ بِجَنَازَةٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَمَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى سُهَيْلِ ابْنِ بَيْضَاءَ إِلاَّ فِي جَوْفِ الْمَسْجِدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an 'abdi alwaahidi, 'an 'abbaadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, yuhaddithu 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa lammaa tuwuffiya sa'du bnu aabiy waqqaasin aarsala aazwaaju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yamurruwa bijanaazatihi fiy almasjidi fayusalliyna 'alayhi fafa'aluwa fawuqifa bihi 'alaa hujarihinna yusalliyna 'alayhi aukhrija bihi min baabi aljanaaiizi alladhiy kaana iilaa almaqaa'idi fabalaghahunna aanna alnnaasa 'aabuwa dhalika waqaaluwa maa kaanati aljanaaiizu yudkhalu bihaa almasjida ‏.‏ fabalagha dhalika 'aaiishaaa faqaalat maa aasra'a alnnaasa iilaa aan ya'iybuwa maa laa 'ilma lahum bihi ‏.‏ 'aabuwa 'alaynaa aan yumarra bijanaazaain fiy almasjidi wamaa sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa suhayli abni baydaa'a iilaaa fiy jawfi almasjidi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abbad b. 'Abdullah b. Zubair reported on the authority of 'A'isha that when Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas died, the wives of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent message to bring his bier into the mosque so that they should offer prayer for him. They (the participants of the funeral) did accordingly, and it was placed in front of their apartments and they offered prayer for him. It was brought out of the door (known as) Bab al-Jana'iz which was towards the side of Maqa'id, and the news reached them (the wives of the Holy Prophet) that the people bad criticised this (i. e. offering of funeral prayer in the mosque) saying that it was not desirable to take the bier inside the mosque. This was conveyed to 'A'isha. She said:How hastily the people criticise that about which they know little. They criticise us for carrying the bier in the mosque. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered not the funeral prayer of Suhail b. Baida' but in the innermost part of the mosque
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَتِ ادْخُلُوا بِهِ الْمَسْجِدَ حَتَّى أُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَأُنْكِرَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى ابْنَىْ بَيْضَاءَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ سُهَيْلٍ وَأَخِيهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ سُهَيْلُ بْنُ دَعْدٍ وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْبَيْضَاءِ أُمُّهُ بَيْضَاءُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, - ya'niy abna 'uthmaana - 'an aabiy alnnadri, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni, 'abdi alrrahmani aanna 'aaiishaaa, lammaa tuwuffiya sa'du bnu aabiy waqqaasin qaalati adkhuluwa bihi almasjida hattaa ausalliya 'alayhi ‏.‏ faaunkira dhalika 'alayhaa faqaalat waalllahi laqad sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa abnaa baydaa'a fiy almasjidi suhaylin waaakhiyhi ‏.‏ qaala muslimun suhaylu bnu da'din wahuwa abnu albaydaa'i aummuhu baydaa'u ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman reported on the authority ot 'A'isha that when Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas died she said:Bring it (the bier) into the mosque so that I offer prayer for him. But, this act of hers was disapproved. She said: By Allah, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) offered prayer in the mosque for the two sons of Baida', viz, for Suhail and his brother
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي نَمِرٍ - عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - كُلَّمَا كَانَ لَيْلَتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - يَخْرُجُ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَتَاكُمْ مَا تُوعَدُونَ غَدًا مُؤَجَّلُونَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لأَهْلِ بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يُقِمْ قُتَيْبَةُ قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ وَأَتَاكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an shariykin, - wahuwa abnu aabiy namirin - 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - kullamaa kaana laylatuhaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - yakhruju min akhiri alllayli iilaa albaqiy'i fayaquwlu ‏"‏ alssalaamu 'alaykum daara qawmin muuminiyna waaataakum maa tuw'aduwna ghadana muuajjaluwna waiinnaa iin shaa'a alllahu bikum laahiquwna alllahumma aghfir laahli baqiy'i algharqadi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yuqim qutaybaau qawlahu ‏"‏ waaataakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported (that whenever it was her turn for Allah's Messenger [may peace be upon him] to spend the night with her) he would go out towards the end of the night to al-Baqi' and say:Peace be upon you, abode of a people who are believers. What you were promised would come to you tomorrow, you receiving it after some delay; and God willing we shall join you. O Allah, grant forgiveness to the inhabitants of Baqi' al-Gharqad. Qutaiba did not mention his words:" would come to you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، تُحَدِّثُ فَقَالَتْ أَلاَ أُحَدِّثُكُمْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَنِّي ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى ح. وَحَدَّثَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ حَجَّاجًا الأَعْوَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، - رَجُلٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، بْنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَوْمًا أَلاَ أُحَدِّثُكُمْ عَنِّي وَعَنْ أُمِّي قَالَ فَظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ يُرِيدُ أُمَّهُ الَّتِي وَلَدَتْهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَلاَ أُحَدِّثُكُمْ عَنِّي وَعَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَتْ لَمَّا كَانَتْ لَيْلَتِيَ الَّتِي كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا عِنْدِي انْقَلَبَ فَوَضَعَ رِدَاءَهُ وَخَلَعَ نَعْلَيْهِ فَوَضَعَهُمَا عِنْدَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَبَسَطَ طَرَفَ إِزَارِهِ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَاضْطَجَعَ فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ إِلاَّ رَيْثَمَا ظَنَّ أَنْ قَدْ رَقَدْتُ فَأَخَذَ رِدَاءَهُ رُوَيْدًا وَانْتَعَلَ رُوَيْدًا وَفَتَحَ الْبَابَ فَخَرَجَ ثُمَّ أَجَافَهُ رُوَيْدًا فَجَعَلْتُ دِرْعِي فِي رَأْسِي وَاخْتَمَرْتُ وَتَقَنَّعْتُ إِزَارِي ثُمَّ انْطَلَقْتُ عَلَى إِثْرِهِ حَتَّى جَاءَ الْبَقِيعَ فَقَامَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ انْحَرَفَ فَانْحَرَفْتُ فَأَسْرَعَ فَأَسْرَعْتُ فَهَرْوَلَ فَهَرْوَلْتُ فَأَحْضَرَ فَأَحْضَرْتُ فَسَبَقْتُهُ فَدَخَلْتُ فَلَيْسَ إِلاَّ أَنِ اضْطَجَعْتُ فَدَخَلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكِ يَا عَائِشُ حَشْيَا رَابِيَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ لاَ شَىْءَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَتُخْبِرِينِي أَوْ لَيُخْبِرَنِّي اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَنْتِ السَّوَادُ الَّذِي رَأَيْتُ أَمَامِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَلَهَدَنِي فِي صَدْرِي لَهْدَةً أَوْجَعَتْنِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَظَنَنْتِ أَنْ يَحِيفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكِ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ مَهْمَا يَكْتُمِ النَّاسُ يَعْلَمْهُ اللَّهُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ أَتَانِي حِينَ رَأَيْتِ فَنَادَانِي فَأَخْفَاهُ مِنْكِ فَأَجَبْتُهُ فَأَخْفَيْتُهُ مِنْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْكِ وَقَدْ وَضَعْتِ ثِيَابَكِ وَظَنَنْتُ أَنْ قَدْ رَقَدْتِ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُوقِظَكِ وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ تَسْتَوْحِشِي فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ أَهْلَ الْبَقِيعِ فَتَسْتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ أَقُولُ لَهُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُولِي السَّلاَمُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَلاَحِقُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni kathiyri bni almuttalibi, aannahu sami'a muhammada bna qaysin, yaquwlu sami'tu 'aaiishaaa, tuhaddithu faqaalat aalaa auhaddithukum 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'anniy ‏.‏ qulnaa balaa h. wahaddathaniy man, sami'a hajjaajana alaa'wara, - waalllafzu lahu - qaala haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi, - rajulun min qurayshin - 'an muhammadi bni qaysi bni makhramaaa, bni almuttalibi aannahu qaala yawmana aalaa auhaddithukum 'anniy wa'an aummiy qaala fazanannaa aannahu yuriydu aummahu allatiy waladathu ‏.‏ qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau aalaa auhaddithukum 'anniy wa'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qulnaa balaa ‏.‏ qaala qaalat lammaa kaanat laylatiya allatiy kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhaa 'indiy anqalaba fawada'a ridaa'ahu wakhala'a na'layhi fawada'ahumaa 'inda rijlayhi wabasata tarafa iizaarihi 'alaa firaashihi faadtaja'a falam yalbath iilaaa raythamaa zanna aan qad raqadtu faaakhadha ridaa'ahu ruwaydana waanta'ala ruwaydana wafataha albaaba fakharaja thumma aajaafahu ruwaydana faja'altu dir'iy fiy raasiy waakhtamartu wataqanna'tu iizaariy thumma antalaqtu 'alaa iithrihi hattaa jaa'a albaqiy'a faqaama faaataala alqiyaama thumma rafa'a yadayhi thalaatha marraatin thumma anharafa faanharaftu faaasra'a faaasra'tu faharwala faharwaltu faaahdara faaahdartu fasabaqtuhu fadakhaltu falaysa iilaaa aani adtaja'tu fadakhala faqaala ‏"‏ maa laki yaa 'aaiishu hashyaa raabiyaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat qultu laa shaa'a ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ latukhbiriyniy aaw layukhbiranniy alllatiyfu alkhabiyru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi biaabiy aanta waaummiy ‏.‏ faaakhbartuhu qaala ‏"‏ faaanti alssawaadu alladhiy raaaytu aamaamiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu na'am ‏.‏ falahadaniy fiy sadriy lahdaaan aawja'atniy thumma qaala ‏"‏ aazananti aan yahiyfa alllahu 'alayki warasuwluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat mahmaa yaktumi alnnaasu ya'lamhu alllahu na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinna jibriyla aataaniy hiyna raaayti fanaadaaniy faaakhfaahu minki faaajabtuhu faaakhfaytuhu minki walam yakun yadkhulu 'alayki waqad wada'ti thiyaabaki wazanantu aan qad raqadti fakarihtu aan auwqizaki wakhashiytu aan tastawhishiy faqaala iinna rabbaka yaamuruka aan taatiya aahla albaqiy'i fatastaghfira lahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat qultu kayfa aaquwlu lahum yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ quwliy alssalaamu 'alaa aahli alddiyaari mina almuuminiyna waalmuslimiyna wayarhamu alllahu almustaqdimiyna minnaa waalmustaakhiriyna waiinnaa iin shaa'a alllahu bikum lalaahiquwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Qais said (to the people):Should I not narrate to you (a hadith of the Holy Prophet) on my authority and on the authority of my mother? We thought that he meant the mother who had given him birth. He (Muhammad b. Qais) then reported that it was 'A'isha who had narrated this: Should I not narrate to you about myself and about the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? We said: Yes. She said: When it was my turn for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to spend the night with me, he turned his side, put on his mantle and took off his shoes and placed them near his feet, and spread the corner of his shawl on his bed and then lay down till he thought that I had gone to sleep. He took hold of his mantle slowly and put on the shoes slowly, and opened the door and went out and then closed it lightly. I covered my head, put on my veil and tightened my waist wrapper, and then went out following his steps till he reached Baqi'. He stood there and he stood for a long time. He then lifted his hands three times, and then returned and I also returned. He hastened his steps and I also hastened my steps. He ran and I too ran. He came (to the house) and I also came (to the house). I, however, preceded him and I entered (the house), and as I lay down in the bed, he (the Holy Prophet) entered the (house), and said: Why is it, O 'A'isha, that you are out of breath? I said: There is nothing. He said: Tell me or the Subtle and the Aware would inform me. I said: Messenger of Allah, may my father and mother be ransom for you, and then I told him (the whole story). He said: Was it the darkness (of your shadow) that I saw in front of me? I said: Yes. He gave me a nudge on the chest which I felt, and then said: Did you think that Allah and His Apostle would deal unjustly with you? She said: Whatsoever the people conceal, Allah will know it. He said: Gabriel came to me when you saw me. He called me and he concealed it from you. I responded to his call, but I too concealed it from you (for he did not come to you), as you were not fully dressed. I thought that you had gone to sleep, and I did not like to awaken you, fearing that you may be frightened. He (Gabriel) said: Your Lord has commanded you to go to the inhabitants of Baqi' (to those lying in the graves) and beg pardon for them. I said: Messenger of Allah, how should I pray for them (How should I beg forgiveness for them)? He said: Say, Peace be upon the inhabitants of this city (graveyard) from among the Believers and the Muslims, and may Allah have mercy on those who have gone ahead of us, and those who come later on, and we shall, God willing, join you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، الأَسَدِيُّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُهُمْ إِذَا خَرَجُوا إِلَى الْمَقَابِرِ فَكَانَ قَائِلُهُمْ يَقُولُ - فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ - السَّلاَمُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدِّيَارِ - وَفِي رِوَايَةِ زُهَيْرٍ - السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَلَاحِقُونَ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمْ الْعَافِيَةَ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu 'abdi allaahi, alaasadiyuu 'an sufyaana, 'an 'alqamaaa bni marthadin, 'an sulaymaana bni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'aliimuhum iidhaa kharajuwa iilaa almaqaabiri fakaana qaaiiluhum yaquwlu - fiy riwaayaai aabiy bakrin - alsaalaamu 'alaa aahli aldiiyaari - wafiy riwaayaai zuhayrin - alsaalaamu 'alaykum aahla aldiiyaari mina almuuminiyna waalmuslimiyna waiinaaa iin shaa'a allaahu lalaahiquwna aasaalu allaaha lanaa walakum al'aafiyaaa
verses.translation: Sulaiman b. Buraida narrated on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach them when they went out to the graveyard. One of the narrators used to say this in the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr:" Peace be upon the inhabitants of the city (i. e. graveyard)." In the hadith transmitted by Zuhair (the words are):" Peace be upon you, the inhabitants of the city, among the believers, and Muslims, and God willing we shall join you. I beg of Allah peace for us and for you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ كَيْسَانَ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَبِّي أَنْ أَسْتَغْفِرَ لأُمِّي فَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لِي وَاسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ أَنْ أَزُورَ قَبْرَهَا فَأَذِنَ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, wamuhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaalaa haddathanaa marwaanu, bnu mu'aawiyaaa 'an yaziyda, - ya'niy abna kaysaana - 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ astaadhantu rabbiy aan aastaghfira laummiy falam yaadhan liy waastaadhantuhu aan aazuwra qabrahaa faaadhina liy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger, (ﷺ) as saying:I sought permission to beg forgiveness for my mother, but He did not grant it to me. I sought permission from Him to visit her grave, and He granted it (permission) to me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ زَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْرَ أُمِّهِ فَبَكَى وَأَبْكَى مَنْ حَوْلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَبِّي فِي أَنْ أَسْتَغْفِرَ لَهَا فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لِي وَاسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ فِي أَنْ أَزُورَ قَبْرَهَا فَأُذِنَ لِي فَزُورُوا الْقُبُورَ فَإِنَّهَا تُذَكِّرُ الْمَوْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydin, 'an yaziyda bni kaysaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala zaara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qabra aummihi fabakaa waaabkaa man hawlahu faqaala ‏ "‏ astaadhantu rabbiy fiy aan aastaghfira lahaa falam yuudhan liy waastaadhantuhu fiy aan aazuwra qabrahaa faaudhina liy fazuwruwa alqubuwra faiinnahaa tudhakkiru almawta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) visited the grave of his mother and he wept, and moved others around him to tears, and said: I sought permission from my Lord to beg forgiveness for her but it was not granted to me, and I sought permission to visit her grave and it was granted to me so visit the graves, for that makes you mindful of death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، - وَهُوَ ضِرَارُ بْنُ مُرَّةَ - عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ فَزُورُوهَا وَنَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الأَضَاحِيِّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ فَأَمْسِكُوا مَا بَدَا لَكُمْ وَنَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنِ النَّبِيذِ إِلاَّ فِي سِقَاءٍ فَاشْرَبُوا فِي الأَسْقِيَةِ كُلِّهَا وَلاَ تَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin waabni numayrin - qaaluwa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'an aabiy sinaanin, - wahuwa diraaru bnu murraaa - 'an muhaaribi bni dithaarin, 'ani abni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ nahaytukum 'an ziyaaraai alqubuwri fazuwruwhaa wanahaytukum 'an luhuwmi alaadaahiyyi fawqa thalaathin faaamsikuwa maa badaa lakum wanahaytukum 'ani alnnabiydhi iilaaa fiy siqaa'in faashrabuwa fiy alaasqiyaai kullihaa walaa tashrabuwa muskirana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu numayrin fiy riwaayatihi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni buraydaaa 'an aabiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Buraida reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:I forbade you to visit graves, but you may now visit them; I forbade you to eat the flesh of sacrificial animals after three days, but you way now keep it as along as you feel inclined; and I forbade you nabidh except in a water-skin, you may drink it from all kinds of water-skins, but you must not drink anything intoxicating
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ الْيَامِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، أُرَاهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - الشَّكُّ مِنْ أَبِي خَيْثَمَةَ - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح . وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح . وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلُّهُمْ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي سِنَانٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an zubaydin alyaamiyyi, 'an muhaaribi bni dithaarin, 'ani abni buraydaaa, auraahu 'an aabiyhi, - alshhakku min aabiy khaythamaaa - 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h . wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa qabiysaau bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an sufyaana, 'an 'alqamaaa, bni marthadin 'an sulaymaana bni buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h . wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'an 'ataa'in alkhuraasaaniyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu buraydaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kulluhum bima'naa hadiythi aabiy sinaanin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 11 — The Book of Prayer - Funerals
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَوْنُ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ الْكُوفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِمَشَاقِصَ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'awnu bnu salaaamin alkuwfiyyu, aakhbaranaa zuhayrun, 'an simaakin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala autiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm birajulin qatala nafsahu bimashaaqisa falam yusalli 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported:(The dead body) of a person who had killed himself with a broad-headed arrow was brought before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), but he did not offer prayers for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
